tei:div.tei:p: — — ga 7/ bas ra—— sadrag / ོ nga ༄ / rangathol sunga'athum (go thanig ) mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang / —
/ ༷) she))shaṃshe//༵di )

dkar chagamachod brjod/ (1)gleng gzhi/ (2)mtsho snying dben pa'i dga' tshal nas dad can yon bdag pho mo rnams la gdams pa'i skor/ (7)mtsho snying ma hā de ba nas yul phyogs gdul byas zhus lan chab shog gi skor/ (230)sa bcu'i dbang phyug rma chen sbom ra'i gangs ri'i mgul nas bzhengs pa'i skor/ (319)brag dkar sprel rdzong dang kya phug pad+ma rdzong dang zwa lung sogs nas bzhengs pa'i skor/ (394)dben gnas khyad 'phags dag pa mkha' spyod dpal gyi tsā ri tra nas bzhengs pa'i skor/ (442)gnas chen gangs dkar gyi rgyal po te se nas bzhengs pa'i skor/ (499)1

gangs ri nas phyir phebs shing khyung lung dang spu hrengs sogs sa cha mang bo brgyud skabs bzhengs pa'i skor/ (632)bal yul mchod rten rnam gnyis la mjal du phebs pa'i lam skabs dang bka' brgyud gong ma'i gdan sa 'brog la phyi gangs kyi ra ba nas bzhengs pa'i skor/ (669)dbus gtsang sogs nas bzhengs pa kha thor sna tshogs pa'i skor/ (690)springs yig ka la piṅka'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so (739)nyams mgur khu byug sngon mo'i skad snyan bzhugs so// (743)'dun ma legs pa'i mgur dbyangs gdangs snyan pi wang gling bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (745)dam chos gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so (747)rgyal ba yab sras la phul ba'i zhu shog rab dkar gos bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (749)skyo mgur pi wang rgyud mang bzhugs so/ / (753)man ngag gser gyi thur ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (757)2
'a drin gyis 'tsho ba'i ban chuche gyi bri 'i sto tshin sa sa pa ba da ba

nga mchod brjod/na mo gu ru/ phun tshogs dge legs bye bas bskrun pa'i mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa'i sku/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i re ba ji bzhin skong ba'i yan lag drug cu'i gsung / /gang la nye ring med par brtse zhing shes bya mtha' dag mkhyen pa'i thugs/ /zhing kun 'od kyis 'geng bzhin chos 'khor bskor ba'i sangs rgyas mgos phyag 'tshal/ /zla med ston pa de yi gsung rab dgongs 'grel mtha' dag rgya gar nas/ /bod du bsgyur mkhas sa thob sangs rgyas byang sems lo paṇa mkhas grub dang / /nyams su blangs nas sa lam mthar phyin dam pa gong ma thams cad kyi/ /sku drin rnam thar dran bzhin lan gcig ma yin yang yang gus pas 'dud/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo rgyud rnams dang rgya bod mkhas grub tshad ldan gyi/ /legs bshad zla med ji bzhin rang gzhan kun gyis go sla 'khyer bde phyir/ /bdag gis mgur dbyangs gang blangs gang gis thos kyang dngos sam brgyud nas kyang / /rgyud la phan thogs rgya chen 'byung bar yang dang yang du byin gyis rlobs//

gleng gzhi/de yang skye dka' ba gling bzhi yi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa lho 'dzam bu gling du skyes/ thob par dka' ba mi yi nang nas dbang bo sgo lnga tshang ba'i mi lus gtsang ma thob mjal bar dka' ba bla ma'i nang nas mtshan nyid tshang ba'i bla ma dang mjal/ 'phrad par dka' ba chos kyi nang nas sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas par 'phrad pa'i dus 'dir dkar bo dge ba'i las la brtson zhing / nag po mi dge sdig pa'i las rnams spong dgos te/ da res mi dge spangs nas dge ba rnam dag cig ma byas na/ phyin chad yang nas yang du 'dzam bu'i gling du mi skye/ sgyes kyang mi lus gtsang ma mi thob/thob kyang mtshan ldan gyi bla ma dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan par mi mjal/ mjal kyang dam chos sgrub pa'i rang dbang rang la e thob mi shes/ des na dal 'byor don ldan zhig byed dgos/de yang myur du brtson pas ma 'bad na mi tshe yun thung / rgas dus mi nus/ nam 'chi cha med pas/ phyi bshol ga le sos dal byed mi rung / 'dus byas kyi 'khor ba'i chos thams cad mi rtag de 2

yi nang nas lhag par sha khrag gi lus 'di ni chu yi chu bur lta bur yal bar sla bas do nub tsam yang mi 'chi snyam pa'i blo gtad med de/ skye bo pho mo gzhon nu lang tsho dar la bab pa rnams kyang glo bur du shi ba mang bas na/ dbugs rlangs pa tsam drod me stag tsam pa 'di'i rgyun skad cig tsam la 'chad nyen yod/ rgan gzhon la go rim med/ pho mo la bzang ngan med/ gzugs byad la yag btsog med/ nam 'chi la nges pa med/ skad cha'i bshad 'phro/ zas kyi za 'phro/ gos kyi gyon 'phro/ las kyi byed 'phro thams cad bzhag nas shi tshe/ kho shi'o mo shi'o zer ba'i gtam ngan gcig min mi 'dug de dus rang nyid gcig pu rgyus med cha med kyi bar do'i 'phrang ring brgyud nas skyabs med mgon med du 'jig rten pha rol tu 'gro dgos/ rgyu mi dge ba byas na ngan song gsum dang ngan 'gro'i rigs su skye/ ngan song gsum du skyes na tsha grang bkres skom bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa yun ring du myong dgos/ ngan 'gro'i rigs zha long 'on lkugs bran g.yog sprang bo nad pa dbang chung khas dman sogs su skyes na sdug bsngal che ba mthong chos su yod pa 'di rnams yin/ rgyu dge ba byas na mngon mtho lha'am mi'i go 'phang dang / nges legs 3

thar ba tsam dang thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob la/ mngon mtho lha'am mi'i gnas su skyes na rigs gzugs 'byor dang dbang phyug shes rab tshe ring nad med bde dang ldan zhing / mtshan ldan gyi bla ma du ma'i zhabs rdul bsten nas zab rgya'i chos la thos bsam sgom gsur/ byas nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob nus/ 'khor ba'i gnas 'di nas thar nas dag pa'i zhing khams bde ba can la sogs su skyes na skye rga na 'chi la sogs sdug bsngal gyi ming tsam yang mi thos par 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la spyod bzhin/ mgon po 'od dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs/ mthu chen thob sogs bla mar bsten nas gsung gi bdud rtsi myang tshe sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bde blag tu thob nus/ thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob na sku mtshan bzang bo sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang bo brgyad cus spras pa/ sku mthong na mi mthun pa med cing 'gro ba gang gi mig yid dbang med du 'phrog pa/gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i gdangs pi wang gling bu las brgya stong 'gyur gyis snyan cing / lha klu mi la sogs so so'i skad du chos ston nus/ thugs kyis chos thams cad phyag mthil du gzigs pa ltar sa ler mkhyen cing / mi gcig gis g.yon nas 4

sku la sta gris gshag cing / g.yas nas mi gcig gis sku la tsan dan gyi lde gus byugs kyang / de gnyis la nye ring chags sdang cung zad tsam yang mi mdzad cing phan gnod bar ma'i sems can gang la mas bu la byams pa ltar brtse zhing / sems can 'dul ba'i dus la bab tshe dmyal ba'i me dong yin yang 'dod ldan pad+ma'i tshal la 'jug pa ltar zhugs nas don byed nus/sku yi 'od zer lan re tsam spros pas kyang sems can mang bo smin grol gyi lam la 'god nus/ sems can gnas khang med pa zhig gis gsol ba btab kyang skad cig gcig la rin po che las grub pa'i khang ba sprul nas ster nus/ zas gos 'dod pa'i sems can sogs la yang nam mkha' sogs la phyag brkyangs nas lha'i gos/ ro brgya'i zas sogs byin nas ci 'dod kyi re ba skong nus/ mdor na sangs rgyas ni skyon kun zad yon tan kun ldan/ phan btags ma btags med par sems can thams cad kyi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen byed pa yin/ des na rgyu mi dge ba spangs nas dge ba bsgrub dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin/ 'o na rgyu mi dge ba de gang yin zer na/ mang bo yod kyang bsdu na/ srog gcod pa/ ma byin len/ mi tshangs spyod/dzun/ phra ma/ tshig rtsub/ ngag 'khyal/ brnab sems/ gnod 5

sems/ log lta 'di rnams yin pas / srog la babs kyang mi byed pa dgos/ gal te ma shes pa'am/ mnyam ma bzhag par cung zad re byas kyang rab tu 'gyod bzhin bshags sdom byed pa gal che/ 'o na rgyu dge ba de gang yin zer na/ che shos rags pa tsam bshad na/ yi ge 'bri ba/ dkon mchog mchod pa/ sbyin pa gtong ba/ chos nyan pa/ klog pa/ 'dzin pa/ 'chang ba/ kha ton byed pa/ sems pa/ bsgom pa rnams yin/ de rnams gang bsgrubs kyang gtso bo sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i don du dmigs nas nyin mtshan gang du 'bad rtsol drag pos byed pa gal che/ de ltar spong rgyu'i mi dge ba spong tshul/bsgrub rgyu'i dge ba de sgrub tshul rnams rgyas par rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo sngags rnams dang rgya bod mkhas grub rnams kyis gsungs pa'i bstan bcos mtha' dag yin la/ de bzhin du bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyes lhag bsam dag pa'i sgo nas rang gzhan kun gyis shin tu go sla zhing 'khyer bde ba'i slad du tshigs bcad mgur dbyangs kyi tshul du 'then pa 'di rnams la dad can pho mo rnams kyis ma yengs par nyon la phyi nas lag len la ci thebs byed par 'tshal/

mtsho snying dben pa'i dga' tshal nas dad can yon bdag pho mo rnams la gdams pa'i skor/bla ma ma lus spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /slob ma ma lus thugs rje spyan gyis gzigs/ /mi med ri khrod 'grim pa'i rnal 'byor glu/ /yengs med skal ldan slob bu gus pas nyon/ /thob dka'i mi lus rin chen da res thob/ /mjal dka'i lha chos mjal ba skal ba bzang / /tshe 'di'i bya ba bsams na mkho ba mang / /tshe rabs mang bor bsgrubs kyang tshar dus med/ /nam 'chi cha med phyir la sgu mi skye/ /nam yang phyi mar rang nyid bde thabs gyis/ /nyi ma bzhin du phyogs ris ma mchis pa'i/ /bla ma rnams la gang yod 'brel ba zhog /dge 'dun pa rnams bsod nams zhing gi mchog /dge slong ban+de gang la bsnyen bkur gyis/ /drin can pha ma 'dzom pa tshe stod yin/ /drin gzo yod na gyis min 'chi la nye/ /nor rdzas mi rtag rtswa kha'i zil ba 'dra/ /nor la ser sna ma byed mchod sbyin thongs/ /'gro kun skye ba sngon 7

ma'i pha ma yin/ /'gro la phan mi thogs rung gnod ma skyel/ /zha long 'on lkugs nad pa sprang bo la/ /zhwa lham zas gos sogs byen gang byams gyes/ /yul gzhan gnas mjal ba la skom chu blud/ /yul mi khyim mtshes phan thogs g.yor skyi gyis/ /tshe 'dir ma chags lha chos thub tshad sgrubs/ /tshe rabs phyi mar bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /glu 'di thos tshad bsam pa dung las dkar/ /ci zhig byas tshad chos su 'gro bar shog /ces pa 'di ni dad ldan slob bu lha 'brug dge slong la smras pa'o//drin can bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe 'di mi rtag ston ga'i sprin dang 'dra/ /pha ma nye 'brel tshong 'dus mgron po 'dra/ /nyam chung lus 'di chu yi lbu ba 'dra/ /nor rdzas mi rtag rtswa mgo'i zil ba 'dra/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos la snying bo med/ /snying bo yod pa dam pa'i lha chos yin/ /dam chos byed pa'i dus ni da res tsam/ /ma byed ma byed tshe 'di'i bya ba zhog /byed na byed na dam pa'i lha chos gyis/ /phyug po phal cher rang gis za mi phod/ /gzhan la mi ster chos phyogs gtong mi nus/ /shi dus zas nor don med 'a ga tu 'gro/ /phyi mar lag stong 'gro dus snying re rje/ /ma yin ma yin phyug po'i bya ba nor/ /yin na yin na gson dus 8

mchod sbyin thongs/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba bsams na dgos pa mang / /rta gcig rnyed na sga gcig 'tshol dgos pas/ /mi dgos dgu dgos 'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos/ /byas kyang mi tshar tshar kyang snying bo med/ /ma byed ma byed tshe 'di blo yis thongs/ /byed na byed na sdig spang dge bsgrub gyis/ /'jig rten pa rnams dgra 'dul gnyen skyong dang / /yod pa 'tsho skyong med pa btsal rnyed dang / /tshong dang zhing las kho nas g.yeng g.yengs nas/ /yod med gnyis gas mi tshe sdug zad byed/ /ma shi bar du khom pa'i dus mi 'byung / /shi nas phyir la 'ong ba'i mi gcig med/ /ma byed ma byed tshar med bya ba zhog /byed na byed na phyag skor kha ton gyis/ /tshe 'di'i lto rgyab 'dang ba ma gtogs pa/ /gsog 'jog mang bo byas nas nam tshod za/ /mi tshe yun thung la mgo'i nyi zer 'dra/ /nyi zer yun ring e sdod bsam blo thongs/ /tshe 'di'i zas nor kho na bsog bsogs nas/ /yun ring sdod rtsis byed rnams blo snying rul/ /ma gsog ma gsog zas dang nor ma gsog /gsog na gsog na 'phags pa'i nor bdun gsogs/ /lo bcu nas bzung rgan po brgyad cu'i bar/ /'chi ba yong snyam med pa'i blo ring tsho/ /don med tshe 'di'i lto rgyab bsgrub bsgrubs nas/ /da res stong log byas na bya ba nor/ /'chi dus dgos pa 9

dam pa'i chos yin pas/ /ma shi gong 'dir chos shig mi byed dam/ /ma ring ma ring ha cang blo ma ring / /da lta da lta 'chi bro lha chos gyis/ /lo brgya thub pa'i mi ni shin tu dka'/ /da lta'i tshe tshad drug cu bdun cu ste/ /tshe stod dam chos mi dran tshe smad la/ /dran kyang mi nus bar gyi tshe la yang / /phyed ka gnyid dang bza' btung g.yeng bas 'khyer/ /dam chos sgrub skabs cung zad tsam min med/ /cung zad tsam las med pa mi shes par/ /dam chos mi byed yun ring sdod gshom byed/ /blo rgya can tsho'i snying la gdon gang zhugs/ /ma byed ma byed rnam g.yeng las ma byed/ /byed na byed na don chen sgrub skabs yin/ /glo bur 'chi ba'i nad kyis bzung tsa na/ /sman dang rim gro byas kyang bzlog pa dka'/ /sman pa rim gro byed rnams ngo 'dzum gnag /kho bo 'chi snyam 'jigs skrag 'gyod pa skye/ /bu dang bu mor 'bral snyam mchi ma gtong / /mig gis hrig trig lta zhing kha chems 'jog /ma byed ma byed kha chems dgos pa med/ /byed na byed na da lta dge rtsa gyis/ /pha mas bu tsha gces par bskyangs na yang / /pha ma shi dus dge rtsa byed mkhan dkon/ /snyigs dus bu la blo gtad ci yang med/ /rang dbang rang la yod dus dge phyogs gyes/ /gal te gson dus dge rtsa byed khom ni/ /ma byung glo bur 'chi na kha 10

chems la/ /nga ni mi rnyed yul du 'gro ba yin/ /khyed rnams rnyed kyi yul nas 'dug pas na/ /nga la dge rtsa ci nus thongs zhes shod/ /de min kho bo phyir la 'ong rgyu ltar/ /lab lab mang bos 'chi khar dgos pa med/ /kha cig 'chi dus kho la dge rtsa ni/ /mi dgos khyod tsho rnams kyi kha rgyab dka'/ /zer ba de ni dper na mun nag tu/ /'gro la mar me mi dgos dkar ngogs su/ /'dug pa rnams la dgos zhes bshad pa 'dra/ /mi de smyos sam don snying rul ba yin/ /ma bshad ma bshad de 'dra ma bshad par/ /bshad na bshad na dge rtsa thongs zhes shod/ /ma shi gong nas ro thag yol ba rnams/ /sta gon byed cing phyi dbugs chad ma thag /tha gus bsdams te yol bas bsgribs nas 'jog /gnyen rnams thams cad 'dus nas ngu 'bod byed/ /sngas mgor bla ma gdan drangs dril bu dkrol/ /ro yi drung du bza' btung skal ba ni/ /cung zad tsam re 'jog pa'i dus tshod de/ /do nub nangs par mi 'ong nges pa med/ /ma ring ma ring blo sna ma ring bar/ /da lta da lta chos la 'bad na legs/ /thams cad bzhag nas rang nyid gcig pu ru/ /sngon chad thos kyang 'gro ma myong ba yi/ /rgyus med cha med bar do'i 'phrang ring 'grims/ /gshin rje chos rgyal drung du song tsa na/ /gshin rje chos rgyal zhal nas 'di skad 11

gsung / /khyod ni dam chos dar ba'i yul du skyes/ /bla ma'i zhal nas nga yis dge sdig gi /shan phyes dge ba byas rnams yar la gtong / /sdig pa byas rnams mar la gtong ngo zhes/ /gsung ba go nas dge ba byas los yod/ /dkon mchog mchod pa dbul bo sbyin gtong dang / /drin can bla ma pha ma'i zhabs tog sogs/ /dge ba gang byas drang bor shod cig zer/ /'jigs so 'jigs so sems yod skyes bu rnams/ /ma bsgrub ma bsgrub ngan 'gro'i rgyu ma bsgrub/ /da lta da lta mi 'chi nges pa med/ /kye ma kye hud shi na de ru 'gro/ /rang gis rang la sha tsha byed snyam na/ /ma sdod ma sdod da lta lha chos rem/ /ma nyal ma nyal phyag dang skor ba gyis/ /e ma e ma mtho ris thar lam la/ /mi rnams mi rnams mig gis yar la ltos/ /myur ba myur bar de la 'gro thabs gyis/ /glu 'di thos tshad 'chi bar rab 'jigs nas/ /phyi mar skyid pa'i lha chos byed par shog /ces pa 'di ni dad ldan lhun grub sogs a rig yon bdag rnams la tshogs drug rang grol gyis mtsho snying nas smras pa'o//spyi gtsug pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng gi /sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma byen rlabs can/ /bdag dang bdag 'dra'i rtag 'dzin can rnams kyis/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran par byen gyis rlobs/ /mkhar khang mi rtag dri za'i grong khyer 'dra/ /rgyu nom mi 12

rtag rtswa kha'i zil ba 'dra/ /gnyen bshes mi rtag tshong 'dus mgron po 'dra/ /sgyu lus mi rtag chu yi chu bur 'dra/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos la rtag pa med/ /thams cad mi rtag mi brtan tshul soms la/ /ma byed ma byed mi dge'i las ma byed/ /byed na byed na dge ba'i las la 'bod/ /bla chen rgyal blon phyug po man chad nas/ /zha long 'on lkugs bran g.yog sprang bo yan/ /sngon chad ma shi lus pa gcig tsam med/ /da lta'i mchog dman bar gsum thams cad 'chi/ /rang nyid nges par 'chi ba'i tshul soms la/ /ma byed ma byed brkus dang jag ma byed/ /byed na byed na phyag dang skor ba gyis/ /'dzam bu'i gling 'di'i tshe la nges pa med/ /'chi ba'i rkyen mang sman gyi nus pa chung / /na so rgas nas shi ba'i pho mo nyung / /gzhon nu dar bab dus su shi ba mang / /rang nyid nam 'chi mi shes tshul soms la/ /ma byed ma byed srog gcod las ma byed/ /byed na byed na ra lug tshe thar gyis/ /mi rnams 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa'i tshe/ /sdig gsog byas pa'i rgyu nor shul du ldus/ /yun ring 'grogs pa'i gnyen bshes rnams dang 'bral/ /rang gi lus kyang mal du bskyur nas 'gro/ /grogs khrid rgyu nom khyer nas song ba med/ /'chi dus thams cad 'jog pa'i tshul soms la/ /ma byed ma byed ser sna ma byed 13

par/ /byed na byed na rgyu nom chos phyogs thongs/ /phyi mar dkar bo dge ba byas pa'i mi/ /mtho ris thar ba'i lam la gyen du 'gro/ /nag po mi dge sdig pa byas pa'i mi/ /ngan song gsum gye lam la thur du 'gro/ /da lta yar mar gang la 'gro ba'i dbang / /rang gi lag na yod pa'i tshul soms la/ /ma byed ma byed mi dge chung ngu 'dzems/ /byed na byed na dge tshogs mtha' dag sgrubs/ /da res lus 'di'i thog nas chos ma bsgrubs/ /sdig pa byas pa ngan song gsum du skye/ /bskal pa bye ba brgyar yang mi yi lus/ /thob pa phar zhog bde 'gro'i sgra mi thos/ /dmyal bar skyes na tsha grang sdug bsngal che/ /yi dwags gnas su skyes na ltogs shing skom/ /dud 'gro'i gnas su skyes na gcig gis gcig /za zhing bkol spyod glen rmongs sdug bsngal mang / /ma byed ma byed ngan song rgyu ma bsgrub/ /byed na byed na mtho ris skye thabs kyis/ /glu 'di thos tshad dad can pho mo yis/ /mi rtag myur du 'chi ba'i tshul bsams nas/ /yud tsam tshe 'di'i bde la mi chags par/ /phyi mar bde ba'i thabs la 'bad par shog /ces pa 'di yang dge slong mi pham bstan 'dzin la smras pa'o//spyi gtsug pad+ma nyi zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma byen rlabs can/ /dad can yon bdag pho mo yi/ /blo kha dam pa'i chos la 14

sgyur/ /dper na dgong dus skar ma rnams/ /nam mkhar shar nas khra shigs se/ /yod pa nangs dus mi snang ltar/ /chos rnams mi rtag de dang 'dra/ /dper na ri ngos spang gshong gi /dkar ser dmar ljang me tog rnams/ /snga phyi byas nas rnyid 'gro ltar/ /chos rnams mi rtag de dang 'dra/ /dper na sngo ljang rtsi shing gi /lo ma me tog 'bras bu rnams/ /thams cad sa la ltung ba ltar/ /chos rnams mi rtag de dang 'dra/ /mi lus rin chen myur du 'jig /'bral mi phod rung bza' tshang 'bral/ /bsogs pa'i rgyu nor shul du ldus/ /'khor ba'i chos la rtag pa med/ /mi lus rin chen ma zhig gong / /bza' tshang ma bral 'dzom pa'i dus/ /rgyu nom steng nas chos bsgrub dgos/ /lha chos mdun du mar me sbor/ /a mchod zhog la bka' chos klogs/ /bla ma rnams la dbang lung zhus/ /dbul bor rgyu nor bza' btung byen/ /pha ma a khur brtsi bkur rem/ /sgo khye phyugs la ma brdung gsos/ /g.yog po g.yog mor kha rgyab 'chos/ /g.yas g.yon khyem mtshes g.yor skyi gyis/ /rang gzhan dge la dga' ba sgoms/ /sngar byas sdig la 'gyod bshags gyis/ /snying rje nyam thag 'gro la ltos/ /snying bo yi ge drug ma thon/ /bar bar nam 'chi cha med soms/ /skabs skabs phyag skor sdom pa srungs/ /rgyun du bsam pa dkar 15

bo gyis/ /'gro la phan pa thub tshad sgrubs/ /phan mi thogs rung gnod ma skyel/ /de ltar mdzad na tshe 'di dang / /phyi mar bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /glu 'di thos tshad khyim pa yis/ /'di bzhin dkar chos bsgrub par shog /ces pa 'di yang yon bdag blo gsal la smras pa'o//gang 'dod chos gsung bla ma'i rigs/ /gang la'ang sgo gsum gus pas 'dud/ /gangs can bod kyi glu ba ngas/ /gang shar glu dbyangs snyan mo len/ /gangs ri dung ltar bsam pa dkar/ /gang nus dge sgrub slob bu nyon/ /gang mkhas bla ma bsten pa'i mi/ /gang gis lugs gnyis blang dor shes/ /gang la nam yang phan 'dogs pa'i/ /gang zag gzhan gyis mthong na dga'/ /gang la gnod pa bskyal ba'i mi/ /gang gis mthong yang yid mi 'ong / /gang zab rgya che'i chos thos nas/ /gang bzang ri nas bsgoms na legs/ /gang la ma chags sgom byed pa'i/ /gang zag rgyud la nyams rtogs 'char/ /gang la snying bo med pa mthong / /gang nus dge sbyor byas na 'tshengs/ /gang du 'gro 'am 'dug kyang rung / /gang la ngan smra ma byed bzang / /gang zag gzhan gyi skyon rig kyang / /gang la ma bshad sel thub ltos/ /gang yang rtag pa med pa shes/ /gang rnyed gsog 'jog ma byas bde/ /gang yod mchod sbyin byas gyur na/ /gang 'dod bde skyid 16

snyan gsum 'byung / /gang shar glu dbyangs blangs pa 'di/ /gang gis thos tshad bde skyid shog /ces pa 'di yang slob bu tshul khrims 'byung gnas la smras pa'o//kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /kun gyis legs nyes shes par byen gyes rlobs/ /ya rabs dad can yon bdag pho mo la/ /'phral phugs phan pa'i kha ta bshad kyis nyon/ /drin can gang yin de la drin gzo gyis/ /rgan gzhon bsam dkar phan pa'i tshig la nyon/ /pha mas yon tan ci yod bu la slobs/ /bu yis ci bya drin can pha mar dris/ /mna' mas a bye a khur brtsi bkur gyis/ /a ne mna' ma ma bu bzhin du 'grogs/ /chen mas chun mar kha tshig rkyang ma byed/ /g.yog po g.yog mos gang bcol go chod gyis/ /khyem mtshes grogs la na tsha byung na dris/ /gzhon nu sha khrag rgyas dus phyag skor rem/ /zas nor longs spyod 'dzom dus med phongs skyongs/ /rgyu nom gang bzang chos kyi phyogs su thongs/ /mi la na tsha byung dus sku rim gyes/ /phyugs la god kha byung na srung ma mchod/ /gzhan gyis ma thub dus su las grogs gyis/ /gtam rnams thams cad mi bden rtogs dpyod dgos/ /bden rdzun gang yin ma shes thag ma gcod/ /min rung nga'i 'di yin zhes mna' ma skyel/ /rang 17

gis mi shes bya ba grogs la dris/ /yul mi khyem mtshes bar du kha ma rgyag /bsod nams kha ru bud na khog tu sbos/ /khyim du ltas ngan byung na bzlog pa gyis/ /gos bzang khyim nas ma rdzob khrom du ngom/ /zas bzang lkog tu ma za kun la byin/ /srog gcod byas nas nam yang chos ma bco/ /brkus jag ri dwags bsad nas kha ma gso/ /dzun gtam g.yo sgyu byas nas tshong ma byed/ /gzhan gyi sems la mi 'bab tshig ma spra/ /lha chos sang la ma 'jog da lta gyis/ /nam 'chi cha med ha cang nor ma gsog /za ma 'pho zags ma byed la yog 'byung / /ban sngags na pa ma brnyas mkho dus yod/ /'chi dus dgos med kha chems rkyang ma 'jog /shi chad byung dus ma ngu dge rtsa thongs/ /skyid sdug thams cad sngon gye las su soms/ /tshe 'dir dge sdig gnyis kyi gang che ltos/ /sdig pa che na 'gyod bzhin bshags sdom gyis/ /dge ba che na dga' bzhin da dung sgrubs/ /mdor na mi lus rin chen thob dus 'dir/ /mis smon bdag skyid chos mthun bya ba gyes//glu 'di thos tshad ya rabs dad pa can/ /yon bdag pho mo'i rgyud la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang yon bdag pho mo yongs la smras pa'o//kun mkhyen chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo la/ /gsol ba 'debs so yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /ya rabs rigs 18

bzang dbang rgyal ja sag la/ /lugs gnyis bslab bya cung zad tsam zhig bya/ /drin can bla ma pha ma spyi bor bkur/ /phan 'dogs gzhung bzang can gyi grogs dang 'grogs/ /mdza' dga' mgron skyid can gyi chung ma longs/ /gang bcol go chod lag gtsang bran g.yog zhog /mdza' mthun khyem mtshes bsten la g.yor skyi gyis/ /pha tshan dgra ru ma len gnyen du khug /rang sder khral dang 'u lag rkyang ma 'jog /mi rgyus ma lon bar du blo ma gtod/ /rang la blo phugs gtad pa'i mi ma bslu/ /btsog dang mi kha 'go ba'i nad la 'dzems/ /kha dkar khog nag mi la blo ma 'dri/ /kha dbyen rdzun tshig che ba'i gtam ma nyan/ /las bzang gang byed gza' skar bzang dang stun/ /khrel yod grogs la nam yang sun ma skur/ /mi thub dgra dang chu la phod ma btsong phar song med pa'i mi la yus ma che/ /mi mang gseb tu gsang ba'i tshig ma sgog /che btsun mang sar 'chal ba'i gtam ma smra/ /lha 'dre rgod sar gnyid dang mtshan ma 'gro/ /ngo nag khog dug che ba'i rtsar ma 'dug /spyod ngan ma rabs rnams dang 'dris ma che/ /mi thub pa la dka' ba'i las ma bcol/ /mi shes blun por gtam dang gros ma 'dri/ /kha la mi nyan pa la blo ma ston/ /las ngan sdig po che la yid ma smon/ /gzhan gyi nor rdzas ha cang rngam 19

ma che/ /spro thung gyod 'khon can gyi khyem mtshes spongs/ /gyod dang gtam ngan can gyi nor ma nyo/ /dug dang mnol btsog shor ba'i zas la 'dzems/ /dkon mchog gtan du 'dor ba'i mna' ma za/ /khyem tshang sde ba'i don du sdig ma gsog /mi dge phyogs la su la'ang blo ma ston/ /gzhan skyon ma tshol rang skyon rtog la sgongs/ /bya ba phal cher yul dus skabs dang stun/ /bla ma bzang bo bsten la bka' chos nyon/ /mi rtag 'chi ba soms la lha chos 'bod/ /nor rdzas mi rtag snyam du mchod sbyin thongs/ /'di phyi'i blo gtad dkon mchog gsum la gyes/ /'phral rkyen sel phyir yul lha gzhi bdag rngon/ /rtag tu chos dang mthun pa'i bya ba gyis/ /glu 'di thos tshad dad can pho mo yis/ /bslab bya 'di rnams sems la 'dzin par shog /ces pa 'di yang dad ldan dbang rgyal ja sag la smras pa'o//lugs gnyis kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal por 'dud/ /lugs gnyis blang dor shes par byin gyis rlobs/ /dad gtong che ba'i yon bdag tshe dpal la/ /lugs gnyis 'dor len kha ta cung zad bya/ /dkon mchog skyabs su bsten na 'di phyir bde/ /bla ma ci mnyes byas na ci bsam 'grub/ /yi dam bsnyen sgrub 'bungs na dngos grub stsol/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong mchod na bar chad 20

sel/ /yul lha gzhi bdag brngan na sdongs grogs byed/ /nor lha g.yang lha mchod na phywa g.yang 'khor/ /rje dpon zhwa bzhin bkur na kha 'dzin che/ /drin can pha ma bkur na kun gyis smon/ /stobs chen dpa' bor 'grogs na dgra kha'i thar/ /phyug po gnyen du bsdebs na longs spyod thob/ /grogs bzang mkhas pa bsten na rang don 'grub/ /zhing las 'tsho skyong mkhas na phyug por 'gyur/ /sems dkar gzhan phan che na kun gyis bkur/ /blo phugs rgan la dris na babs mi brdal/ /blo dris gros byas klad na 'gyod pa chung / /rtog dpyod zhib tu btang na legs nyes shes/ /gzhan la phrag dog med na rang sems bde/ /mi nor zas gsum 'dzoms na kun gyis brtsi/ /g.yo sgyu khram dzun med na kun dang mthun/ /tshig la yangs khog che na kha mchu nyung / /bza' tshang rtse dgod che na khyim tshang skyid/ /rnam dkar dge chos bsgrubs na 'di phyir bde/ /chung nas thos pa byas na mkhas par 'ong / /ban sngags ngag nus che na 'dre gdon thul/ /sgom chen ri nas bsdad na nyams rtogs 'phel/ /btsun pas 'dul khrims bsrungs na bsnyen bkur 'du/ /rgyal po bzang bo skyes na rgyal khams bde/ /blon bo bzang bo bzhag na rgyal khrims dam/ /a khu bzang bo skyes na rten bzhengs mang / /pha mye yang bye bzang 21

na 'go ru mang / /bu tsha bzang bo skyes na pha ma skyid/ /bu mos gnas go chod na ma sems bde/ /mna' ma bzang mo blangs na a ne dal/ /rta bzang gong nas song na gar yang sleb/ /zas bzang gzhan la byen na dga' mgu gus/ /gos bzang khrom du gyon na kun gyis smon/ /rgyal po ngan pa skyes na rgyal khams 'khrug /blon pos bden rdzun bsnogs na rgyal khrims 'jig /btsun pas khe tshong byas na 'dul khrims 'chor/ /rje dpon kha btsan che na bran g.yog dka'/ /chung ma kha lce rgod na nye ring 'byed/ /bu mo mgo bo yang na mi khas 'phog /bu tsha'i kha lag ngan na kha mchur thug /a khu'i kha tshag che na rang kha phyi/ /sdar mas dpa' skad bshad na rogs kyis 'phya/ /khas dman rgyu nom che na dgra la 'chor/ /rabs chad rgyu nom shi na gzhan gyes 'thob/ /mi chags rta rgyug byas na mgo chag 'ong / /phyug po ser sna che na rang mchu bcing / /med pos za 'thung che na za yun thung / /bsod chung cung zad rnyed na kha pho che/ /ngan pa zas kyis rgyags na skad mgo mtho/ /pho ngan skad cha bshad na 'or log mang / /'don ngan chos chen klog na tshig skyag mang / /ma rabs mtho sar bzhag na kun la sdang / /pha ma rgas dus brnyas na mi kha 'du/ /'jigs sar gnas gzhi bzung na 'jigs skrag 'ong / /22

ban sngags bon dang 'gras na byad khas sdang / /phugs su rdzas ngan bcug na god kha 'byung / /gnyan sar sa rdo bslogs na klu nad 'ong / /yul lha gzhi bdag dkrugs na thog ser 'bab/ /dran tshad kha ru bton na kha mchur thug /don med 'gro 'dug mang na don chen 'chor/ /phan med mgron sna bsdus na zas nor gyong / /sems la rnam rtog che na gdon gye gzhi/ /dpe ngan gzhan la bton na rang la 'khor/ /nor la sdigs rdung byas na g.yang lha nyams/ /mi dge sdig la rngam na ngan 'gror ltung / /glu 'di thos tshad skye bo pho mo yis/ /lugs gnyis legs nyes blang dor shes par shog /ces pa 'di yang yon bdag tshe dpal la smras pa'o//bla ma dkon mchog byin rlabs can/ /khyem pa'i shes rgyud byen gyes rlobs/ /gson po'i bar chad sel ba dang / /shi bo'i lam sna 'dren mkhan gyi/ /bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis/ /'khrungs yul 'gro ba snying rje nas/ /phyag dang mchod pa'i zhing sa la/ /dgon pa btab nas rten bzhengs byos/ /yon bdag phul ba'i dkor zas rnams/ /chud zos btang nas ci zhig bya/ /dka' las myang ba don med red/ /sku gsung thugs rten du ma bzhengs/ /dge 'dun sde rnams mchod snyam nas/ /rgyu nom gang rnyed tshags byas bsogs/ /dkor nag dug chu 'dra ba'i zas/ /23

gsol 'phro mdun na ci yod kyang / /khyim pa pho mor 'di byen na/ /mi 'ju snyam nas ma byin na/ /khyem pa blun po 'ga' zhig gis/ /skyabs su mchi dang rgyang nas phyag /'tshal rgyu tshang zhig khong red zer/ /gcig gis ci red dris tsa na/ /rgyu nom steng na de ba ngan/ /'chi no de bas mi shes zer/ /mdun du song na gsol lhag 'dra/ /ci tsam yod rung ster mi dpe/ /de 'dra zer tsho mi nyan ta/ /mdzad spyod a khu cig tshang dang / /skog gtam pa la khyad med ki /bshad na gcig pos 'di skad zer/ /'o ang de 'dra zhig red ya/ /de nyin zhig la mdun du song / /nga la khong gis 'di zer gi /zer nas gnyis ka 'ur langs 'jog /de ni pha phugs mi shes pa'i/ /skye bo blun po'i skad cha yin/ /dgon pa'i lha khang nyams dga' na/ /sku gsung thugs rten khra lam me/ /yod pa de tsho gcig pu ltos/ /bla ma nom par dga' ba de/ /khyem pas kha rgyab 'geb snyam nas/ /bsogs pa lta bu ga la yin/ /rgyu nom bsogs pa'i lag rjes de/ /bltas na gsal bor mngon ka ang / /lo re bzhin du dgon pa la/ /'gyed phogs mang ja gtong la ltos/ /dgos pa ci red de yis shes/ /ser sna e che de yis go /bla mar rgyu nom mi mkho rung / /gdan 'dren ring thung mchog dman su/ /byung yang yon bdag tshogs rdzogs phyir/ /24

dgyes bzhin byon nas gang phul bzhes/ /gson po rnams kyi bar chad bsal/ /shi bo'i lam sna 'dren pa de/ /bsams na khyim pa bsod nams che/ /de min bla ma dge bshes tsho/ /bu dang bu mo gso rgyu med/ /gdan 'dren byas sar gcig ma phebs/ /rgyu nom gang phul gcig ma bzhes/ /ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /thams cad byon nas bzhugs bsdad na/ /gson po'i bar chad su yis sel/ /shi bo'i lam sna su yis 'dren/ /ci zhig byed rgyu dka' mo yin/ /bla ma rnams kyi mdzad spyod kyi/ /pha phugs skye bo mi nag pas/ /shes dka' 'phral gyi spyod pa rer/ /bltas nas kha yis gtong mi rung / /bla mas rtsam khug kha bzos nas/ /steng du rtags jel rgyag na yang / /de yi thugs dgongs ci yin nam/ /mi shes snyam du khas ma gtong / /rang gi thag nye'i bla ma'i rigs/ /shi gson gnyis shar bka' drin che/ /rtag tu mchod bstod bkur ste gyis/ /glu 'di thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /bla mar ngan smras mi byed shog/bla ma dkon mchog rin po che/ /khyem pa rnams kyi lam sna drongs/ /bla ma dam pa 'ga' zhig gis/ /theg pa kun gyi mchog gyur pa/ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi/ /rim gnyis gnad rtogs legs par bsgoms/ /rig ma bsten pa'i dus skabs 25

su/ /slebs tshe gsang nas mtshan ldan gyi/ /rig ma 'ga' re bsten pa la/ /skye bo blun po 'ga' zhig gis/ /sangs rgyas 'phrul snang gyi ling rta/ /'gyel zug a ho ma bzang zer/ /ci red dris na bla ma de/ /dang po bzang ta skyabs su mchi/ /phyi nas spyod pa khrig khrig 'dra/ /med ki spyod log rkyang bca' gi /ya gi tshang gi mna' ma dang / /ma gi tshang gi bu mor bzang / /khong gis chang re 'thung gi zhes/ /smras na gcig pos lan 'di zer/ /deng sang bla ma 'ga' zhig la/ /'dug mi thub pa ci zhig byung / /de yis mi tshad bla ma zhig /tshang gis 'di byed de byed zer/ /gnyis ka 'ur langs bla ma'i rigs/ /'ga' rer khas btang ha ha zhes/ /bgad nas e tsho'i thu red zer/ /bla ma 'ga' re'i spyod pa de/ /'phral du mig sngar mi mdzes rung / /phugs su dgos pa chen bo yod/ /de la brten nas rgya bod kyi/ /sngon byon mkhas grub phal che bas/ /mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa mang / /bla ma 'khrul bar ma snyam dang / /skyon gyis mi gos blo gdeng yod/ /chos log cig yin ma sems shig /de 'dra bsten dgos chos yod dar/ /bla ma 'ga' re'i mdzad spyod phugs/ /'o skol 'dra bas shes pa dka'/ /des na dad pa skyes na rab/ /min kyang kha yis gtong mi rung / /btang na nyes pa 'byung ba yin/ /glu 'di thos tshad 26

khyem pa yis/ /bla mar khas mi gtong bar shog /drin can chos rgyal zhabs la 'dud/ /nyon dang skye bo dad can tsho/ /deng sang dus ngan bla ma'i rigs/ /'di tsho skyon re che gi dang / /za chog 'thung chog 'di tsho min/ /yon tan chen po cang med ki /snyam nas dad log byed mi rung / /sngon dus sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /skyon zad yon tan kun ldan yang / /legs skar rang snang ma dag pa'i/ /stabs kyis yon tan gcig ma mthong / /ci mdzad skyon du mthong ba bzhin/ /bla ma skyon med yon tan dang / /ldan yang rang snang ma dag pa'i/ /stabs kyis bla ma'i yon tan rigs/ /ma mthong rang skyon phar shar ba/ /bla ma'i skyon ltar mthong ba yin/ /bla ma'i skyon yin ma snyam par/ /rang gi skyon yin snyam du soms/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i tshig don de gcig pu/ /soms dang bla ma e ngan gi /sangs rgyas byang sems phal cher gyis/ /bzang ngan sna tshogs tshul bzung nas/ /sems can rnams kyi don byed pas/ /'o skol rnams kyis shes pa dka'/ /bla mar skog tu ngan gtam na/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /lkog tu ngan gtam byas 27

dang mtshungs/ /tshe 'dir mi kha kha mchu 'byung / /phyi mar bla ma rnyed mi 'gyur/ /bla ma mchod bstod bkur thub na/ /phyogs bcu'i mchod 'os skyabs gyur kun/ /mchod cing bstod nas bkur dang mtshungs/ /tshe 'dir kun gyis mchod bstod bkur/ /phyi mar bla ma bzang bo yis/ /rtag tu rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur/ /de phyir khyim pa dad can tsho/ /rang gi yul phyogs bla ma la/ /skog nas ngan smras ma byed par/ /rtag tu mchod bstod bkur ste gyis/ /glu 'di thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /bla ma mchod bstod bkur bar shog/ 'dren mchog sangs rgyas thugs rje can/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis bod la gzigs/ /gsar rnying dgon pa gang yin yang / /sdig la 'dzem par byen gyes rlobs/ /dang po dgon pa 'debs pa'i tshe/ /khang ba'i sa rdo gyang brdung dus/ /grog ma la sogs 'bu srin rigs/ /brgya stong grangs med 'chi ru bcug /de nas shing sdig mang bo blangs/ /shing gnas 'bu yang brgya stong 'chi/ /shing cha mdzo g.yag glang la bkal/ /rgyab rnams thams cad sgal pas khengs/ /glo skrangs 'phongs bshus la la 'chi/ /shing bzo sa rdo shing len gye/ /kha bcos ra lug mang bo bsad/ /shing ris nang rten bzhengs pa'i tshe/ /tshon rtsi rgya yi lag nas nyos/ /rin 28

du ra lug g.yag sogs byin/ /de yang bshan pas gsod par 'gyur/ /lha bzo'i kha bcos 'ga' re bsad/ /rab gnas ston mor mang bo bsad/ /bar du la lung mang bo yi bzang ngan ser mo mang bo bsdus/ /de rnams gnas khang dbub phyir du/ /gong dang cha mthun sdig pa byed/ /yon tan gang yang mi slob par/ /rgyu nom gsog 'jog byed la brtson/ /lag tu nangs par ci zhig 'ong / /gzhan sus mang ja e gtong ang / /gtong ba'i mang ja e bzang ang / /grong chog 'bod mi e 'ong blta/ /de min bshad rgyu bsgom rgyu med/ /bla ma sgu don chen po byung / /yon bdag rnams kyis ma 'dzoms par/ /lo re tsam la 'gyed phogs dang / /mang ja med dam nyung ngan na/ /sngon dus chos dang zang zing gis/ /bskyangs pa'i bla ma yon bdag la/ /ming ngan 'dogs shing zur gtam byed/ /skog na ngan gtam di ri ri/ /g.yag rwa rdo nang drud pa bzhin/ /rgyu nom phyir du phan tshun 'khon/ /chags sdang khong khros dge rtsa 'joms/ /'grig lam kun spyod bcas pa bshig /chos la thos bsam sgom shes pa/ /byed mkhan nyin mo'i skar ma 'dra/ /mi byed mtshan skar bzhin du mang / /chos byed u dum wa ra 'dra/ /mi mthun ldam ldum bas kyang mang / /lnga mchod sgon lam sogs kyi dus/ /ra lug g.yag 29

gsum mang po gsod/ /bla ma khri ba la sogs pa'i/ /nang chen rnams na sha'i ri brtsigs/ /grwa ba nang 'dug dkor gyis tshig /sha rnying mi 'phrod sha gsar dgos/ /shi sha mi 'phrod bsad sha dgos/ /ra sha mi za lug sha dgos/ /snga ma ma tshar phyi ma snon/ /zas su sha thug med na 'khu/ /dgon pa'i nang na mgo sug mang / /mtha' na rus pa lud bzhin spungs/ /sdig pa byas na grong yin mod/ /grong gis de bas lhag mi byed/ /ma byin len dang rdzun gtam mang / /skog nas mi tshangs spyod spyad na/ /dgon pa ma yin khyem pa yin/ /khyem pas de bas lhag ci byed/ /dgon pa ha cang rgyas drags na/ /mtha' la rgya bod hor gsum 'dus/ /sdod sa'i khang ba mang bo phub/ /sgo khyem srang bar phal cher na/ /ra lug g.yag sogs mang po gsad/ /bshas pa'i sha mang brtsigs pa dang / /khrag gi chu phran 'gro ba de/ /mthong na byang sems snying rtsa 'dar/ /spyan chab 'dor ba ngas kyang mthong / /nga 'dra thams cad sha dga' nas/ /snang rtog med par khong 'dzum byed/ /dgon sde gnyis ka sdig par 'bag /tha ma bla ma grwa tshang gnyis/ /ma 'chams rgyab 'gras langs pa'am yang na dmag jag chom rkun byung / /yang na khri ba gshegs pa 'am/ /yang na mchod mkhan rgud par 'gyur/ /gzhan gyi mchod mkhan 30

ma byung na/ /thams cad la thor lung thor byed/ /lha khang gshag par bya bye'u nyal/ /nang du jag pa rkun ma 'dug /sku gsung thugs rten sa la 'thim/ /jag rkun mang bo'i stan du 'gyur/ /lo 'ga'i 'phro nas gyang chag ga /bla ma de bas btab pa'i dgon/ /yin zer yar 'gro mar 'gros gleng / /la las bla ma sus btab zer/ /ci yi rkyen gyis thor tsho zer/ /la las kha rog bshad tshul med/ /la las 'thor rgyu zhig yin zer/ /la las thor ba ma bzang zer/ /de phyir phyi rabs bla ma tsho/ /dgon rnying zhig gsos skyong bkur gyis/ /dgon pa gsar ba btab nas ched/ /deng sang bla mas dgon btab pa/ /chung ma blangs pa las kyang thu/ /dgon gsar btab na dgon rnying 'jig /dgon pa mang na mchod mkhan gyi/ /yon bdag sa brtsad dgon gnyis re/ /sngon chad 'khrug pa mthong thos mang / /dgon pa'i skyong khur 'di'i phyir du/ /sa 'og gnam gnyis ma gtogs pa/ /bla ma mi 'gro sa cha med/ /song yang rgyu nom mi rnyed par/ /sems sdug lus ngag ngal bar 'gyur/ /bsam rgyu bsgom rgyu phar la zhog /sngar bton kha ton rim pa chag /mi tshe yun thung dgon ma 'debs/ /gal te re re 'debs na yang / /dgon pa gzhan gye thag nye sa'i/ /ma 'debs thag ring gyis la thobs/ /'debs na thog 31

mtha' bar gsum du/ /srog gcod las 'di ma byed ang / /'gro kun pha mar ma gyur med/ /dper na tshe 'di'i ma bsad nas/ /dgon zhig bla ma sus 'debs phod/ /btab kyang de la su yis sgon/ /de bzhin pha ma sems can gzhan/ /srog bcad dgon zhig sus 'debs phod/ /btab kyang dam pa su yis smon/ /srog 'di sems can kun la gces/ /dper na rgyal bo chen po yis/ /zas nor 'dzom pa'i phyug po la/ /khyod gsod pa dang mi khyod la/ /gang yod ster las gang 'dems zhes/ /gsungs na srog la shin tu gces/ /gang yod ster zer srog 'dems nges/ /des na zang zing dge ba las/ /srog gcod spangs na dge ba che/ /mi dge bcu yi che shos de/ /srog gcod las 'di ma yin nam/ /sdig dang ma 'dres dgon gtsang thobs/ /mang na mi bzang nyung na bzang / /chos mthun dgon chung 'debs par mdzod/ /chos mthun dgon pa bzang bo de/ /grong las khyad par 'phags pa'i tshul/ /bshad na brjod kyis lang mi 'gyur/ /dgon bsam gom bdun bor ba'i mi/ /sa bdun bar du 'phags zhes gsungs/ /song ngam bsdad pa smos ci dgos/ /kun gyis thos bsam sgom byas na/ /nang nas gcig sangs rgyas pa'i tshe/ /sngon chad sa rdo shing gi phyir/ /srin bu shi tshad 'dren par nus/ /de tshun dgon 32

pas dge ba'i las/ /bzang ngan 'brel ba thogs tshad la/ /bsngos pa'i mthu dang kho rang yang / /chos phyir lus srog dor stabs gyes/ /bde 'gror sgyes na bde skyid ldan/ /'on kyang sdig la shin tu 'dzems/ /cung zad byas kyang bshags sdom gyis/ /dge rtsa de yi don du sngos/ /kun gyes tshe 'di blo yis thongs/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bsgyed nas/ /dam pa'i chos la 'bad par mdzod/ /gtam 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /dgon pa gsar rnying rnams la smras/ /thos tshad dgon pa thams cad kyis/ /srog gcod nam yang mi byed shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis sbyar ba'o//bla ma chos rgyal zhabs la 'dud/ /khyim pa'i blo kha chos la sgyur/ /dbyar ston bla ma bsod snyoms la/ /'byon dus ja zhus byed zer nas/ /ra lug bskyil nas ga zungs zhes/ /bstan tshe 'ga' re nang du rgyugs/ /rkang ba bzung tshe sa la 'gyel/ /dngangs skrag 'jigs nas 'phag shad byed/ /mgo bo thur du bstan nas bsgyel/ /sug bzhi thag nag cig gis bsdams/ /ske gug kha sna bsum pa'i tshe/ /mig gnyis trig trig lus khrig khrig /rnga ma 'tshub 'tshub ri li li/ /gsod mkhan ma ṇi shub shub shub/ /lug gis ril ma tha ra ra/ /byas nas phyi dbugs 'chad 33

par 'gyur/ /'ga' res rtsib nas gri chung brdar/ /shi 'am ma shi a rog zer/ /gri chung rnon pos brang gshags nas/ /lag pa g.yas pa khog tu btang / /srog rtsa dmar por brnyab pa'i dus/ /sngar las lhag pa'i sdug bsngal che/ /nang dbugs chad nas 'chi bar 'gyur/ /yon bdag pho mo drin can tsho/ /chos 'di su yi chos lugs yin/ /'di 'dra byed dgos su yis gsungs/ /phan yon ci yod cig shod dang / /rang gi kha sna rang nyid kyis/ /bsums la cung zad tsam sdod dang / /bla ma ja zhus byas pa de/ /chos su song ngam ma song shes/ /bla ma 'ga' rer khag bzhag nas/ /zhor la tshil dang sha yis byed/ /long g.yos sbom po zhig za snyam/ /zog 'di las can bla ma tshang / /'tsho ba'i thebs su song ba bzang / /de ba cig gi sprul ba yin/ /bla ma gya 'gyen min tsho zhes/ /yon tan rab rib rogs par bshad/ /ma ṇi ring thung sprad nas 'don/ /bar bar thab zangs kha tsho bltas/ /kha 'gul mchil ma ma mid ang / /bla mar ja zhus byed 'dod na/ /go re zhun thud gro ma sogs/ /rang la gang yod ci rnyed kyis/ /bla ma dam par ja zhus gyis/ /'bul ba chen po bkyags na bzang / /ra lug bshas nas sha drangs pa/ /don gyis nang zan mchod pa yin/ /bla ma mchod na rgyu nom phul/ /nang zan mchod na sha 34

bzan bshos/ /sems can srog chod chos gyes zhes/ /sangs rgyas gsung rab gang na med/ /srog 'di sems can kun la gces/ /srog gcod ma byed tshe thar thongs/ /tshe thar byas na ja zhus stong / /byas las phan yon che ba yin/ /phyug pos chos gzhan bcos na rab/ /chos gzhan gal te mi bco rung / /rang gi sgo yi zog cha bo/ /tshe thung ma byed tshe thar gyis/ /chos kyi mchog gcig de na snang / /glu 'di thos tshad khyim pa yis ja zhus log pa mi byed shog /sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la 'dud/ /deng sang bla ma 'ga' re tshos/ /sgom sgrub rten bzhengs dgon mi skyong / /khang ba rgya dang rgya bskyed nas/ /rgyu nom gsog pa'i bsod snyoms mkhan/ /dbyar ston bsod snyoms phyir 'ongs na/ /'brog gi phyug pos gdan 'dren byas/ /yar gyi phugs nas bzhugs bsdad na/ /yon bdag pho mo rub rub rub/ /gcig gis mtshang ra mdzug mdzug mdzug /steng na rlangs pa tho lo lo/ /mdun du bzhag dus ye re re/ /byed dus bla ma'i thugs ma brel/ /grwa ba'i srog la babs ma 'jog /nang mchod byen rlabs tsam zhig yang / /'don rag bar la mi chags par/ /kun gyis lus 'gul mchil ma mid/ /rab rib byas nas bton ma gtong / /35

bar der lag nas sus mi 'phrog /tshe sngon 'gro kun pha dang mar/ /ma gyur pa ni gcig med ces/ /thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas gsungs/ /sangs rgyas gsung la rdzun med bden/ /tshe sngon pha ma byas pa'i dus/ /tshe 'di'i pha mas bskyangs pa bzhin/ /drin gyis yang yang bskyangs pa yin/ /drin lan phan zhig mi 'dogs rung / /pha ma ra lug ma rgan la/ /bla ma grwa bas pham ma glan/ /bla ma phyogs der ma byon na/ /yon bdag pho mo ga la dad/ /yon bdag pho mo ma dad na/ /ra lug srog 'go'i ga la 'dug /ci lan gang lan bla mas lan/ /sdig pa bla ma'i gnya' na snang / /bla ma 'ga' re'i 'tsho ba'i phyir/ /ra lug mang bo'i srog bcad pa'i/ /sdig pa de'i thu gzhan na med/ /yon bdag dad can blun po tshos/ /bla mas yar la drangs yod zer/ /'dren mkhan bla mas rang gi blo/ /nang du bkug nas bsam tsa na/ /blo mi bde ba'i 'dzer zhig yin/ /bla ma nam gshegs tshod mi thig /gshegs khar 'gyod la dgos pa chung / /da lta sku gzugs bde dus su/ /nom pa ma gsog sgom sgrub gyes/ /rta nor ma skyong dgon pa skyongs/ /bsngos sha 'dzems la bsod snyoms rgyob/ /glu 'di bla ma 'ga' zhig gis/ /bsod snyoms rgyag dus dran par shog /36

bla ma dkon mchog thugs rje can/ /khyim pa'i blo kha chos la sgyur/ /e tsho khyem pa pho mo rnams/ /rang gi yul phyogs ser mo tsho'i/ /sdom pa khrig khrig cang med rung / /byin rlabs chen po med ma snyam/ /glo bur geg lhog gzer gsum byung / /sang 'chi gnangs 'chi zer ba'i mi'i/ /steng nas ser mo 'ga' res shig /bton phyin nad sos 'khun dwangs 'gro/ /byin rlabs yod pa de yis shes/ /nad pa'i steng nas khyim pa yis/ /'ur zhig bskyal phyin 'ur der khag /bzhag nas je thung song ba mang / /dge slong ban+de mang bo 'tshogs/ /'ur byas 'don pa ci bton rung / /nad pa je bde je bder 'gro/ /rgan rgon mang bos 'ur bskyal nas/ /nad pa drag bud song ba med/ /e drag ltos dang shin tu dka'/ /bla rgan 'tshogs nas chos bton pas/ /nad pa nad las thar ba mang / /e bden soms dang shin tu bden/ /gson po'i bar chad sel ba'i dus/ /bla rgan rnams tsho phan pa bzhin/ /shi bo'i sngas mgo'i bla rgan tshos/ /bton na de bas phyi mar phan/ /shi dus lam sna 'dren mkhan yang / /yul phyogs bla rgan rnams tsho yin/ /'di phyi gnyis gar bka' drin che/ /bla rgan rnams la yun ring du/ /'grogs tshe skyon mthong dad pa yal/ /e tsho'i ser mo'i bya 'di zhes/ /sngon chad bya ba mang bo zhig /brdzad 37

bzhag pa ltar thams cad po/ /spyi bsdus byas nas ma smod bzang / /bla rgan rnams tsho brgya ngan rung / /lha mi'i rgyal pos phyag 'tshal ba'i/ /dge 'dun dkon mchog gral yin pas/ /khyem pa'i smod bya ga la yin/ /'o na dge 'dun dkon mchog ste/ /skyon zad yon tan ldan pa zhig /yin dgos bla rgan 'di tsho'i rigs/ /'ga' re spro che heb yang che/ /kha cig lto che ser sna che/ /phal cher tshig rtsub sdom pa med/ /'di 'dra'i dge 'dun dkon mchog 'dra/ /yod na ltas ngan bskal pa snyigs/ /snyam na mig shes ngan pas mkhar/ /bltas kyang rab rib mthong ba dang / /mkhris nad can gyes dung dkar la/ /bltas na ser bor mthong ba bzhin/ /bla rgan rnams tsho skyon cang med/ /rang skyon phar la shar ba yin/ /bla rgan rnams tsho skyon med pas/ /mi tshad yon tan mang bo mnga'/ /'bri 'don klog gsum gang la mkhas/ /chos kyi don go chos bshad shes/ /dper na gser gyi ri bo la/ /brten pa'i bya rnams thams cad kyi/ /kha dog gser du snang ba bzhin/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi skyabs 'og na/ /'dug pa'i bla rgan thams cad kyi/ /rgyud na yon tan dpag med yod/ /bla rgan mchod rten dkar chung yin/ /su yis thug kyang dkar bor gtong / /des na rang sa yul phyogs kyi/ /bla rgan rnams tsho 38

shin tu bzang / /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /dkon mchog gsum zhes yongs su grags/ /dge 'dun dkon mchog zer ba de'i/ /gral na bla rgan 'di tsho yod/ /khyim pa ci yang mi shes pas/ /ser mo 'di las kho bzang snyam/ /phyug po rigs rus mtho ba tshos/ /rang gi yul phyogs ser mo la/ /gong gi ya gi'i a khu bzhugs/ /zas phud che bo yar la drongs/ /mi zer kho bo gong gis 'gying / /rtsag rgan nang nas 'phag shad byas/ /bla rgan gan na cig byen zer/ /zas lhag sna sne ngan ngon ster/ /dus ngan bskal ba snyigs dus 'dir/ /dge 'dun dkon mchog brnyas pa mang / /khyem pa pho mo ya rabs tsho rang la zas bzang yod bzhin du/ /ser mo rab 'bring tha gsum sur/ /sha rjud thud kyi sngo ba sogs/ /ngan ngon byen na bsod nams la/ /gnod pas de 'dra ster mi rung / /zas bzang phud dang gtsang ma drongs/ /lhan pa ser bo gyon tshad yan/ /dge 'dun dkon mchog gral yin pas/ /rigs mtho phyug po su yin yang / /'gab tu bzhag nas brnyas mi rung / /rtag tu mgo yi zhwa bzhin bkur/ /bsod nams dpag med thob par 'gyur/ /glu 'di thos tshad khyem pa yis/ /ser mo mchod bstod bkur bar shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyes sbyar ba'o//39

sangs rgyas thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /rjes 'jug bla rgan yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /bsam pa rab dkar dad gus snying rje che/ /rtag tu rnam dkar dge la sems dga' ba'i/ /bla rgan mgo dkar gral mgo man chad nas/ /gzhon pa so dkar gral rnga'i 'dug pa yan/ /gson po'i sku rim shi bo'i dgung zhag tu/ /song dus de bas ra lug gsod pa'i grabs/ /byed dus bla rgan gong ma mal sa nas/ /yar gcig 'gul la mchu de mar la g.yon/ /'gab ma rnams la lug ga snying re rje/ /de ring nged tshos 'phud du 'jug yi shod/ /'og mas snying rje yin na de red lags/ /za rgyu sha 'dra min rung dkon mchog gsum/ /thugs rje yod ki lags so lags so zhus/ /de nas bla rgan gral mgo ma de yis/ /u his mgrin lam sol la yon bdag bos/ /skad gseng mthon pos lug ga lug khyur thongs/ /las go snying rje nged tsho'i 'tsho ba la/ /khyad med khyed ga'i gang 'dzoms des chog ces/ /bshad 'phro 'gab ma kun gyis mthun 'gyur gyes/ /yon bdag rab tu dad pas zhwa phud la/ /lags so lags so zhus la phyag gsum 'tshal/ /tshe thar ring bo zhig thogs lug khyur thongs/ /btang na de bas lhag gi dge ba zhig /'jig rten 'di na med pas e ma ho/ /spyan dang 40

mngon shes mnga' ba'i phyogs bcu yi/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyis gzigs pa'i tshe/ /rab tu dgyes pas mchod pa'i mchog tu 'gyur/ /tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs dkar phyogs kyi/ /lha rnams dga' nas nam mkha'i khams nas 'ongs/ /bla rgan rnams la phyag 'tshal srung skyob byed/ /yon bdag pho mo dad can shin tu dad/ /phyin chad bla rgan rnams la grong chog mang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa snying rjer rag las pas/ /bla rgan rnams kyi rgyud la snying rje zhig /yod phyin da dung bstan pa gnas pa yin/ /bstan 'dzin bla rgan snying rje can la zer/ /'gro kun skye ba sngon ma'i ma yin pas/ /ma sha'i tsho rjud bshad na bla rgan ngan/ /mar gyur 'gro la phan zhig mi thogs rung / /gnod par byed pa'i bla rgan khrel med yin/ /phar la song dus sgo yi ra lug gcur/ /tshur la 'ong dus nang gi lha bshos gcur/ /lam la zhugs dus thang gi 'ba' 'bu gcur/ /gral du 'dug dus mchan gye dkor shig gcur/ /rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i bstan pa'i sgor/ /zhugs nas rang gis thub tshad kun gcur na/ /phyi mar bla rgan gshin rjes bzung nas gcur/ /nam 'chi cha med bla rgan drin can tsho/ /sku rim dgung zhag gang gi dus su yang / /btags pa'i ra lug tshe thar gtong la 'bod/ /thongs zhes mi 41

gtong bsad nas sha 'dren na/ /ma za mar la byen dang ngo mtshar che/ /phyi nas ser mo yon bdag rnams kyis gleng / /sngon gyi bla rgan de tsho cig bzang zer/ /sgo na yon bdag sems med 'ga' zhig gis/ /ra lug bsgyel nas bsha' ba'i dus skabs su/ /khyim na bla rgan so med kha cig gis/ /gri ral rdo la brdar ba de gzigs na/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thugs mi dgyes/ /bod la bstan pa nub gsung yang yang gleng / /dkar phyogs lha rnams mi dga' rgyab phyogs 'gyur/ /pho skyes kha rgod 'ga' res bla rgan tshang / /gri ral brdar nas nged tsho'i bsha' grogs su/ /phebs 'dang min nam sogs zer 'ga' re dgod/ /ra lug sha de tshos nas len pa'i dus/ /nad pa shog dang sngags shig 'debs mi zer/ /'ga' res rdar de yar la cig byin zhes/ /rnam 'joms gdugs dkar la sogs sngags nus rnams/ /nad par ma btab thog mar rdar la btab/ /rked kyi gri ral zad po phyi ru phud/ /brdar nas bar bar kha myang rno tshad blta/ /rno tshe phyis nas mar la mig zur gyis/ /sha skal che chung blta ba'i bla rgan ngan/ /rang skyon mi shes bla rgan 'ga' zhig gis/ /gcod pa ga tshos g.yang gzhi len pa ga /sdig pa che gi zer nas 'phya ba de/ /pags pa blangs dang ma blangs khyad ma 42

gtogs/ /khyad par spu tsam med do bla rgan tsho/ /gcod par sha mang pags pa lhag pa yin/ /bla rgan rnams la pags pa phar la zhog /sha yang cher med lhu re yod pa'i dus/ /a dzi rdzi yin e bden mi bden soms/ /bden phyin bla rgan nga yi kha 'dir nyon/ /tshe 'dir ra lug gang gi pags pa med/ /sha yang nyin gcig ma gtogs za rgyu med/ /phyi mar song na yar la 'gro sa med/ /med gsum ma byed bla rgan bsam shes tsho/ /sku rim dgung zhag gang gi dus skabs su/ /bla rgan kun gyis mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig tu/ /ra lug ma bsha' 'tsho ba khyad med ces/ /skad gseng mthon pos dbyar gyi 'brug bzhin sgrogs/ /bsgrags na de bas gtam snyan gzhan na med/ /lha 'dre mi gsum gang gi rna bar snyan/ /kun gyis bla rgan mchod bstod bkur bar 'gyur/ /glu 'di thos tshad bla rgan grong chog pas/ /btags pa'i ra lug tshe thar byed par shog /rje btsun tsong kha pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /rjes 'jug bla rgan rnams la thugs kyis gzigs/ /gson po'i rim gro shi bo'i dge rtsa la/ /bos na bla rgan 'ga' re gnyid mi 'ong / /mtshan mo sgo dang sgor rgyugs chab bsil btang / /rtags can gnam gye skar mar yang yang bltas/ /nam ring mi chod snga bar yar la 43

langs/ /chos gos snga shad dā len phyi shad byas/ /rta rgan zhig gam g.yag rgan zhig la byon/ /sna sprugs lcag brgyab 'ob sdikas rkyang ba byas/ /steng nas rkang lag tshang mas ral kha sprad/ /ja mar za ma'i bzang ngan che chung byed/ /grong chog shor 'dra e 'gro snyam nas dogs/ /rta rgan g.yag rgan ma song khong khro langs/ /dmod mo byed bzhin rgyug 'dur sprad nas song / /yon bdag de ba'i sgo la babs pa'i dus/ /sgo na gsod rgyu'i ra lug btags pa des/ /bla rgan rnams tshor bltas nas 'then skor byas/ /kho bo thongs shig zer ba'i brda rgyag tshe/ /bla rgan 'phung rgan che chung su yin yang / /snying rje lug ga ma gsod thongs mi zer/ /kun la mi gsod mthu med byung ba bzhin/ /'ga' res ma ṇi pad+me t+t+waṃ ang zer/ /'ga' re kha rog khyim du 'dzul nas 'gro/ /'ga' re lug gi sha stobs shor gyis dogs/ /lug ga yun ring ma 'dogs bzhag nas ched/ /snying rje ma ṇi pad+me t+t+waṃ gyis zer/ /'ga' res snying rje snying rje zer ba de/ /snying rje ma yin tshon po zhig yin tshe/ /dga' nas bshad rgyu ma rnyed skad cha yin/ /ra lug gang rung sha de yar drangs tshe/ /kun gyis sha de rgyags rgan zhig zos nas/ /'ga' re gcig lu kha tsho phyi zhor la/ /snying rje lug 'di ci zhig tsho ni red/ /khos 'di da nangs sgo 44

na btags yod dus/ /mthong nas 'di 'dra'i tsho 'dang ma brgyab zer/ /'don pa 'don dus bla rgan kha cig gis/ /ban+de dge slong 'ga' rer sdang mig gis/ /bltas nas 'don pa snga bar mi 'grub gi /kho bor yul na las don gal can yod/ /rem la da thon bshad rgyu ma mang zhes/ /kho bo spro langs dbu mdzad ma yin kyang / /'don pa'i 'go blangs rem nas shed kyis 'don/ /ban+de 'ga' res a tse bla rgan gan/ /smyos 'dra 'jog rgyu min nam zer nas 'dzum/ /de 'dra'i bya spyod ngan pa spongs shig ang / /ja skabs rnams su ja yi bzang ngan dang / /za ma'i che chung bshad nas mang bo zos/ /ja de ngan na ci zhig dro gi zhes/ /'thung ba'i zhor la kha myang mchil ma 'phangs/ /ja de bzang na he ran ja 'di zer/ /phyi dro dgung mo yin yang mang bo 'thung / /bla rgan 'ga' re sgo la brgya stong 'bud/ /khyis ded rkang sne rdo la thogs nas log /ban+de 'ga' re kun gye sngon la gnyid/ /g.yag rgan g.yag chung snga phyi sprad nas btang / /nangs par yar la langs pa'i ja skabs su/ /yon mchod kun gyis 'phya rgyu ma bco ang / /dge chen bco dus pho skyes ja drangs na/ /ske bsrings yar mar 'ga' re'i ja khar bltas/ /heb langs zhag gzhobs zhag blugs mar longs zer/ /spyi 'bul byin tshe ras kha kha dar 45

tsam/ /steng nas kun gyis 'then sprug rgyong gsum byas/ /'ur langs spro langs yar langs rdung res byas/ /sde bas mi tshor bshad rgyu ma bco ang / /bla rgan 'ga' re gzhan gyi dgung zhag tshor/ /song nas nub gcig mal sar glo bur shi /ro thog ro bzhag byas tshe yon bdag 'gyod/ /'ga' res bla rgan dā len rtsam khug nas/ /sha lhu rtsam ril blangs nas snying re rje/ /'di tsho khyer snyam ma zos yod ki zhes/ /sha zos rtsam ril mar gye khye tshor 'phangs/ /ro gan ci byed yul de thag ring zer/ /bar der nyin zhag mang bo'i bar du lus/ /bla mar 'phrod pa phar zhog bla rgan 'gas/ /khrus chog tsam yang ma byas skal chad yod/ /rgas dus bla rgan rnams kyis grong chog bskyur/ /mal sa drod por kha ton gyis shig ces/ /da lta'i bla rgan grong chog mkhan la smras/ /thos tshad bla rgan rnams la phan par shog /bla ma dkon mchog gsum la 'dud/ /nyon dang khyem pa bsam shes tsho/ /chos bco zer nas ra lug g.yag /bzung gi bzung gi rgya la sprad/ /bshan pas mgo bo 'breg gi bcug /rin du gser ram dngul blangs nas/ /chos dpon heb rgan 'ga' rer byen/ /gser dngul chos leb 'ga' re blangs/ /ser mo 'ga' re a mchod kyi/ /ming btags don gyi g.yog po byas/ /lo 46

zla mang bor 'dug tu bcug /'gro dus rta rgan zhig gis brdzangs/ /chos bton 'bul ba phar la zhog /g.yog po byas pa'i tshegs rin med/ /ra lug mang bo bshas nas shas/ /ser mo 'ga' rer mchod bkur byas/ /nyi ma mang bor cig re bton/ /bton 'phro 'bul ba yin zer nas/ /khas rtswa mi chod song sha yis/ /sti li mi thongs rta rgan dang / /ra rgan rngo bo shig rkyal sogs/ /sgo phyugs nang nas gang ngan byen/ /byin tshe ser mo kha cig gis/ /kho bo'i lug 'di shig rgyal red/ /'ga' res ra 'di rngo bo red/ /'ga' res rta 'di shed med red/ /'ga' res rta 'di kha rgan red/ /thams cad gang gi gang ngan red/ /a wa de yi ched zer nas/ /ser mo rnams kyi sems mi dga'/ /kha nas 'ga' res tshig ngan smra/ /gzhan gyis chos shig bcos pa gang / /thos kyang rjes su yi rangs med/ /de bas khye yi skyag pa zhig /chos 'dra ma bcos khos bcos zhes/ /kho bo nga rgyal je cher song / /rtsag rgan nang nas 'phag shad byas/ /sngon chad gang byas bgrangs nas ngom/ /de tsho lha chos rnam dag min/ /phyi mar 'bras bu de 'dra 'byung / /de phyir lha chos gang bco yang / /srog gcod nam yang byed mi rung / /gzhan gyis lha chos bsgrub pa la/ /khyad gsod 'phya smod byed mi rung / /rang gis lha chos gang byas 47

rnams/ /ngom na 'dzad pas ngom mi rung / /rgyu nom gang gi gang bzang rnams/ /chos phyogs thongs dang yon bdag tsho/ /tshe 'dir snyan grags phyogs bcur rgyas/ /phyi mar 'bras bu de 'dra 'byung / /glu 'di thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /lha chos rnam dag byed par shog /chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /khyem pa'i shes rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /a rog khyem pa bsam shes tsho/ /lha khang phub dang sku rten bzhengs/ /gser dngul thar mdo len pa dang / /rgyal ba'i gsung rab klog dus dang / /ma ṇi bum sgrub la sogs dus/ /rang gi sgo phyugs phal cher de/ /rgya la btsongs nas gsod du bcug /chos phyir bsad na skyon med snyam/ /chos len rab gnas sogs kyi dus/ /chos ston byed zer ra lug g.yag /bsad nas sha ston byed pa de/ /chos la brten pa'i sdig pa yin/ /sdig pa kun gyi nang nas lci/ /bla mar ja zhus byed zer nas/ /ma mo sha bzan bshas nas sha /rlangs pa thol le 'dren pa dang / /pha ma shi dus dge byed zer/ /ra lug g.yag gsum mang bo yi/ /mgo bo yar ston mar ston byas/ /bsad nas sha khrag dron mo yis/ /dge 'dun sde rnams mchod pa de/ /chos shig ma yin yon bdag tsho/ /mdo rgyud gang na de 'dra yi/ /chos kyis 48

gsung ba yod ma myong / /de 'dra'i chos chen bco ba las/ /sdig med chung chung byas na bzang / /de phyir sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i/ /lha chos che thub chung thub gyis/ /glu 'di thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /chos phyir srog gcod mi byed shog /bla ma dkon mchog gsum po mkhyen/ /khyem pa'i blo kha chos la sgyur/ /pho skyes bud med bsam shes tsho/ /bu mo phar la rdzong ba dang / /mna' ma tshur la len pa'i dus/ /ra lug g.yag gsum mang bo bsad/ /gzhan tshor sha khog khyer shog ces/ /ra lug mang bo gsod du bcug /ston mo chen bo byed pa de/ /tshe 'dir cung zad bde na yang / /phyi mar mna' ma bu mo dang / /ston sha za ba'i mgron po yi/ /sha khrag gshin rje 'bum phrag gis/ /dga' ston byed pa'i rgyu zhig yin/ /ston mo chen po byed dgos na/ /ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi dang / /go re dkar ser zhun thud dang / /rtsam dkar gro ma 'bri mar dang / /zho dang chu ge la sogs pas/ /ji ltar byas kyang byas na chog /sha yang glo bur shi ba dang / /g.yang la lhung dang 'gag pa sogs/ /sdig med sha bzang btsal na rnyed/ /za ma kham bu gang do'i phyir/ /sdug bsngal lung gang su yis myong / /'di phyi gnyis gar bde skyid pa'i/ /ston mo byas na mi legs sam/ /ston mo byed dus srog mang bo/ /bcad pa'i 49

mna' ma bu mo'i rigs/ /tshe thar mi phyin kha cig 'chi/ /ston sha teb kyis za ba la/ /na tsha zug gzer mang bo ldang / /sha ston byas na bde snyam pa/ /'di phyi gnyis gar sdug bsngal che/ /rang gi lus kyi yan lag bsdams/ /kha bsum srog rtsa dmar bo bcad/ /sha khrag gnyis kyis ston mo zhig /byed pa phar zhog mdzub mo zhig /bcad nas ston mo byed thub soms/ /rang gi lus la dpe longs la/ /srog gcod las la kun gyis 'dzems/ /glu 'di thos tshad khyem pa yis/ /sha ston nam yang mi byed shog /rje btsun bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyem pa'i blo kha dam pa'i chos la sgyur/ /e ma khyem pa pho mo dad can tsho/ /deng sang dus ngan bskal pa snyigs dus 'dir/ /khyem gye mi la na tsha zhig byung na/ /sgo na gang yod phyugs rnams bsgyel nas bshas/ /sgo khyem sha khrag slo yis 'gengs pa 'dis/ /nad pa drag rung phyi mar nad yun ring / /don la nad las ma thar ba las thu/ /deng sang chos log 'di ga dar cha che/ /sa phyogs gang nas blo ldan sems yod kyis/ /nad pa'i steng nas chos log 'di ma bco/ /'di min bco rgyu med pa ma yin nam/ /ban sngags mkhas btsun bzang gsum kun 'tshogs nas/ /chos log byas nas nang ba yin ma snyam/ /phyi rol bas kyang de'i lhag byed rab med/ /mo ba 50

sman pa rtsis pa drin can tsho/ /kha lag gnyis gas rem nas 'di ma bkyal/ /'di min bkyal rgyu'i sku rim gzhan med dam/ /phyi mar mgo dang phung bor mi gces sam/ /mal na 'khun pa'i nad pa bsam shes tsho/ /nad la phan par 'dod na tshe thar thongs/ /tshe 'dir nad sos phyi mar mi tshe ring / /bla ma dkon mchog mnyes pa'i mchod tshogs phul/ /ban sngags yul mi bsdus la sbyin pa thongs/ /tshe 'dir 'khun dwangs phyi mar longs spyod rgyas/ /chos log byas nas ra lug g.yag gsum po/ /bsgyel ba'i sgang la nad pa lag nas shor/ /ro thog ro bzhag bya ba'i dus tsho 'byung / /phyi mar nad pas sngar las brgya lhag gi /sdug bsngal myong dgos khyem pa sems yod tsho/ /mo ba rtsis pa ngan pa'i khar ma rgyugs/ /mad pa'i steng nas chos log 'di ma bca'/ /mo sman rtsis pa bzang bo'i ngag bzhin du/ /'di phyi gnyis gar phan pa'i sgu rim gyis/ /srog 'di gces pa sems can kun la gces/ /nad pa'i steng nas srog gcod las ma byed/ /glu 'di thos tshad rnams kyis nad pa yi/ /steng nas chos log nam yang mi byed shog /bla ma rnams la gus pas 'dud/ /nyon dang khyim pa dad can tsho/ /'brog gi phyug po ser sda can/ /chos med sdig rgan 51

phal cher las/ /med po chos dad che ba'i rigs/ /'ga' re sdig med phyi mar bde/ /phyug po las ngan phal cher gyis/ /ma rgan tsher mo'i lu gu rnams/ /tsha ru bzang dus ske du gcus/ /gsod dus sems yod 'dug mi tshugs/ /kha nas ma ṇi dbang med 'chor/ /ra lug mang bo rgya la btsongs/ /dmar thig brgyab nas 'ded pa de/ /mthong na byang sems spyan chab 'chor/ /g.yag dang 'bri skams rgya la btsongs/ /ded dam khrid nas 'gro ba de/ /mthong na sems bzang snying rje 'chor/ /ra lug bshan pas gsod pa rnams/ /mthong na rin blangs zos pa de/ /pha ma gnyis kyi sha dang mtshungs/ /khyem tshang bza' ba'i kha lto'i phyir/ /zla re nang du lug re gcur/ /ston kha lug shed bzang ba'i dus/ /dgun dang dpyid dus za snyam nas/ /ra lug g.yag gsum sa la bsgyel/ /mang bo gsod pa de mthong na/ /bshan pa gzhan na med ki snyam/ /mdzo mo lnga bcu tsam yod kyang / /lo re bzhin du rtseb pa'i dus/ /bu de gcig kyang mi 'jog par/ /gsod pa mthong na snying rje can/ /'dug mi thub par sgo tshor 'bud/ /phyug po sdig rgan kha cig gis/ /tshogs rdzogs sgrib sbyong ma byas na/ /tshe 'dir cung zad bde na yang / /phyi mar 'gro sa 'dug sa med/ /de phyir phyug po dad can tsho/ /'bri g.yag rgya la btsongs nas ched/ /'bri 52

bzhos g.yag la khal bkal na/ /'chi rag bar la rin thang yong / /shi na sha ko lhag pa yin/ /ra lug bsad nas ci zhig bya/ /'chi rag bar du bal rtsid gnyis/ /blangs nas rin las lhag pa 'ong / /lu gu chung dus bsad nas ched/ /cher song mo lug cig yin na/ /lo re bzhin du lu gu 'ong / /lug rnams 'phel ba'i grogs su 'gro/ /pho lug yin na dkar 'jam bal/ /blangs nas kha gsos rgyab bkal chog /ra lug g.yag gsum rgya la btsongs/ /ma rgan lu gu gsod pa de/ /chos dang mthun pa phar la zhog /'jig rten lugs kyi kha gso yang / /ma shes pa yin 'brog pa tsho/ /lo re bzhin du zhing btab nas/ /lo tog legs po mi len par/ /zhing bzang btsongs nas rin za ba/ /rong gi zhing ba sems med cig /ma gtogs sems yod su yis btsong / /de bzhin sgo phyugs 'tsho skyong byas/ /bal blangs 'o ma mi bzho bar/ /rgyar btsong bsad nas sha za ba/ /'brog gi phyug po snying med cig /ma gtogs snying yod su zhig phod/ /phyi mar ngan song gsum du skyes/ /sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa myong / /lha chos chen po ma 'gyu yang / /sgo phyugs ma btsong ma gsod par/ /pha ma bu tsha bzhin du skyongs/ /chos kyi mchog cig de ga yin/ /tshe 'dir nor lug je 'phel 'gyur/ /phyi mar mtho 53

ris gnas su skye/ /glu 'di thos tshad phyug po yis/ /srog gcod las la 'dzem par shog /bla ma dam pa rnams la 'dud/ /'brog pa yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /nyon dang 'brog pa dad can tsho/ /'brog gi phyug po phal che ba/ /ma rig nyon mongs dbang du song / /mdzo mo lnga bcu tsam yod kyang / /lo re bzhin du rtseb pa'i dus/ /bu de'i gcig kyang mi 'jog gsod/ /lo gnyis brgya red lo bcu dang / /nyi shur du red cig rtsis dang / /zog bdag phyug po sdig rgan rnams/ /phyi mar yar la 'gro sa med/ /mdzo mo'i lce yis bu la ldag /bu yis mdzo mor blta ba'i dus/ /ma bu gnyis ka kha bral nas/ /ma ngur bu yis phyi mig blta/ /sus mthong mi yis snying rje 'chor/ /kha bsums gsod pa'i dus skabs su/ /sems yod zur nas mi chags 'gro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sku sha rtsed/ /dkar phyogs lha yis nam mkha' na/ /khrel med mi yi bya ba zer/ /dkar phud mchod kyang bzhes pa dkon/ /bu de bsad pa shes pa'i tshe/ /mdzo mos kha zhig grag ma thub/ /ma gtogs khog na 'di bsam yod/ /mi shul rtsad nas chad rgyu tshang / /bu de ma bsad bu bzhag nas/ /'o ma 'di ster dgos na ched/ /bu de bsad nas sha zos pas/ /mi chog da dung de'i steng du/ /mos 54

kyang 'o mas gso dgos pa/ /lag dmar lag snum red ang snyam/ /khros nas mig rtsa dmar bor song / /gsod mkhan mi la rdung snying ni/ /'dod kyang brdungs na mo yang gsod/ /snyam nas gsod mir rdung ma phod/ /bu der phangs nas 'dug ma thub/ /bya thabs gzhan cang ma rnyed tshe/ /don med khye rgan skor 'ded byed/ /ri khar song na bu de dran/ /ri mgor yun ring sdod ma tshugs/ /sems sdug ngur rgyang byed bzhin du/ /dgong dus snga bar yul du 'ong / /bu de bsad nas 'thung skal gyi/ /'o ma bzhos nas 'thung ba de/ /blo ldan rnams kyis bsam shes na/ /de bas khrel med na rag med/ /'di ni gangs can bod yul du/ /sngon nas dar cha che ba de/ /dgos pa gzhan ni mchod cig med/ /yin pa 'o ma dmar ba yin/ /mdzo mo'i bu de gsos nas ched/ /'o ma bzang bo brlag ni yin/ /dpyid dus shi 'gro zer ba de/ /kho bo ngan nas shi ba min/ /chung dus 'o ma ma song bas/ /lan pa yin pas shes par gyis/ /legs par gsos na mdzo 'bri dang / /khyad par med pa ngas kyang mthong / /mdzo mo'i bu de mi gso bar/ /bsad nas za ba phyi rol lugs/ /bod la phyi rol chos log cig /sngon nas da bar dar 'dug pa/ /nang ba sangs rgyas chos kyi sgor/ /zhugs pa gcig gis kyang ma shes 55

'dug /blo ldan dad can snying rje can/ /rnams kyis mdzo mo'i bu ma gsod/ /zhog la nges par gsos shig ces/ /kha min bsam pa thag pas smras/ /smras pa bzhin du 'grub par shog /bla ma dam pa rnams la 'dud/ /'brog pa yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /'brog gi phyug po bsam shes tsho/ /'o ma 'thungs nas bzang gi dang / /phyi mar 'gro 'dang ma yin nam/ /mdzo mo'i bu de gsod dgos zhes/ /sangs rgyas byang sems su yis gsungs/ /nang ba'i mdo rgyud gang na'ang med/ /phyi rol chos log 'di los yin/ /mdzo mo'i bu bzhag 'o ma'i phyed/ /bzhos nas 'thungs na lugs shig red/ /bu bsad sha zos zho 'thung ba/ /ltas ngan mi srid pa zhig red/ /phyi rol mu stegs pa las thu/ /khrel med nang nas khrel med yin/ /thu be+e btsog 'dre a kha kha/ /snying rje med dam a ho ho/ /sa cha zhig tsho ci dar gi /mi rig rgyu tshos ci byed ki /bya de'i btsog ang paṇa chen mkhyen/ /las 'bras mi 'dzem a tsi tsi/ /g.yang sde bsod nams skye rgyu bo/ /mtsho sngon phyogs kyi sog po yis/ /mdzo mo'i bu de mi gsod par/ /gso ba de ga e ma ho/ /gsos na mdzo 'bri g.yag bzhin du/ /bzhos na des chog khal bkal chog /gal te ma gsos shi song yang / /rgya che mthug pa'i ko ba blangs/ /lham dang sgro ba 56

bcos na chog /bu de tshe thar byas pa'i mthus/ /tshe 'dir tshe ring mi phyugs 'phel/ /phyi mar mtho ris gnas su skye/ /ngo mtshar nang nas 'di ngo mtshar/ /'jig rten lugs kyi kha gso tshul/ /chos kyi lugs dang bstun na mthun/ /de ltar kun gyis byas na legs/ /'o ma cung zad des ci bya/ /mdzo mo'i bu de bsad gyur na/ /tshe 'dir tshe bsod rgyas pa'i gegs/ /phyi mar dmyal bar 'gro ba'i rgyu/ /chos dang mthun pa phar la zhog /'jig rten lugs kyi kha gso yang / /ma shes blun po tha chad yin/ /gzhan sdug phyi mar rang sdug pa/ /blo ldan rnams kyis byed mi rung / /dad can snying rje byang sems can/ /rnams kyis mdzo mo'i bu ma gsod/ /'gro kun tshe sngon pha ma yin/ /mdzo mo'i bu de legs par gsos/ /glu 'di mthong thos 'brog pa yis/ /mdzo mo'i bu rnams gso bar shog /gsar rnying la sogs grub mtha'i rigs/ /so sor ma 'dres sa ler mkhyen/ /bla ma 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /tshong pa rnams tsho ma yengs nyon/ /tshong pa las ngan phal cher gyis/ /ja ras mar gyis tshar dom btang / /tsha ru len du song ba'i dus/ /gzhan gyes gdang nas lu gu'i rigs/ /gson por ske du gcus nas bsad/ /tsha ru rlon 57

pa lag tu 'jog /ma mo dgong mo 'ong ba'i dus/ /lu gu thams cad btang ba na/ /phal cher lu gu ma byung tshe/ /yar la 'ongs nas sgo tshor 'ba'/ /lu gu gdang na e yod snyam/ /khyim du rgyugs nas med tsa na/ /phyir thon yar mar kun la btsal/ /lu gu ya gi yin snyam nas/ /ya gir song nas snom zhing 'ba'/ /min tshe ma gi e yin snyam/ /song ste bsnams nas lta ba'i tshe/ /sems yod mig nas mchi ma 'chor/ /sems med rnams la ci cha yod/ /ma mo nyi ma mang po'i bar/ /lu gu yid la rgyun du shar/ /gzhan gyi lu gu rig na 'ba'/ /gzhan gyi ma mo thams cad kyis/ /lu gu khrid nas 'gro ba'i tshe/ /las can ma mo ya gi tsho/ /bzhin du mo yi lu gu de/ /yod na khrid nas song na snyam/ /lu gu da lo 'khrid rgyu yi/ /skal ba ma mo mor ma byung / /kha sang bdud po zhig byung nas/ /bzung ste lu gu gces phrug med/ /mo yi las 'di ngan re snyam/ /sems sdug lug rnams mjug tu bsdad/ /'ba' gi 'ba' gi cung zad song / /kha phyir phyogs nas shed kyis 'ba'/ /de nas rtswa kham re re zos/ /lu gu dran nas re re 'ba'/ /lug bdag tsha ru len mkhan tsho/ /khyed rnams gces phrug bsad nas ni/ /pags pa bshus na ci tsam yin/ /rang gi bu tshor dpe longs la/ /mu ges mgo bo thur bstan nas/ /khyem 58

tshang bza' ba 'chi na yang / /de 'dra'i sdig pa ma byed ang / /de ltar byas na tshe 'dir yang / /phyugs la god kha rgyun du 'ong / /rigs rgyud mi skye skyes kyang 'chi//phyi mar ngan song gsum du skye/ /brgya la mi ru sgyes na yang / /sgyes nas ring min myur du 'chi/ /de phyir tshong ba thams cad kyis/ /tshong ngan de 'dra ma byed cig /bla ma 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho la/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /bla ma 'jam dbyangs byen rlabs kyis/ /tshong pa rnams la phan par shog /rgyal ba gnyis pa pad+ma 'byung / /slar yang mi yi tshul 'dzin pa'i/ /kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /sha zos nyes pa shin tu che//sha khrag za zhing 'thung ba la/ /dkar phyogs lha rnams rab tu skrag /mgon skyabs byed pa dka' ba yin/ /sha khrag khu ba 'thung ba'i phyir/ /g.yag dang ra lug mang bsad na/ /tshe thung nad kyang du mas mnar/ /shi na dmyal ba'i gnas su skye/ /mi ru skyes kyang bshan pa dang / /sdig spyod hor sog yul du skye/ /rtag tu sha dang khrag la rngam/ /srog gcod byed la rab tu dga'//sha gcod nus na phan yon che/ /dkar phyogs lha rnams sprin bzhin 'du/ /rtag tu bsrung zhing mgon skyabs byed/ /tshe ring nad med lus sems 59

bde/ /phyi mar lha mi'i nang du skye/ /sha la sred pa shin tu chung / /tshon po mthong yang heb mi ldang / /dkar gsum mngar gsum zas kyis 'tsho/ /sha yi nyes pas gos mi 'gyur/ /tshe rabs kun tu bde ba nas/ /bde bar 'gro bar the tshom med/ /de phyir sha 'di gcod thub ltos/ /gal te gcod par mi nus kyang / /mthong thos dogs gsum med pa yi/ /rnam gsum dag pa'i sha zos na/ /nyes pa med pas za bar gyis//za ba'i tshe na kai ka ni/ /la sogs gzungs sngags gang shes rigs/ /bzlas nas sha la phus btab ste/ /zos na phan yon che ba yin/ /sems can de la snying rje bsgoms/ /zos nas ma ṇi ci mang bzlas/ /bsngo ba smon lam btab na legs/ /de min bsam bzhin ston dus su/ /ra lug g.yag gsum sa la bsgyel/ /kha sna bsums nas bsad gyur na/ /ra lug gsod mkhan de nyid dang / /sod ces zer ba gtso byas pa'i/ /sha zos khu 'thung thams cad po/ /phyi mar dmyal ba'i nang du skye/ /sdug bsngal yun ring bar du myong //thar nas g.yag dang ra lug tu/ /skyes nas lan brgya'i bar dag tu/ /kha sna bsums nas gsod par 'gyur/ /de bzhin mgo bcad lto ba dral/ /srog rtsa bcad nas bsad gyur na/ /phyi mar de bzhin lan brgyar gsod/ /g.yog po dbul bo phal cher gyis/ /phyi ma'i sdug de mi 60

shes par/ /sha lhu re re tsam gyi phyir/ /yar la rgyugs nas ya gi tshang / /lug bsad mar rgyugs ma gi tshang / /ra bsad phar rgyugs pha gi tshang / /g.yag sod ces na de yang bsad//don med sdig pa mang bo bsags/ /rang sha bcad nas rang kha ru/ /bzhag dang khyad par cung zad med/ /g.yog po snying rul dbul bo tsho/ /tshe 'dir mu ges mgo mar bstan/ /'chi rung de 'dra'i las ma byed/ /mi 'chi sngo dang la yung sogs//ngan ngon ci yang rung bas 'tsho/ /za ma zhim po zos zos nas/ /sangs rgyas song ba sngon chad su/ /dam pa'i chos la 'bad par mdzod/ /'bad na phyi mar lha'i bdud rtsi/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i zas zos chog /mi yi zas la su yid chags/ /phyi mar skyid pa'i thabs la 'bod/ /phyi mar sdug bsngal myong dgos pa/ /mi shes dbul po phal cher gyis/ /phyug po rnams kyis ra lug g.yag /bsad na las can de ba la/ /sha mang yod zer yid smon byed/ /sems med mi zhig ma gtogs pa/ /de la su zhig yid smon byed/ /nangs par gsod pa'i mi zhig gis/ /dgong mo kha zas mang zos nas/ /bde bar nyal ba'i mi de la/ /gsod par shes pa'i mi zhig gis/ /yid smon mi byed snyeng rje ltar/ /phyug po ra lug g.yag gsum po/ /bsad nas kha zhim byed pa rnams/ /phyi mar dmyal ba'i sdug myong ba/ /shes nas byang chub 61

sems dpa' rnams/ /yid smon byed pa phar la zhog /lhag par snying rje skye bar 'gyur/ /a pha rlung gis 'chi gi dang / /a ma rlung gis 'chi gi dang / /a khu rlung gis 'chi gi zhes/ /rlung bcos mang bo bco gi da//phyi mar gshin rje'i pho nya yis/ /a pha tshur la 'dir shog dang / /a ma a khu 'dir byon ces/ /rlung bcos bzang bo byed mod snyam/ /rgan rgon a khu las ngan tsho/ /ja zho mar chur za bzhin du/ /rlung gis mi 'chi skyon dogs med/ /shi na ban rgan ngas khag theg /ra lug g.yag gsum ma bsha' ang / /gal te sman pa la sogs kyi/ /kha de 'dres khrid bsha' dgos zhes/ /bshad kyang sdig med sha zos bzang / /gal te sdig med sha ma rnyed/ /'chi la thug nas lug gsod kyang / /sngon du kha ru rten gsum dang / /rna bar de bzhin gshegs pa yi//mtshan ni gang mang brjod par gyis/ /sha zos 'phro nas ma ṇi rem//phyi nas rus pa'i steng du yang / /yi ge bris la rlung la skyon/ /deng sang rgan rgon a khu la/ /tshe rabs gtan du sdug pa'i rgyu/ /kha 'di'i don du ma byed ces/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /kha min snying gtam 'di nyid ni/ /bsam pa thag pas bshad pa yin/ /spyir ni go tshad mi rnams dang / /khyad par rgan rgon a khu yis/ /tshig 'di thang la ma 'phen ang / /dper na dmag po che 62

zhig chas/ /'ong ba mthong nas bsam bzang gi /mi zhig sngon la myur 'ongs nas//khyed rnams steng du pha gi na/ /dmag po che zhig 'ong gi zhes//bshad na shin tu bden snyam nas//myur du rta zhon go mtshon thogs/ /thams cad song nas 'phrang dog sar/ /bsgugs nas glo bur steng blugs nas/ /pha rol dmag la pham ster bzhin/ /'chi bdag pho nya dmag lta bu/ /khyed rnams steng du lo brgya tshun//nang du 'ongs nas dmyal bar 'khrid//sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong dgos zhes/ /nga yis bshad pa 'di bden snyam/ /sngar byas sdig la 'gyod bshags dang / /phyin chad mi byed dam bca' dang / /tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong la 'bad na/ /'chi bdag dmag dpung slebs na yang / /dmyal ba'i gnas su khred mi nus/ /phyi mar lhag par da ltar gye/ /lus dang longs spyod 'di 'dra ba/ /ma yin mi rigs mthon po yi//bu ru skyes nas gzugs mdzes shing / /longs spyod phun sum tshogs par ldan/ /tshe der dam pa'i chos byas nas//byang chub go 'phang 'thob par 'gyur//mi bden bshad tshod yin bsams nas/ /sha lhod bsdad na steng du blugs/ /mi khyi gang yod thams cad bsad/ /nor rdzas yod tshad khyer ba bzhin/ /da lta nga yis bshad pa rnams//e bden mi bden mi shes snyam//sdig pa zhar dang zhor la bsags/ /dkar 63

bo dge ba ma 'bad na/ /'chi bdag pho nya glo bur slebs/ /dmyal ba'i gnas su khrid nas kyang //bzod med sdug la gtod par 'gyur/ /de dus 'jigs skrag 'gyod mod kyang / /cung zad tsam yang bya thabs med/ /'di bzhin bshad kyang mi nyan pa'i/ /mi de don snying rul ba 'am/ /yang na chung nas med pa yin/ /mi yin snyam du ma sems shig /phyi nas 'gyod pa'i dus shig mchi//kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams la/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /klong chen rab 'byams byin rlabs kyis/ /sha za rnams la phan par shog/ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//snang ba brda' dang dpe char shar//rdo rje'i glu dbyangs len pa yi//rig 'dzin gang shar rang grol la//gsol ba 'debs so byin gyes rlobs/ /sdig can ri dwags gsod rnams kyis/ /mig gis lam du mi blta bar//rkang sne rdo tshor thogs bzhin du//mig gnyis ri yi ngos la bltas//ri dwags gang yang mthong ma thag /rig nas bros 'gro snyam nas 'jab/ /us gis gzas nas brgyab pa'i tshe/ /ri dwags ma sod shor song na//kha nas a ho ma bzang zer/ /sa tshor bsdad nas gcin tsho gtong / /cung zad bsdad nas du ba 'then//de nas langs nas sngar bzhin du/ /lta gi lta gi song ba'i tshe/ /ri dwags mang bo mthong ba na/ /dga' 64

nas bla ma dkon mchog zer/ /gzas nas us 'phangs thar se btang / /ma sod shor tshe ro u po/ /ci zhig byung zer kha tsho blta/ /e shi e shi ma bzang zhes/ /lag pas brang gi steng tsho brdungs/ /de ring nga yi las ngan gi /snyam nas go log sems sdug byas/ /yul du sdug gi sdug gi 'ong / /yul ba rnams kyis sod yod snyam/ /byis pa gzhon nu sngon du rgyugs/ /ri dwags ma sod bshad pa'i tshe/ /khyem tshang bza' ba yi chad nas/ /rgad po yar langs ga re zhes/ /us de mar gye sgo tsho khyer/ /mig cig btsums nas nang tshor bltas/ /bu 'di shin tu ngan pa 'am//yang na us 'di ngan gi snyam/ /khyod kyis ji ltar us 'phangs dang / /ri dwags ji ltar shor tshul dang / /du 'phangs la sogs zhib tu 'dri/ /us de mar gyi steng tsho bzhag /ya ya ja thungs da nangs ngas/ /ma 'gro bshad kyang ma nyan song / /las ka don chen 'di 'dra chag /zer zhing bza' sdig thug pa bskol/ /phyi ma'i sdug bsngal su yis shes/ /kun gyes ma sod sdug de min/ /ma sod na yang ci skyon zhes/ /bshad ni bza' ba'i nang na med/ /nyin re song nas us 'phangs tshe//ri dwags thang du 'gyel ma thag /us bzhag rgyugs nas gson por bsad/ /ri dwags mang bo sod pa'i tshe/ /khal rtar 'gel lam rang khur nas//phyi mar de yi rnam 65

smin gyis/ /dmyal bar song nas ngu bzhin du/ /sdug bsngal myong dgos mi shes par/ /kho bo bsod nams che gi snyam/ /dga' bzhin mal nas glu tsho blaris/ /yul du slebs tshe yul ba rnams/ /dga' nas la la sngon du rgyugs/ /la las thab la chu tsho 'dzugs/ /ri nas yul du slebs ma thag /us de yar gye phu la 'jog /ltogs skom yong zer ja tsho ldud/ /phyi mar sha zos khu 'thung kun/ /dmyal bar song nas sdug bsngal ni/ /ngu bzhin myong ba mi dran par/ /ri dwags mang bo gsod pa la/ /spyir ni khyem tshang bza' ba dga'/ /khyad par a pha shin tu dga'/ /bu 'di ci zhig bzang ni red/ /us 'di ci zhig gzu ni red/ /snyam nas sha khu 'thung zhor la/ /yar gyi us dang mar gye bu'i/ /ngo tshor bar bar yang yang blta/ /phyi nyin rgad po sgo tshor song / /nged kyi bu yis kha sang yang / /ri dwags 'di 'dra bsad 'ongs zhes/ /yul mi khyem mtshes bsgrags nas ngom/ /de ltar nyes med ri dwags kyis/ /don med rtswa chu 'thung ba rnams/ /bsad na tshe 'dir lo re bzhin/ /yar yong med par kha thur 'gro/ /tshe thung nad mang 'chi tshe sdug /phyi mar dmyal ba'i gting du skye/ /thar nas ri dwags bsad tshad kyi/ /lus blangs gzhan gyis gsod par 'gyur//de phyir rngon pa sdig rgan tsho//da lta bsam blo zhib tu 66

thongs/ /gshin rje chos rgyal zer ba de/ /dge sdig rtsis grangs zhib rab yod/ /mdun der song na 'ur zhig khyod/ /slong mi 'dod na da lta'i dus/ /sngar byas sdig pa bshags pa dang //phyin chad mi byed khas len dang / /tshogs gsog gang thub 'bad na legs/ /rig 'dzin gang shar rang grol la/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /gang shar rang grol byin rlabs kyis/ /rngon pa rnams la phan par shog /'phags pa thugs rje chen po dngos/ /rgyal ba rin po che la 'dud/ /ri dwags gsod mkhan rngon pa yis/ /sdig rgyun chod par byen gyes rlobs/ /ri dwags sod zer rgan rgon dang / /ri dwags sha zan bza' tshang dang / /ri dwags gsod mkhan mi gzhon dang / /ri dwags gsod grogs glu 'dir nyon/ /dang po ri dwags gsod pa'i phyir/ /'gro zhes sdig grogs rnams la bshad//rgad pos sman de yang yang bsnos/ /rgan mos yos brngos khol tsho 'thag /chung mas lham ngor lhan pa bslan/ /rgan rgon chung mas ngal ba blangs/ /'gro ba'i nangs par rgad po yis/ /sman dang us rdis do dam byas/ /rgan mos 'khyer rgyu'i bro kha bsgrigs/ /chung mas me bus ja bskol blud/ /'ga' res khal rtar sga tsho bstad/ /grogs kyis bos nas da 'gor thal/ /myur du shog dang 67

da 'gro zer/ /us de phrag par khur nas 'gro/ /bar du ri la slebs pa'i tshe/ /ri dwags zhogs nas gcig ma mthong /ri mgo lung zad mang bo 'grim//char dang kha rlung drag po byung //ltogs skom grang ba'i sdug bsngal myong //nyi ma mang bor song song nas//rkang gi lham zad rkang ba na//us de rgyun du khur khur nas//phrag pa ro stod khol zhing na//tsag dang bser bu khol na ngan//rngon pa ri klung gnyis gar bud//ri dwags dngangs skrag sngon nas bros//rngon pa ri dwags gnyis ka yis/ /sdug bsngal myong ba de mthong na/ /byang chub sems dpas sbyan chab 'chor/ /rngon pa us bzung ri na sdug /bla ma dril bzung grong na skyid/ /rngon pa'i us skad thos na gnod/ /bla ma'i dril skad thos na phan/ /tha ma ri dwags sod tsa na/ /chu mgo'i khar bshas ske la bsregs/ /thab gsur gzhob gsur mang bo byas/ /bdud btsan klu gnyan sogs mi dga'/ /gnod pa btang nas glo bur du/ /geg lhog gzer byung ri mgor 'chi/ /yang na jag pa rkun mar thug /khal rta us dang bro kha 'chor/ /yul lha'i sgo phyugs ri dwags shig /bsad na na tsha god kha 'byung / /byung tshe sku rim mang bo bcos /ri dwags ko dang sha gnyis las/ /lhag pa'i sgo nas rgyu nom 'dzad/ /rngon pa rnams la yar yong dka'/ /rngon pa mtha' la 68
