lhung ba mang / /rngon pa dred kyis bsad pa mang / /rngon pa stag gis khur ba mang //rngon pa 'brong gis gshags pa mang //jon pa gad pas gcur ba mang / /rngon pa ri mgor shi ba mang / /rngon pa 'chi khar na zug mang //de phyir rang la pham ster ba'i//ri dwags bsad nas kha ma gso/ /glu 'di mthong dang thos tshad kyi/ /rngon pa'i sdig rgyun chod par shog /skyon zad yon tan kun gyi gter/ /rgyal ba rin po che la 'dud/ /sa phyogs gang nas rngon pa yis/ /sdig rgyun chod par byen gyis rlobs/ /skyid chung 'di phyir sdug che bas/ /ri dwags bsad nas ci zhig bya/ /bde ba thom bu gang gi phyir//sdug bsngal zangs gang su yis myong / /ru rta'i gong de che rabs yod/ /rgan gzhon tshong pa teb rgan tsho/ /sha ba'i ru rtar heb ma langs ri dwags sha de zhim rabs yod/ /sha dad che ba'i rngon pa tsho/ /ri dwags sha de ma dran cig /spyang lpags wa lbags dro rabs yod/ /gos dad che ba'i rgan gzhon tsho/ /spyang thul wa zhwa ma bsams bzang / /'brong gi ko de mthug rabs yod/ /yar mar rgyug pa'i lham rdol tsho/ /'brong lham mthug po gyon ma snyam//nyes med ri dwags bsad nas ched/ /gsod na nyes can dug gsum sod/ /ri dwags rkang lag bcag nas ched/ /gcog na 'phung bshig 69

us de chogs/ /ri dwags sha de zos nas ched/ /za na sdig med za ma zo/ /ri dwags pags pa gyon nas ched/ /gyon na phying snam la sogs gyon/ /ri dwags phyir du song nas ched/ /'gro na gnas mjal byed du song / /zas nor mang po bsogs nas ched/ /gsog na rnam dkar dge ba gsogs/ /bza' tshang lcang kha'i bye'u mang 'dra/ /mthun par 'grogs kyang myur du 'bral/ /rang nyid gcig pu phyi mar 'gro/ /'gro ba'i nangs par 'gyod med dgos/ /kha 'di'i phyir du sdig ma gsog /kha yi gso lugs chos dang stun//khe tshong zhing las 'tsho skyong gyis/ /khe che nyen chung 'di phyir bde/ /nyan na nga yi tshig 'dir nyon/ /gcod na sdig rgyun rtsad nas chod/ /sngar byas gnong 'gyod bshags pa dang / /phyin chad mi byed dam bca' gyis/ /nyin mtshan med par dge la rem/ /de ltar byas na sdig rgan yang / /phyi mar gyen nas gyen du 'gro/ /mtho ris lha mi'i gnas su 'gro/ /bde chen dag pa'i zhing du 'gro/ /lam chen dkar bo brgyud nas 'gro/ /dkar phyogs lha yis bskyal nas 'gro/ /song na bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /rgyal ba dngos su byon na yang //rngon par zhal gsung 'di min med//nga yang dngos su thug na yang / /rngon par 'di min bshad rgyu med//glu 'di mthong thos rngon pa yis/ /sdig rgyun bcad nas chos 70

bsgrub shog /bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /nya bda' rnams la thugs rjes gzigs/ /dang po nya bda' ngo nag po//phrag tu ra sgye dkar nag khur/ /nya rgya lcags kyu rnon bo dang / /'o co lcags kha lag tu bzung / /chu bo'i gzhung ngam rgya mtsho'i 'gram/ /snga dro'i dus sam phyi dro 'gro/ /bar du nya ba ngo nag po/ /nya mo 'dzin pa'i khog nag po/ /nya rgya lcags kyu btsugs nas lta/ /zin tshe bye tshan nang du 'phen//yar mar lding zhing log nas 'gul//sdug bsngal yun ring myangs nas 'chi/ /tha ma nya ba mdog nag po/ /dmyal bar 'gro ba'i las nag po/ /nya rnams snod kyi nang du 'phangs/ /yar langs gcig sprugs gcig lu nas/ /khur te yul du 'ongs nas bskams/ /nya yi dri ngan chi li li/ /lo gcig ma yin lo re bzhin/ /brgya stong bzung nas rgya la btsong / /nya bda' blun po las ngan tsho/ /nya 'di ma bsad kha mi sos/ /snyam pa khyed tsho 'khrul ni yin/ /nya mo gsod rgyu med sa nas/ /dbul phongs rnams kyis kha sos 'dug /nya bsad kha de gso rag gi /khe tshong 'tsho skyong bkal 'thag dang / /phyug po'i snga phyir rgyugs na bzang / /de 'dra tsam yang mi thub na/ /phyug po'i sgo tshor sprang na dga'/ /mi 'chi ban rgan ngas khag theg /lo re bzhin du brgya 71

stong sogs/ /bzung nas btsong mkhan nya bda' de/ /phyi mar dmyal ba mnar med kyi/ /me nang skyes nas thar mi 'gyur/ /de 'dra'i nya bas bsam blo thongs//rang gis rang la snying rje ltos//tshe 'dir ltogs pa'i sdug bsngal las//brgya stong bye ba las lhag pa'i/ /phyi mar dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal che/ /tshe 'di'i nya sha kham gang phyir/ /phyi mar sdug bsngal lung gang myong / /tshe 'dir cung zad ltogs kyang bzod/ /mi bzod sdug bsngal phyi mar myong / /pha ma ma byas sems can med/ /nya rnams tshe sngon pha ma yin/ /pha mar phan zhig mi 'dogs rung / /gnod pa byed pa khrel med yin/ /deng sang nya bda' khrel med mang / /tshe 'di'i ma yang gsod la byed//nya mo rnams tsho bshad ci dgos//nya rnams klu yi sgo phyugs yin/ /mang bo bsad na na tsha dang //phyugs la god kha 'ong ba yin/ /tshe thar btang na klu rnams kyis/ /ngo blta grogs byed mi phyugs 'phel//nya mo ma gsod tshe thar gyis//sngar bsad rnams la 'gyod bshags rem/ /de ltar byas na tshe 'di ru/ /bza' tshang tshe ring nad med bde//phyi mar mtho sa gnas su sgye//nya mo gser mig ma bsad rung / /nya bda' kun gyis kha sos shog /ces pa 'di ni mtsho sngon phyogs kyi nya bda' rnams la tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//72

rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i srog shing mchog /gnam bskos gong ma rgyal por 'dud/ /rkun ma rnams la thugs rjes gzigs/ /brkus zas za ba'i bza' tshang dang / /brkus la 'gro ba'i mi gzhon dang / /rkun grogs thams cad glu 'dir nyon/ /dang po brkus la 'gro snyam nas/ /rgyu nom su bzang gang bzang 'dri/ /snga dro gcig la gcig thug nas/ /gcig gis gcig la shab shub mang / /phyi dro gcig gi can du 'dug /lus kyi gon pa ldog thung byas/ /snod dang thag pa gang mkho khyer/ /nub mo smag la lam la zhugs/ /song tshe shul gyi bza' tshang mi//la las de bas shes 'dra song / /cha bo bzung 'dra e 'jog gam/ /bzung nas bsad 'dra mi gtong ngam/ /snyam nas sems la sna tshogs dran/ /bar du phyug po zhig gi mtha'/ /slebs tshe khyes go thams cad zug /rgyugs nas 'ong tshe rkang lag la/ /'dzin gyes dogs nas dngangs shing skrag /zog bdag langs nas phyo yi dang / /e ha zer dus shes kyis dogs/ /lu rgyu sprid pa glal mo zhig /byung yang mi khogs bzhin du bkag /dbugs kyang shed kyis len mi nus/ /kha ba char rlung drag po byung / /lus po shin tu grang nas 'dar/ /khyem tshang de ba e gnyid phyir/ /sa 'khyags rdo 'khyags gang rung gi /steng nas yun ring bar du bsdad/ /'phongs sha rkang ba sbrid nas 73

na/ /zog bdag gnyid tshe skrag zhor la/ /song nas gang lon brkus nas 'ong //tha ma khyer nas 'ong ba'i tshe//khyim tshang de ba'i che chung mi/ /gcig gis shes nas yar la langs/ /bshad tshe mi mang lag cha bzung / /phyi nas ki btab ded pa'i dus/ /skrag nas glo snying kha ru 'tshangs/ /bros nas rkang sne rdo tshor thogs//sa la 'gyel yang langs nas bros/ /mtha' tshor thug kyang lding nas bros/ /bros kyang mi thar phyi nas slebs/ /mtshon cha rdo dang dbyug pas brdungs/ /lus po thams cad na tshas gang / /khrag tsho kha sna sogs nas 'ong / /gnam btags sar blangs dbyug pas brdungs/ /khyod la rkun grogs mi du yod/ /mi bshad gsod rgyu yin zer brdung / /na tsha zug rngu mi bzod par/ /rkun grogs du yod tshang ma 'phud/ /thams cad yul na gang yod rnams/ /brkus kyi 'jal du shor nas sprang / /gzhan nor kham bu gang tsam phyir/ /rang nor khang ba gang tsam 'chor/ /de phyir rang la pham ster ba'i/ /brkus 'di nam yang ma byed ang / /glu 'di mthong dang thos tshad kyi//rkun ma rnams la phan par shog /'gro ba rnams kyi mgon skyabs dpung / /gnam skyong gong ma rgyal por 'dud/ /mi ngan khrel med na rag gi /brkus 'di chod par byen gyis rlobs/ /dang po brkus la song ba'i tshe/ /khyim tshang 74

de ba gnyid la shor/ /de yi mtshan mo ma shes sam/ /shes kyang phyi la ma slebs bar/ /rgyu nom gang yod rang yul du/ /khyer nas 'ongs kyang shes e song / /da ni shes 'dra e 'gro ang / /snyam nas sems la bde dus med/ /dbul bo'i kher zog zas brkus na/ /shul na mig chu 'don pa mang / /nyin re bzhin du kha cig gis/ /rkun ma tshe yal tshe thung de'i/ /kha rje dbang thang nag thul le/ /shul chad rjes med rdul phran bzhin/ /song zer dmod mo rkyang ba byed/ /bar du brkus zas za ba'i tshe/ /phyi na mi skad cig grags na/ /de ma thag tu brkus zas sbas/ /kha dang lag pa phyis nas 'dug /sgo la 'gro na thu ba sprugs//kha lag gri chung phyis nas song //nang du 'ong na phyi na su//e yong snyam nas phyi mig bltas//bag phebs za ba'i dus ma byung / /gzhan gyis shes 'gro go 'gro snyam/ /dogs nas brkus zas zos pa de/ /gar tshar mi shes myur du tshar/ /ma zos pa ltar ltogs pa sla/ /lhag par sred pa je cher 'gyur/ /sha nye khyem mtshes la sogs pas//a rog de ba'i rkun ma de/ /khyod red zer nas yid ma ches/ /'dug zer bzung 'dra e 'jog ang / /sems chung gyis dang ma bzang zhes/ /bshad na ngo tshor sha 'gul rgyug /snying yang khog na 'phar zhing 'dar/ /sa gcig mi chags yar mar 'gro/ /tha ma brkus ngan bud pa'i tshe/ /75

bla ma dpon po'i drung du song / /gtugs bsher byas nas yin nges tshe/ /nyes pa'i che chung kun gyis bltas/ /gsod dam yang na mig len nam/ /yang na rkang ba lag pa gcod/ /yang na mar gyi rgya la sprod//yang na khang zhing rgyu nor khyer//de rnams rkun mas ma shes sam/ /mthong dang thos pa yod dam med/ /yod kyang de 'dra zhig mkho 'am/ /mi 'dod sdug bsngal 'ong ba shes/ /brkus byas smyos pa ma yin nam/ /shes bzhin spyon pa zhig ma gtogs/ /ma smyos mi yis mi byed snyam//de phyir rang la pham ster ba'i//brkus 'di nam yang ma byed ang / /glu 'di mthong dang thos tshad kyi/ /rkun ma rnams la phan par shog /rgyal ba'i yab gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /gong ma rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /yul khams mi bde bskyed pa'i gzhi/ /brkus 'di chod par byin gyis rlobs/ /dang po brkus la song ba'i tshe/ /su yis reg thug ma phod pa'i/ /gnyan po dug sdong lta bu yi//rgyu nom mang bo brkus nas 'ong //brkus pa'i phyi nyin nub mo nas/ /bsam nag gcod pa sngags nag gis/ /zhwa nag gyon nas rnga nag brdungs//mthu gtad ngan sngags sna tshogs byed//lo zlar mi 'gor byad khas zug /bar du rkun ma la la spyos/ /de ba'i rkun ma khong tsho yin/ /'di dang 'di 'dra byas nas blangs/ /76

da lta 'di na bzhag yod sogs/ /kha nas mang bo lab nas 'chi//la la pho ba glo bur sbos/ /kho bo gad thal zer bzhin 'chi/ /la la gzhan gyis mtshon chas brgyab/ /glo snying nang khrol lugs nas 'chi/ /la la mtha' chur lding nas 'chi/ /la la rta yis drud nas 'chi/ /la la bsgags nas 'chi bar 'gyur//na tsha shi chad byung ba de/ /mthu mkhan go tshe lhag pa dmod/ /kun gyis de nyos de tshad zer/ /tha ma mi rabs bdun rgyud chad/ /shul du sha nye pha spun gyes/ /log rgyag chu khrid la yung 'debs/ /gnyan po zhig dang 'gras rag gi /btsan po zhig la 'thab kyang drag /gzhan gyis gyang ral zhig po ga /su yi shul yin zer nas 'dri/ /la las de ni las ngan po//de ba'i yin zer kha cig gis//brkus byas tha ma ma bzang zer/ /de 'dra zer ba ngas kyang thos/ /rkun mar rna ba med dam ci//yang na yod kyang 'on pa'am/ /yang na thos kyang de 'dra zhig /mi 'ong blo gdeng zhig yod dam/ /yang na de 'dra zhig 'dod dam/ /'dod phyin lan mang brkus gyis dang / /rang gi lag pas bcos 'dra 'ong / /ring bor mi thogs myur du 'ong / /ban rgan lung bstan thogs med yin/ /steng du 'ong dus 'gyod nas ched/ /'gyod med sngon nas byas na bzang / /glu 'di mthong dang thos tshad kyi//rkun ma rnams la phan par shog /77

sa steng 'di na zla med pa'i/ /gnam skyong gong ma rgyal por 'dud/ /sa phyogs gang nas sdug bsngal rgyu/ /brkus 'di chod par byin gyis rlobs/ /dang po yongs grags rkun ma de/ /ltas ngan 'ug rgan mthong ba ltar//su yis mthong yang yid mi 'ong //kun gyis rig sa mthong sa med/ /'ga' re'i khyim du song ba'i tshe//de yi mthong sar rgyu nor gang //ma 'jog zer nas gang yod sbas/ /bar du mig gnyis ri li li/ /yar mar kun la blta ba'i tshe/ /brkus re byas 'dra e 'jog gam/ /zur nas 'ga' res bsrungs nas 'dug /slong ngam g.yor skyi gang byas kyang / /ster mkhan g.yor skyi byed mkhan med/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis 'ded thabs byed/ /tha ma phar la song shul nas/ /rkun rgan zer nas ngan smras mang / /sde ba kun gyis ma thub dgra/ /rkun tshang ga shul chad na zer/ /gyod sna kha mchu 'dzad rgyu med//thag gcig bcad na gcig mi chod/ /de phyir rang gzhan kun 'phung ba'i/ /brkus 'di bla ma dpon po tshos//chod ces gsungs kyang mi gcod pa/ /mi zhig ma yin the'u rang yin/ /the'u rang rkang gcig yin na ched/ /the'u rang rkang gnyis tha shal yin/ /mi yin snyam du ma sems shig /glu 'di mthong dang thos tshad kyi/ /rkun ma rnams la phan par shog /78

lho rgyal 'dzam gling 'gro ba'i rgyan/ /gnam skyong gong ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rang gzhan yongs la gnod skyel ba'i/ /brkus 'di chod par byen gyes rlobs/ /dang po rkun ma 'chi ba'i dus/ /mnar gcod sdug bsngal shin tu che//mal sa'i nang du yun ring nyal/ /rkang lag 'khum zha dbye mgo rdol/ /sha zad rus par thug nas 'chi/ /la la glo bur gzhon dus 'chi/ /bar du rkun ma 'chi ba'i dus/ /bar do'i mun nag 'phrang ring 'grim/ /grogs med 'khrul snang 'jigs skrag che/ /tha ma dmyal ba'i gnas su 'gro/ /gshin rje'i pho nya mang bo yis/ /lus po thag pa nag pos bkyigs//dug tsher dmar bo'i khrod la sogs//shin tu rtsub pa'i sa ru 'phen/ /bya nag mchu rnon steng du babs/ /gson por mig 'bru kha lce gcod/ /khye 'ongs mchan dang gsus pa nas/ /brtol nas nang khrol lhug lhug 'cha'/ /dri ngan mi gtsang dong nang 'phen/ /mi gtsang nang du lus kun nub/ /mi gtsang nang nas mchu rnon gyi/ /'bu mang byung nas sha rul la/ /'bu zhugs bzhin du lus la zhugs/ /sag sag 'gul nas sha khrag 'jib/ /gshin rje'i pho nya 'ga' zhig gis/ /rkang lag bzhi nas phyogs bzhir brgyangs/ /brla gnyis 'phongs sha la sogs nas/ /sha bcad zan ltar kha nang du//bzhag nas e zhim ltos tsho zer//ske rtsa rkang lag 79

rtsa khrag gtar/ /ja ltar kha ru 'thung du 'jug /khog pa phyes nas glo snying ni/ /mdzo mo'i 'o ma bzho ltar 'then//brkus zas zos na ci tsam red/ /zer nas lhag par snying la brnyabs/ /sdug bsngal mang bo myong du 'jug /de nas rim bzhin nang khrol blangs/ /khyi dang khwa ta sogs la 'phen/ /rkun mas bsam blo zhib tu thongs/ /da lta me stag lhung ba'am/ /skyi bshus byas pa mi bzod na/ /sdug bsngal de 'dra su yis bzod/ /'dzam gling tshe la nges pa med/ /mi gzhon glo bur 'chi la ltos/ /do nub tsam la shi nas ni/ /nangs par lta bur dmyal khams la//mi 'gro'i nges pa cung zad med//glo bur shi na ci zhig bya//kye ma kye hud a tse tse/ /rkun ma de la mi skrag pa//snying de lcags shig ma yin nam//yang na chung nas med pa 'am/ /yang na rul ba zhig yin nam/ /de min snying zhig yod phyin chad/ /'di tsho bsams na cis mi skrag /brkus la dga' ba'i mi de nyid/ /phye leb mar mer dga' ba 'dra/ /brkus zas kha nang bzhag pa de/ /khro chu kha ru blugs dang 'dra/ /de la bde ba'i go skabs med/ /de phyir phyi mar sdig lci ba'i/ /brkus 'di nam yang ma byed ang / /glu 'di mthong dang thos tshad kyi/ /rkun ma rnams la phan par shog /mtshan snyan nyi zla ltar grags pa'i//gong ma rgyal po'i zhabs 80

la 'dud/ /bstan 'gro'i bde skyid la gnod pa'i/ /brkus 'di chod par byen gyes rlobs/ /'di phyi gnyis shar bde ba me da/ /sdug bsngal du ma myong dgos pas/ /brkus la song nas ci zhig bya/ /'gro na gnas mjal byed du song / /snod thag bzung nas ci zhig bya/ /'dzin na ma ṇi bzung la skor/ /brkus zas zos nas ci zhig bya/ /za na rang zas gtsang ma zo/ /rgyu nom blangs nas ci zhig bya/ / len na chos re len thub ltos/ /car wo byas nas ci zhig bya/ /ma ṇi kha shas 'don thub ltos/ /brkus 'jal byas nas ci zhig bya/ /dkon mchog mchod dang sbyin pa thongs/ /tshe 'di'i bya bas ci zhig bya/ /phyi mar bde ba'i dge la rem/ /bza' tshang khrel med mi sna 'dra/ /sdig gi 'khur rogs gcig mi byed/ /lci mo thams cad rang 'khur dgos/ /rang gis rang la snying rje ltos/ /sngar byas brkus la 'gyod bshags gyes/ /phyin chad srog la babs kyang spongs/ /dkar bo dge la 'bad par gyes/ /'bad na brkus mang sngar byas kyang / /phyi mar dmyal bar mi ltung ba'i/ /mtho ris lha mi'i gnas su skye/ /rim pas sangs rgyas 'thob par 'gyur/ /dga' ba bsgoms la legs so zhes/ /nyan na nga yi glu 'dir nyon/ /gcod na brkus ngan 'phro de chod/ /nyin mtshan med par dge la 'bungs/ /gong ma dngos su 81

phebs na yang / /rkun mar zhal gsung 'di min med//ban rgan nga la thug na yang / /rkun mar kha ta 'di min med/ /glu 'di mthong thos rkun ma yis//brkus bzhag dge ba bsgrub par shog /mkhyen rab rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dngos/ /gong ma rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud//yul khams mi bde bskyed pa'i gzhi /jag 'di chod par byin gyis rlobs//dang po jag la song ba'i tshe ra mda' ngo ya ma mchis pa'i/ /phyug po mang bor kha thug nas/ /rgyu ded nom pa mang bo bkal/ /glu blangs gar byas rang yul du/ /slebs tshe nyin gcig phyug por 'gyur//bar du jag pa song shul nas/ /rgyu bdag bza' tshang la lung thor/ /ltogs skom 'khyags nas phal cher 'chi/ /'ga' re gzhan sgor sprang zhor la/ /jag pa'i shul chod rjes bzlog ces/ /ma ṇi'i tshab tu dmod mo bgrang / /gzhan gyis mthong nas jag pa yi/ /mi shul rtsad nas chad na zer/ /tha ma kun gyes gong mar zhu/ /zhus na 'dzad med dmag chen 'ongs/ /shul yang mi shes pa tsam bya/ /kun gyes de tshad de nyos zer//yang na gnyan po dug sdong gis//phyi nas mthu dang ngan sngags sgrub/ /lha srin sde brgyad za kha zug /mi la na tsha drag po byung / /ban bon gnyis kyis sgu rim byas/ /sgo yi rgyu zad khyem gye zas/ /zad 'phror nad pa'i sha zad 'chi/ /med kyi nang 82

nas med gsum 'ong / /jag pa yar la song ba nyung / /jag pa rgyu med sprang bo mang / /jag pa rabs chad pho mo mang / /jag pa thor nas song ba mang / /jag pa rgya la sprad pa mang / /jag pa ngan gsod byas pa mang / /jag pa'i rkang lag bcad pa mang jag pa'i mig gnyis phyung ba mang / /jag pa mtha' chur 'phangs pa mang / /jag pa smyos nas shi ba mang / /jag pa sgos nas gad pa mang / /de 'dra sngon chad ngas kyang tshor/ /jag pas ma thos ma mthong ngam/ /jag zas zos nas bde snyam pa//dug 'thung bde'o snyam pa 'dra/ /sa phyogs gang nas dug gi zas/ /jag 'dir ma dga' jag 'di skyur/ /glu 'di mthong dang thos tshad kyi/ /jag pa rnams la phan par shog /'gro ba yongs kyi mgon skyabs dpung / /gong ma rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mi ngan khrel med na rag gis/ /jag 'di chod par byin gyes rlobs/ /dang po jag la song ba'i dus/ /nyin der phyi nas ra mda' yis/ /ma slebs na yang phyi nas dmag /e 'ong lam tshor thug e 'jog /snyam nas sems la bde dus med/ /so dang mel tshe lta rtog dgos/ /bar du nyin zhig dmag mang 'ongs/ /sgo phyugs gang yod ded nas 'gro/ /ra mda' rgyugs na rang yang gsod//yang na bu dang tsha bo gsod/ /yang na 83

nyin zhig lam nas 'phrad/ /mang bo bcom brdungs bzung nas khyer/ /na tsha ltogs skom sdug bsngal myong / /yang na rma kha mang bton bsgyur//'chi la khad kyi sdug bsngal myong //yang na 'og rta lag cha khyer//dngangs skrag 'jigs pa'i sdug bsngal myong //yang na ded nas la lung tshor//rkang thang bros nas sdug bsngal myong / /jag zas kham bu gang tsam phyir/ /shul gyi ro la kha gtad nas/ /yugs sa ma dang dwa phrug ngu / /mi zad rgyu zad nyin gcig 'byung / /jag la dga' ba'i rgad po tshos//sde tshos zer dang cig tshang de//lkog gtam pa la len rkyang red//bu khyod song na lon na de/ /zos na mar dang bldad na tshil/ /mi gtogs sha lhu red tsho zer//bu yis bden snyam 'gro tshul btsog /song na de ma thag tu gsod/ /rgad po 'phung rgan 'chi med tsho/ /gces phrug sngon la bsad nas ched//rgad po'i lus la spyon pa'i kha//cig re mgo tsho 'dug no red/ /rgad po 'phung bshig brag khung kha/ /gang gi yin na bsums na bzang / /pho gsar gon pa ldog thung byas/ /yar 'gro mar 'gro ma mang ang //gzhon dus dri ror song nas ched//cig re mgo tsho 'ong no red/ /pho gsar glag khra 'dra ba tsho/ /srog de rang gi yin na 'tshos//glu 'di mthong dang thos tshad kyi/ /jag pa rnams la phan par shog /84

lho phyogs 'dzam gling 'gro ba'i rgyan/ /gnam skyong gong ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rang gzhan gnyis gar pham bslan pa'i/ /jag 'di chod par byin gyis rlobs/ /dang po jag pa 'chi ba'i tshe /mnar gcod sdug bsngal shin tu che/ /rnam shes ngo yis mi zin par/ /ldab ldib mang bo lab nas 'chi/ /bar du shi nas bar do la//song na jag pa 'jigs skrag che//mgon skyabs dpung gnyen su gcig med//grogs med zas med gos med 'khyams//tha mar jag pa dmyal bar ltung / /lhung na gshin rje'i mtshon chas gtsabs/ /thig nag btab nas sog les 'dra/ /ri gnyis bar la bsdus nas gcur/ /lcags khang gcig rim nyis rim gyi/ /nang du bcug nas me sbar bsreg /zangs chen ngar mar yos bzhin brngo/ /zangs chen khro chu khol mar 'tshod/ /tsha ba'i sdug bsngal dpag med myong / /de nas grang ba'i dmyal bar lhung / /lus la gos med chab rom dang / /kha ba'i nang nas shin tu grang / /so tham a chu kye hud zer/ /chu bur byung nas chu bur brdol/ /ut+pal pad+ma lta bur gas/ /pad+ma chen po ltar gas nas/ /grang ba'i sdug bsngal dpag med myong / /yar la thon pa'i dus mi 'byung / /de phyir thar med sdug bsngal rgyu/ /jag la ma dga' jag skyur ang //glu 'di mthong dang thos tshad kyi/ /jag pa rnams 85

la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//'khrugs pa med pa'i zhing khams kyi/ /mi 'khrugs pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /mi rnams 'khrug rtsod byed pa kun/ /nye bar zhi bar byin gyis rlobs//mi rnams phan tshun nang 'khrugs nas//'thab rtsod byas pa'i nyes dmigs ni//bshad na brjod kyis mi lang yang / /cung zad tsam zhig bdag gis bshad/ /'thab rtsod byed pa'i mi rnams nyon/ /'khrug gzhi byed pa'i mi de nyid/ /tshe 'dir myur du tshe bsod 'dzad/ /phyi mar dmyal ba thams cad kyi//gting gi dmyal ba yang sos skyes//nam yang yar la thon mi srid/ /dmag dpon byas nas 'gro ba de/ /tshe mjug phal cher mtshon khar 'chi/ /'chi tshe mnar gcod sdug bsngal che/ /phyi mar lha min dmag dpon du/ /skyes nas lha dang 'thab par 'gyur/ /'thab nas pha rol bsad pa'i mi/ /dmyal ba yang sos nang du skye/ /'thab sar song ba thams cad kyang / /lha ma yin du skye bar 'gyur/ /gleng log mang bo 'then pa dang / /'thab nas gsod dgos zer ba'i mis/ /phyin chad kha g.yang bkra shis gang / /brjod na bkra mi shis pa 'ong / /phyi ma gshin rje'i pho nya yis/ /bzung nas lce phyung lce steng du/ /lcags kyi phur ba 'dom gang 'debs//glang gi ko ba bzhin du rgyong //lce steng glang gnyis dor 86

bsdebs rmo/ /kha ru lcags kyi tho lum dang / /khro chu khol ma blugs nas bsreg /phan tshun zhe sdang langs pa yis/ /bskal pa grangs med dge rtsa sngon//bsags pa yod kyang brlags gyur nas//bde ba can du sgye ba 'am/ /sa rdul grangs dang mnyam pa yi/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal brgya byen dang / /tshangs par skye nges pa rnams kyang / /ngan song gsum dang khyad par du/ /dmyal khams bco brgyad nang du skye/ /sdug bsngal myong bzhin 'phral 'phral du/ /sdig pa bsags nas shi 'phos kyang //slar yang dmyal ba'i nang du sgye/ /yar la thon pa'i dus mi 'byung / /bskal chen mang por bde 'gro ru/ /skye ba phar zhog bde 'gro yi/ /sgra tsam rna bas thos pa dka'/ /yul la 'dug pa'i rgan rgon rnams/ /pha rol bsad na dga' ba'i sems/ /skyes na phyi mar dmyal bar 'gro/ /'thab nas bsad pa'i mi rnams ni//shi ma thag tu dmyal bar skye//phan tshun khros nas 'thab pa'i sar/ /'bu srin rkang bas gcur ba yang / /shi na dmyal bar 'gro bar bshad/ /'thab rtsod byas pa'i yul phyogs der/ /sad ser mu ge nad yams sogs/ /bkra mi shis pa sna tshogs 'ong / /sa phyogs kha dog dmar la nag /ngam grog g.yang sa rdo gseg sogs/ /shin tu rtsub pa'i sa ru skye/ /tshe bsod rgyas pa'i sku rim rnams/ /bsgrubs kyang 'grub par mi 87

'gyur gsungs//de phyir 'thab rtsod 'khrug long 'di//gang gi sa nas bcad na bzang / /khyad par reb gong pho skyes tsho/ /'thab rtsod byed pa gtan nas spongs/ /'thab rtsod byed pa phal che ba/ /dpon po rgan rim kha yis lan//dpon po rgan rim thams cad kyis//dmyal ba'i zangs chen kha ma 'byed//phal cher gsar bu'i lag gis phung / /gsar bu rnams kyis dmyal ba'i sdug /rin byin ma nyo ma nyo bzang / /rgan pa rnams kyis kha ma nyes/ /pho gsar rgan pa'i gros la nyon/ /dpa' bo rgya stag 'dra na yang / /chos rgyal mdun na dpa' sa med/ /dpa' bo rnams tsho rang tshod zungs/ /'thab na pha rol pham mo zhes//smras na rang nyid pham pa yin/ /tshe 'dir tshe thung na zug che/ /mi snyan gtam ngan mang bo thon/ /rang nyid gtan pham byas pa yin/ /de phyir khog na sems yod mi//rnams kyis sngon chad nyes pa gang //byas la 'gyod pas bshags pa dang / /phyin chad mi byed dam bca' gyis/ /dpon po rgan pa su yin kyang / /sde ba phan tshun 'thab mo ni/ /byed du ma bcug phan yon ni/ /phyi mar lha 'am mi yul gyi/ /rgyal po blon po chen bor skye/ /sde ba de yi 'khor du skye/ /rtag tu bde zhing skyid ra 'gyur/ /tshe 'dir lha mi thams cad kyis/ /sgye bo de la byams par 'gyur/ /'thab rtsod ma byas yul phyogs de//kha dog 88

dkar dang sngo ljang ser/ /spang ljongs me tog sna tshogs bkra/ /mtsho dang dzing bu du ma 'khyel/ /chu bya du mas skad snyan 'byen/ /sa gzhi bde zhing rab tu bde/ /'jam zhing shin tu 'jam par 'gyur/ /char chu dus babs lo phyugs legs/ /tshe ring nad med lus sems bde/ /dpal 'byor 'dzad med gang gā ltar/ /bdud dgra'i 'tshe med dam chos spyod/ /bsam pa'i don rnams yid bzhin 'grub/ /bkra shis bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /zhi rgyas dbang sogs las gang brtsams/ /thams cad thogs pa med par 'grub/ /rgan pa dmag la mi dga' zhing / /kha nas sod chod gtubs la sogs/ /bkra mi shis pa mi smra bas/ /kha g.yang bkra shis gang brjod kyang / /'thab rtsod gtan nas spong bar mdzod/ /sde rnams bzang bo mi ngan pa/ /'ga' res 'thab tu bcug pa rnams/ /thabs kyis bsdums pa'i phan yon ni/ /tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med pa'i/ /tshe sgrub mchog tu 'gyur ba yin/ /rnyed dang bkur ste byed par 'gyur/ /'thab rtsod mang bo bsdums pa'i mi/ /sangs rgyas byang sems byen gyis rlobs/ /dkar phyogs lha rnams sdongs grogs byed/ /'chi tshe mnar gcod sdug bsngal med/ /bar dor song na 'jigs skrag chung / /phyi mar bde ba can zhing ngam//yang na lha mi'i nang du skye//mdza' 89

bshes mang zhing dgra ni nyung / /'jigs pa med par bder gnas 'gyur/ /de phyir bla ma dpon po tsho/ /grong sde'i 'thab rtsod thabs kyis sdums/ /bsdums kyang 'grig tu mi 'jug pa'i/ /mi de'i khog tu gyod 'dre zhig /zhugs nas mngon sum yod pa'i rtags/ /phyin chad mi de su'i khyim du/ /'ongs na bkra mi shis pa 'ong //de la shin tu 'dzems na bzang //'grig tu ma bcug nyes pa yis/ /tshe 'dir brgya bsam gcig kyang mi 'grub/ /phyi mar dmyal ba'i gting du skye/ /de phyir sems yod mi rnams tsho/ /gyod 'dre zhugs pa'i mi'i kha la/ /nyan nas 'grig tu bcug na bzang / /kun gyis 'grig tu mi 'jug na/ /thams cad snying la zhugs pa yin//de la sgu rim legs po gyis//gyod 'dre dbang du ma gtong zhig /gyod 'dre'i khog tu zhugs rnams kyis/ /kha nas mi bshad dgu bshad dang / /lag nas mi 'khyug dgu 'khyug byed/ /sdum mkhan bla dpon khyad du gsod/ /gyod 'dre'i stabs kyis nyin mo'i dus/ /sa gcig mi chags 'gro snying 'dod//za ma zos na gang ba med/ /mang bo 'thungs kyang skom par 'gyur/ /mtshan mo gnyid yer 'dang log mang / /de 'dra'i mi la bshad pa las/ /khog gi gyod 'dre phud pa'i phyir/ /dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba thobs/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong 'phrin las bcol/ /90

cung zad sdum mkhan rang yul du/ /'ongs nas bde bar bsdad na bzang / /de nas bsdums na phal cher ni/ /'grig pa shin tu mang ba yin/ /da yang nyon dang khyem pa tsho/ /sa steng thams cad ko ba yis//g.yogs na 'dod kyang ga la 'dang //de bzhin dgra rnams thams cad ni/ /bsad par 'dod kyang ga la sod/ /sa steng g.yog gin je che bzhin/ /dgra rnams bsad kyin je mang 'gyur/ /rkang la ko ba'i lham gyon na/ /sa steng g.yogs dang 'dra ba bzhin/ /nang gi zhe sdang gcig bcom na/ /dgra rnams thams cad bsad pa 'dra/ /de phyir rgan gzhon su yin kyang / /bzod pa'i go khrab rgyab tu gyon//bag yod dran shes rta la zhon//byams pa'i mdung ring lag thogs nas/ /zhe sdang dgra 'di cham la phobs/ /sgye bo blun po mi shes pas//dgra rnams cham la phab nas kho/ /rgyun du bde bar 'dug snyam nas/ /'thab rtsod byas pas dus rgyun du/ /bde med sdug bsngal dpag med myong / /byes par pha mas brdungs pa'i tshe/ /sna tshogs rtse dgod pha mar bslangs/ /mgo skyor bros na pha ma gnyis/ /bag gis brdung ba phar la zhog /zhe sdang zhi nas 'dzum dgod byas/ /bos nas rab tu gces pa bzhin/ /blo gros ldan pas pha rol dgrar/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis byams byas na/ /dgra yang gdug rtsub sems zhi ste/ /tshur la de 91

bas byams gyur nas//phan tshun bde zhing skyid par 'gyur//brag la gtam rnams ma smras na/ /brag cha mang bo mi 'byung bzhin/ /rang kha kha rog bsdad gyur na/ /kha mchu rtsod pa med pas bde/ /snyems chung byas nas 'dug shes na/ /bde ba rgyun mi 'chad pa 'thob/ /snyoms chung mi lus skyid pa med/ /don med zhing gi gnya' 'dabs nas//khal cha bzang bo gcog pa bzhin//mi ngan re re'i khar nyan nas/ /gces phrug mang po ma gsod ang / /bcom ldan mi 'khrugs zhes bya la/ /gsol ba btab nas glu dbyangs 'di/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /mdo rgyud bla ma gong ma yi/ /gsung sgos rnams dang sgo bstun nas//spyir ni bod khams sde rnams dang //sgos su dmu rgod reb gong gi /skye bo rnams la phan phyir blangs/ /bcom ldan mi 'khrugs byen rlabs dang / /bdag gi bsam pa bzang po'i mthus/ /sde rnams 'khrug rtsod kun zhi nas/ /rdzogs ldan dus bzhin skyid par shog /cesapa 'di ni bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis reb gong gis 'thab rtsod mang bo byed pa la yid skyo nas/de rnams la cung zad re e phan snyam nas rang bzo lta bu ma yin par mdo dang rgyud sde bla ma gong ma 'ga' re'i gsung sgos dang mthun par smras pa 'dis kyang bod khams spyi dang / khyad par reb gong gi skye bo rnams la phan thogs 'byung bar gyur cigamakhyen rab rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs//ngur sprig 'chang ba'i tshul mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa la/ /gsol ba 92

'debs so byin gyes rlobs/ /gsang sngags bla med rnal 'byor pa/ /ma gtogs sgye bo pho mo rnams/ /'phung byed rgyu ni chang nag yin/ /chang la 'dod chags zhe sdang dang //gti mug nga rgyal phrag dog sogs/ /nyon mongs slong ba'i rgyu rnams tshang / /chang 'thung dus na 'dod chags che/ /rang gi chung mas mi chog par/ /bud med gzhan la spyod snying 'dod//rab byung sdom pa shor ba yang //chang nag 'thungs nas shor ba mang / /chang 'thung dus su zhe sdang che/ /srog gcod la sogs sdig pa'i las/ /chang 'thung dus su byed pa mang //chang 'thung dus su gti mug che/ /bdag gzhan gnyis ka ngos mi zin/ /gti mug gnyid du dbang med 'gro/ /chang 'thung dus su phrag dog dang / /nga rgyal shin tu che ba yin/ /'khon 'dzing 'thab rtsod 'khrug pa rnams/ /chang 'thung dus su 'byung ba mang / /chang 'thung mgo btums shi ba mang chang 'thung mtha' la lhung ba mang / /chang 'thung don chen shor ba mang / /chang 'thung nor rdzas bor ba mang //chang 'thung dge sbyor chag pa mang / /chang 'thung gzhan gyis bsad pa mang chang 'thung dbul bor song ba mang //chang 'thung mgo bo na ba mang //chang 'thung bde bar bsam pa de/ /spyon pa bde'o snyam pa 'dra/ /chang 'thung gzhan la mthu gtad byas/ /'thab rtsod 'khon 93

'dzing byas pa na/ /phyi mar lha ma yin du skye/ /chang 'thung rdo rje'i spun grogs la/ /khros na rdo rje dmyal bar skye/ /chang 'thung chos rtsod nga rgyal byas/ /phyi mar lce la thong gshol gyis//btsugs nas rmo ba'i dmyal bar skye/ /chang 'thung rku 'phrog sna tshogs pa/ /byas na phyi mar 'i dwags ni/ /mtshon cha'i 'khor lo can du skye/ /chang 'thung ngo tsha khrel med kyi/ /bya ba byas na phyi ma la/ /glen lkugs dud 'gro'i gnas su skye/ /chang 'thung khros nas gnod sems kyis/ /gzhan la gri yis brgyab gyur na/ /phyi mar dmyal ba yang sos skye/ /chang 'thung gzhan gyi bud med la//spyad na phyi mar shal ma li'i//sdong bo'i rtse la drag tu 'drud//chang 'thung khye yi lus su skye//mi ru skyes kyang spyon par skye//de phyir mdo sde du ma nas//chang gi nyes pa du ma gsungs/ /ra khyi zer ba'i sgra don ni/ /ra ni 'thungs na shes rgyud ni/ /rwa co bzhin du gyong la zer/ /khye ni bzi nas khye spyon bzhin/ /dgra spun gnyis ka mi shes par/ /mi 'dod gnod pa byed la zer//ra khye de yi stabs kyis thogs//tshe 'dir bza' btung gon pa yi//mnyam la mi phan phyi ma ru//sdug bsngal myong rgyu'i bdud kyi zas/ /chang nag 'thungs nas ci zhig bya//de phyir khyim pa pho mo tsho//'phung sna thams cad 'dren pa yi//chang nag dug chu bdud rtsi bzhin//heb kyis ma 'thung ma 'thung 94

ang / /gnod na chang nag bdud zas chod/ /'thungs na ja zho bzang bo thungs/ /rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa la/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /blo bzang grags pa'i byin rlabs kyis//chang 'thung rnams la phan par shog /mgar ba zhig gi mda' gzhu gnyis/ /g.yu dang gser du bsgyur mdzad pa'i/ /slob dpon bai ro tsa na la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byen gyis rlobs/ /nyon dang du ba 'then mkhan tsho/ /du ba sngon dus bdud mo yi/ /mngal khrag sa la lhung ba la/ /smon lam log pa btab pa'i mthus/ /'jen na nyes dmigs shin tu che/ /dud 'then nyon mongs shin tu rags/ /khyad par zhe sdang chen po skye/ /du ba rgyun du 'then pa'i mir/ /'pho ba btab kyang thebs pa dka'/ /lha srung bzang bo bsten na yang / /dud 'then rnams la 'khor ba dka'/ /dud pa song ba'i phyogs de na/ /dkar phyogs lha klu yod na gnod/ /phyi mar dud 'jen dmyal bar skye/ /dud 'tshong dud sgron 'khor nas skye/ /dam pa 'ga' res gsungs zhes grags/ /tshe 'dir zas gos tshab tu phan/ /mi dgos lhag par gnod par 'gyur/ /dbul bor song ba phal che ba/ /dud 'jen mang bo yod pas 'phung / /khyem tshang gcig la dud 'then gsum/ /yod na yar yong cung zad med/ /de phyir 95

'di phyi gnyis mi phan/ /du ba chod ces mi gcod cing / /bcad kyang phyi nas 'then pa la/ /bdud mo'i byin rlabs zhugs pa yin/ /ya rabs dad can thams cad kyis/ /'di phyi gang la'ang mi phan khar/ /lhag par gnod par 'gyur ba yi/ /bdud mo'i dug 'di ma 'then sgyur/ /slob dpon bai ro tsa na la/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /bai ro tsa nas byin gyis rlobs/ /dud 'then rnams la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o/ /reb gong mun gling lta bu la/ /gangs la nyi 'od 'khyil 'dra ba'i/ /rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho la//gsol ba 'debs so byen gyis rlobs/ /rong gi mi nag phal cher gyes//mdzo g.yag glang la zhing rmo dus/ /sna phug tsha sna blangs nas khrid/ /gnya' shing lci mo gnya' la bzhag /thong lcags zad po sner sprad pa'i/ /lci zhing gshol mda' ring ba yi/ /gshol ngan de yi steng du bkal/ /sra log nyis log rgyag pa'i tshe/ /lag gnyis shugs drag gshol mnan nas//zhing rmos nyin nas gnya' ba skrangs//zom ltar song nas reg mi nyan//sa rnams shin tu sra ba yis//gnya' ba na nas 'then ma thub/ /cung zad bsdad na kho khros nas//dbyug pa chag rag bar du brdungs/ /rma med lus po na tshas 'gengs/ /bdud 96

po rnams tsho de 'dra brdungs/ /khyed rnams gces phrug gsod mkhan gye/ /lag dmar de gnyis ma red mod/ /rgyugs nas ma song dal mi rung //snying rje med pa'i bdud po tsho//khyed rnams phyi nas 'dre zhig gis/ /'ded ki yod ni min mo snyam/ /cung zad ngal re gso ru chugs/ /lag gnyis mnan nas gshol sa'i gting / /'gro gi bcug nas sa 'og na//len rgyu bdud po rnams tshor ci/ /kha nas yang mo gyes la rmos/ /zhing gi pha ri'i sno mo nas/ /tshu ri'i sde la 'bud rag bar/ /dbyug pas gsum bzhi drug bdun brdung / /gcig gnyis tsam re ma mtha' brdung / /de ltar brdungs na nyin re la/ /ci tsam brdung gi bsam blo thongs/ /bdud po khyod tsho zhing rmo bzhin//dbyug pas brdungs na ci 'dra yin/ /e skyid nges par skyid mod snyam/ /bdud po khyed rnams rdung tshul tshor/ /bltas na skyid cig yod las che/ /med na rang lus dpe longs la/ /mdzo g.yag glang rnams gang la yang mi 'dod sdug la ma gtod cig /khyad par steng nas nyi mas bsregs/ /khog na ltogs skom gnyis kyis gdungs/ /gnya' na thur du shing gis mnan/ /sngon gyi sna nas bdud pos 'then/ /phyi nas bdud pos brdungs nas ded/ /sra ba'i lam kha rmo ba'i dus/ /lag pa zung gis gshol mnan tshe/ /gnya' ba khong du shor 97

nas 'gro/ /dbugs rnams thams cad stod du 'tshang / /lce snar ha zhing lus po 'dar/ /sha rus 'gas 'dra'i sdug bsngal myong //sha rus 'gas kyang ma song na//bdud pos brdungs nas sdod mi 'jug /dgung dus rtswa med chu mi ldud/ /dmyal ba zer ba gzhan na gang / /khrel med de 'dra ma byed ang //de ltar byas na bsod nams 'dzad/ /phyi mar dmyal ba'i gnas su 'gro/ /mdzo g.yag glang gi lus blangs nas/ /gshin rje zhing rmo brdungs nas 'ded/ /khrel med mi tsho de khar chugs/ /tshad tshad ran ran nyos no yin/ /snying rje can gyi khrel yod tsho/ /khred med bya ba de ma byed/ /zhing ni las kyis rmo dgos kyang / /gnya' shing yang mo 'jam po dang / /thong lcags gsar ba sprad pa yi/ /gshol mda' ha cang mi ring zhing / /ha cang mi thung 'tsham pa dang / /lag pas cung zad gnon mi dgos/ /sa yi gting du 'dzul 'gro ba'i/ /gshol bzang de 'dras rmo ba'i dus//rdo dang dbyug pas ha cang ni/ /rnga la rdung rdung ma byed par//gshol yang ha cang sa'i gting du/ /'dzul du ma 'jug tshad cig gis/ /rmos la mtshams mtshams ngal re gsos/ /dgung dus 'di gnyis snying re rje/ /snyam du rtswa chu bzang bo byen/ /de ltar byas na tshe 'dir yang / /tshe dang bsod nams cher mi gnod/ /phyi mar rnam smin cher mi 98

myong / /rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho la/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /rje btsun skal ldan byen rlabs kyis/ /log rgyag rnams la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//bdag la rgyal ba las lhag pa'i/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyes rlobs/ /nags la 'gro ba'i shing thun nyon/ /nags la yar la 'gro ba'i tshe/ /sems med la las bong bur zhon/ /steng nas glu tsho len gyin 'gro/ /song nas nags la slebs ma thag /bong bu rtswa chu med sar btags/ /ri yi yar gye ngos la song / /shing mang btus nas ri rtsar 'ongs//bong bus mi theg tsam zhig bkal/ /dbyug pa zhig gis brdungs nas ded/ /la rtsa zhig tu slebs pa'i tshe//bong bu dgye nas cung zad cig /bsdad na stong du ster rgyu bo/ /ye zhes dbyug pas mang bo brdung //de nas bung bu yar la song //la yi rked du thon pa'i dus//'gro ma thub par nyal ba'i tshe/ /khros nas rdo dang dbyug pas brdungs/ /sha rnams pags pa'i nang du blugs/ /phyi nas rma med khong nad bcas/ /lus po thams cad na tshas gang / /yar la langs tshe yang brdungs nas/ /ro smad 'khyogs nas 'gyel la byas/ /'chi la thug rung ma song na//cung zad tsam yang sdod mi 'jug /'gro na 99

khal lci 'gro mi nus//'chi la khad kyi sdug bsngal myong //'chi dang mi 'chi gnyis kyi mtshams/ /yul ngan mu ge ljongs su slebs/ /nas sran chas sogs phar la zhog /rtswa yang mi ster sga blangs nas/ /byes pa 'ga' res sgo tshor 'ded/ /khal lci sga stan ngan stabs kyis/ /rgyab rnams thams cad sgal bar song / /glo dang rmed gnyis ngan stabs kyis/ /g.yas g.yon glo skrangs 'phongs bshus dmar/ /khwa ta skya ka steng du babs//ka dang a sogs skad rigs bsgyur/ /rna sprugs rnga ma tsab tsab byed/ /snying rje cung zad tsam yang med/ /gzhan sdug mi shes snying nag tsho/ /khyed tshor de 'dra'i khal lci bkal/ /brdungs nas ded na ci 'dra yin/ /rang gi lus la dpe zhog la/ /khrel med na rag ma byed ang / /bong bu'i rgyab rnams sgal bas khengs/ /'phongs zad shed ngan lo lon yang / /bong bu 'di nyid snying re rje/ /nyi ma kha shas sos dal du/ /sdod du chugs zhes khyem tshang gi /nang nas gcig gi'ang bshad mi med/ /nyin gcig dal bur sdod mi 'jug /lud sgyel shog bkal shing phyir khyer/ /mi 'dod sdug bsngal sna dgu bo/ /bcol nas rgas tshe gzhan la btsongs/ /btsong sa tshang gis de bas kyang / /sdug la gtad nas 'chi bar 'gyur/ /skyid cig nyin gcig myong mi 'gyur//de ltar bong bur mi byams par/ /khal lci 100

rdo dang dbyug pas brdung / /rtswa chu mi ster rgas pa'i dus/ /rgya la sogs par btsongs gyur na/ /tshe bsod rgyas pa phar la zhog /tshe mjug bong bu tsam med par/ /khyem tshang bza' ba thams cad kyis/ /khur bo 'khur dgos dus tshod 'byung / /phyi mar bong bu sogs su skyes/ /sdug bsngal dpag med myong bar nges/ /de phyir de 'dra ma byed par/ /khrel yod rnams tsho 'di bzhin mdzod/ /sga stan glo rmed 'jam po gyis/ /khal gang 'gel yang yang mo khol/ /rdo dang dbyug pas ma brdungs par/ /yul du bong bu slebs ma thag /gro sran la sogs chas bzang byen/ /de nas rtswa mang chu blud la/ /nyi ma kha shas ngal gsor chugs/ /rgas tshe bong bu drin can zhes//drin de yang yang dran bzhin du//rgyun du sos dal sdod du chugs/ /shi tshe rus par yi ge bris/ /drin gzo ma ṇi pad+me thon/ /de ltar byas na tshe 'dir yang //tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa dang //phyi ma mtho ris lha'ang mir/ /skyes nas bde zhing skyid par 'gyur/ /de phyir khrel yod gzhung bzang tsho/ /bong bur de ltar byams par mdzod/ /chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo la/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i byen rlabs kyis/ /shing thun rnams la phan par shog /zhal chems mgur dbyangs len bzhin du/ /zhing khams 101

gzhan du gshegs pa yi/ /ma cig lab kyi sgron ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byen gyes rlobs/ /'brog gi bud med ngan ma yis/ /be'u lu gu re'u la/ /'o ma nu ru mi 'jug par/ /yod tshad btsir nas 'then stabs kyis/ /be'u lu gu'i ro smad kum/ /rdang na gzhu ltar gug nas 'dug /rdang nas 'phud dus pho nad kyis/ /bzung ba'i mi bzhin lhod por 'gro/ /song nas mar nus 'o ma med/ /mgo rdung byas nas lan 'ga' 'ba'/ /yi chad cung zad dgye nas bsdad/ /de nas 'og tu rgyugs na yang / /ma yis nu ma tsha stabs kyis/ /nu gi mi 'jug phar tshur 'gro//song tshe sngar ltar gug nas 'dug /bdud mos 'o ma btsir stabs kyis/ /re'u lu gu gnyis kyi mgor/ /dbyar yang dgun de 'ongs pa 'dra/ /phung bo thar zhig chod mi 'gyur/ /be'u rgyun du phur bar btags/ /ske yi spu zad phung bo btsog /ske phra khog smad kum nas 'dug /btang na nad pa zungs zad bzhin/ /rgyug mi thub par dal bur 'gro/ /'o ma nu rgyu med pa dang //ma yi glo nas mi sdod par//tshur tsho 'ongs nas cung zad 'dug /de nas song nas e yod blta//ma yang nu ma tsha stabs kyis//lan re nu ru mi 'jug 'gro/ /be'u lu gu re'u ni/ /lus ngan rnams kyi a ma la/ /'o ma yod kyang 'thung dbang med/ /nyi ma gcig ni ma yin par/ /rtswa za chu 102 —

'thung thub rag bar/ /ltogs skom 'khyag pa'i sdug bsngal myong / /phar la mi 'chi tshur mi gson/ /be'u lu gu re'u la/ /sdug bsngal myong du bcug nas ni/ /'o ma zho tsho 'thung ba de/ /a pha a ma gnyis kyi khrag /'thung dang khyad par ga la yod/ /be'u lu gu re'u rnams/ /bdud mo'i rtsa na sdug 'dug byas/ /bdud mo rnams tsho bza' btung gnyis/ /med par nyi ma mang bo la/ /'dug thub bsam blo zhib tu thongs//de ltar phyugs la ma byams na/ /nor dang ra lug lo re bzhin/ /nad kyis shi nas je nyung 'gro/ /shi na bsod zad bdud mo tsho/ /bdud ze'u bzung nas ci 'then snyam/ /phyi mar de yi rnam smin gyis/ /be'u lu gu re'u ru/ /sgyes nas sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur/ /bdud mo rnams tsho rang lus dpe/ /zhog la na rag ma byed ang / /'brog pa'i bud med bzang mo yis/ /be'u lu gu re'u la/ /ma yi 'o ma 'thung du bcug /cung zad tsam min ma bzhos pas/ /lu gu re'u thams cad skyid/ /rdang na thams cad bde bar nyal//ma mo ra ma gcig 'ba' yang / /thams cad langs nas 'ba' dir byed/ /mang bo 'then zhing yang yang 'ba'/ /btang na dgo phrug bzhin du lding / /ma yi 'og tu rgyugs nas nu/ /lto ba 'grangs tshe lus shig sprugs/ /'gying nas dzing btang gnam tsho lding / /sa 'bur gang 103

yod steng tsho 'gro//lha mos 'o ma ma 'then pas//re'u lu gu gnyis kyi mgor/ /dgun yang dbyar de 'ongs dang 'dra/ /phung bo thams cad thar bcad nas//re'u lu gu'i lus po mdzes//be'u'i steng na spu zhag yod//ri dwags bzhin du yid du 'ong //bzung na gzhon nus mi thub 'chor//btang na 'brong phrug bzhin du rgyug /nus nas 'grangs tshe sa tsho bsnam//rnga ma bsgrengs nas yar mar tshor/ /rgyugs pas yun ring zin mi 'gyur/ /be'u lu gu re'u rnams/ /lto ba 'grangs su bcug nas ni//'o ma 'thungs na lha'i bdud rtsi/ /'thung dang khyad par ga la yod/ /be'u lu gu re'u rnams/ /lha mo'i rtsa na bde bar nyal/ /de ltar phyugs la byams byas na//nor dang ra lug lo re bzhin/ /je mang je mang 'gro ba yin/ /je 'phel song na lha mo tsho/ /lha ze'u zungs la da yang 'jen/ /phyi mar phyug po'i gces phrug tu/ /skyes nas 'o zho 'thung bar 'gyur/ /lha mo rang lus dpe longs la/ /ya rabs de 'dra gyes shig ang //ma cig lab kyi sgon ma la//gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /ma cig lab sgron byin rlabs kyis/ /bud med rnams la phan par shog /nyon dang khyim pa pho mo tsho/ /khyem tshang ngan pas sgo khye la/ /lto ma blud pas gzhu ltar gug /sgo rtsar cha med mi byung dus/ /khyi de 104

zug tshe khyem du bltas/ /skad ni snyoms snyoms shig phud nas/ /'ug ge 'ug ge lan 'ga' zug /khyim na bza' btung zhig gi sgra//grag pa thos na nang du rgyugs//song na ro 'drad ga la stos//zer zhing rdo 'am dbyug pa yis/ /brdungs nas song zer sgo ru 'ded/ /ngu zug byed cing rkang lag 'theng / /a long bzhin du 'khyel nas nyal//rgas tshe mtsher nas 'jog pa mang //sgo yi khye de rgud tsa na/ /khyem tshang de ba'i mtshang zhig yin//phyi mar rnam smin shin tu che/ /de phyir khyem pa pho mo tsho/ /khrel med de 'dra ma byed ang //nyon dang khyim pa pho mo rnams/ /khyim tshang bzang bos sgo khye la/ /lto mang blud pas mda' ltar drang / /sgo rtsar cha med mi byung dus/ /zug tshe ngar skad shin tu mtho/ /rgyugs tshe rta bas bang mgyogs shing / /mchongs tshe rgya stag bzhin du lding / /'dug tshe seng ge bzhin du 'gying / /sgo yi khye de dar tsa na/ /khyim tshang de ba'i rgyan zhig yin/ /phyi mar phan yon dpag med 'thob/ /de phyir khyem pa pho mo tsho//ya rabs de 'dra gyis shig ang //zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis khyim pa pho mo yongs la phan phyir smras pa'o//khyem pa dad can rnams tsho nyon//khyim tshang ngan pas g.yog po yi/ /lus la chad chod tshems dug bskon/ /skom du ja min chu 105

min ldud/ /zas su ngan ngon dman zas ster/ /'gro na rgyun du rkang thang 'gro/ /'dug tshe kun gye 'gab tu 'jog /bu dang g.yog por khyad par che/ /cung zad tsam zhig ma lan kyang / /g.yog nag 'dis zer sdigs dang brdung / /nangs par lug rdzi la sogs la/ /'gro na da khyod 'gor bud thal/ /rem rem zo zo thungs thungs zhes/ /za dbang 'thung dbang mi ster 'ded/ /nyin par ri nas grang zhing ltogs/ /dgong mo yul du 'ongs pa'i tshe/ /ngan ngon grang rnyog bza' btung ster/ /myur du zo thungs 'di las dgos/ /zer nas mar gyi sgo tsho 'gro/ /cung zad tsam zhig 'gor mi nyan/ /khyem na g.yog rgan khyod cig gis/ /mnan 'dra yod ni ma yin nam/ /mid par bza' btung mi thar ram/ /shog zer tshig ngan sna tshogs smra/ /de ltar g.yog por byas gyur na/ /khyim tshang bza' ba ngan tshul gyi/ /gtam ngan phyogs bcur g.yog pos sgog /bsgrags tshe mi khas lung ba 'gengs/ /phyin chad g.yog por 'dug mi med/ /phyi mar gzhan gye bran du 'gyur/ /de phyir khyem pa pho mo tsho/ /ma rabs bya ba de tsho spongs//khyem pa pho mo 'di la nyon/ /khyim tshang bzang bos g.yog po la/ /dro 'jam legs pa'i gon pa bskon/ /bza' btung nam mkho'i dus su ster/ /'gro na rta sogs zhon nas 'gro/ /'dug tshe 106

gang du bsdad kyang chog /bu dang g.yog por khyad par med/ /nangs par lug rdzi la sogs su/ /'gro tshe bza' btung rgyags re ster/ /dgong du e 'ong sngon nas blta/ /'ongs tshe grang dang ltogs yod ces/ /tsha zhing mngar ba'i ja rgod ldud/ /snum zhing zhim pa'i za ma byin/ /rgyags rung da dung zo zo zer/ /de ltar g.yog por byas gyur na/ /khyem tshang bza' ba bzang tshul gyi/ /snyan pa phyogs bcur g.yog pos sgrog /bsgrags na snyan pas sa steng 'gengs/ /phyin chad g.yog por 'dug pa mang / /phyi mar gzhan gye rgyal por 'gyur//de phyir khyim pa pho mo tsho ya rabs bya ba de 'dra gyis//zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//cha lugs ma nges sna tshogs byed/ /ngo mtshar gsung byon gdul bya 'dul/ /grub thob 'brug pa kun legs la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /dang po a mchod ming snyan po/ /'ongs ma thag nas a mchod zer/ /sbra gur phugs nas stan tse bting / /a mchod ga nas sdod tsho zer/ /ja tsho blud nas sgo tsho 'gro/ /nged kyis a mchod cig bzhag ces/ /bsdad ma khad nas kun la grags/ /kun gyis a mchod a mchod zer//khos kyang a mchod khur de bzung / /stan tse'i steng nas tsog bur bsdad/ /gang thon zer ba'i chos kha 'byed/ /bar du a mchod las sgrib 107

can/ /mal nas cung zad 'dug khom med/ /a mchod a mchod 'dir shog zer/ /phyir la chos kyi kha de bsums/ /yar langs mar gyi lham gyon nas//re 'ga' lu gu'i rdang na yod//re 'ga' be'u'i ske la 'jus//re 'ga' lug gi phyi na yod//nyin re la lo'i rdzi bo yin/ /bar bar nor la lta ru 'gro/ /khyim tshang bza' ba che chung gis/ /a mchod a mchod rem rem zhes//ming nas rtseg gi rtseg gi 'bod/ /a mchod mtshan nas bzung ma thag /phar la gru gu 'dril 'dril dang / /tshur la 'phang lo 'khor 'khor byed/ /g.yog po'i gdan sa a mchod 'phrog /a mchod man na g.yog po gang //gzhan gyi mi yis bltas pa'i tshe//a mchod bya ba thams cad la/ /dgod rgyu ngu rgyu gnyis ka yod/ /kun gyi kha nas a mchod ces/ /'bod pa'i dus su dgod re bro/ /chad chod a mchod sku la gsol//ngan ngon bzhes tshe ngu re bro//cha med rnams kyis g.yog po dang //a mchod gnyis ka mi shes par//g.yog po a mchod gnyis la bltas/ /khyed kyi a mchod gang yin zhes/ /dris tshe yon bdag ngo re tsha//la las 'phyugs nas g.yog po la//a mchod a mchod 'dir shog ces//zer ba'i tshe na bzhad gad 'chor/ /bar bar a mchod las sgrib ni/ /cung zad zad dus mal nas bsdad//chos kyi kha phyes bton pa'i mod/ /sku yi gon pa 108

ngan pa'i stabs/ /rgyab nas a mchod shig gis bzhes/ /lag gnyis ma slebs phung bo 'gul/ /'og gi stan tse srab pa'i stabs/ /'phongs sha rkang ba sprid nas ni/ /'dug ma thub par 'phag shad byas/ /ngan ngon bza' btung byas pa'i stabs/ /rgyu mas 'ur ldir mang bo byas/ /rgyun du a mchod sgo ru rgyug /phyir 'ongs chos kyi bam khar bltas/ /ma khom stabs kyis cang ma song / /mi 'grub 'dug snyam la yog nas//shog gu kha shas rdzogs nas btang / /yon bdag yod dus cung zad bton/ /rdzogs 'don gnyis ka sbrags ma byas/ /a mchod chos ni de ltar 'don/ /yon bdag chos kyi phan yon yang / /chad chod de 'dra tsam zhig thob//da lta snyigs ma'i dus skabs 'dir//'brog pa'i phyug po phal cher gyis/ /a mchod zer ba'i ha ngas go /a ne a ye a mye dang / /a rgya a lce rnams tsho red/ /mchod ni de rnams thams cad kyis/ /a mchod de las 'di gyis sogs/ /las ka mang bo bcol bcol nas/ /bsam khom sgom khom phar la zhog /mchod cig 'don khom med pas na//a mchod de yi stabs kyis thogs/ /a mchod sdug bsngal 'dzad med pos/ /lo dang zla ba mang bo'i bar/ /char chu'i nang du mang bo 'gyel/ /mun pa'i nang du rkang rdor brgyab/ /nyi ma'i nang du tsha bas bsreg /lus ngag 109

ngal ba du ma blangs//g.yog ni dkar nag gnyis ka byas/ /tha ma a mchod lag stong bo/ /rang gi yul du ldog pa'i dus/ /chos bton 'bul ba mi dgos ni/ /ong ba btus pa'i tshegs rin med/ /a mchod gon pa sa yis zin/ /a mchod ngo tsho thal phyur re/ /a mchod sha skam mdog kyang nyams/ /a mchod lag pa nag cing rtsom/ /a mchod lham zad 'dam gyis gos/ /a mchod chos gos dud par song //a mchod rgyab kyi gon rgyu btsog /a mchod bcing rgyu'i ske rags btsog /a mchod mgo yi zhwa yang btsog /a mchod rkang gi lham yang btsog /a mchod phul ba'i rta yang btsog /a mchod 'khyer rgyu'i skal yang btsog /btsog 'dre mang bo byin stabs kyis/ /a mchod bsam pa de yang btsog /khog nas brgya bsam mi 'grub rgyu/ /tshang gi 'bul ba ngan gi snyam/ /bzhin mdangs gnag nas rang yul bsnyegs/ /yul du slebs tshe yul ba dang / /khyem mtshes thams cad sngon du rgyugs/ /'bul ba ci zhig byin snyam nas/ /yul mi khyem mtshes thams cad kyis/ /khyem la 'bul ba ci byin 'dri/ /dris tshe 'di tsho byen no zhes//bshad tshe thams cad kha log nas//a kha de 'dra cig tshang gi /g.yog por bsdad kyang ster bar 'dug /ma rabs bse rag yi dwags sogs//gtam ngan mi khas lung ba 'gengs//phyin chad 110

a mchod 'dug mkhan dkon/ /'brog gi phyug po phal cher gyi/ /a mchod byas nas sdod pa las/ /rong gi phyug po bzang bo yi /g.yog po bde bar nyal bas skyid/ /a mchod yar la mi mchod par/ /mar gyi g.yog po byed na ni/ /ma bzhag nyes pa med pas bzang / /g.yog pobyas na tshe 'di ru/ /tshe bsod rgyas pa phar la zhog /tshe bsod 'dzad pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur/ /phyi mar gzhan gye bran g.yog tu/ /skyes nas sdug bsngal du ma myong //a mchod dper na me dang 'dra/ /me de bzhag na thams cad dros/ /gtor na snod gos 'tshig pa bzhin/ /a mchod phugs kyi mal nas bzhag /mchod na tshe dang bsod nams rgyas/ /a mchod yar mar mngags gyur na/ /tshe dang bsod nams 'dzad par 'gyur/ /ma rabs dad med thams cad la/ /tshig 'di bshad na nyan mkhan med/ /chu ngan thur du rgyug pa de/ /bkag pas khog pa ngas ma mthong / /ma rabs dge med de dang 'dra/ /de tshor tshig 'di bshad pa min/ /ya rabs dad pa can rnams la//bshad ma thag tu kha la nyan/ /rta kha thur du 'gro ba de/ /srab kyis bsgyur na gyen du 'gro//ya rabs dad can de dang 'dra//de tshor tshig 'di smras pa yin/ /go tshad 'brog pa'i ya rabs kyi/ /dad can rnams kyis a mchod la/ /khrel med de 'dra ma byed ang / /grub thob 'brug 111

pa kun legs la/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /'brug pa kun legs byen rlabs kyis/ /'brog pa yongs la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang dad ldan slob bu lha 'brug dge slong la smras pa'o//chu bo sa la 'gro bzhin gshegs//mkha' la bya ltar 'phur ba yi/ /ras chung rdo rje grags pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /dang po a mchod las can po/ /yon bdag a mchod phebs ki zhes/ /mig gis mthong tshe sngon nas bsu/ /thag rgyang gang la slebs tsa na/ /sbra gur gang yin sgo yar btegs/ /phugs su rab tu 'jam pa'i gdan/ /mthug po mdzes par bzhugs su bcug /a mchod mdun du cog tse bzhag /phye mar la sogs bza' ba phul/ /ja bzang tsha zhing mngar ba drangs/ /dam chos 'di 'dra gsung dgos zhes//lus ngag gus pas snyan du zhu/ /dam chos blangs nas spyi bor bzhag /yar la a mchod phyag tu phul//spos sgon mar me du ma sbar//phyag dang skor ba mang bo bya/ /bar du a mchod bde skyid po/ /gom gang 'gro mi dgos pas bde//na bza' mang bo phul stabs kyis/ /a mchod za ba'i shig med bde/ /stan yang 'jam zhing mthug stabs kyis/ /a mchod 'phongs sha rkang ba bde/ /khog tu sha thud mar la sogs//zos pas a mchod lus po bde/ /khyad par ja bzang 'thung 112

stabs kyis/ /a mchod smra lce shin tu bde/ /a mchod yar mar phebs pa'i tshe/ /yon bdag bsu skyel byed pas bde/ /dam chos bton pa phar la zhog /a mchod go ba can yin na//bsam sgom gnyis kyang bya ba yin/ /de ltar bton bsam bsgoms tsa na/ /yon bdag phan yon dpag med 'thob/ /a mchod zer ba'i sgra don ni/ /a ni a pha a ma las/ /a dur lhag pa'i a mchod la/ /lus ngag bkur snyi byed la zer/ /mchod ni rang la gang yod rnams//nang nas gang bzang gang gces kyi//zas gos nor gyis mchod la zer//a mchod de yi stabs kyis thogs/ /lo dang zla ba mang bo'i bar/ /a mchod lus bde kha skyid brgyab/ /tha ma a mchod sku bsod can/ /rang gi yul du 'byon pa'i skabs/ /a mchod na bza' snum gyis zin/ /a mchod zhal yang snum tsig ge /a mchod sha gsog sku mdog bzang / /a mchod phyag kyang dkar zhing 'jam/ /a mchod lham bzang skam thag ge /a mchod chos gos spos dri bro/ /a mchod sku yi na bza' legs//a mchod zhabs kyi lham yang legs/ /a mchod phul ba'i rta yang legs/ /a mchod 'khyer rgyu'i skal yang legs/ /legs po mang bo phul stabs kyis/ /a mchod bsam pa de yang legs/ /ci bsam thams cad 'grub rgyu tshang / /nga la 'bul ba bzang gi 113

sogs//kha 'jam tshig gi gtang rag gtong //yon bdag dga' zhing spro ba skye/ /a mchod dga' bzhin rang yul phebs/ /yul du phebs tshe yul ba dang //khyim mtshes rnams kyang sngon du rgyugs//'bul ba ci zhig phul snyam nas/ /yul mi khyem mtshes thams cad kyis/ /khyed la 'bul ba ci byin 'dri/ /dris tshe 'di tsho byin no zhes/ /bshad tshe thams cad kha mthun par/ /yon bdag de ba drin can tshang / /kha rje yar la 'gro gi chugs/ /la sogs legs pa'i smon lam 'debs/ /yon bdag de bas nged tshang la/ /'di tsho byin zhes yongs la sgog /kun gyis go nas yon bdag de//tshe ring bkra shis la sogs pa'i/ /gtam snyan sgrog cing phal cher gyes/ /de bas phyin chad nged tshang gi /bla ma ban+de 'di tsho'i gcig /a mchod cig la e 'jog snyam/ /phyin chad a mchod 'jog pa'i dus/ /nga 'dug zer ba mang po 'byung / /a mchod gang gi gang bzang rnams//yon bdag de yi lag tu 'ong //rong gi grong dang dgon pa la/ /gnas pa'i bla ma phal cher las /'brog pa'i phyug po ya rabs kyi//a mchod bde bar bsdad pas skyid/ /a mchod yar la mchod pa'i mthus/ /tshe 'dir tshe dang bsod nams dang / /rlung rta snyan grags ches cher rgyas//phyi mar rgyal po blon po sogs/ /mthon po'i rigs su skyes nas ni/ /114

gzhan gyis mchod cing bkur bar 'gyur/ /a mchod dper na nor bu 'dra/ /yid bzhin nor bu mchod byas na/ /dge legs bkra shis 'byung ba bzhin/ /a mchod rtag tu mchod byas na/ /legs tshogs thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de phyir 'brog gi ya rabs rigs/ /dad can kun gyes a mchod ni/ /de ltar mchod cing bkur ste gyis//ras chung rdo rje grags pa la//gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /grub chen ras chung byin rlabs kyis/ /'brog pa rnams la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//dpal ldan bla ma chos kyi rgyal po de/ /dad ldan bdag gi spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs/ /skal ldan slob ma'i blo kha chos la sgyur//shes ldan bu khyod blang dor gnas shes mod/ /'on kyang mi brjed dran gso gsal 'debs dgos/ /gsal 'debs glu 'dir nyon cig snying gi bu/ /mtshan nyid tshang ba'i bla ma phal cher dang / /kha sems mthun pa'i grogs po gshegs pa dang //lha dang 'dra ba'i yul mi khyem mtshes dang / /dad gtong che ba'i yon bdag pho mo rnams/ /phal cher tshe mthar ma phyin glo bur du/ /'jig rten pha rol song ba'i tshul rnams soms/ /'o skol thams cad de yi rang bzhin yin/ /snyigs dus tshe thung tshe la 115

gnod pa mang / /tshar med 'dre 'dul grong chog bya ba bzhag /snying nas dam pa'i lha chos byed re ran/ /grong chog zer ba'i 'phral du phan phan pos//phugs su 'di phyi gnyis gar pham ster ba'i/ /'di la dga' phyin blun po gzhan na med/ /gong chog phyir du song gin song na 'dod/ /ci tsam song yang chog shes skye mi 'gyur//gcod sngags 'ga' res grong chog rkyang ba byas//rgyu nom mang po rnyed kyang khyem nas phar/ /phyags mas phyags bzhin cung zad tsam mi chags/ /grong chog byed kyin kha thur 'gro ba de/ /lha 'dre mang po'i za skal phrogs pas lan//gcod pa 'ga' res snga dro g.yang gzhi bshams/ /long g.yos sbom po tshang ra tshon po 'chos/ /rnga ril rdung tshe shed che sems kyang dpa'/ /phyi dro dgung mo zug gzer drag po byung / /kha ru chu yang mi 'gro mtshan mo shi /yon bdag lha khyem ro yis brdzad pa yod/ /sde brgyad byad kyi sna sdod byas pas lan/ /o rgyan pad+mas dam la ma btags pa'i//lha 'dre gdug rtsub snyigs ma'i dus 'dir mang / /'dre 'dul mkhan bos phar la 'dre 'dul lam//tshur la rang nyid 'dre yis 'dul mi shes/ /sku bsod che ba'i bla ma dge bshes dang / /grong chog che ba'i ban gcod sngags pa rnams//dug dang mthu byung glo bur shi ba mang / /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir sems can phrag dog 116

che//khyi rgan gar bo sa la rgyug pa bzhin//yon bdag rnams kyis gar bos rgyug mi rung / /grog ma yar mar 'gro 'dug mang drags na/ /rkang lag thang phyir 'byar nas 'chi ba bzhin/ /grong chog phyir du yar mar rgyug drags na/ /dug mthu lha 'dre'i gnod pas glo bur 'chi/ /grong chog byed la dga' ba'i gcod sngags de/ /dug dang 'dres ma'i zas la dga' ba 'dra//lha 'dre byad kyi sna sdod byed pa de/ /ri gzar rbab rdo'i sna nas sdod pa 'dra/ /lus srog bar chad de'i che gzhan na med/ /gcod sngags 'ga' zhig skabs skabs mtshams re la/ /bsdad na yon bdag 'ga' re nang du zhugs/ /thabs med las kyi khyed tshang mtshams grol nas/ /nged kyi khyim du 'ongs nas sku rim zhig /bca' dgos zer nas dbang can rkyang ba btsongs//ma song bsdad na kha drin sna tshogs smra/ /yon bdag ya gi tshang du yang yang khyed/ /'gro gi khong gis bos na cis mi 'ong / /yon bdag nged gnyis ngo khyad cig yod na/ /khyed la gsal mo de min khyed mkhyen zer/ /mtshams rdzogs mdong nge mdong nge der 'gro dgos/ /grong chog byas nas yon bdag ngo bzung na//ngo can min pa'i yon bdag mi gcig med/ /yon bdag gcig dang mthun tshe gcig dang 'khon/ /ngo bzung sems 'dzin ma thub sems sdug mang / /yon 117

bdag kun gye ngo bsrungs sems 'dzin phyir/ /grong chog byas na gcig phyir gcig mthud nas/ /'chi rag bar la khom pa'i dus mi 'byung / /chos kyi bar chad de'i che gzhan na med/ /grong chog byed dus g.yang gzhi rkyang ba blangs/ /lha 'dre mang bo'i za skal 'phrog phrogs nas/ /tshe 'dir na tsha shi chad mang bo 'byung / /mi dang rgyu 'dzad rang yang tshe mi ring / /phyi mar byang chub thob pa phar la zhog /mtho ris gnas su mi skye ngan 'gror ltung / /gcod sngags blo gros che bas bsam shes na/ /rang la gnod pa de'i che gzhan na med/ /yon bdag 'ga' res sku rim tshad ldan btsugs//sri bcad nad gsos tshe bsod rigs rgyud spel/ /phan thogs rgya cher byas kyang drin mi shes/ /'gro khar 'bul ba mi ster phyis 'bul zhes/ /kha bzang chen po gtam nas rdzong thabs byed/ /phyi nas dom bzhin bsnyegs kyang ster mi 'gyur/ /e ster re nas drin 'dren mthu sdugs shig /byas na yon bdag khrel med na rag tshos/ /gri phyung gsod rgyu yin zer steng du 'chor/ /yon bdag khrel med 'ga' res dpon gyi rta/ /phyi ma nang ma byas nas rkun mar ster/ /'ga' res dpon de 'phrag rung ma 'phrag zer/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir yon bdag khrel med mang / /ban sngags 'ga' res grong chog byas byas nas/ /khyem 118

tshang khrel med 'ga' re gsos gsos na/ /na so rgas nas grong chog mi thub tshe/ /kha ton bzlas brjod byed snyam mal sa nas/ /skyabs 'gro'i 'go blangs yod tshe 'don mi 'jug /a khus bu chung 'di zungs ga yang las/ /zer nas nang las bu chung 'tsho skyong gtad/ /tha na skyabs 'gro'i mgo rnga tshang ma zhig /mal sa dron por bsdad nas 'phud khom med/ /skabs skabs rta nor lug gi 'tsho skyong byas/ /char chu mun nag nang nas sdug bsngal myong / /khyem tshang khrel med 'ga' res a khu la/ /chad chod gos bskon ngan ngon bza' btung ster/ /de yang 'dod pa'i dus su ster mkhan dkon/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir khyem tshang khrel med mang / /a khu drin can yin zhes zhwa bzhin bkur/ /mal sa dron po'i bde bar 'dug tu bcug /dro 'jam gos bskon zhim pa'i bza' btung gnyis/ /ster ba'i khyem tshang khrel yod re re tsam/ /a khu 'ga' res zhib tu bsam shes na/ /a khu'i man na g.yog po g.yog mo med/ /chad chod hral hrul a khu'i rgyab na yod/ /g.yog po g.yog mos de'i thu gon rabs med/ /nyag nyog ngan ngon a khu'i za skal yin/ /g.yog po g.yog mos de'i ngan za rabs med/ /nang las sgo phyugs 'tsho skyong a khus byed/ /g.yog po g.yog mos de'i lhag las rabs med/ /de phyir grong chog ma 119

byed ma byed ang / /tshig ngan dam dum ras kha kha dar dang / /za mtsher ma re'i phyir du gcod pa dang / /sngags pa 'ga' re smyos nas mthu gtad byas/ /dgra shi rang yang kum se btang ba yod/ /gcod sngags 'ga' rer gzhan gyis a khu lags/ /khyed kyi mig g.yas rkyen ci byung nas long / /rkang lag 'di tsho rkyen ci byung nas zha//dris na a khu gsar bu sna rkyang gi /song nas mthu gtad 'di 'dra zhig byas nas/ /byung ba yin zhes zer ba'i rna thos yod/ /mthu byas dgra la gnod pa kha ba tsam/ /byung na tshur la ba mo tsam zhig 'byung / /sna sdod sra na byad kha phyir la log /mi la nad dang phyugs la god kha 'ong / /mthu byas tha ma ma bzang zer ba mang / /'gro kun skye ba sngon ma'i pha ma yin//cung zad ngan re byas pa mi bzod par/ /mthu gtad byed pa'i gcod sngags khrel med yin/ /sems can gcig tsam yal bar 'dor ba'i blo/ /skyes phyin theg chen gral nas ro ltar bud/ /bla med byang chub thob pa'i skal ba chad/ /dug mthu mtshon cha gsum gyis gang gi sgos/ /sems can bsad na nyes pa yang lci med/ /phyi mar ngan song ma gtogs 'gro sa med/ /de phyir mthu gtad ma byed ma byed ang / /nam 'chi cha med soms la tshe blos thongs/ /nyams dga'i ri khrod bsten la lha chos sgrubs/ /de ltar mdzad na skal 120

ldan snying gi bu/ /gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /glu 'di thos tshad rnams kyis grong chog dang / /mthu bzhag dben par lha chos bsgrub par shog /ces pa 'di ni dad gtong blo gros che ba'i slob bu dkon mchog bstan 'dzin la smras pa'o//dang po bla ma nges 'byung can//chung ngu'i dus nas rab byung byas/ /cher song bsnyen rdzogs sdom pa blangs//mtshan nyid grwa sa dag la bsdad/ /chos la thos bsam byed pa'i tshe/ /dge 'dun kun gyis 'di nyid la/ /chos ra ba ni bzang bo zhig /nges par 'ong gi zer zhing smon/ /dbu ma lta bur thon pa'i tshe/ /de don bsgom pa phar la zhog /gang zhig cig nas skad nyes shig /go ltar 'phro yang bshol nas 'jog /bar du bla ma 'gro 'dren po//pha yul la sogs grong du 'bab/ /kun gyes bla ma zer zhing mjal//khos kyang bla ma'i khur de bzung / /dad zas gshin zas sdud la brtson/ /dad can mi yis chos zhus tshe/ /nor rdzas rtswa mgo'i zil ba 'dra/ /mchod sbyin byas na bzang la sogs/ /chos gtam chen po kha nas lab/ /khog na 'dod sred me bzhin 'bar/ /de ring 'bul ba ci ster snyam/ /mi zhig shi ba thos nas bzung / /gdan 'dren pa zhig e 'ong snyam/ /mi zhig grags na gdan 'dren pa/ /e yin snyam nas su red zer/ /nyi ma kha shas 121

gdan 'dren pa/ /ma 'ongs pa na rgyang rtsar byed/ /de bas bla ma su gdan drangs/ /ci phul rgyu nom e bzang 'dri/ /gdan 'dren mi ni byung ma thag /grwa bar rem la rta longs zer/ /myur du rta la sga bstad nas/ /reb gong stod kyi jag pa bzhin/ /rgyug 'dur gnyis ka byas nas song / /de nas ja dang sha drangs tshe/ /lug sha tshon po zhig yin na/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ /lug 'di ci zhig tsho ni red zer/ /zer zhing grwa ba rnams la blta/ /grwa bas lags so de red zer/ /de nas cho ga 'don pa'i tshe/ /mig zum khog stod rab tu 'gul/ /khog na de ring ci ster snyam/ /de nas 'bul ba phul ba'i tshe/ /dga' zhing kha nas 'di skad zer/ /nga la 'bul ba che tshad red/ /khyed rnams shi bo 'di'i don du/ /mya ngan byas pas mi phan pas/ /shi bor phan pa lha chos yin/ /chos rnams sgyu ma rmi lam 'dra//rtag pa'i chos ni gang yang med//mya ngan ma byed la sogs pas/ /sdug bsngal can la sems gso byed/ /khog na nor rdzas 'di nyid kyis/ /'di dang 'di 'dra zhig byed snyam/ /char chu nam yang mi 'dzem par//rta rnga khye khar g.yeng bzhin du//dbyar gye dus su mar bsod rgyag /ston gyi dus su nas bsod rgyag /mi rta gnyis gas sdug bsngal myong / /kha dar phyag mdud lung ba 'gengs//yon bdag mi len phyir la 'phen/ /mi len na 122

yang gnya' 'jog byed/ /de ltar thabs ni sna tshogs pa/ /byas nas zas nor khyer nas 'ong / /thugs dam byed kyin yod zer nas/ /rgyun du 'dang log mang bo rgyag /mi zhig slebs na su red zer/ /yon bdag 'di skad red zhus tshe/ /yon bdag bzang bo zhig yin na/ /khong gi mdun du shog cig zer/ /stan bting sngon du sder kha bsgrigs/ /khyed tsho thams cad bde mo zhes/ /skad mgo mthon pos 'tshams 'dri byed/ /de min gzhan gyi mi yin na/ /mdun du 'ong gi ma 'jug zer//grwa bas mi der 'di skad zer//bla ma'i thugs dam ma grol bas//da dung mdun du mi chud zer/ /tha ma bla ma ser sna can/ /gang yod snod kyi nang du bcug /kha la rgya mdud la sogs rgyag /gnyer ba ming gi gnyer ba yin/ /don la bla ma gnyer ba yin/ /zangs kha min tshad kun la slebs/ /gnyer ba grwa ba thams cad la//cung zad tsam zhig yin na yang //yon bdag 'di yis phul ba yi/ /nor rdzas 'di ni ci byas zhes//yang yang rtsad gcod drag po byed/ /lag pa lha khang sgo bas dam//mchod sbyin mang bo phar la zhog /ltogs nas 'chi ba'i mi la yang / /rtsam 'chang tsam zhig ster mi shes/ /zas nor mang bo bsogs bsogs nas/ /'chi ba'i nad kyis thebs pa'i tshe/ /gnyer ba grwa ba rnams kyi khas/ /bla ma'i sgu 'di bde na zer/ /123

khog na bla ma 'di shi na/ /zas nor 'di tsho khor thob snyam/ /nor rdzas chags bzhin bla ma 'chi/ /bla ma shi ba'i nangs par du//yul ba rnams kyis bla ma yi//bdag po khong rnams yin zer 'ongs//nom pa gang yod phal cher khyer//gnyer bas sngon nas gang mkho blangs/ /shul du cung zad tsam bzhag nas/ /bla mar 'di min gang yang med//zer zhing kun la rab bstan nas//cung zad po de tshogs su gtong / /bla ma'i gdung mchod de nas 'grub/ /bla ma nor rdzas rab chags pa'i//stabs kyis nye 'khor de nyid kyi/ /srog chags shig tu skye ba 'am/ /yang na dkor gyi rnam smin rnams/ /rgyab tu khur nas dmyal bar 'gro/ /song na a khu chos rgyal gye/ /drung du bla ma 'o brgyal yod/ /de phyir tshogs drug rang grol khyod/ /deng sang bla ma phal cher gyi/ /go sa de nyid ma 'dzin par//ri dwags rmas ma ji bzhin du//du ma'i ri khrod dben par chos//chos bzhin gyes dang 'chi tshe skyid//skyid pa gzhan la khyod ma smon/ /zhes pa 'di yang deng sang gi bla ma phal cher la bltas nas rang nyid dge la bskul ba'i cha rkyen du smras pa'o//dang po a khu 'don bzang bo/ /mi shes dgu shes grong chog mkhan/ /na tsha shi chad gar yod kyang / /a khu mi sleb sa cha med/ /grong chog bdas nas rgyu nom btsal/ /khe tshong byas nas je 'phel 12 4

btang / /bar du a khu khyim bdag po/ /rgyu nom kun gye dbang can po/ /rgya la lug rnams sprod pa'i tshe/ /sha bzan ya gi bzung la byen/ /pha gi 'di tsho zungs shig zer/ /khyem tshang bza' ba'i lto ched du/ /lug gcig gsod kyang mi skya la//ma mo ma gi'i phar ltag na//yod pa'i lug ga zungs shig zer//tsher mo ma gi'i lu gu de//do dgong len dgos ma brjed zer//tha ma a khu bza' lhag po/ /phyi ma'i chos med sdig rgan po/ /dkor dang sdig pa'i rnam smin khur/ /gcig pur 'jig rten pha rol 'gro/ /gshin rje chos rgyal mdun de na/ /'ur 'ur ba zhig a khur yod/ /de dus a khur 'gyod pa skye/ /dmyal ba'i gnas rnams 'grim pa'i tshe/ /a khus bzod pa shin tu dka'/ /de phyir 'brog gi a khu tsho/ /rab kyis bka' gdams rnam thar bzhin/ /tshe 'di blos thongs ri khrod sten/ /'bring gis dgon pa gang bzang du//song la kha ton bzlas brjod gyes/ /tha mas yul du sdod pa'i tshe//de 'dra'i sdig las mi byed par/ /tshogs gsog dkor sbyong 'bad na legs/ /gtam 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyes/ /'brog pa'i a khu rnams la gdams/ /tshig don ma brjed yid la zungs/ /'phral phugs bde'o a khu tsho/ /zhes pa 'di yang 'brog pa'i a khu phal cher la smras pa'o//dpal ldan bla ma thams cad kyis/ /rgad po yongs la thugs 125

rjes gzigs/ /deng sang rgad po kha cig de//rgas tshe 'dod pa je cher song / /mi rgas rgyu yi sgyu lus rgas/ /rgas rgyu'i nyon mongs je gzhon gyur/ /bza' tshang go khar nam 'tshogs kyang / /rgad pos tshogs gtam rkyang ba gtong / /'ga' res rgad bor mig zur gyis/ /cig bltas 'khun nas sgo tshor 'gro/ /la las mchu gcu sna tsho gnyer/ /lu nas mchil ma chen po zhig /rgad po'i phyogs su phar la 'phen/ /bu yis a pha kha rog zer/ /rgad pos de tsho ma nyan par/ /re re 'gul nas da dung lab/ /thams cad sgo tshor bud song tshe/ /ja 'khyags 'phro ma 'thungs nas 'dug /don dag rgya khab tsam mi 'byung //ma ṇi brgya skor tsam mi 'don//phreng ba skya ril lan mang 'phangs/ /yul mi khyem mtshes rnyed reb mang / /ma ṇi lag 'khor nag ril bo/ /khyem phyags nang na bzhugs reb mang / /mna' mas bza' btung bzang bo zhig /byin nas mi za spro tsho langs//'di byas za rgyu gang na yod/ /khyed tshos 'di mo rkyang ma za//zer nas rang kha rang gis phyi//mna' ma bu yis 'o ya zer/ /rgad po thabs kyis sgo tshor phud/ /shul nas gnyis gas kha g.yos byed/ /rgad pos bsam bzhin rang skal bcad/ /mna' ma bu yi 'dod thog song //mna' mas a bye 'ong gi zhes/ /kha phyis yar tsho langs nas 'dug /bu yang langs nas 126

thu ba sprugs/ /u hi zer nas mar sgor 'bud/ /rgad po khyem du slebs pa'i tshe//mna' mas a bye gcig 'thung dgos//zer nas nyag nyog bza' btung ster/ /ma rig mig gis ci rig byas/ /rgad pos lto ro ro 'thungs na/ /a bye yar sdeb che gi snyam/ /mna' ma dga' nas khong 'dzum 'chor/ /deng sang rgad po skal chad tsho/ /chos kyi nang nas skal chad rung / /za rgyu 'thung rgyu yod bzhin du/ /rang skal rang gis bcad nas ched/ /rgad po gcig pus sdug bsran byas/ /khyem tshang yar la song ba med/ /bza' tshang tshang mas kho bzhin du/ /byed kyin yod snyam rgad po 'khrul/ /lus sgur lus la gnyer ma mang / /skra dkar kha yi so lhung ba/ /myur du 'chi ba'i snga ltas yin/ /shi dus sbra 'am khang ba'i gru'i/ /yol ba zhig gi phar ltag nas/ /bem po cog se bzhag pa'i dus//rgad po'i pha'i skal chad ni yin/ /e go rgad po skal chad tsho/ /go na rgyu nom 'dzoms pa'i dus/ /chos gyis rang gis kha skyid rgyob/ /'dir bde phyi mar skyid par nges/ /glu 'di thos tshad rgad po yis//chos byas kha skyid rgyag par shog/bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgan mo rnams la thugs rjes gzigs//deng sang rgan mo kha cig de/ /rgas kyin kha tshag je cher song / /bza' tshang ci byed skyon du mthong / /rgad por sdang 127

mig rkyang bas blta/ /mna' mas zos bzhag tshar thal zer bu yis yal thal brlag bzhag zer/ /khyim mtshes ngan rab thu rab zer/ /g.yog pos brkus bzhag lto rgan zer/ /bu mos a ma kha rog zer/ /khyem gyi bla rgan drin can dang / /sgo yi khye rgan rig sa med/ /rgad pos chos shig bca' smras na/ /spro langs sdigs skor rkyang ba byed/ /tshur la ma byen heb kyis len/ /phar la g.yor skyi tsam mi bya/ /khyem mtshes g.yas g.yon thams cad sun/ /bza' btung ci yod bdag tu bzung / /mna' ma g.yog por ltogs skom 'ong / /bu la ngo skog thams cad du/ /khyod kyi mna' rul bdud mo rdzongs/ /g.yog rgan ga ded ma 'jog zer/ /khyem tshang bza' ba che chung sun/ /lo 'am zla ba 'ga' re'i 'phror/ /mna' ma g.yog po langs nas 'gro/ /phyin chad mna' ma g.yog mi rnyed/ /bu yi chung ma ma shi ba'i/ /pho yugs a mas bsam bzhin byas/ /mo rang nyin gcig mi dal bar/ /mi thub mi 'gyu'i sdug bsngal nyos/ /yul mi khyem mtshes 'ga' zhig gis/ /lkog na khyod de tshad tshad yin//mna' ma blangs pa mi 'jog brdzangs//g.yog po bzhag pa yul du ded/ /da skyid che gi zer nas 'phya/ /skog na bdud mo'i bya ga zer//de phyir rgan mo bsam shes tsho//tshe 'dir yun ring mi 'dug pas//mi bdag gnyis gar 'gras nas ched//128

khyim mtshes phan thogs g.yor skyi gyis/ /khyem tshang bza' ba skyid du chugs/ /kha nas ma ṇi pad+me thon/ /khog gi bsam pa dkar bo gyes/ /lus kyis phyag dang skor ba rem/ /lag gis ma ṇi chos 'khor skor/ /shi dus a ma drin can ma/ /yod dus bzang zhes gleng ni gyis//glu 'di thos tshad rgan mo yis//kha tshag nam yang mi byed shog /bla ma chos rgyal ngag gi dbang //bdag gzhan sgo gsum byin gyis rlobs/ /deng sang khyem tshang 'ga' zhig gis/ /bu yis chos shig bco smras na//rgan mo chung ma a khu gsum//mi 'thad rgad po 'dug sa nas/ /yar cig 'gul nas 'di skad zer/ /nged tshang chos 'dra can po min/ /bza' ba hral hrul kha rgyab dka'//ya gi tshang la ci 'dra zhig /yod kyang chos 'dra mi bca' gi /ma gi tshang la nged tshang las/ /lhag pa'i lag sa bzang na yang / /chos shig bco ba phar la zhog /da dung rem nas gsog re ltos/ /khyem na yod pas chos bcos 'phro/ /gnam nas mi 'bab sar mi skye/ /'o dka' kha rog da dung gsogs/ /rgyu nom mang bo 'dzoms dus bco/ /bu khyod gsar bu cang mi shes/ /a pha rgan po'i khar nyon zhes/ /dpe dang tshad 'jog mang bo byed/ /bu yis 'o na a ang zer/ /nyin gcig ya gi tshang gi rta/ /tshang ma jag pas ded song 129

zer/ /go tshe rgad pos a ho ho/ /ma bzang la lo yod pa'i dus/ /de bas chos shig bcos na zer/ /ma gi tshang gi nom pa rnams/ /rkun ma zhig gis khyer zer go /a ho nom pa yod pa'i dus/ /de bas chos shig bcos na ched/ /de ba ci byung ma bzang zer/ de nas rang gi nor lug gi /nang du nad byung shi ba'i tshe/ /a ho na ning nor lug tsho/ /yod dus chos shig bcos na ched/ /de nas rgad pos ma pher zer/ /snyeng 'phyas pha bu'i bar na'ang yod/ /rgad po 'gyod tshe bu gcig 'dzum/ /khog nas snying 'phyas 'dom gang btang / /kha nas a phas nged tshang chos/ /can po min zhes zer ba de/ /bden gi lung bstan thogs med red/ /lung bstan rgyag na de gyis rgyob/ /lo lon red mo ha ha zer/ /de phyir rgad po blo ring tsho/ /blo ldan bu yi kha la nyon/ /khyim tshang lto rgyab las lhag pa'i/ /rgyu nom yod dus mchod sbyin thongs/ /glu 'di thos tshad khyem tshang kun/ /gros mthun sgo nas chos byed shog /chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /lha chos nus par byin gyis rlobs//blo ldan dad can pho mo tsho//rgyu nom bsam pa shin tu nag /phan phan tshul gyis pham ster bas/ /rgyu nom mang bo gsogs pa de/ /srog 'tsho ma yin srog gcod yin/ /bla rgan 'ga' res rem rem nas/ /nom pa mang bo yod tsa na/ /rkun ma 130

teb rgan gcig gis go /rkun grogs heb rgan 'ga' rer bshad/ /thams cad gros byas nub gcig 'ongs/ /bla rgan mgo bo rdo bcom byas/ /yod tshad khyer nas song ba yod/ /khyem pa 'ga' res 'tsho skyong byas/ /rta nor mang po yod tsa na/ /jag pa heb rgan 'ga' res go/nangs nub cig la 'ongs nas 'ded//bu dang tsha bo ra mda' rgyugs/ /jag par 'thab tshe nyin gcig la/ /mi zad rgyu zad byas pa mang / /de phyir kha rgyab 'dang ba tsam//ma gtogs phyi phugs phyi 'dang rigs//ma rgyag nam 'chir nges pa med/ /rgyu nom yod kyang rtag pa dkon/ /mchod sbyin thongs dang ma shi na/ /dkon mchog thugs rjes kha rgyab sla/ /rgyu nom mang bo gsog gsogs nas/ /lo gcig chos chen byed snyam na/ /mi yi bsam sar rta mi rgyug /dgra 'dre'i phyogs su 'chor ba mang / /lo re bzhin du chos chung chung / /byas na khyem tshang lto rgyab la/ /mi gnod bzhin du chos mang 'grub/ /lo 'ga'i 'phro nas chos byas tshad//bgrangs na sems la dga' spro 'char//lo gcig chos chen byas pa las//lo mang chung chung byas pa lhag /des na lo re zla re bzhin/ /gang thub lha chos bsgrubs na legs/ /glu 'di thos tshad khyim pa yis//lo re bzhin du chos byed shog/chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo la/ /gsol ba 'debs so khyem 131

pa yis/ /'jig rten mi chos legs grub nas/ /lha chos nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /dang po khyem tshang ngan pa yis//rang gi khyem na gang yod rnams/ /rgad pos dud chang rin du gzhal/ /rgan mos lkog ja nyos nas bskol/ /mna' ma bu mos mchor rgyan bca'/ /bu ni pho gsar ya bo dga'//byis pas mgo min gsus pa shad/ /za nyes bgo btsog 'pho zags bya/ /sha dang sgog chu zhim por dga'/ /yar 'jog can gye mi gcig med/ /za zhing khyer dus thams cad dpa'/ /bar du khyem tshang ngan pa yis/ /zhing la so nam khe tshong dang / /bkal 'thag la sogs las ka rnams/ /mi byed la la nyal la dga'/ /'ga' re grong bar kun tu 'khyams/ /tha na me shing chu yang med/ /khyem phyags thal ba mi 'bo bar za rgyu yin ltar phung logs se/ /khyem nas nyin zhag mang bor spungs/ /khang ba'i gshag mchu 'o co 'bud/ /zhing gi sna sne btsongs nas za/ /sgo phyugs 'tsho skyong mi gso bar/ /thams cad go khar 'tshogs nas 'dug /sgo phyugs la la spyang gis gsod/ /la la ltogs 'khyags 'gags nas 'chi/ /khyem mtshes bos na a mi zer/ /ci red zer nas sdigs skor byed/ /lo re bzhin du kha thur 'gro/ /sde bas de ba lag sa bzang / /da cang med ki ci zhig byung //na tsha shi chad ma byung zer/ /khyem mtshes g.yas g.yon shes 132

ni tshos/ /de ba tshang gi kha thur du/ /mi 'gro ka med bya bco gi /bu dang mna' mas de 'di zhes/ /bya ba ngan pa byed tshul sgog /bsgrags na a ho de yin na/ /rgyal po'i mdzod cig yin yang 'dzad/ /kha de thur du los 'gro zer/ /'grul ba mgron po zhig byung na/ /me bsad tha na khye mi 'gog /bza' ba che chung dge dge dga'/ /gzhan la ngan gtam ha ha zer/ /khyem mtshes mi 'cham 'khon 'dzing byed/ /rgyags rung za ma'i steng nas 'khon/ /yul mi khyim mtshes 'ga' zhig gis/ /phas kha thur du 'gro rgyu tshang / /kho cig song no ja phar zhog /khye yang ma bzung btang bzhag zer/ /'ga' res de ba'i che chung gis/ /rang skyon gcig gis mi shes par/ /rang gi mgo yi kha ba bzhag /gzhan mgo'i ba mo sprug gi zer/ /yul mi khyem mtshes thams cad kyis/ /lkog na ngan smra di ri ri/ /tha ma khyem tshang ngan pa yis//sgo yi rgyu dang khyim gyi zas/ /gnyis ka myur du mnyam tshar byed/ /tshar dus gzhan gye sgo ru song / /a khu a ma lo lo zhes/ /ja log mar log nas log len/ /phyi nas log dom mi sod par/ /kher zog khang zhing yan chad 'chor//ltogs 'khyags sa tshad rdo tshad byed//gzhan gyis ma byin rang la med/ /brkus dang 'phrog bcom ri dwags gsod/ /brkus bud gang yod 'jal du 'chor/ /bza' tshang thor nas 133

phyogs phyogs 'gro /la la phyug po'i g.yog tu 'gro/ /sdigs rdung ngal ba'i sdug bsngal myong / /la la 'o co bzung nas sprang / /khyes ded ltogs 'khyags sdug bsngal che/ /byes pa khyem mtshes can du rgyugs/ /song na khyem mtshes kha cig gis/ /bya byis ka tsho bse re re/ /ja du 'thung yang sleb 'jog gi /mug phrug kha ser ga tsho zer//gzhon nus rtsed sdug rkyang ba byas//ngus tshe e khyod kha rog dang / /'di ster zer nas zan 'chang re/ /byen tshe mig chu lag pas phyis/ /gcig bltas gcig 'dzum mgor so 'debs/ /khyem mtshes mi 'dod sdug bsngal myong / /chos shig nus pa phar la zhog /khyim tshang bza' ba'i kha mi sos/ /'di sdug phyi sdug rang gis bca'/ /bya ba ngan pa zhig gi dus/ /khyem tshang ngan pa de ba tshang / /sde bas dper 'then tshad kyis 'jog /kha gsos chos bca' mi thub rung //sdug med skyid po byed 'dod na//khyem tshang ngan pa'i bya byed rnams//spongs la khyem tshang bzang bo yis ci byed ltar du gyes shig ces/ /gtam 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /khyem tshang ngan pa kha cig la/ /cung zad e phan phyir du smras//thos tshad yongs la phan par shog /chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo la//gsol ba 'debs so khyim pa yis/ /'jig rten mi chos legs grub nas/ /lha chos nus par 134

byin gyis rlobs/ /dang po khyem tshang bzang bo yis/ /rang gi khyem na cung zad cig /yod kyang tshags byas yar la 'jog /rgad pos du ba chang mi 'thung / /rgan mos lkog nas ja mi nyo/ /mna' ma bu mos mchor mi bya/ /bu yis ya bo mi byed bzang / /sha dang sgog chu zhim po la/ /mi dga' za nyes 'pho zags byas/ /chud zos cung zad tsam mi gtong / /gzhon pas ltogs kyang sdug bsran bskyed/ /zas kyi che sa rgan byes ster/ /dpyid dbyar ston dus sngo tshod dang / /gro ma la sogs brkos nas za/ /ltogs kyang bza' tshang brtse zhing dgod/ /bar du khyim tshang bzang bo yis/ /khe tshong zhing las bkal 'thag dang / /phyug po bla dpon snga phyir rgyug /sgo phyugs gso zhing 'tsho skyong mkhas/ /gzhon pa rnams kyis ri las rem/ /rgan rgon byes pas yul las 'bad/ /sbra gur khang ba gang yin yang //phyi nang gnyis ka bye dor byas//chad dam zhig pa yang yang gso/ /gzhan nas rgyu nom cung zad tsam/ /bza' ba che chung sus rnyed kyang / /rang gi khyim du khyer nas 'ong / /mgron po gang 'ongs lha bzhin bkur/ /gang yod bza' btung gtsang ma 'bul/ /ngo mtshar gtam smras gzhan dga' bskyed/ /sngon nas bsu zhing phyi nas skyel/ /sde bas tshe ring bkra shis zer//khyim mtshes g.yas g.yon 'ga' zhig gis/ /chos dang 135
