'jig rten bya ba gang / /byed dus ma thub ma 'gyu ba/ /mthong na song nas las grogs byed/ /khyim mtshes dga' nas ja mar sogs/ /byin nas kha rje yar la 'gro/ /khyed kyis de ring ngar bzang zer/ /phyin chad g.yor skyi gang dgos kyang / /bshad na los skyi los g.yor zer/ /bza' ba che chung thams cad kyis/ /yar mar rgyugs nas btsal stabs kyis/ /lo re bzhin du je bzang 'gro/ /song tshe sde ba'i 'ga' zhig gis/ /de ba sngon tsho mchod cig med/ /lag sa da cig bzang gi zer/ /khyem mtshes shes ni 'ga' zhig gis/ /de ba tshang gi kha rje yar/ /mi 'gro ka med bya bco gi /bu dang mna' mas de 'di zhes/ /bya ba legs po byed tshul sgog /bsgrags na tshe ring bkra shis dang / /kha rje yar la los 'gro zer/ /de nas kun gyes rem pa'i mod/ /lo 'ga'i 'phro nas phyug por 'gyur/ /tha ma khyem tshang bzang bo yis/ /tshe stod cung zad sdug myong yang / /tshe smad skyid kyi mgo bo tshugs/ /gzhan gyi g.yog byed mi dgos bde/ /mi dge'i sdig pa byed mi dgos/ /kha skyid rgyag par phar la zhog /lha chos mang bo bsgrubs pa yin/ /bu mo mna' mas gos rgyan btags/ /bu yis rta zhon gos phrug gyon/ /rgan rgon gnyis kyis phreng ba bzung //ma ṇi 'don bzhin thang ja 'thung / /yar gyi phu na rten bzhengs 136

mang //a mchod chos 'don lhang lhang lhang //bla ma byon la 'bul ba 'gyog /dge 'dun mang bor bsnyen bkur byed/ /dbul bo 'ongs na zas gos ster/ /kun gyis de ba las can zer/ /tshe 'dir bde skyid snyan gsum thob/ /phyi mar lha chos byas pa'i mthus/ /de bas lhag gi bde skyid myong / /'di skyid phyi skyid rang gis bca'/ /bya ba bzang bo zhig gi dus//khyem tshang bzang bo de ba tshang / /sde bas dper 'jen tshad kyi 'jog /chos dang 'jig rten mi chos gnyis//'grub par 'dod na de bzhin gyis//gtam 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /khyem pa pho mo 'ga' zhig la/ /cung zad e phan phyir du smras/ /thos tshad yongs la phan par shog /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /glu 'di nyon dang dad can kun//khyem tshang ngan pa'i sgo phyi nang / /khyem phyags thal bas gang nas btsog /me dal ja chad chu shing med/ /mgron po 'ga' re slebs pa'i dus/ /mgron po'i sngon nas mi bsu bar/ /cha bos khyim nas gong 'gab byas/ /sdigs res rdung res sna nas 'dug /rgad pos rgan mor sdang mig bltas/ /bza' tshang spyi la sdigs skor byed/ /rgan mos rgad por snying 'phyas btang / /mchu gcu sna gnyer lkog shub mang / /bu yis chung ma g.yog por 137

brdung //chung mas zangs rgyag thom rgyag byed/ /g.yog po sgo yi phyi na ngu //mgron po skabs skabs re re lu/ /e tshang khyed kyis de ma byed/ /g.yog po bos nas yar shog zer/ /'ga' res bza' tshang 'di nang gi /phyin chad mi skye smon lam thob//mgron po khyed kyis sos dal gyis/ /ja 'thung khyed brel ma 'jog dang / /khong gi bya ba 'di yin zer/ /mgron po sun nas 'dug ma 'dod/ /kho bo myur du phyir ldog dgos/ /las don gal can yod tsho zhes/ /rdzun smras thabs kyis langs nas 'gro/ /rang yul song nas las ngan tshang / /de ba'i ngo de mi rig gi /chugs zer 'ga' res ci red ces/ /dris na da nangs kho song no/ /cha bos bza' sdigs 'khor lo bskor/ /de yis ched zer snang ba sun/ /phyin chad bos kyang der mi 'gro/ /yul mi khyim mtshes thams cad sun/ /nangs nub med par ga tshang ga /che chung gnyis ka 'khon tshul la/ /ltos dang tha ma mi bzang zer/ /za rgyu 'thung rgyu yod na yang / /khyem tshang bza' ba mi 'cham pas/ /rang gzhan thams cad sdug tu 'jug /sdug bsngal che zhig de na snang / /phyi mar mthun grogs rnyed mi 'gyur/ /de phyir khyem pa bsam shes tsho/ /sdigs res rdung res byas ci bya/ /za rgyu'i nyams la de mi phan/ /'thung rgyu'i tshab tu de mi 'gro/ /kha 'khon lag 'dzing ma byed 138

par/ /tshe thung glog 'gyu tsam 'di la/ /rtse zhing dgod bzhin lha chos gyis/ /glu 'di thos tshad thams cad la/ /nam yang bza' 'khon med par shog /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /glu 'dir nyon dang bsam shes tsho/ /khyem tshang bzang bo'i sgo phyi nang //shin tu gtsang zhing yid du 'ong / /me bzang sbar bas khyem kun dro/ /mgron po song na sngon nas bsu/ /nga bde khyod bde 'tshams 'dri mang / /khyem du thon tshe rgad po yis/ /mal nas e khyod bde mo yin/ /bde bar sdod la skad cha shod/ /rnar snyan yid dga'i gtam gsar ba/ /yod na ma dris bzhin du shod/ /a bye skad cha shin tu dga'/ /zer ba'i lan du mgron po yis/ /gang yod skad cha zhib tu bshad/ /de min cang med a bye zhes/ /smras na 'o ya yod ki zhes/ /ja 'thung sos dal gyis tsho zer/ /ma ṇi ring 'don thung 'don byed/ /rgan mos mi zog e 'tshams 'dri/ /mna' mas ja bskol phye mar 'jog /g.yog po mna' ma'i snga phyir rgyug/bu yis zhwa chung rna g.yas gzar/ /ku re rtsed mo sna tshogs byas/ /bza' tshang mgron po bar bar dgod/ /mgron po dga' spros yun ring 'dug /'gro tshe 'tshams por bde mor zer//'ga' res bskyal nas khye kha'i 'phud/ /yul du song nas las can tshang / /bza' 139

tshang de ba'i skyid la zer/ /ci red dris na thog mar 'dzum/ /de ba'i che chung bzang tshul brjod/ /yul mi khyem mtshes thams cad kyis/ /ga tshang ci zhig 'chams ni red/ /nyin gcig 'khon ni thos ma myong / /tshe ring bkra shis zer nas dga'/ /kha skyid chen po med na yang / /bza' tshang ma 'khon rtse bgad nas/ /rang gzhan thams cad skyid du 'jug /skyid kyi mchog gcig de na snang //phyi mar mthun grogs rnyed par 'gyur//de phyir khyim pa blo ldan tsho/ /'khon res rdung res ma byed par/ /bza' tshang ma bral 'dzoms pa'i dus//rtse dgod byed bzhin dge la 'bod//glu 'di thos tshad khyim tshang rnams//mthun pa'i sgo nas chos byed shog /drin can bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /'gro kun kha lo chos la sgyur/ /e ma ya rabs dad can rnams/ /bza' tshang tshong ra'i mgron po 'dra//mgron po yun ring mi sdod par//snga phyi byas nas 'gro ba bzhin/ /bza' tshang 'jig rten dkar ngogs 'dir/ /yun ring mi sdod phyi mar 'gro/ /'jig rten mi yi gtam dpe la/ /yang yang khrom pa sgang mi tshogs/ /yang yang gyi ling sga mi bstod/ /zer ltar khyim tshang bza' ba rnams/ /yang yang thams cad 'dzom pa dkon//da lta go kha'i gong 'gab byas//gor re kyi ler 'dzoms pa'i dus/ /kun gyis chos re bca' thub ltos/ /lha 140

chos chen po ma 'gyu yang / /bza' sdigs ma byed rtse dgod gyis//gong mas tshogs gtam rkyang ma gtong / /'og mas rang bcad rkyang ma byed/ /gcig gis tshig ngan khab tsam zhig /mi bzod lan du 'big tsam brdab/ /'big tsam lan du gri mdung tsam/ /brdabs nas gsod res rkyang ma byed/ /mtshon gyi rma kha sos dus yod/ /tshig ngan rma kha sos dus med/ /gcig gis gcig por ngan smras tshig /phyi nas lan re dran tsa na/ /ya chung nang du sdug lhang nge / /mi tsho'i sems la gnod pa'i tshig /su zhig la yang ma smras bzang / /gal te re re shor song na/ /phyi nas pha rol dga' thabs rem/ /nga yi spro 'di'i ring gang la/ /cig re'i mgo tsho 'dug gi zhes/ /rang gis rang la ngan smras bgrangs/ /pha rol mi de'i yon tan rjod/ /gcig gis rgyun du babs khur rung da/ /gcig gis tshig ngan rkyang smras na/ /bzang bo shi tshe ngan smras mi//phyi nas 'gyod pa drag po skye/ /yod dus tshig ka dron po zhig /ma bshad zer nas sna tsho lugs/ /ngus rung sur phan su yis go /rta rgyug rdul yal tshar dus yin/ /mi rnams nam 'chi khrig khrig med/ /do nub yin yang 'chi nyen yod/ /gson dus sems la phan pa'i gtam/ /bshad rgyu yod na bshad ran yin/ /chos re bca' na bca' ran yin/ /smon lam phyogs gcig 'debs 141

ran yin/ /glu 'di thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /tshig ngan nam yang mi smra shog /bla ma dkon mchog gsum la 'dud//'gro kun kha lo chos la sgyur/ /khyim pa pho mo dad can rnams/ /mi lus rin chen thob dus 'dir//chos byas yar la 'gro ba dang //sdig byas mar la 'gro ba yi/ /gdam kha rang gi lag na yod/ /rang gi lag na yod dus 'dir/ /chos byas yar la 'gro dgos pas//mi dge bcu bo dug ltar spongs/ /dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /song la jo shāka rnam gnyis dang / /bsam yas la sogs mjal skor gyes/ /gangs can 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon rje/ /rgyal ba paṇa chen rnam gnyis mjol/ /se 'bras dge gsum dge 'dun la/ /mang ja gtong ngam kha 'debs gyes/ /bla ma mang bor 'brel ba zhog /dbul bo rnams la sbyin pa thongs/ /lus kyis phyag dang skor ba rem/ /ngag gis kha ton bzlas brjod brtson/ /rgyun du bsam pa dkar bo gyis/ /phyi mar mi lus rin chen thob/ /chos byas sangs rgyas thob par smon/ /de ltar mdzad na tshe 'dir bde/ /phyi mar skye ba bzang bo blangs/ /lha chos byas nas 'tshang rgya nges/ /glu 'di thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /chos byas sangs rgyas thob par shog /142

'gro ba'i sdug bsngal kun sel ba'i/ /bla ma dkon mchog rin po che/ /khyim pa sems sdug can rnams kyi/ /sdug bsngal sangs par byen gyis rlobs/ /rgyal khams 'grim pa'i ban rgan ngas/ /bu gcig shi ba'i pha ma sogs//sdug bsngal can la sems gso bya/ /dad can bsam shes pho mo nyon/ /sngon dus sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /'chi med rdo rje sku brnyes kyang / /dgung lo brgyad cu bzhes pa'i 'phro/ /sku de mya ngan 'da' tshul bstan/ /mchog thun dngos grub kun thob pa'i/ /rgya gar grub chen brgyad cu dang //bod kyi rje 'bangs nyer lnga dang / /mi la blo bzang yab sras sogs/ /sngon byon mkhas grub gnam gyis sa/ /bkab pa lta bu thams cad kyang / /rtag 'dzin can rnams chos bskul phyir/ /sku de gshegs pa'i tshul bstan na//rang re lta bu smos ci dgos//bod la bstan pa'i srol btod pa'i/ /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po sogs/ /rgyal po blon po mkhas pa dang / /dpa' bo ri brag stag 'dra ba//skyes pa thams cad da lta med//sngon chad skyes pa ma shi bar//tshe thar lus pa gcig kyang med//da lta'i rgan gzhon pho mo dang / /phyin chad skyes pa thams cad 'chi/ /skye ba yod na 'chi ba yod//skyes nas ma shi sems can med//'chi ba gcig la byung ba min/ /snga phyi tsam gye khyad ma gtogs/ /mchog dman bar ba 143

kun la 'byung / /rgan gzhon bar ma su shi yang / /ma sdug ma ngu dge ba gyis//sngon dus sgra sgyur mar pa'i sra sa//la sogs sa thob skyes bu yang / /gzhon dus gshegs pa'i tshul bstan na/ /'o skol rnams tsho smos ci dgos/ /gzugs mdzes skad snyan sems bzang ba'i//lha phrug 'dra ba'i bu tsha dang //me tog pad+ma gsar du kha/ /phye ba lta bu'i bu mo yang / /sngon chad glo bur shi ba mang / /'dzam gling tshe la nges pa med/ /bu gcig shi ba'i ma yin kyang / /ma ngu 'chi bar mgo rnga med/ /che ba dge bshes rgyal blon dang / /phyug po dbul bo kun gyi mgor/ /rkyen ngan mi 'ong gcig kyang med/ /snga phyi byas nas kun la 'ong / /khyem tshang gcig la byung ba min/ /tshe yi tshad la bab pa'i tshe/ /sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed dang / /mthu stobs bdag po phyag rdor dang / /'chi med dpal ster tshe dpag med//dngos su byon yang phan mi thogs/ /sgu rim srung ba kun ngan nas//nad pa lag nas shor ba min//ma ngu ngus na shi bo de/ /bar do'i skabs na gnas pa'i dus/ /steng du rnag khrag char ba 'bab//zhag po bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i bar//ngus na shi bo nyin re bzhin//sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa myong / /ngu bdag de yi lus la gnod/ /sha zhan mdog shor sgur bor 'gyur/ /mig chu mang po 'don mi rung / /mig chus mig gi rtsa la gnod/ /mig 144

kyang mi gsal rab rib 'gyur/ /mya ngan byas na rgan rgon rigs/ /phal cher ngus nas zhar ba mang / /bla ma dge 'dun bzhugs pa'i dus/ /ngu 'bod byas na snyan la gnod/ /shi bor phan pa'i 'don rgyu dang //bsgom rgyu gang yang 'ong ba dka'//de phyir ma sdug ma ngu ang / /chos rnams rmi lam sgyu ma 'dra/ /bza' tshang tshong 'dus mgron po 'dra/ /skye 'chi nyi zla'i 'char nub 'dra/ /skyid sdug lam kha'i mgron po 'dra/ /nor rdzas rtswa kha'i zil ba 'dra/ /dar rgud sems can kun la 'byung / /khyim tshang gcig la byung ba min/ /ma ngu shi gson thams cad la/ /'di phyir phan pa'i dge ba gyis/ /'on kyang sngar mgor ma 'ongs pa/ /gsar du glo bur byung bas na/ /zungs med ngu rgyu 'ong ba khag /med rung ma ngu sdug bsran gyis/ /rta pho byang ma brgyar zhon nas/ /rgyugs kyang mi zin pha rol tu//shi bo bzang bo song phyin chad//ngus nas sus go su la phan/ /shi bos thos na ngu mod kyang //thos pa'i sa na shi bo med/ /mi thos phyin chad ngus nas ched/ /shi bor phan na ngu mod kyang / /phan pa phar zhog shi bor gnod//mi phan gnod pas ngus nas ched/ /rang la mi bzang yul mi tshos//mthong na khyes ni 'phya ni mang / /de tshad de nyos zer yang thang / /ma ngu ngus nas phan mi thogs/ /rkyen ngan byung dus theg pa la/ /pho rab mo rab 145

zer ba yin//skyid ni mi theg su zhig yod//sdug bsngal byung dus theg pa dgos/ /ma rgan bzhin du sna tsho lugs/ /glang rgan bzhin du sdug 'khun byed/ /bong rgan bzhin du phe 'debs pa/ /skye bo blun po'i chos lugs yin/ /ngus nas shi bo phyir mi 'ong / /dge rtsa'i jebs su de mi 'gro/ /rang gis rang la sdug bskul ba/ /ma gtogs don go spu tsam med/ /pho rab mo rab bsam shes tsho/ /blun bo'i lad mo ma byed ang / /gtam 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /khyim pa sems sdug can la smras/ /thos tshad mya ngan kun sangs nas//yid la dga' bde 'char bar shog /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal kun sel ba'i/ /bla ma dkon mchog rin po che/ /khyem pa sems sdug can rnams kyi/ /sdug bsngal sangs par byen gyes rlobs/ /khyem pa pho mo bsam shes tsho//sngon yang rgan rgon 'ga' re tshos/ /mig gnyis 'byar rag bar du ngus/ /shi bor phan zer thos ma myong / /da lta phyin chad su ngus kyang //shi bor phan zhes thos mi srid/ /phan na kun mkhyen sangs rgyas kyis/ /ngus na phan gi kun ngu zhes//los gsung gsungs na thams cad po//nyin mtshan med par ngu mod kyi//ngus na shi bor gnod pa che//shi bo'i phyir du ma ngu zhes//gsungs pa ma gtogs ngu dgos zhes/ /sngon chad ma gsungs da mi gsung //gzhan gyis 146

ma sdug ma ngu zhes//'di ltar sems gso brgya byas kyang //mi phan lhag par steng du bsnan/ /rnga mong bu shi bzhin byed na/ /sangs rgyas gsung la 'dang ma brgyab/ /shi bor snying ma rje ba yin/ /'gro mgon sangs rgyas gsung brtsi na//ma ngu shi bo snying rje na//shi bo'i ra mda' lha chos yin/ /mi yis smon pa'i dge rtsa thongs/ /shi bor phan pa'i chos mi bco//lag pa lha khang sgo bas dam//mig chu lung phran chu las mod/ /med mug ma ṇi bzhin 'don pa//mi ngan khrel med bya ba yin/ /mang bo ngus na gzhan gyis 'phya/ /'ga' res de cig ngu gi zhes/ /smras na 'ga' res de'i mig nas//mig chus mi tshad khrag 'ong rung / /snying 'dra rje rgyu mi 'ong gi /ngas de rig na spro langs gi /shi bo'i pha'i skal chad ni red/ /ja tsho chu red a kha zer/ /'ga' res dge rtsa e bzang gi /dris na 'bul ba zhabs tog 'dra/ /dkon gi mig chu mod gi zer//'ga' res 'di yi ngu gi zhes//lad mo byas nas thams cad dgod//'ga' res gcig po'i tshab tu de/ /shi na dge rtsa bzang bo zhig /gcig po yin na des bco zer/ /'ga' res ngas de bzang mo snyam/ /gseng na mchod cig med ki zhes/ /lkog na kun gyis ngan smras byed//mi shi mi kha mnyam por 'ong / /shi bo'i shul gyi khrel yod tsho/ /ngus na shi bor phan mi thogs/ /ske rags sdoms la sdug bsran skyed/ /lam 147

sna 'dren pa'i bla mar gtugs/ /'pho ba bsngo zhus rta mdzo phul//a mchod zhog la thar mdo dang / /bar do'i thos grol chen mo thon/ /zhag po bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i bar/ /ser mo bsdus la dgung zhag ded//rten gyi drung du mar me sbor//shi bo'i zas su tsha gsur thongs/ /mgur ma bskul la ma ṇi thon/ /nyin mtshan chos kyi 'khor lo skor//a mchod dge slong 'bri khrid dang //ban de lug khrid thar re thongs//shi bor dge chen byas tsa na/ /kun gyis dge rtsa e bzang gi /dris na kha tsho lag pas bkab/ /de 'dra'i dge chen da snga yan/ /su yis ma bcos bu rgod po//de la tshe ring bkra shis zer/ /'ga' res shi bo las can red/ /zhabs tog 'bul ba gang thad nas/ /mi bzang ba gcig med ki zer/ /phyi nas gzhan gyi dge rtsa 'dra/ /ngan na bla rgan heb rgan tshos/ /de ba'i dge de yang yang gleng / /de tsho bltas na skog gtam la/ /'di tsho dge 'dra ma red zer/ /'ga' res shi bo dge bco na/ /de bas bcos ni 'dra ba zhig /bcos na ang zer yid smon byed/ /de phyir ngus na sus mi smon//smon rgyu bco na dge chen gyis//phyi nas lan re shi bo de'i//lus kyi byad dbyibs rnam 'gyur dang / /ngag gi bshad tshul yid la shar/ /dran nas ngu rgyu 'ongs pa'i dus/ /gzhan tshor rang sems yengs su chugs/ /nam yang sems sdug 148

ma byed bzang / /bco lnga gnam stong tshes brgyad dus/ /a mchod re re 'bod thub ltos/ /dbyar ston bla ma bsod snyoms pa/ /byung yang bsngo re zhu thub ltos/ /de ltar mdzad na shi gson la/ /'di phyir bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /gtam 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /khyem pa sems sdug can la smras/ /thos tshad mya ngan kun sangs nas/ /yid la dga' bde 'char bar shog /'phags pa thugs rje chen pos dgongs su gsol/ /tshe 'dir drin gyes bskyangs pa'i drin can pha/ /'jig rten phyi ma'i yul du song ba la/ /g.yel ba med par thugs rjes spyan gyis gzigs/ /shul nas bu yis dkon mchog mchod pa dang / /dge 'dun bsnyen bkur la sogs dge ba'i las/ /ci byas thams cad myur du rjes 'brangs nas/ /phyi ma'i dus su phan thogs 'byung bar shog /khyem tshang bza' ba'i kha rgyab gnyis kyi phyir/ /nam yang yul nas sdod pa'i dus mi 'byung / /phyogs bcur 'khyams nas zas nor gos rnams btsal/ /gang mkho khye ra nas 'ong ba'i drin can pha/ /'jig rten phyi mar song ba snying re rje/ /sbyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /shul nas bu yis ci byas dge rtsa rnams/ /rjes su 'brangs nas phan thogs 'byung bar shog /nyin par 'gro zhing mtshan mo nyal na yang / /bu dang 149

bu mo mang bo'i lto rgyab 'di/ /ji ltar byas na rnyed dam bsam blo btang //sems khur ma las che ba'i drin can pha/ /'jig rten phyi mar song ba snying re rje/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /shul nas bu yis ci byas dge rtsa rnams/ /rjes su 'brangs nas phan thogs 'byung bar shog /zas ni ngan ngon gos hrul slog pa gyon/ /nyin par lto bcag mtshan mo'i gnyid spangs nas/ /zhing las so nam rem pas nyin mtshan 'das/ /tshe 'dir skyid po ma byung drin can pha/ /'jig rten phyi mar song ba snying re rje/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /shul nas bu yis ci byas dge rtsa rnams/ /rjes su 'brangs nas phan thogs 'byung bar shog /nor rdzas btsal nas ma rnyed rku 'phrog byas/ /rdzun dang g.yo sgyus pha rol gzhan mgo bskor/ /sdig las mang bo zhar dang zhor la bsags/ /phyi mar nam yang mi skyid drin can pha/ /'jig rten phyi mar song ba snying re rje/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /shul nas bu yis ci byas dge rtsa rnams/ /rjes su 'brangs nas phan thogs 'byung bar shog /rgyun du tshong dang bun bskyed 'tsho skyong byed/ /bu la bzang zhig yod na bu skyes snyam/ /rab tu dga' bas khong 'dzum mang bo byed/ /kha skyel mgo la byugs pa'i drin can pha//'jig rten phyi 150

mar song ba snying re rje/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /shul nas bu yis ci byas dge rtsa rnams/ /rjes su 'brangs nas phan thogs 'byung bar shog /bu la na tsha cung zad tsam byung yang / /dngangs nas mo sman rtsis pa'i drung du rgyugs/ /khyem na yod pa'i zas gos phal che ba/ /phangs med glud du gtong ba'i drin can pha//'jig rten phyi rol song ba snying re rje//spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol//shul nas bu yis ci byas dge rtsa rnams/ /rjes su 'brangs nas phan thogs 'byung bar shog /bu dang bu mo che ru song ba na/ /bu mor gos rgyan btags nas gnas la rdzong / /bu ni la lar chos bslabs rab byung byas/ /la lar chung ma len pa'i drin can pha//'jig rten phyi mar song ba snying re rje/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /shul nas bu yis ci byas dge rtsa rnams/ /rjes su 'brangs nas phan thogs 'byung bar shog /sdigs sdug gtam ngan thams cad khyad du bsad/ /sha thang bskyed nas 'bad pas btsal ba yi/ /sa zhing khang ba nor rdzas ci yod pa/ /thams cad bu la sprod pa'i drin can pha/ /'jig rten phyi mar song ba snying re rje/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /shul nas bu yis ci byas dge rtsa rnams/ /rjes su 'brangs nas phan thogs 151

'byung bar shog /rang nyid lag pa stong bar gyur na yang / /bdag gis thams cad bu la 'phrod do zer/ /da ni 'phrod sar 'phrod ni yin no zhes/ /slar yang dga' dga' byed pa'i drin can pha/ /'jig rten phyi mar song ba snying re rje/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /shul nas bu yis ci byas dge rtsa rnams/ /rjes su 'brangs nas phan thogs 'byung bar shog /de ltar tshe 'dir bskyangs pa'i drin chen phas/ /don med bza' tshang lto rgyab bsgrub bsgrubs nas/ /don chen dam chos bsgrub pa'i khom ma byung //tshe 'dir bskyangs pa'i bu dang bu mo bral/ /'jig rten phyi mar song ba snying re rje//spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /shul nas bu yis ci byas dge rtsa rnams//rjes su 'brangs nas phan thogs 'byung bar shog /ces pa drin can gyi pha shi ba'i dge rtsa'i steng nas bskul chog pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//bod kyi lha skal 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /brtse ba'i thugs kyis bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /tshe 'dir drin gyes bskyangs pa'i drin can ma//mi mthong 'jig rten phyi ma'i yul du song //grogs med bar do'i 'phrang ring 'grim pa'i tshe//thugs rje can khyod thugs rje der ma chung / /byams pa'i zhal bzang 152

drin can a mar ston/ /brtse ba'i phyag gis a ma'i lag nas drongs/ /bde ba can nam po ta la ru skyol/ /dge 'dun bsnyen bkur ngan slong sbyin gtong sogs/ /shul nas bu yis ci byas dge rtsa rnams/ /rjes su 'brangs nas phan thogs 'byung bar shog /snga ma'i lus bor phyi ma'i lus ma blangs/ /bar do'i gnas su gcig pur 'khyams pa'i tshe//las kyi dbang gis ma yi mngal du zhugs/ /zla bcu'i bar du khur ba'i drin can ma/ /mi mthong yul du song ba snying re rje/ /thugs rje chen pos lam sna drang du gsol/ /shul nas bu yis ci byas dge rtsa rnams/ /rjes su 'brangs nas phan thogs 'byung bar shog /'gro 'dug 'gul skyod shugs drag las mi byed/ /gzhan gyi kha zas gang yin za mi nus/ /ske rags dam por mi bcing lhod por bcings/ /bu la gnod kyis dogs pa'i drin can ma/ /mi mthong yul du song ba snying re rje/ /thugs rje chen pos lam sna drang du gsol//shul nas bu yis ci byas dge rtsa rnams//rjes su 'brangs nas phan thogs 'byung bar shog /btsas dus sha rus 'gas 'dra'i sdug bsngal myong / /phyi ru thon dus 'jam pa'i stan la bzhag /bu dang bu mo gnyis kyi gang yin yang / /nor bu rnyed bzhin dga' ba'i drin can ma//mi mthong yul du song ba snying re rje//thugs rje chen pos 153

lam sna drang du gsol//shul nas bu yis ci byas dge rtsa rnams//rjes su 'brangs nas phan thogs 'byung bar shog /brtse ba'i sems kyis 'jam pa'i lag tu blangs/ /byams pa'i mig gis lta zhing 'dzum gyis bsus/ /snyan pa'i ming nas 'bod cing nu zho blud/ /sha yi drod la bslan pa'i drin can ma/ /mi mthong yul du song ba snying re rje/ /thugs rje chen pos lam sna drang du gsol/ /shul nas bu yis ci byas dge rtsa rnams/ /rjes su 'brangs nas phan thogs 'byung bar shog /zas ni g.yos nas byen na chog mod kyang / /gnod kyis dogs nas lce yis bsnyod nas ster/ /snabs kyang lag pas phyis na gnod kyis dogs/ /'jam po kha yis phyi ba'i drin can ma//mi mthong yul du song ba snying re rje/ /thugs rje chen pos lam sna drang du gsol/ /shul nas bu yis ci byas dge rtsa rnams/ /rjes su 'brangs nas phan thogs 'byung bar shog /mi gtsang sa rdos phyis na gnod kyis dogs/ /skyug mi ldog par lag pas phyis nas dor/ /mtshan mo'i dus su 'og tu gcur gyes dogs/ /gnyid kyi bde ba bkag pa'i drin can ma/ /mi mthong yul du song ba snying re rje/ /thugs rje chen pos lam sna drang du gsol//shul nas bu yis ci byas dge rtsa rnams//rjes su 'brangs nas phan thogs 'byung bar shog /me chu g.yang sogs 154

'jigs pa rnams las bskyabs/ /zhim pa'i zas byin snyan pa'i ming nas bos/ /'jam po'i gos bskon gtam dang 'gro lugs bslab/ /kha skyel mgo la byugs pa'i drin can ma/ /mi mthong yul du song ba snying re rje//thugs rje chen pos lam sna drang du gsol//shul nas bu yis ci byas dge rtsa rnams/ /rjes su 'brangs nas phan thogs 'byung bar shog /bu la mgo na cham pa tsam byung yang / /bu ni na las rang nyid na na snyam//bu ni shi las rang nyid shi na snyam/ /kha min snying nas 'dems pa'i drin can ma/ /mi mthong yul du song ba snying re rje/ /thugs rje chen pos lam sna drang du gsol/ /shul nas bu yis ci byas dge rtsa rnams//rjes su 'brangs nas phan thogs 'byung bar shog /langs dang gom pa re re 'dor ba'i dus/ /g.yas g.yon nas skyor mi gzhon la sogs zer/ /nged kyi bu la bltas zer gzhan la ngom/ /sems la dga' spro shar ba'i drin can ma/ /mi mthong yul du song ba snying re rje/ /thugs rje chen pos lam sna drang du gsol/ /shul nas bu yis ci byas dge rtsa rnams/ /rjes su 'brangs nas phan thogs 'byung bar shog /chang 'thung bzhin du 'gro 'dug byed pa'i dus/ /yul na 'dug dus dpral ba'i mig bzhin 'tshos/ /gzhan du song na bu de nyes sam snyam/ /sems la bde dus med pa'i 155

drin can ma//mi mthong yul du song ba snying re rje//thugs rje chen pos lam sna drang du gsol/ /shul nas bu yis ci byas dge rtsa rnams/ /rjes su 'brangs nas phan thogs 'byung bar shog /'gro 'dug legs par thub pa'i dus skabs su/ /gang bzang zas ni pho bas 'ju tshad byin/ /'jam pa'i gos bskon mdzes pa'i rgyan mang btags/ /nam yang blo sems bde ba'i drin can ma/ /mi mthong yul du song ba snying re rje/ /thugs rje chen pos lam sna drang du gsol/ /shul nas bu yis ci byas dge rtsa rnams//rjes su 'brangs nas phan thogs 'byung bar shog /zas shig rnyed kyang bu la ster snyam nas/ /bu de gzhan du song na za mi nus/ /gzhan la mi ster rul rag bar du 'jog /nam yang snying nas gces pa'i drin can ma//mi mthong yul du song ba snying re rje//thugs rje chen pos lam sna drang du gsol/ /shul nas bu yis ci byas dge rtsa rnams/ /rjes su 'brangs nas phan thogs 'byung bar shog /skom pa'i dus su mngar ba'i ja bzang blud//ltogs pa'i dus su zas rnams mdun du spung / /grang ba'i dus su dro 'jam gos kyis g.yogs//gang mkho dga' bzhin ster ba'i drin can ma//mi mthong yul du song ba snying re rje/ /thugs rje chen pos lam sna drang du gsol/ /shul nas bu yis ci byas dge rtsa rnams/ /rjes su 156

'brangs nas phan thogs 'byung bar shog /de ltar yang yang bskyangs pa'i drin can mas/ /tshe 'di'i bu dang bu mo bskyangs bskyangs nas/ /phyi ma'i lha chos bsgrub pa'i dus ma byung / /dga' ba'i grogs dang bral nas gcig pu ru//mi mthong yul du song ba snying re rje/ /thugs rje chen pos lam sna drang du gsol/ /shul nas bu yis ci byas dge rtsa rnams/ /rjes su 'brangs nas phan thogs 'byung bar shog /ces drin can gyi ma shi ba'i dge rtsa byed dus mgur du bskul chog pa 'di ni tshogs drug rang grol gyis khyim pa khrel yod dad can rnams la phan phyir lhag bsam dag pas smras pa'o//sangs rgyas thugs rje can la 'dud/ /'gro kun blo kha chos la sgyur/ /dad can pho mo bsam shes tsho//sangs rgyas gsung rab gang yin yang //rab tu dad pas bris bton na//ngo mtshar phan yon dpag med yod/ /lhag par thar ba chen po'i mdo/ /'bri zhing 'don pa bsod nams che//stong gsum grangs med rin po ches//bkang ste sbyin pa byin pa bas//mdo sde thar ba chen po ni//yi ger 'bri dang 'don pa dang / /glegs bam 'chang ba bsod nams che//stong gsum 'gro la srog gi skyabs//sbyin pa bas kyang mdo sde 'di'i//tshigs bcad gcig gi don tsam zhig /gzhan la bshad pa bsod nams che/ /mdo sde thar ba chen po las/ /157

gsungs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi mtshan/ /lan gcig tsam zhig thos tshad kun//bskal chen khri phrag bzhi bcu'i bar//dmyal ba'i gnas su ltung mi 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mtshan/ /lan gcig tsam zhig sus thos kyang / /bskal chen khri phrag nyi shu dang //stong phrag bzhi bcu'i bar du yang //dmyal ba'i gnas su ltung mi 'gyur/ /mdo sde 'di nyid bton tsam gyis/ /tshul 'chal mtshams med lnga byas pa/ /chos la skur ba btab pa sogs/ /mi zad sdig pa'i las byas pa/ /byang zhing dag ste mya ngan 'da'/ /mdo sde thar ba chen po ni/ /'bri 'don byed pa'i gang zag ni//de yi nye 'khor mi phyugs la//tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs pa'i/ /dkar phyogs lha yis srung skyob byed/ /de phyir skye 'gro dad can rnams/ /mdo sde mchog gyur thar mdo ni/ /gser dngul sogs kyis rang gis bris/ /'bri dus lhag chad med par bris/ /yang na chos dpon lag nas longs/ /len dus 'bul ba chen po phul/ /rtag tu rang gis kha ton gyes/ /'don dus lhag chad med par thon/ /yang na gzhan la 'don du chugs/ /bton 'phro 'bul ba bzang po khyogs/ /glu 'di thos tshad thams cad kyis//thar mdo blangs nas 'don par shog /sangs rgyas mar me mdzad la 'dud/ /mar me'i phan yon 158

cung zad bshad/ /bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i sgos/ /mar me gsal bo sbar mkhan gye/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung mun khung du/ /nyi zer zhugs bzhin 'dag par 'gyur/ /lus bde lus la gzi brjid 'bar/ /rig pa je gsal je gsal 'gro/ /sngar ma shes pa'i chos don go /dngos sam nyams dang rmi lam du/ /spyan ras gzigs sogs lha zhal mthong / /'chi khar shes pa shin tu gsal/ /bar dor mun pa 'thib mi 'gyur/ /phyi mar ngan song gnas mi ltung / /bde ba can nam mi yul skye/ /gang du skyes kyang gzugs byad mdzes/ /mig rno rig pa shin tu gsal/ /dge sdig legs nyes blang dor shes/ /nag po mi dge dran mi 'gyur/ /dkar bo dge ba'i phyogs la dga'/ /rtag tu tshogs gnyis gsog la brtson/ /gnas skabs bde skyid nyi ma 'char mthar thug rang don chos sku dang / /gzhan don mtshan dang dpe byad kyis/ /brgyan pa'i gzugs sku thob par 'gyur/ /de phyir chos kyi rgyal pos kyang / /spyir ni chos kun lo yags kyi/ /snye ma 'dra bas mi bzang med/ /khyad par chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /snying bo yi ge drug ma dang / /chos 'khor jo dar mar me dang / /tshe thar btang na phan yon che/ /gsungs pa kun gyes yid la zungs/ /glu 'di thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /mar me gsal bo sbar bar 159

shog /skyabs gnas bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /sdig sgrib 'dag par byin gyis rlobs//yig brgya thun mtshams nyer gcig re/ /brjod na nyes ltung mi 'phel zhes/ /rgya bod mkhas grub dgongs pa mthun/ /lan gcig tsam zhig brjod na yang / /nyes ltung thams cad 'dag go zhes/ /rta mchog rol ba'i rgyud las gsungs/ /rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams pa rnams//phyi mar rdo rje dmyal bar skye//de yi sdug bsngal tshe yi tshad/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsung mi phod/ /gsungs na byang sems snying rje can/ /kha nas khrag byung 'chi bar byed/ /de rgyu nyams chag sdig sgrib kyang / /rdor sems sgom bzlas byas na 'dag /gos sngon can gyi rgyud nas gsungs/ /de phyir sdig ltung drag po yis/ /non pas 'di la thugs dam mdzod/ /lwa ba bkrus na tshos mdog legs/ /de bzhin sdig sgrib sbyang ba na/ /rgyud la nyams rtogs skye ba sla/ /de phyir gzhan la 'khrid 'debs tshe/ /thog mar yig brgya 'don du chugs/ /thabs lam sgom dus bde drod lus/ /skye ba'i thabs la rdor sems kyi/ /sgom bzlas 'di nyid zab bo zhes/ /bla ma stag lung thar bas gsungs/ /ma mgon chos skyong gang bsgrubs kyang / /rdor sems sgom bzlas 'di byas na/ /nyams chag dag 160

nas 'khu ldog med/ /nad gdon rgyu ni sdig sgrib ste/ /sdig sgrib med na nad gdon kyang / /'byung bar mi 'gyur rkyen ngan pa/ /bzlog thabs 'di las zab pa med/ /sgrub pa'i rtags mtshan mi gsal ba//sdig sgrib che bas bsgribs pa yin//gsal thabs 'di las zab pa med/ /lta ba rgyud la mi skye ba//lhan skyes ma ri ga sgrib pas bsgribs/ /sgrib pa med na cis mi skye/ /skye thabs 'di las zab pa med/ /mdor na 'di nyid kho na yis/ /sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur zhes gsungs/ /de phyir 'di la thugs dam mdzod/ /'di nyid tshogs drug rang grol smras/ /thos tshad yig brgyar 'bad par shog /bla ma rnams la gus phyag 'tshal/ /tshogs gsog nus par byen gyes rlobs/ /skye ba 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang ma thob tshun chad kyi/ /sgye ba blangs dus bde skyid kun/ /'byung ba'i rgyu ni tshogs gsog yin/ /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob dus yang / /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa'i sgu/ /bsod nams tshogs las 'byung ba yin/ /bsod nams bsag thabs grags mang yang / /maṇ+ḍal phul las zab pa med/ /'bul chen 'gyog dang mang ja 'dren/ /dbul bo rnams la sbyin gtong dang / /de bzhin lha 'bri rten bzhengs sogs/ /rgyu yi dngos po gtong dgos 161

rnams/ /dri ma gsum dang ma 'dres dkon/ /dang po sgrub tshe sdig dang 'dres/ /bar du dka' tshegs sdig dang 'dres/ /tha ma ser sna'i sdig dang 'dres/ /maṇ+ḍal dri ma de gsum med/ /lag pa brkyang bskum bsod nams tshogs/ /sgrub la maṇ+ḍal las lhag pa/ /med ces gling chen ras pas gsungs/ /mdo sngags gsar rnying thams cad mthun/ /maṇ+ḍal mang bo phul ba na/ /rtogs pa shugs kyis skye ba yin/ /shes rab ngang gis 'phel ba yin/ /chos mthun ci bsam thams cad 'grub/ /gsung rab tshig don go ba yin/ /sa lam rim gyis bgrod pa yin//mthar thug sangs rgyas thob pa yin/ /de phyir tshogs gsog kun gyi mchog /maṇ+ḍal 'bul la 'bad par mdzod/ /bsod nams bsag thabs glu chung 'di/ /thos tshad bsod nams tshogs gsog shog /skyon kun zad yon tan kun gyi gter/ /mgon sangs rgyas thugs rje can la 'dud/ /mi skya ser pho mo thams cad kyis//chos rnam dag bsgrub par byin gyis rlobs/ /brkus jag dang g.yo sgyus gzhan nor blangs/ /des dge 'dun bsnyen bkur sogs byas nas/ /chos byas so snyam pa'i khyim pa tsho//chos rnam dag yin min bka' la ltos/ /rten lha bzhengs dam chos 'bri 'dod tshe/ /de'i ched du sems can srog bcad nas//chos byas so snyam pa'i 162

khyem pa tsho/ /chos rnam dag yin min bka' la ltos/ /pha shi ba'i don du ra lug bsad/ /sha sngas mgo'i bla ma 'dren pa yis/ /chos byas so snyam pa'i khyim pa tsho/ /chos rnam dag yin min bka' la ltos/ /rje thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyis//chos byed dus srog chod gsungs pa med/ /don de phyir khyem pa pho mo tsho/ /sdig ma 'dres lha chos mdzad na legs/ /glu 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyes/ /grong khyem pa pho mo rnams la smras/ /glu 'di nyid thos tshad thams cad kyis//sdig ma 'dres lha chos byed par shog /me 'obs lta bu'i 'khor ba'i gnas 'di nas/ /pad tshal lta bu'i thar ba'i gnas mchog tu/ /'gro kun 'dren mdzad rgyal sras rnams la 'dud/ /nyam thag 'gro rnams thar ba'i gnas su drongs/ /rigs drug 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir gar skyes kyang / /sdug bsngal ma gtogs bde ba cung zad med/ /dmyal ba rnams la tsha grang sdug bsngal yod//yi dwags rnams la bkres skom sdug bsngal yod/ /dud 'gro rnams la bkol spyod sdug bsngal yod/ /mi la skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal yod/ /lha ma yin la 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal yod/ /lha la 'chi 'pho ltung gi sdug bsngal yod/ /ma chags ma chags 'khor ba'i btson dong skyur/ /'gro na 'gro na 163

thar ba'i grong khyer snyogs/ /khyad par mi yi sdug bsngal rgyas par bshad/ /mi la skye ba'i sdug bsngal mngal gnas tshe/ /dri ngan mi gtsang nang du nyal ba 'dra/ /btsas dus pags pa dmar bshu byas pa 'dra//phyi ru thon dus tsher phung nang lhung 'dra//rgas pa'i sdug bsngal drang bo'i lus po sgur/ /kha yi so bud skra dkar gnyer ma mang //mig dang rna ba mi gsal brjed ngas che//tsha grang bkres skom cung zad tsam mi bzod/ /lus stobs shor bas 'gro 'dug shin tu dka'/ /langs nas 'gro dang sa la sdod pa'i dus/ /a pha a ma mang bo kha nas shor/ /byes pa rnams kyis lad mo byed cing dgod/ /yul mi khyem mtshes rnams kyis brnyas bcos byed//khyem tshang bza' bas mi 'dod 'chi ran zer//sdig rgan 'di la srog gcod mi 'ong zer/ /'chi med ma 'di shi na tshad red zer//tshig ngan nyin re bzhin du mang bo go /ma 'dug ma 'dug gzhon dus phyag skor gyes/ /'dug na 'dug na rgas dus nyal la sdod/ /na ba'i sdug bsngal nad gdon drag pos zin//nyin re'i mnar gcod sdug bsngal bzod mi nus//lus kyi sha lpags bskams shing 'gul skyod dka'/ /yid du 'ong ba'i zas dang skom rnams ni/ /nad la gnod zer sman pas zar mi ster/ /yid du mi 'ong zas sman gtar sreg rnams/ /rang gis mi 164

'dod bzhin du bsten dgos shing / /mo sman rim gro mang bo byas pa rnams/ /gnod pa skyel bzhin je sdug je sdug 'gro/ /mi khyod mi dge spongs la ma na gong / /yang dang yang du tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong gyis/ /'chi ba'i sdug bsngal nad tshabs cher song ste/ /mo sman rim gro byed rnams rang yul bsnyegs/ /gnyen bshes rnams kyis mtha' bskor smre sngags 'don/ /shi dge dur 'debs sogs kyi gshom ra 'ding / /de dus rang gi lus kyi bkrag mdangs nyams/ /kha bskams mchu brdze mig gnyis dong du lhung / /dbugs brtsegs sngar byas sdig pa'i las la 'gyod/ /grogs dang bu tsha bu mo nor rdzas chags/ /hrig trig blta zhing mchi ma re gnyis 'dor/ /bzang ngan ldab ldib gtam gyis kha chems 'jog /gnyen bshes 'khor g.yog nor rdzas rnams dang bral/ /gces par bskyangs pa'i lus kyang mal du bzhag /mar gye nang nas spu bton bzhin du 'gro/ /ma byed ma byed dgra 'dul gnyen skyong zhog /byed na byed na 'chi bro lha chos gyis/ /dgra dang phrad dang phrad dogs sdug bsngal dang / /gnyen dang bral dang bral dogs sdug bsngal dang / /yod pa'i 'tsho skyong mi thub sdug bsngal dang / /med pa'i btsal na mi rnyed sdug bsngal dang / /phyug po sprang bor song ba'i sdug bsngal dang / /mang bo 165

gcig tu song ba'i sdug bsngal dang / /tsha grang ltogs shing skom pa'i sdug bsngal dang / /'thab rtsod gtugs bsher la sogs sdug bsngal mang / /de phyir 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho zhes/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams las gsungs pas na/ /da ni 'khor ba 'di la rgyab bstan nas/ /bde chen thar ba'i zhing khams bsnyeg re ran/ /bsnyeg pa'i thabs ni dam chos kho na yin//myur ba myur du dam pa'i lha chos gyis//sdig dang sdig pa'i grogs po thabs kyis spongs//dge dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten byas nas/ /bde nas bde bar 'gro bar the tshom med//glu dbyangs 'di nyid thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /'khor ba thams cad me ma mur gyi 'obs/ /srin mo'i gling dang dug sbrul tshang ltar mthong / /thar 'dod shugs drag rgyud la skye bar shog /cesapa 'di yang dad can blo ldan sha nye ban+des zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o/ /bla ma bka' drin can la gsol ba 'debs//bdag gzhan chos dang mthun par byin gyis rlobs/ /bla ma dam pas chos kyi sgor bcug nas//dred po dred mor shor ba ngo re tsha/ /mkhan slob spyan sngar khrims bsrung khas blangs nas/ /nag chang bsten pa'i btsun pa ngo re tsha//theg chen spyod pa yin par khas blangs nas//166

snying rje med pa'i chos pa ngo re tsha/ /dam tshig tshul bzhin ma bsrungs gsang sngags slob/ /zong du btsongs pa'i sngags pa ngo re tsha/ /ri la mi tshugs lto phyir grong yul 'grims/ /yon bdag mgo skor rnal 'byor ngo re tsha/ /gnyan sa 'grims nas bdag 'dzin mi gcod par/ /ra lug mgo gcod gcod pa ngo re tsha /rgyal khams thams cad chos bzhin mi skyong bar/ /nyes med gsod pa'i rgyal blon ngo re tsha//gang yod rnams kyis dgon par phogs mi rgyag /sdug gsog byed pa'i bla ma ngo re tsha/ /nor rdzas yod bzhin mchod sbyin mi gtong bar/ /ser sna che ba'i phyug po ngo re tsha/ /ngo tshar gtad kyang da dung ngo mi tsha/ /mgo la gto zhog mi yin ma sems shig /glu la dga' ba'i shugs kyis glu 'di blangs//'di nyid thos tshad rgyud la phan thogs shog /bod kyi nyi ma pad+ma 'byung / /bod la drin can jo bo rje/ /bod yul gtsug rgyan blo bzang grags/ /bod khams yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /khyim pa pho mo phal cher ni/ /skal ba dman pas chos mi thos/ /thos bsam ma byas chos mi shes/ /rtswa mi za zhing chu mi 'thung / /ma gtogs phyugs kyi bu dang 'dra/ /da lta mi lus thob dus 'dir/ /bla ma dam pa tshul bzhin bsten/ /lo re bzhin du dbang lung zhus/ /lo brgya lon nas dbang brgya thob/ /tshe 167

'dir tshe ring nad med cing / /phyi mar lha mir skyes na yang / /dbang can mthon po'i rigs su skye//dam tshig bsrungs na skye ba gsum/ /yang na bdun dang bcu drug tshun/ /sangs rgyas thob ces rgyud las gsungs/ /rgyun du sdig spongs dge ba sgrubs/ /dkon mchog gsum po skyabs su sten/ /khyad par bod yul lha skal ni/ /thugs rje chen por gsol ba thobs/ /rigs drug sgye ba'i sgo gcod pa'i//yi ge drug pa rgyun du thon//de ltar mdzad na gnas skabs skyid/ /mthar thug sangs rgyas go 'phang thob/ /gtam 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /khyim pa pho mo yongs la smras/ /thos tshad khyem pa thams cad kyis/ /chos la thos bsam sgom byed shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis khyim pa rnams la phan phyir smras pa'o/ / bla ma dam pa rnams la 'dud/ /nyon dang dad can pho mo tsho/ /mi rnams lang tsho dar bab dus/ /lha chos mi dran kha bde tshos/ /'e lags sku phyogs rin po che/ /khyed rnams lta bu nged tsho min/ /bza' ba hral hrul nyag nyog mang / /chos tsho mi thub mi 'gyu zer//na so yar la rgas tsa na/ /drang bo'i lus po sgur zhing 'khyogs/ /sha khrag bri zhing gnyer ma mang / /nag po'i skra tsho dung ltar dkar/ /kun gyis rgad po gan tsho 'am/ /rgan mo ma gi zer 168

nas brnyas/ /de dus chos shig dran na yang //lus kyi stobs zad sems dpa' zhum/ /phyag gcig 'tshal kyang lhu tshigs na/ /rang dbang bu dang mna' mar shor/ /mchod sbyin 'dod kyang dbang mi chod/ /bar bar ltogs skom 'khyags pa na/ /kha sems mthun pa'i rgan rgon tshor/ /thug na bshad nas cung zad ngu / /mig gnyis mi gsal rab rib 'gyur//steng du ja pho hu hu zer//rna ba sra bas lan mang 'dri/ /sgra log go tshe hon log zer/ /so rnams bud pas smra ba dig /ngo tsha'i gtam shor gzhon nu dgod/ /nam ngan byung dus skal gcod zer/ /tsag ngan 'khol dus go gcod zer/ /kho bo yi chad shi na zer/ /rlung mkhris bad gan nad kyis zin/ /sdod par dka' ba'i zug gzer lang / /bde bar nyal yang sdug bsngal che/ /bza' btung zos kyang ro mi myong //mgo bo btegs kyang thur du gug /'jam por nyal yang dpyi mgo khol//de dus sman dpyad rim gro byas/ /da dung sos na 'dod mod kyang / /rgad po sman gyi kha dgos med/ /lho sgo tsam re tshad yin zer/ /rgan rgon yi chad da red snyam//sngar byas las la 'gyod pa sgyes/ /mig gnyis dong lhung mchi ma 'dor/ /tshe 'dir yud tsam sdod dbang med/ /snyigs dus bu la blo gtad med/ /sngas mgo'i bla mar khrig khrig med/ /srog bcad dge bas phan pa med/ /de 169

phyir 'dir tshogs dad can tsho/ /gzhon nu dus su phyag skor gyis/ /rang dbang yod dus mchod sbyin thongs/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /thos tshad gzhon dus chos byed shog /dpal ldan bla ma rnams la 'dud//'dir tshogs blo kha chos la sgyur/ /glu ba tshogs drug rang grol glur/ /'dir 'dus dad can pho mo nyon/ /skyes pa'i tha ma nges par 'chi//khas dregs can la 'dug dbang med//'grogs pa'i tha ma nges par 'bral/ brtse gdung can la 'grogs dbang med/ /bsogs pa'i tha ma nges par 'dzad/ /ser sna can la khyer dbang med/ /'chi bdag pho nyas zin pa'i dus/ /mnar gcod sdug bsngal bzod par dka'/ /sman pa bos nas sman dpyad byas/ /sman gyis ma phan sman pa'ang 'gro/ /ban bon bos nas sku rim bcos/ /rim gros ma phan thams cad song / /shul nas gnyen bshes rnams tsho bsdad/ /sngam pa 'then zhing nad par bltas/ /khyod ni de ring ci mo red/ /zer tshe nad pas mgo bo btegs//kho bo tshur 'then ma red zer/ /gnyen bshes drung nas ngus pa'i tshe/ /hrig trig mig gis bu tshor blta/ /ngar ngar sgra ni mgrin par 'don/ /nom nom lag pas gos tshor reg /ldab ldib gtam gyis kha chems 'jog /'jig rten 'di nas pha rol 'gro/ /mi dge'i sdig pa byas pa 170

rnams/ /'jigs 'jigs gshed mas mgul nas khrid/ /'jigs pa'i mun pas mdun nas bsus/ /las kyi rlung gis rgyab nas phul/ /'gro dus 'jigs skrag 'gyod pa skye/ /de dus phan pa'i thabs 'tshol na/ /phan pa dam pa'i lha chos yin//dam pa'i lha chos 'bad par mdzod/ /glu 'di tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /thos tshad lha chos 'bad par shog /ces pa 'di yang khyim pa pho mo rnams la smras pa'o//tshe 'di blos btang ri khrod 'grims/ /smyung gnas stong dang lnga brgya bsrungs/ /bla ma bstan 'dzin nyi ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs//skye bo pho mo rnams tsho nyon//sems med mi skya phal cher gyis/ /rgya yi khe bar kha thug nas/ /phyug po rnams kyi sgo ru khrid/ /sha bzan mang bo btsong du bcug /dmar thig brgyab nas brgya stong sogs/ /ded nas sdig can bshan pa yi/ /drung du khrid nas gsod du bcug /dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal rin byen nyos/ /bud med bdud mo phal cher gyis/ /sgo yi khye la'ang lto mi ldud/ /mna' mar phye skya lag btsir byed/ /g.yog por mi 'dod sna dgu gtong / /a khur ja min chu min 'dren/ /khyim mtshes gnyen bshes mi 'chams 'khon//bza' sdigs thug pa bzhin du bskol/ /de yang dmyal ba'i rgyu zhig yin/ /tshong pa 171

las ngan phal cher gyis/ /g.yo sgyu rdzun bshad dbul bo mi'i//rgyu nor cung zad yod pa len/ /bre dang rgya ma g.yo sgyu byas/ /blun po drang bo'i mgo bo bskor/ /tshong la song dus mdzo g.yag sogs/ /khal mas mi theg khal bkal nas/ /dbyug pas shugs drag brdungs nas 'ded/ /de yang dmyal ba'i rgyu zhig yin/ /phyug po yi dwags phal cher gyi/ /lag pa lha khang sgo bas dam/ /go re chag po yan chad rdems//snod du bcug nas rang mi za//gzhan la mi ster rul du 'jug /ja log mar log ras log sogs/ /byin nas lo mang 'phel du bcug /dbul bo'i zhing khang nor rnams len//de yang dmyal ba'i rgyu zhig yin//byes pa snying med smyon pa yis/ /mthong tshad khyi la rdo yis brdung / /sgo nga blangs nas rdo la rgyag /bya bye'u bzung nas gshog pa gcod/ /bung ba bsad nas sbrang rtsi 'jib/ /bra byi bzung nas sdug myong 'jug /grog tshang bshig dang 'ba' 'bu gsod//de yang dmyal ba'i rgyu zhig yin//de ltar dmyal ba'i rgyu bsags na//phyi mar dmyal ba'i gting du skye/ /'bras bu sdug bsngal yun ring myong / /myong dus bya thabs cung zad med/ /med kyang rang g.yos tshod ma yin/ /de phyir skye bo pho mo tsho/ /dmyal ba'i rgyu rnams ma bsgrub cig /bsgrubs na mtho ris lha mi ru/ /skye ba'i rgyu la 'bad par gyis/ /bla ma bstan 172

'dzin nyi ma la/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /bstan 'dzin nyi ma'i byen rlabs kyis//skye bo pho mor phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan mnga'/ /sbas pa'i sangs rgyas mi gzugs can/ /bla ma sngags 'chang rdo rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /khyim pa pho mo rnams tsho nyon/ /gcod pa sngags pa bzang bo yis/ /rabs chad bu dang bu mo gnyis/ /gang yang med la gcod btsugs nas/ /mgul du srung 'khor 'dogs pa sogs//thabs ni rnam pa sna tshogs byas//rmang po bud med bu skye bcug /dbul bo nor med bza' mi la/ /bsod nams rgyas pa'i sku rim byas/ /dbul bo nor med nor dang sprad/ /dri gshed rgyal gdon byad kha yis/ /smyos nas sdug bsngal myong ba rnams/ /lha sngags ting nge 'dzin gyis gzir/ /dri gshed rgyal gdon byad kha nas/ /phrogs te smyos pa bde ru bcug /gza' btsan klu gnyan sa bdag gis//bzung ba rnams kyang grol du bcug /tha na khye yis bzung ba yan/ /sngags la sogs pas drag tu bcug /mdor na zhi rgyas dbang drag gi /sgo nas phan btags drin can gyi//gcod sngags tshur la 'ong ba'i skabs/ /mi bsu khyem du sdod pa'i dus/ /zhabs tog chung zhing 173

'gro ba'i tshe/ /de ring 'bul ba med ki lags//phyi nas 'di 'dra ster ro zhes/ /kha bzang gtam gyis brdzangs nas gtong / /phyin chad dom bzhin ded na yang / /mi ster ster yang ngan pa ster/ /khrel med khyem pa phal cher gyis/ /phyin chad sgo ru song ba'i tshe/ /ltas ngan 'ug pa byung ba bzhin/ /khyem du yar la 'ong bcug nas/ /ja zhig 'dren pa phar la zhog /nged gi 'grul ba mi chud zer/ /sgo yi khye yang mi 'gog gtong / /gcod sngags phal cher thugs khros nas/ /khyed la 'grul ba mi chud par/ /shog zer smon lam log pa 'debs/ /drin can gcod sngags su yin yang / /ma bkur brnyas na mthu byas bzhin/ /na tsha god kha mang bo 'ong / /'ongs tshe ngo tsha mi shes par/ /sngar gyi gcod sngags 'bod du rgyug /song na gcod sngags su yin yang //khog na khyod la de tshad snyam/ /kha nas o ho snying re rje/ /nga ni khom pa med sogs zer/ /mkho dus gcod sngags 'ong mi 'gyur/ /tshe 'dir tshe bsod sogs mi rgyas/ /phyi mar gzhan gyi bran dang g.yog /rnams su skyes nas sdug myong 'gyur/ /drin can gcod sngags thams cad la/ /ma rabs de 'dra ma byed ang / /nyon dang khyem pa ya rabs tsho/ /drin can gcod sngags su yin yang / /mthong dus sngon nas bsu ba dang / /bzhugs dus zhabs tog bzang bo dang / /phebs 174

dus 'bul ba chen po phul/ /phyin chad mthong ba'i dus rnams su/ /mgo yi zhwa bzhin bkur bar gyis/ /de ltar byas na gcod sngags rnams/ /phyin chad nam mkho'i dus su 'ong //tshe 'dir tshe dang bsod nams dang / /rigs rgyud rlung rta snyan grags rgyas/ /phyi mar mthon po'i rigs su skyes//kun gyis mchod cing bkur bar 'gyur/ /de phyir gcod sngags drin can rnams/ /rgyun du mchod cing bkur bar mdzod/ /bla ma sngags 'chang rdo rje la/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /sngags 'chang rdo rje byin rlabs kyis/ /khyem pa rnams la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//gsar rnying bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ni/ /srid rtse'i bar du bsgreng la brtson/ /pad+ma bzhad pa'i rdo rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byen gyis rlobs/ /nyon dang khyem pa pho mo tsho/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas snyigs ma'i dus/ /sems can so so'i snang ngo ru/ /gang la gang 'dul tshul bstan nas//sems can rnams kyi don mdzad pas/ /'jig rten pa rnams shes pa dka'/ /la las sprang bo nga 'dra'i tshul/ /bzung nas ci yang mi mkho ltar/ /byas nas sems can rnams don mdzad//la las bla chen tshul bzung nas//rgyu nom dgos pa'i tshul bstan nas/ /sems can rnams kyi don 175

mdzad pas/ /dbyar dang ston ga'i dus skabs su//bla ma mang bo mar bsod du/ /phebs dus 'brog pa dad med rigs/ /phal gyis bla ma mthong ma thag /ltas ngan mthong ltar phyi sgo na/ /yod kyang myur du khyim du 'gro/ /bla ma 'khor bcas tshur phebs dus//yun ring 'gor nas byis pa la/ /mar rdog btsog pa bya gong tsam/ /thom bu'i nang du bzhag nas bskur/ /la las ci yang mi ster bar//yul na mi su med pa ltar//bcos nas sgo phab kha rog 'dug /mar ni bya sgong tsam pa re/ /'o ma'i dri 'khyags ma shes na//da ra'i nang du 'gro ba mang //mar ni bye'u'i sgo nga tsam//phul dang skyon med skal chad tsho/ /bla mar cung zad tsam pa re/ /phul yang bsod nams dpag med thob/ /da ra'i nang du song ba la/ /dgos pa ci yod bsam blo thongs//bya rnams mtshan mo 'ug pas mgo /bcad 'gro snyam nas dogs pa bzhin/ /bla ma nang du gdan drangs nas/ /'brel ba 'jog pa phar la zhog /bla ma phar la 'gro rag bar/ /sgo la bud nas bla ma la/ /khyi yang mi 'gog skal dman mang / /gdan drangs 'tsho ba mi 'dren kyang / /sgo la bud nas khyi bkag ste/ /mjal na mgo la cang mi 'ong / /kha dar phyag mdud byin pa'i tshe//med dang mug rab rgyu mtshan ni/ /ma ṇi bzhin du grangs med 'don/ /bshad pa'i zhor la kha dar dang / /176

phyag mdud lag pas yang yang bsnogs/ /byin rlabs rnams nyams mdog kyang shor/ /yon bdag gzhan la ster tshul med / /bshad pa tshar nas phyir la ster/ /la las kha dar phyag mdud tsho//brnyas bcos byas nas blangs te khyer/ /kha gnyer mchil ma 'phen pa sogs/ /mi dad rnam 'gyur mang bo bstan/ /zas nor cung zad cig phul ba/ /ma phul ba dang khyad par sked//nyon dang a khu 'brog pa tsho/ /chen po 'bul rgyu med na yang / /gang yod 'brel ba mi 'jog gam/ /'pho lung bka' bsgo mi zhu yang / /srung mdud mgul du cis mi 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas sgo khar phebs pa'i dus/ /mar ni bye'u mgo tsam re/ /phul nas mjal na chog pa yin//da lta mi mjal nam tshod mjal/ /phar la song na bla ma la//dam chos 'pho lung bka' bsgo sogs/ /zhu skabs phar zhog phyag mjal yang / /snga dro tsam rer 'ong mi srid/ /deng sang bla ma phal cher ni/ /rgyu nom bsams nas 'ong mi srid//'o na ci yin zer tsa na/ /snyigs dus dmu rgod sems can la/ /dam pa'i lha chos bshad pa dang / /zas gos 'brel ba tsam bzhag na/ /phyi mar 'brel tshad sems can rnams/ /dag pa'i zhing du 'dren snyam dang / /ci phul dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa'i/ /dge sbyor byed pa'i mthun rkyen du/ /phul na yon bdag bsod nams kyi/ /tshogs 177

rdzogs pa dang dge 'dun rnams/ /thugs dam dge sbyor 'phel lam snyam//dgos pa du ma dmigs nas 'ong //de phyir khyim pa pho mo tsho/ /ha cang ser sna ma che bar/ /gang yod zas nor 'brel ba zhog /da yang nyon dang khyim pa tsho/ /skye bo brgya phrag mang bo la/ /lo mang 'tsho ba'i zas byen pas//bla ma sgo rtsar phebs par mar//ril ma tsam zhig phul gyur na/ /bsod nams shin tu che ba yin//ston dus gang bzang bla ma rnams/ /nas bsod phyir du phebs pa'i tshe/ /dung bus g.yang sde bsod nams can/ /da lo lo legs skal bzang red/ /bsod snyoms bzang bo ma 'gor zhes/ /skad gseng mthon pos bsgrags pa na/ /char med g.yu 'brug grags pa bzhin/ /rong gi zhing pa dad med kyis/ /nas phor gang yang 'bul mi srid/ /brag cha bzhin du byes pa rnams/ /grwa pas gang smras lad mo byed/ /nas phor tsam re tsi gu dang / /bye'u rnams kyis bskyal ba mang / /bong bu lan re shor nas za/ /bla mar phul na phyi ma'i dus/ /bsod nams brgya phrag thob pa yin/ /bong bus zos la dgos pa ci/ /ci yang khyer nas ma 'ongs na/ /grwa pa thams cad sgo ru song / /a khu a ma zer nas bos/ /bsod snyoms shig byin smras pa'i tshe/ /khyim na cig gis mnan yod bzhin/ /yun ring 'gor nas phor ba ru/ /nas ngan kha skogs 178

tsam khyer 'ong / /la las mi 'ong phyi sgo la/ /yag shing brgyab nas kha rog 'dug /sangs rgyas sgo la tshur phebs dus/ /nas phor tsam re'i steng nas kyang / /dkyil du bsdad nas mjal na chog /de dus mi mjal nam mjal snyam/ /phar la song nas bla ma'i rigs/ /phal che ba la rta phul kyang / /mjal phrad mi 'ong a rog tsho/ /da yang nyon dang khyem pa tsho//bsod nams med pa phal cher gyes/ /bla ma mang po phebs tsa na/ /'di tsho rnams la 'dug dal med/ /da lo bla ma'i mang re ltos/ /byin gyin byen gyin 'dzad rgyu med/ /a kha kha zer snang ba sun/ /dus ngan bskal pa'i snyigs ma la/ /bla ma bsod snyoms byed pa las/ /rgya sprang spre'u 'dzin pa dga'/ /sprel 'dzin mtha' ru mi mang 'du/ /zas skom gnyis ka mang bo ster/ /bla ma dam pa su phebs kyang / /zas gos 'du ba phar la zhog /mdun na 'khor mkhan mi gcig med/ /de ltar rong 'brog gang yin kyang / /bsod snyoms legs po ma phul na/ /bsod snyems mi 'bul yul phyogs der/ /grwa pa rnams kyis da lo nas/ /yul ngan mu ge'i grong khyer der/ /phyin chad song nas ched zer nas/ /bla ma gdan 'dren mkhan byung yang //grwa pas bla ma phebs mi 'jug /phyin chad bla ma bzang bor 'brel/ /bzhag na dad can 'ga' re yis/ /'dod kyang 'byon pa shin tu 179

dka'/ /bsod snyoms legs po phul sa der/ /grwa pa rnams kyis yang yang du//lha yul gnyis pa de nyid du/ /bla ma da lo phebs na zer//gdan 'dren mkhan su ma byung yang //lo re bzhin du bla ma phebs/ /bla ma gang gi gang bzang la/ /'brel ba 'jog kyang lag na yod/ /bla ma mang gi a kha kha//zer ba'i sgo ru lo re bzhin/ /bla ma 'ong mkhan je nyung 'gro/ /lo na kha shas song 'phro la/ /bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams/ /a kha kha zer snang ba sun/ /de nas gcig kyang 'byon mi 'gyur/ /dri bo'i mig rtsa bsal ni yin/ /bdud po'i snang ba bde ni yin/ /nyon dang rong 'brog dad can tsho/ /bla ma brgya phrag phebs na yang //da lo bla ma grangs med byon/ /'di rnams nang nas sangs rgyas kyi/ /rnam 'phrul mang bo yod par nges/ /nga rang skal ba bzang 'dug snyam/ /rab tu dga' spro dad pa'i sgos/ /bla ma nang du gdan drongs la/ /'khor bcas 'tsho ba bzang bo drongs/ /dbang bskur 'pho lung bsngo ba zhus/ /rta gos nor dang ra lug dang / /mar chur gro nas gang 'dzoms rnams/ /phangs pa med par gus pas phul/ /bla ma khyed kyi sku tshod kyi/ /rgyu nom 'bul rgyu ma mchis mod/ /'on kyang yon bdag nga rang gi /tshod kyi 'di 'dra zhig yod lags//yod na khyed la cis mi 'bul/ /phyin chad bla ma sa phyogs 'dir//yang 180

yang byon nas rgad po nga //dus dang rnam pa thams cad du//khyed kyi thugs dam sku 'og nas/ /ma 'dor khyed mkhyen khyed mkhyen sogs/ /gtam snyan bshad pa bzang bo dang / /bcas te 'brel ba 'jog par mdzod/ /pad+ma bzhad pa'i rdo rje la/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /pad+ma bzhad rdor byen rlabs kyis/ /khyem pa rnams la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//kha ba can byon bla ma/ /kha bdar mkhan ngas gzhan la/ /kha ta gang byas thos tshad/ /kha lo chos la sgyur cig /kha gzhon dus nas rgyun du/ /kha zhe med par chos byed//kha la ngal rgyu med par//kha nas rgyun du glu len/ /kha bde tshogs drug rang grol/ /kha rog dben par 'dug zhor/ /kha min bsam pa thag pas//kha ba can gye mi rer/ /kha ta re re byas yod/ /kha dog sngo ljang rtsi shing / /kha dog skya bor song bzhin/ /kha dog nag pa'i skra lo//kha dog dkar bor song ba'i/ /kha rgan bsam shes rnams dang / /kha gzhon dad pa can tshos/ /kha ta'i tshig bzhin gyis dang / /kha yi so lhung lus sgur/ /kha dog shor nas 'chi khar/ /kha sems mi 'gyod blo bde/ /kha bshad mkhan ngas gang smras/ /kha shas 'phyugs rung mkhas rnams/ /kha log tshig ngan ma gsung / /kha rgyab mi 'dzom sprang 181

rgan/ /kha la rtsad gcod ci yod//kha nas bzang gi la sogs//kha tshig bzang bo gsungs dang / /kha shas bden par bzung nas/ /kha ton sogs la 'bad nges/ /kha mkhas tshogs drug rang grol/ /kha nas glu dbyangs gang blangs/ /kha gzhon rgan rnams thos tshad//kha lo chos la 'gyur shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o /drin can gye bla ma rnams la 'dud//bdag gzhan kun sdug bsngal ming med pa'i/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro nus pa'i/ /skal ba de rgyud la bzhag tu gsol/ /'khor ba na sdug bsngal mang bo yod/ /sdig sdug dang gtam ngan gang la yang / /ma 'dzems par thabs ni sna tshogs kyis/ /longs spyod ni bsgrubs nas rang nyid la/ /'byor ba zhig byung tshe thams cad kyis/ /mi 'os pa'i khral chen 'gel ba dang / /rku 'phrog sogs byas nas longs spyod gtong / /mi nus rung gtong dgos sdug bsngal dang / /longs spyod rnams bsrung phyir chen po la/ /zhu ba dang sems 'dzin thad ka ba/ /gtam bsher dang 'khrug rtsod so mel tshe/ /byed dgos pas nyin par lto mi dran/ /mtshan mo gnyid mi 'ong sdug bsngal dang / /nye du dang gnyid dang 'khor g.yog dang / /mdza' bshes dang bla ma dpon bzang dang / /bral ba na 182

sems la mya ngan skyes/ /ngag tu yang smre sngags 'don pa dang / /lus kyi skra 'bal sogs sdug bsngal myong / /sngar 'khon pa'i dgra la phrad pa na//dgra de yis chad pas bcad pa dang //bcad kyis dogs sdug bsngal myong ba dang / /tshe sngon dus bsod nams ma bsags pas/ /tshe 'di ru dbul bo'i mir sgyes te/ /zas gos dang gnas mal la sogs kyis/ /phongs pa dang bsod nams byas na yang / /lo ma byung tshong byas khe ma 'ongs/ /'tsho skyong byas phyugs kyang cher ma 'phel/ /ster mkhan dang skyi mkhan su ma byung / /de'i steng du sngar gye dom pas 'ded/ /drag po byung ci bya gtol med gyur//rang gis sngar drin gyis bskyangs rnams dang //rang las ches dman pa rnams kyi bran/ /khol bo sogs byed dgos sdug bsngal dang / /rgyal po dang chom rkun la sogs kyis/ /bsad pa dang bcings pa'i sdug bsngal dang / /bsad kyis dogs bcings kyis dogs pa sogs/ /'khor ba na sdug bsngal brjod mi lang //sdug bsngal gye sgra yang mi thos pa'i//bde ba can la sogs sangs rgyas kyi/ /zhing khams su song na 'dod pa'i mis/ /'khor ba 'dir da nas mi chags par/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro re ran/ /'gro thabs de dam pa'i chos yin pas/ /thams cad kyis dam pa'i lha chos sgrubs/ /glu dbyangs 'di 183

blangs pa'i dge ba rnams/ /rang gzhan gyis 'khor bar rgyab bstan nas/ /bde ba can la sogs sangs rgyas kyi/ /zhing khams su 'gro ba'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis sbyar ba'o//e ma ngo mtshar rgyal ba'i sras//stong nyid snying rje'i go mtshon thogs//nyon mongs g.yul ngo pham mdzad pa'i//snying stobs can gyi rnal 'byor pa/ /zho 'ong la kha'i pho skyes rnams/ /mi tshe 'di ru skyid pa dang / /khyad par phyi mar bde thabs kyi/ /zhal gdams brtse bas gnang bar zhu/ /zhes pa 'di slob bu pad+ma rang grol gyis skul tshig tu smras pa'i lan du/drin can rtsa rgyud bla ma dang //yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gis/ /bdag gzhan 'gro ba thams cad kyi//blo kha dam pa'i chos la sgyur/ /lho rgyal 'dzam bu'i gling du skyes/ /sangs rgyas shākya thub pa yi/ /bstan par mjal ba'i dus skabs 'dir/ /lha chos bsgrub dgos pho skyes tsho/ /sngar skyes ma shi gcig kyang med/ /da lta'i ngeg cag thams cad 'chi/ /phyin chad mi 'chi'i mi yang med/ /'chi dus chos min mgon skyabs med//nyon dang zho 'ong pho skyes tsho/ /rang nyid rgas pa ma shes par//rgas khar chos med ma byed cig /'chi ba 'ong ba ma tshor bar/ /'chi dus sdig pa ma 'khur zhig /tshe 'di'i bya ba sgrub bsgrubs nas/ /phyi mar lag 184

stong ma 'gro zhig /bu dang chung mar chags chags nas/ /phyi mar gcig pur ma 'gro zhig /pha yul mkhar khyem bsdad bsdad nas/gtan sdug yul du ma 'gro zhig /phyi mar lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /lha gshags pham du ma 'jug cig /mnyam por 'ong ba'i bdud lag tu/ /song nas sdug bsngal ma myong zhig /srog gcod mang bo byas byas nas / /dmyal ba'i yul du ma 'gro zhig /nor rdzas ser sna byas byas nas/ /yi dwags yul du ma 'gro zhig /phan tshun 'thab rtsod byas byas nas/ /lha min yul du ma 'gro zhig /da dung nyon dang pho skyes tsho/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po khur/ /thugs rje khong las che ba med/ /rgyun du mtshan ldan bla ma sten/ /byen rlabs kho las che ba med/ /yi dam thugs rje chen po sgrubs/ /yi dam 'di las bzang ba med/ /snying bo yi ge drug ma thon/ /sgrib sbyong 'di las zab pa med/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong rgyun du mchod/ /grogs su 'di las mdzangs pa med/ /'dis mtshon dge bas pho sgyes kun/ /blo kha chos la rab phyogs nas/ /nyin mtshan chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /'di phyi kun tu bde bar shog /ces smras pa'o//e ma snyigs dus 'gro ba'i mgon/ /zho 'ong pho skyes dad can la/ /zhal gdams gnang ba bka' drin che/ /da ni zho 'ong 185

bud med rnams/ /gnas skabs kun tu bde ba dang / /rim bzhin sangs rgyas go 'phang de/ /thob pa'i zhal gdams gsal bo zhig /brtse ba chen pos gnang du gsol//zhes pa 'di yang slob bu pad+ma rang grol gyis smras pa'i lan du/phyogs bcu'i mchod 'os skyabs gyur kun//byin rlabs nus pa'i rtsal bskyed la/ /bdag gzhan tshe 'di'i bar chad sol//blo sna chos la myur du sgyur/ /nyon dang skye dman bu smad rnams/ /skye dka' 'dzam bu'i gling du skyes/ /thob dka'i mi lus rin chen thob//phrad dka'i dam pa'i chos dang phrad//mjal dka'i bla mar mjal dus 'dir/ /dam pa'i lha chos ma byas na/ /khong na don snying med pa yin/ /rang mgo rang gis bskor ba yin//rang gis rang nyid phung ba yin/ /rin chen gling du sleb slebs pa//lag pa stong ba su zhig 'gro/ /dam chos dar ba'i yul skyes nas/ /phyi mar chos med su zhig 'gro/ /rin chen gser gyi gling phyin nas//lag stong mchan du bcug nas 'gro/ /phod pa'i mi de'i don snying rul/ /yang na gdon gyis spyos pa yin/ /dam chos dar ba'i gling du skyes/ /lha chos mi byed 'chi phod pa'i/ /bu smad don snying rul ba yin/ /yang na gdon gyis smyos pa yin/ /da dung nyon dang bu smad rnams/ /pha yul pha ma rgyab tu bzhag /nor khyer gzhan gye 186

g.yog la 'gro/ /khyed rnams zhib tu bsam blo thongs/ /g.yog mo zer ba logs na med/ /dpon mo yin snyam dgod re bro/ /zas nor khyer ba'i dbang can tsho/ /nor rdzas don med ma byed cig /'chi ba mi dran khom med tsho/ /'chi khar chos med byed cig /ngan 'gror mi skrag snying can tsho/ /shi tshe dmyal bar ma 'gro zhig /bu khyo 'dul ba'i dpa' mo tsho//mi tshe stong zad ma byed cig /zas nor 'dzom pa'i phyug mo tsho/ /'chi dus bzhag nas ma 'gro zhig /byi dor rem pa'i gzugs bzang tsho/ /'chi tshe mal du ma 'jog cig /bkal 'thag mkhas pa'i gos bzang tsho//'chi khar gcer bur ma 'gro zhig /bza' btung zhim po za mkhan tsho/ /'chi khar zas med ma 'gro zhig /so nam zhing las tshar med tsho/ /'chi khar bzhag nas ma 'gro zhig /bu khyo gso ba'i gzhung bzang tsho 'chi khar gcig pur ma 'gro zhig /da yang nyon dang bu smad tsho/ /mchod gnas dkon mchog gsum la gyes/ /brten sa 'di las bzang ba med/ /bla ma mgo yi zhwa bzhin bkur/ /bkur gnas 'di las bzang ba med/ /thugs rje chen por gsol ba thobs/ /byin rlabs 'di las che ba med//snying bo yi ge drug ma thon//sgrib sbyong 'di las bzang ba med/ /mi dge bcu spongs dge bcu sgrubs/ /chos su 'di las bzang ba med/ /pha ma gnyis la drin 187

gzo mdzod//drin la 'di las che ba med//phyugs dang sgo khye rem la gsos//bsod nams 'di las che ba med//ltogs phongs can la sbyin pa thongs/ /sbyin pa 'di las bzang ba med/ /dug lnga skye ba'i zas nor spongs/ /chags sdang 'di las ngan pa med/ /zer lo mang bo'i smra mchu tshums/ /zag pa de las sog pa med/ /bla ma dngos su byon na yang //gdams ngag 'di las lhag pa med//pha ma dngos su byung na yang / /kha ta 'di las lhag pa med/ /gtan bde byed dam gtan sdug byed//da lta rang gi lag na yod//rang dbang rang la yod dus 'dir/ /gdam kha ma nor bu smad tsho/ /dge 'dis skye dman bu smad kun/ /blo kha lha chos byed la phyogs/ /gang nus dge la myur 'bad nas/ /tshe rabs kun tu skyid par shog /ces smras pa'o/ /tshogs gnyis rgya mtshor yun ring goms pa'i mthus//deng 'dir 'gro drug 'dren la 'gran zla bral//rang byung pad 'byung gnyis pa'i thugs kyi sras//nyon mongs 'ching ba kun grol bla ma la//lag gnyis thal mor sbyar nas 'di skad zhu//zho 'ong gshis kyi dad can pho skyes rnams/ /blo kha chos la phyogs pa'i zhal gdams ni//go sla nyung 'dus brtse bas gnang du gsol//zhes pa 'di yang dad gtong blo gros mchog mnga' snod ldan slob bu pad+ma rang grol gyis smras pa'i lan du/188

drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /dad can pho sgyes rnams kyi blo kha dam pa'i chos la sgyur/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol phan pa'i glu dbyangs len/ /dad can zho 'ong gshis kyi pho skye rnams tsho nyon/ /mi lus rin chen rnyed dka' thob dus chos byed dgos/ /mi rtag 'chi ba nam 'ong cha med glo bur 'ong / /mi dge'i sdig pa byas na ngan song gnas su ltung / /mi bzod sdug bsngal myong dus 'gyod kyang bya thabs med/ /dkar nag las 'bras 'di la nam yang bslu ba med/ /nag po mi dge bcu la shin tu shin tu 'dzems/ /dkar bo dge bcu chos spyod bcu la 'bad par gyes/ /rgan pa'i kha 'di nyes na pho gsar lag nyes 'gro/ /pho gsar blo sna ma thung rgan pa'i kha la nyon/ /rgan pa ser sna ma che dbul bor sbyin pa thongs pho gsar 'khon 'dzing ma byed rang tshod rang gis zungs/ /kha 'jam khog nag mi la blo 'dri ma byed bzang / /gzhan la 'phog nyen yod pas tshod bzung ran par sgos/ /ha cang dran rgyu ma mang gang byed mtha' ru thon/ /rang sde sdug la ma gtad dbang can gong ma tsho/ /bza' sdigs kha tshag ma mang khyem tshang bza' dpon tsho/ /khye la rdo dang dbyug pas ma rdungs gzhon nu tsho/ /phyugs la brdungs na mi tshe 'dir yang bsod nams 'dzad/ /ha 189

cang zhe sdang ma che khro med bzod pa sgoms/ /zhe sdang langs na phyi mar dmyal ba'i gting du skye/ /bzod pa bsgoms na phyi mar gzugs mdzes mi lus thob/ /mgo bo na ba'i chang gis ci bya chang ma thungs/ /za rgyur mi phan du ba nyes dmigs che bas chod/ /rgan gzhon thams cad brkus dang dmag gi las la dga'/ /grong sde 'khrug rtsod byas pa thabs kyis 'grig tu chugs/ /'gro kun pha ma yin pas srog gcod gtan nas spongs/ /khyad par 'phyi ba bya wang la sogs nyes med kyi/ /ri dwags gsod du ma 'jug bsad na khrims la sbyor/ /bong bur me shing lci mo ma 'gel yang mo khol/ /bkal nas rdo dang dbyug pas ma rdungs sems yod tsho/ /'phongs zad rgyab rnams sgal pas khengs dus mi gzhan la/ /ma btsongs snying rje drin can yin pas drin gzo gyis/ /tshe 'di'i pha ma a khu rgas dus bkur ste rem/ /chos mdzad dam pa gang yin bstod la 'brel ba zhog /sdig byed skye bo rnams kyi blo kha chos la sgyur/ /grong sde khyim tshang gang yang dam pa'i chos la skul/ /chos la bskul na byis pa yin rung kha la nyon/ /sdig la sbyor na rgan pa yin yang khar ma nyan/ /mdor na mi dge'i las la pho skyes kun gyis 'jems/ /dkar bo dge ba'i las la 'chi rung 'bad par gyis/ /de ltar byas na tshe 190

'dir tshe dang bsod nams rgyas/ /phyi ma lha'am mi lus gtsang ma thob par nges/ /rim bzhin skye ba bzang bo brgyud nas sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /glu dbyangs thos tshad blo kha chos la phyogs par shog /ces smras pa'o//rnam mkhyen kun bzang dgongs par rtag gzhol ba'i//rnam 'dren bla ma tshogs drug rang grol la/ /rnam dkar dge la gzhol ba'i slob bu ngas/ /rnam dag dad pas thal sbyar 'di skad zhu/ /zho 'ong gshis kyi dad can pho skyes la/ /zhal gdams brtse bas gnang ba bka' drin che/ /da ni zho 'ong gshis kyi bu smad rnams/ /chos la bskul ba'i zhal gdams gnang du gsol//zhes pa 'di yang dad ldan sems bzang ngang ring slob bu pad+ma rang grol gyis smras pa'i lan du/pha rgan chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bor gsol ba 'debs/ /zho 'ong gshis kyi bu smad yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol brtse ba'i rgyang glu len/ /zho 'ong gshis kyi dad can skye dman bu smad nyon/ /skye dman bu smad yin yang rnyed dka'i lus rten yin/ /lus 'di mi rtag 'jig par nges pas lha chos dgos/ /chos med 'chi dus 'gyod pa skye yang phan pa med/ /sdig pa'i dbang gis dmyal bar song na sdug bsngal che/ /da lta bde sdug gnyis kyi gdam kha rang la yod//bde 191

ba 'dod na 'di bzhin mdzod cig bu smad tsho/ /bdag 'dzin bu smad che bas bu dang khyor ma zhen/ /'dod pa bu smad che bas nor dang rdzas ma chags/ /blo sna bu smad mang bas dran rgyu'i blo ma mang / /bya ba bu smad mang bas don med bya ba spongs/ /dug lnga bu smad che bas skyes tshe gnyen po sten/ /go ba bu smad chung bas yang yang chos la nyon/ /le lo bu smad che bas brtson 'grus chos la skyed/ /ser sna bu smad che bas dbul bor sbyin pa thongs/ /smra ba bu smad mang bas ha cang gtam ma mang / /mchor la bu smad dga' bas ha cang mchor ma byed/ /thams cad bsgyed gzhi yin pas bu tsha chos sgor chugs/ /khyim gyi rten sa yin pas bza' 'khor byams pas skyongs/ /'phral dbang bu smad che bas nye 'khor zas kyis skyongs/ /'di phyir byen rlabs 'byung bas bla ma dkon mchog mchod/ /bsogs pa bzhag nas 'gro bas gang la'ang sems ma chags/ /dad pa kun slong ci byed chos dang bstun na legs/ /a bye a ne drin che pha ma bzhin du bkur/ /lus kyi zla grogs ngan yang phan pas mig bzhin 'tshos/ /bu tsha rgas khar phan nges rgyun du brtse bas skyongs/ /'dus pa 'bral ba yin pas yun du mthun par 'grogs/ /bzang ngan nor gyis 'byed pas gang yod yar 'jog gyis/ /gang yod yar 'jog 192

gyes/ /lto srog 'brel ma yin pas so nam rem la gyis/ /'jig rten rnam thar yin pas mgron por bzang bo gyis//lha chos med na phyug rung mi tshe stong log yin//gzugs byad phun sum tshogs rung 'chi tshe bzhag nas 'gro/ /bu mang 'khor g.yog ldan rung gcig pur dmyal bar 'gro/ /gsog rum byed la mkhas rung dud 'gro rnams dang 'dra/ /mi tshe stong zad ma byed rgan mo bu smad tsho//rang don yal bar ma gtong mna' ma bu smad tsho//'di bas phyi sdug ma byed g.yog mo bu smad tsho/ /myur du lha chos sgrubs shig zho 'ong bu smad tsho/ /gtam 'di bya btang tshogs drug rang grol zhes bya ngas/ /zho 'ong gshis kyi dad can bu smad yongs la gdams//glu dbyangs 'di nyid thos tshad las can bu smad kyis//yar 'gro dam pa'i lha chos rgyun du byed par shog /ces spras pa'o//sems can thar bar 'dren mdzad pa'i/ /drin can bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /dad can rnams tsho ma yengs nyon/ /tshe 'dir srog gcod byas gyur na/ /phyi mar mi tshe thung bar skye/ /de phyir srog gcod ma byed ang / /tshe 'dir ma byen par blangs na/ /phyi mar dbul bo'i mi ru skye/ /de phyir ma byen ma len ang / /tshe 'dir mi tshangs par spyad na/ /phyi mar chung ma bsrung mi thub//de phyir mi tshangs ma spyod ang / /tshe 'dir dzun gyi tshig smras na/ /phyi 193

mar mi khas shin tu sdang / /de phyir rdzun tshig ma smra ang / /tshe 'dir phra ma byas pa na//phyi mar 'khor g.yog rnyed mi 'gyur//de phyir phra ma ma byed ang / /tshe 'dir tshig rtsub smras pa na//phyi mar mi snyan tshig ngan thos/ /de phyir tshig rtsub ma smra ang / /tshe 'dir ngag 'khyal tshig smras na/ /phyi mar rang gi tshig mi btsun/ /de phyir ngag 'khyal ma smra ang / /tshe 'dir brnab sems byas gyur na/ /phyi mar ci bsam don mi 'grub/ /de phyir brnab sems spongs shig ang //tshe 'dir gnod sems byas gyur na//phyi mar 'jigs skrag che ba yin/ /de phyir gnod sems spongs shig ang / /tshe 'dir log lta byas gyur na/ /phyi mar yang dag lta bar rmongs//de phyir log lta spongs shig ang //ang yig bcu yi zhal gdams 'di/ /'di phyir bde ba'i thabs su smras/ /smras pa ji bzhin bsgrub par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//drin can bla ma rin po che/ /spyi gtsug pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs/ /thugs rje spyan gyis yongs la gzigs/ /khyad par ya rabs nor bu yi/ /mi mthun 'gal rkyen bar chad sol/ /blo kha dam pa'i chos la sgyur/ /tshogs drug rang grol zhal gdams ster/ /dad can khrims ldan nor bu nyon/ /phyogs bcu'i sems can thams cad kyi/ /mig phyung btson rar bcug pa slar/ /194

btson ra de nas bton nas mig /byen nas tshangs pa'i bde ba la/ /dang bas blta ba phan yon che/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad po//mchod las bla ma'i ba spu yi/ /bu ga gcig mchod phan yon che/ /gtong phod che ba'i nor bu khyod/ /de lta mi lus thob dus 'dir/ /de rnams bsgrub nus khyod kyis sgrubs/ /sems bskyed ma byas dus skabs su/ /sbyin pa rgya chen btang ba las/ /sems can thams cad don du bdag /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ /de phyir sbyin gtong 'di bya snyam/ /sems bskyed byas nas dud 'gro la/ /zan changs gcig byen phan yon che/ /ci'i phyir zhe na sems can la/ /grangs med pa dang sangs rgyas ni/ /yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /mnga' bas phan yon che ba yin/ /thos rgya can gye nor bu khyod/ /da lta mi lus thob dus 'dir/ /de yang bsgrub nus khyod kyis sgrubs/ /khyim pa'i zang zing dpag tu med/ /sbyin las rab tu byung ba yis/ /dam chos tshigs bcad gcig byin na/ /phan yon shin tu che ba yin/ /e ma khrel yod nor bu khyod/ /da lta mi lus thob dus 'dir/ /de yang bsgrub nus khyod kyis sgrubs/ /byang sems khyem na gnas pa yis/ /'bru mar rgya mtsho tsam pa la/ /snying bo ri rab tsam pa zhig /btsugs nas mar me phul ba las/ /dge slong 195

byang sems dgon pa na/ /gnas pas 'bru mar thigs pa gcig /tsam la sdong bu khab rtse tsam/ /btsugs nas mar me phul ba de/ /phan yon shin tu che ba yin/ /ci'i phyir phan yon che zer na/ /byang chub sems la khyad med kyang / /rten gye sgo nas phan yon che/ /ngo tsha shes pa'i nor bu khyod/ /da lta mi lus thob dus 'dir/ /de yang bsgrub nus khyod kyis sgrubs/ /byang shar mtshams kyi sangs rgyas ni/ /dbang phyug rgyal po'i zhing khams su/ /bskal bar tshul khrims bsrung ba las/ /mi mjed 'jig rten zhing khams 'dir/ /tshul khrims sna re tsam bsrung ba/ /phan yon shin tu che ba yin/ /ston pa'i bstan pa skyon ma zhugs/ /dus su tshul khrims yun ring du/ /bsrung las bstan pa 'jigs pa la/ /nye ba'i dus 'dir snga dro tsam/ /zhig la tshul khrims bsrung ba de/ /phan yon de bas shin tu che/ /shes rab che ba'i nor bu khyod/ /da lta mi lus thob dus 'dir/ /de yang bsgrub nus khyod kyis sgrubs/ /'di phyi'i bde sgrub rnal 'byor ngas/ /'di ni zho 'ong nor bur smras/ /'di nyid thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /'di bzhin tshe 'dir bsgrub nus shog /ces pa 'di yang lugs gnyis gang la'ang blo gros kyi rtsal che zhing bla ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bor len pa'i zho 'ong bla ma'i tsha bo 'phags pa'i nor bdun gyis phyug po'i nor bus zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//196

pha rgan chos rgyal rin po che/ /mos pa'i bu yi lam sna drongs/ /khrel yod gzhung bzang dad pa can/ /chung 'grogs slob bu rin chen rgyal/ /sems can gzhan gyi srog ma gcod/ /'chi blu tshe thar ci thub thongs/ /ma byin pa rnams ma len par/ /zas gos nor gyis mchod sbyin thongs/ /gzhan gyi chung mar ma spyod par/ /rang gi grogs kyis chog par gyis/ /rdzun gyi tshig rnams ma smra bar/ /drang bo'i gtam ni smras na bzang / /phra mas mthun pa ma 'byed par/ /mi mthun pa rnams thabs kyis sdums/ /mi 'dod tshig rtsub ma smra bar/ /yid 'ong gtam ni smra bar mdzod/ /don med ngag 'khyal ma smra bar/ /don ldan chos kyi gtam rnams shod/ /gzhan gyi nor la brnab sems spongs/ /rang gi nor gyis chog par gyis/ /gzhan la gnod sems ma skye bar/ /phan pa'i sems dang ldan na legs/ /chos la log lta ma byed par/ /yid ches nges shes rab tu skyed/ /de ltar byas na tshe 'di la/ /bde skyid phun sum tshogs ldan zhing / /phyi mar lha'am mi lus 'thob/ /rim bzhin sangs rgyas 'thob par 'gyur/ /gtam 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /dad can rin chen rgyal la gdams/ /dge 'dis rang la 'brel thogs gyis/ /ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub par shog /197

ka dag chos sku'i klong nas 'gro don du/ /kha dog ngur sprig 'dzin pa'i sku ru bzhengs/ /ga nas bltas kyang skyon zad yon tan gter/ /nga yi gtsug rgyan drin can bla mar 'dud/ /ca co'i rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi ring du dor/ /cha med dben pa'i ri khrod nyams dga' bsten/ /ja chang 'dod yon longs spyod gang la yang / /nya ltar spyod pa'i sred pa gtan spangs nas/ /ta thā ga ta'i thugs kyi bcud lta bu'i/ /tha bral lta ba rtse gcig bsgoms pa'i mthus/ /da re tshe 'dir rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ /nā gā rdzu na gnyis pa khyod las gang / /pa sangs ltar dkar gzhan phan bsam pa yis/ /pha mar gyur pa'i snyigs dus 'gro ba'i rigs/ /ba lang lta bu'i rmongs pa rnams grol phyir/ /ma yengs 'di ltar sgrub la gzhol dgos zhes/ /tsā ri las dben gnas chen mtsho snying du/ /tsha grang khyad du bsad nas yang dag lta/ /dza hu'i rgyun bzhin byeng rgod bar mi chod/ /wa ler dus kun da dung skyong 'di rmad/ /zhwa gos rgyan sogs 'khor ba myang 'das kyi/ /za zi'i snang ba sgyu ma'i chos su go /'a 'ur lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul ci byung yang / /ya nga med par ya mtshan lta mor mthong / /ra ba gangs ris bskor ba'i yul phyogs 'dir/ /la lung rnams su sdod mi mang na yang / /sha stag nges don chos la gzhol ba de/ /sa 'dir 198

da lta khyod min gzhan na su/ /ha ha mgon khyod thugs rjes bu ngas kyang / /a don skye med rtogs snyam dga' spro 'phel//lha mir bcas pa'i 'gro rnams skyabs khyod kyis/ /mos gus che ba'i ka ring sngags 'chang dang / /dad pa che ba'i a bar the bu la/ /rab tu brtse bas zhal gdams gsung du gsol/ /zhes pa 'di slob bu pad+ma rang grol gyis skul tshig tu smras pa'i lan du/sgrib gnyis zad kyang sgrib pa sbyong ba'i tshul//tshogs gnyis rdzogs kyang tshogs gsog rgya cher mdzad/ /'dod pa zad kyang 'dod yon lnga la spyod/ /rgyal sras chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /chos dang mi mthun chos pa'i khur de 'dzin/ /skyo ba mi skye skyo mgur snyan mo len/ /nyams rtogs med pas nyams mgur lhang lhang 'then/ /kha bshad mkhan ngas kha nas glu dbyangs len/ /ka ring sngags 'chang a bar the bu yi//kha rgan ba sam shes gzhon nu dad can tsho/ /ga le gyi le 'bol le dal cag ge /nga yis glu dbyangs 'then la rna ba gtod/ /ca co'i gtam mang ma lab kha ton gyis/ /cha med bla ma che chung su byung yang / /ja mar gro nas sogs kyis 'brel ba zhog /nya ltar sha la dga' nas srog ma gcod/ /ta 'dug yang 'dug sogs la gnas mjal gyis/ /tha ma kha dang chang gnyis gcod thub ltos/ /dā bu sogs 199

kyi tshar dom ma gtong bzang / /na so rgan gzhon med par ma ṇi rem/ /pa ru'i kha bzhin lag pa ma dam par//a pha a khu shi dus dge rtsa gyis/ /ba mo 'bri dang ra ma ma mo'i bu/ /ma 'grangs bar du 'o ma 'then ma gtong / /tsā yi mi bzhin jag dang brkus ma byed/ /tsha ru'i phyir du lu gu'i rke ma gcu/ /dza bh+yo sod gtubs zer ba'i mthu ma dga'/ /wa zhwa'i tog ltar mchog gsum yar la bkur/ /zha long 'on lkugs g.yog por byams par gyis/ /za ma med pa'i dbul bor sbyin pa thongs/ /'a 'ur 'thab rtsod ma byed byas pa sdums/ /ya rabs bla dpon rgan la brtsi bkur gyis/ /ra lug g.yag gsum bsad nas chos ma bco/ /la lung ri khrod bsten pa'i sgom chen mchod/ /sha rkyang dgo sogs ri dwags rigs ma gsod/ /sa dzā phyag skor smyung gnas sdom pa srungs/ /ha cang rgas pa'i drin can pha dang ma/ /a khu gsum la rgyun du bsnyen bkur gyis/ /ka nas a yi bar gyi kha ta 'di/ /ka ring a bar the bu gsum la smras/ /a ma bzhag kyang 'gro kun a mar sgoms/ /yul phyogs spangs kyang gzhan gyi yul mang 'grims/ /bya ba btang kyang bza' btung bya ltar tshol/ /yar sdeb byas kyang kun gyis yar mchod pa'i/ /reb gong tshogs drug rang grol glu dbyangs 'di/ /thos tshad tshogs rnams gnas 200

skabs bde zhing skyid/ /bsod nams tshogs dang ye shes tshogs bsags nas/ /myur du tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas 'tshang rgya shog /ces smras pa'o//na mo gu ru/ mgo dang don snying 'dra ba'i/ /bla ma chos kyi rgyal po/ /rig 'dzin 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho/ /dag pa'i zhing du gshegs thal/ /yan lag nying lag 'dra ba'i/ /pha ma mched grogs yon bdag /la la shi bral byas song / /la la gson bral byas thal/ /mi med lung ba stong ba'i/ /brag khung skam po'i nang du/ /ban rgan rang nyid gcig pur/ /gzugs phung bzhin du lus thal/ /tshul de zhib tu bsams tshe/ /skyo shas shugs drag skye nas/ /mig nas mchi ma'i thigs pa/ /ma zung 'ga' re shor thal/ /da ni ma gyur 'gro ba'i/ /don du byang chub sems bskyed/ /ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su/ /tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms ya/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka 'tshengs pa'i/ /byang chub go 'phang thob na//bya btang pa nga'i dga' ba/ /ri khrod pa nga'i skyid pa/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis blangs pa'o//sa skya gzhal yas khang lta bu'i/ /steng du rgyal mtshan btsugs 'dra ba'i/ /rje btsun kun dga' rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byen gyes rlobs/ /mkhas pa yod bzhin de bsten 201

nas/ /yon tan mi slob sdod pa yi/ /mi de gdon gyis zin pa'am/ /yang na las kyis mnar ba yin/ /longs spyod yod bzhin rang spyod dam/ /gzhan la sbyin pa mi gtong na/ /mi de nad kyis btab pa 'am/ /yang na yi dwags mngon sum yin/ /spyod dam sbyin par min nus pa'i/ /nor de phyug bor bsgoms na ni/ /ri bo gser du bsgoms pa yis/ /phyug por bsgom pa shin tu sla/ /chos dang chos min shes pa yi/ /mkhas pa shin tu mang na yang / /shes nas nyams su len pa de/ /'jig rten 'di na shin tu dkon/ /bsod nams zad na sems ngan sgye/ /rigs rgyud zad na bu ngan skye/ /tshe zad pa la 'chi ltas 'byung / /ha cang shes rab che drags pas/ /bya ba mang na rang nyid brlag /rgyal po dran rgya che ba yis/ /rgyal srid nyams pa shin tu mang / /ha cang longs spyo da sog drags pas/ /nor ni rang gi gshed ma yin/ /phung krol phal cher phyug po la/ /'byung gi sprang bo bde bar rgyu/ /mkhas pas bya ba ci byed kyang / /rang gi bsod nams brtags te bya/ /rtsod dus sems can phun tshogs pa/ /skye bo brgya yi nang na dkon/ /rdzing ngan chu yis khengs pa na/ /phyogs gcig ci nas 'jig pa ltar/ /gang la nor dang ldan gyur na/ /de la rigs rgyud shin tu dkon/ /bu dang ldan na nor che dkon/ /202

nor dang ldan na dgra bos 'joms/ /thams cad 'dzoms na ring min du/ /mi de myur du 'chi ba mang / /des na mkhas pas bsod nams bsags/ /bsod nams kho na phun tshogs rgyu/ /mi rnams phal cher phun tshogs pa/ /de ni bsod nams bsags pa'i rtags/ /rdzun gyis pha rol bslus so zhes/ /snyam na rang nyid bslus pa yin/ /lan cig rdzun du smras pa des/ /bden par smras kyang dogs pa skye/ /blo ldan bya ba cung zad kyang / /rgyun du gros kyis bsgrub par bya/ /grub par gyur na smos ci dgos/ /ma 'grub na yang mdzes pa'i rgyu/ /sems can mos pa sna tshogs pas/ /thams cad mgu ba sus kyang dka'/ /rang nyid yon tan ldan byas na/ /thams cad mgu ba de la nye/ /shin tu rgas par gyur tshe yang / /thos pa mang bo bsags na bzang / /phyi mar thos pas phan pa tsam/ /sbyin pa btang bas phan pa min/ /skye bo dam pa dman pa yi/ /khyad par legs par shes nas ni/ /de gnyis bya ba sgrub shes pa/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i gzhi chen yin/ /mkhas pas rig pa ma bsgrims na/ /nyes pa 'byung la blo ldan gyis/ /rig pa rab tu bsgrims pa na/ /nyes pa 'byung ba'i go skabs dka'/ /rang nyid gang la mi dga' ba/ /gzhan la dus kun de mi bya/ /rang nyid dga' ba de gzhan la/ /byas na 203
