rang la gang dga' bya/ /gnyom chung rnams kyis rang gi gtam/ /nga smras thams cad 'khrul bar bsam/ /gtam rnams mang bo mi smra ba'i/ /mi la gzhan gyis bkur ba nye/ /bshad sa'i yul dang dus bab na/ /rab tu bsgrims te lan 'ga' smra/ /legs bshad yin yang mang gyur na/ /tshong zong lhag bzhin brin mi 'gyur/ /rang gi skyon ni mkhas pas kyang / /skyon du go ba shin tu dka'/ /mang bo rang la de smra na/ /skyon can min par shes par bya/ /shes kyang skyon de mi 'dod na/ /mi de gdon gyis btab pa yin/ /da dung gnyen po mi bsten na/ /cung zad bsam pa yod rnams kyis/ /skyon de myur du 'don par bya/ /de ltar gnyen pos skyon ston na/ /mi de je bzang je bzang 'gro/ /blun po log pa'i lam 'gro ba/ /blun po nyid du go bas chog /mkhas pa log pa'i lam 'gro na/ /rgyu mtshan gang zhig yin dpyad dgos/ /rang gis legs par shes na yang / /bya ba thams cad gros kyis sgrubs/ /mi gang gros la mi dga' ba/ /'gyod pa rin gyis nyos pa yin/ /g.yo can tshig gang smra ba la/ /drang bo de la brtag dpyad dgos/ /rang gis legs par shes na yang / /bya ba thams cad gros kyis sgrubs/ /mkhas pa dgra la rtag tu yang / /gnyen la byams ltar tshig 'jam smra/ /de yis 'dum la mi phan 204

yang / /nges par gnod sems 'ju ba'i sman/ /tshig ngan brjod pas 'jig rten na/ /'dod pa 'grub pa mi srid kyi/ /yid kyis rang gi don sgrub yang / /ngag gis kun dang mthun par gyis/ /rang dang gzhan gyi don bsgrub na/ /'jam rtsub ji ltar byas kyang rung / /thabs la mkhas pa'i spyod pa la/ /g.yo sgyu thub pas yin ma gsungs/ /byams pas khyab pa'i tshig smra ba/ /sgrub sla gzhan dga' dbang sdud mchog /nor gyes thams cad mgu mi nus/ /lus srog btang yang cher mi tshim/ /phongs kyang gdung ba bskyed mi bya/ /'byor kyang dga' bas dregs mi bya/ /skyid sdug gnyis ka dbyar dgun bzhin/ /mi rtag rim pas 'gyur nas 'gro/ /chog shes can gyi longs spyod ni/ /mi zad rtag tu bde zhing skyid/ /chog shes med pas nor 'tshol ba'i/ /mi la sdug bsngal char bzhin 'bab/ /nam dgos dus na len chog pa'i/ /nor ni sbyin par thub pas gsungs/ /bsags pa'i nor rnams sbrang rtsi bzhin/ /nam zhig tshe na gzhan gyis spyod/ /'jig rten 'di na bun btang ba/ /dngos po thob pa'i nges pa med/ /slong la sbyin na 'bad med par/ /chung yang brgya 'gyur thob pa yin/ /'jab la phyug po mi srid cing / /gtong ba dbul bor mi srid pas/ /'jungs pa nor dad chung 'dra/ /gtong ba 205

nor la rngam pa 'dra/ /bye ba stong phrag gter yod kyang/ /gzhan la cung zad gtong mi nus/ /de dag 'jig rten 'dir dbul zhes/ /thos mang rnams kyis de skad smra/ /za rgyu zan gcig med na yang / /gang yod gzhan la gtong phod pa/ /de dag 'jig rten nor chen zhes/ /yang dag gzigs pa rnams kyis gsungs/ /bu ni phyug po bya snyam nas/ /gang yod thams cad bu la ster/ /bu ngan la las nor rnams brlags/ /khye ldom bzhin du 'khyams pa mang / /pha mas bu la byams pa bzhin/ /bu yis pha mar byams pa min/ /pha mas bu tsha bskyang bskyangs nas/ /pha ma rgas na bu tshas brnyas/ /sred pa'i khol por gyur rnams kyis/ /srog dang bsdos nas nor phyir 'brang / /chog shes can rnams nor rnyed kyang / /rnyed tshad skye bo gzhan la ster/ /de ltar byen pas bsod nams thob/ /pha rol tshims na dga' ba sgoms/ /dga' ba bsgoms pas bsod nams gang / /bsags pa gong nas gong du 'phel/ /khro na de la bzod pa sgoms/ /bzod pa bsgoms pas phyi ma ru/ /gzugs mdzes yid 'ong mi ru skye/ /des na sbyin la 'bad par bya/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i snod gyur pa'i//lus 'di dgra dang 'dra mod kyi/ /blo dang ldan na 'di nyid ni/ /bsod nams gsog pa'i rten du bzang / /kun mkhyen sa skya padhi 206

tar/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /parnyi yi byen rlabs kyis//thos tshad rgyud la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis sa skya pani ta'i gsung bzhin rang gzhan la phan phyir smras pa'o//bod yul gangs ri lta bu na/ /srab med seng ge 'phyo 'dra ba'i//rje btsun mi la ras pa la//gsol ba 'debs so byen gyis rlobs/ /lto gos tshe 'di blos btang nas//gangs rdza g.ya' dang nags tshal sogs/ /dben pa'i gnas su gcig pu ru/ /dam chos nyams su len pa'i tshe/ /re 'ga' gos bzang gyon na 'dod/ /gos bzang gyon na 'dod pa'i tshe/ /gos su ngan ngon dug hrul gyon/ /'jam legs sgyu ma lta bur ltos/ /res 'ga' zas zhim zos na 'dod//zas zhim zos na 'dod pa'i tshe/ /ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes gyis/ /zhim mngar sgyu ma lta bur ltos/ /res 'ga' nor rdzas gsog na 'dod/ /nor rdzas gsog na 'dod pa'i tshe//nor ni 'phags pa'i nor bdun gsogs//nor rdzas sgyu ma lta bur ltos//res 'ga' yul du song na 'dod//yul du song na 'dod pa'i tshe//yul ni chos dbyings pho brang zungs//pha yul sgyu ma lta bur ltos/ /res 'ga' pha mar phrad na 'dod//pha mar phrad na 'dod pa'i tshe/ /'gro kun drin can pha mar sgoms/ /pha ma sgyu ma lta bur ltos/ /res 'ga' grogs dang 207

'grogs na 'dod/ /grogs dang 'grogs na 'dod pa'i tshe/ /grogs su bya dang ri dwags 'grogs//grogs rnams sgyu ma lta bur ltos/ /res 'ga' bla mar mjal na 'dod/ /bla mar mjal na 'dod pa'i tshe//'bral med spyi bo snying dbus sgoms/ /bla ma sgyu ma lta bur ltos/ /zla med mi la ras pa la//gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs//mi la ras pa'i byen rlabs kyis//ri ba gsar bar phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//rwa sgreng lha yul lta bu na/ /dpag bsam ljon shing rgyas 'dra ba'i//'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas la//gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /spyir ni nyon mongs dbang gis las/ /bsags nas 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin/ /sgos su khong khro 'di nyid kyis/ /dge rtsa dpag tu med pa 'joms/ /byang chub sems dpa' nang phan tshun/ /khros na bskal brgya'i dge 'joms shing / /gzhi nas lam la slob dgos gsungs/ /phal ba byang chub sems dpa' la/ /zhe sdang skad cig gcig skyes na//'khor los sgyur rgyal thob pa yang / /skad cig nyid la 'joms par gsungs / /nyon mongs dgra yi nang 'di na/ /zhe sdang dgra las 'jigs pa med/ /'di yis sdang byas dge rtsa 'phrog /phyi mar ngan 'gro'i gnas su 'phen/ /phal cher dmyal ba'i gnas su 208

bskyur/ /yi dwags gnas su skyes na yang //gzhan la gnod pa'i rgyal 'gong dang / /dri gshed la sogs gdon chen po/ /'jigs su rung bar skye ba yin//skabs re dud 'gror skyes na yang //sbal sbrul sdom sdig stag dred dang / /glag khra chu srin sogs su skye/ /mi ru skyes kyang mdog mi mdzes/ /sdig spyod bshan pa sogs su skye/ /lhar skyes lha ma yin la 'thab/ /lha min skyes kyang lha dang 'thab/ /gang du skyes kyang sngon goms kyi/ /khong khro'i bag chags mthug po des//zhe sdang shin tu che ba yin//zhe sdang 'dra ba'i nyon mongs med//lhag par snyigs ma'i dus skabs 'dir//mi rnams zhe sdang che ba yin/ /zhe sdang dgra 'di gzhom 'dod na/ /bzo da pa'i go khrab lus la gyon/ /byams pa'i mdung ring lag thogs nas/ /zhe sdang dgra yi snying du thobs/ /zhe sdang dgra 'di thul gyur na/ /dgra rnams thams cad bsad pa yin/ /dpa' bo khrom gshog de la zer/ /bzod pa byams sems can gyi mir/ /lha mi kun gyis byams pa dang / /dgra rnams thams cad gnyen du 'gyur/ /phyi mar lha 'am mi ru skye/ /gzugs byad phun sum tshogs par 'gyur/ /zhe sdang skyes pa'i nyes dmigs dang / /bzod pa byams pa'i phan yon rnams/ /sogs la zhe sdang dgra bo rnams/ /byung dus 'bur 'joms byed pa gces/ /'brom ston rgyal ba'i 209

'byung gnas la/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas byen rlabs kyis/ /'gro kun zhe sdang zhi bar shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//chos rnams gang gsung dpe don gnyis//'brel nas 'chad la rab mkhas pa'i/ /rje btsun chen po po to bar/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /dper na chu bo chen po la/ /brgal na gru yod dus brgal dgos/ /med na brgal thabs med pa bzhin/ /'khor ba sdug bsngal chu chen la//dal 'byor mi lus gru yod thog /brgal dgos med na brgal thabs med/ /de yang 'khor ba chu chen 'dra//dal 'byor mi lus gru dang 'dra/ /rig pa mgron po nyid dang 'dra/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen skya ba ni/ /'dzin pa'i gru ba rnams dang 'dra/ /da res thams cad 'dzom thog la/ /pha rol ci sgrol byed dgos gsungs/ /rang gi mdun gyi sa gseb nas/ /srin bu zhig thon thal mo sbyar//sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal zer ba zhig /byung na ngo mtshar che ba bzhin/ /ngan song gsum sogs mi khom pa'i/ /gnas su sngon chad 'khyam 'khyams nas/ /da res mi lus thob pa 'di/ /de bas da dung ngo mtshar che/ /byang gi gru gu zha'u che/ /zer ba'i mi zhig rkyang la zhon/ /glu dbyangs kho na len pa la/ /gnas kyis khyod ni 'di tsam gyi/ /glu 210

dbyangs len pa ci yin zhes/ /dris pa'i tshe na kho na re/ /nga ni rkyang la zhon dus 'dir/ /glu mi len na nam len zhes/ /smras pa bzhin du dal 'byor lus/ /thob dus dam chos mi byed na/ /nam byed dam chos thob skabs yin/ /gtsang ba'i ar pa tshan gcig gis/ /dbus su nya yi tshod ma byas/ /zos pas gcig gi nad la brgyab/ /skyugs ki snyam nas lham sgog gis/ /rke bsdam dus su gnas mo yis/ /khyod de byed pa ci yin zhes/ /dris tshe skyug tu 'phangs pa zhig /skyugs kyis dogs nas rke bsdams zhes/ /smras bzhin 'chi ru 'phangs pa yi/ /dal 'byor mi lus thob pa 'di/ /chos med 'chi la 'phangs dgos gsungs/ /yang sngon mu ge chen po zhig /byung dus dbus su mi ltogs pa/ /bza' tshan gcig gis nangs ma gcig /'u cag ha cang sdug che 'dug /da nangs zan 'chang re za zer/ /zos pas byis pa gcig yod pas/ /kho rang zan de rgyab tu sbas/ /pha yi zan la zos pa'i bar/ /khye zhig yod pas zan rgyab tu/ /sbas pa khyer bas byis pa yis/ /rgya ma lan cig sne zan ni/ /khyi la shor zer ngus pa bzhin/ /rgya ma lan cig rnyed pa yi//dal 'byor mi lus chos med par//shi na de dang 'dra'o gsungs/ /dper na dgra spun sa mtshams kyi/ /sa mkhar btsan po dgrar shor na/ /yul khams thams cad phung bar 211

byed/ /mkhar de spun gyis thob gyur na/ /yul gyi gtan srid zin pa ltar/ /da re dal 'byor mi lus 'di//mi dge'i phyogs su shor gyur na/ /dmyal ba mnar med gnas su bskyur/ /dge ba'i phyogs la 'bad gyur na/ /mngon mtho nges legs gang yang thob/ /da re dge la 'bad byas nas/ /dal 'byor don ldan zhig byed dgos/ /dper na gser snod rin po che//sna tshogs spras pa de'i nang du/ /kha zas la sogs rab gtsang zhing / /yid du 'ong ba mi ldug par/ /ngan skyugs la sogs mi gtsang ba/ /blugs bzhin mi khom gnas rnams nas/ /bskal ba brgyad khrir btsal na yang / /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor mi lus 'di/ /rnyed dus dam chos mi byed par/ /tshe 'di'i che thabs sgrub pa'i phyir/ /sdig pa mi dge'i las ngan pa/ /sna tshogs spyod pa de dang 'dra/ /dal 'byor chud zos song ba yin/ /tshe rabs gtan du bde ba'i rgyu//dam chos rnam dag ma byas na/ /ma shi tshun chad bde ba dang / /sdug bsngal sel ba'i thabs tsam la//brtson pa dud 'gro la yang yod/ /mi lus thob kyang dud 'gro yin/ /da re mi dang dud 'gro yi/ /khyad par shes pa zhig byed dgos/ /dper na rin po che'i gling du/ /phyin na lag stong mi 'ong bar/ /rin chen ci thub khyer 'ong bzhin/ /da re mi lus thob dus 'dir//chos med lag stong 212

mi 'chi bar/ /ci thub dam pa'i chos byas nas/ /mi lus thob pa don dang bcas/ /nom pa bcas pa zhig byed dgos/ /snyam du nyin dang mtshan med par//dam pa'i chos la 'bad par mdzod//rje btsun chen po po to bar/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /rje btsun po to'i byin rlabs kyis/ /thos tshad rgyud la phan thogs shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//skye 'chi mi mnga' o rgyan dang / /ngo mtshar dzu 'phrul sna tshogs pa/ /ston mkhas rje 'bangs nyer lnga la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /tshes bcu bzung ba'i phan yon ni/ /cung zad tsam zhig bdag gis bshad/ /dad can skye bo pho mo nyon/ /yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i nyi ma der/ /o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas nyid/ /lho nub srin po'i yul phyogs kyi/ /zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo nas/ /nyi zer mdangs la chibs te byon/ /bod khams sems can bde skyid la/ /gzigs nas 'gal rkyen bar chad bsal/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub gnang / /dad mos las can gang zag la/ /mngon sum zhal bstan zab chos gsungs/ /yar ngo'i tshes bcu bzung ba rnams/ /dpon slob yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sel/ /khyad par snang srid lha 'dre yis/ /gnod 'tshe byas pa 213

thams cad sel/ /sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe dang bsod nams klung rta dang / /snyan grags phyogs bcur rgyas par byed/ /tshes bcu'i nyin par o rgyan gyi/ /'dra skur rdul phyis sus brgyab na/ /sgrib gnyis dag nas sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams grangs med mthong / /tshes bcu'i nyin par 'dug spos dang / /me tog mar me lha bshos sogs/ /mchod pa bzang bo sus phul ba/ /tshe 'dir zas nor longs spyod 'phel/ /phyi mar gzugs bzang gzi brjid che/ /bsod nams can du skye bar 'gyur/ /tshes bcur tshogs pa thams cad la/ /bza' ba bzang bo sus drangs na/ /sgye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang ma thob par/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i zas mchog dang / /ting 'dzin zas kyis 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /btung ba zhim po sus phul ba/ /skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang ma thob par/ /skom pas gdung bar mi 'gyur zhing / /btung ba zhim po thob par 'gyur/ /ba dan gdugs dang bla bre dang / /snyan dar bzang bo sus phul ba/ /skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang ma thob bar/ /'jam mdzes dro ba'i gos gyon 'gyur/ /der tshogs sngags pa a mchod la/ /khri gdan 'bul dang bsu skyel byas/ /skye ba 'di 214

dang skye ba gzhan/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang ma thob bar mthon po'i rigs su skye ba dang / /gzhan gyis mchod cing bkur bar 'gyur/ /tshes bcu lan gcig tsam bzung na/ /bskal ba khri phrag gcig tsam la/ /bsags pa'i sdig pa kun dag nas/ /phyi ma rig 'dzin sa thob cing / /gzhan yang tshes bcu lan gcig tsam/ /bzung na bskal ba grangs med gsum/ /sdig pa dag nas phyi ma ru/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gral du skye/ /kun gyi tshogs dpon byed nges zhes/ /o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas gsungs/ /gzhan yang o rgyan pad+ma la/ /mos shing gsol ba btab pa dang / /mchod cing tshes bcu bzung ba rnams / /shi na bar do'i gnas skabs su/ /rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i bsu ba 'ong zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo yi/ /o rgyan bzhugs pa'i drung du khrid/ /zhal mthong gsung thos sgrib pa 'dag /de nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yis/ /mdun nas bsus te mkha' skyod dam/ /gang 'dod zhing khams rnams su khrid/ /sangs rgyas zhing gi pad+mo ru/ /skyes nas byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /tshes bcu 'dra ba'i chos shig med/ /tshes bcu bzung ba'i phan yon ni/ /bshad na brjod kyis mi lang ngo / /de phyir tshes bcu 'dzin pa kun/ /dga' zhing spro bas ja bzang thongs/ /tshes bcu nyams pa thams cad kyis/ /215

slar yang gsos nas gang legs gyes/ /tshes bcur 'tshogs pa'i sngags 'chang dang / /a mchod rnams kyis nyin gcig pur/ /'grig lam kun spyod la sogs pas/ /dad can dang ba 'dren par gyis/ /ha cang chang mang 'thung ba dang / /du ba 'then dang 'khon 'dzing sogs/ /mi dad spyod pa thams cad spongs/ /badz+ra gu ru mi tshig gis/ /bar mi chod par bzlas gyur na/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyi/ /byin rlabs dbang med 'jug par gsungs/ /de phyir lab lob ma mang bar cho ga gu ru le'u bdun dang / /badz+ra gu ru mi tshig gis/ /bar ma chod par bzla bar gyis/ /tshes bcu chos shig min snyam nas/ /khral du bsams nas za ma dang //ja mar ngan ngon tsam byed pa//blun po tha shal yin pa'i rtags/ /tshes bcu bzung la phan yon ni/ /yod pa shes bzhin brnyas bcos byas/ /tshes bcu bzang bo mi 'dzin pa'i/ /mi de gdon gyis zin pa'am/ /yang na yi dwags skye mtha' yin/ /tshes bcur gnod 'tshe byed pa kun/ /o rgyan pad+mas bslu bar 'gyur/ /snang srid lha 'dres za kha zug /mi kha gram mchus rgyun du sdang / /phyi mar ngan song gnas su sgye/ /de phyir 'gal rkyen ma byed cig /tshes bcu'i mthun rkyen bsgrub pa la/ /gong du bshad pa'i phan yon rnams/ /'byung bar yid gnyis the tshom 216

med//de phyir khyim pa dad can tsho//khyed rnams lag len thub pa yi//tshegs chung phan yon shin tu che/ /tshes bcu'i mthun rkyen ci thub zhig /'chi rag bar du 'bad par gyis/ /o rgyan rje 'bangs nyer lnga la/ /gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /o rgyan rje 'bangs byin rlabs dang/ /bdag gi bsam rnam dag mthus/ /grong gi sngags pa a mchod sogs/ /dad can pho mo thams cad la/ /phan pa dpag med thob gyur nas/ /tshes bcu legs par bzung ba'i mthus/ /tshe 'di'i 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi/ /tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba dang //phyi mar dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /sgyes nas byang chub thob par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//bod yul skye dgu thams cad la/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba las lhag pa'i/ /bka' drin che ba'i jo bo la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe rabs 'khor ba thog med nas//tha ma da lta thug gi bar/ /'khor ba spyi dang khyad par du/ /ngan song sdug bsngal bsam mi khyab/ /myong 'dug da dung sdug bsngal gyi/ /mtha' yang rtogs par dka' bar 'dug /da re dal 'byor mi lus kyi/ /gru chen rnyed pa'i dus skabs 'dir/ /'jigs rung 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las nges par thar thabs chos bya dgos//de yi rgyu mtshan 217

sngon bsags kyi/ /dge ba'i mthu zhig la brten nas/ /da re stabs ka yag pa zhig /'phrod nas dal 'byor mi lus thob/ /dbang bo sgo lnga legs par tshang //dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzang bor phrad/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa la yang mjal/ /chos gang byed kyang rang dbang yod//byed thabs shes pa'i dus skabs 'dir/ /'khor ba'i gnas nas thar nges pa'i/ /dam chos rnam dag cig byed dgos//phyin chad 'di 'dra'i dal 'byor gye//lus rten shin tu rnyed par dka'/ /dal 'byor byas pa'i don gang yin/ /zer na mi khom gnas brgyad dang / /bral bas dal ba zer ba yin/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen du/ /rang 'byor lnga dang gzhan 'byor lnga/ /bcu tshang bas na 'byor ba zer/ /mi khom brgyad ni gang yin na/ /dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang / /kla klo tshe ring lha dang ni/ /log lta sangs rgyas kyis stongs pa/ /lkugs pa 'di dag mi khom brgyad/ /'byor ba bcu ni gang yin na/ /mi nyid dbus skyes dbang bo tshang / /las mtha' ma log gnas la dad/ /'di lnga rang la yod stabs kyis/ /rang gi 'byor ba zer ba yin//sangs rgyas byon dang des chos gsung / /ston pa gnas dang de'i rjes 'jug /gzhan phyir snying nas brtse ba'o/ /'di lnga rang gi dam chos ni/ /sgrub pa'i cha rkyen yin na yang / /gzhan gye rgyud la 218

yod stabs kyis/ /gzhan gyi 'byor ba zer ba yin/ /de 'dra'i dal 'byor mi lus 'di/ /shin tu rnyed par dka' tshul ni/ /spyir ni bde 'gro tsam zhig gi /lus thob pa la tshul khrims sogs/ /dge ba sna gcig tsam byed dgos//khyad par dal 'byor mi lus shig /thob la tshul khrims rnam dag gis/ /gzhi bzung sbyin pa la sogs pa'i//grogs byas smon lam dri med kyis//mtshams sbyor ba sogs dge ba'i las/ /mang bo 'joms nas thob dgos na/ /ngan song gsum na sdug bsngal gyes/ /gzir bas dge sems tsam skyes dka'//lha rnams thams cad ting 'dzin dang //'dod bdes g.yengs pas dge sgrub dka'/ /mi la dam chos ma dar bas/ /dge ba zer ba'i sgra tsam yang / /thos dka'i yul ni dpe bzhag na/ /nas kyi phung bo'i tshod tsam du/ /byas na dam chos dar ba'i yul/ /nas 'bru gcig tsam tshod du snang / /dam chos dar ba'i yul phyogs ni/ /da lta rang re bod lta bur/ /mtshon na skye bo khri phrag gcig /'tshogs pa'i khrod na tshul khrims ni//bsrung ba'i mi ni shin tu nyung / /tshul khrims bsrungs kyang sbyin gtong sogs/ /dge ba sgrub pa shin tu dkon/ /dge ba bsgrubs kyang mir sgye ba'i/ /smon lam 'debs pa de bas dkon/ /rgyu de gsum ka tshang ba ni//nyin par skar ma bzhin du dkon//rang la dpyad 219

na dge ba'i las/ /gtsang ma blo bde nges pa zhig /nyi ma gcig tsam byas pa yang / /mi dran dge ba'i grangs ni nyung //sdig pa mi dge zhar zhor la/ /nyin re bzhin du bsags pa yang / /rgyal po chen po'i dkor mdzod bzhin/ /gang la bltas na bsags 'dug pas/ /da re tshe zhabs 'di nyid la/ /gtan bde'i btsan sa zin pa'i thabs/ /dam chos rnam dag ma byas na//phyin chad mi lus thob mi 'gyur/ /thob mod snyam pa'i bsam pa 'di/ /dbyed dus sa bon ma btab par/ /ston gyi dus su lo legs po/ /'ong snyam zor ba brdar ba 'dra/ /dper na stong gsum stong chen po'i/ /'jig rten khams 'di thams cad ni/ /rgya mtsho chen po de'i gting na/ /rus sbal mig med long ba gcig /lo ni brgya brgya'i 'phro nas mtsho//de yi kha ru lan re 'ongs//rgya mtsho chen po de'i kha na/ /gser gyi gnya' shing bug pa gcig /can zhig shar gyi rlung gis ded/ /nub tu 'phyo zhing nub rlung gis/ /ded nas shar gyi phyogs su 'phyo//de bzhin phyogs mtshams thams cad kyi//rlung gis ded nas 'phyo ba de'i//bu gar rus sbal mgrin pa ni//chud dam mi chud sangs rgyas kyis/ /'khor la gsungs pas 'khor rnams kyis/ /rgya mtsho'i kha ni chung na chud/ /srid kyis rgya mtsho'i kha de che//gser gyi gnya' shing bu ga mang //rtag tu phyogs 220

gcig bsdad na chud/ /srid kyi bu ga gcig min med/ /rlung gis ded nas phyogs kun 'phyo/ /rus sbal rgyun du mi sdod par/ /rgya mtsho'i kha ru yang yang 'ong / /mig dang ldan na chu srid kyis/ /lo brgya thengs re las mi 'ong / /mig med phyir ro zhes zhus so/ /mi khom brgyad nas dal 'byor gyi/ /mi lus thob pa de dang mtshungs/ /gyang log ngos la sran ma ni/ /gtor na chags pa dkon pa bzhin//mi lus thob pa de dang 'dra//rnga yi steng du nam mkha' nas//sran ma spar gang gtor gyur na/ /steng du chags pa dkon pa bzhin/ /mi lus thob pa de dang 'dra/ /dal 'byor mi lus de 'dra zhig /thob par dka' na mi mang gi /snyam na 'gro ba gzhan grangs la/ /ma bsam pa yin dbyar dus su/ /srin bu shin tu mang ba'i dus//sa gzhi phyar ba tsam zhig gi /steng na dud 'gro chung ngu ni/ /brtsis na grangs kyis mi lang yod/ /grog tshang chen po zhig la yang //yul grong zhig gi mi las mang //lung phran zhig gi srin bu la/ /bod yul mi yi grangs tsam yod/ /dud 'gro kha 'thor 'di rnams las//dud 'gro byengs na gnas pa mang / /dmyal bar gnas pa'i sems can ni/ /mtshan mo'i skar ma'i tshod tsam du/ /byas na yi dwags nyin skar tsam/ /yi dwags mtshan mo'i skar mchi tshod/ /tsam du byas na dud 'gro byings//gnas pa 221

nyin mo'i skar ma tsam/ /dud 'gro byings nas mtshan skar gyi/ /tshod du byas na kha 'thor gyi/ /dud 'gro nyin mo'i skar ma tsam /dud 'gro kha 'thor mtshan skar gyi//tshod du byas na mi rnams ni//nyin mo'i skar ma tsam yin gsungs//de tsam dal 'byor mi lus 'di/ /rnyed par dka' ba ci'i phyir yin/ /zer na mi lus thob pa'i rgyu/ /dge ba rnam dag bsgrub pa nyung / /ngan 'gror skye rgyu mi dge ba/ /bsgrub pa mang ba'i stabs kyis dka'/ /gal te ngan 'gror skye na yang / /las ngan zad nas slar yang ma'i//lus thob los 'ong mi dka'o/ /snyam na ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal ni/ /myong zhing skabs skabs sdig las byed/ /ngan 'gro'i gnas nas shi 'phos kyang / /slar yang ngan 'gro'i gnas su skye//mi lus thob pa phar la zhog /bde 'gro'i sgra yang thos pa dka'/ /ngan 'gro'i gnas nas shi 'phos te//de ru skyes pa sa rdul 'dra//bde 'gror skyes pa phyag sen gye/ /rtse mos blangs pa'i sa rdul dang / /'dra zhes thub pa'i zhal nas gsungs/ /rnyed par dka' ba tsam ma zad/ /rnyed na don yang shin tu che//mo gsham bu dang ri bong gi /rwa bzhin rnyed par dka' na yang / /brgya la rnyed kyang ltad mo tsam/ /blta ba ma rtogs don re chung / /dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi lus ni/ /rnyed na de 'dra ma yin par/ /'di la brten nas dam 222

pa'i chos/ /byas na mngon mtho lha'am mi'i/ /go 'phang 'di la brten nas thob/ /nyan thos rang rgyal go 'phang yang / /'di la brten nas thob par nus / /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang 'di la brten nas thob/ /nus pas yid bzhin nor las lhag /yid bzhin nor bu zas gos sogs/ /longs spyod 'byung yang de lta bu'i/ /go 'phang thob pa'i nus pa med/ /des na da re yid bzhin gyi/ /nor bu las lhag dal 'byor gyi/ /mi lus yang yang rnyed dka' ba//rnyed nas bla ma dam pa bsten/ /zab mo'i gdams pa rang nyams su/ /len pa'i skal ba ldan pa la/ /dper na rabs chad bza' mi la//bu skyes pa dang dbul bo yis//nor bu rnyed ltar dga' ba dang //spro ba bskyed nas tshe 'di yi//'khor dang nye du longs spyod sogs/ /gang la ma chags thar ba yi/ /lam sna zin thabs dam chos la/ /dal khom re 'jog mi byed par//nyin mtshan med par 'bad par gyis//mnyam med jo bo chen po la//gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs/ /jo bo chen po'i byen rlabs kyis/ /thos tshad sems la phan par shog /cesapa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//lo ni dgu brgya dgu bcu bzhugs//o rgyan phebs pa'i lung bstan gsung / /mkhan chen bo dhi sa twa la//gsol ba 'debs so 223

byin gyes rlobs/ /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor mi lus thob/ /phrad dka'i bla ma dam par phrad/ /zhugs par dka' ba'i chos sgor zhugs/ /shes par dka' ba'i blang dor shes/ /thar dka'i 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /thar nas byang chub gling du 'gro/ /thub pa'i mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa 'di/ /pho sgo mo sgos thob pa min//phywa dang dbang phyug gis thob min/ /nor bo che yis nyos pa min/ /rtsal stobs che nas 'phrog pa min/ /mkhas pas thabs kyis blangs pa min/ /tshe sngon tshul khrims rnam dag bsrungs/ /tshogs bsags smon lam btab pa'i mthus/ /byung ba yin pas phyin chad ni/ /'di 'dra'i mthun rkyen tshang mi srid/ /da res brtson 'grus shugs bskyed nas/ /dam pa'i chos la 'bad dgos te/ /gal te chos la ma 'bad na/ /ded dpon rin po che'i gling nas/ /lag stong 'ong ba las kyang blun/ /srog dang ma bral na yang ro/ /'dre yis ma khyer smyon pa yin/ /mi rnams bsam blo yod med dang / /grung mi grung dang sbyang mi spyang / /pho rgod mi rgod da res shes/ /da res mi lus rin po che/ /chud zos stong log ma song bar/ /tshe rabs gtan du bde skyid pa'i/ /so nam dam pa'i chos bsgrubs na/ /grung po spyang bo rgod po yin/ /da res chos shig ma byas na/ /khog na don snying med pa 'am//yang na smyo 'tshab che ba yin//rang 224

gis rang nyid bslus pa yin/ /rang gis rang mgo bskor ba yin//rang gis rang nyid phung ba yin/ /rin chen gser gyi gling phyin nas/ /lag pa stong bar mi 'ong ltar/ /dam chos dar ba'i sar skyes nas//dam pa'i lha chos byed gal che//da res dam chos nyams blangs nas//mi lus thob pa don ldan zhig /mdzad dgos nam 'chi cha yang med/ /glo bur shi na ci zhig bya/ /snyam du dam chos bsgrub pa la/ /ga le sos dal mi byed par/ /da lta nyid du 'bad par mdzod/ /mkhan chen bo rnyi sa twa la//gsol ba btab nas glu 'di blangs//bo dhi sa twa'i byen rlabs kyis//kun gyis lha chos bsgrub par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o// chos kun tu bzang bo dang / /longs sku rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang / /sprul sku shākya thub pa sogs//phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams/ /gar bzhugs zhing nas gnas 'dir byon/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' 'od klong / /pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs/ /smon lam 'grub pa'i dbang bo mdzod/ /bdag gis 'dis mtshon dus gsum du/ /bsags pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang / /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /rgyal ba'i bstan pa ma dar yul/ /dar kyang nyams pa'i yul phyogs su / /bdag gis bshad dang 225

sgrub pa yi/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs par shog /rgyal ba sras bcas gsung bzhin du//bdag gis mgur dbyangs blangs rnams kyis/ /dngos sam brgyud nas bstan 'gro la//phan thogs rgya chen 'byung bar shog /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyis//bla med byang chub bsgrub pa la//'gal rkyen bar chad med pa dang / /mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs par shog /lam bzang bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen bsgrubs/ /'gal rkyen bar chad sel rnams/ /skye ba kun tu rnam dag gi /lam dang 'bral bar ma gyur cig /bdag ni nam zhig sangs rgyas tshe/ /sems can spyi dang khyad par du/ /'brel thogs kun gye thog mar drangs/ /'khor gyi thog mar 'gyur bar shog /bdag ni mthong thos dran reg kun//tshe 'dir tshe dang bsod nams rgyas/ /phyi mar mngon mtho lha mi 'am//nges legs thar ba'i bde thob shog /mdor na sems can thams cad la/ /gter chen bum bzang dpag bsam shing / /nor bu nyi ma ji bzhin du//bdag gis phan pa cher thogs shog /rgyal ba sras bcas byen rlabs dang //chos nyid bden pa'i nus mthu dang //bdag gi lhag bsam rnam dag mthus//smon lam ci btab myur 'grub shog /ces pa 'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis lhag bsam dag pas smon lam btab pa'o//226

sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams nas/ /skad cig yud tsam gnas 'dir byon/ /mdun mkhar 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba'i klong / /sprin phung gtibs pa lta bur bzhugs//rgyal khams spyi dang khyad par du//gangs can bod yul mi phyugs rnams/ /rtag tu bde zhing skyid pa'i phyir/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid bdun/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad bdud rtsi dang / /a ru rnam rgyal la sogs pa'i/ /gang la gang 'dod char 'bebs shing / /rol mo du ma'i sgra dang bcas/ /shis brjod glu dbyangs sgog par gyur/ /bla ma yid dam bkra shis shog /sangs rgyas byang sems bkra shis shog /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis shog /chos skyong srung ma'i bkra shis shog /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje sku yi bkra shis shog /tshangs dbyangs gsung gi bkra shis shog /'khrul med thugs kyi bkra shis shog /long ba rnams kyis mig gis mthong / /'on pa'i rna bas sgra thos shing //sbrum mas bu dang bu mo gang //gnod med btsa' ba'i bkra shis shog /dbul bo zas gos nor med rnams/ /zas gos nor rnams rnyed pa dang //yid chad yid sos mya ngan can//dga' ba rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /skrag rnams 'jigs med bcings pa 227

grol//mthu med mthu ldan mgron po rnams//lam skabs bde zhing don rnams kun/ /bsam bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /gru dang gru chen zhugs pa rnams/ /chu yi ngo ngogs su bder phyin cing / /mya ngam lam gol mgron por phrad/ /bde blag bgrod pa'i bkra shis shog /longs spyod phun sum tshogs ldan zhing / /phan tshun 'thab rtsod med pa dang / /lha yi yul bzhin sems can kun/ /bsam bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /char chu dus su 'bab pa dang / /lo tog phun sum tshogs pa 'khrungs/ /sman rnams nus mthu dang ldan nas/ /nad kun sel ba'i bkra shis shog /rgyal blon chos bzhin byed pa dang / /mkha' 'gro srin po la sogs pa/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub kyi/ /sems dang ldan pa'i bkra shis shog /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas//bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe brtan/ /dge 'dun phan tshun thugs mthun zhing / /chos bzhin byed pa'i bkra shis shog /sems can thams cad tshe ring zhing / /bsod nams klung rta snyan grags rgyas/ /sdig pas spangs nas dge ba'i las/ /rtag tu byed pa'i bkra shis shog /sgos su gangs can bod yul gyi/ /sa bcud nyams pa slar 'phel nas/ /mi phyugs rdzogs ldan dus bzhin du/ /bde zhing skyid pa'i bkra shis shog /yang sgos yul 'di'i mi 228

phyugs kun/ /nyin mo gang du song yang bde/ /mtshan mo gang du nyal yang bde/ /rtag tu bde ba'i bkra shis shog /mdor na 'gro kun sdug bsngal dang / /sdug bsngal rgyu dang bral gyur nas/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i bde ba dang / /bde rgyu ldan pa'i bkra shis shog /sangs rgyas go 'phang ma thob bar//rmi lam du yang sdug mi myong //zag bcas lha mi'i bde ba dang / /'bral ba med pa'i bkra shis shog /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang rin po che thob nas/ /zag med thar ba'i bde skyid la/ /'brel med spyod pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun zhabs dkar rdo rje 'chang chen pos mchog dman bar ma'i gdul byar gang la gang 'tsham gyi rdo rje'i mgur dpag tu med pa bzhengs pa yi ger 'khod pa'i nang tshan las mtsho snying dben pa'i dga' tshal nas dad can yon bdag pho mo rnams la gdams pa'i skor te gsum pa'o//229

mtsho snying ma hā de ba nas yul phyogs gdul byas zhus lan chab shog gi skor/na mo gu ru/ phun tshogs tshogs gnyis kyis bskrun sku mchog mtshan dpe'i dpal du 'bar//gsung snyan snyan 'jebs tshangs dbyangs chos sgras 'jig rten gsum po 'gengs/ /zab gsal gsal stong thugs ni srid zhir mi gnas chos kun gzigs/ /pha ma ma gyur 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig chos rgyal gtsug gis mchod/ /dngos brgyud bla ma'i byen rlabs chu 'dzin 'gro bla'i mkha' dbyengs spros/ /yi dam zhi khro'i dngos grub rnam gnyis char gyi rgyun bzang phab/ /mkha' 'gro srung ma'i 'phrin las rnam bzhis gdul bya'i zhing sa bkram/ /phan bde'i lo yag snye mas re ltos 'gro kun tshim mdzod kye/ /spyir na lus can gang gis rang nyid mthong thos dran reg dang / /'dra sku mthong dang mgur dbyangs thos tshad ngan song skye sgo khegs/ /bde 'gro thar ba'i gru gzings la brten rnam mkhyen nor bu'i gling //ring min bde blag bgrod par sras bcas rgyal bas byen gyis rlobs/ /sgos su skye bar 'brel ba'i bla ma mched lcam yon bdag gis/ /brtse gdung dag 230

snang dad pa'i sgo nas bka' mchid ri mo'i skyes/ /bstsal ba'i mchid lan spros pa 'dis kyang bstan dang 'gro ba la/ /phan thogs 'byung bar rtsa gsum lha yi dngos grub char du bsnyil/ /tshul bzhin nyams su len pa'i slob ma yang slob thams cad la//dam can chos skyong dkar phyogs lha yi byang chub ma thob bar/ /lus dang dri bzhin 'grogs la lam mchog sgrub la nyer 'tshe'i rigs/ /gtan nas brlag pa'i 'phrin las nam yang g.yel med mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//phyogs rnams kun gsal gyi rin chen brag steng na/ /bya btang rnal 'byor ngas dga' spro'i rgyang glu 'then//sa chu rab tu dros myu gu 'khrungs pa yis/ /skye 'gro thams cad la dga' spro'i nyi ma shar/ /g.yu 'brug sngon mo yis gsung snyan bsgrags pa yis//rma bya thams cad la dga' spro'i nyi ma shar/ /zim bu'i sbrang char de dal bus babs pa yis/ /khu byug thams cad la dga' spro'i nyi ma shar/ /khu byug skad snyan de lhang lhang bsgrags pa yis/ /mi rnams thams cad la dga' spro'i nyi ma shar/ /'ja' tshon ri mo de lam lam shar ba'i tshe/ /byes pa thams cad la dga' spro'i nyi ma shar/ /sngo ljang rtsi shing dang me tog rgyas pa yis/ /'brog pa thams cad la dga' spro'i nyi ma shar/ /lo legs 231

phun tshogs kyi snye ma 'khrungs pa yis/ /zhing ba thams cad la dga' spro'i nyi ma shar/ /dbyar zas zwa chod dang shing 'bras smin pa yis/ /ri ba thams cad la dga' spro'i nyi ma shar/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dbyar dus shig tu phyi rol tu khams gseng byas pas snang ba spro ba'i shugs kyis rba rlabs chal chil g.yo zhing chu bya dar dir sgrog pa'i mtsho snying dben pa'i dga' tshal lho yi brag steng zhig nas blangs pa'o//dbyings khyab gdal chos sku'i lha lam du/ /byams brtse ba'i chu 'dzin rab dkrigs nas/ /gsung chos kyi char ba 'bebs mdzad pa'i/ /pha chos rgyal spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs/ /ngas pha yul bzhag nas mtsho snying bsnyegs/ /nyams dga' ba'i mtsho snying ri bo nas/ /chos zab mo tshul bzhin nyams blangs tshe/ /sems skyid pa'i ltad mo sna tshogs mthong / /mtsho g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal lta bu'i steng / /bya ngang ba skya ser la sogs pa'i/ /chu bya'i tshogs tshom bu bkod bzhin mjes/ /kun rgyun du skad snyan bsgrags pa yis/ /sems skyid du bcug pa'i rnal 'byor ngas/ /ngag snyan pas lhang lhang rgyang glu blangs/ /mi skal ldan yod na gnas 'dir shog /'khor nye du zhog la myur du shog /byang ngos kyi ljon shing rtse mo dang / /ri'i ngos na rab tu mdzes pa yi/ /bye'u mang bo 'phur lding g.yo bzhin du/ /skad snyan mo dar dir 'byin pa yis/ /sems skyid du bcug pa'i rnal 'byor ngas/ /ngag snyan 232

pas lhang lhang rgyang glu blangs/ /mi skal ldan yod na gnas 'dir shog /dri bzang bo 'thul ba'i sman sna dang / /sngo tshod ma mang bos khor yug gang / /spang rab mdzes bde 'jam yangs pa ru/ /khams gseng phyir lan re phyin pa'i tshe/ /sems skyid du bcug pas rnal 'byor ngas/ /ngag snyan pas lhang lhang rgyang glu blangs/ /mi skal ldan yod na gnas 'dir shog /'khor nye du zhog la myur du shog /mdog mi gcig me tog gzhon nu'i tshogs/ /kun 'dzum dgod byed pa'i khor yug na/ /rkang drug ldan sbrang ma'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /gar byed bzhin glu dbyangs blangs pa yis/ /sems skyid du bcug pas rnal 'byor ngas/ /ngag snyan pas lhang lhang rgyang glu blangs/ /mi skal ldan yod na gnas 'dir shog /'khor nye du zhog la myur du shog /ma mkha' 'gro dkar phyogs lha rnams kyis/ /chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen thams cad bsgrubs/ /rkyen phyi nang bar chad kun bsal bas/ /phyi sgyu ma'i lus po bde ba yis/ /sems skyid du bcug pas rnal 'byor ngas//ngag snyan pas lhang lhang rgyang glu blangs/ /mi skal ldan yod na gnas 'dir shog /'khor nye du zhog la myur du shog /ri'i mtha' ma mtsho yis yongs bskor bas/ /gzhan phyi rol yon bdag pho mo dang / /dgra jag rkun la sogs 'ong skabs med/ /233

gtam chags sdang kha skad mi thos pas/ /sems skyid du bcug pas rnal 'byor ngos/ /ngag snyan pas lhang lhang rgyang glu blangs/ /mi skal ldan yod na gnas 'dir shog /'khor nye du zhog la myur du shog /pha bla mar dad gus drag po dang / /mar 'khor ba'i chos la nges 'byung dang / /ma nyam thag 'gro la byams snying rje/ /byang chub kyi sems bzang skyes pa yis/ /sems skyid du bcug pas rnal 'byor ngas/ /ngag snyan pas lhang lhang rgyang glu blangs//mi skal ldan yod na gnas 'dir shog /'khor nye du zhog la myur du shog /phyi'i cir snang sems kyi rol ba dang / /de kun kyang sgyu ma lta bur go /sems khyab gdal stong gsal chos skur shes/ /nyams rtogs pa cung zad skyes pa yis/ /sems skyid du bcug pas rnal 'byor ngas/ /ngag snyan pas lhang lhang rgyang glu 'then/ /mi skal ldan yod na gnas 'dir shog /'khor nye du zhog la myur du shog /nga rnal 'byor g.yu 'brug sngon mo'i lus/ /gos ngur smrig lho sprin gsar bas g.yogs/ /gnas mtsho snying nam mkha'i khams na mdzes/ /glu rab snyan sgra dbyangs lhang lhang sgrog /glu snyan mo'i 'brug sgra 'di thos pa'i/ /mi skal ldan rma bya gzhon nu tshos/ /gnas 'di 'dra'i ljon shing yal ga nas/ /chos nyams len gar stabs byed par shog /ces pa 'di yang reb gong gru ba 234

tshogs drug rang grol gyis nyams dga' ba'i shugs kyis skal ldan las 'phro can rnams chos la bskul ba'i phyir mtsho snying lha yul gnyis pa nas blangs pa'o//yang skabs shig slob bu pad+ma rang grol gyis khyod kyis skyid gru zhig longs zhes smras pa'i lan du/skye 'chi med pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /sprul ba dngos chos rgyal yab yum dang / /sku drin can tshogs drug rang grol gsum/ /byang chub kyi bar du skyabs su 'dzin/ /sngon byon pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyi/ /zhal bzang de mjal skabs ma mchis kyang / /lung rtogs kyi yon tan kun mnga' ba'i/ /bla ma dang mjal 'di skal ba bzang / /mdo sngags kyi rgya che'i gzhung rnams la/ /thos bsam 'dra cung zad ma byas kyang / /dam chos kyi snying bo rdzogs chen dang / /mjal ba 'dir bsams kyin nga re skyid/ /rdzogs chen gyi yang dag lta ba la/ /'gyur med kyi brtan cha ma thob kyang / /'khrul med kyi nges shes rnyed pa yis/ /nyams rtogs kyi nyi ma 'char snyam dga'/ /snod bcud kun lha dang zhing khams su/ /ma shar kyang mtsho snying dben gnas dang / /chos mthun gyi grogs dang mjal ba yis/ /'og min du slebs 'dra'i dga' spro shar/ /nyon mongs kun rang grol ma song yang / /mtsho snying gi gnas 'di dben pa'i mthus/ /nyon mongs kun da lta bag la zha/ /sdom gsum dang ngang gis ldan pas skyid/ /bdag po las gzhan dag 235

gces 'dzin pa'i/ /byang sems kyi rnam thar skyong dka' yang / /dgra gnyen gnyis gang dang ma 'brel ba'i/ /chags sdang med btang snyoms byung bas dga'/ /rje btsun khyod lta bur spros med kyi/ /ting nge 'dzin rgyun du ma bsgoms kyang / /skabs skabs su spros bcas dge sbyong bzhag /bsgom bsgoms ltar byed 'di dgod re bro/ /'di 'dra yi skyid cig byung ba de/ /drin can gyi bla ma'i bka' drin yin/ /drin lan du tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms/ /tshe thag de ring bar byen gyis rlobs/ /zhes smras pa'o/ /gnas yid 'ong mtsho snying khor yug gi /shing sngo ljang me tog 'dab rgyas tshe/ /pha bla ma'i sku mdzes yang yang dran/ /yid bag phebs chu bya sna tshogs kyis/ /skad snyan mo dar dir sgrog pa'i tshe/ /pha bla ma'i gsung snyan yang yang dran/ /steng mtho la yangs pa'i nam mkha' la/ /sprin med par sa ler 'dug pa'i che/ /pha bla ma'i thugs dgongs yid la dran/ /chu dwangs bsil rnyog med mtsho sngon la/ /rlabs chu gnyer ri mo g.yo ba'i tshe/ /pha bla ma'i yon tan yang yang dran/ /shar ri bo'i rtse nas nam mkha' la/ /'od lam lam nyi ma shar ba'i tshe/ /pha bla ma'i 'phrin las yang yang dran/ /pha drin chen bla ma rin po che/ /zhing dag pa rab 'byams gar bzhugs kyang / /bur ye shes spyan gyis rgyang 236

nas gzigs/ /zhes pa 'di yang nyin gcig pha bla ma chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo dran pa'i shugs kyis smras pa'o//grangs med 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs/ /zla med pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /dbyer med drin can bla ma rje/ /chos med bu la brtse bas dgongs/ /dge sdig blang dor cang mi shes/ /dge sbyong gzugs brnyan ri ba la/ /dge legs gzhi gcig mgon khyod kyis/ /dge la bskul ba'i zhal gdams gnongs/ /dus gsum mkhyen pa pad 'byung dngos/ /dus snyigs 'gro ba'i mgon khyod dang //dus rnam kun tu mi 'bral bar//dus 'di lta bur 'gyur bar shog /mnyam med mtsho skyes rdo rje dang //dbyer med tshogs drug rang grol la//chos med blo bzang rin chen gyis//zol med sgo gsum gus pas phul/ /zhes pa 'di bskul ba'i lan du/rigs rgyud mtho zhing blang dor gnas/ /rig nas gzhan la ston mkhas pa'i/ /rin 'dzin ngag gi dbang bo yis/ /rigs bzang bu la thugs rjes gzigs/ /tshar rgyu med pa'i las dang gcig /mgu med mi yi ngo srung gnyis/ /skyo ngal med pa'i long gtam gsum/ /chos dang 'gal bas rgyab tu skyur/ /bdag tu bzung ba'i gnas dang gcig /kha lan re ba'i tshogs dang gnyis/ /ngo srung dgos pa'i g.yog po gsum/ /chos dang 'gal 237

bas rgyab tu skyur/ /slob dpon mkhyen rgya chung dang gcig /slob ma dad pa med dang gnyis/ /dam tshig mi brtsi mched grogs gsum/ /chos dang 'gal bas rgyab tu skyur/ /bza' tsho rgyun du 'thab dang gcig /bu dang tsha bo mang dang gnyis/ /bskyangs kyang khengs pa'i 'khor g.yog gsum/ /chos dang 'gal bas rgyab tu skyur/ /ser sna zer ba'i phan phan po/ /phan par bzung nas pham ster ba'i/ /ser sna dgra bo yin pa de/ /e shes shes na rgyab tu skyur/ /gti mug zer ba'i phan phan po//phan par bzung nas pham ster ba'i//gti mug dgra bo yin pa de//e shes shes na rgyab tu skyur/ /nye 'brel zer ba'i phan phan po//phan par bzung nas pham ster ba'i/ /nye 'brel dgra bo yin pa de/ /e shes shes na rgyab tu skyur/ /le lo zer ba'i phan phan po/ /phan par bzung nas pham ster ba'i/ /le lo dgra bo yin pa de/ /e shes shes na rgyab tu skyur/ /rgyab tu bskyur dgos brgyad kyi glu/ /glu ba tshogs drug rang grol blangs/ /blangs pa 'di thos dad can rnams/ /rnam dag lha chos byed par shog /ces smras pa'o/ /e ma skyabs mgon rin po che/ /nga yi nye gnas dge slong dang / /sman rams ngag dbang bkra shis dang / /bya btang gling rgya'i bstan 'dzin gsum/ /zhal gdams shig zhus bshad yod 238

pas/ /brtse bas mgur zhig gnang bar zhu/ /zhes pa 'di yang slob bu pad+ma rang grol gyis smras pa'i lan du/sems can la gnod sems ngan gdug rtsub can/ /ma rungs dgra rnams ma lus thabs kyis btul/ /ma gyur 'gro rnams ma lus bde la 'god//bstan pa skyong ba'i bstan 'dzin rgyal por 'dud/ /kwa ye chos mthun sman pa'i rab 'byams dang / /kha mkhas khog dkar nye gnas dge slong dang / /ga red snyam du 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam/ /nga bzhin bya btang byed pa'i bstan 'dzin gsum/ /ca co ma smra rnal 'byor glu 'dir nyon/ /cha lang rnga dril dung bus grong chog byas/ /ja ras gos dar bsogs nas khyer sa med//nya ro bzhin du lus kyang bzhag nas 'chi/ /ta zig rgyal ltar gos nor 'dzoms na yang / /tha ma thams cad 'dzad pa mi shes sam/ /da nas bzung ste zas gos nor ma gsogs/ /na 'chis ma gtugs gzhon dus chos la 'bod/ /pa sangs lta bur mtho yang srid pa'i mtsho'i pha mthar ma son bar du bde med pas/ /bā la ha 'dra'i dam rten thob dus 'dir//ma 'dug 'khor ba'i mtsho las thar thabs gyis//tsa yis khram pa ji bzhin gzhan ma bslu/ /tshwa sgog dud btsong rgya bzhin tshong ma byed/ /dza re dze re'i shing bzhin tshig ma rtsub/ /wa 239

dang spyang ki gnyis bzhin 'gro 'dug spongs/ /zhwa lham gos rgyan mdzes dang sha thud sogs/ /za ma bzang bo zos nas du sangs rgyas//'a rogs cha bo mchor dang zas ma dga'//ya mtshan can gyi bla ma'i mgo'i steng du/ /rwa sgoms gsungs kyang the tshom ma byed par/ /la lung gnyis kyi brag khung 'go ris su//sha stag gyis la sgoms dang nyams rtogs 'char/ /sa lam yon tan ma lus mthar phyin tshe/ /ha ha khyed gsum sprul ba grangs med bkye/ /a ma'i gtso byas 'gro kun drangs na chog /dge 'dis chos mthun khog dkar bya btang ba/ /gsum gyi chos sgo mtha' ru thon par shog /ces smras pa'o//o rgyan pad 'byung ni snyigs dus//bstan dang 'gro ba kun don du/ /slar yang mi gzugs su byon pa'i/ /drin can bla ma la 'dud do/ /reb gong stod smad kyi sngags 'chang / /o rgyan rjes 'jug gi tshogs rnams//rnam dkar dge ba la bskul ba'i//zhal gdams mgur dbyangs shig gsungs lags/ /zhes pa 'di yang slob bu pad+ma rang grol gyis smras pa'i lan du/skyes mchog mchog thun dngos grub brnyes tshar kyang //'gro rnams rnam dkar dge la 'god pa'i phyir/ /sna tshogs tshogs gnyis bsags nas brda chos ston/ /e ma ma gyur 'gro mgon bla 240

mar 'dud/ /rang yul pha ma pha tshan zhing khang bskyur/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka 'tshengs pa'i lam zhig ni/ /rang gis e rnyed blta ba'i bsam bzang ngas/ /rang sems rnam par dag pas glu dbyangs len//rang don yongs rdzogs mthar phyin bla ma la//rang la gang yod phul nas gdams pa zhus//rang rang gang mos zab chos nyams len pa'i/ /rang dang rigs mthun reb gong sngags 'chang nyon//mtshan ldan bla ma su zhig mthong na yang / /dam ldan mched grogs rnams la rab bskul la/ /brgyud ldan zab mo'i chos la legs par nyon/ /snod ldan rnams la'ang spel cig sngags 'chang tsho//mi lus rin chen rnyed dka' rnyed na yang / /mi rtag myur du 'jig pa'i tshul soms la/ /mi nor zas la chags zhen ma che bar/ /mi 'gyod lha chos mdzod cig sngags 'chang tsho/ /las 'bras dkar nag gang byas rjes su 'brangs/ /las kyi dbang gis reb gong sar skyes dus/ /las nag 'thab rtsod mthu gtad las ma byed/ /las dkar dge ba sgrubs shig sngags 'chang tsho/ /'khor ba pa la bde ba'i go skabs med/ /'khor ba'i 'ching thag bu dang chung ma spangs/ /'khor nor med kyang bde bas nga bzhin khyed/ /'khor bcas mdzad dam mi mdzad sngags 'chang tsho//'gro kun rang gi pha mar ma gyur med/ /'gro ba rnams 241

la byams dang snying rje bsgoms/ /'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas thob byas nas/ /'gro kun 'dren snyams sems bskyed sngags 'chang tsho/ /bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po gsum gyi sgos/ /myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsgrub la 'bod/ /rang don rdzogs nas 'gro ba gzhan gyi don/ /yongs su rdzogs par gyis shig sngags 'chang tsho/ /chos thog 'khor ba ma stongs bar du tshugs/ /chos thog 'grig lam kun spyod yag po gyis/ /chos thog tshogs dus kun gyis chang ma thungs/ /chos bzhin chos thog dus kyi sngags 'chang tsho/ /dge bskos dbu mdzad rgan pa su yin kyang / /dge legs gzhi gcig chos thog las don gang //dge sems sgo nas gsungs dus thams cad kyis/ /dge bskos sogs kyi gsung rtsis sngags 'chang tsho/ /bsten na bla ma mched grogs ded dpon sten/ /'jug na bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen gru ru zhugs/ /sgrol na 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho sgrol/ /bsnyegs na thar ba'i gling snyegs sngags 'chang tsho/ /dge 'dis 'di 'dra rang gzhan bsags tshad rnams/ /rnam dkar dkar bo'i bsam pas phyogs gcig bsdus/ /bsdus kun kun bzang rang ngo ma 'phrod 'gro/ /'gro rnams rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo/ /zhes smras pa'o//242

na mo gu ru/ nam zla dgun dpyid de bzhud thal/ /dbyar zla gsum po kho slebs byung / /khu byug sngon mo nga'i skyid pa/ /gshog sgo legs po byas brgyangs te/ /ljon shing rtse mo ru babs nas//bya bye'u sna tshogs la lta bzhin/ /skad snyan yag po de 'byen ya//skad snyan yag po zhig 'byung ba/ /nam mkha'i lho sprin nas sbrang char/ /'jam po babs pa'i drin yin snyam/ /khu byug sngon mo nga dga' nas/ /bar bar bzhad gad re shor ro/ /mtsho dar dkar bo de bzhud thal/ /mtsho chu sngon mo ni slebs byung / /ngang ba ser bo nga'i skyid pa/ /gshog sgo legs po byas brgyangs te/ /mtsho chu sngon mo'i khar babs nas/ /gser mig nya mo la lta bzhin/ /skad snyan yag po de sgog ya/ /skad snyan yag po zhig byung ba/ /mtsho zhabs rdo bzang rtsar chags pa'i/ /zhim mngar 'dam gtsang drin yin snyam/ /ngang ba ser bo nga dga' nas/ /bar bar gshog sgo re sprugs so/ /bying rmugs rnam rtog de langs thal/ /stong gsal rjen pa kho slebs byung / /blo bzang rin chen nga'i skyid pa/ /lus gnad legs po byas bcos te/ /rtse gcig nyams bzhag la gnas nas/ /gsal 'debs dpe cha la lta bzhin/ /mgur dbyangs snyan mo de len ya/ /mgur dbyangs snyan mo zhig byung ba/ /mtshan ldan bla ma yis zab rgya'i/ /gdams pa gnang ba'i 243

drin yin snyam/ /blo bzang rin chen nga dga' nas/ /bar bar thal mo re sbyar ro/ /zhes pa 'di yang nyin zhig slob bu blo bzang rin chen gyis bskur ba'i lan du/'gro na khur bo ni med cing / /sdod na ba cha yang mi snang / /ljon shing yal ga na 'dug pa'i//khu byug sngon mo khyod ngar nyon//gshog sgo legs po de brgyangs nas/ /ljon shing rtse mo la 'bab dus//sder mo shing 'dzer gyis 'big pas//de la dogs zon re gyis ya/ /'gro na bro kha yang med cing / /sdod na khang ba yang mi snang / /ngang ba ser bo khyod ngar nyon/ /gshog sgro legs po de brgyangs nas/ /mtsho yi 'gram rnams su 'bab dus/ /rkang ba 'dam 'bag gis 'gos pas/ /de la dogs zon re gyes ya/ /'gro na lus rgyu ni med cing / /sdod na chags sa yang mi snang //blo bzang rin chen khyod ngar nyon/ /lus gnad chos bdun de bcas nas//rtse gcig mnyam bzhag la bzhag dus//bying rgod phra mo yis bsgrib pas/ /de la dogs zon re gyes ya//zhes sbras pa'o//dus dang po phun tshogs dge legs kyi/ /rgyu dri med me shel las grub pa'i//pha chos rgyal 'od gsal nyi ma de/ /sngon smon lam rta ljang stobs kyis drangs/ /ma'i mngal sgo'i sprin gyis ma bsgribs par/ /bod shar ri'i rgyan du shar ba'i mod/ /gzhan 244

bstan 'dzin zla ba zil gyis mnan/ /bsdu bzhi yi 'od stong 'gyed pa'i mod/ /'khor gdul bya'i rgyud kyi ma rig mun/ /kun lhag med bsal nas blang dor gye/ /gnas shes rab mig gis gsal bor mthong / /dus bar du slob bu pad+ma ngar//yul pha spun 'dam gyes ma gos par/ /stod sog po'i phyogs su gyen du 'phags/ /pha chos rgyal nyi mas bskyangs pa'i mod/ /lung rtogs pa'i yon tan bcud bzang de/ /bdag pad+ma'i lto bar cung zad 'khyil/ /gzhan skal ldan dad can bung ba rnams/ /rgyang ring bo nas 'ongs mdun du 'khor/ /lus phyag skor 'phur lding g.yo bzhin du/ /chos zhu tshig sgra dbyangs dar dir bsgrags/ /rang gang 'dod zab chos sbrang rtsi sbyin/ /da tha ma chos rgyal nyi ma ni/ /zhing gzhan gyi nub rir yibs pa'i mod/ /nga pad+ma dga' spro'i 'dzum dgod ni/ /sngar phye ba'ang dbang med zum nas song / /mya ngan gyi grib mas dbang med gnon/ /yar na so rgas pa'i ba mos mnar/ /na 'chi ba'i kha rlung 'tshub pa'i tshe/ /nga me tog pad+mas ji ltar bzod/ /bdag pad+mar re ltos byed pa yi/ /'khor gdul bya bung ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /chos zab mo'i sbrang rtsi gang nas 'tshol/ /gzhan bstan 'dzin zla ba yod na yang //nga me tog pad+ma ga la phan/ /slar mchog gsum thugs rje'i rta ljang 245

gis/ /pha chos rgyal yang sprul nyi ma drangs/ /bod gangs can shar ri'i rgyan du shar/ /gsung chos kyi 'od stong 'byed par smon /yid smon pa bzhin du 'grub gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang mtsho snying gi ri skyibs dro sa zhig tu phyi dro song nas bsdad pa'i tshe/ nyi ma nub ri la lam lam yib nas 'gro dus chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo zhing gzhan du gshegs pa dran nas nyi ma dang mthun pa'i bla ma dran pa'i gdungs dbyangs 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis blangs pa'o//yul gangs can lha lam yangs pa yi/ /nga chu 'dzin dga' ba'i dkar mdangs can/ /mgon chos rgyal nyi mas bor stabs kyis/ /mdog gnas 'gyur mya ngan smug por gyur/ /gdong mchi ma'i char ba 'bab la khad/ /tshugs ma thub phan tshun phang phung g.yo/ /mthar na 'chi'i rlung gis ma gtor bar/ /char zam zim skabs skabs 'bab 'bab 'dra/ /zhes pa 'di yang nyi ma nub ba'i 'phro la mkha' na sprin zhig yod pa smug por gyur ba'i tshe sprin de dang mtshungs pa'i skyo mgur 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyes blangs pa'o//bdag la sku drin can gye chos rgyal gyi/ /zhabs la sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal nas/ /'gro la byams shing chos la dad che ba'i/ /grogs la kha ta tshig 'ga' bshad kyis nyon/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa las/ /rab tu drin che mtshan ldan bla ma rje/ /rab gus yid kyis tshul bzhin legs sten dang / /rab bzang 'dod dgu'i dngos grub 'byung bar 'gyur/ /chos 246

grogs rnams la byams dang chos gyis dang / /chos skyong srung ma dkar phyogs lha rnams kyis//chos kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad kun bsal nas/ /chos mthun 'phrin las g.yel med bsgrub par 'gyur//'khor ba'i nyes dmigs soms la tshe 'di'i don//don du gnyer ba spongs la gnas dben par/ /bar mtshams med par gsang sngags nyams len gyis/ /gyis dang gtan bde'i byang chub thob par 'gyur//nyams su blangs dge dge tshogs ci mchis pa//sems can 'khor bar bar med rtag 'khyams nas//sdug bsngal myong kun kun mkhyen thob phyir sngos//bsngos na dge de de bas 'phel bar 'gyur/ /dge 'dis mgon los mtshan ldan bla ma zhig /rtag tu mgon du bsten nas nyams len byas/ /'gro ba'i mgon skyabs sangs rgyas go 'phang de / /thob nas mgon med sems can 'dren par shog /ces pa 'di yang dad gtong blo gros dang ldan pa'i grogs po mgon lo la tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par byen gyis rlobs/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol glu dbyangs la/ /dad can slob bu dkon mchog smon lam nyon/ /dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi lus rin po cher/ /brten nas sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par nus//da res ma gtogs phyi 247

nas rnyed par dka'/ /dal 'byor don che rnyed dka' thob dus 'dir/ /rang gzhan 'tshengs phyir sangs rgyas thob thabs gyis/ /nges par 'chi zhing nam 'chi nges pa med/ /'chi tshe gnyen bshes nor gyes phan pa med//de phyir tshe 'di'i mi nor zas gsum la//ma chags ma zhen blo yis gtong bar gyis/ /shi na 'khor bar mi skye'i blo gdeng med/ /'khor bar skyes phyin sdug bsngal shin tu che/ /dmyal bar skyes na tsha grang sdug bsngal che//yi dwags skyes na bkres skom sdug bsngal che/ /dud 'gror skyes na bkol spyod sdug bsngal che//mi ru skyes na na 'chi'i sdug bsngal che//lha min skyes na 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal che/ /lha ru skyes na 'pho ltung sdug bsngal che/ /des na 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las/ /da lta nyid du rang nyid thar na ang / /snyam du nges 'byung skyo shas bsgyed par gyes//'khor ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba'i 'gro rnams kyang //bdag gi pha ma ma gyur gcig kyang med/ /drin can pha ma rnams kyang snying re rje//bslu med bla ma dkon mchog rin po che//rang gzhan 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir bsgral nas kyang / /bde chen thar ba'i gnas su drang du gsol//snyam du nangs nub kun tu skyabs 'gro gyis/ /rang nyid gtan du bde zhing skyid pa dang / /pha ma sems can 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las/ /sgrol la sangs rgyas go 'phang 248

thob dgos 'dug /ngas ni sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par bya/ /snyam du smon pa sems bskyed yang yang gyis/ /de phyir lus dang srog la mi blta bar//mi dge'i las rnams phra zhing phra ba spangs/ /dge ba'i las rnams legs par bsgrub par bya/ /snyam du 'jug pa sems bskyed yang yang gyes/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob nas sems can kun/ /bde chen dag pa'i zhing du 'u ru ru/ /'dren pa'i dus de bdag la nam 'ongs na/ /snyam du dge ba'i las la 'bad par gyis/ /sangs rgyas thob nas sems can gcig tsam yang / /ma lus dag pa'i zhing du legs drangs nas/ /'khor ba'i grong khyer ma stongs de srid du//bdag gis sems can don chen mi mdzad na/ /snyam du zhe mna' dam bca' yang yang gyis/ /rang gis dge sbyor gang dang gang byed kyang / /phyi nang ri dang khang khyem sa chu me/ /rlung dang nam mkha' la sogs thams cad dang / /nang gi dgag sgrub rnam rtog sna tshogs su/ /'char ba rnams dang 'gro 'chag za nyal dang/ /smra brjod la sogs 'khor 'das chos rnams kun/ /rmi lam sgyu ma mig yor smig rgyu dang / /chu zla sgra snyan dri za'i grong khyer dang //sprul ba lta bur rang bzhin cung zad tsam/ /med do snyam du yang yang bsgom par gyis/ /skabs skabs bla ma dkon mchog rnam gsum la/ /dngos 'byor 249

yid sprul mchod pa rgya cher phul/ /bdag ni 'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang myur du thob par byen gyis rlobs/ /zhes pas 'dod pa'i don la gsol 'debs gyis/ /dge ba gang byas thams cad rang nyid kyis/ /nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam sems can kun don du/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu ru sngos/ /de ltar byas na ring bor mi thogs par/ /myur du sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par 'gyur//'di nyid mthong thos dad can pho mo yis//'di bzhin lha chos byas nas 'tshang rgya shog /ces pa 'di yang dad can sdom gsum rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i slob bu dkon mchog smon lam la tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//pha rgan chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud//slob bu rnams kyi sgo gsum byin gyis rlobs//gzhi yi rang sems dper na chu mgo 'dra//las nyon sgrib lci rdzing bu sa rdul gyi//mi gtsang dri mas gos nas rnyog pa 'dra//lam dus gdams pa du ma bsgom pa de//thog mar kha yi mi gtsang nyal nyil bsal/ /de nas chu rnyog thams cad phyi ru dor/ /rdo dang bye ma phan tshun 'og rnams su/ /blugs nas chu de dwangs su bcug pa 'dra/ /'bras bu chos gzugs gnyis kyi sku thob pa//chu mgo 'khyil ba shin tu dwangs pa na//nang du gzugs brnyan sna tshogs 'char ba 'dra//bu rnams gzhi lam 250

'bras gsum de ltar ltos//gzhi yi sems nyid nor bu rin chen 'dra/ /las nyon sgrib pa 'dam gyis gos pa 'dra/ /lam dus bsod nams ye shes tshogs gsog pa//nor bu chus bkrus ras kyis phyis pa 'dra/ /mthar thug 'bras bu chos gzugs sku thob pa/ /nor bur dgos 'dod ma lus 'byung ba 'dra/ /bu rnams gzhi lam 'bras gsum de ltar ltos//gzhi yi rang sems dper na nam mkha' 'dra/ /las nyon sgrib pa mkha' la sprin 'khrigs 'dra/ /lam du zab rgya'i gdams pa bsgom pa de/ /sprin rnams rlung gis phyogs bcur gtor ba 'dra//'bras bu chos gzugs gnyis kyi sku thob pa/ /nam mkha' nyi zla'i sgrib med gsal ba 'dra//bu rnams gzhi lam 'bras gsum de ltar ltos//glu dbyangs 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /slob bu rnams kyi sku gnyis mngon 'gyur shog /ces pa 'di yang slob bu bya btang ri khrod pa ngag dbang chos 'phel dang / ngag dbang bkra shis/ blo bzang rin chen rnams la tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//rje bla ma chos rgyal zhabs la 'dud/ /glu 'di la blo gsal 'phrin las nyon/ /dpe spang thang nyin gung ma gtogs pa/ /dgong phyi dro bkram na mi skam bzhin/ /chos gzhon nu'i dus su byas na 'ong / /yar na so rgas na byed mi nus/ /lus drang bor 251

bzhag kyang 'khyogs nas 'gro/ /'phongs yar la btegs tshe mar la 'phyang / /yar langs dus sug bzhi'i kha nas langs/ /phar 'gro tshe sgur nas 'jab kyin 'gro/ /mgo 'khor nas lus tshugs mi thub par/ /skabs skabs su gom 'bras dbang med 'khyor//so phal cher lhung nas re gnyis lus//zas sra ba thams cad bldad mi nus//nang pho bar song na mi 'ju na//gos dron po gyon kyang lus drod chung / /sar 'dug tshe lus kyi shed kyis brdeg /khas a pha a ma mang bo 'chor/ /mig mi gsal dpe cha mig sgor 'khyer/ /mdog nag po'i skra de gangs las dkar/ /gdong bzhin ras gnyer ma mang bos gang / /sems mi gsal brjed ngas shin tu che/ /phyi'i tsha grang sdug bsngal rkyen mi theg /nang ltogs skom cung zad tsam mi bzod/ /dbugs ma chad na yang ro dngos yin//tshe 'di nas pha rol 'phos dang 'dra//don de phyir blo gsal 'phrin las khyod//nor zas gos gsog 'jog ma rem par/ /dus da lta gzhon nu'i dus skabs su/ /chos thos bsam sgom gsum nan tan gyis/ /dge 'di yis blo gsal 'phrin las kyis/ /chos thos bsam sgom gsum mthar phyin shog /ces pa 'di yang rgyal mkhan chen gyi tsha bo 'phrin las la tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//252

bdag gi gtsug rgyan chos rgyal thugs rje can/ /'dris pa'i grogs la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /mi nga bkra shis 'khyel du bsdad pa'i skabs/ /nyer mkho'i mthun rkyen ster ba'i snying grogs nyon/ /khyod kyi sngon bsags legs smon bzang bo'i mthus/ /bla ma sangs rgyas lta bur legs par mjal/ /sgo gsum gus pas sku don kho nar 'bad/ /de phyir bla mas dgyes bzhin rjes su bzung //bla ma'i phyag mdzod nye gnas phal mo che/ /dkor gyis tshig nas rang mthong nga rgyal che//gzhan la brnyas smod khyad gsod mang bo byed//bla ma'i skyon mthong dad pa 'grib pa mang / /khyod kyis bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong / /rang 'dod med par bla ma'i bka' bzhin bsgrub/ /thugs rgyud mi dkrug rtag tu gang dgyes byas/ /mtho bkur dma' skyong mnyam pa'i 'grogs lugs sogs/ /gang gi thad na'ang gzhan gyis khrel ba med/ /da dung sngar bzhin bsod nams zhing gi mchog /bla ma'i sku don bsgrub la rtag tu 'bod/ /rang las mtho ba pha ma bzhin du bkur/ /rang las dman pa bu tsha bzhin du skyongs/ /rang dang mnyam pa spun zla bzhin du 'grogs/ /rang gi lus ngag spyod pa chos dang stun//bstan dang bstan 'dzin 'gro la gang phan gyis//rgyun du rang rgyud chos dang e mthun ltos/ /de ltar mdzad na 253

grogs po khyod nyid kyi//'di phyi'i bsam don thams cad 'grub par nges/ /zhes pa 'di yang rgyal mkhan chen rin po che'i phyag mdzod dad gtong blo gros dang ldan pa'i dmag sar rab 'byams pa la tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//'gro kun kun tu bzang bo'i go 'phang la/ /'god mdzad mdzad bzang mtha' 'khob bod kyi yul/ /cher snyigs snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig pu/ /chos rgyal rgyal sras mchog la gus pas 'dud/ /chos phyir ri la gnas pa'i ri khrod pa/ /chos grogs byams pa chos dar zhes bya ngas/ /chos kyi sgor zhugs zho 'ong ban brgya la//chos gtam tshig 'ga' snying nas bshad kyis nyon/ /dal ba brgyad dang 'byor ba bcu tshang ba'i//dal 'byor mi lus zer ba phyis rnyed dka'//dal bar da lta sdod pa'i dus skabs min/ /dal khom med par chos la 'bad re ran/ /'chi bas ma bcom sems can gcig tsam med//'chi dus chos med mi rnams 'gyod pa skye//'chi bdag pho nya ma 'ongs gong 'di la//'chi tshe mi 'gyod chos shig kun la dgos//'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba cung zad med/ /'khor nor rdzas la chags pas ci zhig bya/ /khor yug lcags ris bskor ba'i dgon pa nas/ /'khor bcas dam chos mdzad na mi legs sam//dge legs bkra shis sa dpyad bzang ba dang //dge chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen 'dzom 254

pa'i sar//dge 'dun thugs mthun sgo nas dgon zhig btab//dge la ci thub kun gyis 'bad par rigs//tshe 'dir de 'dra'i skal bar mi ldan na//tshe ring nad med chos 'byor 'dzoms pa'i dus//tshe 'dir ha cang ma chags chos mdzod dang / /tshe rabs phyi mar bde zhing skyid par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor glu dbyangs dbyangs snyan 'di nyid ni//zho 'ong ban rnams rnam dag chos la bsgul/ /gnas skabs dam chos chos bzhin spyad pa'i mthus/ /chos 'byor legs tshogs tshogs gnyis 'phel bar shog /cesapa 'di yang zho 'ong chos grogs ban brgya yongs la kha min snying nas bya btang byams pa chos dar gyis smras pa'o//'gro mgon sangs rgyas de chos kyi dbyings su gzims//o rgyan pad+ma de lho nub srin yul bzhud/ /mi la re ba de mngon dga'i zhing du gshegs/ /blo bzang grags pa de dga' ldan gnas su phebs//chos rgyal ngag dbang wang mkha' spyod zhing du gshegs/ /rdo rje tshe brtan de 'jig rten pha rol song / /bstan 'dzin nyi ma de ri bo rtse lngar bzhud/ /rgyal gyi mkhan chen de bkra shis 'khyil na bzhugs//lus srog bskyed pa'i ma sgyes pa'i yul na snang / /sprang rgan rang nyid ni mtsho snying ri la lus/ /mnyam 'grogs skad snyan gyi chu bya'i rigs rnams bzhud//sna tshogs me 255

tog gi mdog nyams bskams nas thal//bung bas glu dbyangs de mi len tshang du nyal//g.yu 'brug sngon mo yi tshogs kyis rdza ri bsnyegs/ /rtsi shing thams cad kyi kha dog ser skyar song / /ri mgo'i kha ba de rim bzhin mar mar 'bab/ /na tshod rgas pa de rim bzhin yar yar bsnyegs//gnas tshul 'di tsho bsam skyo ba nang nas skyes/ /zas nor longs spyod la zhen pa gting nas log /sgrub la brtson pa de ngang ngam shugs kyis byung / /zhes pa 'di yang ston dus ri mgo kha bas mnan dus shig tu tshogs drug rang grol gyis blangs pa'o//mi shes mun pa mthug pos blo mig bsgribs/ /'khor ba'i g.yang du lhung ba'i nyam thag 'gro//thar ba'i bde sar khrid pa'i lam mkhan rje/ /cung zad ngal gso mdzad nas bu la dgongs/ /khyod sku mtshan dpe'i 'dab bzhad pad+ma dkar/ /lung rtogs yon tan bcud kyis gtams mthong nas/ /skal bzang lus mdzes rkang drug gzhon nu'i tshogs/ /ma bos bzhin du dbang med drung du lhags/ /khyod gsung legs bshad dbyangs snyan g.yu 'brug sgra//mthon po'i khri yi mkha' dbyengs nas bsgrags tshe/ /gdul bya bye ba ther 'bum rma bya'i tshogs/ /dma' ba'i sa nas dga' dad zlos gar bsgyur//khyod kyi mkhyen pa rgya chen nam mkha'i mtha'/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i mkha' lding kun 'phur 256

nas/ /bskal bar btsal kyang 'di zhes mi dmigs na/ /bdag 'dra'i bye'u'i tshogs kyis smos ci dgos/ /khyod kyi brtse ba'i grub gzings gcig pu yis/ /'gro kun srid mtsho las bsgral 'di mthong na/ /phyag na pad dkar 'chang ba'i ded dpon yang / /skabs 'dir cung zad ngal gso mdzad dam snyam/ /brjed dang nor 'khrul sprin gyis ma bsgribs par/ /khyod thugs mkha' la bka' dang dgongs 'grel gyi/ /nyi zla skar tshogs shar 'dis 'khrul kun gyi/ /mi shes smag rum mthug po cis mi sel/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga'i lus stobs g.yu ral rgyas/ /seng chen khyod kyis skal bzang gangs khrod du/ /skyon bral legs bshad nga ro bsgrags pa na//mkhas rlom ri dwags bye ba'ang zil gyis mnan//khyod thugs mkha' la mkhyen brtse'i sprin glog 'khyug /gsung dbyangs sgra brgya bzhad dang lhan cig tu/ /lung rigs thog phab rgol ngan brag ri bcom/ /snyan grags char chu ngal med 'gro 'di mtshar/ /zab rgyas don dang 'brel ba'i gos kyis bklubs/ /sdeb legs tshig gi rna cha gdu bus spras/ /khyod gsung rtsom pa'i bu mo mdzes ma des/ /mkhas mang gzhon nu'i yid 'phrog yang yang blta/ /chos dang zang zing nu zho zas byin nas//thos bsam sgom gsum lus stobs rgyas byed ma/ /khyod kyi drin de bu ngas 257

bsams pa'i mod/ /rtsa ba'i ma'i drin dran pa'i go skabs 'phrog /reb gong gser mo ljongs kyi mkha' na mdzes/ /bsdu bzhi'i 'od kyis kun la dga' bde ster/ /sngon med gsar du shar ba'i nyi gzhon khyod/ /da dung bdag sogs pad tshal yun ring skyongs/ /phyag mdzod grwa slob gser nya rtse ba'i gzhi/ /'phags nor bdun gyi pad+mas brgyan pa'i mtsho/ /khyod la skad snyan 'byen pa'i ngang ba nga //ring min myur du 'phrad pa'i smon la 'tshal/ /'gro mgon khyod kyi legs bshad zla ba'i gzugs/ /bdag blo dwangs pa'i chu gter chen po'i klong / /shar ba'i mod la dga' dad dri gzhon langs/ /bstod tshig yid 'ong rlabs phreng 'di 'khrugs so/ /zhes pa 'di yang drin can bla ma rgyal mkhan chen rin po che'i yig lan zhig tu tshogs drug rang grol gyis phul lo// sngon sbyangs las kyi 'phro sad nas/ /chung nas bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan de/ /'bad rtsol drag pos bsgreng la brtson/ /pha bas lhag pas bu'i drung du//pha rgan dga' spro'i zhu yig 'bul//chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo sogs/ /bshes gnyen du ma'i zhabs la gtugs/ /sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes skyes/ /bsam dang sbyor bas tshul bzhin bsten/ /ci gsungs tshad mar bzung nas bsgrubs/ /bu khyod rang rig lha lam du/ /nyams rtogs rta bdun 258

dkyil 'khor rgyas//mgur dbyangs 'od stong 'gyed pa'i mod/ /gdul bya skal bzang byes pa rnams/ /chos brgyad grang bas 'khum pa dros/ /chos gtam ca co dbang med shor/ /nyams len rtsed mo byed du bcug /bka' drin che'o snying gi bu/ /bdag kyang mtshan ldan bla ma yis/ /gzhan don gyes zhes bka' cupo5 bzhin/ /skal ldan gdul byar chos 'chad bzhin/ /ri grong mtshams na bde bar mchis//ched zhu don gyi snying bo ni//sangs rgyas bstan pa gang dang gang / /khyad par a ti rdzogs chen bstan/ /phyogs brgya kun tu dar ba dang / /sgos su rang yul gdul bya rnams/ /smin grol mdzad phyir myur byon la//zab rgya'i chos kyi dga' ston stsol//zhu yig yig chung rta'i steng du/ /kha dar dar yug dkar bo 'phangs//slob ma ma gyur 'gro mgon drung //yar tshes tshes grangs bzang bor phul/ /zhes pa 'di yang sku drin 'khor med drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam dpal rdo rje rin po ches bdag gi spyi bor bstsal pa'i lan du/thos bsam sgom gsum mdzad pas rang rgyud grol/ /'gro gzhan khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa kun/ /myur du sku gsum go 'phang la 'god phyir/ /dbang lung khrid gsum gnang ba'i bka' drin can/ /mgon khyod gzugs sku yid bzhin nor bu mchog /skye med chos sku'i rgya mtsho chen po nas//sngon smon rnam 259

dag ded dpon bzang bos drangs/ /reb gong yul gye rgyal mtshan rtse na mdzes/ /mi 'dod nyer 'tshe'i 'dam gyis ma gos par/ /mngon mtho nges legs bde bas phongs pa yi/ /gdul bya dbul bo 'dod pa can dag gis/ /mchod cing rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i mod/ /zab cing rgya che'i chos kyi dgos 'dod ni/ /char ltar 'bebs bzhin bzhugs zhes gtam snyan gyi/ /tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs thos pas bdag gi yid/ /lha bu gzhon nu dga' dad dpag med thob/ /phran chung slob bu bdag gis mi lus grur/ /brten nas 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho yi/ /pha rol sgrol snyam dam chos dar 'phyar nas/ /brtson 'grus mthun pa'i rlung gis bskyod bzhin yod/ /da res mgon la skyabs 'jug zhu ba ni/ /da lta chos sgrub skal ba ldan pa 'di/ /da ngas bsams tshe khyod kyi drin du 'khums//da lo nas bzung tshe lo ci yod bar//da lta'i 'di bzhin bsgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /da khyed spangs nas skyabs gzhan ngas mi 'tshol//da nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar/ /da dung bu la thugs rje'i spyan gyes gzigs/ /tshogs drug rang grol blo yi rdzing bu nas/ /zhu yig 'dzum dgod byed pa'i pad+ma 'di/ /dad gus phyag dang bcas te phul ba'i mthus/ /bla ma'i byen rlabs sems la 'jug par shog /ces phul lo//260

'phags nor bdun gyi rgyal srid sna bdun mnga'/ /bcu gcig shel dgon sum cu rtsa gsum gnas/ /gzim chung rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang dbus/ /bla ma lha dbang brgya byin gnyis pa'i drung //ri khrod dben pa'i skyed mos tshal chen por / /nyams len rtsed 'jo byed pa'i lha bu ngas/ /zhu yig 'dab stong bzhad pa'i pad+ma zhig /zol med dad pa'i phyag dang bcas te 'bul/ /mgon khyod gzugs sku nyi ma gzhon nu la/ /nyer 'tshe'i sprin gyes ma bsgribs bzhugs yod ces/ /gtam snyan 'od stong bdag blo'i pad tshal du/ /lhung bas dga' dad rtse dga' dgod bzhin du/ /bdag kyang ri khrod dben pa'i sa mkhar bzung //bla ma'i gdams ngag go khrab mtshon cha thogs/ /nyon mongs dug lnga'i dgra la 'thab na yang / /nyes ltung 'chi rmas med par da bar bde//dge legs bye ba'i chu shel las grub pa'i/ /sngon med gsar du byung ba'i mgon khyod sku'i/ /zla gzhon mdo smad shar ri'i rtser 'phags pa/ /bstan 'dzin rgyu skar kun gyi rgyan du gyur/ /thugs dgongs rab dkar gangs ri rnar snyan gyi//gsung gi nyi 'od lhung nas bzhugs pa'i mod/ /snyan grags chu rgyun khor yug ri bo'i bar/ /'gro 'di gaṅgā'i rgyun la 'gran pa 'dra/ /thugs kyi mkha' na mkhyen brtse'i khyung chen gnyis/ /'gro don lho 261

byang 'grims pa mthong ba'i mod/ /phyi rol mkha' la bya dang bye'u'i tshogs/ /brgya stong 'gro la blta ba'i skabs rnams bcom//gdul bya 'dod lha dpag med brten pa'i gzhi//thabs mkhas bsdu ba rnam bzhi'i bang rim can/ /gzugs sku'i lhun po g.yo med bskal brgya'i bar/ /bzhugs zhes sor bcus thal sbyar gsol ba 'debs/ /sngon gyi rgyal sras seng chen dkar mo'i tshogs/ /nyams rtogs g.yu ral ngom zhing 'gying ba'i sa//dben pa'i gangs khrod nyal ba'i seng phrug ngar//lung rtogs g.yu ral rgyas pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ /dpag med yon tan 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i gnas//'gro mgon yid bzhin nor bu rin chen la//ri khrod rgya mtsho'i gling nas 'khyams pa yi/ /ded dpon bdag ni myur du mjal bar smon/ /zhu yig mi mthun med pa'i tsan dan shing //dri med lha rdzas glang chen zhig la bkal//mtsho snying rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul nas phul//khyed drung dge legs dri yis khyab gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang mtshungs med bla ma chu dmar rin po che la bde zhus su tshogs drug rang grol gyis phul ba'o//mi nor mang bo yod tshad rgyab tu spangs/ /bla ma mang bsten zab rgya'i gdams pa thob//ri khrod mang bsten rtse gcig sgrub pa mdzad/ /yon tan mang bo mnga' ba'i mgon de'i drung / /phran 262

chung byams pa chos dar zhes bya ngas/ /sgo gsum gus pas zhu yig 'bul bu 'bras/ /mgon khyod gzugs sku bde zhes thos pas spro/ /bdag kyang mchog gsum thugs rjes zag phung bde//da ni mgon khyod ri khrod gzhan ma 'grims/ /rang yul gdul bya'i mgon du bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /bdag kyang zab gsal thugs kyis ma 'dor bar//chos mgo mtha' ru thon pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ /zho 'ong steng 'og dad can pho mo rnams/ /'brel tshad don ldan dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'di/ /slar yang rang yul phebs pa skal ba bzang / /kun gyis mchod bstod bkur dang 'brel tshad rnams/ /tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med 'byor ba rgyas//phyi mar bde ba can du 'dren par nges//zhes pa mtsho snying dben pa'i dga' tshal nas//yar ngos zla tshes bzang bo zhig la phul/ /zhes pa 'di yang lung rtogs yon tan du mas thugs rgyud yongs su gtams pa'i sgyung gnas pa rin po che'i drung du tshogs drug rang grol gyis phul ba'o//mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mnga' bdag /bstan pa'i gsal byed dam pa/ /grub dbang mchog gi zhabs zung / /'khor los mtshan pa'i drung du//gus phran sman pas zhu 'bras/ /dge legs bye ba'i dpal las/ /legs 'khrungs mgon khyod mdzes sku/ /chu shel mngon par dwangs shing / /'phrin las bsil zer phreng ba/ /263

phyogs bcur spro bzhin 'gro kun/ /phan bde'i dpal la 'god pa/ /bka' drin shin tu che'o/ /bdag kyang mchog gsum drin las /sgyu lus da bar bde lags/ /ched gsol brtse ba'i mnga' bdag /khyed kyis sems can thams cad//thar ba'i sa la 'god pa'i/ /khur du bzhes mod yang sgos/ /chung nas 'dris cha che ba'i/ /rdo rje spun grogs bdag la/ /rig pa gtad nas nyon mongs/ /'ching ba las grol thar ba'i/ /lam la 'god pa'i skyabs 'jug /khyad par jo bo chen po/ /dga' ldan zhing na bzhugs dus/ /'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ /rwa sgreng lha khang bzhengs nas/ /gsol ba drag tu btab pa'i/ /mthu las rab gnas me tog /thor ba la sogs byin rlabs/ /dngos su phebs pa lta bu'i/ /bdag kyang 'di nas nyid la/ /nyin bzhin gsol ba drag tu/ /'debs dang 'debs mur lags na/ /'di nas 'phos tshe skye ba//gzhan gyis bar mi chod par//bde ba can du sgye ba'i/ /rtags ni yang dag bdag la/ /'ong ba'i skyabs 'jug thugs srung //rdo rje'i rwa gur dag nas//nam yang 'dor med mkhyen mkhyen//sman pa na chung gzhon nus/ /zhu yig sgra snyan pi wang / /gtan gyi skyabs khyod snyan du/ /zla tshes bzang bor brdungs so/ /zhes pa 'di 5nga lung rtogs yon tan du ma'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa'i 264

chos 'brel che ba'i drin can bla ma sman rgan rin po ches rdo rje'i spun grogs kyi tshul du bdag gi spyi bor batsho ba'i lan du/bka' brgyud gong ma rnams ltar rang rgyud grol/ /bka' gdamam bla ma rnams bzhin sangs rgyas kyi/ /bka' dang dgongs 'grel thams cad gdams par shar/ /bka' drin mnyam med bla ma rin po che/ /mgon khyod gzugs sku zla ba gzhon nu de/ /ma yi mnga' sgo'i sprin gyis ma bsgribs par/ /bsil ldan bod yul lha lam yangs pa yi/ /rgyan du shar ba'i mod la bstan 'dzin gyi/ /skyes bu rgyu skar thams cad zil gyis mnan//thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i bsil zer 'byed pa'i mod/ /skal bzang gdul bya ku mud khyod drung phyogs/ /dga' dad 'dzum dgod mang bo byed 'di mtshar/ /phran chung bdag gi sgyu lus khang rul steng / /zhag dang za ma'i char chu rgyun du babs//lo dang zla ba'i thigs chus brdungs stabs kyis/ /yid brtan med rung da dung ma zhig gda'/ /mgon khyod tshogs gnyis tshe 'dir goms pa'i mthus/ /nam zhig gshegs pa'i tshe na bde ba can//zhes bya'i zhing du tshe rabs phyi ma la//skyes nges skyes pa'i tshe na nga ma 'dor/ /bdag blo rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lha gnas nas//zhu yig lha bu gzhon nu mdzes pa zhig//dri med lha rdzas lag 265

gnyis rkyong bzhin du/ /bla ma lha dbang brgya byen drung du thal/ /zhes phul lo//rab 'byams rgyal ba kun las/ /rab mang 'gro ba mtha' dag /rab 'jigs 'khor ba'i mtsho las/ /rab sgrol skyabs mchog gang der/ /mgon khyod sras kyi thu bo/ /rigs bdag rig 'dzin zla bas/ /gsung gi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i/ /ngag dbang yon tan zhu 'bras/ /gang thugs bde chen mkha' las/ /byams brtse'i sprin dkar 'khrigs shing / /zhal gdams dbyar rnga sgog bzhin/ /gnang skyes sbrang char phab pas/ /bdag yid zhing sa brlan te/ /dga' bde'i snye ma rgyas shing / /dad gus lo 'bras smin pas/ /rang rigs zhing sa mgu'o/ /zhu gsol don gyi snying bor/ /deng nas byang chub bar du/ /khyed rang yab sras gnyis las/ /re sa'i skyabs gzhan med pas/ /dus dang rnam pa kun tu/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyu rnon pos//'bral med rjes su bzung nas/ /thugs yid 'dres par byen rlobs//rnam mang sgye 'phags yongs kyi//rnam dkar dge tshogs rlabs chen/ /rnam kun gcig tu bsdus te/ /rnam 'dren gnyis pa khyod kyi/ /zhabs zung 'gyur med brtan cing / /gsang chen bstan pa rgyas phyir/ /zhabs rdul spyi bor len pa'i/ /gsang sngags spyod pas 'bul lo/ /brtse 266

gzigs chen pos dgongs nas/ /zhal dkyil myur du mjal ba'i//rten 'brel smon lam 'tshal lo//de bzhin 'grub par gyur cig /gzhi lam 'bras bur 'brel ba'i/ /zhal gdams zab mo'i mthar thug /bdag gzhan yongs la phan phyir/ /ci nas gnang bar 'tshal lo/ /skabs su dad pa'i rten du/ /phyag tham dbu skra na bza'/ /spyi bor stsol ba'i bka' drin/ /re ba don ldan mkhyen mkhyen/ /zhu yig lha rdzas bcas pa/ /ri khrod bkra shis 'khyil nas/ /dad gus phyag dang bcas pas/ /dus tshes dge bar phul lo/ /zhes pa 'di ni dad gtong blo gros dang ldan pa'i ngag dbang yon tan gyis bskul ba'i lan du/sa gsum na zla med/ /kun mkhyen pa'i klong chen/ /rab 'byams khong bdag snying / /pad+mo ru bzhugs shig /rdzogs chen gyi gzhi lam/ /'bras gsum gye rnam gzhag /mgrin pa ru btegs nas/ /glu dbyangs su len no/ /dang po gzhi'i skabs su/ /ci 'dra las zer na/ /nam mkha' ni yangs pa/ /kha dog dang dbyebs med/ /mtha' dbus med khyab gdal//stong gsal ni ji bzhin/ /rang rig ni stong gsal/ /kha dog dang dbyibs med/ /mtha' dbus med khyab gdal/ /chos sku ru gnas so/ /nam mkha' la nyi zla//gza' skar gyi tshogs rnams/ /dang po nas yod 267

bzhin/ /chos sku yi dbyings na/ /gzugs sku dang ye shes/ /lhun grub tu gnas so/ /glo bur du sprin rnams/ /nam mkha' la 'khrigs nas/ /nam mkha' dang nyi zla/ /gza' skar rnams sgrib bzhin/ /glo bur du ma rig /nyon mongs las rnams byung / /chos sku dang gzugs sku/ /ye shes rnams bsgribs so/ /bar du lam bsgom tshe/ /ci 'dra yin zer na/ /skyi bser gyi rlung chen/ /shugs drag ni ldang bzhin/ /mtshan ldan gyi bla ma/ /yun ring du bsten nas/ /rdzogs chen gyi gdams pa/ /thos bsam byas ji bzhin/ /shes pa'i tshe dben par/ /rtse gcig tu bsgom dgos/ /mthar thug gi 'bras bu/ /ci 'dra yin zer na/ /lho sprin rnams dag nas/ /nam mkha' dang nyi zla/ /gza' skar rnams gsal bzhin/ /las nyon dang ma rig /sgrib pa kun dag nas/ /chos sku dang gzugs sku/ /ye shes lnga mngon no/ /zla ba yang rim bzhin/ /gzhan stong gi dus su/ /mi snang ba bzhin du//gzugs sku dang ye shes/ /chos sku yi dbyings su/ /mi snang bar nub nas//ston dus kyi tho rangs/ /nam mkha' ni ji bzhin/ /chos sku las nam yang //'gyur ba ni med do/ /chos sku las gzugs sku/ /'gag med du shar nas/ /sems can don mdzad dus/ /ci 'dra yin zer na/ /nam mkha' ni cung zad//ma g.yos pa bzhin du//slar yang ni zla 268

ba/ /phyi rol tu snang nas/ /'od dkar ni 'gyed bzhin/ /chos sku las cung zad/ /ma g.yos pa bzhin du/ /longs skur ni snang nas/ /sar gnas kyi byang chub/ /sems dpa' rnams don mdzad/ /zla ba yi gzugs brnyan/ /sa steng na yod tshad/ /dwangs pa'i mtshor snang bzhin//sprul ba'i sku grangs med//phyogs bcu ru snang nas/ /'gro drug gi sems can/ /ma lus pa'i don mdzad/ /chu snod ni med na/ /zla ba yi gzugs brnyan/ /mi snang bar nam mkha'i/ /zla ba la thim bzhin/ /sprul sku de mi snang / /longs sku la thim mo/ /gnam stong dus zla ba/ /mi mthong ba bzhin du/ /sar gnas kyi byang sems/ /gdul bya rnams med na/ /longs sku yang gzhi yi/ /chos sku la thim mo/ /bco lnga yi zla ba/ /gnam stong gi dus su/ /gtan med du ma song / /snang rgyu yang med bzhin/ /gzugs sku gnyis gzhi yi/ /chos sku ru thim dus//gtan med du ma song //gang du yang mi snang //gdul bya rnams yod dus//sngar bzhin du snang nas//'gro don las nam yang //rgyun chad ni med do/ /glu dbyangs 'di slob dpon/ /pad 'byung ni slar yang / /mi gzugs su shar ba//kun mkhyen gyi klong chen//rab 'byams pa 'i legs bshad//sa gsum gyi smron me//mdzod bdun gyi drin las//pad 'byung gi bu rgyud/ /rnam 'byor pa tshogs drug /rang grol 269

ngas blangs so/ /dge ba 'dis 'gro bas/ /dgos 'dod ni kun 'byung //rang rig gi nor bu//ring min du rnyed nas//srid zhi yi dbul phongs//ma lus pa sel shog /ces spras pa'o//gang thugs dri med rab dkar bum bzang bor/ /gsang chen chos kyi bdud rtsi rtag 'khyil zhing //rmad byung byams brtse'i dar gyi sham bu mdzes//'gro kun re 'dod skong mdzad gang de'i drung / /gus phran dge sbyong gzugs 'dzin bya btang ba/ /ngag dbang rgyal mtshan ming can ngas zhu 'bras/ /mgon khyod mdzad bzang snyan pa'i pi wang sgra//ring du thos pas dga' dad dpag med thob/ /'di na chos med smyon pa'i zlos gar mkhan/ /chos pa'i gzugs brnyan khur du bzung ba bdag /nyid kyi thugs rjes bskyangs pa'i grub dbang mchog /rig 'dzin zla ba'i gsung gis 'tsho bzhin lags/ /snga sor nyid kyi zhal mchog ma mthong kyang //gsang gsum rnam thar phyogs tsam thos pa'i mod//'gyur med dad gus thob la zog ma mchis//de phyir mgon khyod thugs rje chen po yis//dus rnam kun tu 'bral med rjes 'dzin ngos/ /gsang sngags lta sgom spyod 'bras tshul sbyar ba'i//zhal gdams go sla mgur du bzhengs pa dang / /phyag thal na bza' dad gus rten du zhu/ /re 'bras don dang ldan pa bla ma mkhyen/ /270

bdag ni deng nas ji srid 'tsho yi bar/ /ri khrod dben par sdod pa'i dam bca' dang / /dge sbyor gang byas mgon khyod zhabs brtan du/ /'bul zhing bdag lus 'byung bzhi snyoms pa nas//myur du mjal ba'i smon 'dun yang dag 'tshal//rab gus zhu yig lus mdzes rkang drug ldan//lha rdzas dar gyi gshog rlabs rab bskyod de//khyod zhabs rab dkar dri ma med pa de//phyogs bcur bzhad pa'i khor yug bsnyegs bud thal/ /zhes pa 'di yang bya btang ri khrod pa ngag dbang rgyal mtshan gyis bskur pa'i lan du/pha rgan chos rgyal zhabs la 'dud/ /pha yi rjes bzung bu bdag dang / /pha ma sems can thams cad la/ /pha khyed thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /tshogs drug rang grol bung ba yis ri khrod dben pa'i pad tshal na/ /nyams len 'phur lding g.yo bzhin du//rnar snyan glu dbyangs dar dir sgog /zla med bla ma du ma'i thugs//dri med shel dkar bum bzang gi /'khrul med zab rgyas gdams pa'i bcud//ngoms med 'thung mkhas grogs khyod nyon//sems can blo ni ma rig pas/ /bsgribs nas 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin//ma rig pa de sel ba la//gdams ngag gcig po 'di las med/ /dper na 'ja' sprin nyi zla rnams/ /nam mkha' gcig pu'i cho 'phrul yin/ /'khor 'das chos rnams ma 271
