lus pa/ /sems nyid gcig pu'i cho 'phrul yin/ /sems la ltos dang ngos bzung med/ /stong gsal nam mkha' yangs pa 'dra/ /sasal stong rjen ne ye re ba//zang thal smra bsam brjod du med//rang gi nyams su myong rgyu zhig /'dug pa de nyid lta ba yin//stong gsal ngang la yengs med du//rgyun du gnas pa sgom pa yin//ci ltar 'dug kyang gsal stong dang / /'bral med byed pa spyod pa yin//stong gsal zang thal rjen pa de //mngon du gyur pa 'bras bu yin/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi snying gtam 'di/ /chos sems 'dres pa'i snying gi grogs/ /rgyun du ma brjed snying du chongs/ /nyams rtogs nyi ma snying dbus 'char/ /chos kun snying bo lta mgur 'di/ /chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo yis/ /chos bzhin brtse bas bskyangs pa'i bu//chos pa tshogs drug rang grol blangs//dge 'dis sems nyid nam mkha' yi/ /ma rig nyon mongs sprin rnams yal/ /sku dang ye shes nyi zla de/ /'gro ba kun gyis mthong bar shog /ces smras pa'o//pad 'byung mkhyen brtse lha yi lam las shar//mi dbang nyi ma yon tan 'od stong can/ /gang de'i zhabs pad gus pas rab bsten nas/ /tshogs gnyis legs bsags mthu las tshe gcig la/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang brnyes kyang 'gro ba kun/ /srid las 272

sgol phyir dam bca' brtan po yis/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan srid rtser bsgrengs pa'i mod/ /snyan grags dbyar rngas sa gsum yongs la khyab/ /bdag sogs mdongs ldan gdul bya'i tshogs rnams kun/ /dbang med dga' spro'i gar stabs 'khrab tu bcug /dal thob ser gzugs bdag ni bstan pa'i sgor/ /zhugs nas bslab gsum mnos kyang sngon bsags kyi/ /bsod nams dman pa'i mthu yis mi mthun pa'i/ /rkyen gyis dran shes bag yod lhod gyur kyang / /phyi ru wa skyes rnam thar 'dzin bdag la/ /mgon khyod thugs rje'i spyan gyes legs gzigs nas/ /zhal gdams byin rten dbu lo na bza' bcas/ /mthong thos dran reg kun grol rten mchog stsol/ /rnam 'dren sras kyi thu bo snying stobs can/ /bstan 'gro yongs kyi mdzes rgyan skyabs gcig pu/ /bde ldan zhing gi mgon bzhin bskal brgya'i bar/ /zhabs zung rdo rje'i khri la bzhugs ngos nas/ /bdag cag 'dir 'khod mched lcam 'dus tshogs kyi/ /'gal rkyen nad gdon bar chad kun zhi nas/ /mthun rkyen legs tshogs ches cher 'phel ba dang //skye ba phyi ma'i dus na mgon khyod kyi//thugs smon las grub 'tshang rgya'i zhing khams der/ /'khor gyi thog mar rjes su 'dzin par zhu/ /bdag yid pad+mos rab brgyan rdzing bu nas/ /zhu yig 273

lus mdzes skad snyan ngang ba zhig /lha rdzas dar gyi gshog rlabs rab bskyod nas//mgon khyod sgra 'dzin rgya mtsho bsnyegs te thal//ces pa 'di yang dam tshig ldan zhing dug lnga shugs chung ba/ dag snang che zhing blo ldan ngang ring brtse ba'i gogs po mthong sa'i dge slong mtshams pas bskur ba'i lan du/thugs rje'i rlabs chen rgyun du g.yo/ /mkhyen pa'i gting mtha' dpog nus min/ /chos rgyal dge legs chu gter de'i/ /zhabs la gus pas bdag phyag 'tshal/ /tshogs drug rang grol khu byug gis/ /ri khrod dben pa'i nags gseb na/ /gdams ngag char zil 'thung bzhin du/ /glu dbyangs skad snyan lhang lhang sgog /mi lus rin chen bum bzang ltor/ /mdo rgyud man ngag bdud rtsis gtams/ /gang gi spyi bor bkur byas na/ /gtan gyi bde ster grogs po nyon/ /yang yang rnyed dka'i dal 'byor rten/ /da lta rnyed pa dbul bo'i mis/ /shin tu rnyed dka'i yid bzhin gye/ /nor bu rnyed ltar ngo mtshar che/ /lus can srog gi nyin byed de/ /rgas dang na ba'i rlung gis bskyod/ /'chi ba'i bya lam yangs par zhugs/ /bar do'i nub kyi sa 'dzin brgyud/ /'jig rten phyi ma gling gzhan du/ /ma song sems can 'di yod ces/ /sngon chad mthong thos gcig med na/ /rang la mi 'chi'i gnas yod dam/ /gnyen bshes dbus na dpa' na yang / /glo bur 'chi bdag 274

gshin rje slebs/ /nad kyi mtshon chas lus la btab/ /mal sa'i nang du bsgyel ba'i tshe/ /gshang gcis gos pa'i mal stan nas/ /mig gis trig trig sdang mig bltas/ /'khun bu'i dgra skad 'then na yang / /'chi bdag ba spu gcig mi g.yo/ /de'i tshe brtse ba'i gnyen 'khor rnams/ /thams cad 'ongs nas mdun du bsdad/ /yid ni mya ngan bsam gtan gnas/ /ngag gi smre sngags dbyangs su blangs//lag pa'i dbyu gus brang rnga brdungs//kun gye mig gnyis bhan+ta ru/ /rang byung mchi ma'i sman raka bskyil/ /bzhin gyi lha sku mchod na yang //don go sna gcig e yod soms//de'i tshe lus kyi khang rul nas//rnam shes skyes bu phyi ru thon//las kyi rlung gi rtar zhon nas//grogs med gcig pur phyi mar 'gro/ /de dus rang la phan nges pa//dkar bo dge ba ma gtogs med/ /yun ring 'grogs pa'i gnyen dang 'bral/ /bsags pa'i zas nor longs spyod tshogs/ /til 'bru tsam yang rjes mi 'brang / /de ltar 'gyur bar shes bzhin du//phyi ma'i bya ba ji ltar bshol//tshe 'dir yun ring sdod long med//le lo ji ltar bya bar rigs//sha rus dag kyang gyes gyur na/ /gnyen bshes tshogs la ji ltar chags/ /tshul 'di 'di ltar mi bsam par/ /mi chos chos brgyad khol bo rang / /byas na na rga 'chi bdag kho/ /byung dus dus der 275

'gyod pa skye//de phyir shes ldan snying gi grogs//khyod la mang bo smra ci dgos/ /mdor na tshe 'di blo yis thongs/ /ri khrod 'grims pa nyams len mdzod/ /bdag blo nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor las/ /thon pa'i legs bshad 'od zer 'di/ /snying grogs blo yi pad+mor zhugs/ /dga' spro'i 'dzum dgod dbang med 'chor/ /bsgrub pa'i brtson 'grus mdangs stobs rgyas/ /snyan grags dri yis phyogs kun khyab/ /nyams rtogs yon tan bcud kyis gtams/ /sku gsum 'bras bu smin par shog /ces smras pa'o//bgrang yas rgyal ba sras bcas kun las 'gro ba la/ /ches cher brtse bas gzigs mdzad pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes/ /zhing 'dir skal ldan gdul bya yongs kyi gtsug rgyan du/ /mi yi rnam rol chos rgyal chen por spyi bos 'dud/ /mgon de'i thugs kyi shel dkar bum bzang las thon pa'i/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyes rang rig nor bu yi/ /nyon mongs dri ma myur bkrus lung rtogs yon tan gyi/ /dgos 'dod kun mnga' grub dbang rin po che yi drung / /chos gos rnam gsum 'chang zhing chos pa'i gzugs kyi ni/ /rang gzhan bslu byed 'di phyi gnyis med mchog ming gi /g.yo med sor bcu'i pad+mo spyi bor rab bkod de/ /zhu mchid 'bul lo brtse bas gzigs shing dgyes dgongs mdzod//276

snga sor nyid kyi bka' yi glegs bu skyes dang bcas/ /spyi bor bstsal ba rab dga'i sa thob bzhin spro yang / /chos rgyal rta bdun dkyil 'khor myang 'das nub ri'i phag /yibs pas skyabs bral bdag yid skyes bu mya ngan gyi/ /mun pas non kyang bla ma mchog gsum mthu byin gyis//thigs tshags bzang bas sgyu lus khang rul ma zhig yod//zhu don snying bo 'di phyi gnyis med seng ge bdag /byang chub go 'phang ma thob bar du brtse bas skyongs/ /da dus sems la phan pa'i zhal gdams phyag tham dang / /lan bu'i khrod du bcing rgyu'i dbu lo'i chun po bcas/ /mgon khyod thugs sras rig 'dzin zla ba byon pa'i skabs/ /dgyes brtse sgo nas re ba 'bras ldan mdzad par zhu//rdo rje'i sku la nam yang 'pho 'gyur mi mnga' yang / /bdag cag dad ldan 'gro ba yongs kyi gtsug rgyan du/ /ri bo mchog rab bzhin du g.yo bral lham me bar/ /srid mtha'i bar du chos ston mdzad phyir bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /zhu yig lus mdzes skad snyan na chung gzhon nu ma/ /lha rdzas gos gyon gser gyi gdu bu 'khrol bzhin du//dben gnas bkra shis 'khyil nas yar tshes lam la zhugs//khyod zhabs bsten pa'i slob ma gzhon nur 'grogs nas thal/ /ces pa 'di yang grogs mchog mchog ldan gyis bskur ba'i lan du/277

snga 'gyur gsang chen chos kyi yid bzhin nor bu las/ /ma rtogs log bshad mi gtsang dri mas gos pa rnams/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas bye dor byas nas skal bzang gi /gdul bya'i re skong chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bor 'dud/ /bya btang byams pa chos dar kha yi nam mkha' la/ /dung so sum cu'i lho sprin gsar ba lang long 'khrigs/ /lce yi glog dmar 'khyug bzhin glu dbyangs 'brug gi sgra/ /sgrog la grogs po rma bya gzhon nu dga' bas nyon//dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi lus rin chen rnyed par dka'/ /'khor dang longs spyod rgyas kyang bzhag nas phyi mar 'gro/ /pho brang gnas khang bzang yang gtan du 'dug dbang med/ /lhan cig 'grogs pa'i sha rus yan chad bzhag nas 'gro/ /mi tshe tshe thung ma chags pha yul yul mi spongs/ /'gran 'dod 'dod chags ma che mi bsgrub sgrubs ma zer/ /mi shes shes so ma smra zhe sdang sdang sems dang / /ma grol grol brdzu ma byed ma zhig zhig brdzus spongs/ /mtshan ldan bla ma bsten la zab rgya'i gdams pa nyon/ /lha ru dkon mchog mchod la blo phugs de la gtod/ /rang gis dam chos sgrub bzhin gzhan yang chos sgor chugs/ /dge ba'i las rnams bsgrub cing mi dge'i las rnams spongs/ /mtho ris skas la 'dzeg pa'i dge bcu dang du longs//ngan song g.yang la 278

lhung ba'i mi dge bcu la 'dzems//dge ba gang byas thams cad phyi mar sngon na yod//gzhan la bcol ba'i nor rnams rang gis len pa 'dra/ /lta ba rang sems chos kyi sku ru rtogs par gyis/ /sgom pa rang sems chos sku'i ngang la goms su chugs/ /spyod pa rang sems chos sgu de nyid rgyun du skyongs/ /'bras bu rang sems chos sgu las gzhan btsal mi bya/ /dam tshig nyams pa med par mig 'bras bzhin du srungs//'gro la snying rje bskyed la bu bzhin byams par mdzod/ /'di bzhin lha chos byas na bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /ming dang don gnyis mthun pa'i chos pa de la zer/ /chos med longs spyod ldan rung yi dwags gter srung yin/ /tshe 'di'i 'dun mar mkhas rung byol song rkang gnyis yin/ /kun gyi tshogs dpon gyur rung dmyal ba'i dpon po yin/ /ngan song sdug bzod dka' rung rang g.yos tshod ma yin/ /glu 'di 'di 'dra len cing dben gnas gnas la dga'/ /dam chos chos mdzad dam pas gang gsungs gsung bzhin byed/ /yang dag dag snang che ba'i grogs mchog mchog ldan gyis/ /bskul tshe tshe 'dir zhen log kun byams byams pas blangs/ /bdag sems zla ba las thon glu dbyangs 'od dkar 'di/ /chos grogs mchog ldan yid kyi me tog ku mud tar/ /phog tshe dbang med dam chos 279

nyams len 'dzum dgod byas/ /lung rtogs yon tan bcud kyis yongs su gtams par shog /ces smras pa'o/ /bstan dang 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs gcig pu/ /pad 'byung sprul ba chos rgyal thugs sras mchog /rdzogs chen bstan pa'i me ro slong mdzad pa'i/ /tshogs drug rang grol zhabs kyi pad+mo'i drung / /chos kyi sgor zhugs chos mdzad dam pa bsten/ / chos mang nyan kyang chos sems rgyab 'gal dang / /chos pa'i gzugs kyi chos min sna tshogs byed/ /chos brgyad g.yog nag chos dred rab rgyas kyis/ /zol med sgo gsum gus pas zhu yig 'bul/ /grangs med 'gro ba'i don du sems bskyed nas/ /yengs med rtse gcig sgrub la gzhol ba yi/ /zla med rdo rje spun grogs brtse bas gzigs//skyabs mgon chos rgyal nyi ma zhing gzhan gye//nub rir yibs pas skal dman bdag nyid ni/ /mya ngan grib mas g.yogs dang lhan cig tu/ /rmongs pa'i mun nag mthug pos non pa'i tshe/ /bya bral rdo rje'i spun grogs zla gzhon khyod/ /zhing 'di'i shar ri'i rtse las rab 'phags te/ /legs bshad 'od dkar phyogs brgyar 'gyed pa'i mod/ /skal bzang gdul bya ku mud tshogs rnams ni/ /khyod la phyogs nas dga' dad 'dzum dgod shor/ /rmongs pa'i mun pas non pa'i mtshan 'gros 280

bdag /lam log g.yang du ma lhung yang dag pa'i/ /thar ba'i lam sna zin pa shin tu dga'/ /zhu don snying bo bdag cag rjes 'dzin phyir/ /'di gar phebs pa thugs 'dun gtod pa dang / /khyad par sems la phan pa'i zhal gdams dang //chos sgo mtha' ru thon pa'i skyabs 'jug mkhyen/ /zhu yig 'dab stong pad+ma'i dga' tshal du/ /spyan gyi bung ba 'phur lding g.yo rten du//kha ba'i mdangs 'dzin lha rdzas bcud kyis gtams/ /dad gus phyag dang bcas te zla tshes phul/ /zhes pa 'di yang thos bsam sgom gsum 'chad rtsod rtsam gsum bslab pa rnams dang ldan pa'i rdo rje'i spun grogs dkon mchog rab rgyas kyis bskur ba'i lan du/rgyal bstan logs bris lha sku mdzes pa rnams/ /ma rtogs log rtog mun pas bsgribs pa la/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i mar me rab sbar te/ /gsal bar ston mdzad chos rgyal zhabs la 'dud/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol sgeg mo yis/ /rna bar snyan pa'i glu yi gzugs brnyan 'di/ /rdo rje spun grogs dkon mchog rab rgyas kyi//blo gros shel dkar me long nang du 'bul/ /mi lus thob tshe tshe 'dir yun ring du/ /mi sdod tshul 'di 'di ltar rngo5 bsams par/ /nyin mtshan shor na na so rgas pa'i tshe/ /'chi bdag slebs dus dus der 'gyod kyang 'phyis/ /bshan 281

pas bsad pa'i lug gi lhag ma rnams/ /bshan pa mthong yang yid bder gnas pa bzhin/ /mnyam 'grogs grogs rnams shi yang 'khu 'khrig med/ /khyod la mi 'chi sdod pa'i gnas yod dam/ /bsams tshe gtan du sdod snyam 'khrul bar go /go bzhin dam chos mi bsgrub phyugs pas phyugs//phyugs kyang g.yang kha mthong tshe skrag pa skye//skye mtha' 'chi ba 'di la cis mi 'jigs//lo zla zhag gi kha ba bu yug 'tshub/ /na rga gnyis kyi shugs drag rlung chen langs/ /tshe srog snum zad mar mer brgyab pa'i tshe/ /de la yun ring sdod pa'i skabs yod dam/ /nam zhig 'byung 'khrugs nad kyis lus la btab/ /bzod glags med pa'i sdug bsngal drag pos gzir/ /langs 'dug mi nus mal sa'i nang du nyal/ /yan lag phra zhing skra rnams gyen du langs/ /sha rnams zad nas lhu tshigs ma bral tsam/ /mdog nag pags pas g.yogs pa'i drang srong des/ /nyin mo kha zas gcod pa'i dka' thub byas/ /mtshan mo gnyid kyi bde ba bkag byas nas/ /'khun bu'i drag sngags shugs drag bgrangs byas kyang / /'chi bdag ba spu gcig tsam g.yo mi nus/ /de tshe rang la brtse ba'i nye 'khor rnams/ /drung du 'ongs nas brtse bas ngo la bltas/ /bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor mchi ma'i chu yis bkrus/ /yid ni mya ngan bsam 282

gtan la gnas shing / /ngag gis 'o dod nga ro dbyangs su blangs//lag pa'i dbyu gus brang gi rnga brdungs kyang //ngal ba ma gtogs don go sna gcig med/ /de tshe lus kyi grong khyer stongs par bskyur/ /rnam shes skyes bu phyi ma'i lam la zhugs/ /rgyus med phyogs su gcig pur 'khyams pa'i tshe/ /sngon bsags las kyi nus pa ma gtogs pa/ /yun ring dga' mgur skyod pa'i gnyen dang grogs/ /ngal ba du mas bsgrubs pa'i longs spyod rnams/ /til gye cha shas tsam yang rjes mi 'brang / /tshul 'dir bsams na glog bzhin mi brtan pa'i/ /tshe 'di'i yud tsam zhig gi bde ba'i phyir//phyi ma bskal bar sdug bsngal myong ba'i rgyu/ /bsgrub la sems yod skyes bu su zhig 'jug /sgyu lus bar snang 'ja' bzhin ring mi gnas/ /snyan grags 'brug gi sgra bzhin yud tsam yin/ /thams cad tshong 'dus mgon bzhin so sor gyes//longs spyod sbrang ma'i rtsi bzhin gzhan gyis spyod/ /de ltar yin yang ma rig ling tog gis/ /blo mig bsgribs pa'i skya ser phal mo che/ /mi gtsang khrod na dga' ba'i sbrang ma bzhin/ /tshe 'di'i bslu brid dag gi dbang du gyur/ /kye ma mthon po'i tha mar 'chi bas 'joms/ /lang tsho dar ba'i tha ma'ang rgas pas 'phrog /longs spyod rgyas pa'i tha ma rgud pa sogs/ /'gro mgon rgyal ba sras 283

bcas gang gsungs rnams/ /de bzhin da lta 'di na snang na yang / /'dod sred chu bos khyer ba'i mi rnams kyis/ /'di yi rang bzhin ma mthong ji ltar bya/ /skye dgu'i phan bde'i rtsa ba rgyal bstan gyi/ /nyi ma nub ri'i rtse la nye bar slebs/ /srid mtshor sgol ba'i dal 'byor gru chen yang / /nam zhig tshe na 'jig par mi shes pas/ /de phyir dal 'byor thob cing bstan dang mjal/ /bshes gnyen dam pa bsten rgyu yod bzhin du/ /de las 'ongs pa'i gdams pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun//kwa ye da lta nyid du mi 'thung na/ /nam zhig glo bur nyid du dbang med par/ /gnyen bshes mang bo'i gseb nas rang gcig pu/ /nad kyi pho nyas bzung nas 'chi bdag gi /drung du khrid na de dus ci zhig bya/ /de phyir yed smon tsam du ma 'jog par/ /pang du dug sbrul byung ba'i mi bzhin du/ /le lo dor nas brtson 'grus shugs bskyed de/ /deng nas dam pa'i chos la 'bad par rigs/ /shes ldan khyod la mang du smra ci dgos/ /mdor na tshe 'di'i bde 'byor kun gyis bslu/ /yid brtan rung ba dam pa'i lha chos yin/ /de phyir dal 'byor thob pa don ldan gyes/ /glu 'di 'di 'dra'i glu dbyangs mang bo len/ /mi chos chos brgyad spangs pa'i rnal 'byor ngas/ /spel legs legs pa'i tshig gis rab brgyan 284

te//chos mdzad mdzad bzang snying grogs khyod la springs//bdag yid dri med rab dkar gangs ri las/ /byung ba'i legs bshad chu rgyun ngal med du/ /babs 'dis mched lcam blo yi rgya mtshor zhugs/ /dam chos nyams len dbu phreng g.yo bar shog /ces smras pa'o//o ṭa'i rgyal po bstan 'gro'i dpal du/ /mi yi rnam rol chos rgyal wang gi /thugs sras tshogs drug rang grol zhabs kyi/ /pad+mo dri ma med pa'i drung du/ /gus phran bkra shis 'bum gyis zhu 'bras/ /gang sku mi mthun phyogs las rnam par/ /rgyal zhing bstan gnyis rgyal mtshan srid rtser/ /sgreng bzhin bzhugs zhes thos pas spro'o/ /phran kyang mchog gsum dam pa'i thugs rje/ /gong ma'i chos rgyun dpe srol bzang bo/ /ma lus tsam la mos mos ngang du/ /sgyu lus da bar bde mor gnas lags/ /zhu don snying bo gus phran bdag la/ /sems la phan pa'i zhal gdams shig dang //skabs su dad rten phyag tham na bza'//dbu lo dang bcas spyi bor stsol cig /bstan dang 'gro ba'i gtsug gi rgyan du/ /zhabs zung 'jig bral rdo rje'i khri la/ /legs par bzhugs nas bdag cag bltos bcos/ /thugs kyis nam yang 'dor med masteṇ+ḍid masteṇ+ḍid/ /ces pa 'di yang bla ma du ma'i zhabs la gtugs nas zab chos 285

mang bo gsan/ thos don nyams su len zhing gzhan la yang phyin ci ma log par ston nus pa'i reb gong sngags 'chang kun gye gtsug rgyan bkra shis 'bum gyis bskur bas lan du/rtag tu kun bzang chos kyi dbyings las/ /skad cig tsam yang g.yo ba med pa'i/ /pha rgan chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la/ /sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs so//chos dbyings bde ba'i btsan sa ma zin/ /'khor ba'i g.yang sa chen por lhung ba'i/ /bdag dang pha ma sems can nyam thag /thugs rje'i lcags kyus bde bar drongs shig /ma sogs gnyen bshes thams cad blos btang / /ma byas rang grub brag khung nang du/ /ma rabs spyod pa ngan pa spangs nas//ma gyur 'gro ba sems can thams cad//ma lus don du gong ma'i rnam thar/ /ma shi bar du 'dzin mkhan bdag gis/ /ma ltar brtse bas snyan pa'i glu len/ /ma yengs blo ldan grogs khyod nyon cig /rang sems dang po gang nas byung dang / /bar du lus kyi phyi nang gar gnas/ /dbyibs dang kha dog la sogs e 'dug /tha ma mi gnas 'gro dus dbang bo'i//sgo rnams gang nas 'gro la ltos dang / /byung gnas 'gro gsum gang yang mi rnyed//ma rnyed pa de rnyed pa'i mchog yin/ /sems kyi gnas lugs ye nas stong gsal//phyogs ris med par kun la khyab pa/ /rgya chad med pa'i gdal ba chen po/ /sgrib g.yog kun 286

bral zang thal yin pas/ /stong gsal khyab gdal zang thal chos dbyings/ /chen po'i ngang du shes pa glod la//nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu zhog dang / /mngon shes dzu 'phrul la sogs 'char ro mi gnas rnam rtog phyogs bcur 'phro tshe/ /sngon bsu rjes gcod gang yang ma byed/ /shes pa lhod kyis glod la sngar bzhin//sems nyid stong gsal ngang du zhog dang / /de ltar bzhag ma thag tu rnam rtog /mi gnas gar song med par 'gyur ro/ /bying rmugs gnyid gsum gang byung dus su/ /phaṭa brjod mig cer rig pa ngar bskyed/ /sa le sang nge hrig ge rjen ne/ /sems nyid stong gsal ngang la zhog dang / /bying rmugs gnyid gsum sangs par 'gyur ro/ /rjes thob dus su 'khor 'das chos rnams/ /mkha' la 'ja' dang sprin gnyis byung ba/ /ji bzhin rang gi sems kyi cho 'phrul/ /yin par thag chod 'ja' sprin rang bzhin/ /med par stong ba nyid ltar chos rnams/ /thams cad stong bar shes pa'i gdeng de'i/ /rtsis kyis bzung nas phyag dang skor ba/ /tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong byams dang snying rje/ /byang chub sems dang bsgyed rim bsgom sogs/ /thams cad gyis dang ngo mtshar che'o/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi snying gtam zab mo/ /'di nyid skal —ldan snying gi grogs khyod//rgyun du ma brjed snying la chongs dang //287

skyid pa'i nyi ma snying la 'char ro/ /chos kun snying bo lta mgur len mkhan/ /chos dbyengs na chung mdzes mar 'grogs nas/ /chos spyod bcu sogs rtsed mo byed pa'i/ /chos pa tshogs drug rang grol yin no/ /mgur dbyangs them skas bzang bo 'di la/ /brten nas skal ldan las can mang bo/ /chos dbyengs khang bzang rtse mor son nas/ /gzugs sku'i zlos gar ston par gyur cig /ces smras pa'o//'dzam gling gser ldan gyi khyon 'dir/ /'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba'i/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug ni chen po/ /tshogs drug rang grol gye drung du/ /a khyung sku skyes kyis zhu 'bras/ /gang thugs chos dbyings kyi nam mkhar/ /byams brtse'i chu 'dzin ni 'khrigs te/ /bka' mgur sbrang char ni 'jam po/ /gdul bya'i 'dzin ma la phab pas/ /bdag yul pad dkar yang brlan te/ /dga' dang dgod 'dzum zhig shor thal/ /phran kyang mchog gsum gyi bka' drin/ /dar dkar yol ba la brten nas/ /tshe srog mar me kho 'chi bdag /rlung gis ma bskyod par gnas lags/ /ched gsol gangs can gyi bod yul/ /gser gyi sa gzhi yi khyon 'dir/ /gzugs sku'i ri rab de g.yo med/ /bskal pa brgya phrag bar bzhugs shig /ngur sprig gos dkar gyis lus 288

mdzes/ /nyams rtogs lang tsho ni rgyas pa'i/ /yid 'ong grul bum gyi phru gu /khyed kyis nyams len gyi zlos gar//byed bzhin mgur dbyangs glu blangs pa/ /thos yid mi 'phrog pa su yod/ /yid 'phrog rab snyan gyi mgur dbyangs/ /longs zhes thal mo bdag sbyor ro//zhes pa 'di yang mkhas pa'i dbang bo a khyung sku skyes kyis bskur ba'i lan du/spyi gtsug 'ja' 'od kyi lho sprin//dkyil du chos rgyal rje g.yu 'brug /bzhugs nas gsung snyan gyi 'brug sgra/ /sgrog bzhin dngos grub gye char phobs//ri khrod lha lam ni yangs pa'i//brag phug chu 'dzin gye gseb nas/ /tshogs drug rang grol gye 'brug chung / /glu dbyangs dbyar gyi rnga sgogs ya/ /'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gar byed cing / /lung ltogs yon tan sgro'i mdangs bkra/ /chos grogs zhi dul can rma bya//gzhon nus dga' spro yis nyon cig /mtshan ldan bla ma ni bsten na/ /legs tshogs yon tan kun 'byung ste/ /yid bzhin nor bu la gsol ba//btab na dgos 'dod ni kun 'byung //dal 'byor mi lus ni thob dus/ /dam pa'i lha chos la 'bad 'tshal//cang shes rta pho de yod dus//sa thag ring bo de bgrod dgos//rang dang lhan cig tu 'grogs pa'i/ /mdza' bshes so so ru gyes 'gro//tshong 'dus mgron po ni yun ring //mi sdod phyogs bcu ru gyes yong //tshe 'dir yun ring 289

du mi sdod/ /sog 'jog mang bo byas ci bya/ /tshong ba lam bar du zhag dus/ /mkhar las rgya che 'dra byed dam/ /bsogs na dbang phyug ni mi thob/ /mkhas pas phyogs bcu ru ster dgos/ /bzhag na nor bskyed ni mi 'byung / /tshong byed mkhan rnams kyis zong 'grem/ /slong la sbyin pa rang btang na/ /phyi mar brgya 'gyur du thob yong / /dpyid dus zhing bzang la nas btab/ /ston dus 'phel ba la ltos dang / /sgyu ma'i nor rdzas ni bsogs rnams/ /nges par rang gis spyod mi shes/ /sbrang mas sbrang rtsi ni bsogs pa/ /nam zhig mi gzhan gyes spyod 'gyur/ /ngan song sdug bsngal de shes bzhin/ /de yi rgyu rnams ni ma sgrubs/ /g.yang sa chen po de mthong bzhin/ /de ru mchong ba'i mi yod dam/ /ngan song sdug bsngal de ma byung / /gong du thar thabs shig bya dgos/ /rbab rdo 'dril ba de rang thog /ma byung gong nas rang phros ya/ /rang nyid ngan song gi 'jigs las/ /skyob mkhan dkon mchog gsum bsten dgos/ /nag can dgra'i 'jigs las skyob pa'i/ /skyabs shig mi bsten par 'dug gam/ /rang gis ci 'dra'i las byas pa/ /'bras bu de 'dra ba smin nges/ /gro nas sa bon gang btab la/ /'bras bu de 'dra zhig 'khrungs 'gyur/ /sems can gzhan don la brtson na/ /zhor la rang gi yang don 'grub//lo tog 'ong 290

ba'i phyir 'bad na/ /sog ma 'bad rtsol ni mi dgos//thos pa ma byas pa'i bsgom de/ /re zhig grub gyur kyang myur 'jig /gser dngul zangs rnams ni bzhus dus/ /med dang bral ma khad sra ya/ /thos pa mang bo byas ma bsgoms/ /mang bo shes na yang don chung / /'o ma mang bo bsogs rtsi mar/ /ma blangs dgos pa ni ci yod/ /sgom la snying rus ni ma byas/ /nyams rtogs rang rgyud la skye dka'/ /ngu ru bro ba ni ma byas/ /dgod re bro ba'i zas mi myong / /gtan gye bde ba zhig 'dod na/ /chos phyir dka' ba ni spyod dgos//kha yis zhim po zhig za na//lag pas dka' las ni myong dgos/ /chos phyir dka' ba ni spyod tshe/ /'phral du sdug na yang phugs bde/ /gtar dang bsreg gis nad 'dod dus/ /cung zad gnod mod kyang phugs phan/ /rkyen gyis lan re tsam gtses na//rnal 'byor bogs 'don du 'gyur nges//dpon gyis ber ka yis lan re/ /brdungs na bran g.yog la phan 'gyur/ /rtag tu rkyen ngan gyes gtses na/ /yul de chos mdzad kyis spang dgos/ /dpon gyis dus rgyun du brdungs na/ /bran g.yog mi 'bros par sdod dam/ /mkhas pas mang shes kyang phyi ma'i/ /don du da dung yang slobs ya//khyem pas lo tog ni blangs kyang //sang phod zhing gi don los byed/ /blun por yon tan ni med rung / /da lta slob 291

dus na mi slob/ /bu ngan la la yis pha zhing / /bzang bo dbyed dus na mi 'debs/ /bstan bcos legs na yang blo gros/ /med pa'i mi rnams kyis mi len//rin chen rgyan cha de mdzes kyang //ba lang mig zur gyis mi blta/ /rang dgos bstan bcos de nyin re/ /tshigs re bzung na yang mkhas 'ong / /sbrang mas sbrang rtsi de nyin re/ /cung zad bsogs pa de cher 'gyur/ /blo ldan rang nyid kyis shes kyang / /mkhas pa gzhung lugs la blta yong / /phyug po rang don ni mang yang / /gzhan nor rin byin nas tshur nyo/ /mkhas pa mang bo ni yod kyang / /legs bshad smra ba ni re re/ /nags tshal mang bo ni yod kyang / /dri zhim 'byung ba de tsan dan/ /mkhas pa'i bzang ngan gyi khyad par/ /legs bshad brtsams pa'i tshe shes nges/ /rta yi bzang ngan gyi khyad par/ /'gro zhing rgyugs pa'i tshe shes ya/ /de 'dra'i glu dbyangs de 'jen mkhan/ /gangs can bod yul gyi glu ba/ /tshogs drug rang grol kho yin snang //thos tshad thams cad la bkra shis//zhes smras pa'o//rgyal ba gnyis pa pad 'byung snyigs dus 'dir/ /rgyal po'i tshul 'dzin zhabs la gus pas bsten/ /rgyal kun mnyes pa'i spyod pa lhur bzhes pa'i/ /rgyal sras chen po'i zhabs kyi pad+mo'i drung / /dal 'byor chos tshang mi lus bum pa yi/ /phyi ru chos gos 292

rnams gsum dar gyis btums/ /nang du chos brgyad mi gtsang du mas bkang / /rgyun du chos min dri ngan bro ba ngas/ /mi lus shel dkar bum bzang dri med du//mi rnyed lung rtogs yon tan bdud rtsis bkang / /mi las 'das pa'i skyes mchog khyod nyid la/ /mi phyed dad pas gsol ba 'debs 'bras ni//mgon khyod gdod ma'i dus nas rang byung gi /ye shes mngon du gyur kyang snyigs dus su//gdul bya thams cad lam der 'dzud pa'i phyir//thabs mkhas rgyal sras spyod pa lhur bzhes pa'i//'bras bu tshig gcig mngon gyur tshul bstan nas/ /mthong thos dran reg smin grol la 'god bzhin/ /bzhugs ngos snga sor bden tshig smon lam gyi/ /glegs bu spyi bor bstsal bas rab dga'i sa/ /thob bzhin dga' spro dpag tu med pa thob/ /'di na phyi ru chos pa'i gzugs 'chang zhing / /nang sems dug gsum dug lngas dbang gyur te/nga/mi dge'i las la 'dzem med rab spyod cing //bla ma dge ba'i bshes dang mjal na yang //bsam sbyor gnyis kyis bsten pa phar la zhog /tha na mos gus dag snang tsam zhig yang / /mi skye log lta'i sgrog tu tshud pa dang / /gdams ngag zab dgu thob yang le lo che/ /bsgom bsran chung bas dam chos gnad smin zhig /da lta sgrub pa'i skal ba dman na yang / /dam pa nyid gye 293

thugs rjes da nas bzung / /bla ma dkon mchog mched grogs la sogs la/ /dad gus dag snang rab tu 'phel ba dang / /dam chos sgrub pa'i brtson 'grus shugs drag po/ /'khor bar skyo ba'i nges 'byung rnam dag dang / /gzhan phan byang chub sems dang yang dag lta/ /rtogs pa'i shes rab la sogs rgyas pa dang / /nam zhig 'chi tshe mnar gcod mi 'byung zhing / /bla ma dkon mchog rjes su dran pa dang / /bar do'i skabs su sku yi snang ba bstan/ /snyan pa'i gsung gis 'khrul ba'i snang ba rnams/ /rang rig cho 'phrul yin zhes ngo sprad nas//brtse ba'i phyag gis bdag gi lag nas bzung / /skye ba gzhan gyis bar mi chod pa ru/ /bde skyid ngo mtshar dpag tu med pa yi/ /zhing khams kun las khyad 'phags bla na med/ /bde ba can du 'dren pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ /skabs su bdag dang bdag 'dra thams cad kyi/ /sems la phan pa'i zhal gdams legs bo dang / /phyag tham dbu skra na bza' rten 'dus kyi/ /sa sngags la sogs dad rten stsol ba mkhyen/ /zhu yig glang chen sa la rab brtan steng / /dri med dung mdog lha rdzas rgyan cha spras//grub dbang chos rgyal khyod kyi zhabs drung du//ngag dbang dge 'dun 'phrin las glang dzis phul//zhes pa 'di yang bslab gsum rgyan gyis mjes pa'i grogs po ngag dbang dge 'dun 'phrin las kyis 294

bskur ba'i lan du/ /sngon dus dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/ /du ma'i tshogs bsags bsags mthus rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rgyas nas 'gro rnams rnam mkhyen sa la 'dren/ /'dren mchog bla ma ma lus zhabs la 'dud/ /rab 'bring tha gsum mi yi rgyu 'grul med/ /rab dben mtsho snying rang byung brag phug na//rab bde bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /rab snyan glu dbyangs lhang lhang 'then pa la/ /rab byung bsnyen par rdzogs nas dus kun tu/ /rab mkhas bla ma mang bsten thos bsam byas/ /rab tu 'bad pas sgom sgrub byed mkhan gyi/ /rab mdzes ngur sprig 'chang ba'i snying grogs nyon//mtshan ldan bla ma sku bzhi'i gangs ri la//dad gus shugs drag nyi ma ma shar na/ /byen rlabs chu rgyun gtsang ma mi 'byung bas/ /dad gus nyi mas che cher bzhus shig ang / /mi lus gru dbus dam chos dar 'phyar ba/ /brtson 'grus mthun pa'i rlung gis ma bskyod na/ /nges legs rin chen gling du mi sleb pas//brtson 'grus mthun pa'i rlung gis bskyod cig ang //glo bur 'chi bdag dmag dpung steng du blugs/ /dbang med gsod pa 'di la ma 'jigs na/ /'chi brod chos kyi go mtshon mi gsog pas/ /'chi bdag dmag la dogs zon gyis shig ang / /295

mi dge bcu yi dug chu ngar ma 'di/ /'jem pa med par heb kyis 'thungs gyur na/ /phyis nas bzod glags med pa'i sdug bsngal myong //mi dge'i dug chu rngam nas ma thungs ang //dge ba bcu yi lha yi bdud rtsi de/ /ngoms pa med par rgyun du ma 'thungs na/ /mngon mtho'i bde skyid lus stobs mi rgyas pas/ /dge ba'i bdud rtsi heb kyis thungs shig ang / /'khor ba'i me dong dor nas bde chen gyi/ /thar ba'i bsil sar sor nas ma bsdad phyin/ /nam yang bde ba'i go skabs mi 'ong bas bde chen thar ba'i bsil sar snyogs shig ang / /sgo gsum dge ba gang sgrub lcags phye la//byang sems gser bsgyur rtsi yis ma zin na//thams cad mkhyen pa'i gser du mi 'gyur bas//byang sems gser bsgyur rtsi 'di gal che ang / /bdag 'dzin 'phung rgan dgra yi snying dkyil du//bdag med lta ba'i mdung ring ma btab na/ /bdag la bde ba nam yang mi 'byung bas/ /bdag lta'i dgra la mdung re thobs shig ang //bskyed rim gsal ba'i pho gsar gzhon nu mchog /rdzogs rim brtan pa'i bu mor ma 'phrad na/ /zung 'jug sku yi gces phrug mi 'byung bas//gnyis ka lhan cig nyal du chugs shig ang //rdzogs chen khregs chod thod rgal nor bu la/ /nyams len byi dor bzang bo ma byas na/ /nyams rtogs 296

yon tan dgos 'dod mi 'byung bas/ /nyams len bye dor byed pa gces so ang //rnam dkar dge ba ci bsags rta bzang de//bsngo ba'i srab kyis kha lo ma bsgyur na//thar ba'i lam la gyen du mi rgyugs pas//bsngo smon rnam dag srab kyis kha sgyur ang //thos bsam stobs rgyas chos mdzad dar seng rnams/ /ri khrod dben kha'i gangs la ma 'gying na//'jig rten chos brgyad mi gtsang dri mas gos//ri khrod gangs ltongs rgyun du zungs shig ang / /dge 'dis dam chos chos bzhin byed rnams kyi/ /'gal rkyen kun zhi zhi sogs las kun 'grub/ /rnam dkar legs tshogs tshogs gnyis gang bsags rnams/ /gong nas gong 'phel 'phel ba brtan par shog /ces smras pa'o/ /dam pa'i chos kyi gru chen la brten nas/ /las dang nyon mongs sgrib pa'i rgya mtsho bsgral/ /sku gsum 'dod 'byung nor bu len mkhan gyi/ /sngon med snyigs dus ded dpon chen po'i drung //bde med pha yul rgya mtsho chen po na//chos brgyad rba rlabs shugs drag 'khrugs pas g.yengs/ /las nyon gnyis kyi chu srin khar chud pa'i/ /nyam thag grogs ngan bdag gis gus zhu ni/ /mkhyen brtse'i pad dkar 'dab stong rab tu bzhad/ /dri med legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston gyes/ /skal ldan rkang drug 297

gzhon nu'i re skong ba'i//mgon khyod gzugs sku pad sdong bde zer spro/ /rmad byung blo gros lus stobs rab tu rgyas/ /byams brtse'i byang chub sems kyi g.yu ral 'chang //ri khrod dben pa'i rab dkar gangs la 'gying / /gsung mgur nga ros sa steng thams cad 'gengs//seng chen khyod dang da lta mtshungs pa zhig /gangs can khrod na med ces kun gyis gleng / /sngon chad 'ga' re yod ces rna bas go /phyin chad re re tsam re srid dam ci//de phyir mjal dka'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog /chung nas 'dris cha che ba'i grogs ngan pa'i//tshe 'di'i rkyen ngan bar chad zhi ba dang / /phyi ma'i lam sna drongs shig thugs rje'i gter/ /bdag sogs rang yul re ltos byed pa rnams/ /re ba skong phyir slar yang 'byon par bskul/ /bar skabs sems la phan pa'i zhal gdams dang / /dad rten stsol ces zho 'ong bla mas phul/ /zhes pa 'di yang dad gtong blo gros dang ldan pa'i grogs po zho 'ong bla ma chung bas bskur ba'i lan du/pha chos kyi rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /grogs ci bsam 'argyub par byin gyis rlobs/ /ming tshogs drug rang grol zhes bya nga'i/ /glu 'di la blo ldan snying grogs gson/ /nor bsogs pa'i tha ma 'dzad pa yin/ /grogs 'dus pa'i tha ma 'bral ba yin/ /298

mthor song ba'i tha ma rgud pa yin/ /yar skyes pa'i tha ma 'chi ba yin/ /chos thams cad mi rtag tshul soms la/ /tshe 'di yi che thabs bya ba kun/ /dpe mgar ba shi ba'i lag cha bzhin/ /da bsgyur la dam pa'i chos gyis shig /las rgyu 'bras nam yang bslu ba med/ /rgyu dge dang mi dge gang byas kyang / /phyis 'bras bu de 'dra 'byung bar gsungs/ /da mi dge sdig pa'i las ma byed/ /dmyal ba na tsha grang sdug bsngal che/ /yi dwags la bkres skom sdug bsngal yod//dud 'gro la bkol spyod sdug bsngal yod//mar ngan song sdug bsngal la 'jigs nas/ /yar lha mi'i go 'phang thob na 'dod//de tsam gyi phyir du dge bsgrubs na//mi de la skyes bu chung ngu zer//yar mtho ris na yang ngan song gsum/ /sdug de 'dra tsam zhig med mod kyang / /mir skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal mang / /lha ma yin 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal che/ /lha rnams la 'pho ltung sdug bsngal ldan/ /spyir 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la 'jigs nas/ /rang gcig pur 'khor ba'i thar na 'dod/ /de tsam gyi ched du'ang chos byed na/ /mi de la skyes bu 'bring zhes zer/ /'khor ba 'dir lhung nas sdug myong ba'i/ /sems can kun drin can pha mar shes/ /kun 'khor ba 'di nas 'dren nus pa'i/ /yar sangs rgyas go 'phang thob na 'dod/ /de phyir du dam pa'i 299

chos byed na//mi de la skyes bu chen po zer//da grogs khyod skyes bu chen bo bzhin/ /yar sangs rgyas go 'phang thob pa'i phyir/ /chos mdo sngags nyams su len par gyis/ /sgos bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen bsgom par mdzod/ /yang sgos su myur lam rdzogs chen sgoms/ /dge 'di yis 'gro ba ma lus par//mchog sangs rgyas go 'phang myur thob shog/ces smras pa'o//dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yang mes po//gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang bo de//snyigs dus 'gro ba kun ngor mir sprul nas/ /mchog thun dngos grub kun stsol bla ma rje/ /khyod thugs 'od gsal rta bdun dkyil 'khor las/ /phan pa'i mgur dbyangs 'od zer legs 'gyed nas/ /bdag blo'i pad+ma dkar bo kha phye ste/ /nyams rtogs bcud bzang 'khyel bar mdzad du gsol/ /bdag gzhan skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs kun/ /mgon po khyod dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing //ci gsungs bka' bzhin zab chos nyams blangs mthus/ /mthar thug sangs rgyas go 'phang myur thob shog /ces pa 'di yang dad pa dang brtson 'grus snying rje che zhing dbang bo rnon po khog yangs dad ldan las can slob ma blo bzang rin chen gyis smras pa'i lan du/tshe 'di'i bya ba kun dor nas//tshe dang sgrub pa bsnyoms nas kyang //tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob rnams kyis/ /tshe rabs kun tu 300

bu la gzigs//skyes pa'i yul dang zas nor spangs//dben pa'i bsil grib la 'khod nas/ /snyan pa'i glu dbyangs len pa la/ /mos pa'i bu khyod ma yengs nyon/ /pha yul bdud kyi btson khang zhog /gzhon grogs bdud kyi bu mo spongs/ /zas nor bdud kyi bslu brid skyur//chos brgyad bdud kyi zhags nag chod//nag can btson nas 'bros pa bzhin/ /mdza' ba'i bshes dang sdang ba'i dgra/ /chags sdang skye ba'i yul spongs la//'gro na dben pa'i ri la phros/ /nyon dang skal ldan snying gi bu/ /ljon shing g.ya' ri gangs 'dabs dang //dur khrod nags khrod dben gnas su//bla ma'i gdams ngag bsgom par mdzod/ /der yang chags nas ma 'dug par/ /nyi zla bzhin du phyogs gzhan song / /bya ba ngan pa mtha' dag spongs//rnam mkhyen go 'phang bsgrub la brtson//nyon dang skal ldan snying gi bu//dad pa'i nor dang tshul khrims nor/ /gtong ba'i nor dang thos pa'i nor/ /khrel yod ngo tsha shes pa'i nor/ /shes rab nor dang bdun po ni/ /'dzad med 'phags pa'i nor bdun yin/ /nor mchog 'di bsten phugs su phan/ /'phral du lha mi kun gyis mchod/ /nyon dang skal ldan snying gi bu/ /lus 'tsho'i bsod snyoms byed pa'i tshe/ /khyim pa rnams kyi sgo drung du//'o dod rgyang bos la sogs pa'i//mi dad spyod pa rnams 301

spangs te/ /bag yod spyod pa'i legs gnas la/ /snyan pa'i tshig gis slong bar gyis//mi rung ma gtogs dman yang longs//nyon dang skal ldan snying gi bu/ /bzang ngan chags sdang rnams spangs nas/ /dge rtsa bsngo zhing smon lam thobs/ /blangs nas yun ring ma 'dug par/ /spang gzhongs me tog sna tshogs bkra/ /khu byug ltong ltong dga' bas lding / /nyams dga'i ri khrod dben pa snyogs/ /sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zungs/ /dge 'dis skal ldan slob ma rnams/ /rnam g.yeng dbang du mi 'gro bar/ /bar mtshams med par dam pa'i chos/ /chos mdzad gong ma bzhin byed shog /ces smras pa'o//dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse ni//gcig tu bsdus nas ngur sprig tshul 'dzin pa/ /'gran zla dang bral tshogs drug rang grol la/ /gus pas 'dud do byang chub bar du skyongs/ /khyod thugs lha lam kun gsal ngos yangs por/ /mkhyen brtse'i chu 'dzin stug po nyer 'khrigs nas/ /man ngag sbrang char bdag yid zhing sa ru/ /legs phab cung zad brlan 'di e ma mtshar/ /da dung 'di na skal dman slob bu bdag /chos brgyad chu bo'i dkyil du gnas bcas nas/ /skyabs mgon khyod la 'o dod drag po yis/ /gsol 'debs gdung dbyangs len bzhin 302

zhal gdams zhu/ /byang phyogs bod yul nam mkha' nga 1ngas pa'i rgyan/ /gzugs sku dri med zla gzhon khyod nyid kyis/ /bdag yid ku mud dga' tshal bzhad phyir du/ /zhal gdams mgur dbyangs 'od dkar deng 'dir bkye/ /'di zhus dge ba'i bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun/ /dal 'byor rten thob dam pas rjes bzung nas/ /mdo sngags chos rnams thos bsam bsgoms pa'i mthus/ /mthar thug rnam mkhyen go 'phang thob par shog /cesapa 'di yang tshe 'di blos btang ri khrod 'grim mkhan bslab gsum rgyan ldan slob bu ngag dbang chos 'phel gyis smras pa'i lan du//bka' gdams mes po jo 'brom sogs//bka' gdams bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /bka' gdams rnam thar bus zin par//bka' gdams gong mas byin gyis rlobs/ /rnam g.yeng med pa'i dben gnas su/ /rnam mkhyen thob phyir lha chos la/ /rnam pa kun tu brtson pa'i bu/ /rnam dag bslab pa gsum ldan nyon/ /yid gnyis the tshom ma byed par/ /tshe gcig sgrub la nan tan gyis/ /gnyid rmugs le lo g.yeng ba rnams/ /spongs la brtson 'grus shugs drag skyed/ /dran dang shes bzhin bag yod pas/ /dbang bo'i sgo rnams rtag tu srungs/ /nyin mtshan kun tu rang rgyud la/ /rtogs la chos dang e mthun ltos/ /bdag gi nyes pa 303

gzhan la sgrogs/ /gzhan gyi skyon la ma rtogs shig /bdag gi yon tan khog tu sbos//gzhan gyi yon tan phyogs bcur sgogs//rnyed pa dang ni bkur ste dang / /khengs drag rtag tu spangs na bzang / /'dod pa chung zhing chog shes sten/ /phan byas lan du drin gzo mdzod/ /'gro ba yongs la byams pa dang / /snying rje'i byang chub sems mchog skyed/ /mi dge bcu bo dug ltar spongs/ /rgyun du 'gyur med dad pa dgos/ /gzhan la khro sems skyes tshe gzhom/ /byams pa'i sems dang ldan par mdzod//log pa'i 'tsho ba ma bsten par/ /chos mthun 'tsho bas 'tsho bar mdzod/ /zang zing dngos po ma bsogs par/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun gsog la brtson/ /'du 'dzi che ba'i grong dgon spongs/ /ri khrod dben pa rtag tu sten//don med ngag 'khyal tshig rnams spongs//rtag tu smra ba nyung na mdzes/ /bla ba mkhan po su yin yang / /mthong tshe gus pas rim gro skyed/ /phyogs bcu'i chos mdzad su mthong yang / /ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya/ /sems can che chung su mthong yang / /pha ma bu tsha'i 'du shes skyed/ /sdig pa'i grogs po thabs kyis spongs/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen rtag tu sten/ /sdang dang mi bde'i sems byung tshe/ /ri khrod gzhan du bde bar song / /gang la chags zhen che ba de/ /spongs la chags 304

med zhen med gyis/ /thog mar brtsam pa gang yin pa/ /mthar ma thon gyi bar du sgrubs/ /gzhan las nga bzang snyam pa yi/ /rang mthong nga rgyal skyes tshe spongs/ /zhum pa'i sems ni byung ba'i tshe/ /sems kyi gzengs ni bstod par gyis/ /nye ring chags sdang byung ba'i tshe/ /sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin du ltos/ /mi snyan tshig rnams thos pa'i tshe//brag cha bzhin du khyer la thongs//lus la gnod pa byung ba'i tshe/ /sngon gyi las su blta bar gyes/ /ri dwags shi ba'i ro bzhin du/ /sus kyang mthong tshor med sar sdod/ /gal te gzhan dag mthong ba'i tshe/ /khro gnyer ngo gnag mig log spongs/ /bzhin mdangs gsal zhing 'dzum bzhin du/ /'jam zhing drang bo'i tshig rnams smros/ /nyam thag dbul bo mthong ba'i tshe ser sna med par gang mkho byin/ /phrag dog 'gran 'dod 'thab rtsod spongs/ /rtag tu bzod pa sgom par mdzod/ /ngo dga' gsar 'grogs la ma dga'/ /rtag tu rang tshugs thub par gyis/ /mtho dman gang la ma brnyas par/ /kun la bran bzhin bkur sti rem/ /gzhan la dam chos ston pa'i tshe/ /snying rje phan sems bskyed la shog /gzhan gyi chos la skur ma 'debs/ /rang nyid gang mos nyams su longs/ /chos spyod rnam pa bcu bo yis/ /nyin mtshan gnyis ka 'da' bar mdzod/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i 305

dge ba kun/ /rang gzhan sangs rgyas thob phyir sngos/ /mjug tu 'dun pa drag po yis/ /smon lam rgya chen legs par thobs/ /de ltar byas na tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ /sgrib gnyis dag nas sangs rgyas 'gyur//gtam 'di tshogs drug rang grol gyis//dad pa dam tshig ldan pa yi/ /slob bu ngag dbang chos 'phel la/ /mtsho snying gnas nas legs par smras//glu 'di thos tshad thams cad kyis//bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /chos min spangs nas chos bzhin byas/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par shog /ces smras pa'o//go dka'i mdo sngags tshig don ma lus pa/ /go bar ma zad skye bo gzhan rnams kyis/ /go log go zhing gtan nas ma go ba/ /go sla'i ngag gis 'chad pa'i mkhas grub mchog /go sa mtho ba'i chos kun wang la sogs/ /go rgya che ba'i bla ma du ma'i gsung / /go ba'i drin gyis tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /go rim nges med glu dbyangs stong lhag blangs/ /go rig bzang ba'i mkhas pa dgyes phyir dang / /ko gyong lta bu'i rang rgyud 'dul ba'i thabs/ /go ba med pa rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /go sla khyer bde'i glu dbyangs blangs pa rnams/ /go med blun po glang rgan lta bus kyang / /go tshe rnar snyan yid la 'bab pa dang / /go myong rtogs pa mchog ldan 306

kun mkhyen gyi/ /go 'phang thob nas 'gro kun 'dren gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis sbyar ba'o//dad ldan rang gi slob bu/ /rnams kyis 'di bzhin mdzod cig /byes pa chung ngur gzhan gyes/ /bzang ngan tshig gang smras kyang / /re re bgad nas 'dug bzhin/ /dad dang mi dad mi yis/ /rang la ci zhig smras kyang / /re re dgod la sdod ya/ /byis par ci zhig byin kyang / /re zhig blangs nas 'dor bzhin/ /gzhan gyis gang byen longs la/ /ma gsogs mchod sbyin gyis shig /yang na lha sku'i mdun du/ /mchod pa ci zhig phul yang / /cung zad mi len bzhin du/ /gzhan gyis zas nor gang phul/ /bstan 'gro'i don re med tshe/ /cung zad tsam yang ma len/ /grub mtha' gzhan la ma smod/ /gang la'ang dag snang gyis shig /rang gi chos la yid gnyis/ /the tshom ma za sgrubs shig /rgan mos rma rdor phyag 'tshal//badz+ra kyi li kyi la//kha ngor rak+ka'i phreng ba//rgan po'i mgo la gdugs 'khor//sngon gyi gtam rgyud de tshor//soms la dad gus mos pas/ /rgyun du nyams len mdzod dang //'phral phugs bde skyid 'byung nges/ /bstan 'gro'i don gang byed dus//nam mkha' bzhin du sems la/ /bzang ngan gnyis ka shong dgos/ /sne do bzhin du ma dog /tshig ngan dam dum go na/ /kha 307

ngo lag pa ma 'dar//kha nas tshig ngan ma 'tshor//bla slob grogs rnams 'tshogs dus//g.yag rwa rdo nang drud bzhin//sems la mi ran tshig rtsub/ /zur gtam skyon mtshang ma 'bru/ /sems nyid nam mkha' bzhin du//rgya bskyed 'khor 'das chos kun//sems kyi nang du longs la/ /gang la'ang dgag sgrub ma mdzad/ /snang ba yangs po gyis shig /zas nor rnyed dang ma rnyed/ /bde dang mi bde gang byung / /rmi lam gnas skabs bzhin du//ltos la dga' sdug ma byed/ /snyan dang mi snyan bstod smad/ /'brug bzhin yid tsam grags nas//slar yang nyams tshul soms la//gang la chags sdang ma mdzad/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub//sems kyi nyi 'od brdol la/ /zhog dang 'gro ba mang bor/ /ngang ngam shugs kyis phan nges/ /snying gtam sems la zungs la/ /yul du bde bar bzhud cig /nga rang dben pa'i gnas su/ /song nas 'chi brod chos byed/ /khyed rnams sems kyis mi brjed/ /ring min myur du mjal lo/ /zhal mjal dus su bkra shis//rang yul chos grogs rnams la/ /rgyang nas gtam 'di bskur ro/ /rgyun du rnga rdungs dung bus/ /cha lang brdabs nas ma 'don/ /mtshams min skra can ma mang / /mang sar thod phor ma 'dzin/ /tshogs min chang nag ma thungs/ /dngos su phyag rgya ma 308

sten/ /kha dbyen tshig rjes ma 'brang / /ngo lkog gtam ni ma mang / /mo dang rtsis sogs ma byed/ /pho tshod lung bstan ma gnang / /grong du 'gro 'dug ma mang / /bsod snyoms mang bo ma rgyag /dbang dang srog gtad ma byed/ /mang bo phyogs gcig ma 'dug /mthu gtad drag las ma bco/ /bla mar dad log ma byed/ /grogs la ngan smras ma brjod/ /phyogs phyogs ri klung rnams kyi/ /rang byung brag phug snyogs la/ /rgyun du gcig pur sdod cig /yang na thun ni gnyis gsum/ /mtshams dam 'dag sbyar gyis shig /yang na thun ni 'ga' re//nyi zla bzhin du phyogs med//ri khrod nga bzhin 'grims shig /gos su ngan ngon gyon la//zas su gang rnyed zo shig /sgo skur sna tshogs byung yang / /shing gi mi bzhin gyis shig /deng sang kha dbyen rdzun mang / /gang la'ang bden par ma 'dzin/ /deng sang ngo skog gtam mang //gang thos rna ba'i phyir dor/ /yon tan brjod pa thos na'ang //rang mthong nga rgyal ma che/ /rang la yon tan yod tshad/ /sa 'og gter bzhin sbos shig /gsang sngags gsang nas bsgrub dgos/ /mngon mngon rkyang ba ma byed/ /gzhan gyi yon tan spu tsam/ /mthong yang ri tsam gyis la/ /dad can rna bar sgogs shig /phan btags gnod pa byed dang / /bzang byas ngan du song ba/ /309

re ba'i re thag chod rung / /gang la sdug bsngal ma byed/ /skye med chos dbyings chen po'i/ /ngang du me rer sdod cig /blo bde 'bol le 'gro nges/ /mdor na steng nas thog rgyag /'og nas sa 'gul bar nas/ /mi kun dgra ru langs kyang / /thams cad sems kyi rol ba/ /rmi lam bzhin du ltos la/ /gang yang bden par ma 'dzin/ /gang la khong khro ma skye/ /gang yod khyer na'ang byen la/ /gang bca' bco gi chugs shig /rgyun du gnyom chung kha rog /sdod dang kha mchu mi 'ong / /lag pas mgo skyor phros dang / /ded nas gcog mkhan su yod/ /khe dang rgyal kha phar byen//gyong dang pham kha tshur longs//'di ni 'o skol bya btang //chos mdzad ri ba'i lugs yin//lugs 'di 'chol du ma 'jug/a rog snying grogs cha bo/ /'di bzhin mdzad ki sdod dang //ring min myur du mjal 'ong //zhes pa 'di yang bya btang ri khrod pa rnams la mtsho snying nas rma rgyal du 'gro khar bris pa'o/ /bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dang //mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams la gus phyag 'tshal/ /bdag gis gang shar glu dbyangs blangs pa yi/ /'gal 'khrul nongs pa dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /glu ba tshogs drug rang grol zhes bya ngas/ /glu la dga' bas stong phrag lhag tsam blangs/ /gzhung mang sgra tshad snyan 310

dngags ma bslabs pas/ /mkhas mang dgyes pa'i lung 'dren sdeb sbyor med/ /rang la nang na nyams myong ma mchis pas/ /rtogs ldan rab tu mgu ba'i man ngag med/ /'on kyang bla ma lha yi byin rlabs dang / /dben par lo mang sgrub pa byas pa'i mthus/ /rang gzhan rgyud la phan pa'i kha ta'i rigs/ /me long gzugs bzhin yid la 'char 'char 'dra/ /dpe ltos blo 'dzin gshar sbyang ma byas kyang / /glu dbyangs 'dzad med gaṅgār 'gran pa 'dra//'on kyang ban rgan gsal 'grib mtho dman che//'gal 'khrul nongs pa mkhas pa'i spyan sngar bshags/ /mkhas pas mi legs gsungs nas ma 'gog dang / /bdag 'dra'i rmongs pa mang bor phan yang sred/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis 'chugs na 'dom pa gang / /blun po bdag 'dras 'chugs na mtho gang zer/ /mkhas pas shes bzhin 'chug gi ma 'jug dang / /bdag 'dras 'jugs kyang mi shes bka' ma bkyon/ /byis pas bsam pa drang bos gang smras pa/ /min rung pha mas lhag par byams pa ltar/ /bdag ni byis pa'i nang nas byis pa ste/ /nor kyang mkhas pas lhag par thugs brtse mdzod/ /de ltar bshags pas 'gal 'khrul nongs pa gang / /byang zhing dag nas sgrib par ma gyur cig /mgur dbyangs stong phrag blangs pa'i bsod nams 311

mthus/ /sangs rgyas stong gi bstan pa 'bar gyur cig /rgyal srid sna bdun bzhin du glegs bam 'dis/ /rgyal khams thams cad bde la 'god par shog /ces mgur 'bum nor bu la 'gal 'khrul gyi g.ya' shor ba bzod gsol bshags pa'i khrus ras kyis byi dor byas nas smon lam dri ma med pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rtse la bzhag ste skal ldan gdul bya'i tshogs la dgos 'dod kyi char phab pa'o//sangs ma rgyas pa'i bdag gzhan 'gro kun la/ /sangs rgyas las lhag tshogs drug rang gol rje/ /sangs rgya'i nyon mongs ma sangs mi bzang yang / /seng bzang ming can bu la snyan gson dgongs/ /khyod mgrin gangs ri'i mgur dbyangs chu rgyun byung / /gdul bya'i rgya mtsho chen por 'bab pa mthong / /mkhas rlom chu phran gyis 'gran ngal ba'i tshe/ /ngo tsha bzang brdzu'i bye ma'i nang du bros/ /ngo mtshar shin tu snyan pa'i mgur blangs pa/ /thos tshad yid 'phrog mi rnams nyan pa mthong / /khu byug gis 'gran mi sus ma nyan tshe/ /ngo tsha snye ma zhig brkus kha rog bros//snyan grags dbyar rngas sa steng 'geng ba mthong / /g.yu 'brug gis 'gran dbyar dus sgra bsgrags kyang / /khol bu tsam re min pa ma go tshe/ /ngo tsha kha rog rdza ri mthon po bsnyegs/ /mgur 'bum rgyal srid sna bdun rin po che/ /gangs can bod la 'jog pa bzhag pa mthong / /ri rab rtse nas lha dbang brgya byin gyis/ /rgyal srid sna 312

bdun yod kyang yid rab 'phrog /tshig bzhi re re'i phyir du'ang sangs rgyas kyis/ /sku lus mar me lcags gzer stong btab sogs//bsams na blo ldan skye bo su yin kyang //sor bcu spyi bor yang yang ci'i mi 'khyer/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong bcud bsdus nas/ /rnar snyan yid 'phrog glu yi rnam pa ru/ /blangs pa'i yon du bdag lus longs spyod kun/ /phul kyang 'khor bar dka' bas bdag blo 'khums/ /'on kyang cha tsam 'jal phyir da nas bzung //tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad blos btang ste//shin tu dben pa'i ri dang nags tshal nas/ /gang nus bshad dang sgrub pa'i mchod sprin spro/ /'di ltar rje la gtang rag phul ba'i mthus/ /'di nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /'di ltar dpal ldan bla ma legs bsten nas/ /'di 'dra'i zab rgya'i gdams pa nyan par shog /ces pa 'di yang slob bu seng bzang rgya mtsho'am/ pad+ma rang grol lam/ rig 'dzin zla ba la nga'i mgur ma rnams byin dus tshig gi gtang rag gi rta'i steng du sgrub pa'i mchod pa'i gos 'phangs nas bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du phul ba'o//sha smug po'i rwa dang 'brong gi rwa/ /rwa skyes sa mi gcig tha dad de//de gzhu mkhan drung du rang 'dus tshe//tshe gang bo mthun zhing 'grog pa'i rtags/ /bya rgod po'i sgo dang glag mo'i sgro/ /sgro skyes sa mi gcig tha dad de/ /de mda' mkhan drung du rang 313

'dus tshe/ /tshe gang bo mthun zhing 'grog pa'i rtags/ /yar la yi mi dang lung gi mi/ /mi skyes sa mi gcig tha dad de/ /de dben pa'i ri la rang 'dus tshe/ /tshe gang bo mthun zhing 'grog pa'i rtags/ /mchog sangs rgyas go 'phang ma thob bar bar mtshams med zab rgya'i chos nyan te/ /de bzhin du sgrub dus 'di bzhin yang / /yang yang du phrad nas 'grog par smon/ /zhes pa 'di yang ri ba mang bo mtsho snying nas lhan cig bsdad dus phan tshun gcig la gcig mthun zhing ma bu bzhin du 'grogs tshe sems spro ba'i shugs kyis rba rlabs chal chil g.yo zhing chu bya dar dir sgrog pa'i mtsho kha nas reb gong gru ba tshogs drug rang grol gyis 'jig rten glu ba'i glu ltar du blangs pa'o//bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas rnams/ /spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /'dir 'dus dpon slob yon bdag rnams/ /yang yang phrad par byin gyis rlobs/ /ya ki dgung sngon nam mkha' dang / /de la 'khor ba'i nyi zla gnyis/ /gnas skabs phan tshun 'brel ba bzang / /dgung sngon sku khams bde bar bzhugs/ /nyi zla gling gzhan bskor du 'gro/ /dgung sngon sprin gyis mi bsgrib cing / /nyi zla gza' yis mi zin par/ /yang dang yang du phrad par shog /pha ki'i brag stod mthon po dang / /de la 'khor ba'i bya rgod gnyis/ /gnas skabs phan tshun 'brel ba bzang / /brag stod sku khams bde bar bzhugs/ /bya rgod mkha' la 'phur nas 'gro/ /brag stod thog gis mi bshig cing / /bya rgod snyi yis mi 314

zin par/ /yang dang yang du phrad par shog /ldum rar 'khrungs pa'i me tog dang / /de la 'khor ba'i bung ba gnyis/ /gnas skabs phan tshun 'brel ba bzang / /me tog sku khams bde bar bzhugs/ /bung ba 'phur nas gzhan du 'gro//me tog sad kyis mi khyer zhing //bung ba ser bas mi bcom par//yang dang yang du phrad par shog /shar phyogs chu bo gaṅgā dang //de la 'khor ba'i nya mo gnyis/ /gnas skabs phan tshun 'brel ba bzang / /gaṅgā sku khams bde bar bzhugs/ /nya mo rgya mtsho 'grim du 'gro//gaṅgā'i chu rgyun mi 'chad cing //nya mo lcags kyus mi zin par//yang dang yang du phrad par shog /'tsho ba sbyor ba'i yon bdag dang //de la 'khor ba'i sgom chen gnyis/ /gnas skabs phan tshun 'brel ba bzang //mdo yi yon bdag bde bar bzhugs//sgom chen phu yi brag la 'gro//yon bdag pho mo mi 'chi zhing //sgom chen nga yang mi 'das par/ /yang dang yang du phrad par shog /ces pa 'di yang rma chen gangs la 'gro khar slob ma yon bdag rnams la bde zhus su smras pa'o//na mo gu ru/ skya sa le nam mkha' langs byung / /nga 'dzam gling nyi ma'i skyid pa/ /'od mu mtha' med par bkye nas/ /gling bzhi bo bskor la chas 'gro/ /dbyar nam zla rim gyis slebs byung //nga me tog pad+ma'i skyid pa//'dab 'jam mnyen mdzes pa 315

brgyangs nas/ /skyabs dkon mchog drung du chas 'gro/ /tshe 'di ni blo yis btang byung / /nga bya btang ras pa'i skyid pa/ /chos nyams len byed bzhin ngang nas/ /gnas ri khrod dben par chas 'gro /zhes pa 'di ni tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//mchod 'os skyabs gyur rnams la phyag 'tshal nas/ /bstan 'gror phan pa'i smon lam rnam dag gdab/ /bdag gis dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyes 'grub par shog /bdag ni mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /skye ba gsum las mi 'gyang 'tshang rgya shog /bdag gi lus dang longs spyod gar song sar/ /rtag tu chos dang bkra shis 'phel bar shog /bdag gi 'dra sku bzhengs pa mthong tshad kyis//dben par gong ma'i rnam thar skyong bar shog /'dra sku gar yod khyem du bkra shis 'khyil//nad gdon nyer 'tshe'i ming yang med par shog /bdag gis mgur dbyangs gang blangs 'jig rten du/ /'khor ba ma stongs bar du gnas par shog /gang gis lus kyi phyag skor tsam byas na/ /de yi lus kyi sgrib pa dag par shog/ngag gis dbyangs byas mgur tshan gcig bton kyang //de yi ngag gi sgrib pa dag par shog /yid kyis dad gus bsam sgom gang byas kyang / /de yi yid kyi sgrib pa dag par shog /gang gis 316

mchod cing bkur ste byed pa de/ /skye 'gro yongs kyis mchod cing bkur bar shog /phyogs bcur spel nas dar rgyas mdzad pa yis/ /rnam dkar 'phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /mdor na mgur 'bum mthong thos dran reg kun/ /gnas skabs skyid cing mthar thug 'tshang rgya shog /ces pa 'di ni tshogs drug rang grol gyis lhag bsam rnam par dag pas nyin zhig smon lam btab pa'o//'gro rgyud smin cing grol bar mdzad pa yi/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol mdzad pa'i/ /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad kun sel ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i bkra shis shog /chos kyi 'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen sgrub/ /yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyi bkra shis shog /mi la na tsha med pa'i bkra shis shog /phyugs la god kha med pa'i bkra shis shog /zhing la sad ser med pa'i bkra shis shog /dus 'khrug mu ge med pa'i bkra shis shog /lo legs 'bru nor 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog /tshe ring longs spyod rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /bde ldan zhing bzhin skyid pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis bris pa'o//rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun zhabs dkar rdo rje 'chang chen pos mchog dman bar ma'i gdul byar gang la gang 'tsham gyi rdo rje'i mgur dpag tu med pa bzhengs pa yi ger 'khod 317

pa'i nang tshan las/ mtsho snying ma hā de ba'i gnas nas yul phyogs gdul byas zhus lan chab shog gi skor tsho de tha ma'o/ /mtsho snying nas mgur tshan chig stong lhag tsam zhig yi ger 'khod snang kyang / dam pa 'di nyid bya bral gyi brtul zhugs 'ba' zhig lhur bzhes pa'i skabs yin gshis do dam ma mdzad/gzhan bka' bsdu ba por nges 'jog cher ma byung snang / 'on kyang bla ma pad+ma rang grol gyis mgur tshan gcig par du brko bar mdzad pas 'gro don cher 'phel kyang /mgur phal mo che'i ma phyi gzhan gyis dad rten du khyer nas rgyun 'byams su 'gro la nye ba na/ dam pa gang gi zhabs sen dge mtshan gyi pad+mo mdo smad sa'i thig ler rnam par bkod pa dang sngon gyi thugs smon dar ba'i mthu las ma phyi phal mo che phyag tu son pa/ sngon bsags legs byas kyi mthu brtas shing dam pa du ma'i gsung gi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba bslab pa gsum gyis thugs rgyud gtams shing / rdzab shar sor bcu'i 'khrul 'khor bsgyur bar rkyen pa'i nyang gi mtshams pa mchog gis/ ma 'ongs da lta'i gdul byar sman pa'i lhag bsam gyis glegs bam du bsdu bgyis pa rjes su yi rang ba'i gnas lags shing / ma phyi rnams stabs gcig tu ma byung gshis go rim cung zad 'chol ba rnams7skyabs gcig 'khor lo'i mgon po'i zhal gyi 'bab stegs las 'ongs pa bzhin nges pa can du pu sta ga'i pad mtshor skyil ba po ni/ dam pa gang gi bka' 'bangs kyi tha shal rmongs brtul sangs rgyas rin chen gyi sor bcu'i 'du byed las so/ /da dung yang mtsho snying gi mgur tshan bzhi brgyar nye ba zhig ma phyi ma rnyed pas phyis nas rnyed na gong 'og gang du gzhug dgos pa sgrin po'i blos legs par dpyad de 'jug par zhu zhes rjes 'jug mchog dman rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa lags pas dgongs 'tshal/ /318

sa bcu'i dbang phyug rma chen sbom ra'i gangs ri'i mgul nas bzhengs pa'i skor/bka' dang dgongs 'grel tshig don kun mkhyen nas/ /bka' chos stsol mkhas chos rgyal ngag dbang wang / /bka' las cung zad mi 'da' ri khrod nas/ /bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i bu nga'i spyi bor bzhugs/ /bstan pa'i bdag po sangs rgyas snyigs dus 'dir/ /bstan 'dzin bshes gnyen tshul 'dzin bla mas chos/ /bstan bzhin nyams len byed pa'i ri ba ngas/ /bstan 'gro yongs la phan par byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag 'dra'i bris sku mthong ba'i 'gro ba rnams/ /lus kyi na tsha sems kyi sdug bsngal kun/ /nye bar zhi nas lus la bde ba dang / /sems la dga' spro 'char bar byen gyis rlobs/ /rang gi rgyud la phan pa'i glu dbyangs dang / /gzhan gyi rgyud la phan slad glu blangs pa/ /dngos dang brgyud nas rang dang 'gro ba gzhan/ /kun gyi rgyud la phan par byin kyis rlobs/ /sa phyogs gang du'ang mgur 'bum 319

glegs bam gnas/ /sa der bkra mi shis pa'i ming mi grag /sa yi rtsi bcud lo tog 'phel zhing rgyas/ /sa steng dge legs khyab par byen gyis rlobs/ /mdor na bdag dang bdag gis glu blangs pa/ /mthong thos 'bri 'don klog 'chang byed pa rnams/ /gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thugs sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang myur du thob par byen gyes rlobs/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i dge ba dang / /gzhan yang rang gis gang bsags dge ba'i mthus/ /gangs can bod du skyes pa'i glu ba nga'i/ /ci bsam thams cad de bzhin 'grub par shog /brgyud gsum rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad la/ /sgo gsum rab tu gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i bdag gzhan gyi/ /sku gsum go 'phang thob par byen gyis rlobs/ /dbyar gsum ston gsum dgun gsum dpyid gsum dus/ /rdza phug g.ya' phug sa phug brag phug bsten/ /gos ngan lham ngan zas ngan ja ngan 'thung / /dpon med g.yog med grogs med nor med ngas/ /nyon mongs nad kyi na ba rang nyid la//mdo sngags dam chos sman gyi mdzod bslogs nas/ /glu dbyangs thun chung byas nas sman 'ga' ster/ /nyon mongs nad ma sos rung bsam pa red/ /grong khyim tsig khung ban 320

rgan bung ba yis/ /'grims na chags sdang rgya ru tshud nyen che/ /mtshan ldan bla ma dri med me tog gi /mdo sngags gsung chos bcud bzang 'thungs na legs/ /yon tan stobs zhan ban rgan byis pa yis/ /rgyal sras spyod pa'i khur chen mi theg rung / /bsam pa thag pas 'khur ba'i grabs gyis dang / /rgyal sras pha mas mthong na brtse zhing byams/ /sems nyid zhing sar sems bskyed sa bon thobs//thabs dang shes rab chu lud drod gsher gyes/ /skyongs dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'bras bu smin/ /tshe 'di'i bde skyid sog ma zhor la 'byung / /sos dal sdod dus gnyen po'i gri chung rdor/ /stobs ldan nyon mongs dgra bos dbang med du/ /'og tu bcug tshe 'og nas gri chung gis/ /gtsags pa gnyom chung lugs yin gtsags thub ltos/ /'di'i mtshon rnam dkar dge ba'i zhing sa la//bden tshig smon lam sa bon mang bo 'debs/ /phun tshogs bde skyid lo legs 'bras smin nas/ /rang gzhan kun gyes rtag tu longs spyod thog /cesapa 'di ni ban rgan rang la smras pa'o//ri bo rma chen gye dbu rtse'i gangs dkar khyod//mtshan ldan bla ma de yin na dga' ba la//gangs ri'i ra ba na 'gro ba'i 'brong chung khyod//dad can slob ma nga yin na skyid pa la//dwangs bsil 321

mtsho chung kha'i ngang ba ser bo khyod/ /chos mthun grogs po de yin na dga' ba la/ /me tog rtse mo na 'khor ba'i bung ba khyod/ /snod ldan slob ma de yin na skyid pa la/ /spang gzhongs 'jam po na nyal ba'i rkyang bu khyod/ /rgas pa'i a ma de yin na dga' ba la/ /g.ya' spang mtshams shig na rgyu ba'i dgo khyu khyod/ /dad can yon bdag tsho yin na skyid pa la//bla ma a ma grogs slob bu yon bdag dang / /lhan cig yud tsam bsdad so sor gyes nas song //chos rnams thams cad po mi rtag 'di dang 'dra/ /'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i lus 'di yang mi rtag 'jig /tshe 'di'i mi nor zas chags zhen ma byed par//dam pa'i lha chos kyis tshogs drug rang grol ang / /glu 'di phyi rol gyi snang bas rkyen byas nas/ /ri bo rma chen gyi gangs ri'i 'dabs nas blangs//na mo gu ru/ ya ki stong gsal gyi nam mkha' yangs pa na/ /'od stong phyogs bcu ru 'phro ba'i nyi ma khyod//'gro mgon sangs rgyas de yin na dga' ba la/ /bod la chos 'khor zhig bskor bar bskul na ang / /lho nub phyogs kyi ri'i rtse mo'i nam mkha' na/ /'o ma 'phyur ba bzhin lding ba'i sprin dkar khyod/ /pad 'byung yab sras tsho yin na skyid pa la/ /rdzogs pa chen po yi lta khrid zhus na ang //shar phyogs ri bo yi rtse mo'i nam mkha' na/ /322

zho gsar spungs pa bzhin langs pa'i sprin dkar khyod/ /mi la yab sras tsho yin na dga' ba la//phyag rgya chen po yi lta khrid zhus na ang / /steng phyogs nam mkha' na dar yug dkar bo zhig /phyogs bzhir brgyangs pa ltar 'then pa'i sprin dkar khyod/ /blo bzang yab sras tsho yin na skyid pa la//dbu ma chen mo yi lta khrid zhus na ang / /zhes pa 'di ni nyin zhig snga dro phyogs phyogs nas sprin langs pa dang lding ba mthong tshe gangs dkar ri bo rma chen nas blangs pa'o//'od gsal nyi ma de nam mkhar shar/ /'od kyis phyogs mtshams kun khyab pa mthong //o rgyan pad+ma de bod du byon/ /rgyal bstan btsugs pa'i tshul yid la shar/ /bya rgyal rgod po zhig mdun mkhar 'ongs//nam mkhar yar yar du bstod pa mthong //grub chen mi la khong bod du byon/ /grub rtags bstan pa'i tshul yid la shar/ /dngul dkar mdog 'dra'i sprin nam mkhar 'khrigs//sbrang char 'jam po zhig babs pa mthong / /rje btsun tsong kha pa bod du byon//chos char phab pa'i tshul de yid la shar//'dzam gling nyi ma de 'od lam lam/ /nub phyogs ri skyibs su yibs pa mthong //slob dpon pad 'byung khong zangs mdog gi /dpal rir gshegs pa'i tshul yid la shar/ /bya rgyal rgod po yis 'dab gshog brgyangs/ /bzhud nas shar phyogs su 'gro ba 323

mthong //grub chen mi la khong mngon dga' yi//zhing du gshegs pa'i tshul yid la shar/ /dngul dkar mdog 'dra'i sprin g.yo 'gul byas/ /steng phyogs nam mkha' la thum pa mthong rje btsun blo bzang khong dga' ldan gyi//zhing du gshegs pa'i tshul yid la shar//'chi med rdo rje yi sku brnyes kyang //rtag 'dzin can rnams chos bskul phyir du/ /'gro mgon de gsum gyis mi rtag pa'i/ /rnam 'gyur bstan pa'i tshul yid la shar/ /rang lus mi rtag par 'jig par nges/ /'jig rten mi chos spangs chos bsgrubs nas/ /phyi ma 'gro mgon gsum bzhugs pa'i zhing / /gsum du 'gro 'dod cig yid la shar//zhes pa 'di yang phyi rol gyi snang bas rkyen byas nas yid la shar ba ltar gangs ri'i ra ba nas blangs pa'o//zhing 'di yi gdul bya smin grol bkod/ /zhing mang bo'i lha yis bsu skyel mdzad/ /zhing gzhan gshegs chos rgyal ngag dbang wang / /zhing gang na bzhugs kyang bu la gzigs/ /mtsho dbyar dus dar zhing rgyas pa'i tshe//rgyan chu bya pho mos byas pas mdzes//dgun 'gram dar rim gyes chags tsa na//rgyan chu bya pho mo bral nas thal/ /shing yal ga lo ma rgyas pa'i tshe/ /rgyan me tog 'bras bus byas pas mdzes/ /ston ser skyar rim gyes song tsa na/ /rgyan me tog 'bras bur bral nas thal/ /rang gzhon nu sha 324

khrag rgyas pa'i tshe/ /rgyan bla ma pha mas byas pas mdzes da stobs mdangs rim gyis nyams tsa na/ /rgyan bla ma pha mar bral nas thal/ /chos thams cad mi rtag 'di dang 'dra/ /chos gsung mkhan bla ma'i bka' bzhin du/ /chos myur du sgrubs dang ri khrod pa/ /chos sgrub rten lus 'di rgas nas thal/ /ri rma rgyal mgul nas dgong dus shig /sems skyo ba'i rta zhig rnyed nas zhon/ /mgur snyan mo'i lcag 'dis brabs pa'i mod/ /chos zab rgya'i lam la khur nas thal//na mo gu ru/ spang ser bo gser gyi bum bzang mgul/ /rlangs na bun gos kyis dkris pa de/ /sus gar khyer med par yal nas song / /'dis rkyen byas mi rtag dran nas byung / /zhing bde 'jam rin chen maṇ+ḍal gyi/ /steng snye ma g.yu yi tshom bus brgyan//de zhing bdag chom rkun byung nas khyer//'dis rkyen byas mi rtag dran nas byung / /shing 'dab rgyas tshong ra yangs pa na/ /'bras me tog lo ma'i khrom chen 'tshogs/ /kun mi sdod phyogs bzhir thor nas song //'dis rkyen byas mi rtag dran nas byung //steng lha lam yangs pa'i lhas 'jam na//sprin dkar nag rta nor nyal ba rnams/ /rlung jag chen glo bur byung nas ded/ /'dis rkyen byas mi rtag dran nas byung / /ri klung gi pha yul nyams 325

dga' na/ /bya khu byug bu mo 'dug pa de/ /yul cha med thag ring gnas su song / /'dis rkyen byas mi rtag dran nas byung / /steng chu 'dzin phyug po'i sbra gur na/ /'brug a mchod chos kyi sgra sgrog pa/ /yar rdza gseb rang gi yul du phebs/ /'dis rkyen byas mi rtag dran nas byung //shar ri bo rgya gar 'phags yul na//steng nyi ma sangs rgyas byon pa de//nub ri bo 'og min zhing du gshegs//'dis rkyen byas mi rtag dran nas byung / /yul pha yul mgron khang nyams dga' na/ /pha ma sogs mgron po rnying ba'i rigs/ /su mi 'dug mgron chung gsar ba snang / /'dis rkyen byas mi rtag dran nas byung //nga ban rgan rgyal mtshan rtse mo yi/ /rje bla ma yid bzhin nor bu'i tog /zhing gzhan gyi gdul bya'i rgyan du gyur/ /'dis rkyen byas mi rtag dran nas byung / /rang sgyu lus gnyom chung ri dwags kyi//phyi lo zla zhag gi rngon pas ded//mdun na 'chi'i g.yang sar sleb la khad//da skyo 'jigs sna tshogs dran nas byung //zhes pa 'di yang skyo shas than thun skyes dus shig tu bris pa'o//sku la mtshan dang dpe byad yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /sku gsum mchog brnyes phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas las//sku drin che ba'i rtsa ba'i bla ma yi/ /sku tshe 'di yi gdul bya rdzogs pa'i mod/ /sku la bgres rgud med rung bgres pa'i tshul/ /sku la skye 'chi med rung 326

'das pa'i tshul/ /sku de mig gis mthong rgya'i skal ba chad/ /sku bzhugs dus su bka' chos gnang tshul dang / /sku mdun song nas phyag g.yas mgo thog blangs/ /sku gzugs bde mo lags zhes zhus pa'i tshe/ /sku zhal 'dzum nas gsung snyan 'byon pa'i tshul//sku mi bzhugs kyang da lta yid la shar//sku gsum thugs kyi yon tan mtha' dag dang / /sku drin rang la che tshul dran pa'i mod/ /sku yi bkod pa chos dbyings bsdus song kyang / /sku gzugs nyi ma 'dra ba yid la shar/ /sku drin 'khor med mtshan ldan bla ma la/ /sku tshe 'di ru mi mjal kho thag chod/ /sku skyes 'khrul med phyogs 'dir myur byon nas/ /sku gzugs de la mjal ba'i smon lam 'tshal/ /ces pa 'di yang bla ma chos rgyal dran nas blangs pa'o//na mo gu ru/ phyogs bzhi'i nam mkha' na gyen du/ /langs pa'i sprin dkar gyi tshogs rnams/ /zhig nas rang yal la song ba/ /mthong tshe mi rtag pa dran byung / /shar gyi ri mgo nas shar ba'i/ /'od gsal 'dzam gling gi nyi ma//nub phyogs ri skyibs su 'gro ba/ /mthong tshe mi rtag pa dran byung / /bar snang yangs pa na shar ba'i//kha dog lnga ldan gyi 'ja' tshon//yun ring mi sdod par yal ba/ /mthong tshe mi rtag pa dran byung / /rdza ri mthon po yi 327

mgul du//smug pa ske rags ltar 'then pa//mi sdod rang yal la song ba//mthong tshe mi rtag pa dran byung //bde 'jam zhing chen gye steng gi /lo yag snye ma yi tshogs rnams/ /khyem pas zor ba yis 'breg pa/ /mthong tshe mi rtag pa dran byung/ /ljon shing yal ga rnams rgyas pa'i/ /rtse mo'i lo ma dang me tog /'bras bu phyogs mtshams su thor ba/ /mthong tshe mi rtag pa dran byung //drod gsher 'dzom sa ru skyes pa'i//rab mdzes me tog gi 'dab ma//nyi ma kha shas 'a phror lhung ba/ /mthong tshe mi rtag pa dran byung / /zhes pa 'di nyid kyang gangs can/ /bod kyi glu ba ngas blangs so//na mo gu ru/ tshong ra yangs pa'i dkyil na//mi mang khrom chen 'tshogs pa/ /mi sdod phyogs bzhir gyes nas/ /song tshe mi rtag dran byung / /mgron khang nang na 'dug pa'i/ /mgron po rnying ba chas nas/ /phyogs phyogs lam la zhugs pa/ /mthong tshe mi rtag dran byung / /bde 'jam yangs ba'i lhas na/ /rta nor lug gsum nyal ba/ /rdzi bos ded nas ri khar/ /song tshe mi rtag dran byung / /ri klung chu chen mtsho kha'i/ /khu byug chu bya ngang ba/ /mi sdod yul gzhan 'phur nas/ /song tshe mi rtag dran byung //chu 'dzin mthing sngon gseb na/ /g.yu 'brug sgra dbyangs sgrog pa/ /mi sdod sbrang char 'bab bzhin/ /song tshe mi rtag dran byung / /drin can pha 328

ma'i rtsa na/ /'dug pa'i na chung bu mo/ /cha med thag ring gnas su/ /song tshe mi rtag dran byung / /sgra rgan mthing smug phu na/ /a mchod chos sgra sgog pa//mi sdod rang gi yul du//phebs tshe mi rtag dran byung / /dgon chung nyams dga'i nang gi /ban chung gzhon nu 'ga' re/ /dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du/ /song tshe mi rtag dran byung //rang skyes pha yul nyams dga'i//mthun grogs gnyen bshes phalacher/ /mi mthong 'jig rten phyi mar/ /song tshe mi rtag dran byung / /khri stan mthon po'i steng nas/ /zab rgya'i chos char 'bab mkhas/ /bla ma mang po zhing gzhan/ /gshegs tshe mi rtag dran byung //zhes pa 'di yang gangs can bod kyi glu dbyangs mkhan gyis blangs pa'o//'od gsal 'dzam gling nyi ma/ /shar nas nub rir yibs song / /nyam chung pad dkar lus po/ /grang reg ba mos mnan byung / /dbyar skyes chu 'dzin sngon mo/ /'phyur nas nam mkhar yal song / /nyam chung khu byug lus po/ /skom tshad drag pos gdungs byung / /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma/ /byon nas zhing gzhan gshegs song / /nyam chung slob bu'i lus po/ /rgas pa'i mtshan mas mnan song //zhes pa 'di yang yid la shar ba bris pa'o//'bri mo bzang mo'i tshogs rnams snga phyi byas/ /mi mthong spang ri ser bor bzhud nas thal/ /skal dman 'bri phrug rtod phur rtsa 329

bar lus/ /song na 'dod kyang rke nas thag pas bzung //sdod ma tshugs par skabs skabs 'jen skor byas/ /'bri mo bzang bo'e 'o mas ma bskyangs na/ /yun ring rtod phur rtsa nas su yis bzod/ /'bri yis 'bri phrug spang ri ser bor drongs/ /bya rgyal rgod po'i tshogs rnams snga phyi byas//mi mthong da gung sngon mkha' la 'phur nas thal//skal dman rgod phrug brag dmar dkyil du lus/ /song na 'dod kyang mtha' na brag gis bskor/ /sdod ma tshugs par skabs skabs lhab lhab byas//bya rgyal rgod pos zas kyis ma bskyangs na/ /yun ring brag dmar dkyil nas su yis bzod/ /rgod pos rgod phrug dgung sngon mkha' la drongs/ /drin can bla ma'i tshogs rnams snga phyi byas//mi mthong dag zhing gzhan du gshegs nas thal/ /skal dman slob bu 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir lus//song na 'od kyang las nyon gnyis kyis mnan//sdod ma tshugs par skabs skabs gsol 'debs byas/ /drin can bla ma'i thugs rjes ma bskyangs na/ /yun ring 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir su yis bzod/ /bla mas slob ma dag pa'i zhing du drongs/ /zhes pa 'di yang chos 'brel che ba'i bla ma du ma gshegs pa la skyo nas blangs pa'o//steng stong sang nam mkha' yangs pa la/ /dngul mdog 'dra'i na bun langs pa bzhin/ /phyogs kun khyab nam mkha'i 330

klong yangs nas//rje bla ma'i gzugs sku bstan na ang //mdog rab mdzes 'ja' tshon ri mo 'then/ /char 'jam po dal bur babam pa bzhin//'ja' 'od lnga'i gur khyem zhig nang nas//chos zab mo mang bo gsungs na ang / /sa bde 'jam yangs pa'i spang gzhongs su//char ji babs steng du 'khyil ba bzhin/sems dad gus che ba'i slob bu ngas//chos gang gsungs yid la bzung na ang / /mdog rab mdzes me tog sna tshogs pa/ /spang bde 'jam steng du skye ba bzhin/ /nyams rtogs pa'i yon tan sna tshogs pa/ /bu bdag gi rgyud la skyes na ang / /zhes pa 'di yang nyin zhig phyi'i snang bas rkyen byas nas blangs pa'o//rje mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /zhing dag pa rab 'byams gar bzhugs kyang / /bus rgyang nas 'bod do thugs rjes gzigs//sprang ri khrod zin par byin gyes rlobs//zhal thog mar mjal ba'i dus skabs su/ /thugs brtse bas rjes 'dzin drin can rje//da zhing khams gzhan du gshegs bud song //nga mgon med skal dman dben par 'gro/ /yon kha btags min pa ma mchis kyang / /lung dbang 'khrid gnang ba'i drin can rje/ /da zhing khams gzhan du gshegs bud song / /nga mgon med skal dman dben par 'gro/ /rang nyer mkho'i mchod rdzas dpe cha 331

sogs/ /gang dgos pa khyer gsung drin can rje/ /da zhing khams gzhan du gshegs bud song / /nga mgon med skal dman dben par 'gro/ /chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen lto gos gnyis/ /zhu mi dgos gnang ba'i drin can rje/ /da zhing khams gzhan du gshegs bud song //nga mgon med skal dman dben par 'gro//nam mdun du song yang skal byin nas/ /gsung zhal ta gnang ba'i drin can rje/ /da zhing khams gzhan du gshegs bud song / /nga mgon med skal dman dben par 'gro//lus mgo na cham pa tsam byung yang / /sngags bka' bsgo byed pa'i drin can rje/ /da zhing khams gzhan du gshegs bud song / /nga mgon med skal dman dben par 'gro/ /zhag lo zla'i 'phro la mjal ba'i dus/ /bzhin mdzum gyis bsu ba'i drin can rje/ /da zhing khams gzhan du gshegs bud song / /nga mgon med skal dman dben par 'gro/ /phyogs gang du bsdad kyang 'tshams rtags dang / /gsung zhal gdams bskur ba'i drin can rje/ /da zhing khams gzhan du gshegs bud song //nga mgon med skal dman dben par 'gro//lus bskyed pa'i drin can pha ma las/ /ches lhag pa'i drin che'i drin can rje/ /da zhing khams gzhan du gshegs bud song / /nga mgon med skal med dben par 'gro/ /zhal mjal bar dka' 332

ba'i drin can rje//gsung thos par dka' ba'i drin can rje/ /da zhing khams gzhan du gshegs bud song / /nga mgon med skal dman dben par 'gro//lo kha shas da dung bzhugs na ched/ /bu shul lus las 'di ngan re ang / /dus da bar zhing khams gzhan na bzhugs/ /zhing gzhan de'i gdul bya'i skyid la ang / /pha khyed la spyan dang mngon shes mnga'//bus pha ma 'bod 'dra'i gdung dbyangs kyis/ /bdag mos gus drag pos gsol ba 'debs//sprang ri khrod thub par byin gyis rlobs//rje sangs rgyas kun las drin lhag pa'i/ /rje chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang wang / /rje 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho la sogs pa'i/ /rje bla ma rnams la gus pas 'dud/ /dngul shel mdog na bun skabs skabs su/ /ri'i sked nas lding ba'i khrod cig na/ /sa phun tshogs phug pa mdog legs pa/ /dpe lha bzo mkhas pas bris 'dra yod/ /g.yu baiḍūr+ya yi mdangs 'dzin pa'i/ /nags shin tu nyams dga'i khrod cig na/ /shing yal 'dab rgyas pa'i bsil khang ni/ /dpe steng nas gdugs bzhin phub 'dra yod/ /dung zho gsar spungs ltar rab dkar ba'i/ /ri gangs kyis brgyan pa'i khrod cig na/ /skyibs rab mdzes phug pa mdo yangs pa/ /dpe 'bag bzo mkhas pas bzhengs 'dra yod/ /mtshal byu ru lta bur 333

mdog mdzes pa'i/ /brag mtho zhing brjid pa'i khrod cig na//gnas byin chags phug pa sra brtan pa//dpe rdo bzo bzang bos las 'dra yod/ /mdog mi gcig rin chen spungs 'dra ba'i/ /rdza khra mo spungs ba'i khrod cig na/ /sa g.yang chags phug pa phu yangs pa//dpe rang la gzes nas las 'dra yod//rtswa sngo ljang me tog skyes pa yi/ /spang bde 'jam yangs pa'i khrod cig na/ /sa bde 'jam cog pu 'bub sa'i spang / /dpe gos chen sa la brdal 'dra yod/ /phyogs chu phran lhung lhung nang du 'bab/ /bya ngang bas brgyan pa'i mtsho dkyil dang //phyi'i 'gram na sgrub phug nyams dga' ba/ /dpe lha mi'i rgyal pos brtsigs 'dra yod/ /tshe 'di yi bya ba blo yis btang / /gnas de 'dra bsten nas chos byed mi/ /'phral nyams dga' bde skyid snyan gsum 'byung / /phugs sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob par 'gyur/ /sa gangs can bod kyi glu ba ngas/ /sa dben pa bsten slad mgur 'di blangs//sa gang gi mi yis thos tshad kyis/ /sa phun tshogs ri khrod bsten par shog/bla ma rnasam la gsol ba 'debs/ /ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs//e ma ri khrod dben pa na//spos ngad dri bzang chi li li/ /dkar ser dmar ljang me tog rtser/ /bung ba che chung di ri 334

ri/ /ri sul spang gzhongs 'jam po na//ri dwags bang rtsal sha ra ra//ljon shing yal 'dab rgyas pa'i rtser//bya bye'u skad snyan kyu ru ru/ /ri brag rtse mo'i sked pa na/ /bya rgod 'khor ba kyi li li/ /sprin 'ja' nyi ma dus gcig 'dzoms/ /sbrang char babs pa da la la//dri bzhon bser bu byung ba'i tshe/ /rtsi shing lo 'dab khri li li/ /chu chen mtsho khar chu bya 'dus/ /skad 'byen gshog sprugs so lo lo /gangs rdza g.ya' dang brag ngos na//chu gtsang lhung sgra si li li de ltar ngo mtshar mtha' yas pa'i/ /ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /'dug pa'i skye bo skal ba bzang / /yon tan nyi shu'i yong sgo yod/ /'jig rten bya ba med pas dal/ /chags sdang la sogs nyon mongs chung / /mi dge sdig pa'i las mi gsog /log 'tsho dkor gyes gos mi 'gyur/ /gang la'ang chags zhen sems mi 'byung / /skye bo mang bo'i 'du 'dzi med/ /zog dang tshul 'chos ngang gis 'grib/ /ngo srung sems 'dzin byed mi dgos/ /phan tshun rtsod pa med pas bde/ /lus la na zug sems sdug med/ /mtshan mo gnyid chung rig pa dwangs/ /dus bzhi 'gyur dus mi rtag dran/ /dad dang nges 'byung gsar du skye/ /sdom pa gsum dang ngang gis ldan//mi rtog ting 'dzin shugs kyis skye/ /rgyun du nyams dga' snang ba spro/ /bla ma mkha' 'gro byin gyis rlobs/ /335

nyams rtogs yon tan rgyud la 'char//chos skyong srung mas bar chad sel/ /lha mis zas gos mthun rkyen sbyor/ /rtag tu lus sems bde zhing skyid/ /snyan pas sa steng yongs la khyab/ /sgrub brgyud bstan par phan thogs 'gyur/ /de phyir tshogs drug rang grol khyod/ /rtag tu ri khrod dben pa sten/ /glu 'di thos tshad thams cad kyis//ri khrod bsten nas chos byed shog /bla ma rnams la gus phyag 'tshal//ri khrod zin par byen gyis rlobs/ /rtag tu khyim pa'i grong bar na/ /'a 'ur zang zing 'u ru ru/ /khyem tshang bzang ba 'khon 'dzing byed/ /byis pa'i ngu skad tse re re/ /mal na rgan rgon bla rgan 'khun//'ga' res sdug gtam shub shub shub/ /re'u lu gus 'then skor byas/ /rdang nag 'ba' sgra di ri ri/ /'ga' re na nas sku rim btsugs/ /ban bon ḍa dril khro lo lo/ /'ga' res mo ba sman pa bos/ /lag pa kha tsho yab yab yab/ /'ga' res me sbar yos brngos nas/ /mu ge'i lag skor khyog khyog khyog /khyim na 'ga' res med mug dang / /chags sdang gtam ngan lhang lhang lhang //sgo khye phyugs kyis sgra sgrog cing //khwa skyag pho rog lhab lhab lhab/ /khang chag sbra chad gur rul na/ /thigs chu bser bu shugs shugs shugs/ /de 'dra'i grong du su bsdad kyang //nyes skyon nyi shu tsam zhig 'ongs/ /tshe 'di'i dbang 336

song chos mi dran/ /mi rtag 'chi ba gting nas brjed/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug skye/ /nga rgyal phrag dog ser sna 'phel/ /srog gcod gzhan gyis ma byin len/ /mi tshangs pa spyod nan tshig smra/ /phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal dang / /brnab sems gnod sems log lta skye/ /mi 'dod gyod sna kha mchu 'ong / /gleng log 'then nas zas nor 'phrog /dbang can rnams kyis tshig gis bsdig /shed can rnams kyis lag gis brdung / /jag pas rgyu nom dngos su 'phrog /rkun mas lkog tu brkus nas khyer/ /nyin par lto bcag 'tsho skyong dgos/ /mtshan mo gnyid bcag lta rtog dgos/ /'chi rung dmag la 'gro yang dgos/ /dgra la dgra skad 'then yang dgos/ /log 'tsho dkor zas za yang dgos/ /tshul 'chos g.yo sgyu byed yang dgos/ /mi snyan tshin ngan sna tshogs thos/ /sems la nam yang bde ba med/ /mi tshe yad ma yud la 'chor/ /de phyir tshogs drug rang grol khyod/ /grong du ma 'khyams ri khrod 'grims//glu 'di thos tshad thams cad kyis//grong spangs ri khrod bsten par shog /sngon ri khrod dben par chos mdzad dang //da ri khrod nyams dgar chos sgrub mkhan//khong ri khrod pa rnams yongs la 'dud//sprang ri khrod zin par byin gyes rlobs/ /bya khu byug lha bya gong mo 337

dang / /bye'u lcog ka 'jol mo mthing sngon sogs/ /bya bye'u chung snyan pa'i sgra sgrog pa'i/ /gnas dben pa sten dang rgyal khams pa/ /shing ljon pa'i bsil grib gdugs ltar mdzes/ /rtswa sngo ljang skyes pa stan ltar 'jam/ /zas rang grub sil thog yod pa yi/ /gnas dben pa sten dang rgyal khams pa/ /spang bde 'jam dri zhim sna tshogs 'thul//mdog mi gcig me tog gcal du bkram//lha'i gos chen sa la lhung 'dra ba'i/ /gnas dben pa sten dang rgyal khams pa/ /lus gshog steng ri mo sna tshogs bkra//rkang drug ldan sbrang ma phye leb sogs/ /'bu du ma 'a 'ur sgra sgog pa'i/ /gnas dben pa sten dang rgyal khams pa/ /dri zhim pa'i lha shing shug pa sogs//shing ljon pa'i tshogs rnams sngo shig se/ /re yal 'dab brgyangs nas gar byed pa'i/ /gnas dben pa sten dang rgyal khams pa/ /sha dgo ba rkyang 'brong rna ba sogs/ /lus mdog dbyibs mi gcig ri dwags tshogs/ /yid bag phebs rgyu zhing bang rtse ba'i/ /gnas dben pa sten dang rgyal khams pa/ /chu dwangs gsal rnyog med chung chung gis/ /rdza g.ya' brag them skas nyams dga' 'grims/ /sgra snyan mo si li li byed pa'i/ /gnas dben pa sten dang rgyal khams pa//brag phyi dbyibs kha dog shin tu legs/ /nang brag khung yangs la sra zhing brtan/ /lus tsha grang 338

'jig pa las skyob pa'i/ /gnas dben pa sten dang rgyal khams pa//dri zhim po dro ba'i shug shun sogs//mdog sngo la 'jam pa'i bkra shis rtswa/ /stan sngas 'bol byas na lus bde ba'i/ /gnas dben pa sten dang rgyal khams pa//gnas dben pa bsten slad 'di blangs mthus/ /gnas ri khrod kun gyis bsten nus shing / /gnas gang du 'gro 'am 'dug kyang rung / /sprang ri khrod dben par bsgom du gshegs/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas dang / /khong rgya bod mkhas grub thams cad kyis/ /gnas dben pa'i bsngags brjod mang bo mdzad/ /sbrang ri khrod dben par bsgom du gshegs/ /dus da lta'i skyes chen dam pa'i rigs/ /bstan 'gro don mdzad pa phal cher gyis/ /gnas ri khrod dben par yid smon byed//sprang ri khrod dben par bsgom du gshegs//mi bdag gi bla ma rin po che/ /mtshan snyan pa bstan 'dzin nyi ma dang / /grogs slob bu mang bo dben par bzhugs/ /sprang ri khrod dben par bsgom du gshegs/ /chos tshul bzhin bsgrub 'dod skye bo kun//rang nam 'chi cha med tshul soms la//da ma 'dug tshe 'di blo yis thongs/ /gnas ri khrod dben par bsgom du byon/ /gnas dben pa bsten la dus kun tu/ /dgra nang na nyal ba'i bdag 'dzin la/ /pha bla ma'i gdams ngag mtshon rnon snun/ /de 339
