thul na gtan du bde bar 'gyur//glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba dang //gzhan rnam dkar dge ba gang bsags mthus//gnas dben par bdag gzhan thams cad kyis/ /dgra bdag 'dzin 'phung rgan thul bar shog/sngon byon dam pa gong ma rnams la//yid 'ong sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal/ /deng sang bya btang ri ba bdag la/ /ngo mtshar mchog thun dngos grum stsol cig /sngon byon dam pa gong ma'i gdan sa//yid 'ong dben pa'i ri khrod nyams dga'//deng sang tshogs drug rang grol bzung bas/ /ngo mtshar bde skyid snyan gsum 'dzoms byung / /sngon byon dam pa gong ma'i bzhugs sa/ /yid 'ong rang byung brag phug nyams dgar/ /deng sang tshogs drug rang grol bsdad pas/ /ngo mtshar bde skyid snyan gsum 'dzoms byung//sngon byon dam pa gong ma'i grogs po/ /yid 'ong bya dang ri dwags tshogs la/ /deng sang tshogs drug rang grol 'grogs pas/ /ngo mtshar bde skyid snyan gsum 'dzoms byung / /sngon byon dam pa gong ma'i gsol zas/ /yid 'ong sngo tshod shing 'bras tshogs rnams/ /deng sang tshogs drug rang grol zos pas/ /ngo mtshar bde skyid snyan gsum 'dzoms byung //sngon byon dam pa gong ma'i btung ba/ /yid 'ong gangs rdza g.ya' brag chu gtsang //340

deng sang tshogs drug rang grol 'thungs pas/ /ngo mtshar bde spyid snyan gsum 'dzoms byung //sngon byon dam pa gong mas gyon pa'i//yid 'ong gzan sham sgom thag zhu sogs//deng sang tshogs drug rang grol gyon pas/ /ngo mtshar bde skyid snyan gsum 'dzoms byung / /sngon byon dam pa gong mas bsnams pa'i/ /yid 'ong gsal 'debs be'u bum sba dbyug/ /deng sang tshogs drug rang grol bzung bas/ /ngo mtshar bde skyid snyan gsum 'dzoms byung / /sngon byon dam pa gong ma rnams kyis/ /yid 'ong dben gnas kho na 'grims bzhin/ /deng sang tshogs drug rang grol 'grims pas/ /ngo mtshar bde skyid snyan gsum 'dzoms byung / /sngon byon dam pa gong ma rnams kyis/ /yid 'ong mgur dbyangs mang po blangs bzhin/ /deng sang tshogs drug rang grol blangs pas/ /ngo mtshar bde skyid snyan gsum 'dzoms byung / /sngon byon dam pa gong ma ji bzhin/ /yid 'ong ri khrod bsten na chos 'ong / /deng sang skal ldal skyes bu rir shog/ngo mtshar bde skyid snyan gsum 'dzom nges/ /sngon skyes pha yul pha mkhar gnyen bshes//yid du 'ong yang chags sdang 'byung bas//deng sang las 'phro can tsho rir shog /ngo mtshar bde skyid snyan gsum 'dzom nges/ /sngon byon dam pa'i rnam thar skyong bzhin/ /yid 'ong skyid 341

pa'i rgyang glu blangs pa/ /deng sang skal ldan pho mos thos ma ngo mtshar ri khrod bsten par gyur cig /e ma bla ma sangs rgyas//sangs rgyas ma thob bar du//ri khrod 'grim pa'i slob bu/ /bu mas skyong bzhin skyongs shig /bla ma gong ma'i gdan sa//ri sul brag phug nyams dga'//deng sang bdag gis bzung nas/ /ha ha dga' spro shar byung / /bya dang ri dwags 'dug sa/ /yid 'ong nags tshal ri bo/ /deng sang bdag gis bsten pas//ha ha dga' spro shar byung / /lus mdzes ri dwags du ma/ /bag phebs rtse bro rdung la/ /deng sang bdag gis bltas pas/ /ha ha dga' spro shar byung / /yid 'ong bya bye'u rnams kyis/ /skad snyan sna tshogs sgog la/ /deng sang bdag gis nyan pas/ /ha ha dga' spro shar byung / /ljon shing yal 'dab rgyas pa'i//rtse mo'i ro mngar sil thog /deng sang bdag gis zos pas/ /ha ha dga' spro shar byung / /me tog 'dzum dgod byed pa'i/ /spang gzhongs bde 'jam dkyil na/ /deng sang bdag gis nyal bas//ha ha dga' spro shar byung //mi med lung ba stong ba'i//dga' bde gter gyi kha de/ /deng sang bdag gis phye bas/ /ha ha dga' spro shar byung / /deng sang nga 'dra'i skyid pa/ /re gnyis ma gtogs mi 'dug /skyid kyang skyid pa'i rgyang glu/ /'then mkhan nga min mi 342

snang / /pha yul bdud kyi btson khang / /nang nas chos mdzad ma 'dug /chags sdang shugs kyis 'ong bas/ /yul nas 'bud grabs mdzod cig /chos pa yul du lhung ba/ /seng ge dong nang lhung 'dra/ /skyo shas shugs drag bskyed la/ /myur du yul nas bud cig /ri khrod bsten na gang 'dod//dge sbyor byas na 'ong bas//chos pa rnams kyis ri khrod/ /dben pa bsten grabs mdzod cig /chos pas ri khrod bsten na/ /seng ge gangs rir 'gying 'dra/ /chos kyi mthun rkyen bsgrubs la/ /myur du bsten grabs mdzod cig /yul gyi dge sbyor brgya las/ /dben pa'i dge sbyor gcig dga'//rje btsun skal ldan gsungs pas//des na rgyun du sten cig /ri khrod bsten na dga' spro/ /spro na de sbyor los 'ong /'ongs na 'phral phugs bde skyid/ skyid dus rgyang glu 'then ya/ /glu 'di thos tshad chos pas//pha yul spangs nas ri khrod/ /dben pa bsten nas lha chos//tshul bzhin bsgrub par gyur cig /ri khrod bsten nas chos bsgrubs sangs rgyas pa'i/ /bla ma gong ma yongs la gus pas 'dud/ /ri khrod 'grim pa'i rnal 'byor glu dbyangs la/ /dad can skye bo pho mo gus pas nyon/ /snga bar langs nas gshol mda' phrag la bkal/ /sra log nyis log rgyag tu 'gro ba las/ /ri khrod dben pa'i ljon shing bsil grib 343

tu//nyi dros song nas sil thog zos na ang //phying ba snam mthug slog hrul lci mo gon//rngul chu 'ong bzhin khur bo 'khur ba las//ras dang dā bu'i gzan sham 'jam yang gyon/ /sngo brlan steng tsho song nas nyal na ang / /mgo bo me rdul chom me go mtha' bsrungs/ /bza' sdigs thug pa rgyun du bskol ba las/ /sa gzhi gos ltar 'jam pa'i spang gzhongs nas/ /bde smon la sogs kha ton byas na ang //nyin par lto bcag phyugs kyi 'tsho skyong byas/ /mtshan mo gnyid bcag phyo sogs zer ba las/ /ri khrod nyams dga' zhig nas zhwa lham gnyis/ /yar mar 'phangs nas mgur tsho bskul na ang / /gyang ra srang mdor rgan rgon byes par 'grogs/ /sa rdul khrod nas ngag 'khyal lab pa las/ /ri khrod cig nas chos mthun grogs dang 'grogs/ /me tog ljongs nas chos bshad byas na ang / /rta rgan g.yag rgan ma song khong khro langs/ /yob sdigs lcag gis brgyab nas 'gro ba las/ /sba dbyug thogs nas ga le sos dal byas/ /khong khro med par rkang thang song na ang / /kha dar ras kha sha lhu tsam re'i phyir/ /gnyid bcag snga bar langs nas rgyug pa las/ /ri khrod dben pa'i dro 'jam mal sa nas//mdo rgyud man ngag kha phye bltas na ang //kha lce lbu ba 'khrug bzhin za chog bton/ /khams 'khrugs a yo 344

shugs tsho zer ba las/ /khu byug la sogs bya bye'u sgra sgog pa'i/ /ri khrod cig nas ngal gsos bsdad na ang / /grong gi khang rul sbra chad gur rul 'grims/ /du bar bdug bzhin rnga rul brdung ba las//nyams dga'i chu mig mang bo'i mgo bo 'grims//gcod ḍar dkrol nas gar 'cham byas na ang / /nyin par lci ba'i las ka mang bo las//dgong mo a yo a na zer ba las/ /ri khrod dben pa'i nyi phug dro sa nas/ /sos dal bsdad nas dge sbyor byas na ang / /khe tshong zhing las sogs byas dka' las myang / /chung ma'i ngo 'dzum dkar nag blta ba las/ /ri khrod dben pa'i ser kha'i khams gseng byas/ /bag phebs phyogs bzhir ltad mo bltas na ang / /bza' ba hral hrul 'tshogs pa'i go dong nas//thal khem 'phyar nas 'khon 'dzing byed pa las/ /ngang bas brgyan pa'i mtsho dang chu chen khas/ /ting shags dkrol nas brgya rtsa bsngos na ang / /glu 'di thos tshad dad can skye bo kun/ /grong du bsdad nas tshe 'di'i bya bas brel/ /mi tshe don med sdug zad mi gtong bar/ /ri khrod bsten nas chos la spyod par shog/rtsa gsum lha dang dam can chos skyong la/ /sgo gsum rab tu gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /khams gsum 'khor 'khyams bdag gzhan sems can kun/ /sku gsum go 'phang ma thob bar 345

du skyongs//mtshan ldan bla mas rjes bzung mdo sngags chos//thos pa skal ba bzang yang nyams len dus/ /brtson 'grus zhan pa'i bya btang ri khrod pa/ /tshogs drug rang grol rang la glu 'di 'bul/ /bla ma dam pa tha mal zhig tu bltas/ /nyin mtshan gsol ba btab kyang don go chung / /sangs rgyas dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus kyis/ /snying nas gsol ba thobs dang ri khrod pa/ /mi lus thob dus dam chos ma bsgrubs na//'dzam bu'i gling du skyes pa don go chung / /shin tu rnyed dka' don che'i tshul soms la /chos kyi snying bo longs dang ri khrod pa/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzis nyin mtshan dus 'da' na//mi rtag 'chi ba shes pa don go chung //nam 'chi cha med soms la nyin mtshan kun/ /yengs med dam chos sgrubs dang ri khrod pa/ /dge sdig blang dor zhib tu mi byed na/ /las 'bras rnam dbye shes pa don go chung / /shin tu phra ba'i dge dang sdig pa la/ /blang dor zhib mo gyis dang ri khrod pa/ /tshe 'di'i bde skyid blo yis mi gtong na/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs shes pa don go chung / /spyad pas mi ngoms sdug bsngal sna 'dren pa'i/ /'khor ba'i phun tshogs spongs dang ri khrod pa/ /'gro la sgo gsum ci phan mi byed na/ /'gro kun pha mar shes pa don go chung / /byams dang snying rje'i byang chub sems bskyed la/ /rtag tu 346

phan thogs gyis dang ri khrod pa//nyams rtogs yon tan rgyud la ma skyes na/ /gsang sngags lam bzang bsgom pa don go chung / /dben par rtse gcig bsgoms la mngon shes dang //ya mtshan rdzu 'phrul ston dang ri khrod pa/ /mdor na rang rgyud gyong bo ma thul na//mi tsher ri la bsdad kyang don go chung //dbu rdzogs phyag chen gcod sogs gang gi sgos/ /rang rgyud thul nges gyis dang ri khrod pa/ /gtam 'di tshogs drug rang grol zhes bya bas//rang la cung zad e phan re nas blangs/ /rang dang ri ba gzhan rnams thos tshad kyi//rgyud la dngos sam brgyud nas phan thogs shog /rdo rje 'chang chen snyigs dus gdul bya'i ngor//tha mal mi yi tshul 'dzin chos rgyal la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan kun/ /byang chub ma thob bar du thugs rjes zungs/ /skyes pa'i yul spangs 'dus pa'i gnyen bshes bsgyur/ /sa mthar 'khyams nas nyams len mi byed dor/ /mi nor zas gsum bsgrub pa'i go log po/ /rang gis rang mgo ma skor glu 'dir nyon/ /khyod kyis ri khrod bsten nas lo du song / /rgyud la nyams rtogs yon tan ji tsam 'khrungs/ /grong ban rnams dang sgom chen khyod gnyis la/ /khyad par gnam sa tsam zhig los che snyam//khyad par 'di tsho yod ces da gcig shod/ /yun ring bsgoms 347

pas sa lam thob pa'i rtags/ /spyan dang mngon shes grub rtags gcig kyang ston//khyad par bshad rgyu ston rgyu cang med na//mi tshe ri la bsdad kyang rang sdug yin/ /tha na gzhan gyis tshur la tshig ngan zhig /smras pa'ang mi bzod sems 'gyur ngo mdangs log /spyan dang mngon shes grub rtags spu tsam med//phan med glu chung lung phran chu las mod/ /rang sems cung zad ma thul rje gyong song //nyams rtogs yon tan med pa'i rgyud stong bo//bla ma dam pa gong ma'i bla btsong bo/ /mdo sngags lha chos bzang bo'i rkang 'dren po/ /gla ba brag la bsdad kyang gla rtsi bzang / /khyod kyis gla ba zhig gi go ma chod/ /a ho khyod kyi bya 'di btsog re ltos/ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i myur lam yang / /ring lam byed mkhan khyod ngo mi tsha 'am/ /'dzam bu'i gling 'dir skye ba shin tu dkon//bla ma chos dang mjal ba de bas dkon//mi tshe yun thung nam 'chi nges pa med/ /sang dgong do nub tsam la 'chi na'ang thang / /'jig rten bya ba bsgrubs kyang zin tshar med/ /dgos pa bsams na mi mkho gcig kyang med//da re gtan bde byed dam gtan sdug byed/ /gdam kha rang la yod dus 'phyug mi rung / /gtan bde byed na yid brtan mi rung ba'i//tshe 'di'i bde skyid snyan gsum blo yis thongs/ /chos phyir dka' spyad sdug dgu dang 348

du longs/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la'i snying rus mthus/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas go 'phang thob la ltos/ /sos dal skyid chos can la sangs rgyas dka'/ /nam yang skyes pa'i lus 'di tha ma 'dor/ /chos phyir dka' ba spyad nas dor na 'tshengs/ /lto gos phyir du bsam blo gcig ma gtong //na rung ltogs rung 'khyags rung sdug bsran gyis/ /mi med khye med ri khrod dben pa ru/ /yengs med rtse gcig bsgoms la tshe mjug 'dir/ /mngon shes grub rtags sgo nas 'gro don gyis/ /gtam 'di bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /rang la e phan phyir du legs par smras/ /thos tshad dad can chos mdzad ri ba yis/ /sems rgyud la yang phan thogs 'byung bar shog/drin can bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /dgra la phan thogs nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe 'dir rang la gnod pa byed pa'i dgra/ /rang gi tshe rabs sngon ma'i pha ma yin/ /lan du gnod pa byed pa phar la zhog /phan 'dogs bya dgos de yi rgyu mtshan ni/ /tshe sngon dgra yang rang gi pha dang ma/ /yang yang byas dus lto rgyab 'gengs pa'i phyir/ /nyin par lto bcag mtshan mo'i gnyid spangs nas/ /tsha grang bkres skom sdug bsngal dpag med myangs//lus srog dor ba'i dus kyang yod pa yin/ /tshe 'di'i pha 349

ma tshe sngon dgra bo yis/ /pha ma byas pa snga phyi'i khyad min med/ /kha sang ltogs dus za ma byin pa dang / /de ring ltogs dus za ma byin pa la/ /khyad par med bzhin tshe 'di'i pha ma yis phan btags pa dang tshe sngon dgra bo yis/ /pha ma byas dus phan byas khyad par med/ /tshe 'di'i drin can pha ma gdon gyes smyos/ /bdag gzhan gang yin ngo yis mi zin dus/ /'ga' res bu la sdigs rdung gis bskul na/ /bu la ngan smras dbyug pas brdungs na ang / /bu yis spyos par shes nas lan mi byed/ /lhag par snying rje ci phan byed pa bzhin/ /tshe sngon rang la drin che'i dgra bo yang //tshe 'di'i nyon mongs gdon gyis smyos pa la//rang gi sngon las ngan pas kho bskul nas/ /rang la gnod pa che chung gang byas kyang / /rgyu mtshan de rnams shes nas dgra bo la/ /gnod pa phar zhog yal bar 'dor mi rung / /lhag par snying rje bskyed nas phan 'dogs dgos/ /dgra bos gnod kyang ma khros phan btags na/ /tshe 'dir yul mi khyim mtshes thams cad kyis/ /mi bzang lha yin zer nas mchod bstod bkur/ /phyi mar gzugs byad mdzes shing bde skyid tshe/ /shes na dgra yis tshur la gnod pa ltar/ /snang yang gnod min phan zhig btags pa yin/ /de phyir dgra yis gnod do ma snyam par//nam zhig mthong yang drin 350

can yin soms la/ /ma khro ma sdang yal bar ma 'dor bar/ /tshe 'di'i pha ma bzhin du gang byams gyis/ /de ltar byas na byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /tshe 'dir bde la phyi mar byang chub thob/ /'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis//rang la e phan phyir du nyin gcig sbyar/ /dge 'dis rang gzhan kun gyis sdang pa'i dgra/ /pha mar shes nas phan 'dogs byed par shog /rje sangs rgyas kun las drin lhag pa'i/ /pha chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bu bdag gis byang chub ma thob bar/ /thugs brtse bas 'bral med bskyang du gsol/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa/ /rje bla mar brten nas 'byung ngo zhes/ /chos mdo rgyud kun nas rgya cher gsungs/ /bsam sbyor bas sten dang ri khrod pa/ /rten dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi lus 'di/ /rnyed shin tu dka' zhing don che bas/ /'di don med chud zos ma gtong bar/ /da don ldan mdzod dang ri khrod pa/ /dus da lta'i gnyen grogs nor dang bral/ /tshe 'di ru mi sdod pha rol 'gro/ /khong 'chi bdag nam 'ong cha med pas/ /tshe blo yis thongs dang ri khrod pa/ /gnas ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal de/ /rang myong dgos byung na bzod par dka'/ /'jigs kun las skyob mkhan dkon mchog gsum/ /mgon skyabs su sten dang ri khrod 351

pa//las nyon mongs gnyis kyi gzhan dbang gis/ /gnas 'khor ba mtho dman gar skyes kyang / /rang mi sdod sdug bsngal du mas mnar//las nyon mongs spongs dang ri khrod pa//rang bde 'dod dam pa'i chos byas na/ /de theg pa dman pa'i chos lugs yin/ /ma 'gro kun don du byang chub kyi/ /sems yang yang skyed dang ri khrod pa/ /sems bskyed kyang rgyal sras spyod pa la/ /rang ma bslabs sangs rgyas mi thob pas/ /lam phar phyin drug dang bsdu bzhi la/ /da ci nus slobs dang ri khrod pa/ /mchog sangs rgyas myur du thob pa'i thabs/ /chos gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi/ /sgor zhugs la nyin mtshan khor yug tu//da nyams su longs dang ri khrod pa/ /chos mdo sngags nyams su len pa la/ /gnas dben par rtag tu bsten dgos pas/ /khyod grong du 'gro 'dug ma mang bar/ /rir rtag tu sdod dang ri khrod pa/ /glu 'di yang rang la phan phyir blangs/ /dge 'dis kyang rang gzhan la phan nas/ /rje dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /chos nyams su blangs nas 'tshang rgya shog /a bo phun tshogs dge legs bye ba'i/ /rgyal lo 'byung gnas bla ma rin chen/ /gces phrug spyi bo'i rgyan du zungs ang / /lo go snying gtam dang po yin ya/ /a bo 'dod 'byung nor bu las 352

lhag /rgyal lo sangs rgyas go 'phang rin chen/ /gces phrug myur du thob thabs gyis ang //lo go snying gtam gnyis pa yin ya//a bo rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang / /rgyal lo thob thabs mdo sngags lha chos/ /gces phrug tshul bzhin nyams su longs ang / /lo go snying gtam gsum pa yin ya/ /a bo sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i rten bzang / /rgyal lo lto rgyal 'dzam gling mi lus/ /gces phrug lus 'di'i steng nas 'bod ang / /lo go snying gtam bzhi pa yin ya/ /a bo tshe gcig sangs rgyas dka' bas/ /rgyal lo phyi mar rnam smin brgyad ldan/ /gces phrug rten bzang thob thabs gyis ang/ /lo go snying gtam lnga ba yin ya/ /a bo yang na dag zhing zhig tu//rgyal lo phyi mar skye thabs gyis la//gces phrug zhing der sangs rgyas sgrubs ang //lo go snying gtam drug pa yin ya/ /a bo bya btang tshogs drug rang grol/ /rgyal lo snying gtam 'di drug byas na//gces phrug skyid pa'i nyi ma 'char nges//lo go snying gtam tshar ni yin ya/ /lags so/ /ya ya/ /zhes pa 'di yang rang la smras pa'o//a bo sbyin pa yid bzhin nor bu/ /lo go drin can ma gyur 'gro bas/ /sems rten ci 'dod re ba skongs ang / /lo lo snying gtam dang po yin ya/ /a bo tshul khrims gaṅgā'i chu bos/ /lo go 353

nyon mongs nag nog dri ma/ /sems rten lhag ma med par khrus ang / /lo lo snying gtam gnyis pa yin ya/ /a bo bzod pa'i go cha gyon la/ /lo go gzhan gyi tshig rtsub mtshon chas/ /sems rten rgyag rung gnod med gyis ang / /lo lo snying gtam gsum pa yin ya/ /a bo brtson 'grus rta phor zhon la/ /lo go mdo sngags lam la zhugs nas//sems rten sangs rgyas sa la song ang lo lo snying gtam bzhi ba yin ya/ /a bo bsam gtan sa mkhar rdungs la//lo go rnam g.yeng dmag gi dpung tshogs//sems rten gcig kyang 'ong med khogs ang / /lo lo snying gtam lnga ba yin ya/ /a bo shes rab sgon me sbor la/ /lo go mi shes mun pa nag po/ /sems rten myur du sangs thabs gyes ang / /lo lo snying gtam drug pa yin ya/ /a bo ri ba tshogs drug rang grol/ /lo go snying 'di drug bsgrubs na/ /sems rten skyid pa'i nyi ma 'char ang //lo lo gtam 'grub ni yin ya//lags so/ /ya ya/ zhes pa 'di yang ri bo rma chen nas smras pa'o// phul byung sprul sku gtsug tu bzhugs/ /dung dung gus 'dud thugs dbus zungs/ /rgyud thul kun mgu sgrub thub nus/ /chur mgu kun 'byung byung dus 'dzum/ /rgyud rtsub brkus rdzun sdug tu 'jug /tshur sdug kun 'byung byung dus ngu / /phu nu bu chung yul 354

phyugs bsgyur/ /chu rgyun lhung lhung bung chung 'phur/ /khu byug 'du lung sgrub phug zungs/ /rgyun du sku gsung thugs gsum bkur/ /phul byung thub gsung dus kun sgrubs/ /zung 'jug sku gsum myur 'grub 'gyur/ /klu sgrub bu rgyud btsun chung mchus/ /thub gsung bcud 'dus glu chung byung / /kun rgyud glus bsgul myur myur du//thub gsung gsung kun sgrub nus 'gyur//zhes zhabs kyu kho na las byas pa'i glu 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//bsten tshe nyer 'tshe gegs med bde/ /bde gshegs brnyes byed sems bskyed bde/ /bde chen skye med shes de bde/ /bde legs dge ster rje de mkhyen//bshes gnyen legs bsten bde chen 'dren/ /theg chen sems bskyed bde gshegs brnyes/ /dge byed khe che bde legs 'phel/ /skye med de shes bde ster nges/ /sdig sgrib grib 'dis sprin bzhin bsgribs/ /sdig sgrib kyis zin mi mi skyid//sdig sgrib 'di gnyis 'jigs 'jigs kyi//sdig sgrib bshig phyin spyod kyi rigs/ /gcig gnyis mi yis mi rig ri'i//yid gnyis mi 'dzin gcig dril gyes//rim gnyis ting 'dzin cig dmigs phyin//sgrib gnyis shigs shig ci'i phyir min//chos brtson blo gros mchog tshor 'grogs/ /chos nyon don soms sgom tsho rgyob/ /chos 'dod pho mor chos tsho shod/ /chos spyod spyod 'phro 355

bsngo tsho mdzod/ /go go dgod 'chor chos rtsom kho//mthong mthong blo rno don go spro/ /bton bton blo rmongs mgo bo 'khor/ /thos thos tshogs rdzogs grol thob shog /ces pa 'di yang rtsom dka' ba'i tshig gis sbyar ba'o//bla ma sangs rgyas bdag phyag 'tshal/ /phan dga' bzang rnams gnang bar 'tshal/ /bya btang bsam dkar bslab bya bshad//dad can thams cad gsan par 'tshal//bla ma rnams la dad na bzang //phan dga' dpag par dka' ba gnang / /pha ma rgas khar byams na bzang / /rtag par pha mar gang byams 'tshal/ /rgyal mkhyen phyogs brgyas phyag byas skyob/ /skyabs rgyal mkhyen rgyas phyag brkyangs kyis/ /rgyal spyod skyong phyin phyis skyid myong / /skyid myong bya byed rgya bskyed gyis//khyem gyi gyong gyod 'gyod skyo skye//khyem dmyal skyo skye phyir rgyab rgyongs//smyo spyod skyon byas phyis 'gyod skye/ /'gyod skye smyo spyod phyi rgyab rgyongs/ /'brel 'brel spro brod 'gro 'dren sras//spro brod 'gro 'dren sras 'brel 'grogs//phrad phrad srog 'phrog 'gran bral dgra/ /srog 'phrog 'gran bral dgrar skrag bros/ /'phrod 'phrod 'grig grogs bral 'phro dran/ /bral 'phro dran grogs phrad 'phro 'grogs/ /'grogs 'grogs dgrar bros 'grogs 'phro skrag /'grogs 'phro skrag 'gro phrad 356

'phro bros//dkon mchog mchod bstod dgos 'dod stsol//rtog dpyod blos thongs chos don go /srog gcod sogs spongs mngon mthor 'gro/ /gtso bo nyon mongs tshogs choms grol/ /phyogs phyogs thos thos pho mo tshos/ /dgos 'dod yongs stsol 'gro mgon mchog /slob dpon dkon mchog sogs mchod bstod/ /nyon mongs tshogs bcom yongs grol shog /ces pa 'di yang rtsom dka' ba'i tshig gis sbyar ba'o// mchod 'os mgon rje skyabs gnas 'dud/ /'dud gnas skyabs rje mgon 'os mchod//sbyin gtong che tshe snyan grags che/ /che grags snyan tshe che gtong sbyin/ /sdom khrims legs bde dge rten gzhi/ /gzhi rten dge bde legs khrims sdom/ /bzod pa bsgom pa'i chos pa bzang / /bzang ba chos pa'i bsgom pa bzod/ /brtson pa bzang na bya ba legs/ /legs pa byas na bzang ba brtson/ /zhi zhing dul gnas bde dga' skyid/ /skyid dga' bde gnas dul zhing zhi/ /shes rab chos bzang yod pa legs/ /legs pa yod bzang chos rab shes/ /sbyar dka' mgur legs rab snyan gtam/ /gtam snyan rab legs mgur dka' sbyar//zab lam ches dka' kun mi shes//shes mi kun dka' ches 357

lam zab/ /snang bzhin med phyir snang ba stong / /stong ba snang phyir med bzhin snang / /mkhas rnams rtogs nyid de ltar gnas/ /gnas ltar de nyid rtogs rnams mkhas/ /blun rnams mthong ba log pa'i 'khrul/ /'khrul ba'i log pa mthong rnams blun/ /zhes tshig rkang gong ma'i mjug nas yar bton na tshig rkang 'og ma 'ongs pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis sbyar ba'o//chos rnams snang stong snang rnams chos/ /snang bzhin stong la stong bzhin snang //'dra ba rmi lam rmi ba 'dra//mtshar ba ltos dang ltos pa mtshar/ /mkhas pas de rtogs de bas mkhas/ /'gro sa bde zhing bde sa 'gro/ /rmongs rnams ma rtogs ma rnams rmongs//'khor bar rim bzhin rim par 'khor/ /zhes tshig rkang re re'i mgo mjug gang nas klog na yang tshig don gcig pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis sbyar ba'o//dad can bdag la snyan gsan 'tshal/ /'dod yon mo gzhon grogs sogs spongs/ /sems de yengs med dge rem rem/ /mi khye'i gling 'di mi skyid kyi/ /dpyid dbyar phyogs phyogs bya skyibs skyid/ /brag khrod 'grim sprang phran smras gros/ /sgyu lus dngul bum dbus su zungs/ /mkhas rnams de shes de rnams mkhas/ /zhes bya dka' ba 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis sbyar ba'o/ /bza' tshang tha ma bral snyam nas//mtshan ldan bla ma btsal na 358

bzang / /dal brgyad tshang la rab dga' nas/ /rnam dkar las la 'bad na bzang //gang yang rtag par dka' snyam nas/ /gang la'ang ma chags spangs na bzang //pha mar gnang ba blangs byas nas/ /skra bcad gzan sham blangs na bzang / /bka' bstan rnams la rab sbyangs nas/ /bka' gdams rnam thar bskyangs na bzang / /gsang ba sngags la rab nyan nas/ /gsang nas rang nyams blangs na bzang / /yan lag ma tshang lam spangs nas/ /lam bzang cha tshang bslabs na bzang / /bzang bzang cha tshang lam bzang la/ /yang yang bag chags bzhag na bzang / /gzhan la bsam pa ma gnag par/ /gzhan phan bsam pa ldan na bzang / /phan btags ma btags gang la yang / /phan byas ngan ma byas na bzang / /pham kha thams cad rang blangs nas/ /rgyal kha gzhan la btang na bzang / /ma rabs bya ba rnams spangs nas/ /ya rabs bya ba byas na bzang / /bla ma rnams la zhal mjal nas/ /sangs rgyas bka' la sbyangs na bzang / /gsang sngags lam bzang rnams nyan nas/ /lha sngags bzlas pa mdzad na bzang / /tsha ngar 'bar thabs mang na yang / /a haṃ 'bar 'dzag byas na bzang / /lag pa mnyam bzhag phyag rgya bcas/ /lta bar mnyam par bzhag na bzang / /rang gzhan sangs rgyas 359

thabs gang la'ang/ /rang na tsha yang 'bad na bzang / /bya ba thams cad rab spangs nas//bya bral sprang nag byas na bzang //gang la chags sdang ma byas par/ /gang phan gzhan la byas na bzang / /gnas ngan thams cad rgyang spangs nas//gnas bzang rnams la bsdad na bzang //lag g.yas 'gram pa la sbyar nas//ngag dbyangs snyan pa blangs na bzang / /gangs dkar brag dmar rtsa ba nas/ /gang phan dbyangs snyan blangs na bzang / /nyams dga' g.ya' spang nags tshal nas/ /nyams shar dbyangs snyan blangs na bzang / /rnar snyan bya dbyar grags skabs la/ /dbyangs snyan lhang lhang blangs na bzang / /dpag tshad rgyang la gnas bcas nas/ /dbyangs snyan rgyang nas blangs na bzang //zhes gi gu rna ru 'greng bu zhabs kyu gang yang med pa 'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis sbyar ba'o//a rog lus mdzes sbrang ma//myur du sbrang rtsi longs dang //me tog bya ba 'bring red/ /snga bar bskams nas e 'gro/ /sbrang rtsi mang bo longs la/ /me tog skam ma'i dus su/ /tshang gi phu de snyegs la/ /lus bde kha skyid rgyob ya/ /a rog smug rim bra ba/ /myur du sngo rtswa longs dang / /rtswa yi bya ba 'bring red/ /snga bar skya bor e 'gro/ /rba rtswa mang bo longs la/ /rtswa rnams skya bor song 360

dus/ /bug pa phugs ring snyogs la/ /lus bde kha skyid rgyob ya//a rog bya btang ri ba//myur du dge sbyor gyis dang //lus 'di'i bya ba 'bring red/ /snga bar zhig nas e 'gro/ /dge sbyor mang bo gyis la/ /sgyu lus zhig pa'i dus su/ /dag pa'i zhing zhig snyogs la/ /lus bde kha skyid rgyob ya/ /zhes pa 'di yang sbrang ma dang bra ba 'ga' res gsog 'jog byed pa mthong nas blangs pa'o//na mo gu ru/ chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo yi/ /zhabs la gus pas gsol ba 'debs//skal ldan grogs mched shes rgyud la//ye shes 'bar bar byen gyis rlobs//e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu//rdzogs chen sgom tshul mi shes sam/ /rdzogs pa chen po bsgom pa ni//rang gi sems la blta ba yin//e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /sems kyi gnas lugs mi shes sam//sems kyi gnas lugs mi shes na/ /sems la cer gyis bltas pa'i tshe//sa le sang nge wal le ba/ /sprin med ston ga'i nam mkha' bzhin/ /'di yin med pa'i gsal zhing dwangs/ /smra rgyu med pa'i nyams myong de/ /rang gnas bsam gtan dngos yin no/ /e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /sems kyi 'jog tshul mi shes sam/ /sems kyi 'jog tshul ma shes na/ /'gyur ba med pa ri bo bzhin/ /yangs dog bral ba nam mkha' bzhin/ /mi g.yo dwangs pa rgya mtsho bzhin/ /khyab 361

gdal zang thang ngang nyid du/ /sa le trig ge 'jog pa yin/ /e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /rnam rtog lam 'khyer mi shes sam/ /rnam rtog lam 'khyer ma shes na/ /rnam rtog sems kyi cho 'phrul yin/ /sems la rnam rtog shar ba'i tshe/ /dgag sgrub blang dor mi byed par/ /sems nyid rang gi ngang du zhog /rang sar 'gro bar je tshom med/ /sems kyi gsal cha nyams gyur nas//ci yin 'di yin med pa yi/ /lung ma bstan du 'byams gyur na/ /mun khang mar me btegs pa bzhin/ /lta stangs rig pa'i ngang bskyed de/ /sang nge ye re bsgo ma pa yin/ /yid dpyod rtsol bas bslad gyur na/ /nyi ma sprin las grol ba bzhin/ /yid dpyod rtsol ba lings kyis bor/ /rang byung ye shes sems nyid ngang / /rang sar glod nas 'jog pa yin/ /e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /da dung snying gtam shar gcig bshad//'thad dam snyam na sems la chongs//'gro na rang gnas bsam gtan ngang / /sa le sang nge hrig ge song / /rdzogs chen rnal 'byor 'gro tshul yin/ /'dug na ma bcos rig pa'i ngang / /kyi le wal le 'bol ler sdod / /rdzogs chen rnal 'byor 'dug tshul yin/ /za na gnas lugs lta ba'i ngang //phyal le khres se bun ne zo//rdzogs chen rnal 'byor za tshul yin//nyal na mnyam nyid zang thal ngang //rjen ne lhag ge shig se 362

nyol/ /rdzogs chen rnal 'byor nyal tshul yin/ /gzhan gyi tshig la gsan pa'i tshe//stong nyid ngang du rjen ne nyon//rdzogs chen rnal 'byor gsan tshul yin//rang gis gtam rnams bshad pa'i tshe/ /lta ba'i ngang nas lhag ge shod/ /rdzogs chen rnal 'byor bshad tshul yin/ /sems la nyin dang mtshan du ltos/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor gyi//thun mtshams med pa'i dge sbyor yin//e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /rang rig kun tu bzang bo'i sku/ /gzung 'dzin bral ba'i sems la ltos//kun tu bzang bo logs na med/ /rang byung chos sku e ma ho/ /ma 'gag rang gsal rdo rje sems/ /smra brjod bral ba'i sems la ltos/ /rdo rje sems dpa' logs na med//rang byung longs sku e ma ho//dran rtog rang grol pad+ma 'byung / /'dzin med zang thal ngang du zhog /pad+ma 'byung gnas logs na med/ /rang byung sprul sgu e ma ho/ /zhes sems ngo skyong tshul blun po'i snying gtam 'di ni grogs mched dag la rig 'dzin tshogs drug rang grol gyis gsal 'debs bogs 'byin gyi tshul du bris pa'o/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sems la mtha' med ngos bzung med/ /'pho 'gyur med pa'i nam mkha' 'dra/ /'khor 'das skyon yon gang yang 'byung / /thams cad sems las 'byung ba'i phyir/ /sems ni kun gyi 'byung gnas yin/ /363

thams cad sesam kyis byas pa'i phyir/ /sems ni kun kyi mkhan po yin/ /thams cad sesam su 'dus pa'i phyir/ /sems ni kun gyi rtsa ba yin/ /thams cad sems la gnas pa'i phyir/ /sems ni kun gye gzhi ma yin/ /ya gi rgyal ba'i zhing khams nas/ /ma gi dmyal khams bco brgyad yan/ /rang snang yin par blo thag chod/ /dpal chen khrag 'thung man chad nas/ /the'u rang grong rgyu yan chad yang / /rang snang yin par blo thag chod//phyi snod 'jig rten thams cad dang / /nang bcud sems can snang ba yang / /rang snang yin par blo thag chod/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba thams cad dang / /bar do phyi ma'i snang ba yang / /rang snang yin pa blo thag chod/ /mi yis gnod 'tshe byas pa dang / /lha 'dre'i gnod pa cho 'phrul yang / /rang snang yin pa blo thag chod//rang snang gzhi med stong ba yin/ /stong la snang ba rmi lam 'dra/ /snang stong yin par blo thag chod/ /bcad 'phro shes pa lhod kyis glod/ /glod tshe stong sang nam mkha' dang / /'dra ba'i nyams shig 'bad med 'char/ /de ga'i ngang la mnyam par zhog /de rjes tshogs gsog sgrub sbyong sogs//byed na sgyu ma lta bur spyod//glu 'di thos tshad la phan shog/tshogs gnyis mthar phyin sku gnyis kyi/ /go 'phang thob pa 364

rnams la 'dud/ /snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams kun/ /mkha' la 'khrigs pa'i sprin 'ja' bzhin/ /snang yang rang bzhin grub pa med/ /sprin 'ja' nam mkha'i cho 'phrul yin/ /cir snang rang rig cho 'phrul yin/ /rig pa'i ngo bo ngos bzung med/ /btsal na mi rnyed nam mkha' 'dra/ /nam mkha'i gar khyab rig pas khyab/ /rig pas gar khyab chos skus khyab/ /chos sku bdag med spros bral gyi/ /ngang du rtse gcig mnyam par zhog /de rjes sgyu ma rmi lam ltar/ /bsod nams tshogs la 'bad par mdzod/ /phyogs bzhir 'khyams nas bde sdug kun/ /myong ba'i rig pa'i khye'u chung //chos sku yum chen ma'i pang du//kyi li me re dga' 'dzum me/ /bsdad nas bsod nams tshogs bsags kyi//nu zho mngar mo 'thung nus na/ /sku gnyis lus stobs cher rgyas nas/ /'gro don rtsed mo byed par nus/ /glu 'di thos pas tshogs gnyis bsags/ /sku gnyis go 'phang thob par shog /thabs shes zung 'brel nyams len byas/ /chos gzugs zung 'brel thob la 'dud/ /'ja' sprin snang yang 'dzin med ltar/ /chos rnams rang bzhin ma grub stong / /'ja' sprin mkha' las byung ba bzhin/ /chos rnams rig pa'i rtsal las byung / /nam mkha' 'dzin med stong ba ltar/ /rig pa'i ngo bo stong ba yin/ /365

stong ba de la mnyam 'jog dus/ /a ma lab kyi sgon ma yi/ /thabs mkhas gdams pa 'di ka zab/ /rang gi snying gar rig pa ni/ /thig le zhig gi rnam par dmigs/ /phaṭa sgra lhang nge ba zhig gis/ /spyi bo'i mkha' la rgyangs se 'phangs/ /nam mkhar yal nas dbyer med 'dres/ /nam mkha'i gar khyab rig pas khyab/ /rig pa'i gar khyab chos skus khyab/ /chos sku mtha' dbus dang bral ba'i/ /ngang du bde 'jam thang chen du//rta rgod srab kha glod pa bzhin/ /'dzin pas ma bcings glod la thongs/ /rta chad lhan ner 'dug pa bzhin/ /glod 'phro kyi le me re sdod/ /rjes su rig pa'i ngo bo stong / /chos rnams rig pa'i rol ba dang / /sgyu ma lta bur ma gtogs par/ /thog ma med nas da bar du//rang gzhan sems can thams cad kun/ /'khor ba'i gnas su 'khyam 'khyams nas/ /sdug bsngal myang ba snying re rje/ /da lta sdug bsngal dpag med kyis/ /mnar ba'i 'gro rnams snying re rje/ /phyin chad sdug bsngal myong dgos pa'i/ /ma gyur 'gro ba snying re rje/ /da ni rang nyid bde ba dang / /'gro kun gtan bde'i go 'phang la/ /'god pa'i don du thog mar rang / /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par bya//de phyir lus srog longs spyod la/ /nam yang cung zad mi blta bar/ /rgyal sras spyod pa rlabs po che/ /rnams la zhum pa 366

med par 'jug /snyam du snying rje shugs drag po'i/ /sgo nas byang chub sems bskyed la/ /spyod phyogs rnams la 'jug par bgyi/ /phyogs bcur ngal gso med par khyab/ /bde sdug sna tshogs myong ba yi/ /rang byung rig pa'i mgon chung de/ /chos sku yangs pa'i mgron khang du//babs nas sos dal ngal gsos bsdad//tshogs gsog khe tshong byas gyur na/ /chos gzugs khe rgyal lon par 'gyur//glu 'di thos pas thabs shes gnyis//zung 'brel nyams blangs sangs rgyas shog /chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /e ma skal ldan pho mo tsho/ /nam mkha' bzhin du rang gi sems//stong ba mtha' dbus med par sgoms/ /rgya mtsho bzhin du dwangs shing gsal/ /gang yang 'gag med 'char bar sgoms/ /phyi snod nang bcud chu zla bzhin/ /sems kyi dbyings su shar bar sgoms/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /cir snang stong gzugs yin par sgoms/ /de ltar bsgom pa'i shes pa la/ /ngos bzung ci yang med par sgoms/ /de nas ci yang mi bsgom par/ /rang babs cag ge mag ge sdod/ /bsdad tshe mkha' la 'phur ba bzhin/ /sang sang yangs yangs phyal le ba'i/ /nyams shig ma bcos rang babs 'char/ /shar ba'i ngang du ma yengs zhog /brgya bshad 367

stong tsho tsam bshad kyang / /sems kyi gnas lugs nges nges po/ /de ka yin pas rgyun du skyongs//rnal 'byor pa de 'chi ba'i tshe//skye med chos sku mngon du 'gyur/ /'gag med gzugs sku'i 'gro don 'byung / /rnal 'byor blo la shar nas blangs//thos tshad rgyud la phan par shog /chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud//nyon dang dad can skye bo kun/ /da lta'i snang grags chos rnams kun/ /nam mkha'i 'ja' bzhin stong ba'i gzugs/ /rang sems stong ba nyid dang 'dres//sems nyid nam mkha' stong bar 'dres/ /nam mkha' chos sku chen por 'dres/ /chos sku khyab gdal mer bar sgoms/ /de nas sgom mkhan blo dang khrol/ /rang babs me re 'dzin med zhog /bzhag tshe lci ba'i khur chen zhig /yun ring khur nas phog pa bzhin/ /bde la yang ba'i nyams myong skye//ngang du gu yangs yan par glod/ /spros bral rang byung lta ba la//spros pa mang bo'i dgos pa chung //spros med skyong ba'i rnal 'byor pa//lus rgya'i 'ching ba zhig pa dang / /skye med chos sku mngon du 'gyur/ /'gag med gzugs sku 'gro la 'char/ /rnal 'byor sems la gang shar blangs//thos tshad rgyud la phan par shog /chos kyi rgyal por gus pas 'dud/ /nyon dang las ldan slob 368

bu rnams/ /chos rnams rmi lam lta bur sgoms/ /chos kun sems su 'dus par sgoms/ /sems nyid stong ba nyid du sgoms/ /stong ba mtha' dbus med par sgoms/ /mtha' bral chos sku yin par sgoms/ /de nas ci yang ma bsgom sdod/ /bsdad tshe grub chen phyogs bzhi ru/ /brtod pa'i thag pa bcad pa'i tshe/ /nyams shig 'bad med lhug par 'char/ /shar ba'i ngang la ma yengs par/ /'jog pa'i rnal 'byor 'chi ba'i dus//skye med chos sku mngon du 'gyur/ /'gag med gzugs skus 'gro ba 'dren/ /rnal 'byor sems la gang shar blangs//thos tshad rgyud la phan par shog /chos kyi rgyal por gus pas 'dud/ /e ma bya btang rnal 'byor pa//rang sems dang po byung sa dang / /bar du lus sogs gang na gnas/ /tha mar 'gro sa e yod dang / /dbyibs dang kha dog e 'dug ltos/ /bltas pas gang yang ma mthong na/ /ma mthong ba de mthong ba'i mchog /bltas pas sems la mthong ba med/ /med pa'i ngang du glod la thongs/ /yal le lam me 'dzin med zhog /bzhag sar mi 'dug sems 'phro dus/ /sngar bzhin byung gnas 'gro gsum tshol/ /ci 'dra zhig red zhib tu ltos/ /bltas pas ci yang mthong rgyu med/ /med pa'i ngang du rtsol med zhog /yang 'phro yang ltos yang zhog bzang / /lta mkhan rnam rtog 369

yin mod kyang / /lcags kyis lcags rnams gshag pa ltar/ /rnam rtog nyid kyis rnam rtog dag /de ltar yang yang nyams blangs na/ /rnam rtog je nyung je nyung 'gro/ /skabs shig rnam rtog med par gnas/ /de dus rtsol ba ma mang bar//'jog sgom kho na byas na legs//glu 'di thos tshad la phan shog / chos kyi rgyal por gus pas 'dud/ /nyon dang bya btang ri khrod pa/ /phyi la ma blta nang du ltos/ /blo kha nang du tshur phyogs la/ /nang gi sesam la cer gyis ltos/ /bltas pas ci yang mthong rgyu med//med pa'i ngang la shes pa lhod//lhan ne lhang nge rtsol med zhog /bzhag tshe yun ring mi sdod par/ /bzang ngan rnam rtog skyes pa'i tshe/ /rkun ma bzhin du tsir gyes zungs/ /bzung 'phro ngo la cer kyis ltos//bltas pas ci yang ma rnyed na//ngang du glod la phyam gyis zhog /rnam rtog byung dus rjes ma rgyugs/ /byung ma thag nas rnam rtog ngo //ltos dang stong nyid kho na yin//rnam rtog mang bo 'phro ba'i dus/ /stong nyid ston pa'i slob dpon grogs/ /yin pas skyon du ma blta bar/ /dga' ba bsgoms la ngo la ltos/ /me shing ci tsam mang na yang / /khol mo'i rlung gis bskyod nus na/ /me lce de tsam che ba ltar//rnam rtog ci tsam 'phro na yang //kun gyi ngo bo blta nus na/ /stong ba nyid kyi yong sgo mang / /glu 'di thos 370

tshad la phan shog /chos kyi rgyal por gus pas 'dud/ /nyon dang dad can chos mdzad mkhan/ /lus ngag yid gsum khong glod la/ /zhog dang rnam rtog 'gag shul na/ /sangs sangs yangs yangs 'di'o zhes/ /gzhan la smra ru mi btub pa'i/ /rang gi nyams su myong ba yi/ /lkugs pas rmi lam rmis pa bzhin/ /brjod du med pa'i nyams shig 'char/ /de ga'i ngang du kha rog pa/ /cag ge mag ge 'jam ldem me/ /ci tsam gnas rag bar la zhog /mi gnas rnam rtog langs pa'i dus//phar lta tshur lta ma mang bar/ /shes pa cog ge glod la thongs/ /glod pas rnam rtog rang sar zhi/ /sngar gyi mnyam gzhag shugs kyis zin/ /dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/ /shes pa lhod kyis glod nas nyal/ /chog pa'i chos shig 'di yin te/ /a ma lab sgon drin can rnams/ /nyal bas chog pa'i chos yin yang //bu slob thams cad nyal ma nus//des na rgad mo yid ma ches/ /zhes gsungs nyal nus rnal 'byor pa/ /gol sa med de a ma yis/ /gang yang yid la ma byas na/ /gol sar ltung ba ci las byung / /bsam med sgom pa ma nor na/ /chos sku'i byang chub the tshom med/ /ces gsungs rnam ltog ma mang bar//blo bde 'bol le nyol la sdod//glu 'di thos tshad la phan shog/371

na mo gu ru/ me rdo dang me cha grang na yang //me brdabs na me stag tsha mo 'byung / /'di mtshar re zhig red ha ha ha//mtsho chu bo shin tu sla na yang / /dgun 'khyags na sra ba'i dar dkar 'byung //'di mtshar re zhig red ha ha ha/ /ma'i mngal sgor lag mgo mi thar kyang / /mar nang nas bu chung che ba 'byung / /'di mtshar re zhig red ha ha ha/ /la yung ma'i sa bon shig tsam la/ /'bras kho las brgya 'gyur che ba 'byung / /'di mtshar re zhig red ha ha ha//gro nas sran sa bon skam la chung //sar btab na ljang bu ring bo 'byung / /'di mtshar re zhig red ha ha ha/ /phyi brag gis smra ba mi shes kyang / /nang brag cha mang bo lhang lhang 'byung //'di mtshar re zhig red ha ha ha//shing skam po pags pa zhig gis btums/ /de brdungs na rnga sgra che ba 'byung / /'di mtshar re zhig red ha ha ha/ /g.yu gser dngul mu tig chung na yang //'di nyos na rin thang shin tu che//'di mtshar re zhig red ha ha ha/ /mtshan gti mug gnyid kyi dbang song tshe/ /sna tshogs pa'i rmi lam mang bo rmis/ /'di mtshar re zhig red ha ha ha/ /rang sems nyid stong gsal 'dzin med las/ /spyir 'khor 'das skyon yon gang yang 'byung / /'di mtshar re zhig red ha ha ha//sde'i chos pa kha cig sems de dog /tshig ngan pa dam dum 372

khog mi shong / /dpe dud khug ra tse'i sne bud bzhin/ /rtags ngo mdangs ldog pa ha ha ha/ /nga ban rgan sems 'di'i yangs re ltos/ /mkhar mda' 'phangs rgya mtshor chu thim ltar/ /gang gar song 'dir song mi shes ki /'di dgod rgya zhig red ha ha ha/ /zhes pa 'di yang sems la gang shar rang dgar bris pa'o// ༄nam mkha' ltar/ /thugs yangs pa'i/ /gu ru mkhyen/ /chos dbyings kyi//thang chen nas/ /rig stong gi /rta mchog kha//glod la thongs/ /rgyugs rgyugs rgyugs/ /yan par rgyugs/ /dga' yal le//skyid chil le//ban ma bun//phya ma 'phyo//'al ma 'ol//shag ma shig /khral ma khrol/ /sangs ma sangs ya la la yengs yengs yengs/ /ye re re/ /phyam phyam phyam/ /me re re/ /rgyob rgyob rgyob/ /ma yengs pa'i/ /lcag gis rgyob/ /a yo she/ /e ha ha/ /de tsam gyis/ /chog ni gyis//ban rgan 'bab//g.yang zog po//sems bskyed kyi//ri khar bud//tshogs bsags kyi/ /rtswa chu thungs/ /ngo mtshar che ma ma ho//zhes pa 'di yang snang ba ban bun gyi ngang nas smras pa'o//chos kyi rgyal por gus pas 'dud/ /rang sems pho gsar a bo khos/ /phyi snang bu mo mgo stong ma'i/ /phyi la rgyug dus 'di ltar du/ /skad cha dris dang dgod kha 'chor/ /a rog sesam nyid gzhon nu ang //da nangs gang nas langs nas 'ongs/ /da khyod 373

ci'i 'ongs gang du 'gro//khyod sdod lus dbyibs ngo mdangs la//ban rgan nga yis blta dgos zhes/ /shod dang ci yang mi smra bar//gar song med par yal nas 'gro/ /song sa 'ong sa mthong mi 'gyur/ /ma mthong tsa na a mtshar re/ /snyam du kha rog par sdod dang //yang 'ong 'ongs tshe de ma thag /ngo mtshar e khyod 'di nas sdod/ /'gro 'dug mang bo ngal ba'i rgyu/ /khyod la 'dri rgyu mang bo snang / /khyod ni su yi bu tsha yin/ /'gro bsdad mang ba dgos don ci/ /pha ma'i ming la ji skad zer/ /khyod lo du yin la sogs pa/ /sngar bzhin dris dang ngo tsha nas/ /gang zhig cig la bros bud 'gro/ /song tshe shul nas a mtshar re/ /snyam du kha rog par sdod dang //yang 'ong 'ongs tshe yang dris dang //dgod rgyu zhig yin a ha ha/ /mtshar re zhig yin e he he/ /'di thos tshad rgyad la phan par shog/ ༄chos kyi rgyal por gus pas 'dud/ /e ma rdzogs chen rnal 'byor pa/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol sems/ /nam mkha' bzhin du rgya re che/ /sa gzhi bzhin du sra zhing brtan/ /rgya mtsho bzhin du dwangs shing gsal//chos kun sems kyi rtsal du rdzogs//'khor 'das gnyis kyis 'dzin pa bdag /bdag gzhan dgra gnyen dgag sgrub bral/ /chos dbyings ngang du mer gyis song / /374

gang du bsdad kyang nyams re dga'//su dang 'grogs kyang zhe re brod/ /mi dga' bya ba'i ming yang med/ /gu yangs yan pa blo re bde/ /chos dbyengs ngang du dga' yal le/ /e ma rmad byung skal ba bzang / /'di thos rgyud la phan par shog /chos kyi rgyal por gus phyag 'tshal/ /dbyar dgun med par gangs ri chags/ /ston dbyed med par na bun 'khrigs/ /ri klung med par ri dwags gnas/ /nyin srib med par me tog bkra/ /ngo mtshar ri bo rma chen na//bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba rmi lam dang / /'dod yon sgyu ma lta bur bsgom/ /chos rnams sems kyi cho 'phrul dang / /sems nyid stong gsal bde nyams bskyangs/ /de ltar rtogs la dga' ba dang / /ma rtogs 'gro la snying rje bsgom//e ma sna tshogs snang ba'i chos//rang bzhin med bzhin snang ba mtshar/ /'di thos rgyud la phan par shog /chos rgyal zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /stong nyid rtogs pa'i gang zag gis//ma rtogs 'gro la sngar bas kyang / /lhag pa'i snying rje shugs drag skye/ /snying rje'i shugs kyis 'gro ba yi/ /sdug bsngal sel zhing bde ba'i thabs/ /las 'bras sngar bas brgya stong lhag /'dor len byed 'dod ngang gis 'byung / /stong ba 375

nyid dang snying rje 'brel/ /snying rje las 'bras 'brel yod pas/ /mi de'i 'dun ma gtan nas legs/ /yang dag stong nyid rtogs pa dang //snying rje skye ba dus mnyam zhes//grub chen dam pa sangs rgyas gsungs/ /stong nyid rtogs dang ma rtogs de/ /snying rje yod med steng nas shes/ /snying rje chen po ma mchis na/ /stong nyid rtogs pa de dang 'dra/ /lta bar mnyam par bzhag yod dus/ /cung zad tsam res rkyen byas nas/ /'gro la snying rje skye ba de/ /dper na bu gcig shi ba'i mas//cung zad rkyen res bu de dran//mya ngan ldang ba lta bu dgos/ /'gro la snying rje bsgoms yod dus//cung zad tsam res rkyen byas nas/ /lta ba dran nas dga' ba de//dper na bu chung ngu sgang la/ /a ma slebs pa lta bu dgos/ /nam yang stong nyid snying rje gnyis/ /ma bu bzhin du 'grogs yod pa'i/ /mi de'i mdun ma rtse mor phyin/ /snying rje chen po'i kun slong gi /sgo nas byang chub sems bskyed la/ /mi dge phra zhing phra ba spongs/ /dge tshogs mtha' dag bsgrub la 'bod/ /stong nyid snying rje snying bo can/ /las 'bras rnams las zab pa'i chos/ /gzhan na med ces rgyal ba'i sras/ /rnams kyis yang dang yang du gsungs/ /chos 'di nyams su sus blangs kyang / /mi de'i 'dun ma dgung la reg /'di thos rgyud la phan par shog /376

kun gyis gtsug gi rgyan du 'dzin/ /chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang wang / /drin gyes tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /cer gyis bltas pas sems ngo mthong / /spros bral nam mkha' lta bu mthong mthong ba'i ngang la cog ge bzhag /bzhag pas rnam rtog phra rags zhi/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 'brel/ /'brel ba skal ba shin tu bzang / /bzang bo'i glu 'di sems la shar/ /shar tshe thogs pa med par blangs//blangs pa thos tshad phan par shog /chos rgyal zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /chos rnams thams cad ngo bo stong //chos dbyengs stong ba de la zer//chos las chos dbyengs gzhan na med/ /chos kyi dbyings las chos gzhan med//chos rnams chos kyi dbyings la brten/ /chos dbyengs chos rnams yongs la brten/ /chos rnams chos kyi dbyengs la 'brel/ /chos dbyings chos rnams yongs la 'brel/ /chos pa tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /chos rnams snang stong rten 'brel rtogs//chos 'di thos tshad la phan shog /chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bor 'dud/ /phyi snod nang bcud sems can rnams/ /rang rang sa na ma 'dres par/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /snang yang rang bzhin grub pa med/ /377

thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas gsungs/ /thams cad ye stong yin pa la//yin par rang gis ngo shes dgos//chos rnams ngo bo stong ba la//mtha' bral chos dbyings chen po zer/ /shes na chos dbyings pho brang na//sangs rgyas sems can thams cad gnas//'khor 'das rmi lam bzang ngan 'dra/ /rang snang gzhi med stong ba'i gzugs/ /don dam blang dor gnyis med pa'i/ /chos dbyengs btsan sa bzung na legs/ /de ltar rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /chos ma byas kyang blo re bde/ /dper na 'tsho med nad kyis zin/ /lo mang mal sar lhung ba'i mi/ /sman pas sman byen nad de sos/ /ri mgo mthon po zhig gi rtser//phyin nas phyogs mtshams kun mthong tshe/ /sems la dga' bde 'char ba bzhin/ /ma rig nyon mongs dbang du song / /'khor bar yun ring 'khyams pa'i mi/ /bla mas khrid byas chos rnams kyi/ /gnas lugs thog mar shes pa'i tshe/ /sems la dga' bde skye bar 'gyur//'di thos rgyud la phan par shog/chos rgyal zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /'od gsal mthong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /be'u phur thang du brdabs pa bzhin/ /lus po g.yo 'gul med par sdod/ /logs bris lha sku'i spyan phye bzhin/ /mig gnyis 'byed sum med 378

par zhog /ras bal thang la brdal ba bzhin/ /shes pa lhod kyis glod la zhog /bzhag tshe rnam rtog 'gags shul na/ /sprin med mkha' ltar gsal sang nge / /dri med shel ltar zang thal le/ /'dug pa de ka don dam pa'i/ /'od gsal rdzogs chen lta ba yin/ /de yi ngang la mnyam par zhog /mkha' ltar dag pa'i 'od gsal te/ /byeng rmugs gnyis dang mi nor yang / /dwangs la mi rtog bsam gtan dang //nor nyen che bas nor mi rung //bzang ngan rnam rtog langs pa'i dus/ /rnam rtog phyir du phar ma rgyugs/ /tshur la bkug nas ngor ma blta/ /gang yang bya rtsol ma byed par/ /shes pa lhod kyis glod la thongs/ /rnam rtog rang sar zhi bar 'gyur/ /yun ring mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshe/ /dper na chu rnyog dwangs pa na/ /sna tshogs gzugs brnyan 'char ba bzhin/ /sems nyid je dwangs je gsal du/ /song nas spyan dang mngon shes sogs/ /yon tan mang bo 'bad med 'char/ /o rgyan dngos su byon na yang / /rdzogs chen lta ba de'i lhag med/ /klong chen rab 'byams byon na yang //rnam rtog lam 'khyer de'i lhag med/ /rje 'bangs nyer lnga byon na yang //nyams myong gsung rgyu de'i lhag med/ /rnal 'byor nga yang nyal ba dang / /'gro yang bsgom rgyu de'i lhag med//so sor rtog pas dpyad na yang //rlung 379

gis sprin gtor mkha' mthong bzhin/ /sems nyid stong gsal de ka mthong / /de las lhag cig mthong rgyu med/ /ma dpyad rang babs bzhag na yang / /chu ma rnyog na dwangs pa bzhin/ /sems nyid stong gsal de ka mthong //de las lhag cig mthong rgyu med/ /lta ba rnam grangs mang na yang / /sems nyid stong gsal 'dzin med 'di/ /rdzogs chen lta ba 'khrul med yin/ /rnal 'byor pa de 'chi ba'i tshe/ /'chi ba 'od gsal zin par 'gyur/ /'di thos rgyud la phan par shog /chos kyi rgyal por mgos phyag 'tshal/ /chos rnams nam mkha'i 'ja' sprin bzhin/ /snang yang rang bzhin ma grub stong / /'ja' sprin nam mkha'i cho 'phrul bzhin/ /chos rnams rig pa'i cho 'phrul yin/ /rig pa'i ngo bo stong ba yin/ /stong sang nam mkha' yangs pa 'dra/ /de la mnyam par 'jog pa'i dus/ /thog mar rang rig thig le zhig /rnam par snying gar gnas par bsgom/ /lus las 'od zer dpag med 'phros/ /snod bcud la phog ma dag sbyangs//'od du zhu nas rang la thim//rang lus 'od zhu snying ga yi/ /thig le la thim thig le de/ /dper na skyen pos mda' 'phangs bzhin/ /phaṭa kyis nam mkhar yar la 'phangs/ /mkha' la 'ja' tshon yal ba ltar/ /thig le nam mkhar yal nas 380

'dres/ /nam mkhas gar khyab rig pas khyab/ /rig pas gar khyab chos skus khyab/ /chos sku khyab gdal ngang du glod/ /glod 'phro kyi li me re sdod/ /yun ring bar du 'dug thub ltos/ /de las langs nas rjes thob dus/ /mkha' la 'ja' tshon 'then pa bzhin/ /rang rig stong gsal yangs pa ru/ /snod rnams thams cad dag pa'i zhing / /bcud rnams lha dang lha mor dmigs/ /gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i zhing khams su/ /rang nyid song nas sangs rgyas la/ /mjal zhing dam chos nyan par bsgom/ /gzhan yang rang nyid seng ge dang / /nyi ma zla ba'i steng du bsdad/ /nam mkhar gyen du 'gro ba dang //ri brag rnams la thal byung du//phug nas phar 'gro tshur 'gro dang / /rang lus lha yi sku ru bsgom/ /gcig las mang bor sprul ba dang / /mang bo gcig la sdud pa dang / /gcig nas gcig tu gnas mang bsgyur/ /'di ni kun mkhyen chos rgyal gyis/ /nyin zhig gsung gi zhor zhig la/ /khyod kyis lta ba skyong dus su/ /skabs rer 'di ltar gyis shig dang / /dgos pa du ma yod do gsungs/ /brjed kyis dogs nas yi ger bris/ /mthong thos rgyud la phan par shog /thugs chos sku'i mkha' las ma g.yos bzhin/ /sku rab mdzes 'od gsal nyi ma shar/ /bu bdag gzhan pad tshal legs 381

skyong ba'i//mtshan snyan pa ngag dbang wang la 'dud/ /spyir lta ba 'tshol tshul mang na yang //nang sems steng lta ba 'tshol ba'i tshe /khyod nam mkha' 'di la dpe longs la/ /da mtha' dbus med pa'i lta ba tshol/ /spyir sgom pa bsgom tshul mang na yang / /nang sems nyid 'od gsal sgom pa'i tshe/ /khyod nyi zla 'di la dpe longs la/ /da gsal 'grib med pa'i sgom zhig rgyob//spyir spyod pa spyod tshul mang na yang / /nang lta sgom bogs 'byin spyod pa'i skabs/ /khyod skyi ser rlung 'dir dpe longs la/ /da ngos bzung med pa'i spyod pa gyis/ /spyir 'bras bu thob tshul mang na yang / /nang lta sgom spyod gsum mthar phyin 'bras/ /dpe sprin med mkha' la nyi shar 'dra/ /rang gzhan don lhun grub 'bras bu thob/ /glu 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /ri rma chen mgul nas rang la blangs/ /'di mthong dang thos tshad dad can gyi/ /nang sems la phan thogs 'byung bar shog /drin can bla ma chos rgyal wang la 'dud//ri khrod 'grim pa'i bya btang sgom chen ang / /khrag rul rnag rul bsogs pa'i rma rul la/ /thug gang reg gang mi 'jug byes pa bzhin/ /las nyon sdug bsngal rtsa ba sems nyid la/ /rtog dpyod mi byed hon ne bsdad na 'phung / /za byin pags pa gyong bo thar bcad nas//382

pags mnyed mkhas pas mnyes pa'i dpe bzhin du/ /tshogs gsog byed bzhin sems nyid gyong bo kho/ /lung rig brgya phrag spros la bdar sha chod/ /mnyed 'ong tshar nas mnye ba ngal ba'i rgyu/ /'on kyang chu thigs lhung na mnye dgos bzhin/ /bdar sha chod nas dpyad pa ngal ba'i rgyu/ /'on kyang chags zhen byung na dpyad 'jog bzang //khyi rgan kha sgor gang byung za ba bzhin//mi rtog thams cad bsgom du bzung na 'phung / /ngang bas chu las 'o ma len pa bzhin/ /rtog med stong gsal zang thal rjen pa skyongs/ /glu 'di nyin zhig rang la phan phyir blangs/ /thos tshad rnams kyi rgyud la phan par shog /chos kyi rgyal po gtan gyi skyabs/ /skyabs su mchi'o byen gyis rlobs/ /sems nyid nam mkha' sa gzhi dang / /rgya mtsho bzhin du rgya che ba'i/ /rdzogs pa chen bo'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gangs can bod kyi glu dbyangs mkhan//bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas//shog dril bzhin du sems kum pa/ /bla ma'i thabs mkhas gdams ngag gis/ /dben par bsdad nas bdar sha bcad/ /gam kum med par thang chod nas/ /da ni bdar sha chod yag red/ /nam zhig mnyam par bzhag na yang / /gang zhig cig la lhod lhod lhod/ /phyam phyam mi re re byed gda'/ /'khor ba zer ba'i 383

'jigs po che/ /spang ma dgos par rgyun du shar/ /sangs rgyas zer ba'i sgra bo che/ /btsal ma dgos par rang las byung / /stong nyid bsgoms pas snying rje kho/ /bsgom ma dgos par shugs kyis skyes/ /gnyis ka ma bu bzhin du gda'/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung skal ba bzang / /rdzogs chen rnal 'byor gsar ba tsho/ /dben par rdzogs chen sgom pa'i dus/ /thog mar sems kyis rtsad gcod gyis/ /skye med stong bar kho thag chod/ /gcod mkhan de yang sems yin pas/ /rang bzhin grub pa e 'dug ltos/ /bltas pas ci yang mi mthong tshe/ /spros pa mang bo'i kha dgos med/ /ma mthong ba de'i ngang du sgyur/ /bsgyur tshe sa le sang nge ba/ /trig ge rjen nas ye re ba/ /bsgom med rdzogs chen lta ba yin/ /yengs med skyongs da nga e ma ho/ /glu 'di thos tshad rdzogs chen pa/ /gsar bu rnams la phan par shog /chos kyi rgyal por gus pas 'dud//e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /lus po g.yo 'gul med par sdod/ /ngag gis smra ba thams cad chod/ /mig gnyis ma btsum hrig ge zhog /kha rlung shugs chung dal bar gyis/ /sems kyis snang grags gang la yang //'di zhes 'dzin pa med par zhog /lus ngag yid gsum khong lhod nas/ /sos dal lhan ne bsdad pa'i tshe/ /rnam rtog med par kyi 384

ler gnas/ /gang yang mi mthong brjod mi shes/ /sa le sang nge hrig ge ba/ /sprin med ston gyi mkha' 'dra ba/ /sems kyi gnas lugs rjen pa yin/ /de yi ngang la gnas par gyis/ /'di thos rgyud la phan par shog /chos kyi rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /e ma skal ldan slob ma rnams//lus po 'gul med cog ge zhog /ngag gi smra med cog ge zhog /sems nyid rtog med cog ge zhog /cog bzhag gsum gyi sgo nas sems/ /gnas lugs ji bzhin mthong bar 'gyur/ /rnam rtog byung na glang bo cher/ /tsher ma zug kyang rtsol med bzhin/ /rtog med had de khyad de zhog /bzhag na chu rnyog dwangs pa na/ /chu yis rang mdog ston pa bzhin/ /phra rags rnam rtog kun 'gags tshe/ /gsal stong bde nyams shugs kyis 'char/ /shar ba de ni 'gag mi dgos//gsal stong bde'o snyam pa zhig /byung na de ka rnam rtog yin/ /rnam rtog de ka bor la thongs /dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/ /rnam rtog phra rags gang skyes bor/ /bsgom med had de phyad de sdod/ /sems ngo gsal stong 'di'o zhes//blo yi gtad sa zhig byung na//de yang rnam rtog yin pas na/ /de ka rang sar zhi bar gyis/ /gnas 'dug 'phros bzhag snyam pa zhig /byung na de ka rnam rtog yin/ /de yang rang 385

sar zhi bar gyis//bying rgod dbang du e song dang //e 'gro snyam pa zhig skyes kyang / /de yang rnam rtog yin pas na/ /de ka bor la lhan ner sdod//gzhan yang bzang ngan sna tshogs kyi//nyams snang ci byung dgag mi dgos/ /de dang 'di byas 'dzin pa zhig /byung na de ka rnam rtog yin/ /de yang lings kyis bor la thongs//rnam rtog phra rags ci byung yang //gnyen po gzhan cang btsal dgos med/ /dran rtog med par had de zhog /rnam rtog rang sar zhi bar 'gyur/ /mdor na rnam rtog bzang bo rtas/ /mi khug pa zhig byung yang bor/ /dus dang rnam pa thams cad du//mi rtog ngang du lhan ner gnas/ /gnas tshe dper na chu rnyog cig /ma rnyog bzhag na sa rdul dwangs/ /dri med chu yi rang mdog mthong / /gzugs snyan sna tshogs 'char ba ltar/ /nyon mongs rnam par rtog pa yis/ /sems nyid 'od gsal bslad 'dug pas/ /phra rags rnam rtog thams cad bor/ /mi rtog ngang du lhan ne gnas/ /bsdad na rnam rtog kun zhi tshe/ /ka dag sems nyid 'od gsal mthong / /nyams snang rnam pa sna tshogs 'byung / /'di thos rgyud la phan par shog /chos kyi rgyal por gus pas 'dud/ /sems la 'khor 'das kun rdzogs pa'i//rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa//tshogs drug 386

rang grol zhes bya ngas/ /don dam rdo rje'i glu chung 'then/ /e ma rang gi sems nyid kyi/ /ngo bo ye nas stong ba nyid/ /ya ki sangs rgyas zhing khams nas/ /ma ki dmyal ba yan chad la/ /sems nyid stong bas khyab par gda'/ /stong ba nyid la mtha' dbus med/ /mtha' bral nam mkha' yangs pa 'dra/ /'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus pa/ /thams cad sems kyi nang na gnas/ /gnas pa'i 'khor 'das chos rnams kun/ /snang tsam ma gtogs ngo bo stong / /snang stong chu nang zla gzugs 'dra/ /bde ba can dang dmyal ba gnyis//rnam pa bzang ngan ltar snang yang //ngo bo stong ba bzang ngan med/ /de ltar ye nas yin pa la/ /yin par shes nas de'i ngang la/ /yang yang bdag gis goms pas mthus/ /da ni sri zhi'i spang blang bral/ /myang 'das thob kyang dga' rgyu med/ /zhi bar gnas la dgos pa chung //'khor bar 'khyams kyang sdug rgyu med/ /dga' bzhin 'gro don byas na 'tshengs/ /ma rtogs sems can snying re rje/ /pha mar ma gyur gcig kyang med/ /thams cad drin can sha stag yin//da ni drin lan mjal ba'i phyir//ma gyur 'gro ba'i don la 'jug /sems nyid gnas lugs ji bzhin rtogs/ /'bral med skyong ba'i rnal 'byor nga'i/ /sems nyid stong gsal chos sku yin//da lta'i sgyu lus gzugs sku yin/ /387

chos sku'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin/ /gzugs skus 'gro ba'i don la brtson/ /nam zhig sgyu lus gzugs kyi sku/ /'chi ba 'od gsal chos skur bsdu/ /chos sku'i dbyings las gzugs skur ldang / /slar yang 'gro don dpag med byed/ /gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor nga / /'khor bar khor yug 'khyams na yang //nyam nga bag tsha spu tsam med//sku gsum 'khor lo bskor ba yin/ /'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku yin/ /bar do'i sgyu lus longs sku yin/ /skye ba len pa sprul sku yin/ /da ni sku gsum 'khor lo bskor/ /ma gyur 'gro ba'i don la brtson/ /dper na sgye zhabs rdul sprugs bzhin//'khor ba dong nas ma sprugs bar//'gro ba'i don la brtson par smon//smon pa bzhin du 'grub gyur cig /thugs mkha' ltar stong zhing shel ltar dwangs/ /rang sems ngo sprod pa'i chos rgyal la/ /bdag mos gus drag pos gsol ba 'debs/ /sems gnas lugs rtogs par byen gyis rlobs/ /sprin dkar nag 'ja' tshon ri mo gsum//dus dang po byung yang mkha' las byung / /dus bar du gnas kyang mkha' la brten//mthar thim yang mkha' la thim par 'gyur/ /'od 'od zer 'od kyi gur khang gsum/ /dus dang po byung yang nyi zlas byung / /dus bar du gnas kyang nyi zlar brten//mthar thim yang nyi zlar thim 388

par 'gyur//mdog rab mdzes me tog rtsi shing gsum//dus dang po byung yang ri las byung/ /dus bar du gnas kyang ri la brten/ /mthar thim yang ri la thim par 'gyur/ /rlabs chen po chung ngu chu lbur gsum/ /dus dang po byung yang mtsho las byung //dus bar du gnas kyang mtsho la brten/ /mthar thim yang mtsho la thim par 'gyur/ /phyi snang grag nang gi rnam rtog gsum/ /dus dang po byung yang sems las byung / /dus bar du gnas kyang sems la brten/ /mthar thim yang sems su thim par 'gyur/ /chos thams cad rang gi sems kyi 'phrul/ /sems stong gsal ngang la mnyam par zhog /gzhan ma rtogs 'gro la snying rje sgoms/ /sems bskyed la rgyal sras spyod pa slobs/ /glu 'di yang rang la e phan phyir/ /ri gangs dkar rma chen mgul nas blangs/ /dge 'dis kyang rang gzhan la phan nas/ /sems skye med chos sku mngon 'gyur shog /thugs mkha' ltar stong zhing rab tu yangs//pha ma ltar drin che chos rgyal wang //mgo'i zhwa ltar spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs//bus dran ltar 'dud do byin gyis rlobs/ /rje mi la skal ldan rgya mtsho sogs/ /rje gong ma'i rnam thar rjes zhugs nas/ /rje rma chen bzhugs gnas gangs ri nas/ /rje chos rgyal bu ngas glu chung 389

len/ /khyod nam mkha' yangs par dpe zhog la/ /sems mtha' dbus med pa'i sgom zhig rgyob/ /nang rnam rtog lho sprin ltar 'khrigs kyang //sems nam mkha' bzhin du bde mor bzhugs//khyod 'od gsal nyi mar dpe zhog la//sems gsal 'grib med pa'i sgom zhig rgyob/ /nang rnam rtog nyi zer ltar 'phro yang /sems nyi ma bzhin du bde mor bzhugs/ /khyod rma chen ri la dpe zhog la/ /sems g.yo 'gul med pa'i sgom zhig rgyob/ /nang rnam rtog rtsi shing ltar skye yang //sems ri bo bzhin du bde mor bzhugs/ /khyod rgya mtsho chen por dpe zhog la//sems kha gting med pa'i sgom zhig rgyob//nang rnam rtog rba rlabs ltar 'khrugs kyang //sems rgya mtsho bzhin du bde mor bzhugs//glu sngon chad mang bo mang bo blangs/ /glu len la shin tu shin tu dga'/ /glu 'di yang lhang nge lhang nge blangs/ /glu thos tshad je skyid je skyid shog/ces pa 'di rnams kyang tshogs drug rang grol gyis blangs pa'o//chos rgyal zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal//rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gangs can khrod kyi glu dbyangs mkhan/ /ri ba tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /res 'ga' nam 'chi cha med bsgom/ /nam 'chi cha med bsgoms tsa na/ /'chi bdag thag nyer slebs pa 'dra/ /ci drag snyam pa'i blo sna thung / /res 'ga' 390

'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgom/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgoms tsa na/ /nyes can btson rar tshud pa 'dra/ /bde'o snyam pa cung zad med/ /res 'ga' 'gro la snying rje bsgom/ /'gro la snying rje bsgoms tsa na/ /bu chung na ba'i a ma 'dra/ /cung zad yal bar 'dor snyam med//res 'ga' bla mar gsol ba gdab//bla mar gsol ba btab tsa na//khye'us pha ma 'bod pa 'dra//rjes su mi 'dzin dogs pa med/ /res 'ga' yi dam bskyed rim bsgom/ /yi dam bskyed rim bsgoms tsa na/ /'bag bzo mkhas pas 'bag bzhengs 'dra/ /bskyed rim zer ba 'di ang snyam/ /res 'ga' gtum mo'i bde drod sbar/ /gtum mo'i bde drod sbar tsa na/ /ja tsha dro gos gyon pa 'dra/ /dro zhing bde ba'i nyams dang ldan//res 'ga' rdzogs chen lta ba bsgom/ /rdzogs chen lta ba bsgoms tsa na//khyung chen mkha' la lding ba 'dra//'khor ba'i g.yang la 'jigs pa med/ /res 'ga' 'od gsal thod rgal bsgom/ /'od gsal thod rgal bsgoms tsa na/ /'og min zhing du slebs pa 'dra/ /myang 'das e thob re ba med/ /rnal 'byor sems mkhar nyams myong sprin/ /'khrigs tshe nyams mgur char ba byung / /thos tshad shes rgyud zhing sa brlan/ /nyams rtogs lo legs 'khrungs par shog /ces pa 'di yang nyams myong med rung yod yod ltar 391

blangs pa'o//chos rgyal zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol ngas//gang sharwa glu dbyangs blangs tshad kun//'gro la phan par byen gyis rlobs/ /phye ma leb kyis rgyang ring nas/ /lhab lhab byas tshe 'ga' zhig gis//mthong nas gshog pa ga tshod kyi//lus po ci 'dra zhig yod snyam//brgyugs nas drung du song tsa na//a me ya sdeb che gi snyam//'on kyang ltos dang gshog steng na/ /ngo mtshar ri mo sna tshogs yod/ /rkang drug bung bas rgyang ring nas/ /sgra chen bsgrags tshe 'ga' zhig gis/ /thos nas sgra skad ka tshod kyi/ /lus po ci 'dra zhig yod snyam/ /brgyugs nas drung du song tsa na/ /a me ya sdeb che gi snyam/ /'on kyang ltos dang lus po na/ /ngo mtshar thig le sna tshogs yod/ /rnal 'byor nga yis rgyang ring nas//glu dbyangs 'then tshe 'ga' zhig gis//go nas mgur 'bum ka tshod kyi/ /nyams rtogs ci 'dra zhig yod snyam/ /brgyugs nas drung du song tsa na/ /a me ya sdeb che gi snyam/ /'on kyang ltos dang mgur 'bum na/ /ngo mtshar mgur ma sna tshogs yod/ /mgur 'bum mthong thos dran reg dang / /'bri 'don klog 'chang byed tshad kun/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par smon/ /smon bzhin 392

myur du 'grub gyur cig /smon bzhin 'grub na dga' ba la/ /smon bzhin 'grub na skyid pa la/ /smon bzhin dkon mchog mthus 'grub shog /de skad smon pa'i dge ba des/ /de nyid ma rtogs 'gro ba kun/ /kun tu bzang bo'i go 'phang la/ /la 'ur son pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis bris pa'o//rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun zhabs dkar rdo rje 'chang chen pos mchog dman bar ma'i gdul byar gang 'tsham gyi rdo rje'i mgur dpag tu med pa bzhengs pa yi ger 'khod pa'i nang tshan las//sa bcu'i dbang phyug rma chen sbom ra'i gangs ri'i mgul nas bzhengs pa'i skor ro//393

brag dkar sprel rdzong dang kya phug pad+ma rdzong dang zwa lung sogs nas bzhengs pa'i skor/dbu rdzogs phyag chen gcod rgyud bla ma rnams/ /dbu ma'i yar sne spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /phun tshogs tshogs gnyis mthar phyin sangs rgyas kyi/ /gsung rab rab 'byams gdams par 'char du gsol/ /brag dkar shel dkar spungs 'dra'i sprel rdzong nas/ /sems dkar rnam dkar dge sgrub rnal 'byor ngar/ /nges nges khrig khrig nyams myong ma mchis kyang / /legs legs 'grig 'grig nyams mgur lhang lhang len/ /yang dag dag snang dad gus shes rab can/ /bu rnams rnam dag dad pas glu 'dir nyon/ /bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur bod kyi mkhas grub kyis/ /bka' 'gyur bstan bcos brtsams la dpe ltos gyis/ /sangs rgyas gsung la lan gcig ma bltas na/ /sangs rgyas bstan la mjal ba dgos pa chung / /shes rab rta phor le lo'i sgrog ma rgyag /gsung rab dgongs 'grel thang la gcig rgyugs 394

ang / /bka' dang bstan bcos bltas na pan yon che/ /bka' srung dam can rgya mtshos srung skyob mdzad/ /ya mtshan che ba'i mdo rgyud bstan bcos la/ /nyin mtshan med par dben pa bsten la gzigs/ /chos shes chos rnams gzhan la 'chad shes bzhin/ /chos min chos pas byas na ltas ngan yin/ /thos pa byas pa kho nas ma tshims par/ /thos bsam sgom gsum sgo nas rang rgyud thul/ /glu 'di thogs med blangs dges 'gro rnams kyi/ /klu sgrub thogs med rnam thar zin phyir bsngo/ /zhes pa 'di yang slob bu yongs la gangs can bod kyi glu dbyangs mkhan tshogs drug rang grol gyis brag dkar sprel rdzong nas smras pa'o/ /ma bzhin bzhin mdangs 'dzum nas phar phyin dang / /ma smin smin par byed pa'i gsang sngags dbang / /ma grol grol byed bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen khrid/ /ma lus lus med gnang mkhas bla mar 'dud/ /brag dkar dkar phyogs lha gnas sprel rdzong nas/ /sems dkar dkar chos sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor ngas/ /rnam dkar dkar bo'i dge bskul rgyang glu len/ /las dkar dkar bo'i sems kyis sgrub rnams nyon/ /ya mtshan mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa yis/ /ci gsungs gsung bzhin bsgrubs na rang nyid kyis/ /ci bsams bsam don thams cad chos bzhin du/ /'grub nges nges tshig yin pas gal che ang / /nam yang yang yang mi 395

rnyed mi yi lus/ /lus 'di 'di bzhin mi rtag myur du 'jig /'jig che tshe 'di'i rgyu nor zas gsum mi/ /mi phan phan nges chos yin tshe blos thongs/ /las dkar dkar bo'i sems kyis legs bsgrubs na/ /'od dkar dkar bo'i lam brgyud gyen du 'gro/ /las nag nag po'i sems kyis bsgrubs gyur na/ /mun nag nag po'i lam brgyud thur du 'gro/ /dkar chos chos min mi dge gang byas kyi/ /rnam smin smin pa'i tshul rnams zhib tu soms/ /dus kun kun la gnod 'tshe ma byed par/ /ci phan phan thogs mdzod dang 'di phyir bde/ /'khor ba pa la bde ba cung zad med/ /skyabs mchog mchog gsum bsten la skyabs 'gro rem/ /gtan bde bde ba can gyi zhing la sogs/ /rnam dag dag zhing zhig la yid smon gyis/ /a ma ma byas sems can gcig kyang med/ /byas tshe tshe 'di'i ma bzhin drin che bas/ /phan sems sems bskyed mdzad nas dus kun tu/ /ci phan phan thogs byed pa shin tu gces/ /ma dad dag pa'i snang bar bsgyur mdzad pa'i/ /bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen gdams pa nyams su longs/ /blangs na na 'chi'i dus su 'ja' 'od sogs/ /grol rtags rtags bzang dang bcas gshegs par 'gyur/ /thub bstan bstan 'dzin bzhugs gnas sprel rdzong nas/ /'di blangs blangs 396

pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /rgyal bstan bstan 'dzin sa steng yun ring gnas/ /'gro rnams rnam mkhyen go 'phang thob par shog /ces pa 'di yang slob bu 'gyur med kyis bskul ngor gangs can bod kyi glu dbyangs mkhan gyis brag dkar sprel rdzong nas smras pa'o/ / mtshan ldan gyi bla ma spyi bor bzhugs/ /gus ldan gyi grogs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /don ldan gyi glu dbyangs snyan mo la/ /skal ldan gye grogs rnams ma yengs nyon/ /khrims ldan gyi dam pa'i rnam thar bzhin/ /chos ldan gyi bya ba byed 'dod na/ /mtshan ldan gyi bla ma tshul bzhin bsten/ /brgyud ldan gyi mdo sngags gdams pa nyon/ /skyon ldan gyi yul grong nor rdzas spongs/ /byen ldan gyi ri khrod dben pa sten/ /blo ldan gyi chos mthun grogs dang 'grogs/ /'byor ldan gyi mi la sgrub brgyags slongs/ /bde ldan gyi zhing du skye rgyu sgrubs/ /sdug ldan kyi ngan song rgyu rnams dor/ /snod ldan gyi slob ma rjes su zungs/ /dad ldan gyi pho mor dam chos shod/ /rigs ldan gyi grogs po thams cad kyis/ /don ldan zhig mi lus thob dus mdzod/ /bsil ldan gyi bod yul glu ba ngas/ /dam ldan gyi grogs la phan pa'i glu/ /byen ldan gyi sprel rdzong gnas nas blangs/ /shes ldan gyi 'gro la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang gangs can bod kyi glu dbyangs mkhan gyis brag dkar sprel rdzong nas smras pa'o/ /397

dmigs med brtse ba dri med mkhyen pa can/ /mtshungs med bla mar zol med gus phyag 'tshal/ /'chad med thogs med rma chu'i rgyun bzhin du/ /'dzad med ngal med rnal 'byor glu dbyangs 'then/ /mi med dben pa'i ri khrod nyams dga' na/ /grogs med gcig pur 'dug pa'i bya btang nyon/ /bslu med bla ma dkon mchog rin po che/ /'bral med spyi bo'i gtsug tu khur cig ang / /'khrul med dam chos mnyam thob grogs po la/ /sel med dad gus dag snang gyis shig ang / /grangs med phan btags ma gyur 'gro rnams la/ /tshad med snying rje bskyed la phan thogs ang / /nor med lam bzang mdo rgyud man ngag la/ /yengs med thos bsam nan tan gyis shig ang / /don med tshe 'di'i bya ba blos thongs la/ /g.yel med rtse gcig sgom la brtson cig ang / /dpag med yon tan gzhi rten sdom pa gsum/ /nyams med srog las gces par srungs shig ang / /thogs med ang drug glu dbyangs blangs pa 'dis/ /byar med tshogs drug rang grol la phan shog /rmongs pa ba lang lta bu'i bdag blo chos/ /bsgyur mkhas mkhas btsun bzang 'dzoms bla mar 'dud/ /phan thogs thogs tshad byed pa'i yon bdag gis/ /lha chos chos bzhin nus par 398

byin gyis rlobs/ /gang 'dod 'dod ltar phangs med ster mkhan gyi/ /yon bdag bdag gi glu dbyangs 'di la nyon/ /mi lus lus rten gzhan las khyad par 'phags/ /mi rnyed rnyed dus chos gyis yon bdag ang / /rtag 'dzin 'dzin chags che na chos mi dran/ /mi rtag rtag tu soms shig yon bdag ang / /dben gnas gnas pa bdag gis snyan pa'i glu/ /'di blangs blangs pa'i dge ba la brten nas/ /chos mthun mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i yon bdag gi /tshogs rnams rnam pa kun tu bde skyid shog /e ma ma gyur 'gro 'dren rgyal sras mchog /bla ma ma bzhugs thugs rje'i phyag rkyongs la/ /pha ma ma rig nyon mongs dbang gyur rnams/ /lhag ma ma lus bde chen zhing du drongs/ /dar dkar 'phyar 'dra'i brag dkar sprel rdzong na/ /lus dkar rgod 'dra'i bya btang ri khrod pas/ /rab dkar sems kyis rgyang glu ring bo len/ /rnam dkar dge sgrub rgyang na gnas kyang nyon/ /mi mngon chos dbyings nam mkha' yangs pa na/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas nyi ma bzhugs/ /bla ma me shel bzang bor bsten nus na/ /yon tan me zhig rang rgyud spra bar 'pho/ /mi lus rnyed dka' don che'i khang ba na/ /'jig sla chos la bskul ba'i pha ma yod/ /'grogs nas sdig spong dge sgrub so nam rem/ /mngon 399

mtho'i bde dga' longs spyod 'dzad med 'byung / /nges 'byung rnam dag rgyal mtshan rtse mo na/ /bslab gsum yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel yod/ /nyams len rtse gcig gsol ba 'debs nus na/ /nges legs thar ba tsam gyis dgos 'dod 'byung / /byams dang snying rje'i brag dmar khyung tshang na/ /byang chub sems mchog bya rgyal khyung phrug yod/ /tshul khrims rnam gsum mas drod zas byen na/ /thabs shes gshog rgyas kun mkhyen mkha' la 'phur/ /zhi gnas gser gyi yu ba la brten nas/ /lhag mthong 'jam dbyangs sprul ba'i ral gri yod/ /dran shes lag pas legs par 'phyar nus na/ /bdag 'dzin 'phung rgan dgra yi snying rtsa 'dar/ /gsang sngags smin byed dbang gi gser mkhar na/ /grol byed khrid kyi gong ma rgyal po bzhugs/ /dam sdom khrims brtsis nyams len mchod bkur na/ /sku gnyis gser yig gser tham chen mo gnang / /nam yang bdag gzhan las dkar gang bsags rnams/ /nam mkha' nam gnas bar la rgyal bstan gnas/ /nam yang rgyal sras zhabs brtan mdzad pa rgyas/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam bdag gzhan rnams sangs rgyas/ /zhes pa 'di yang grogs po yongs la bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis brag dkar sprel rdzong nas smras pa'o/ /400

gtan gyi bde ster bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byen gyis rlobs/ /e ma skal ldan khyod nyon cig /zhen med bya btang rnal 'byor ngas/ /pha yul rgyab tu bskyur bas bde/ /nye 'brel 'ching ba bcad pas bde/ /zas nor zhen pa spangs pas bde/ /bya ba thams cad btang bas bde/ /'gro na lus rgyu med pas bde/ /bsdad na chags rgyu med pas bde/ /khyim mtshes chags sdang bral bas bde/ /rdzogs chen be'u bum khur na bde/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag sems la bde/ /lta ba 'gyur ba med pas bde/ /sgom pa byeng rgod med pas bde/ /spyod pa gza' gtad med pas bde/ /'bras bu re dog zhig pas bde/ /dben gnas ri khrod zin pas bde/ /grogs gcig kyang med na de bas bde/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' drin gyis/ /tshe 'dir yang bde la phyi mar bde/ /bar do rang ngo shes pas bde/ /da nas bde nas bde bar 'gro/ /rnal 'byor bde ba'i skyid glu 'dis/ /'gro kun bde zhing skyid par shog /dga' 'o skyid do rdo rje'i spun/ /khyed kyang nga bzhin e skyid ltos/ /zhes pa 'di yang mched grogs 'ga' res bde zhus byas pa'i lan du smras pa'o/ /snying dbus bla ma spyi bor bzhugs/ /snying dang 'dra ba'i bu la gzigs/ /snying nas bu khyod chos byed na/ /snying bo med pa'i bya ba sgongs/ /snying rus bskyed nas sgom rgyob dang / /snying la 401

nyams rtogs nyi ma 'char/ /snying nas bla mar gsol btab na/ /snying bum byin rlabs bdud rtsis 'gengs/ /snying nad che ba'i dgra yin yang / /snying rje bsgom pa chos pa'i lugs/ /snying grogs rnams la phan thogs dang / /snying nas tshur la ma ltar byams/ /snying rje stong nyid chos kun gyi/ /snying bo yin pas bsgoms na 'tshengs/ /snying gtam 'di nyid bu khyod kyis/ /snying du chongs la lha chos mdzod/ /snying 'di phyir phyung bstan yang sha /snying gtam smras pa de bas lhag /snying nas smras pa'i tshig dor na/ /snying rul yin pas gzhan ma sems/ /snying nas chos sgrub rnal 'byor ngas/ /snying gtam smras pa thos tshad kyis/ /snying bo med pa'i bya ba spangs/ /snying bo'i lha chos bsgrub par shog /ces pa 'di yang dad gtong shes rab sogs 'phags pa'i nor gyis phyug pa'i slob bu lha bzo blo bzang yon tan gyis bskul ngor gangs can bod kyi gru dbyangs mkhan gyis brag dkar sprel rdzong nas smras pa'o/ /steng spyi gtsug pad+ma nyi zla'i steng / /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma thugs rje can/ /spyir sems can yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /sgos chos mthun grogs po bu bzhin skyongs/ /sngon las dang smon lam bzang bo'i mthus/ /nged rnam gnyis skye sa mi gcig rung / /dus da lo gnas 'dir 'dug sa gcig /'brel legs po bzhag pa skal ba bzang / /yar skyes pa mi rtag tha mar 'chi/ /gnyen 402

'dus pa mi rtag tha mar 'bral/ /nor bsags pa mi rtag tha mar 'dzad/ /mthor song ba mi rtag tha mar ltung / /grogs khyod kyis chos rnams mi rtag pa'i/ /tshul soms la tshe 'di blo yis thongs/ /rje dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar skyongs/ /mi nga yang gang du song na yang / /grogs khyod kyis ci bsam 'grub pa'i phyir/ /lha dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal chos skyong srung mar 'phrin bcol bya/ /zhal mjal rag bar du bde bar bzhugs/ /dus ring min myur du mjal bar shog /bkra shis pa'i nyi mar slar mjal dus/ /bkra shis pas phyogs 'dir khyab gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang brag dkar sprel rdzong nas rma 'gram kya phug pad+ma rdzong du 'ong dus blo gros mchog mnga' grogs po ri khrod pa 'jam dbyangs dar rgyas la smras pa'o/ /rje kun mkhyen sangs rgyas thugs rje can/ /sprang bdag gi spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs/ /mgon khyod kyis bstan 'dzin dge 'dun rnams/ /thugs shin tu mthun par byen gyis rlobs/ /khyed dgon pa skyong ba'i bla ma yis/ /'gyed mang ja phogs rgyob bka' chos gsungs/ /khyed dge bskos che chung dge g.yog gis/ /'grig kun spyod dge 'dun nang khrims sdoms/ /khyed dbu mdzad che chung mchod dbyangs pas/ /dbyangs 'don pa gnyis ka nges nges gyis/ /khyed spyi ba gnyer ba phyag mdzod pas/ /403

gzhan yon bdag 'ong ba lha bzhin bkur/ /khyed grwa ba rgan gzhon thams cad kyis/ /'grig kun spyod brtsis la thos bsam gyis/ /khyed dkon gnyer rnams kyis lha khang gi /nang bye dor gyes la mchod pa shoms/ /khyed ja ma chu len nang zan gyis/ /las gang bcol byed dus go chod gyis/ /khyed dad can 'byor ldan yon bdag gis/ /dus rtag tu dgon pa mchod bkur rem/ /khyed mchog dman bar ba thams cad kyis/ /dus rtag tu 'dod chung chog shes sten/ /sngar rten bzhengs gang byas nyams pa gsos/ /phyis sku gsung thugs rten bzheng la brtson/ /gzhan chos la ma smod dag snang sbyongs/ /rang gang mos chos de nyams su longs/ /kun 'phags nor bdun gyis phyug na bzang / /kun dge sbyong chos bzhir gnas na bzang / /mdor bsdus na dgon de'i skyid ang zhes/ /gzhan mthong thos yid smon 'chor ni gyes/ /glu 'di nyid mthong dang thos tshad kyis/ /dgon che chung yongs la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang dgon pa rnams la smras pa'o/ /seng gangs dkar ltongs su bsdad na mjes/ /zas 'tshol phyir gangs mthar gcig babs na/ /gzhan mi rnams ngo mtshar ltad mo blta/ /dus rgyun du babs na ltas ngan zer/ /rgod brag dmar stod du bsdad na mdzes/ /zas 'tshol phyir ri mthar 404

gcig 'khor na/ /gzhan mi rnams ngo mtshar ltad mo blta/ /dus rgyun du 'khor na ltas ngan zer/ /khong sgom chen ri nas bsdad na mjes/ /zas 'tshol phyir grong mthar gcig 'ongs na/ /gzhan mi rnams ngo mtshar mjal du 'ong / /dus rgyun du song na ltas ngan zer/ /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa 'di dag gis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /sbyin bdag rnams kyis mchod sbyin btang ba dang / /kha ton phyag skor la sogs dge ba'i las/ /sngon chad byas dang phyin chad byed rgyu kun/ /bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i phyir du bsngo/ /de'i mthus sangs rgyas bstan pa dar bar shog /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe ring bar shog /'gro kun gnas skabs kun tu bde bar shog /mthar thug sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par shog /dper na zhing sa chen por sa bon zhig /btab na brgya stong bye ba cher 'phel bzhin/ /de ltar bsngos pas dge rtsa cher 'phel ba/ /slar yang sbyin pa'i bdag por smin par shog /de'i mthus tshe ring nad med lus stobs rgyas/ /bu dang tsha bo yang tsha mang bo 'dzom/ /gong ma'i mdzod bzhin 'dzad med 'byor ba ldan/ /405

slar yang bstan 'gror phan thogs cher 'byung shog /'chi dus bu pha'i khyem du 'gro ba bzhin/ /bde ba can gyi lam la zhugs ma thag /bod kyi lha skal 'phags pa spyan ras gzib/sa/ /dngos su byon nas lam sna 'dren par shog /bde ba can gye zhing du legs khrid nas/ /bcom ldan mgon po 'od dpag med pa yis/ /ma nor zab rgyas chos bstan nyams su blangs/ /myur du sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par shog /rdzogs sangs rgyas tshe sprul ba mang bo bkyes/ /tshe 'di'i pha ma bu dang chung ma dang / /mthun grogs khyem mtshes g.yas g.yon 'brel thogs kun/ /nub phyogs bde ba can du 'dren par shog /drangs nas chos thos nyams blangs sangs rgyas te/ /yon tan khyad med spun zla bzhin du 'grogs/ /dag dang ma dag zhing khams rab 'byams 'grims/ /sangs rgyas mchod cing sems can 'dren par shog /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis ba 'di dag gis/ /'go la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /e ma 'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na/ /bde zhing skyid pa'i bde ba can zhing yod/ /zhing der bcom ldan mgon po 'od dpag med/ /sku mdog dmar bo 'od zer 'phro ba bzhugs/ /406

g.yas phyogs bod kyi lha skal spyan ras gzigs/ /g.yon gyi phyogs su mthu chen thob bzhengs nas/ /bzhugs pa'i mtha' skor dge slong bye ba 'bum/ /chos gos rnam gsum gsol nas ser ldem me/ /bzhugs pa yongs la spyan dang mngon shes mnga'/ /sems can kun gyis bya ba gang byed rnams/ /lag mthil bltas bzhin sgrib med spyan gyis gzigs/ /khog tu gang dran thugs kyis sa ler mkhyen/ /mos gus phyag la nye ring khyad med pas/ /bdag gi chu bur mig gis mi mthong rung / /nub kyi phyogs su kha bltas lag pa gnyis/ /thal mo sbyar nas rgyang nas gus phyag 'tshal/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul ba'i mchod tshogs 'bul/ /'gro la phan phyir thugs rje'i stobs kyis bzhes/ /mgon po 'od dpag med pa thugs rje can/ /'khor bcas bdag la brtse bas dgongs su gsol/ /tshe las 'das pa 'di yis thog drangs pa'i/ /tshe 'das sems can ji snyed yod pa kun/ /'khor bar ma gtong thugs rje'i phyag rkyongs la/ /bde ba can gyi zhing du drang du gsol/ /tshe 'das phyir du tshe ldan pho mo yis/ /dkon mchog mchod pa dbul bor sbyin gtong dang / /dge 'dun bsnyen bkur la sogs dge ba'i las/ /ci byas tshe 'das la phan phyir du bsngo/ /ba yi rjes su be'u 'brang ba bzhin/ /tshe 'das bar do 407

rigs drug gar gnas kyang / /rjes su song nas de yi mthu la brten/ /bde ba can gyi zhing du skye bar shog /gal te de 'dra'i skal bar mi ldan na/ /mtho ris yon tan bdun ldan mi lus thob/ /rtag tu ngu dang nā ro'i rnam thar bzhin/ /mtshan ldan bla ma tshul bzhin bsten par shog /dang po thos pa byed pa'i dus skabs su/ /kun mkhyen blo bzang grags pa'i rnam thar bzhin/ /rgya cher thos pa byas nas mdo rgyud dang / /bstan bcos thams cad gdams par 'char bar shog /bar du dben pa bsten nas bsgoms pa'i mthus/ /grub chen mi la ras pa'i rnam thar bzhin/ /snying rus bskyed nas bsgoms pas grub rtags rigs/ /phul byung skye 'gro gzhan la ston nus shog /tha ma 'gro don byed pa'i dus skabs su/ /sangs rgyas thugs rje can gyis rgya gar du/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i chos 'khor bskor ba bzhin/ /chos 'khor bskor nas 'gro kun smin grol shog /sngon bla ma bsten dus dad pa chung / /da dad pa che dus bla ma med/ /de gnyis ka 'dzom pa'i dus ma byung / /nga ri khrod dben par sgom du 'gro/ /sngon bla ma'i mdun nas 'dug mi 'dod/ /da bsdad na 'dod dus bla ma med/ /de gnyis ka 'dzom pa'i dus ma byung / /nga ri khrod dben par sgom du 'gro/ /sngon bla ma'i 408
