gsung la nyan mi 'dod/ /da nyan na 'dod dus bla ma med/ /de gnyis ka 'dzom pa'i dus ma byung / /nga ri khrod dben par sgom du 'gro/ /sngon bla mar chos mang zhu mi 'dod/ /da zhus na 'dod dus bla ma med/ /de gnyis ka 'dzom pa'i dus ma byung / /nga ri khrod dben par sgom du 'gro/ /sngon bla ma bsten dus 'bul rgyu med/ /da 'bul rgyu rnyed dus bla ma med/ /de gnyis ka 'dzom pa'i dus ma byung / /nga ri khrod dben par sgom du 'gro/ /sngon bla ma bzhugs dus mjal mi 'dod/ /da mjal na 'dod dus bla ma med/ /de gnyis ka 'dzom pa'i dus ma byung / /nga ri khrod dben par sgom du 'gro/ /sngon a ma yod dus dungs sems chung / /da dungs sems che dus a ma med/ /de gnyis ka 'dzom pa'i dus ma byung / /nga ri khrod dben par sgom du 'gro/ /sngon a mar yun ring 'grogs mi 'dod/ /da 'grogs na 'dod dus a ma med//de gnyis ka 'dzom pa'i dus ma byung / nga ri khrod dben par sgom du 'gro/ /sngon a ma'i tshig la nyan mi 'dod/ /da nyan na 'dod dus a ma med/ /de gnyis ka 'dzom pa'i dus ma byung / /nga ri khrod dben par sgom du 'gro/ /sngon a mar yun ring 'grogs mi 'dod/ /da 'grogs na 'dod dus a ma med/ /de gnyis ka 'dzom pa'i dus ma byung / /nga ri khrod dben par 409

sgom du 'gro/ /sngon a ma yod dus thug mi 'dod/ /da thug na 'dod dus a ma med/ /de gnyis ka 'dzom pa'i dus ma byung / /nga ri khrod dben par sgom du 'gro/ /sngon grogs po yod dus brtse gdung chung / /da brtse gdung che dus grogs po med/ /de gnyis ka 'dzom pa'i dus ma byung / /nga ri khrod dben par sgom du 'gro/ /sngon grogs po yun ring 'grogs mi 'dod/ /da 'grogs na 'dod dus grogs po med/ /de gnyis ka 'dzom pa'i dus ma byung / /nga ri khrod dben par sgom du 'gro/ /sngon grogs kyi tshig la nyan mi 'dod/ /da nyan na 'dod dus grogs po med/ /de gnyis ka 'dzom pa'i dus ma byung / /nga ri khrod dben par sgom du 'gro/ /sngon grogs po yod dus phan mi thogs/ /da phan 'dogs thub dus grogs po med/ /de gnyis ka 'dzom pa'i dus ma byung / /nga ri khrod dben par sgom du 'gro/ /sngon grogs po yod dus 'phrad mi 'dod/ /da 'phrad na 'dod dus grogs po med/ /de gnyis ka 'dzom pa'i dus ma byung / /nga ri khrod dben par sgom du 'gro/ /zhes pa 'di ni ri khrod du song ba'i shul nas lo snga phyi byas bla ma a ma grogs po 'ga' re gshegs pa la yid skyo ba'i shugs kyis tshogs drug rang grol gyis kya phug pad+ma rdzong nas blangs pa'o/ / ljon shing yal ga khyod da lta 'gul skyod 'dra ma mang / /bya 410

rgyal khu byug nga yang yang khyod steng nas mi grag /ston gsum nam zla kho slebs dus myur du rang 'gro nges/ /mdangs ldan me tog khyod da lta 'gul 'khrig 'dra ma mang / /yid 'ong bung ba nga yang yang khyod steng la mi 'bab/ /zam zim kha char kho slebs na myur du rang 'gro nges/ /dam ldan mched grogs rnams da lta ca co rang ma mang / /skal ldan bya btang nga sa 'dir yang yang ni mi 'ong / /skyo shas shugs drag kho skyes na myur du rang 'gro nges/ /zhes pa 'di yang mched grogs mang bos tshe blos btang ste yul phyogs gzhan du 'gro mi thub zer ba thos pa'i lan du bris pa'o/ /rje bla ma chos rgyal ngag dbang wang / /bu'i shes rgyud byen gyis brlab tu gsol/ /nga'i rjes 'jug chos mthun snying gi bu/ /rje dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /rang gang 'dod dben par da song la/ /chos zab rgyas gdams pa nyams su longs/ /nga thag ring dbus gtsang dag zhing gi /gnas dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dgar 'gro/ /gnas dben pa'i yon tan dran pa'i mod/ /dus da dung dben pa bsten snying 'dod/ /ri smug chung 'then pa'i khrod cig na/ /blo chos su 'gro ba'i dben gnas yod/ /shing rtsi thog me tog sil thog mod/ /bya bye'u chung skad snyan sna tshogs sgog /sems spro ba'i spang gzhongs 'jam po 411

dang / /brag phug pa shin tu sra ba yod/ /gnas de 'dra bsten pa'i mi de la/ /sems skyid pa'i nyi ma khong nas 'char/ /glu 'di thos rnams kyis sgom rgyag phyir/ /gnas shin tu dben pa bsten par shog /ces pa 'di ni kya phug nas smras pa'o/ /mi sogs 'gro kun skyabs gnas bla ma rje/ /mi 'bral spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /mi ngas bza' btung mi brjed dran pa ltar/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /mi lus rin chen thob pa da re tsam/ /mi tshe yun thung nam 'chi nges pa med/ /mi sngar ma shi zer ba thos ma myong / /mi mang shi ba'i rtsis grangs zhib tu thongs/ /mi kun gsod pa'i gshin rje'i pho nya yis/ /mi khyod tshe thar byas nas mi 'jog nges/ /mi bzod ngan song sdug bsngal myong ba'i rgyu/ /mi dge bcu yi 'byung gnas grong yul yin/ /mi kha ngan pa nyes skyon shugs kyis 'ong / /mi dge sdig pa'i grogs kyis thur du khrid/ /mi za 'dod kyang log 'tsho dkor zas 'bag /mi mang 'dzoms sar 'go nad 'khon 'dzing mang / /mi snyan gtam ngan nyin re bzhin du thos/ /mi tshe sdig sdug gtam ngan ngang la 'dzad/ /mi khyod grong du song nas ma 'dug ang / /mi yi yod med gnyis ka sdug bsngal che/ /mi nor zas gsum cung zad 'dzoms pa la/ /mi theg khral dang 'u 412

lag dpon pos 'jog /mi ngan rkun mas brku zhing jag pas 'phrog /mi min lha 'dres na tsha god kha gtong / /mi phyugs nom pa 'dzad snyam sems sdug mang / /mi nor zas gsum med na lto rgyab gnyis/ /mi 'dang mi khebs sems la bde dus med/ /mi dpon phyug po'i bran dang g.yog byas na/ /mi des las ka gang bcol byed dgos shing / /mi bzang zas gos hral hrul gos ngan gyon/ /mi zad shig mang dgra bor 'thab mo 'chor/ /mi gzhan 'ga' re'i lag nas bu lon blangs/ /mi 'phrod mi rung yang yang 'ded du 'ongs/ /mi ngan sprang slong zer zhing sdigs rdung mang / /mi khyod yod med gnyis ka ma smon ang / /mi med ri khrod dag pa'i zhing dang mtshungs/ /mi 'dod sdug bsngal mi snyan ming yang med/ /mi yis nam yang bdag tu ma bzung ba'i/ /mi 'dzad chu shing sngo tshod shing 'bras mang / /mi gcig kha de ji ltar byas kyang sos/ /mi la la sogs gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /mi chos spangs nas rnam dag chos byas na/ /mi g.yog ma byas rgyu nom ma bsogs kyang / /mi zas dam dum shugs dang stabs kyis 'ongs/ /mi ltogs mi grang dge sbyor gong 'phel 'gyur/ /mi tshe 'di 'am phyi mar sangs rgyas nas/ /mi yis gtso byas 'gro kun 'dren par 'gyur/ /mi khyod ri khrod bsten la chos sgrubs ang / /413

mi rtag 'chi ba dran pa'i glu dbyangs 'di/ /mi khom brgyad kyi nang du ma skyes kyang / /mi bsam dgu bsam sems nyid mi khom pa'i/ /mi nga'i rgyud la phan thogs 'byung bar shog /ces pa 'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis chos lung phu'i dben gnas zwa lung nas rang la smras pa'o/ /gsung rab dgongs 'grel tshig don kun la mkhas//mkhas par ma zad thugs rgyud dul zhing zhi/ /zhi bar mi gnas 'gro la dam chos ston/ /ston pa'i bstan 'dzin bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /tshe 'di yun thung nam 'chi nges pa med/ /tshe thar yin zhes zer ba gcig mi snang / /tshe la snon pa cung zad tsam yang dkon/ /tshe tshad lnga bcu ring ba drug cu ste/ /tshe phyed yad ma yud la shor nas thal/ /tshe lhag ci tsam yod de sus mi shes/ /tshe srog mi brtan chu yi chu bur 'dra/ /tshe la gnod pa'i rkyen ni shin tu mang / /tshe yi 'phen zad 'chi nad byung ba'i tshe/ /tshe dpag med mgon sgol ma dkar mo sogs/ /tshe lha mang bo dngos su byon na yang / /tshe bsring mi thub shi na bar dor 'khyam/ /tshe 'di'i lto rgyab phyir du sdig byas na/ /tshe zad srin bu grog tshang khar tshud bzhin/ /tshe rabs phyi mar dmyal ba'i gnas su ltung / /tshe 'dir dge ba byas na phyi mar bde/ /nam 'chi cha med sdig pa byed mi rung / /rung ba chos yin sgrubs zhes bla mas gsungs/ /gsungs 414

pa de bzhin bdag gis yi ger bkod/ /bkod pa 'di yis rang gzhan la phan shog /ces pa 'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang gzhan yongs la phan phyir dben gnas zwa lung nas smras pa'o/ /drin can bla ma dang kha thag ring ba'i dus/ /mjal 'dod dad gus dang dag snang skye skye 'dra/ /mjal nas lo zla tsam 'grogs dang dus mnyam du/ /dad gus je chung song log lta je cher gyur/ /grwa slob yon bdag tshos mchod bstod bkur ba'i dus/ /kha tsam tshig tsam min snying nas byams byams 'dra/ /tshig ngan cung zad tsam smras dang dus mnyam du/ /byams pa gnas 'gyur nas zhe sdang zhig tu song / /dro 'jam gon pa dang zhim pa'i zas 'dzoms tshe/ /chos pa dga' mo tsho'i gral dbur bzhugs bzhugs 'dra/ /ltogs 'khyags ngal ba zhig byung dang dus mnyam du/ /chos pa'i khyu nas bud chos min gral du thal/ /zhes pa 'di yang rang gi spyod tshul la nyin zhig lta rtog cung zad bgyis tshe/ rkyen ngan cung zad tsam yang mi theg par go nas khrel bdas kyi tshul du dbus kyi dben gnas zwa lung nas smras pa'o /nyams rtogs mthar phyin bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /nyams snang sna tshogs 'char ba'i rnal 'byor nyon/ /nyams su bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen len pa'i tshe/ /nyams la lha yis zhal gzigs chos ston sogs/ /nyams snang rnam pa sna tshogs 'char ro zhes/ /415

—nyams myong can gye rnal 'byor pa rnams gsungs/ /nyams de bzang ngan gang la chags mi rung / /nyams la zhen chags g.yeng na dam chos gang / /nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor bar chad yin/ /nyams rtogs gong nas gong du mi 'phel gsungs/ /nyams myong rtogs ldan gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /nyams gang shar yang ma chags ma yengs par/ /nyams len mdzod dang myur du sangs rgyas nas/ /nyam thag 'gro ba yongs la phan par 'gyur/ /nyam chung bya bral tshog drugs rang grol gyis/ /nyams la gang shar smras pa dge legs 'phel/ /zhes pa 'di yang dad ldan 'phrin las smin grol gyis nyams snang sna tshogs byung ba gang yin nam zer ba'i lan du bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas zwa lung nas smras pa'o//bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha la 'dud/ /bdag gzhan chos dang mthun par byin gyes rlobs/ /ya rabs dad can skal ldan slob ma la/ /ya mtshan che ba'i kha ta cung zad bya/ /mi lus rin chen yang yang rnyed par dka'/ /mi tshe yun thung nam 'chi nges pa med/ /phyi mar rang nyid bde zhing skyid 'dod na/ /phyin chad gang du sdod kyang 'di bzhin gyis/ /byang chub ma thob bar du bla ma sten/ /gnas lugs ma rtogs bar du thos pa gyis/ /chos ni shes pas mi chog nyams su longs/ /chos gang nyams su len dus 416

'du 'dzi spongs/ /brtan pa ma thob bar du ri khrod zungs/ /grogs ngan ma sten chos mthun grogs dang 'grogs/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu dam pa'i chos la 'bungs/ /chos bzhin byas na lto rgyab zhor la 'byung / /'dod pa ma che nor la chog shes sten/ /nga rgyal ma che zhi zhing dul bar gyis/ /rnyed dang bkur ste 'ching byed yin pas spongs/ /bstod dang snyan grags bslu brid yin pas dor/ /dman pa rnams la ma brnyas snying rje skyed/ /dgra gnyen gnyis la chags sdang med par mdzod/ /mkhas grub ma smod gus pas bka' chos nyon/ /gzhan skyon ma tshol rang skyon rtogs la spongs/ /chos mdzad yongs la bran ltar gus par gyis/ /'gro ba yongs la bu bzhin byams par mdzod/ /bzhin mdangs ma gnag 'dzum bzhin tshig 'jam smros/ /lab lab ma mang tshod zungs ran par smros/ /grub mtha' gang la'ang ma smod dag snang sbyongs/ /rang nyid gang mos chos de nyams su longs/ /ser sna ma che gang yod mchod sbyin thongs/ /spyod log ma byed tshul khrims rnam dag srungs/ /zhe sdang ma che khro med nga 1 ) pa sgoms/ /le lo ma che sgrub la brtson 'grus gyis/ /rnam g.yeng dgra rnam sa bsam gtan mdung gis thul/ /mi shes mun nang shes rab sgron me sbor/ /mdor na chos dang mthun pa'i bya ba gyis/ /417

byas na bde skyid nyi ma 'char bar nges/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag gzhan sgo gsum chos dang mthun par shog /ces pa 'di yang dad can ye shes lhun grub kyis zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas zwa lung nas smras pa'o/ /na mo gu ru bh+ya/ sngon sbyangs las 'phro can/ /skal ldan snying gi bu/ /tshe 'di blo yis thongs/ /mtshan ldan bla ma sten/ /mdo rgyud man ngag nyon/ /ri khrod dben pa snyogs/ /rtse gcig nyams su longs/ /tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms/ /snyan pa'i ba dan g.yo/ /nyams rtogs zla ltar rgyas/ /bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /tshig 'di shin tu bden/ /'di'i gzhan ngas mi shes/ /mdor bsdus zhal gdams 'dis/ /kun la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis slob ma kun la phan phyir dben gnas zwa lung nas bris pa'o/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma byin rlabs can/ /bdag gi shes rgyud byen gyes brlab tu gsol/ /mi rnams nam 'chi nges pa cang mi 'dug /grogs bo phal cher phyi ma'i lam la thal rang yang nam 'gro'i nges pa ma mchis bzhin/ /yun ring sdod gshom byed pa'i blo ring bo/ /sos dal bde bar 'dug pa'i snying khams can/ /da res gtan bde sgrub dbang yod dus 'dir/ /snyom las ngang la sdod pa'i dus tshod min/ /'chi ba'i nad ni glo bur 418

steng du 'ong / /'ongs dus na zug ma bzod g.yag ltar 'khun/ /dbugs kyang ring len thung len byed pa'i dus/ /'ga' res yar btegs mar bsnyal kha lo bskor/ /ci 'dra red ces 'dri dus 'gyod kyang 'phyis/ /shin tu brtse ba'i gnyen bshes rnams dang bral/ /bsags pa'i rgyu nom thams cad shul du bsgyur/ /'jig rten phyi mar lag stong 'gro dgos pas/ /gnyen bshes rgyu nom phyir du sdig ma gsog /gnyen bshes rgyu nom phyir du sdig bsogs na/ /rgyus med cha med bar do'i 'phrang ring la/ /grogs med gcig pur 'gro dus 'jigs skrag che/ /de las thar kyang dmyal ba'i gnas su ltung / /lhung na tsha grang sdug bsngal bzod glags med/ /de phyir rang gis rang la snying rje na/ /tshe 'di'i gnyen bshes rgyu nom blo yis thongs/ /phyi mar gtan bde'i lha chos 'bad par gyis/ /bla ma'i byen rlabs sems la myur zhugs nas/ /tshe blos btang nas dam chos bsgrub par shog /ces pa 'di yang dben gnas zwa lung nas smras pa'o/ /drin can bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe 'di blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /dben par lha chos nus par byen gyis rlobs/ /grub dbang mi la ras pa la sogs pa'i/ /sngon byon dam pa gong ma'i 419

rnam thar bzhin/ /ming dang don gnyis mthun pa'i bya btang zhig /byed pa'i dus shig bdag la nam 'ong ang / /spang ljongs nags tshal me tog rgyan ldan zhing / /chu gtsang rgyun 'bab bya bye'us skad snyan sgrog /na bun ldang ba'i dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /gcig pur 'dug pa'i dus shig nam 'ong ang / /bsgrub pa'i dus su dka' tshegs dka' las myang / /spyad pas mi ngoms sdig sdug gtam ngan gsum/ /sna 'dren sha sogs zhim mngar zas spangs nas/ /ngan ngon za ba'i dus shig nam 'ong ang /dad zas log 'tsho mi dgos shig sro med/ /tshe ring nad med rig pa shin tu gsal/ /nyams rtogs 'char sogs phan yon mang gsungab pas/ /bcud len byed pa'i dus shig nam 'ong ang / /don med rnam g.yeng gti mug ro nyal spangs/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag rtse gcig nyams su blangs/ /tshe mjug 'di la sa lam mthar phyin nas/ /gzhan don byed pa'i dus shig nam 'ong ang / /zhes pa 'di yang slob bu don yod phun tshogs la bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dbus kyi dben gnas zwa lung nas smras pa'o/ /na mo rat+na gu ru/ lha lam dro 'jam nyi ma/ /'dzin ma'i me tog spang rgyan/ /bar snang chu 'dzin 'dzoms dus/ /sprin dkar me tog mdzes kyang / /nyi ma nub rir yibs nas/ /ri mgo mun 420

pas non tshe/ /sprin dkar me tog lus pa/ /dkar gsal mdzes rgyu mi snang / /gong gi sha tsha'i ma rgan/ /'gab kyi snying nye'i sring mo/ /bar gyi bu nga 'dzoms dus/ /ming sring bde skyid spro yang / /drin can a ma shi nas/ /sems mgo skyo bas non tshe/ /ming sring shul du lus pa/ /bde skyid spro rgyu mi snang / /bya rgyal khu byug sngon mos/ /mdzes pa'i mgrin pa btegs nas/ /phyogs bzhir kha bltas lhang lhang / /skad snyan sgog pa thos tshe/ /byams pa'i mig gis bur bltas/ /snyan pas ming nas 'bod pa'i/ /rgas pa'i a ma dran nas/ /mig nas 'chi ma lhung byung / /khu byug yul gzhan song bar/ /skyo ba cung zad skye yang / /phyi lo 'ong tshul bsams tshe/ /skyo ba skye rgyu mi snang / /ma rgan phyi mar song la/ /skyo ba tshad med skye ba/ /phrad rgyu med tshul bsams tshe/ /skyo ba sangs dus mi snang / /ma la phrad 'dod che yang / /phrad yul a ma med tshe/ /phrad na 'dod kyang sur 'phrad/ /sring mor phrad rung mi phan/ /ma la zhen chags che yang / /chags yul a ma med tshe/ /chags na 'dod kyang sur chags/ /gzhan na chags sa'i ma med/ /da ni ma'i drin chos kyis/ /'jal phyir dben par chas 'gro/ /bu ngas chos kyis ma la/ /phan thogs 'byung bar gyur cig /gcig pur skyo mgur 'then pa/ /a mas tshor na dga' ba/ /chos kyis ma la 421

phan nas/ /bu zhes gleng na skyid pa/ /skyo bral rang sems mkha' la/ /skyo shas chu 'dzin 'khrigs tshe/ /skyo dbyangs dbyar rnga ldir bzhin/ /skyo mgur char 'di 'bebs so//na mo rat+na gu ru/ sprin 'ja' nyi ma rnam gsum/ /mkha' la dus gcig 'dzoms nas/ /dga' ston sbrang char phab tshe/ /sprin dkar lang tsho gsar yang / /'ja' yal nyi ma nub nas/ /sa gzhi smag gis khebs tshe/ /sprin dkar shul du lus pa/ /'od mdangs ci yang mi snang / /bla ma grogs bdag rnam gsum/ /sa la dus gcig 'dzoms nas/ /dga' ston chos gtam bgyis tshe/ /nyams dga' snang ba spro yang / /grogs gshegs bla ma zhing brjes/ /rang sems skyo bas khebs tshe/ /bdag nyid shul du lus pa/ /dga' spro ci yang mi snang / /rab mdzes me tog tshal na/ /lus mdzes bung ba mang bos/ /dga' ba'i gar bsgyur glu blangs/ /sbrang rtsi len pa mthong tshe/ /sngon dus bla ma'i drung nas/ /slob mas gsol 'debs phyag byas/ /dbang lung khrid gsum zhus pa/ /dran nas 'chi ma lhung byung / /'od gsal nyi ma nub rir/ /yibs tshe cung zad skyo ba/ /nyin re bzhin du 'char tshul/ /bsams na skyo rgyu mi snang / /nyi ma las lhag bla ma/ /zhing gzhan gshegs la skyo ba/ /nam yang mjal rgyu med tshul/ /bsams kyin 422

skyo ba skyes byung / /bla mar mjal 'dod che yang / /mjal yul bla ma med tshe/ /mjal na 'dod kyang sur mjal/ /gzhan la mjal bas mi phan/ /bla mar bdag sems chags rung / /chags yul bla ma med tshe/ /chags na 'dod kyang sur chags/ /gzhan na chags sa mi snang / /da ni bla ma'i sku drin/ /gzhal phyir dben par chas 'gro/ /bu nga'i sgrub pas bla ma'i/ /thugs dgongs rdzogs par gyur cig /gcig pur skyo mgur 'then pa/ /bla mas gsan na dga' ba/ /sgrub pa'i mchod pas dgyes nas/ /bu zhes gleng na skyid pa//na mo rat+na gu ru/ dang po lus srog bskyed ma/ /bar du zas gos ster ma/ /tha ma chos sgor 'jug ma/ /rgas pa'i drin can a ma/ /sngon dus nyin gcig tsam la/ /gson bral byed mi phod rung / /da lta shi nas gtan bral/ /byas rung sdod dgos dus byung / /kye hud sdod mi tshugs rung / /'dus nas 'bral ba 'jig rten/ /'khor ba'i chos nyid yin pas/ /gzhan du 'gro sa mi snang / /da ni 'phrad na 'dod kyang / /cang shes rta phor zhon nas/ /sa steng nyul nas btsal yang / /ma la 'phrad dus mi 'byung / /ma bu tshe 'dir lhan cig /'dus nas rtse dgod byed bzhin/ /skyid dga' longs spyod dga' ston/ /byed pa'i skal ba 423

chad song / /da ni zhim mngar bza' btung / /byin nas dro 'jam yang gos/ /yod tshad bskon na 'dod kyang / /bskon yul a ma mi snang / /rnar snyan yid 'bab gtam snyan/ /da lta rang gis shes tshe/ /ma la bshad na 'dod kyang / /bshad yul a ma mi snang / /sha tsha snying nye'i spun zla/ /chung 'dris mthun grogs pho mo/ /yul mi khyem mtshes rgan rgon/ /lha bas lhag pa'i sems bzang / /ma bzhin rang la byams pa'i/ /gnyen bshes brtse gdung can rnams/ /thams cad 'di yi chos nyid/ /nam zhig so sor 'bral nges/ /nam 'bral nges pa mi snang / /sang dgong do nub yin yang / /bral nas e 'gro bsams na/ /da lta yud tsam 'tshogs dus/ /phan tshun sems la gnod pa'i/ /bya ba ngan pa sus byed/ /brtse zhing dungs pa'i sgo nas/ /phan thogs byed par rigs so/ /sngar yang drin can a mar/ /zas byin gos bskon sems la/ /phan pa'i gtam snyan smras mod/ /'on kyang sems la gnod pa'i/ /tshig ngan dam dum shor ba/ /deng sang bsam blo btang tshe/ /sems la 'gyod pa skyes nas/ /mig chu 'don dgos byung ba/ /da yang khyod kyis brjed nas/ /brtse bas gnyen bshes gzhan la/ /ci phan phan thogs ma byas/ /tshig ngan re gnyis shor na/ /phyi nas gtan bral gyur dus/ /'gyod pa drag po 'byung 424

nges//de dus 'gyod kyang 'phyis song / /ngus rung sur phan sus go /'gyod med 'dod na su la/ /da lta gnod 'tshe ma byed/ /thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i sgo nas/ /blo kha chos la sgyur ang / /snga sor brtse gdung can gyi/ /gnyen bshes la la shi bral/ /la la gson bral byas tshul/ /bsams na da lta 'grog pa'i/ /gnyen bshes 'di dang nged gnyis/ /nam tshod cig la bral 'gro/ /snyam na sngar bas 'dod gdung / /khong na me bzhin 'bar byung / /de dang lhan du bdag 'dzin/ /chags zhen 'khrul ba byung nas/ /nam yang 'bral mi phod par/ /lhan cig sdod 'dod skyes kyang / /yun ring 'grog pa'i mthu med/ /phyi mar khrid pa'i sa med/ /khrid rung gar 'gro cha med/ /bsams na tshe 'dir yud tsam/ /'grogs la don go mi snang / /de phyir chags nas ci bya/ /de bas chos shig bya dgos/ /bsams nas zhen chags chod song / /da ni skye ba phyi mar/ /pha ma gnyen bshes thams cad/ /dag pa'i zhing du drangs nas/ /'grog pa'i skal ba ldan phyir/ /rang gi lus srog la yang / /chags zhen spu tsam med par/ /dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dga'/ /'grim pa'i go cha gyon song / /dang po smon 'jug sem sa bskyed/ /bar du tshogs gnyis dger 'bad/ /tha ma bsngo smon mtshams sbyor/ /nyin bzhin byed par smon no/ /ma 'ongs pha 425

ma gnyen bshes/ /'gro la ci phan byed snyam/ /rang gi yid na yod pa/ /de bzhin 'grub par gyur cig /ces pa 'di rnams kyang dbus kyi dben gnas zwa lung nas smras pa'o/ /blo phugs gtad na mi bslu ba'i/ /'gro ba yongs kyi mgon skyabs dpung / /bla ma yi dam dkon mchog la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /yid bzhin nor bu las lhag pa'i/ /dal 'byor mi lus rin po che/ /shin tu rnyed dka' don yang che/ /rnyed dus chud zos ma gtong ang / /brtsigs pa'i gnas khang bsags pa'i nor/ /'grogs pa'i gnyen bshes rgyab tu bsgyur/ /phyi mar nam 'gro cha med pas/ /'grub med bya ba ma mang ang / /bde 'dod sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa/ /sems can thams cad blo mthun pas/ /rang gi lus la dpe longs la/ /gzhan la gnod pa ma byed ang / /'gro la byams na bu chung la/ /gces na pha ma dga' ba bzhin/ /rgyal ba sras bcas thugs mnyes pas/ /'gro la phan thogs gyis shig ang / /khros pas rang gi dge rtsa 'joms/ /mdza' bshes grogs po rnams kyang sun/ /zhe sdang drag po'i gzhu 'then nas/ /tshig rtsub dug mda' ma 'phen ang / /chos pa 'ga' res phyi rol gye/ /spyod pa mig sngar mi mdzes kyang / /nang gi thugs dgongs mi shes pas/ /gang 426

la'ang dag snang gyis shig ang / /dam pa'i chos la mi bzang med/ /dbu ma phyag rdzogs zhi byed gcod/ /la sogs chos la bzang ngan phyes/ /phyogs ris chags sdang ma byed ang / /rang gis brtsigs pa'i gnas khang du/ /rtag tu 'dug dbang rang la med/ /don med khang las ma byed par/ /ri khrod brag phug sten cig ang / /sems can sems la gang shar rnams/ /rgyal ba'i thugs kyis sa ler mkhyen/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal rnams thugs khrel ba'i/ /bsam ngan yid la ma 'chang ang / /'gro kun lus ngag bya spyod gang / /byas tshul phyogs bcu'i rgyal rnams kyis/ /rtag tu ye shes spyan gyis gzigs/ /spyod ngan lkog tu ma byed ang / /'khor ba sdug bsngal thams cad po/ /las dang nyon mongs rgyu las byung / /las nyon rtsa ba bdag 'dzin yin/ /bdag 'dzin phung rgan thul cig ang / /chos rnams thams cad sems kyi 'phrul/ /sems nyid dpyad na ngos bzung bral/ /ngos bzung med pa'i stong sang gi /ngang la mnyam par zhog cig ang / /chos kun rmi lam sgyu ma 'dra/ /rang bzhin grub pa rdul tsam med/ /med bzhin snang ba'i chos rnams la/ /tshugs thub bden par ma 'dzin ang / /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal kun las bskyabs/ /bde ba kun la sprod pa'i mgon/ /bslu med dkon mchog gsum yin 427

pas/ /rtag tu skyabs su sten cig ang / /byin rlabs stsol ba'i bla ma dang / /dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha/ /bar chad sel ba'i chos skyong gsum/ /g.yel med tshul bzhin sten cig ang / /mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma yis/ /rang la ma nor chos bstan pa/ /yin min the tshom ma byed par/ /rtse gcig nyams su longs shig ang / /dge chos gang byas thog ma ru/ /smon 'jug byang chub sems bskyed la/ /tha ma 'dun pa drag po yis/ /bsngo smon rnam dag gyis shig ang / /de ltar mdzad na gnas skabs su/ /mngon mtho lha mi'i bde ba 'byung / /mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang dam pa thob par 'gyur/ /dge 'dis mtshon pa'i rang gzhan gyis/ /dge ba ci bsags 'gro ba kun/ /sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /thams cad sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces pa 'di yang dad can slob bu ngag dbang dar rgyas kyis bskul ngor tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas zwa lung nas sbyar ba'o// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /phan pa'i snying gtam tshig 'ga' smra/ /ma yengs legs par nyon cig ang / /thos bsam byas pa'i dgos pa ni/ /lag len mkhas pa yin pa la/ /chos kyi phyag len mi shes par/ /'jig rten shes rgya ma che ang / /khyem spangs rab tu byung nas 428

bzung / /dge sbyong chos bzhi bsten dgos pas/ /tshig ngan khab tsam mi bzod par/ /ngan lan 'khon 'dzin ma byed ang / /rang nyid btsun par khas blangs bstod/ /gzhan la sdom shor zer nas smod/ /rang gi rlom sems mi spong bar/ /gzhan la brnyas smod ma byed ang / /chos dang chos min shan 'byed pa/ /kun mkhyen spyod yul yin pa la/ /mthong lam tsam yang ma skyes par/ /chos la bzang ngan ma 'byed ang / /phyi yi spyod lam mi mdzes kyang / /nang rgyud smin cing grol ba mang / /mngon shes med bzhin rnal 'byor pa'i/ /rgyud tshod nam yang ma 'dzin ang / /'dul khrims bsrung ba chags sdang sogs/ /nyon mongs 'dul thabs yin pa la/ /tshul khrims srung gin dug gsum sogs/ /nyon mongs che ru ma 'gro ang / /'gro ba'i don du sems bskyed nas/ /sgrub pa snying bor mdzad dgos la/ /rang don ma legs phran tshegs phyir/ /sems 'khrugs sems bskyed ma 'chor ang / /gzhan skyon nyon mongs mi dge'i las/ /spong ba'i thabs la brtson dgos na/ /rang skyon spong ba smos ci dgos/ /g.yo sgyu khram gsum spongs shig ang / /lta ba rtogs na sngar bas kyang / /sdig pa phra mo'ang 'dzem dgos la/ /dge ba spangs nas mi dge bcu/ /sngar bas lag len ma che ang / /gsang sngags sdom pa 429

gsum ldan la/ /gnang bkag so mtshams ma shes par/ /nga la gang yang ma bkag ces/ /so thar khyad du ma gsod ang / /gsang sngags gsang nas sgrub pa la/ /dben par gsang nas mi bsgrub par/ /khrom dang grong yul dgon sogs nas/ /gsang ba nam yang ma sgrog ang / /rgyal bas bsngags pa'i ri khrod du/ /thag ring bgrod dka' mi tshugs zer/ /grong gi sbra chad khang rul nas/ /gtan du sdod grabs ma byed ang / /mdor na mdo rgyud man ngag kun/ /sems can nyon mongs 'dul thabs yin/ /rtag tu thos bsam sgom gsum sgos/ /rang rgyud nyon mongs thul cig ang / /ang yig bcu bzhi'i zhal gdams 'di/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /slob bu tshul khrims rnam rgyal la/ /smras pa bzhin du 'grub par shog /ces pa 'di ni dbus kyi dben gnas zwa lung nas smras pa'o/ /na mo rat+na gu ru/ ma gyur 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon/ /ma rig dbang gyur bdag la/ /ma nor lam bzang ston pa'i/ /ma las lhag pa'i bla mar/ /sngon chad lo 'am zla gcig /zhag bdun tsam la bral nas/ /phyogs gzhan 'gro dgos byung na/ /mi 'thad 'bral mi phod rung / /rtag 'dzin phyi bshol mkhan gyi/ /'gro rnams chos la bskul phyir/ /sngon dus ston pa sangs rgyas/ /430

gzugs sku mya ngan 'das bzhin/ /mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma'i/ /sku de mi rtag tshul bstan/ /da lta gzugs sku chu bur/ /mig gi lam du mi snang / /kye hud skal dman rang nyid/ /nya mo chu dang bral bzhin/ /shul nas mya ngan byed bzhin/ /sdod dgos dus ngan byung song / /da ni dpon slob 'khor bcas/ /tshe 'dir lo 'am zla bar/ /'grog pa phar zhog yud tsam/ /'grog pa'i skal ba med bzhin/ /gzhan yang 'brel tshad bla ma/ /dam tshig gcig pa'i spun grogs/ /ci gsung sgrub pa'i slob bu/ /rgyu zas 'brel thogs yon bdag /dad can pho mo rnams kyang / /'di yi rang bzhin yin pas/ /nam zhig so sor 'bral nges/ /nam 'bral nges pa mi snang / /da lta yud tsam 'grogs dus/ /bla ma grogs mched slob ma/ /sbyin bdag rnams kyi sems la/ /gnod pa'i bya ba ma byed/ /zas gos nor rdzas chos kyis/ /ci phan phan thogs mdzod la/ /ci smras ji bzhin sgrubs shig /zhen cing chags nas ci bya/ /rang gzhan gnyis kyi su yang / /tshe 'dir yun ring mi sdod/ /phyi mar so sor 'gro nges/ /sang 'gro gnangs 'gro'i cha de/ /rang gzhan gnyis la med phyir/ /da ni tshe 'di'i zhen chags/ /'khri ba rbad kyis bcad nas/ /tshe rabs phyi mar 'brel tshad/ /dag pa'i zhing du 'god phyir/ /bya btang rnal 'byor nga 431

yis/ /ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su/ /zab mo'i sgrub pa byed la/ /blo kha ches cher phyogs so/ /nam zhig sangs rgyas mchod cing / /sems can 'dren par smon no/ /rang gi yid la ci bsam de bzhin 'grub par gyur cig /nga rang skyo ba'i mgur 'dis/ /nga la phan thogs byung tshe/ /nga yi slob bu yongs la/ /nga bzhin phan snyam bskur song / /skyo ba rang skyes 'ong dka'/ /skyo shas sems la bskyed na/ /skyo mgur 'di 'dra 'then dang / /skyo shas nges 'byung skyes yong / /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas zwa lung nas smras pa'o/ /gtan gyi skyabs gnas bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /blo kha chos la phyogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /phyi rol snang ba dper bzhag gros shig 'debs/ /sor bcu brang la khroms la soms shig bu/ /nor bu dor nas 'ching bu 'tshol ba bzhin/ /bla ma dor nas grogs ngan ma tshol bu/ /gser dngul khrod du slog hrul drud pa bzhin/ /yon tan bor nas nyes skyon ma tshol bu/ /rin chen gling nas zong zad slar log bzhin/ /dal 'byor thob nas stong log ma byed bu/ /rang la mi 'chi'i gdeng zhig yod pa bzhin/ /yun ring sdod shom blo rgya ma che bu/ /mig can 'ga' re g.yang la mchong ba bzhin/ /shes bzhin las 'bras khyad du ma 432

gsod bu/ /mi gtsang khrod la dga' ba'i sbrang ma bzhin/ /'khor ba'i bde la chags zhen ma che bu/ /lcags kyu med pa'i glang chen smyon pa bzhin/ /nyes ltung du ma'i 'dam du ma bying bu/ /g.yo can chu skyar bye las spyod pa bzhin/ /zog gis rang gzhan gnyis ka ma bslu bu/ /rang don 'ba' zhig sgrub pa'i nyan rang bzhin/ /ma gyur 'gro rnams yal bar ma dor bu/ /mtsho 'khyags steng du chu rgyun bkram pa bzhin/ /nga bdag 'dzin pa je cher ma gtong bu/ /ded dpon bsten na rin chen gling bgrod bzhin/ /bla ma bsten nas gsang sngags sgor zhugs bu/ /gru de gas chag byung na nyen che bzhin/ /dam tshig nyams na nyen che srungs shig bu/ /nor bu lon tshe mchod bstod gsol 'debs bzhin/ /dbang khrid thob nas nyams su longs shig bu/ /nor bu mchod na dgos 'dod 'byung ba bzhin/ /gsang sngags nyams blangs dngos grub kun 'byung bu/ /mdor na seng lpags gyon pa'i wa skyes bzhin/ /chos par badzus nas chos min ma byed bu/ /sngon byon dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /chos min dor la chos bzhin gyes shig bu/ /glu 'di bton dang thos tshad thams cad kyi/ /rgyud la dngos sam brgyud nas phan thogs shog /ces pa 'di ni bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis slob bu skal ldan rang grol la dben gnas zwa lung nas gdams 433

pa'o/ /rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams/ /snyan pa'i glu yis mchod/ /nyams rtogs yon tan rnams/ /skye bar byin gyes rlobs/ /bya btang ri ba ngas/ /mi med lung stong nas/ /rang nyid skyo sangs phyir/ /dga' spro'i rgyang glu len/ /mtshan ldan bla ma la/ /zol med dad gus skyes/ /skal ldan slob bu yi/ /gral du tshud la spro/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' shes/ /tshe lhag don ldan byas/ /'dzam gling mi'i nang nas/ /bu rgod po rang byung / /mi rtag 'chi ba dran/ /tshe 'di blo yis thongs/ /chos pa dga' mo tsho'i/ /gral dbur gnas na mdzes/ /las 'bras rnam dbye shes/ /sdig spangs dge ba bsgrubs/ /ngan song gsum po la/ /'jigs pa spu tsam med/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsams/ /'khri ba btsan chod byas/ /bde chen thar ba'i zhing / /gang du song yang yongs/ /khas blangs sdom pa rnams/ /bsrung rgyu'i skal ba byung / /sdom brtson thams cad kyi/ /khyu mchog nga la gyis/ /pha ma sems can la/ /byams dang snying rje skyes/ /byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /gral du tshud pa mtshar/ /bdag 'dzin nyon mongs rnams/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis btul/ /'phags pa dgra bcom tsho'i/ /gral du sleb la khad/ /gsang sngags bla med chos/ /gsang nas nyams su blangs/ /tshe 434

gcig sangs rgyas de/ /da ni yong yong 'dra/ /sngon chad spyod tshul la/ /bsams pas spro shugs kyis/ /snyan pa'i glu chung 'di/ /kha nas shor bud song / /skyid pa'i rgyangs glu 'di/ /thos tshad bde skyid shog /ces pa 'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas zwa lung nas blangs pa'o//phyag dang mchod pa'i zhing mchog /'di phyi gtan gyi skyabs gnas/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po/ /mkhar rdo rin po che zhes/ /mtshan snyan nyi zla ltar grags/ /snyan pa lha mi'i yul na/ /nyin rer yang yang gleng ba'i/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i snyan du/ /tshe rabs gcig tsam ma yin/ /tshe rabs mang bo'i bar du/ /brtse bas rjes su bzung ba'i/ /skal ldan slob mas gus zhu/ /mgon khyod ngo mtshar rmad byung / /bskal pa dpag med sngon nas/ /sangs rgyas tshar nas 'gro la/ /gang 'dul gzugs sku bstan nas/ /gang 'tsham zab rgyas chos gsungs/ /sems can mang bo smin grol/ /lam la bkod pa mtha' yas/ /skabs 'dir gangs can ljongs 'di'i/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i snang ngor/ /sngags 'chang gos dkar lcang lo/ /can gyi tshul bzung gsang sngags/ /rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi/ /'khor lo bskor ba ngo mtshar/ /phul byung ltas dang cho 'phrul/ /smin grol slob ma yang slob/ /dge 435

legs bde skyid bkra shis/ /chen pos phyogs kun khyab byung / /khyed kyis gdul bya yongs la/ /dngos sam brgyud nas phan thogs/ /byung ba'i bka' drin stong gsum/ /gser gyis bkang rung gzhal dka'/ /'on kyang da dung skal bzang / /gdul bya yongs kyi don du/ /bskyed rim rdzogs rim rdzogs chen/ /khrid yig shin tu gsal ba/ /shel dkar phreng ba lta bu/ /gsungs zhes zhu rten lha rdzas/ /dri med shel phreng zhig phul/ /sor bcu snying gar sbyar nas/ /gsol ba yang yang 'debs pas/ /brtse ba chen po'i sgo rges/ /gsungs tshe bdag la stsol cig /ces pa 'di yang dben gnas zwa lung nas lha rdzas dri med bcas phul/dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad sol/ /chos dang mthun par byin gyis rlobs/ /e ma skal ldan chos mthun grogs/ /dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du 'ongs/ /chos la thos bsam byed dus su/ /ma yengs brtson 'grus skyed cig ang / /yon tan che chung gang yin yang / /mtshan ldan bla ma bsten las 'byung / /rtag tu bla ma ci mnyes gyis/ /thugs dang 'gal ba ma byed ang / /bla ma grogs kyi bka' drin gyis/ /phul byung mdo rgyud man ngag don/ /cung zad tsam zhig shes pa'i tshe/ /rang 436

mthong nga rgyal ma che ang / /thos pa mang bo byas pa de/ /rang rgyud nyon mongs 'dul thabs yin/ /thos pa byas kyin rang rgyud de/ /je rtsub je ngan ma 'gro ang / /khyem spangs rab byung dge slong byas/ /bslab pa blangs nas mi bsrung bar/ /nor phyugs bgrangs nas nyo tshong byas/ /sdom pa 'chor du ma 'jug ang / /khyem pa rnams dang rab byung gnyis/ /bzang ngan gnyis kyis khyad thon dgos/ /dzun smras g.yo sgyu 'khon 'dzing byas/ /khyem pa las thu ma bco ang / /cha lugs ngan pa'i gang zag gi /nang na yon tan ldan pa mang / /rang la mngon shes med bzhin du/ /dman par bltas nas ma brnyas ang / /sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i chos lugs mtha' yas 'byung / /rang dang mi mthun chos lugs la/ /ngan par bltas nas ma smod ang / /thos pa byas nas dben pa'i gnas/ /ri khrod bsten nas mi bsgom par/ /grong gi sbra nag khang rul 'grims/ /grong chog rkyang ba ma byed ang / /mdor na rab tu byung nas bzung / /thos bsam sgom gsum mi byed par/ /lo zla phar re tshur res zad/ /rab byung don med ma byed ang / /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /rang gi sems la gang shar rnams/ /dad ldan dge 'dun bzod par smras/ /thos tshad yongs la phan 437

par shog /rab gsal thugs kyi rin chen shog sngon la/ /yon tan du ma'i gser yig sna tshogs bkra/ /bla ma 'jam dbyangs sprul ba'i glegs bam la/ /'phrin yig dri med dar gyi na bza' 'bul/ /khyod thugs chos sku lha yi lam yangs ngos/ /byams dang brtse ba'i chu 'dzin 'bum 'khrigs nas/ /rnar snyan yid dga'i gsung dbyangs dbyar rnga ldir/ /thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i sbrang char phab pa'i tshe/ /gdul bya 'dzin ma'i zhing sa gshin po la/ /sngar med phan bde'i lo tog cir yang 'khrungs/ /snyan grags chu rgyun mang byung skye dgu yi/ /rna ba'i mtshor zhugs sems kyi glu dbang dgyes/ /slob bu mgrin sngon 'ga' res mgrin pa btegs/ /khyed sgu bde bar bzhugs zhes gdangs snyan skad/ /lhang lhang bsgrags pa bya btang mi rgan ngas/ /go tshe sems la sngar med dga' spro shar/ /bdag lus dbyar khang steng du dus rgyun du/ /lo zla nyin zhag char ba babs na yang / /mchog gsum thugs rjes thigs chag bzang bo'i mthus/ /da dung ma zhig sngar bzhin bde bar mchis/ /yon tan 'od 'bar khyed sku nyi ma de/ /lo zla nyin zhag rta ljang shugs kyis drangs/ /skad cig tsam yang mi sdod zhing gzhan gyi/ /nub rir nye ba mthong nas bdag yid skyo/ /lung 438

rigs lus stobs rab tu rgyas bzhin du/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa'i khur chen mi 'khur bar/ /rnyed bkur glang mo'i phyir du rab brgyug pa'i/ /dge bshes glang chen smyon pa des ci bya/ /thos bsam gshog rgyas bya rgyal rgod po khyod/ /grong dgon 'du 'dzi'i tshang la ma chags par/ /skabs rer ri khrod lha yi lam la 'phur/ /dpyad 'jog sgom gyes nam 'phang ches cher stod/ /tshem stug dkar dmar thig le lus la 'chang / /skra yi rwa gdengs nyams len gar stabs bsgyur/ /dben pa'i pad tshal 'grim pa'i bung ba ngas/ /'phrin yig dar dir sgog 'dir gsan par rigs/ /rje khyod bzhin ras g.yo med ri dbang gi /rked na 'khor ba'i spyan ras nyi zla yi/ /lta stangs 'od de 'phrin yig skyed tshal du/ /'jig rten tshe sgrub ril bu zhig bcas phul//phul mthus ring min myur mjal yong bar shog /ces pa 'di ni bka' drin nyams med rtsa ba'i bla ma rgyal mkhan chen rin po che la dbus gtsang nas phul ba'o/ /drin can bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /dang po dad can grwa slob sbyin bdag gis/ /rgyu nom ser sna ma byas 'bul tshul legs/ /bar du dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing khams nas/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis chos phyogs gtong tshul legs/ /tha ma lha chos 439

byas tshad bdag gzhan kun/ /'phral phugs bde phyir bsngo sgon byed tshul legs/ /legs gsum legs kyi dge ba byas pa'i mthus/ /'gro kun legs tshogs 'phel zhing rgyas par shog /ces pa 'di yang dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du slebs nas/ slar rang yul gyi grwa slob sbyin bdag thams cad la yi ge bskur ba'i mjug tu bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o/ /dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /thugs smon bzhin du sangs rgyas 'gro ba 'dren/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'dud/ /bdag gi smon lam 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyis/ /mgur bskul ma ṇi bton pa'i dge ba dang / /gzhan yang dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /drin can bla ma'i bzhed don kun 'grub shog /lus srog bskyed pa'i drin can pha ma dang / /chos grogs grwa slob yon bdag drin can dang / /zhon bkal bzhos pa'i sgo phyugs drin can kun/ /myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog /sha zos spu dang pags pa gyon pa dang / /rdo dang dbyug pas brdungs dang mtshon gyis bsad/ /dug dang mthus bsad rkang bas gcur tshod kyi/ /'gro rnams sangs rgyas go 'phang myur thob shog /gzhan yang nam mkha' yangs pa'i mtha' mnyam pa'i/ /mar gyur sems can gcig 440

kyang ma lus pa/ /tshogs rdzogs sgrib sbyangs sangs rgyas thob par shog /smon lam de dag myur du 'grub gyur cig /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dang / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma dang / /yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyi bkra shis shog /nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'jig rten khams rnams su/ /mi mthun rgud pa'i ming yang mi grags shing / /dge legs phun tshogs yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel/ /'gro kun rtag tu bde ba'i bkra shis shog /khyad par rgya bod sog gsum rgyal khams kyi/ /nad rims mu ge 'khrug rtsod kun zhi nas/ /lo legs 'bru nor cher 'phel skye 'gro kun/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde ba'i bkra shis shog /lhag par rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor bcas rnams/ /nad med lo brgya'i bar du 'dug pa dang / /'dug rag bar la 'khor nor longs spyod 'dzoms/ /rnam dkar dge chos gzhol ba'i bkra shis shog /ces rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun zhabs dkar rdo rje 'chang chen pos mchog dman bar ma'i gdul byar gang la gang 'tsham gyi rdo rje'i mgur dpag tu med pa bzhengs pa yi ger 'khod pa'i nang tshan las/ brag dkar sprel rdzong / kya phug pad+ma rdzong / zwa lung sogs nas bzhengs pa'i skor ro//441

dben gnas khyad 'phags dag pa mkha' spyod dpal gyi tsā ri tra nas bzhengs pa'i skor/na mo gu ru mañdzu sgo ṣa ya/ skyon zad yon tan kun ldan rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /mgon des bstan pa mdo rgyud dam pa'i chos/ /de nyid 'dzin skyong spel mkhas dge 'dun te/ /bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyis rtag tu skyongs/ /rgyal ba'i mdo sngags bstan pa rin po che/ /rgyal khams yongs la dar zhing rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal sras gzhan las lhag pa'i bka' drin can/ /rgyal ba yab sras gsum gyis dge legs stsol/ /gsol ba btab na dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba'i/ /mtshan ldan bla ma yid bzhin nor bu mchog /'bral med spyi bor bkur nas gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal tu gsol/ /bla mas rjes bzung tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /ri khrod dben pa'i ljon shing bsil grib la/ /'khod nas dam chos bdud rtsi 'thung bzhin du/ /snyan pa'i glu dbyangs blangs tshul bshad par bya/ /442

dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar ji bzhin du/ /mdo sngags chos la thos bsam sgom gsum byas/ /gtan bde sangs rgyas go 'phang thob 'dod pa'i/ /skal bzang skye bo pho mo ma yengs nyon/ /de yang stod na grags che ba gangs dkar gyi rgyal po te se seng gdong ma khra mo sku yi gnas/ bar na khungs btsun pa la phyi stag gdong ma khra mo gsung gi gnas/ smad na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba tsā ri phag gdong ma nag mo thugs kyi gnas gsum las/ thog mar tsā ri rong skor dang gnas nang na sdod pa'i skabs rnams su glu dbyangs sna tshogs blangs pa ni 'di ltar ro/ /chos sku kun khyab kun tu bzang bo dang / /longs sku mtshan dpes spras pa rdo rje 'chang / /sprul sku 'gro 'dren shākya thub pa gsum/ /mdo sngags bstan pa yongs kyi bdag po dngos/ /'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bcu drug dang / /rgyan drug mchog gnyis grub chen brgyad cu sogs/ /rgya gar yul gyi mkhas grub ji snyed kun/ /bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa ste/ /'phags yul paṇa grub gangs ri'i khong gseng nas/ /zab rgyas chos kyi chu klung sbyan drangs te/ /bod yul sngon med chos kyi rgya mtshos bkang / /lo tsā ba rnams bka' drin 'khor thabs med/ /'chi med rdo rje'i sku brnyes pad 'byung gis/ /bod yul lha srin 443

sde brgyad dam la btags/ /gtsug lag khang bzhengs chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /mdo sngags bstan pa'i nyi ma de nas shar/ /zab rgyas gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin jo bo rjes/ /skyes bu gsum gye lam gyi rim pa bstan/ /gsung rab thams cad gdams par 'char du bcug /bka' gdams pa zhes grags pas sa steng khyab/ /rdo rje 'chang chen tai lo nā ro nas/ /legs brgyud lta sgom spyod pa thugs nyams su/ /bzhes nas bka' brgyud bstan pa nyi ma ltar/ /gsal mdzad dwags po lha rje las gzhan gang / /rgyal ba rang nyid zhing 'dir byon pa ltar/ /bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel la 'gran zla bral/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos blo bzang grags pa yi/ /yon tan gsang ba'i bdag pos brjod ma lang / /shes bya'i mkha' dbyings legs bshad 'brug sgras bkang / /phyi rgol the'u rang stong gi klad pa 'gems/ /rigs pa gnam lcags thog gis log smra yi//brag ri bshig la sa skya paṇa chen bsngags/ /dri med rgyal ba'i bka' yi snying bo'i don/ /dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed gcod yul bstan/ /spel ba'i grub thob dam pa sangs rgyas dang / /ma cig lab sgon yin zhes 'brug bzhin grags/ /rgya bod mkhas grub de dag thams cad kyi/ /bstan pa de 'dzin brgyud par bcas pa rnams/ /phyag mchod bsod nams 444

bsags pa'i zhing gi mchog /kun gyis spyi bo'i gtsug tu 'khur bar rigs/ /de phyir bdag gis gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul kun bzang mchod sprin 'bul/ /chos spong las ngan bsags pa mthol lo bshags/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mdzad par rjes yi rang / /dpag med chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /gzugs sku mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /dge tshogs bstan pa thams cad rgyas pa dang / /bstan 'dzin skyes bu sgu tshe brtan phyir bsngo/ /bdag ni skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ /ngan song gsum du nam yang mi skye shog /mtho ris yon tan bdun gyis mjes brgyan pa'i/ /dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten bzang thob par shog /skyes ma thag tu smra zhing 'gro shes te/ /phyag 'os rnams la bstod nas phyag 'tshal shog /zhing khams 'di dang phyogs bcu'i zhing khams na/ /bzhugs pa'i byel ba sras bcas mchod par shog /dam pa'i chos spangs 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la/ /skur ba btab sogs sdig ltung bshag par shog /bla ma dam pa'i sku tshe mdzad 'phrin la/ /phrag dog med par yi rang byed par shog /yon tan yod bzhin sbas nas bzhugs pa la/ /'gro la chos 'khor skor zhes bskul bar shog /bstan 'dzin skyes bu mya ngan 'da' bzhed 445

la/ /yun ring bzhugs zhes gsol ba 'debs par shog /dge ba ci bsags bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang / /'gro la phan pa'i phyir du bsngo bar shog /ces yan lag bdun pa dang 'brel ba'i smon lam 'di ni/chos dang gang zag yongs la phyogs med kyis dad gus dag snang sbyong ba'i slob bu kun bzang gzhan phan gyes bskul ngor bya btang ri khrod pa byams pa chos dar ram/ ming gzhan tshogs drug rang grol du 'bod pas/ sar gnas dag pa mkha' spyod dpal gyi tsā ri tra nas smras pa'o//nyi ma g.yu 'brug dung rnga seng ge glang / /'khor los sgyur rgyal rgyal mtshan nor bu dang / /'dra ba'i mtshan ldan bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gzhan smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /phun tshogs tshogs gnyis gser dang shel las grub/ /thugs rje'i 'od kyis 'gro la dga' bde ster/ /skal bzang gdul bya pad tshal rtse dga' dgod/ /mtshan ldan bla ma 'dzam gling nyi ma 'dra/ /gangs can ljongs kyi lha lam yangs par 'phags/ /legs bshad sgra sgrog byen rlabs sbrang char 'bebs/ /gdul bya rma bya dga' dad zlos gar bsgyur/ /mtshan ldan bla ma g.yu 'brug sngon mo 'dra/ /lung rtogs yon tan ri mo g.yas su 'khrul/ /mkhas mang sdud pa'i chos sgra lhang lhang sgog /thos tshad ma rig nyon mongs nad rims zhi/ /mtshan ldan bla ma dung dkar g.yas 'khyil 'dra/ /thabs dang shes rab phun tshogs gser gyi rnga/ /brtse chen dbyug gus yang yang drag tu brdungs/ /zab rgyas 446

chos kyis stong gsum khyon yangs bkang / /mtshan ldan bla ma chos kyi rnga chen 'dra/ /sku lnga ye shes lnga yi g.yu ral rgyas/ /bsdu bzhi'i yan lag 'phrin las rtsal stobs ldan/ /gdul bya gangs ri'i khrod na rtag par 'gying / /mtshan ldan bla ma dar seng dkar mo 'dra/ /theg chen stobs ldan bstan pa'i khur chen khur/ /pha rol phyin bcu rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /lung rigs sna yis phyi rgol glang ma 'joms/ /mtshan ldan bla ma glang bo rin chen 'dra/ /lugs gnyis chos kyi khang bzang nyams dgar bzhugs/ /nyams rtogs yon tan du ma'i gos rgyan mdzes/ /'phags pa'i nor gyi rgyal sred sna bdun mnga'/ /mtshan ldan bla ma 'khor los bsgyur rgyal 'dra/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga kha dog lnga ldan gos/ /bla med gsang sngags rin chen tog gis mdzes/ /mkhas grub gdugs dang ba dan dbus na mtho/ /mtshan ldan bla ma thub bstan rgyal mtshan 'dra/ /ci 'dod longs spyod sbyin pa'i blo bral yang / /nyam thag 'gro ba mtha' yas gang 'dod kyi/ /mchog thum dngos grub mtha' yas ster mdzad pa'i/ /mtshan ldan bla ma yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /bdag ni deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /rigs gzugs 'byor ldan dbang phyug shes rab che tshe ring nad med dal 'byor rten bzang thob//mtshan ldan bla ma de 447

'drar mjal bar shog /mjal ma thag tu lus kyi ba sru g.yos/ /mig nas mchi ma g.yo ba'i dad pa skyes/ /'bad pa du mas tshul bzhin bsten pa la/ /rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang lta bur shog /bla ma des kyang rang nyid mthong ma thag /ma yis yun ring stor ba'i bu mthong ltar/ /dgyes pa'i 'dzum bstan snyan pa'i gsung byon nas/ /snying nas brtse bas rjes su 'dzin par shog /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / /'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing / /sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /ces mtshan ldan bla mar mjal ba'i smon lam 'di yang slob bu bstan 'dzin nyi mas bskul ngor bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis tsā ri tra nas smras pa'o/ /ka sha'i ras ltar thugs 'jam bla ma bsten/ /kha lag sprad ltar 'phyugs med gdams pa longs/ /ga bur dkar ltar sems dkar grogs dang 'grogs/ /nga bdag che ltar gzhan gces che na legs/ /ca co'i gtam ltar chos gtam kho na gyis/ /cha lugs chos ltar byas na mig sngar mjes/ /ja chu 'dres ltar chos sems 'dres pa gces/ /nya shar rngam ltar 'dod sred skye ba choms/ /ta la bcad ltar bdag 'dzin rtsad nas chod/ /tha mal g.yog ltar lus sems chos la bkol/ /da lta 'chi ltar phyi rtsis 448

'dun ma zhog /nā ro ba ltar bla ma'i gsung bzhin sgrubs/ /pa sangs mtho ltar lta ba mtho na legs/ /pha mas byams ltar drin can 'gro la byams/ /ba glang nyal ltar ma 'dug lha chos rem/ /ma rabs rnams ltar chos min las ma byed/ /tsā ri'i gnas ltar byin ldan dben pa sten/ /tsha grang nad ltar chos sems 'gal ma 'jug /dza yig 'khyog ltar ma 'khyogs drang bo gyis/ /wa mo rgyug ltar lto phyir cher ma rgyug /zha long rnams ltar rtag tu dman sa zungs/ /za ma bsten ltar dad gus dag snang sten/ /'a 'ur 'brug ltar skad mgo cher ma mtho/ /ya rabs bu ltar ngo tsha khrel yod gyis/ /rwa lo ba ltar zab gsal bskyed rim sgoms/ /lwa ba pa ltar 'od gsal rdzogs rim sgoms/ /shā ri'i bu ltar shes rab che bar mdzod/ /sa ra ha ltar gdams ngag glu ru longs/ /ha la'i dug ltar gzhan la gnod tshad spongs/ /a ru sman ltar 'gro la phan tshad sgrubs/ /yid bzhin nor ltar phan pa'i legs bshad yin/ /su zhig de ltar byas kyang dge legs 'phel/ /zhesapa 'di yang rang gzhan la phan phyir bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis gnas chen tsā ri gcig char nas spras pa'o//yar 'brog g.yu mtsho'i nya mo gser mig /mtsho stod 'grims pa dga' mo 'dug ste/ /snga sor nya ba ngo nag slebs 449

nas/ /nya mo mang bo bsad pa e go /rgya mtsho'i gting na btsan sa 'dzin rgyu/ /yod na myur du zungs dang dga'o/ /spang ri mthon po'i sha ba rwa bcu/ /spang stod 'grims pa dga' mo 'dug ste/ /snga sor rngon pa khye khrid slebs nas/ /sha ba mang bo bsad pa e go /ri bo'i rtse na btsan sa 'dzin rgyu/ /yod na myur du zungs dang dga'o/ /ri khrod 'grim pa'i bya btang rnal 'byor/ /rgyal khams 'grims pa dga' mo 'dug ste/ /snga sor 'chi bdag pho nya slebs nas/ /rgan gzhon mang bo bsad pa e go /dam pa'i chos na btsan sa 'dzin rgyu/ /yod na myur du zungs dang dga'o/ /grang reg ba mo mig gis mthong byung / /skyi bser tsha ba lus kyis tshor bas/ /yang yang dus bzhi 'gyur ba sems skyo/ /'phrin zhig nam zla'i rgyal mor bskur 'bras/ /nam zla bsring ba'i thabs shig khyed mkhyen/ /sgyu lus rgas rtags mig gis mthong byung / /na tsha zug rngu lus kyis tshor bas/ /yang yang mi tshe zad pa sems skyo/ /'phrin zhig tshe dpag med la bskur 'bras/ /lo brgya thub pa'i thabs shig khyed mkhyen/ /lo tog brnga ba rna bas thos byung / /rtsi shing bskams pa mig gis mthong bas/ /yang yang lo zla zad pa sems skyo/ /'phrin zhig sa chu dro sar bskur 'bras/ /me tog 'khrungs pa'i thabs shig khyed mkhyen/ /mi mang shi ba rna bas 450

thos byung / /grogs mched gshegs pa mig gis mthong bas yang yang skyes nas 'chi ba sems skyo/ /'phrin zhig rdo rje 'chang la bskur 'bras/ /sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs shig khyed mkhyen/ /bu yis khrims 'gal nyes pa byas na/ /drin can pha mas skyob par mi nus/ /sring mo rnams tsho ga ler bzhugs bzhugs/ /bu yis khrims lugs ji bzhin byas na/ /srog bdag rgyal po'i bka' bkyon mi 'dug /blon po rnams tsho ga ler bzhugs bzhugs/ /mi dge'i sdig pa rang gis byas na/ /shākya thub pas skyob par mi nus/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang ga ler bzhugs bzhugs/ /dam pa'i chos bzhin rang gis byas na/ /gshin rje chos rgyal zhed po mi 'dug /rak+ka glang mgo ga ler bzhugs bzhugs/ /'di phyi gang du skyid po 'dod na/ /skyid pa gzhan la yid smon mi dgos/ /skyid po rang gis byas na chog yong / /skyid po'i thabs kyi mchog ste chos yin/ /chos bzhin mdzod dang 'di phyi gang du/ /bde skyid nyi ma bzhin du 'char yong / /sdug bsngal rgyu ni sdig pa yin pas/ /sdig pa mi dge'i las de byas na/ /sdug po gzhan gyis rang la btang yong / /sdig pa'i che shos mi dge bcu yin/ /mi dge bcu bo dug ltar choms dang / /gzhan gyis sdug po btang nas mi yong / /zhes pa 'di rnams kyang bya btang tshogs drug rang 451

grol gyis rang nyid la dben gnas tsā ri nas smras pa'o/ /a ma yu mo de 'das song / /she'u phrug rdza khrod du song nas/ /sdod pa'i kho thag de chod song / /spang gshongs 'grim pa la chas 'gro/ /spang stod spang smad kun 'grims nas/ /rtswa zos dkyus rtsed rang byed dus/ /rngon pa khye khrid kyis gsod ki /ma 'jug yul phyogs 'di'i gzhi bdag /a ma gser nya de 'das song / /nya chung mtsho dkyil du song nas/ /sdod pa'i kho thag de chod song / /mtsho mtha' 'grim pa la chas 'gro/ /mtsho stod mtsho smad kun 'grims nas/ /zas btsal rtsed 'jo rang byed dus/ /nya ba rgya thogs kyis gsod ki /ma 'jug mtsho sman gyi rgyal mo/ /a ma rgan mo de 'das song / /bu nga pha yul du song nas/ /sdod pa'i kho thag de chod song / /dben gnas 'grim pa la chas 'gro/ /ri khrod gangs khrod kun 'grims nas/ /sgom byas nyams mgur rang 'then dus/ /'chi bdag bdud po yis gsod ki /ma 'jug rtsa gsum gyi lha tshogs/ /dang po rgas pa'i pha ma/ /na chung bu dang bu mor/ /'grogs nas rtsed dgod byas tshul/ /da lta lan re dran byung / /bar du mtshan ldan bla ma/ /chos mthun grogs dang 'grogs nas/ /chos gtam ku re byas tshul/ /da lta lan re dran byung / /tha ma rim pa 452

bzhin du/ /shi bral gson bral byas dus/ /sems skyo mya ngan byas tshul/ /da lta lan re dran byung / /da ni rang nyid rgas dus/ /mdza' bo'i gnyen bshes mkho yang / /sngon dus yun ring 'grogs pa'i/ /brtse gdung can kun bzhud song / /rang yang phyi mar 'gro ba'i/ /snga ltas skra dkar gnyer ma/ /rgas rtags phal cher slebs byung / /myur du 'gro la khad snang / /spyir ni 'dus pa 'bral zhing / /sgos su skyes mtha' 'chi ba/ /'khor ba'i chos nyid yin snang / /gang la'ang chags nas ci bya/ /skye 'chi 'du 'bral med pa'i/ /gtan gyi btsan sa 'dzin phyir/ /'khor ba'i chags zhen spangs nas/ /lha chos byed par smon no/ /sems la skyo ba skyes nas/ /ngag gis skyo mgur blangs song / /lus kyi ba spu g.yos nas/ /mig nas mchi ma lhung byung / /skyo med sprang nga'i rgyud la/ /skyo shas lan re skyes dus/ /skyo ba che ru gtong grogs/ /skyo mgur pi wang 'di brdungs/ /drod gsher gnyis kyis bskyangs pa'i/ /me tog lo 'dab rgyas kyang / /mi 'dod ba mo byung nas/ /mdzes pa'i 'gying bag glod song / /kye hud dri ldan me tog /mdog kyang gsar rnying brjes nas/ /da ni smug por gyur song / /myur du bskams pa skyo byung / /char dang chu bos bskyangs pa'i/ /dbyar mtsho dar zhing 453

rgyas kyang / /mi 'dod than pa byung nas/ /gang ba'i mtsho chung bri song / /kye hud sngo ljang mtsho mo'i/ /chu yi mang nyung brjes nas/ /da ni je nyung gyur song / /myur du bskams pa skyo byung / /pha ma gnyis kyis bskyangs pa'i/ /rang lus bkrag mdangs rgyas kyang / /mi 'dod rgas pa byung nas/ /dar ba'i lang tsho rgud song / /kye hud bya btang rnal 'byor/ /rang lus dar rgud brjes nas/ /da ni 'byung ba rgud song / /myur du 'chi snyam skyo byung //mgon khang mgron po rnying ba/ /'dus pa so sor bral nas/ /snga phyi rim pa bzhin du/ /rang rang yul du bzhud song / /gsar ba rnams kyang chas tshar/ /da ni 'gro khar thug byung / /nam 'gro'i nges pa mi snang / /bsams pas skyo ba skyes song / /ri klung khu byug sngon mo/ /'dus pa so sor bral nas/ /snga phyi rim pa bzhin du/ /lho mon phyogs su bzhud song / /phyi ma rnams kyang chas tshar/ /da ni 'gro khar thug byung / /nam 'gro'i nges pa mi snang / /bsams pas skyo ba skyes song / /pha yul pha ma mdza' bshes/ /'dus pa so sor bral nas/ /snga phyi rim pa bzhin du/ /'jig rten phyi mar bzhud song / /gzhon pa rang yang rgas tshar/ /da ni 'gro khar thug byung / /nam 'gro'i nges pa mi snang / /bsams pas skyo ba sgyes song / /mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhal ras/ /454

mdzes 'dzum bzhad tshul dran na/ /bzhin legs bu dang bu mo/ /mdzes rung lta 'dod mi snang / /mtshan ldan bla ma'i gsung dbyangs/ /'dren 'gugs snyan tshul dran na/ /pi wang gling bu'i sgra dbyangs/ /snyan yang nyan 'dod mi snang / /mtshan ldan bla ma'i thugs rgyud/ /zhi dul 'jam tshul dran na/ /srab 'jam yang ba'i gos la/ /de 'dra'i 'jam sha mi snang / /mtshan ldan bla ma'i yon tan/ /yod tshad zhib tu dran na/ /yid bzhin nor bu la yang / /yon tan de 'dra mi snang / /mtshan ldan bla de 'dra/ /'jig rten khams 'dir dkon byung / /rin chen gser g.yu dngul yang / /de 'dra'i dkon rgyu mi snang / /mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma'i/ /sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan/ /dran na mjal 'dod ma gtogs/ /'dod pa gzhan rnams mi snang / /mjal yul bla ma gshegs song / /da ni mjal rgyu med tshul/ /bsams na ngu rgyu ma gtogs/ /'dod pa gzhan rnams mi snang / /zhes pa 'di rnams kyang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas tsā ri nas smras pa'o/ /e ma nyams dga' rig pa dwangs/ /'du 'dzi med pa'i dben gnas su/ /rang byung brag gi phug pa ru/ /sngo ljang rtswa dang 'bol gdan la/ /gcig pur drang srong spyod tshul gyis/ /gnas nas byams dang snying rje dang / /byang chub sems kyis kun 455

bslangs nas/ /lus bsrangs ngag gis smra ba spangs/ /rnam rtog sprin phung dwangs su bcug /sems kyi nam mkhar trig ger blta/ /nyams kyi 'jadza tshon ci shar yang / /de la ched 'dzin med par bzhag /bsgom rgyu rdul tsam mi dmigs kyang / /yengs su skad cig tsam yang med/ /de ltar mnyam par bzhag tsa na/ /bzhag dus mi g.yo ri dbang bzhin/ /ci tsam bzhag pa de tsam gnas/ /btang na dge ba'i dmigs pa gang / /yin yang thogs pa med par 'jug /lus sems las rung bde chen 'dren/ /ma bsgrubs lha zhal mang bo mthong / /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul cir yang 'byung / /de yis grags pa zla 'od kyis/ /lha mi'i rmongs pa'i mun pa sel/ /lag pa'i pad+mo dbang med bsums/ /rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing / /mkha' las lha yi rol mo brdungs/ /bdug spos me tog char ba 'bebs/ /sa nas mi yis zas gos 'bul/ /ya mtshan gtam snyan phyogs bcur sgrog /bstan dang 'gro ba ma lus la/ /dngos sam brgyud nas phan thogs pa'i/ /de 'dra'i sgom chen pa zhig gyes/ /de min grong ltag dgon chung dang / /ri phug brag phug 'ga' re na/ /bsdad rung sems de grong du btang / /dge slong byas rung 'dul khrems dang / /dge sbyong chos bzhi rtswa ltar dor/ /bya btang byas rung ham pa che/ /456

zas nor khyem pa las kyang gsog /de 'dra'i sgom chen gzugs brnyan gyis/ /ci bya de bas 'jig rten gyis/ /zhes pa 'di yang bdag gi yid la shar tshe slob bu yongs la phan phyir dben gnas tsā ri nas smras pa'o/ /drin can bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mnyam gzhag brtan par byin gyis rlobs/ /sems ngo 'phrod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /gnas lugs ngang la mnyam 'jog dus/ /nam mkha' lta bur dpangs bstod de/ /snang ba gu yangs sang nger bzhag /sa gzhi lta bur rgya bskyed de/ /dran pa khyab kyang che bar bzhag /ri bo lta bur lhun phab la/ /sems nyid g.yo 'gul med par bzhag /mar me lta bur gsal bstod la/ /rig pa sa le trig ger bzhag /man shel lta bur dri ma spangs/ /shes pa rtog med sang nger bzhag /sems kyi bzhag thabs lnga bo 'dis/ /sems ngo skyong la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang phyag chen zhig gi gzhung na yod pa tshigs su bcad nas tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o/ /'di phyi gtan gyi skyabs gnas su/ /bla ma dkon mchog gus pas sten/ /phral du bde phyir khrims yod kyi/ /dpon bzang bkur zhing yul lha rngon/ /tshe bsod snyan grags rgyas pa la/ /tshe thar srog blu sbyin pa thongs/ /dpon gyes rang nyid bkur ba la/ /mtho bkur dma' ba brtse bas skyongs/ /g.yog gis rang la 457

byams pa la/ /dpon gyis gang bcol go chod gyis/ /nye gnas yun ring chags pa la/ /lag gtsang khog yangs kha la nyon/ /bla dpon sku tshe'i bar chad che/ /dug mthu ngan sngags phyogs la 'dzems/ /nad ngos mi zin sman pa yis/ /sman log gtsags bu khyer la 'dzems/ /gzhan la ham pa ma che bar/ /rang gi nor gyis chog shes gyis/ /rang la mngon shes med bzhin du/ /pho tshod log lta byed mi rung / /rang nyid bya ba kun shes kyang / /gzhan gye bya ba khyad ma gsod/ /rang gi grub mthar zhen che yang / /gzhan gyi grub mtha' smod mi bya/ /rang gshis ngan pas rang rgyud bsreg /tshig ngan byung dus bzod pa sgoms/ /gzhan rnams thams cad mgu dka' yang / /rang gis ngo tsha khrel yod sten/ /ma brtags bya ba nor 'khrul che/ /bya ba thams cad rtog la gyis/ /lta ba mkha' ltar mtho na yang / /rgyu 'bras spang blang zhib na legs/ /dgon chung grwa btsun smra ba mang / /dbyen dzun tshig rnams btang snyoms zhog /gzhan la phan na phyug po'i mchog /yod dus g.yor skyi ster gsum gyis/ /yon bdag dad pa che na yang / /chos pa sdod yun ma ring zhig /mi mang kha la nyan mi rung / /mi rgan bsam shes tshig bzhin gyis/ /'di ni mi rgan bsam shes gtam/ /rgyal khams mi la sgog par rigs/ /zhes pa 'di 458

yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas tsā ri nas smras pa'o/ /na mo gu ru/ mi rtag 'chi ba ston pa'i slob dpon la/ /mi phyed dad pas snying nas gsol ba 'debs/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran pas rgyud bskul nas/ /mi tshe chos kyis 'da' bar byen gyis rlobs/ /bla ma mang bsten bka' chos mang thos pa'i/ /gus ldan mtshan snyan zhi ba tshe ring la/ /lha chos byed lugs bslab bya mi dgos mod/ /'on kyang gsol 'debs glu 'dir gsan par rigs/ /nam zla dbyar dgun ston dpyid 'gyur ba ltos/ /'di yang mi rtag sgyu ma'i dpe zhig red/ /thams cad rtag par bzung nas ci zhig bya/ /mi rtag 'chi ba yang yang bsams na legs/ /ri klung gyang ra zhig cing ral ba ltos/ /'di yang mi rtag sgyu ma'i dpe zhig red/ /sa mkhar mthon po brtsigs nas ci zhig bya/ /khang chung re nas dal bur bzhugs na legs/ /phyug po'i longs spyod bsags tshad zad par ltos/ /'di yang mi rtag sgyu ma'i dpe zhig red/ /ser snas zas nor bsags nas ci zhig bya/ /gang yod chos kyi phyogs su btang na legs/ /rgan gzhon go rim med par 'chi ba ltos/ /'di yang mi rtag sgyu ma'i dpe zhig red/ /yun ring sdod shom byas nas ci zhig bya/ /phyi ma'i lam sna zin thabs byas na legs/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob so sor 'bral la 459

ltos/ /'di yang mi rtag sgyu ma'i dpe zhig red/ /'khor g.yog gnyen bshes sdang nas ci zhig bya/ /'dus pa 'bral snyam brtse bas bskyangs na legs/ /dam pa'i lha chos byed lugs mang na yang / /mi dge bcu spangs chos spyod bcu bo bsgrubs/ /'phags nor bdun bzung dge sbyong chos bzhi bsten/ /rgyun du gzhan la ci phan byas na legs/ /dge ba gang byed thog mar sems bskyed dang / /mjug tu bsngo ba smon lam mtshams sbyor mdzod/ /de ltar byas na je mtho je mthor 'gyur/ /mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang thob/ /yul phyogs mi gcig mdo dbus bar thag ring / /mi tshe yun thung nam 'chi nges pa med/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob yang yang mjal dka' bas/ /da lta'i snying gtam 'di nyid thugs la zungs/ /glu dbyangs 'di nyid thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /gang la bltas kyang mi rtag 'chi ba dran/ /tshe 'dir dam pa'i lha chos byas pa'i mthus/ /phyi mar rnam mkhyen go 'phang myur thob shog /ces pa 'di yang mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa'i 'dod dpal mkhan po zhi ba tshe ring la dge ba'i gsol 'debs su bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas dag pa mkha' spyod dpal gyi tsā ri tra nas springs pa'o/ /bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /mi mthun 'gal rkyen bar chad sol/ /mthun 460

pa'i lam sna chos la drongs/ /phyogs med ri khrod 'grim pa yi/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /dad can sde ba stobs ldan la/ /dge ba'i gsal 'debs bshad kyis nyon/ /srog bcad gzhan gyis ma byin len/ /mi tshangs spyod dang dzun gye tshig /phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal smra/ /brnab sems gnod sems log lta ste/ /'di dag mi dge bcu yin pas//byas na ngan song gsum du skye/ /spangs na dge ba bcu yang yin/ /mtho ris lha mi'i nang du skye/ /des na khyod kyis nyin re bzhin/ /mi dge bcu bo e byas ltos/ /byas na dmyal bar skye ba'i rgyu/ /byas pa ma bzang snyam nas 'gyod/ /bshag pa gyes la phyin chad sdoms/ /de ltar byas na sdig pa rnams/ /'dag ces thub pa chen pos gsungs/ /yi ge 'bri zhing dkon mchog mchod/ /sbyin pa gtong zhing chos la nyan/ /gsung rab klog cing blo la 'dzin/ /gzhan la 'chad cing kha ton bya/ /chos don sems shing bsgom par bya/ /'di dag chos spyod bcu bo yin/ /chos spyod bcu bo 'di byas na/ /bsod nams phung bo dpag med thob/ /dbus mtha' rnam 'byed las gsungs pas/ /khyed kyis nyin rer gang nus sgrubs/ /'gyur med dad pa tshul khrims ldan/ /sbyin gtong byed cing chos mang thos/ /khrel yod ngo tsha shes rab rnams/ /'phags pa'i nor 461

bdun yin par gsungs/ /khyed kyis 'di bdun 'dzin par rigs/ /gzhan tshur khro yang slar mi khro/ /tshur la gshe yang slar mi gshe /skyon mtshang 'bru yang slar mi 'bru/ /rdeg rdung byed kyang slar mi brdeg /dge sbyong chos bzhi yin par gsungs/ /khyed kyis 'di yang bsten par 'os/ /de rnams snga sor mdzad na legs/ /da dung de bzhin nyams su longs/ /de ltar byas na phyi ma ru/ /dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang / /kla klo tshe ring lha dang ni/ /log lta sangs rgyas kyis stongs pa/ /lkugs pa de dag mi khom brgyad/ /rnams su nam yang skye mi 'gyur/ /mi nyid rnyed cing yul dbus skyes/ /dbang bo tshang zhing gnas la dad/ /de bzhin las mtha' ma log pa/ /sangs rgyas byon dang de chos gsungs/ /bstan pa gnas dang de'i rjes 'jug /gzhan phyir snying nas brtse ba ste/ /'byor ba bcu dang ldan par 'gyur/ /rigs gzugs 'byor dang dbang phyug dang / /tshe ring nad med shes rab che/ /mtho ris yon tan bdun yang thob/ /tshe rabs kun tu bde zhing skyid/ /mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba yongs la phan/ /chos rnams kun gyi nying khu yin/ /tshig don ma brjed yid la zungs/ /'di nyid thos tshad thams cad kyi/ /rgyud la phan thogs 'byung bar shog /ces pa 'di 462

yang dad gtong blo gros che ba'i sde ba stobs ldan la dge ba'i gsal 'debs su bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas tsā ri nas springs pa'o/ /rje bla ma dkon mchog thugs rje can/ /sprang nga la blo gtad sbyin bdag rnams/ /tshe 'di ru sdod ring bar chad sol/ /tshe phyi mar 'gro dus lam sna drongs/ /khyed yon bdag rgan gzhon pho mo rnams/ /tshe ring rung drug cu bdun cu yin/ /de yan la sdod mkhan shin tu dkon/ /kun mi sdod 'jig rten phyi mar 'gro/ /tshe 'di yi snang ba kun nub nas/ /tshe phyi ma'i yul la 'gro ba'i tshe/ /skyabs skyel ma bla ma dkon mchog gsum/ /phan thogs pa 'phags nor bdun yin pas/ /lha dkon mchog gsum la dad pa gyis/ /mi dad pa can la byin rlabs 'jug /las mi dge bcu spangs tshul khrims srungs/ /mi khrims ldan mtho ris thar ba thob/ /nor longs spyod yod dus sbyin pa thongs/ /tshe 'di phyir bde skyid snyan gsum 'byung / /rje bla ma sten la thos pa gyis/ /chos mang thos kun mkhyen go 'phang nye/ /dus rgyun du ngo tsha khrel yod sten/ /khrel ngo tsha ldan pa lha mis bkur/ /legs nyes pa 'byed pa'i shes rab skyed/ /mi shes rab che bas ci bsam 'grub/ /nged rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor bcas la/ /khyed yon bdag rtsa ba bka' drin che/ /kun gnas skabs bde zhing 463

mthar thug tu/ /sangs mnyam por rgya ba'i smon lam 'tshal/ /zhes pa 'di yang 'phags pa'i nor gyi mdzod 'dzin pa'i yon bdag rtswa 'chang dga' tshang la dge ba'i gsal 'debs su bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas tsā ri nas springs pa'o/ /bre ser 'brong gi tshogs rnams kyis/ /bde 'jam yangs pa'i spang ri na/ /spang la rno ba'i rwa gnyis brdar/ /rnga gzeng byed pa nyams dga' yang / /sdig can rngon pas ded pa'i tshe/ /rnga ma btegs nas 'bros khom med/ /bsad nas steng gi ko ba bshus/ /de dus skrag kyang bya thabs med/ /nyon dang rtsal ldan 'brong chung rnams/ /de la phan pa'i thabs 'tshol na/ /ma sdod mi med rdza lung snyogs/ /bag phebs rtswa chu 'thungs na legs/ /'dab chags bye'u chung tshogs rnams kyis/ /stong gsal nam mkha' yangs pa na/ /mkha' la gshog brgyangs skad snyan sgog /'phur lding g.yo ba nyams dga' yang / /sdig can khra yis ded pa'i tshe/ /gshog chung brgyangs nas 'bros khom med/ /bzung nas steng gi bya spu gtor/ /de dus 'dar yang bya thabs med/ /nyon dang skad snyan bye'u chung rnams/ /de la phan pa'i thabs 'tshol na/ /ma sdod shing gnas mthug po snyogs/ /bag phebs shing thog zos na legs/ /skye bo pho mo'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /lho rgyal 'dzam bu'i gling ba na/ /sa la mkhar brtsigs dga' ston 464

byas/ /glu gar len pa nyams dga' yang / /sdig can 'chi bdag slebs pa'i tshe/ /sman dang rim gro byed khom med/ /shi nas steng gi gon pa bshus/ /de dus 'gyod kyang bya thabs med/ /nyon dang dad can pho mo rnams/ /de la phan pa'i thabs 'tshol na/ /ma 'dug ri khrod dben pa snyogs/ /bag phebs lha chos byas na legs/ /zhes pa 'di yang dad can pho mo gzhon nu yongs la bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas tsā ri nas smras pa'o/ /mgon med nyam chung ri bong pho mo rnams/ /khrel med glag gis gsod pa snying re rje/ /bzod med sdug bsngal myong la phan pa'i thabs/ /gzhan med gsod tshul bsams nas bdag yid skyo/ /skyabs med nyam chung khyim pa pho mo rnams/ /khrel med mi yis gsod pa snying re rje/ /bzod med sdug bsngal myong la phan pa'i thabs/ /gzhan med gsod tshul bsams nas bdag yid skyo/ /chos med nyam chung khyem pa pho mo rnams/ /khrel med gshin rjes gsod pa snying re rje/ /bzod med sdug bsngal myong la phan pa'i thabs/ /gzhan med gsod tshul bsams nas bdag yid skyo/ /chos med phyin chad thams cad de dang 'dra/ /sdug med bde ba can du skye 'dod na/ /don med tshe 'di'i bya bas ma g.yengs par/ /bslu med bla ma bsten la lha chos gyis/ /zhes pa 'di yang dad can 465

yongs la phan phyir bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i tsā ri nas smras pa'o/ /sprin dang bral ba'i nyi ma/ /gling bzhi'i phyogs phyogs gang la/ /shar kyang gsal 'grib med rung / /byang bstan phug par mi 'char/ /gos med 'khyags rum can rnams/ /rang lus dro bar 'dod na/ /shar bstan phug par sdod dang / /dro 'jam 'od zer btang yong / /gter bdag mgon po dzam la/ /ri rab phyogs phyogs gang la/ /bzhugs kyang phongs pa med rung / /gsol mchod med la mi gnang / /nor med dbul bo'i tshogs rnams/ /zas nor longs spyod )'dod na/ /mchod bstod gsol ba thobs dang / /'dod dgu'i dngos grub bstsal yong / /mtshan ldan dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ /ri klung phyogs phyogs gang la/ /bzhugs kyang khyad par med rung / /dad med phyogs su mi 'byon/ /chos med mi yi tshogs rnams/ /dad pas spyan 'dren gyis dang / /zab rgyas gdams pa gnang yong / /zhes pa 'di yang skye bo pho mo yongs la phan phyir bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas tsā ri nas smras pa'o/ /byen rlabs stsol ba'i bla ma bsten/ /dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam bsten/ /bar chad sel ba'i chos skyong bsten/ /bsten pa gsum gye bstan bcos yin/ /phyogs ris bral ba'i lta ba gces/ /bying rgol bral ba'i sgom pa gces/ /tshul 'chos bral 466

ba'i spyod pa gces/ /gces pa gsum gyi bstan bcos yin/ /bla ma mnyes pa'i zhabs tog byed/ /yi dam mnyes pa'i bsnyen sgrub byed/ /mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i tshogs mchod byed/ /byed pa gsum gye bstan bcos yin/ /tshe blos thongs la lha chos yong / /rang 'dod med la byang sems yong / /lha chos byed la skyid po yong / /yong ba gsum gyi bstan bcos yin/ /spyo spyod byed dang 'khrul zhig nor/ /tshe blos btang dang sprang po nor/ /chos pa rnams dang zog po nor/ /nor ba gsum gyi bstan bcos yin/ /bla mar brnyas pa'i slob ma ngan/ /dpon por brnyas pa'i g.yog po ngan/ /pha mar sdang ba'i bu tsha ngan/ /ngan pa gsum gyi bstan bcos yin/ /bla ma rnams kyis slob ma 'tsho/ /dpon po rnams kyis 'khor 'bangs 'tsho/ /phyug po rnams kyis rta nor 'tsho/ /'tsho ba gsum gyi bstan bcos yin/ /rdzun mang smra ba'i kha de tshums/ /tshig rtsub che ba'i kha de tshums/ /ngag 'khyal lab pa'i kha de tshums/ /tshums pa gsum gyi bstan bcos yin/ /rnam g.yeng ngang la nyin par zad/ /gti mug ngang la mtshan mo zad/ /don med ngang la mi tshe zad/ /zad pa gsum gyi bstan bcos yin/ /bza' tshang mang bo'i lto rgyab dka'/ /mo ngan mang bo'i dpon po dka'/ /rta nor mang bo'i 'tsho skyong dka'/ /dka' ba gsum gyi bstan 467

bcos yin/ /ser sna che ba'i lag pa dam/ /dge slong gsar ba gos tshags dam/ /rgan rgon bla rgan ko long dam/ /dam pa gsum gyi bstan bcos yin/ /dge 'dun kun la 'dul khrims dgos/ /chos pa kun la snying rje dgos/ /sngags pa kun la dam tshig dgos/ /dgos pa gsum gyi bstan bcos yin/ /bla ma thams cad 'bul bar dga'/ /dpon po thams cad bstod par dga'/ /sngags pa thams cad chang la dga'/ /dga' ba gsum gyi bstan bcos yin/ /zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis tsā ri nas smras pa'o/ /bla ma dkon mchog gus pas mchod/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong mchod/ /chos rgyal pha ma chos grogs mchod/ /'di ni mchod pa rnam gsum yin/ /mtshan ldan bla ma bsten rnams skyid/ /chos ldan bya ba byed rnams skyid/ /'byor ldan mchod sbyin gtong rnams skyid/ /'di ni skyid pa rnam gsum yin/ /bshad bshad mi bden rtog dpyod dgos/ /zos zos mi zhim khas myang dgos/ /'dod 'dod mi ster chog shes dgos/ /'di ni dgos pa rna ma gsum yin/ /bla ngan gnyer ngan kha la nyan/ /rgyal ngan blon ngan kha la nyan/ /pho ngan mo ngan kha la nyan/ /'di ni nyan pa rnam gsum yin/ /bsam ngan sbyor rtsub byed la dga'/ /bla ngan grub mtha'i phyogs ris dga'/ /mo ngan dbyen tshig rdzun la 468

dga'/ /'di ni dga' ba rnam gsum yin/ /dpon ngan dmag jag 'khrug rtsod byed/ /g.yog ngan rku rdzun g.yo sgyu byed/ /rta ngan mi sdod glo 'drogs byed/ /'di ni byed pa rnam gsum yin/ /'thab tshod mi zin rang srog 'chor/ /bshad tshod mi zin tshig ngan 'chor/ /gnyid tshod mi zin so nam 'chor/ /'di ni 'chor ba rnam gsum yin/ /'dod sred can rnams kha tshags che/ /re'u lug can rnams sdig pa che/ /rku rdzun can rnams gnong 'gyod che/ /'di ni che ba rnam gsum yin/ /bu rul pha mas skyob par dka'/ /sdig can bla mas skyob par dka'/ /nyes can dbon pos skyob par dka'/ /'di ni dka' ba rnam gsum yin/ /phyi la dgos pa gos dang rgyan/ /nang du dgos pa zhim mngar zas/ /phyi mar dgos pa dam pa'i chos/ /'di ni dgos pa rnam gsum yin/ /'dus nas 'bral ba gnyen bshes yin/ /bsags nas zad pa zas nor yin/ /skyes nas 'chi ba sems can yin/ /'di ni yin pa rnam gsum yin/ /sa rdo'i nang na gser dngul yod/ /ku re'i nang na don dam yod/ /sems can nang na sangs rgyas yod/ /'di ni yod pa rnam gsum yin/ /lta ba phyogs ris bral na legs/ /sgom pa byeng rgod bral na legs/ /spyod pa tshul 'chos bral na legs/ /'di ni legs pa rnam gsum yin/ /gzhan phan 469

che ba'i bla ma bzang / /ci gsung sgrub pa'i slob ma bzang / /dad pa che ba'i yon bdag bzang / /'di ni bzang ba rnam gsum yin/ /gzugs bzang lus kyi bkra shis gcig /tshig 'jam ngag gi bkra shis gnyis/ /bsam bzang sems kyi bkra shis gsum/ /'di ni bkra shis rnam gsum yin/ /zhes pa 'di yang rang gzhan yongs la phan phyir bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas tsā ri nas smras pa'o/ /dbang chen gser gye sa gzhi la/ /ri bo che chung mang gnas kyang / /chags nas 'pho 'gyur med pa de/ /dbus kyi ri bo mchog rab yin/ /stong gsum mi mjed zhing khams na/ /sangs rgyas byang sems mang gnas kyang / /skyes nas 'chi rgyu med pa de/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ /shin tu dwangs pa'i rgya mtsho na/ /nor bu che chung mang gnas kyang / /phun sum tshogs pa'i nor bu de/ /yid bzhin nor mchog bsam 'phel yin/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin pa yi/ /mkhas btsun bzang gsum mang gnas kyang / /gsung rab gdams par 'char ba de/ /rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa yin/ /gangs dkar shel gyi zur kha na/ /gcan gzan che chung mang gnas kyang / /dpa' rtsal shin tu che ba de/ /ri dwags rgyal po seng ge yin/ /ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal na/ /rnal 'byor che chung mang gnas kyang / /grub 470

rtags dpag med ston pa de/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la yin/ /mtha' bral nam mkha' yangs pa na/ /rgyu skar che chung mang gnas kyang / /'od kyis phyogs kun khyab pa de/ /khri gdugs nyi ma zla ba yin/ /gangs can 'dzin ma'i khyon yangs na/ /bstan 'dzin che chung mang gnas kyang / /'phrin las phyogs kun khyab pa de/ /skyabs mgon rgyal ba paṇa chen yin/ /dgung sngon dbyings la lding ba yi/ /'dab bzang bya rgyal mang gnas kyang / /spu mdog 'ja' ltar mdzes pa de/ /rgya yul spu sdug rma bya yin/ /sa steng 'di na rig smra yi/ /dge bshes mkhas pa mang gnas kyang / /dri med legs bshad 'doms pa de/ /kun mkhyen sa skya paṇa chen yin/ /ri dang brag la skyes pa yi/ /rtsi shing che chung mang gnas kyang / /dri zhim bzang bo 'byung ba de/ /shing mchog tsan dan dkar dmar yin/ /dben gnas rgyal khams 'grim pa yi/ /bya btang che chung mang gnas kyang / /snyan pa'i glu dbyangs len pa de/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol yin/ /zhes pa 'di yang rang dgar bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o/ /dad brtson shes rab che ba na/ /mkhas pa'i dbang bo yong ba yin/ /sdom pa gsum la nyes ltung gis/ /ma gos btsun pa yong ba yin/ /bsod nams che zhing spyir byams na/ /mi bzang 471

gtso bo yong ba yin/ /bdag pas gzhan gces che ba na/ /byang chub sems dpa' yong ba yin/ /tshogs gnyis las la 'bad pa na/ /sku gnyis thob nas yong ba yin/ /chos sku gzugs sku gnyis thob na/ /don gnyis 'grub nas yong ba yin/ /yong ba drug gi glu dbyangs 'di/ /tshogs drug rang grol blangs pa yin/ /zhes pa 'di yang gnas chen tsā ri nas smras pa'o/ /bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su thag bcad nas/ /rang las dma' sar 'jog pa'i bsam log po/ /'di yang 'gal ba che bas sems la zungs/ /dkon mchog mchod zer gzhan gyis gang byin blangs/ /zhun mar zhal zas za ba'i bsam log po/ /'di yang 'gal ba che bas sems la zungs/ /bdag pas gzhan phan byed par sems bskyed nas/ /rang don kho na bsgrub pa'i bsam log po/ /'di yang 'gal ba che bas sems la zungs/ /lag tu byin len ma byas lto mi za/ /nor phyir rtsod pa rgyag pa'i bsam log po/ /'di yang 'gal ba che bas sems la zungs/ /slob ma rnams la tshe blos thongs shig smra/ /rang gis rnyed tshad gsog pa'i bsam log po/ /'di yang 'gal ba che bas sems la zungs/ /dngos su kun la dag snang sbyong dgos zer/ /phag na skyon mtshang 'bru ba'i bsam log po/ /'di yang 'gal ba che bas 472

sems la zungs/ /rang la so thar byang sems sngags sdom med/ /gzhan la sdom pa 'bogs pa'i bsam log po/ /'di yang 'gal ba che bas sems la zungs/ /rang sems ja yun tsam la mi sdod par/ /gzhan la sems 'dzin ston pa'i bsam log po/ /'di yang 'gal ba che bas sems la zungs/ /rang gis thig le yar 'dren mi nus kyang / /gzhan la yar 'dren slob pa'i bsam log po/ /'di yang 'gal ba che bas sems la zungs/ /rang gis spros bcas za chog 'thung chog slob/ /gzhan la spros med ston pa'i bsam log po/ /'di yang 'gal ba che bas sems la zungs/ /rang gis 'dod sred zhen chags che ru btang / /gzhan la 'dod chung gyes zer bsam log po/ /'di yang 'gal ba che bas sems la zungs/ /rang nyid kun gyi gral mgor e thon blta/ /gzhan la dman sa zungs zer bsam log po/ /'di yang 'gal ba che bas sems la zungs/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos tshad mar 'dzin dgos zer/ /gzhan la dgag pa gtong ba'i bsam log po/ /'di yang 'gal ba che bas sems la zungs/ /zhes pa 'di yang rang gzhan kun la tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o/ /lha dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /rgyud chos dang mthun par byen gyis rlobs/ /sprang bya btang tshogs drug rang 473

grol ngas/ /chog dge ba'i gsal 'debs cung zhig bya/ /spyir chos rnams thams cad mi rtag cing / /sgos nam 'chi cha med yang yang soms/ /de bsams na lha chos byed 'dod dran/ /chos dran na byed 'dod shugs kyis 'byung / /chos byed lugs shin tu mang na yang / /khyed dad can sbyin bdag 'di bzhin mdzod/ /rje bla mar snying nas gsol ba thobs/ /lha dkon mchog gsum po mchod bstod bkur/ /rten jo bo rnam gnyis mar me phul/ /dus yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i mchod pa thongs/ /sgom sgrub pa mdzad la mthun rkyen sgrubs/ /gnas skor mi rnams la gnas mal g.yor/ /lto slong mi byung na zas sbyin thongs/ /lus phyag dang skor ba gang nus gyis/ /ngag kha ton bzlas brjod gang shes thon/ /dus rgyun du bsam pa bzang bo gyes/ /tshe 'dir bde phyi mar skyid par nges/ /zhes pa 'di yang sbyin bdag nam mkha'i mdzod pa la dge ba'i gsal 'debs su dben gnas tsā ri nas smras pa'o/ /sa khyad 'phags rgya gar rdo rje gdan/ /yul grong khyer gcig na tshong phrug mang / /kun phyogs gcig 'tshogs nas nyo tshong byas/ /tshong khe rgyal lon tshe rtse zhing dgod/ /dus yun ring bsdad na dga' ba la/ /tshong gang yod zad tshe mi 'dug par/ /kun snga phyi rim pa bzhin du gyes/ /yun mi ring gyes nas song la skyo/ /474

yul mi gcig so sor song ba'i mthus/ /slar sngar bzhin thams cad 'dzom par dka'/ /nged dpon slob mi rtag de dang 'dra/ /ngas bsam zhing skyo ba nang nas skyes/ /rang 'byung bzhi'i lus kyang mi rtag 'jig /ngas bsam zhing bsam zhing shes pa 'phyo/ /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /sprang lha chos nus par byin gyes rlobs/ /stod dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing khams na/ /rje bla ma gcig la slob ma mang / /kun phyogs gcig 'tshogs nas dbang lung zhus/ /chos gang 'dod thob tshe rtse zhing dgod/ /dus yun ring bsdad na dga' ba la/ /lung dbang khrid tshar tshe mi sdod par/ /kun snga phyi rim pa bzhin du gyes/ /yun mi ring gyes nas song la skyo/ /yul mi gcig so sor song ba'i mthus/ /slar sngar bzhin thams cad 'dzom pa dka'/ /nged dpon slob mi rtag de dang 'dra/ /ngas bsam zhing skyo ba nang nas skyes/ /rang 'byung bzhi'i lus kyang mi rtag 'jig /ngas bsam zhing bsam zhing shes pa 'phyo/ /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /sprang lha chos nus par byen gyis rlobs/ /nga chos khrims dar ba'i bod yul na/ /rje chos rgyal gcig la bka' blon mang / /kun phyogs gcig 'tshogs nas gsung gros byas/ /gros gang dgos 'grig tshe rtse zhing dgod/ /dus yun ring bsdad na dga' ba la/ /gros byed rgyu 475

tshar tshe mi sdod par/ /kun snga phyi rim pa bzhin du gyes/ /yun mi ring gyes nas song la skyo/ /yul mi gcig so sor song ba'i mthus/ /slar sngar bzhin thams cad 'dzom pa dka'/ /nged dpon slob mi rtag de dang 'dra/ /ngas bsam zhing skyo ba nang nas skyes/ /rang 'byung bzhi'i lus kyang mi rtag 'jig /ngas bsam zhing bsam zhing shes pa 'phyo/ /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /sprang lha chos nus par byen gyis rlobs/ /smad a mdo'i phyogs kyi sa cha na/ /sde chen po gcig la pho mo mang / /kun phyogs gcig 'tshogs nas dga' ston byas/ /gos rgyan cha legs tshe rtse zhing dgod/ /dus yun ring bsdad na dga' ba la/ /gtam ston mo tshar tshe mi sdod par/ /kun snga phyi rim pa bzhin du gyes/ /yun mi ring gyes nas song la skyo/ /yul mi gcig so sor song ba'i mthus/ /slar sngar bzhin thams cad 'dzom pa dka'/ /nged dpon slob mi rtag de dang 'dra/ /ngas bsam zhing skyo ba nang nas skyes/ /rang 'byung bzhi'i lus kyang mi rtag 'jig /ngas bsam zhing bsam zhing shes pa 'phyo/ /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /sprang lha chos nus par byen gyis rlobs/ /yul chos yul ser 'bras dge gsum na/ /dgon grwa sa gcig na dge bshes mang / /kun phyogs gcig 'tshogs nas bgro gleng byas/ /chos 476
