dka' gnad go tshe rtse zhing dgod/ /dus yun ring bsdad na dga' ba la/ /chos slob gnyer tshar tshe mi sdod par/ /kun snga phyi rim pa bzhin du gyes/ /yun mi ring gyes nas song la skyo/ /yul mi gcig so sor song ba'i mthus/ /slar sngar bzhin thams cad 'dzom par dka'/ /nged dpon slob mi rtag de dang 'dra/ /ngas bsam zhing skyo ba nang nas skyes/ /rang 'byung bzhi'i lus kyang mi rtag 'jig /ngas bsam zhing bsam zhing shes pa 'phyo/ /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /sprang lha chos nus pa byen gyes rlobs/ /gnas dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dga' na/ /chos brgyud pa gcig pa'i rnal 'byor mang / /kun phyogs gcig 'tshogs nas nyams len byas/ /nyams rtogs pa shar tshe rtse zhing dgod/ /dus yun ring bsdad na dga' ba la/ /lo zla mtshams tshar tshe mi sdod par/ /kun snga phyi rim pa bzhin du gyes/ /yun mi ring gyes nas song la skyo/ /yul mi gcig so sor song ba'i mthus/ /slar sngar bzhin thams cad 'dzom par dka'/ /nged dpon slob mi rtag de dang 'dra/ /ngas bsam zhing skyo ba nang nas skyes/ /rang 'byung bzhi'i lus kyang mi rtag 'jig /ngas bsam zhing bsam zhing shes pa 'phyo/ /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /sprang lha chos nus par byen gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis skyo ba 477

than thun skyes pa'i dus shig la dben gnas tsā ri nas smras pa'o/ /nyon dang tshogs drug rang grol pa/ /tshe 'dir mngal du bzung ba'i ma/ /drin can yin zhes khyod gleng na/ /sngon tshe skye ba grangs med par/ /phan btags pha ma sems can rnams/ /drin de lan cig mi dran pa/ /khyod la ci zhig byung ba yin/ /tsha grang bkres skom bkol spyod dang / /zha long sprang bo nad can sogs/ /nyam thag ma gyur sems can kun/ /blo yis 'dor bar nus sam ci/ /sems can thams cad drin can ma/ /tshe sngon ma dang tshe 'di yi/ /ma la khyad par med do zhes/ /sangs rgyas gsungs pa de bden na/ /khyod la skye ba snga phyi yi/ /ma la khyad par ci'i phyir byung / /khyod kyis khyad par phye ba la/ /dgos pa ci yod bsam mno thongs/ /ma gyur sems can kun blos dor/ /ma gcig dran pa chags zhen yin/ /snying rje skye ba yin ma sems/ /phyogs ris chags zhen yod phyin chad/ /da dung 'khor bas mthar ma re/ /zhen chags yod bzhin tshe 'di yi/ /bya ba blos btang yod ma smra/ /ma gyur sems can yal bar dor/ /ma rgan dran nas ngu ba de/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas kun/ /su yis gzigs kyang thugs kyis khrel/ /ma gyur 'gro ba'i drin de dran/ /sdug bsngal bsams nas khyod ngus na/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas dgyes/ /de phyir tshe 478

'di'i ma dran bzhin/ /nyam thag ma gyur sems can gyis/ /sdug bsngal myong ba'i tshul soms la/ /mig nas mchi ma yang yang thongs//tshe 'di'i ma la byams pa bzhin/ /ma gyur 'gro la byams pa dang / /snying rje byang chub sems bskyed dang / /theg pa chen po'i gral du chud/ /drin can pha ma 'gro drug rnams/ /drin de yang dang yang du bsams/ /tshe 'di'i ma ltar phar bskyangs na/ /tshur yang bu ltar byams par 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di yang a ma dran pa'i dus shig tshogs drug rang grol gyis rang la smras pa'o/ /khra yis 'dzin gyis dogs nas/ /byi'u chung sa nas ma bsdad/ /shing gnas mthug po bsnyegs nas/ /'tshe med skad snyan bsgrags song / /lcags kyus 'dzin gyis dogs nas/ /nya chung mtsho mthar ma bsdad/ /gting zab chu dkyil bsnyegs nas/ /dgra med rtsed 'jo byas song / /lus la gser mig 'khyil byung / /'khor bar 'ching gis dogs nas/ /mi nga yul nas ma bsdad/ /ri khrod dben par bsnyegs nas/ /sdig med dge sbyong byas song / /rgyud la nyams rtogs shar byung / /nyams snang sna tshogs shar dus/ /nyams dga' snang ba spro nas/ /nyams rtogs gdu bu 'khrol bzhin/ /nyams mgur gling bu 'di bus/ /dmar ser me tog pad tshal/ /ba mos bcom na mi rung / /479

bsams nas lo 'dab bzhad dus/ /sbrang rtsi mang bo bsdus song / /da ni ba mo byung yang / /bung ba 'gyod pa mi snang / /zhing bzang lo yag snye ma/ /ser ba phog na mi rung / /bsams nas 'bras bu smin dus/ /ston thog khyim du bsdus song / /da ni ser ba byung yang / /zhing bdag 'gyod pa mi snang / /yang yang thob dka'i mi lus/ /'chi nad byung na mi rung / /bsams nas lus sems bde dus/ /nyams len rgyud la sbyar song / /da ni 'chi ba byung yang / /rnal 'byor 'gyod pa mi snang / /'khrungs sa phyi yi rgya mtshor/ /'khrungs pa'i 'od gsal nyi ma/ /sdod sa lha lam yangs pa/ /las su gling bzhi bskor song / /dro 'jam 'od zer btang bas/ /pad tshal yongs la phan byung / /'khrungs sa rab dkar gangs rir/ /'khrungs pa'i dar seng dkar mo/ /sdod sa gangs kyi ra ba/ /las su ri sul bskor song / /'o ma kha zas byen pas/ /seng phrug yongs la phan byung / /'khrungs sa a mdo'i phyogs su/ /'khrungs pa'i tshogs drug rang grol/ /sdod sa ri khrod dben pa / /las su rgyal khams bskor song / /mgur 'jen chos bshad byas pas/ /dad can yongs la phan byung //char dang kha ba gnyis kyis/ /rang gi mgo la gnod byung / /480

yar la bkag pas ma khog /zhwa zhig gyon pas phan song / /rdo dang tsher ma gnyis kyis/ /rang gi rkang la gnod byung / /mar la bsal bas ma tshar/ /lham zhig gyon pas phan song / /rdzun dang tshig rtsub gnyis kyis/ /rang gi sems la gnod byung / /phar la lan byas ma thub/ /bzod pa bsgoms pas phan byung / /mar dang 'o ma'i gzhi ma/ /'dod 'jo'i ba mo rgas rung / /da dung 'o ma bzhos pas/ /mar yang mang bo lon song / /sa lam bgrod pa'i gzhi ma/ /cang shes rta mchog rgas rung / /da dung zhon nas song bas/ /thag ring mang bo 'khor song / /lha chos byed pa'i gzhi ma/ /dal 'byor mi lus rgas rung / /da dung sgom sgrub byas pas/ /nyams rtog mang bo shar song / /pad+mas brgyan pa'i mtsho yis/ /ngang ba bsdu 'dod med rung / /su yis ma bos bzhin du/ /ngang ba pho mos bskor byung / /dri ldan yid 'ong pad+mas/ /bung ba bsdu 'dod med rung / /su yis ma bos bzhin du/ /bung ba pho mos bskor byung / /bya btang rnal 'byor bdag gis/ /slob ma bsdu 'dod med rung / /su yis ma bos bzhin du/ /skal ldan slob mas bskor byung / /char sbyin gtong mkhan glu yis/ /khyim pa'i zhing sa'i steng du/ /gang yod char ba babs pas/ /zhing bdag yongs la phan song / /zang zing 481

sbyin mkhan mi yis/ /nyam thag sprang bo'i snod du/ /gang yod sbyin par btang bas/ /dbul bo yongs la phan song / /chos sbyin gtong mkhan bdag gis/ /skal ldan slob ma'i rna bar/ /gang yod gdams pa bshad pas/ /dad can yongs la phan song / /zhes pa 'di rnams kyang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas tsā ri nas smras pa'o/ /na mo gu ru/ 'di phyi dang bar dor/ /blo rtse de gtad na/ /nam yang ni bslu med/ /sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun/ /byen rlabs kun stsol ba'i/ /drin can gyi bla ma/ /dngos grub kun ster ba'i/ /yi dam gyi lha tshogs/ /bar chad kun sel ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong / /sprang bo nga'i mgon skyabs/ /dpung gnyen du khugs pa/ /bsam gyin du rang blo/ /bde ba de skyid do/ /mtshan ldan gyi bla ma/ /mang bo yi zhal gyi/ /bum bzang las thon pa'i/ /zab rgyas kyi gdams pa'i/ /myong grol gyi bdud rtsi/ /mang bo zhig 'thungs pas/ /chos spong gi nad gcong / /rang 'gag la bud song / /shes rab kyi lus stobs/ /ches che ru rgyas byung / /dag snang gi gzi mdangs/ /'bar ba 'di skyid do/ /smin grol gyi gdams pa'i/ /sde mig ni bzang zhing / /thos bsam dang sgom gyis/ /'byed tshul la mkhas pas/ /gzung 'dzin gyi sgo lcags/ /dam po yang phyes song / /khregs chod kyi lha khang / yangs pa ru 482

tshud byung / /snang bzhi yi lha skur/ /mjal ba 'di skyid do/ /dad brtson dang shes rab/ /ldan pa yi tshogs rnams/ /mtshan ldan gye bla ma'i/ /zhabs drung du song la/ /gdams ngag gi lde mig /lag tu rang longs dang / /shes rab kyi sgo 'phar/ /brgya phrag cig phyes yong / /thun mong gi lam rnams/ /rim pa bzhin bgrod pa/ /rdzogs chen gyi chos kyi/ /ri dbang rtser phyin dang / /stong gsal gyi lta ba'i/ /nam mkha' rang langs yong / /lhun grub kyi snang bzhi'i/ /nyi ma yang 'char nges/ /ngo mtshar gyi ltad mo/ /de dus su mthong ngo / /mngal skyon gyis ma gos/ /pad+mo las 'khrungs shing / /'chi bdag gis mi tshugs/ /rdo rje yi sgu brnyes/ /o rgyan gyi thugs bcud/ /rdzogs chen gyi chos la/ /da lta rang mjal ba bla ma yi bka' drin/ /chos rgyal wang bka' drin/ /'khor thabs rang med do/ /drin lan du sgrub pa'i/ /mchod pa rang 'bul lo/ /sgrub 'bras kyis bstan 'gror/ /phan thogs shig shog ang / /zhes skyid pa'i rgyang glu 'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas tsā ri nas blangs pa'o/ /nam yang ni mi nyams/ /sems bskyed kyi lus la/ /rnam dag gi tshul khrims/ /rtsal gsum yang rdzogs shing / /gzhung lugs ni rab 'byams/ /g.yu ral gyis non pa/ /khur du yang ma song / /rgyan du rang bzung nas/ /thub bstan gyi gangs ri'i/ /khrod na 483

rang 'phyo ba'i/ /'gran bral gyi mi yi/ /seng ge mchog blo bzang / /yab sras kyi bu rgyud/ /dge lugs pa'i dge bshes/ /seng phrug gi seng ma'i/ /ngar skad dang mtshungs pa'i/ /lung rigs kyi nga ro/ /ches che ru bsgrags tshe/ /phyir rgol gye wa skyes/ /thams cad kyang brgyal 'gro/ /nang ba'i yang log rtog /mche ba can phal cher/ /rgyang ring na gnas kyang / /snying rtsa de 'dar na/ /grub rtags la de nyid/ /gcig pus kyang chog yong / /'khor ba kun sdug bsngal/ /rgya mtsho ru shes nas/ /nges 'byung dang skyo shas/ /thugs rgyud la grub pa'i/ /grub rtags ni khyem spangs/ /rab tu rang byung nas/ /gang la yang chags zhen/ /chung ba 'di yin pas/ /grub rtags la de nyid/ /gcig pus kyang chog yong / /sems can kun drin can/ /pha ma ru shes nas/ /byang chub kyi sems de/ /thugs rgyud la grub pa'i/ /grub rtags ni rang 'dod/ /rtsa ba nas bud nas/ /gzhan phan gyi thabs la/ /brtson pa 'di yin pas/ /grub rtags la de nyid/ /gcig pus kyang chog yong / /chos rnams kun rang bzhin/ /ma grub par shes nas/ /yang dag gi lta ba/ /thugs rgyud la grub pa'i/ /grub rtags ni bdag 'dzin/ /je chung la song nas/ /thugs rgyud ni zhi zhing / /dul ba 'di yin pas/ /grub rtags la de nyid/ /gcig pus kyang 484

chog yong / /mdor bsdus na chos phung / /brgyad khri dang bzhi stong / /thams cad kyi gnad 'gag /dpe thog tu ma lus/ /thugs rgyud la grub pa'i/ /grub rtags su nyon mongs/ /brgyad khri dang bzhi stong / /thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ /dug lnga de je chung / /song ba 'di yin pas/ /grub rtags la de nyid/ /gcig pus kyang chog yong / /chos gang yang nyon mongs/ /gnyen po ru song na/ /dam chos kyi dgos pa/ /de ka rang lags pas/ /grub rtags kyi che shos/ /de ka rang yin nges/ /grub rtags kyi mchog de/ /dge lugs pas bstan yong / /de 'dra yi grub rtags/ /ston rgyu zhig med par/ /nam mkha' la 'phur nus/ /ri brag la 'dzul kyang / /grub rtags kyi mchog tu/ /mkhas pa rnams mi bzhed/ /de ltar du go na/ /grub thob ni rkyang yin/ /rnal 'byor nga blo bzang / /grags pa yi bu rgyud/ /grub rtags kyi mchog la/ /de ka rang 'dod do/ /nyams dbyangs 'dis blo bzang / /yab sras kun mchod pas/ /nyon mongs kun thul bar/ /byen gyis rang rlobs shig /ces pa 'di yang 'ga' res dge lugs pa brgya bzang rung phyag rdzogs pa ltar grub rtags ston mkhan gcig kyang mi snang sogs zer ba byung bas rkyen byas/ bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas tsā ri nas rgyang glu'i tshul du 'then pa'o/ /nam mkha' las yangs shing / /rgya mtsho las dwangs pa/ /chos 485

kun gyi 'byung gnas/ /chos dbyings la 'dud do/ /rnal 'byor nga'i sems nyid/ /stong gsal ni 'dzin med/ /chos dbyengs kyi nam mkha'/ /yangs pa yi klong du/ /zhe sdang can 'ga' res//kha lce'i gzhu 'jen nas/ /tshig ngan gyi dug mda'/ /lan mang du 'phangs kyang / /gar song dang 'dir song / /rjes med du gyur nas/ /rang gzhan la phan gnod/ /spu tsam zhig ma byung / /chos dbyings kyi thang ma/ /phyogs kun tu brdal bas/ /sdug btsir gyi 'ching ba/ /lhod grol la langs song / /kun rdzob kyi chos kun/ /chos dbyings las mi 'da'/ /gar bsdad kyang chos dbyings/ /pho brang du 'dug go /'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i/ /chos rnams kun snang stong / /sgyu ma yi gzigs mor/ /lam lam du shar byung / /rtag chad dang bral ba'i/ /dbu ma ba nga gyis/ /phyogs ris dang bral ba'i/ /rdzogs chen pa nga gyis/ /dgag sgrub dang bral ba'i/ /phyag chen pa nga gyis/ /nyams mgur 'di dbu rdzogs//phyag chen gsum brgyud pa'i//bla ma rnams mchod pas/ /byen rlabs kun stsol cig /nam mkha' dang 'dra ba'i//lta ba yi rgyal po/ /thams cad kyis rtogs pa'i/ /yid smon zhig 'cha' 'o/ /zhes pa 'di yang 'ga' res khyed la tshig ngan zhig zhus kyang thugs gting nas khro ba cung zad mi snang / khong tshos tshig ngan khab tsam yang mi bzod pa zer ba'i lan du bya btang tshogs 486

drug rang grol gyis dben gnas tsā ri nas blangs pa'o/ /rtsa gsum gyi lha tshogs/ /gsol ba rang 'debs bzhin/ /dben pa ru sgo gsum/ /rang babs su glod nas//chos kun gyi rtsa ba/ /sems nyid ni skye 'gag /gnas gsum dang bral ba'i/ /gnas lugs ni stong gsal/ /spros bral gyi ngang la/ /nyin mtshan du bzhag dus/ /gnas lugs kyi stong char/ /phyi rol gyi nam mkhas/ /nyin mtshan du 'gran kyang / /'gran par ni ma bzod/ /chu 'dzin gyi phag tu/ /lan mang du yibs song / /gnas lugs kyi gsal char/ /phyi rol gyi nyi mas/ /nyin re bzhin 'gran kyang / /'gran ma tshugs ngo tsha/ /nub ri'i phag brgyud nas/ /gling gzhan du bros song / /stong gsal nyams nam mkha'/ /nyi ma las lhag byung / /nam mkha' dang nyi ma/ /rnal 'byor pa nga gyis/ /zhes pa 'di yang nyin zhig phyi dro nyi ma dro sa zhig tu bsdad nas nang sems nyid stong gsal spros bral gyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag yod dus/ nam mkha' sprin gyis bsgribs/ nyi ma nub rir yibs song bas rkyen byas bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis yid la shar ba ltar blangs pa'o/ /lnga ldan gyi 'ja' tshon/ /stong gsal gyi nam mkha'/ /yangs pa yi klong na/ /stong ba yi cha nas/ /ro gcig tu gnas kyang / /snang ba yi cha nas/ /du ma ru shar ba'i/ /ya mtshan gyi ltad mo/ /'di nyid la bltas pas/ /rgyu 'bras dang rten 'brel/ /mi bslu 487

bar nges pa'i/ /ha de yang go song / /'khor 'das kyi chos rnams/ /stong gsal gyi sems nyid/ /yangs pa yi klong na/ /stong ba yi cha nas/ /ro gcig tu gnas kyang / /snang ba yi cha nas/ /du ma ru shar ba'i/ /ya mtshan gyi ltad mo/ /'di nyid la bltas pas/ /rtag chad sogs gegs rnams/ /chos dbyings kyi klong du/ /lhag med du grol song / /gegs sel dang bogs 'don/ /gdams pa yi tshogs rnams//re zhig gi bar du/ /ga le rang bzhugs shig /snyan pa'i dbyangs mkhas pa'i/ /snyan lam du phul kyang / /snyan po red gsungs nas/ /snyan grags kyang brjod yong / /zhes pa 'di yang nyin zhig 'ja' tshon shar ba zhig mthong ba'i tshe bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas tsā ri nas smras pa'o//nam 'chi cha med 'khor bar bde ba med/ /rang don ma grub gzhan don 'ong ba med/ /ma gyur 'gro ba yongs la 'dzad mtha' med/ /'gro don ma snga bsgom gyis snying gi bu/ /bsgoms nas sangs rgyas thob na mkha' mnyam gyi//'gro don mdzad chog sku las 'od zer re/ /spros kyang sems can dpag med bder 'god nus/ /de dus 'gro don byed dgos snying gi bu/ /deng sang mi mang bsdus nas dbang lung dang / /khrid sogs byed pa 'gro don yin snyam yang / /rnam g.yeng chags sdang sdug bsngal bskyed 488

pa'i rgyu/ /skyid 'dod sdug la ma dga' snying gi bu/ /grong sde kun la khral chen bsdus nas ni/ /mchod sbyin gtong ba tshogs gsog yin snyam yang / /kun la sdig sdug gtam ngan 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /skyid 'dod sdug la ma dga' snying gi bu/ /mi dang dud 'gros sa rdo shing gsum blangs/ /lha khang rten bzhengs phan yon che snyam yang / /mi phyugs ngal zhing srin bu gsod pa'i rgyu/ /dud 'gror sgal pa ma 'don snying gi bu/ /sa dge rnying gsum bka' brgyud ya bzhi sogs/ /phyogs 'dzin bstan pa'i zhabs tog yin snyam yang / /bdag bstod gzhan smod bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren rgyu/ /grub mtha'i la rgya ma rtsod snying gi bu/ /dbang lung khrid gsum bstan bcos mang bo bsags/ /rang gzhan kun gyi rgyud la phan snyam yang / /nyams su ma blangs phan med nga rgyal rgyu/ /dpe mang bsdu la ma dga' snying gi bu/ /dpe lta 'chad rtsod nyams dbyangs len pa sogs/ /sems la yar bskyed bogs 'don yin snyam yang / /rtse gcig bsgoms tshe rnam rtog 'phel ba'i rgyu/ /spros pa thams cad dor cig snying gi bu/ /khang bar gad bdar bza' btung g.yo bskol sogs/ /bya byed mang ba bde thabs yin snyam yang / /don med ngang du mi tshe 'dzad pa'i rgyu/ /bya ba thams cad spongs shig snying gi bu/ /dgon gzhi bzung nas rnyed tshad gsog 489

pa de/ /dgon pa yun ring gnas phyir yin snyam yang / /grwa slob chags sdang 'thab rtsod skye ba'i rgyu/ /gzhi dgon bdag tum 'dzin snying gi bu/ /lha rten dpe cha mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa/ /ri khrod dben par sdod dus mkho snyam yang / /'gro dus khur lci brlags na sems sdug rgyu/ /cis kyang dgos pa med do snying gi bu/ /mdor na sprang bo bzhin du dman sa zungs/ /drang srong bzhin du dben par gcig pur sdod/ /rje btsun mi la ji bzhin sgrub la gzhol/ /snying gtam 'di rnams ma brjed snying gi bu/ /zhes pa 'di ni skal ldan snying gi slob bu kun bzang rang grol la bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin 'du ba'i gnas dag pa mkha' spyod dpal gyi tsā ri nas smras pa'o/ /chos sku kun tu bzang bo man chad nas/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma yan chad kyi/ /rdzogs chen brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /theg pa'i yang rtse rdzogs pa chen po yi/ /khregs chod gnas lugs lta ba rtogs pa dang / /thod rgal nyams kyi sgom pa mthar phyin nas/ /snang bzhi ye shes 'char bar byen gyis rlobs/ /rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul bla ma'i rnam thar la/ /log lta skad cig tsam yang skye mi rung / /sangs rgyas dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus gyis/ /bla ma'i 490

byin rlabs 'jug go snying gi bu/ /rdo rje spun gyis ci byas skyon du mthong / /khros nas ngan smra tshig rtsub byed mi rung / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yin snyam dag snang sbyongs/ /mkha' 'gros dngos grub ster ro snying gi bu/ /tshig re'ang bskal brgyar thos dka'i rdzogs chen chos/ /rnam dag yin min the tshom skye mi rung / /theg dgu'i yang rtse yin snyam dad gus gyis/ /chos skyong srung mas bsrung ngo snying gi bu/ /lto gos tsam gyi rtsol sgrub thams cad bor/ /na bun gos gyon brag phug zhwa ltar bsten/ /chos phyir ltogs rung 'khyags rung sdug bsran skyed/ /las ngan sdig sgrib 'dag go snying gi bu/ /long med brtson 'grus snying rus bskyed 'dod na/ /nam 'chi cha med 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang / /thar ba'i phan yon gong ma'i rnam thar soms/ /brtson 'grus snying rus 'byung ngo snying gi bu/ /rgyal ba kun gye byen rlabs 'jug 'dod na/ /skyabs gnas thams cad rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dus/ /bzlas brjod gzhan bsgyur bla mar gsol ba thobs /rgyal kun byin rlabs 'jug go snying gi bu/ /'khor 'das chos la ltad mo blta 'dod na/ /chos kun rtsa ba rang gi sems la thug /sgom sgrub gzhan zhog rgyun du sems la ltos/ /ngo mtshar ltad mo mthong ngo snying gi bu/ /tshe 'dir 'ja' lus 'od sku bsgrub 'dod 491

na/ /spros pa kun dor 'od gsal thod rgal sgoms/ /sha rus gdos bcas snang ba kun dag nas/ /'ja' lus 'od sku 'grub bo snying gi bu/ /mdor na o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /'phongs rul gdan rdol shi rung rdzogs chen sgoms/ /gsungs ltar lam bzang 'di la nan tan mdzod/ /bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub bo snying gi bu//dge 'dis dam gtsang dpon slob 'khor bcas kyis//dam pas byin brlabs dben pa'i ri sul du/ /zab lam rdzogs pa chen po'i bshad sgrub kyi/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mi nub 'dzin par shog /ces pa 'di yang tshogs drug grol gyis dad gus dag snang che ba'i bu mchog skal ldan rang grol dang / kun bzang gzhan phan bstan 'dzin nyi ma rnams la tsā ri nas smras pa'o//tshe sngon bskal mang tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i mthus/ /tshe 'dir dpal 'byor rin chen spungs pa 'dra/ /sngon goms bag chags bzang bo tshe 'dir sad/ /dad gus snying rje mchod sbyin byed la spro/ /zang zing nor la snying bo med na yang / /mchod sbyin mdzad na phan bde snying bo len/ /tha mal nor gyis mtshan dpe brgyan pa'i sku/ /sgrub la brtson pa'i rgyal yum gang de'i drung / /'jig rten 'khor ba'i bya ba las 'das shing / /myang 'das bde ba da dung ma thob par/ /gnyis med bya btang tshogs drug rang 492

grol gyis/ /rab tu gus pas zhu yig nyung ngu 'bul/ /khyed sku rab tu bde ba'i gtam snyan dang / /mkho ba'i yo byad gnang ba mthong ba'i mod/ /bdag sems shing bal dga' spro'i dri bzhon gyis/ /bskyod nas dga' gtam shag shog 'dab sgra sgogs/ /phran kyang bla ma'i thugs rjes sgyu lus bde/ /rgyud la nyams rtogs yon tan ri bong rwa/ /'on kyang bla mar gsol btab nyams len byas/ /nyams rtogs 'char ba'i re ba byed bzhin mchis/ /rgyal yum khyed kyis gang gsungs bdag gis bgyid/ /khyed kyis da dung sngar bas sum 'gyur gyis/ /mchod sbyin phyag skor kha ton dge la 'bod/ /khyad par 'khor g.yog sde rnams bu bzhin skyongs/ /sngon gyi las bzang smon lam dag pa'i mthus/ /tshe 'dir dpon slob 'brel ba skal ba bzang / /kun kyang gnas skabs tshe ring nad med cing / /mthar sangs mnyam por rgya ba'i smon lam 'tshal/ /da res gzigs rten stong ba min tsam du/ /kha ba'i mdangs 'dzin lha rdzas dri med bcas/ /sar gnas dag pa mkha' spyod tsā ri nas/ /zla tshes bzang bor phul ba dge legs 'phel/ /zhes pa 'di yang rgyal yum 'chi med zla ba pad dkar gyis gsung yig cig bskur ba'i lan du tsā ri nas phul ba'o/ / spang ri nags tshal rgyu ba'i ri dwags rnams/ /dbyar gsum 493

rtsi thog za ba nyams dga' ste/ /sdig can mi dad khyi yis ded tsa na/ /dngangs skrag 'jigs nas bros pas kha lce bskams/ /de dus rdza rir 'gro 'dod dran na yang / /'bros pa'i dbang med mi ngan lag tu chud/ /da dung mi khyis ma zin ri dwags tsho/ /ma 'dug ma 'dug myur du rdza rir phros/ /brag stod mthon por gnas pa'i bya rgod rnams/ /ling ling gzan la rub pa nyams dga' ste/ /thag rnyi khra bos bzung nas 'gags tsa na/ /dngangs skrag 'jigs nas gshog sgro sa la brdebs/ /de dus nam mkhar 'phur 'dod dran na yang / /'phur ba'i dbang med bya gsod lag tu chud/ /da dung rnyi yis ma zin bya rgod tsho/ /ma 'dug ma 'dug myur du mkha' la 'phur/ /'dzam bu'i gling du skyes pa'i pho mo rnams/ /tshe 'dir longs spyod 'dzoms pa nyams dga' ste/ /'chi nad drag pos lus la thebs tsa na/ /dngangs skrag 'jigs nas mal nas rkang lag g.yab/ /de dus lha chos byed 'dod dran na yang / /byed pa'i dbang med 'chi bdag lag tu chud/ /da dung 'chi nad ma byung pho mo rnams//ma 'dug ma 'dug myur du lha chos gyis/ /ces pa 'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis khyim pa pho mo yongs la dben gnas dag pa mkha' spyod dpal gyi tsā ri tra nas smras pa'o//dbyar gsum nam zla slebs pa 'di dga'o/ /me tog sna 494

tshogs 'khrungs pa 'di skyid do/ /glo bur ba mos gnod pa ni ma byung / /nam zla'i rgyal mo'i bka' drin rang lags so/ /ston zla gsum po slebs pa 'di dga'o/ /'bras bu sna tshogs smin pa 'di skyid do/ /glo bur ser ba'i gnod pa ni ma byung / /nus ldan ser srung bka' drin rang lags so/ /thos bsam sgom gsum byas pa 'di dga'o/ /nyams rtogs sna tshogs shar ba 'di skyid do/ /glo bur tshe la bar chad ni ma byung / /dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin rang lags so/ /zhes pa 'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis tsā ri nas smras pa'o//phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas dgongs su gsol/ /khyed gsung mdo rgyud bstan bcos dgongs don rnams/ /bdag gis slar yang glu ru blangs pa yis/ /bdag gzhan yongs la phan par byen gyis rlobs/ /tshe 'dir thos bsam rgya cher ma byas mod/ /'on kyang bskal pa mang bo'i sngon rol nas/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas mang bor bya ba byas/ /nges pa don gyi chos mang khong du chud/ /tshe 'dir bla ma re las zab gnad can/ /chos re thos kyang chos mang gnad 'gag grol/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems mchog la/ /thugs dam mthil byas bdag pas bzhan gces 'byongs/ /gsang sngags bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen bsgoms pa'i mthus/ /dbu ma'i rtsa mdud rim gyis 495

lhod nas grol/ /mgrin par mi la ras pas gar byas bzhin/ /nam yang mi zad glu dbyangs gter kha rdol/ /rjes 'jug skal ldan gdul bya pho mo la/ /phan phyir mdo rgyud bstan bcos dgongs don rnams/ /go sla khyer bde'i phyir du glu ru blangs/ /'brel tshad mngon mthong nges legs lam la bkod/ /gangs can ljongs kyi phyi rabs gang zag la/ /phan pa'i 'jog pa byed rgyu gzhan ma mchis/ /kun gyi spyi rgyur ngo mtshar mgur 'bum gyi/ /glegs bam 'di nyid 'jog pa byas pa yin/ /'di nyid rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo rgyud dang / /rgya bod mkhas grub gong ma'i thugs nyams su/ /'khrungs pa'i rdo rje'i glu yi dgongs don ltar/ /yin pas gnad zab byin rlabs dpag med yod/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos blta bar mi nus pas/ /'di la ltos dang legs nyes blang dor shes/ /dge sdig legs nyes blang dor ston pas na/ /mgur 'bum 'di nyid bla ma zhig dang mtshungs/ /mthong thos skyo sangs nyams dga' snang ba spro/ /mgur 'bum 'di yis grogs kyi go yang chod/ /de bzhin byas na ci bsam re ba skong / /mgur 'bum 'di nyid yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /de phyir mchog dman kun gyis glegs bam 'di/ /nor bu bzhin du spyi bor len par rigs/ /'di nyid 'dzin skyong spel ba'i gang 496

zag la/ /chos skyong dkar phyogs lha yis srung skyob gyis/ /glegs bam gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs su/ /chos dang dge legs bkra shis 'phel ba dang / /mgur dbyangs mthong thos dran reg sems can kun/ /myur du sangs rgyas go 'phang thob gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang mgur 'bum gyi mjug tu sgon tshig tu bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas khyad 'phags dag pa mkha' spyod dpal gyi tsā ri nas smras pa'o//ngo mtshar phyogs bcu'i zhing nas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ chos skyong srung ma/ yul lha gzhi bdag sogs nam mkha' gang bar byon nas/ mdun gyi nam mkha' 'ja' zer 'od phung 'khyel ba'i klong du bzhugs te/gnas 'dir bkra shis pa'i me tog dang / 'dod dgu'i char phab rol mo'i sgra sgog par gyur/ rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bkra shis shog /chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyi bkra shis shog /mi la na tsha med pa'i bkra shis shog /phyugs la god kha med pa'i bkra shis shog /zhing la sad ser med pa'i bkra shis shog /mdzod la gang stongs med pa'i bkra shis shog /yul la 'khrug rtsod med pa'i 497

bkra shis shog /'gal rkyen thams cad med pa'i bkra shis shog /mi rnams tshe ring nad med bkra shis shog /phyugs la g.yang kun 'khyel ba'i bkra shis shog /mi phyugs gong du 'pheb/ ba'i bkra shis shog /char chu dus su 'bab pa'i bkra shis shog /lo legs 'bru rnams 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog /mthun rkyen thams cad 'dzom pa'i bkra shis shog /kun gyis lha chos byed pa'i bkra shis shog /chos mgo mtha' ru phyin pa'i bkra shis shog /chos pas sa steng khyab pa'i bkra shis shog /tshe 'dir thams cad skyid pa'i bkra shis shog /phyi mar byang chub thob pa'i bkra shis shog /ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /dge legs rgyun mi 'chad pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis dang dge legs bde skyid chen pos phyogs kun khyab nas/ dus nam yang mi nyams par gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang mgur 'bum gyi mjug tu bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas khyad 'phags dpal gyi tsā ri nas bris pa'o/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun zhabs dkar rdo rje 'chang chen pos mchog dman bar ma'i gdul byar gang la gang 'tsham gyi rdo rje'i mgur dpag tu med pa bzhengs pa yi ger 'khod pa'i nang tshan las/ 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba'i dben gnas khyad 'phags dag pa mkha' spyod dpal gyi tsā ri tra nas bzhengs pa'i skor ro/ /498

gnas chen gangs dkar gyi rgyal po te se nas bzhengs pa'i skor/na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣa ya/ dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs kyi pad+mo la/ /bka' drin dran bzhin lan brgyar gus phyag 'tshal/ /zang zing nor rdzas lus ngag bsnyen bkur dang / /bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pas mnyes par bya/ /bka' drin mtshungs med dpal ldan bla ma yi/ /bka' dang 'gal ba thams cad mthol lo bshags/ /bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rnams/ /bsam gyin rjes su yi rang yang yang bya/ /bdag bzhan 'gro la chos kyi 'khor lo yang / /'khor ba ma stongs bar du bskor bar bskul/ /rje btsun bla ma bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dge tshogs rnams/ /bla ma'i bzhed don 'grub pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /tshe rabs kun tu bla mar mjal ba la/ /jo bo rje dang 'brom ston lta bur shog /mjal nas bsam dang sbyor bas bsten pa la/ /rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang lta bur shog /bsten nas thos bsam rgya chen byed pa la/ /kun mkhyen blo bzang yab 499

sras lta bur shog /thos don bsgom zhing nyams dbyangs len pa la/ /sa ra ha dang mi la lta bur shog /rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel mdzad pa la/ /'phags pa klu sgrub thogs med lta bur shog /'chad rtsod rtsom la thogs pa med pa la/ /'jam dbyangs dbyangs can lha mo lta bur shog /skye 'chi mi mnga' sku tshe ring ba la/ /tshe dpag med dang pad 'byung lta bur shog /log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'joms pa la mthu stobs phyag rdor rta mgrin lta bur shog /tshad med thugs rjes 'gro kun 'dren pa la/ /spyan ras gzigs dang sangs rgyas lta bur shog /ces dpal ldan bla ma la phyag dang bcas pa'i yan lag bdun pa zhig sngon du btang nas/ bla mas rjes bzung bya bral ri khrod pa tshogs drug rang grol bdag gis skyes pa'i pha yul rgyab tu bskyu da gnyen bshes tshogs rnams ring du spangs tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis btang nas/bka' drin mtshungs med chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo sogs mtshan ldan gyi bla ma rnams kyi gsung bzhin phyogs med kyi rgyal khams yangs pa'i sa phyogs dang / nges med kyi ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal rnams 'grims nas nyams len chos la byed dus/ rang gzhan gyi rgyud la phan pa'i nyams dbyangs sna tshogs blangs pa ni gzhan du gsal la/ da lan 'dir bde mchog 'khor lo'i pho brang / dgra bcom lnga brgya'i bzhugs gnas/ gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i zhing mchog gang zag phal ba rnams kyi rgyud byen gyis brlabs pa'i gnas chen gangs dkar gyi rgyal po te se nas sgrub la gzhol skabs su/ gzhan phyi rol gyi snang grag bzang ngan gyis rkyen byas/nang rang sems me long gtsang ma la/ mgur dbyangs gzugs brnyan gyi ri mo gang shar rnams yi ge'i gzugs su bkod pa ni 'di lta ste/bla ma mchog gsum dpag bsam shing drung du/ /'khod nas 500

rang blor dpag pa'i glu dbyangs len/ /dam chos ston mkhan 'tsho byed gzhon nu 'dra/ /dam pa'i chos ni 'tsho thabs sman dang 'dra/ /chos de nyan mkhan yun ring nad pa 'dra/ /chos la nyan pa sman pa'i tshig nyan 'dra/ /nyams su len pa sman rnams 'thung ba 'dra/ /nyon mongs zhi ba nad las thar ba 'dra/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' u dus+thā ra 'dra/ /lus srog g.yo ba chu yi chu wur 'dra/ /dkar nag las 'bras dug dang bdud rtsi 'dra/ /'khor ba 'di ni rgyal po'i btson ra 'dra/ /'gro kun tshe 'di'i drin can pha ma 'dra/ /sems bsgyed sangs rgyas rgyu yi sa bon 'dra/ /sbyin pa 'gro ba'i re skong nor bu 'dra/ /tshul khrims mtho ris thar ba'i them skas 'dra/ /bzod pa tshig rtsub mtshon la go cha 'dra/ /brtson 'grus sa lam bgrod pa'i rta mchog 'dra/ /bsam gtan sems la dbang bsgyur rgyal po 'dra/ /shes rab chos kun lta ba'i mig dang 'dra/ /bsdu bzhi gzhan yid 'gug pa'i lcags kyu 'dra/ /gsang sngags chos ni myur ba'i gsang lam 'dra/ /dbang thob phal ba rgyal sar bton pa 'dra/ /dam tshig yon tan bsgyed pa'i sa gzhi 'dra/ /bskyed rdzogs gdams pa gser 'gyur rtsi dang 'dra/ /las mtha' sna tshogs nyer mkho'i yo byad 'dra/ /chos rnams thams cad lo yag snye ma 'dra/ /thams cad 501

nyams su lon pa'i smon lam 'tshal/ /zhes pa 'di yang mtshams la bsdad pa'i skabs shig sems la shar ba ltar bris pa'o//rang nyid thog ma'i dus nas da lta'i bar/ /drin gyis bskyangs pa'i ma gyur sems can gyis/ /da lta sdug bsngal pyong ba snying re rje/ /tsha ba'i dus su bsil ster drin can ma/ /la la da lta tsha dmyal brgyad du skyes/ /tsha ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba snying re rje/ /grang ba'i dus su drod kyis bskyangs pa'i ma/ /la la da lta grang dmyal brgyad du skyes/ /grang ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba snying re rje/ /bkres skom dus su bza' btung ster ba'i ma/ /la la da lta yi dwags gnas su skyes/ /bkres skom sdug bsngal myong ba snying re rje/ /byams pas rtag tu bskyangs pa'i drin can ma/ /la la da lta dud 'gro'i gnas su skyes/ /bkol spyod sdug bsngal myong ba snying re rje/ /brtse bas gang 'dod ster ba'i drin can ma/ /la la da lta mi yi gnas su skyes/ /na 'chi'i sdug bsngal myong ba snying re rje/ /gnod pa kun las skyob pa'i drin can ma/ /la la da lta lha min gnas su skyes/ /'thab rtsod sdug bsngal myong ba snying re rje/ /phan pa kho nas skyong ba'i drin can ma/ /la la da lta lha yi gnas su skyes/ /'pho ltung sdug bsngal myong ba snying re rje/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rang sangs 'gyur dus med/ /rang la da lta skyob pa'i nus 502

pa med/ /sdug bsngal myong ba'i ma rnams snying re rje/ /de ltar 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bsams tsa na/ /de ring nangs par gnyis kyi de ring yang / /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob na snyams pa byung / /bdag ni myur ba myur du sangs rgyas nas/ /ma gyur sems can yongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal/ /thams cad bde la 'god pa'i smon lam 'tshal zhes pa 'di yang mtshams khang sgor lto gos ye med pa'i ngan slong mang bo yang yang slong du 'ongs pas rkyen byas/ ma gyur 'gro ba yongs la snying rje shas mi bzod pa/ mchi ma 'khrugs pa tsam zhig byung ba'i dus su bris pa'o/ /dgung sngon mthon po la bya rgod lding ba bzhin/ /mtha' bral chos dbyings kyi nam mkha' yangs pa la/ /rang rig 'dzin med kyi bya rgod 'phyo na ang / /bar snang yangs pa na sprin dkar 'phyur ba bzhin/ /dbyings rig dbyer med kyi bar snang yangs pa la/ /bde gsal mi rtog pa'i sprin dkar langs na ang / /'od stong phyogs bcu ru spro ba'i nyi ma bzhin/ /mtha' med 'gro kun gyi pad+mo'i skyed tshal du/ /'gag med snying rje yi nyi ma shar na ang / /skyi bser rlung bo kho phyogs kun 'phyo ba bzhin/ /gzhan phan 'phrin las kyi shugs 'byung skyi bser rlung / /phyogs ris thogs rdugs med kun la 'phyo na ang / /lho phyogs nam mkha' na 'brug cig ldir ba bzhin/ /skal bzang gdul bya yi mdongs ldan dga' ston du/ /zab rgyas legs bshad kyi dbyar rnga ldir na 503

ang / /zim bu'i sbrang char zhig dal bus 'bab pa bzhin/ /dad ldan zhing sa ru byin rlabs char babs nas/ /nyams rtogs yon tan gyi myu gu 'khrungs na ang / /zhes pa 'di yang nyin zhig nam mkha' mthon po'i dbyings rum na bya rgod cig lding zhing / phyogs phyogs kyi ri rtse'i bar snang la sprin dkar gyen du 'phyur/ lho phyogs na g.yu 'brug cig ldir zhing sbrang char 'bab pa/ skyi ser rlung 'jam po dal bur rgyu ba sogs kyis rkyen byas yid la 'di shar tshe 'phral du ye ger bris pa'o/ /sgrub khang phyi rol gyi me tog sna tshogs/ /kha dog smug por gyur 'dab ma lhung nas/ /mi rtag rnam 'gyur ni rang bstan byung / /mig gis mthong yul gyi spang gzhongs tshogs rnams/ /kha dog ser skyar song 'bras bu lhung nas/ /mi rtag rnam 'gyur ni rang la bstan byung / /thag nye'i bya bye'u dang ri dwags tshogs rnams/ /yul phyogs gzhan du song shul rnams stongs nas/ /mi rtag rnam 'gyur ni rang la bstan byung / /sa dang bar snang gi srin bu'i tshogs rnams/ /gcig kyang mi snang yal sgra skad nyams nas/ /mi rtag rnam 'gyur ni rang la bstan byung / /bya btang rnal 'byor pa rang gi sgyu lus/ /'di yang de bzhin du mi rtag 'gyur bas/ /mi rtag 'chi ba soms dam pa'i chos gyis/ /tshe stod bzang bo ni yad yud shor song / /tshe mjug cir 'gyur ni rang la cha med/ /da lta gzhon dus su dam pa'i chos gyis/ /lo yang snga ma ni yad yud shor song / /phyi ma cir 'gyur ni rang la 504

cha med/ /da lo'i lo nang 'dir dam pa'i chos gyes/ /zla ba snga ma ni yad yud shor song / /phyi ma cir 'gyur ni rang la cha med/ /zla ba 'di'i nang du dam pa'i chos gyis/ /kha sang nyi ma ni yad yud shor song / /sang nyin cir 'gyur ni rang la cha med/ /de ring nyi ma la dam pa'i chos gyis/ /da nangs snga dro ni yad yud shor song / /phyi dro cir 'gyur ni rang la cha med/ /da lta da lta rang dam pa'i chos gyis/ /zhes pa 'di yang ston dus rtswa rnams ser bor 'gro ba sogs nam zla dus bzhi'i 'gyur ldog mthong bas rkyen byas rang la phan phyir bris pa'o//phyi chos gos rnam gsum rgyan gyis mjes/ /nang bslab pa rnam gsum nor gyis phyug /chos sde snod rnam gsum kun mkhyen pa'i/ /rje bla mar sgo gsum gus pas 'dud/ /rje dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /tshe 'di yi bya ba blo yis btang / /gnas nges med 'grims pa'i rnal 'byor ngas/ /chos gang shes kha nas glu ru len/ /rje bdag nyid chen po'i bstan la zhugs/ /bstan 'gro la ci phan mdzad mkhan gye/ /khyed chos mthun dbang bo sbyin pa gnyis/ /nga'i phan pa'i snying gtam 'di la nyon/ /tshe 'di yi bde la zhen chags nas/ /tshe phyi ma mi dran 'dir bde'i phyir/ /lto gang bzang gon pa gang dro snyam/ /las dgra 'dul gnyen skyong byed mkhan de/ /gzugs mi ru 'dug kyang phyugs las glen/ /rwa 505

mjug ma med rung dud 'gro dngos/ /mi de la skyes bu tha shal zer/ /rten mi lus rnyed dka' 'chi ba dang / /mar ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal bsams/ /tshe 'di yi bde la ma chags par/ /tshe phyi mar lha mi'i bde ba 'dod/ /de'i don du mi dge bcu bo spangs/ /las dge bcu dang du len mkhan gyi/ /mi de la skyes bu chung ngu zer/ /spyir khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsams/ /mtho lha mi'ang bde skyid med par shes/ /mar 'khor ba'i gnas la zhen pa log /yar thar ba'i go 'phang thob na 'dod/ /de thob thabs bslab gsum nyams len pa'i/ /mi de la sgyes bu 'bring zhes zer/ /rang 'khor bar skyes nas sdug myong ltar/ /ma 'gro ba kun kyang de 'dra snyam/ /rang gcig pu thar 'dod blo spangs nas/ /gzhan ma gyur sems can kun don du/ /yar sangs rgyas go 'phang thob 'dod nas/ /byams snying rje byang chub sems kyi sgos/ /lam phyin drug bsdu bzhi slob mkhan gyi/ /mi de la skyes bu chen po zer/ /spyir skyes bu che 'bring chung gsum gyis/ /don gang yang bsgrubs na chog dus 'dir/ /chos byang chub lam rim che chung bzhin/ /bsgrub nus na bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /don de phyir phyi mar bde 'dod na/ /tshe 'di yi bya ba blo yis thongs/ /gnas shin tu dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /chos 506

byang chub lam rim nyams su longs/ /mi ngas kyang nyams len de ltar byas/ /khyed gnyis kyang de ltar mdzad na legs/ /don de bzhin nyams su len pa la/ /gegs gol sa med pa'i smon lam 'tshal/ /zhes pa 'di ni sde ba dbang bo dang dbu mdzad sbyin pa gnyis la smras pa'o//kun rdzob chos kyi gnas lugs dpyad tshe snang stong gzigs mor lam lam lam/ /shes rab mtshon gyis bdag 'dzin bcad tshe stong nyid dbyengs su lhod lhod lhod/ /gang shar rnam rtog ngo bor bltas tshe 'dzin med klong du khrol lo lo/ /don dam chos dbyings ngang la bzhag na stong gsal khyab gdal me re re /mtha' bral chos dbyings chen po'i klong na 'khor 'das ltad mor shig shig shig /kun khyab mnyam gzhag mig gis bltas na thams cad sgrib med sa la la/ /ma rtogs 'gro la snying rje skyes dus mig nas mchi ma sha ra ra/ /stong nyid snying rje'i shugs kyis bskyod dus 'gro don yid la wa la la/ /lus ngag 'gro ba'i don la brtson dus 'di 'dra'i mgur dbyangs lhang lhang lhang / /zhes pa 'di yang nyin zhig yid la shar ba ltar bris pa'o//bdag pas gzhan gces byang chub sems/ /mnga' ba rnams la gus phyag 'tshal/ /gnod pa byas kyang phan 'dogs pa'i/ /skyes mchog rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /sems can mthong 507

thos thams cad la/ /pha ma bu tsha'i 'du shes skyed/ /sdug bsngal can la snying rje dang / /bde ba med la byams pa sgoms//khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la byin/ /gyong dang pham kha rang gis longs/ /blangs kyang tshur la khro gyur na/ /phar la byams pa chen po sgoms/ /bsgoms kyang tshig rtsub smras gyur na/ /phar la 'jam pa'i gtam snyan smros/ /smras kyang skyon mtshang 'bru gyur na/ /phar la yon tan brjod par bya//brjod kyang lag gis brdungs gyur na/ /phar la phyag 'tshal bsnyen bkur bya/ /byas kyang lan du gnod byed na/ /da dung phan thogs chen po bya/ /byas pas mi phan gsod na yang / /da dung phan sems gtong mi bya/ /skyid na rang bde 'gro la thongs/ /'gro kun bde bas 'tsho bar smon/ /sdug na gzhan sdug tshur la longs/ /'gro kun sdug dang bral bar smon/ /chos 'di rgyud la yod na gzhan/ /gang yang med rung sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /chos 'di rgyud la skyes pa'i mi/ /de ni gang na gnas kyang bde/ /chos 'di'i tshig don dran tsam gyis/ /chags sdang skyes pa zhi bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di yang slob bu blo bzang tshul khrims kyis blo sbyong zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor bris pa'o//sngon byon grub thob pho mo yis/ /dang po mtshan ldan bla ma btsal/ /lus dang srog la ma bltas par/ /bsam dang sbyor bas 508

tshul bzhin bsten/ /bla ma des kyang rjes su bzung / /gdams ngag zab mo ma sbas par//dus gsum sangs rgyas gshegs shul gyi/ /ma nor lam bzang gsal bar bstan/ /bar du lam de bsgom pa'i dus/ /tshe 'di'i bya gzhag rmang nas bshig /'jig rten chos brgyad rdog brdzis byas/ /rtag tu ri yi bu byas te/ /na bun sngon po gos su gyon/ /brag phug yun ring zhwa ltar bsten/ /lto gos gtam la gyong bskur nas/ /spang la phur ba btab pa ltar/ /stan gyi thog tu sdod tshugs shing / /yengs med rtse gcig bsgoms pa'i mthus/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag snying la zhugs/ /snying la nyams rtogs nyi ma shar/ /tha ma shin tu brgal dka' ba'i/ /srid pa'i ra ba dum bur gtubs/ /bde chen thar ba'i grong khyer du/ /ngo mtshar ltas bzang bcas te gshegs/ /grub thob gong ma'i rnam thar ltar/ /bdag kyang dang po bla ma bsten/ /ngo mtshar zab rgyas gdams ngag blangs/ /bar du tshe 'di blo yis btang / /me tog ljon shing bkra ba'i ljongs/ /bung bas snyan pa'i sgra sgog cing / /bya bye'u 'phur lding 'jo sgeg g.yo/ /ri dwags bag phebs gnas pa'i sa/ /shin tu dben pa'i dga' tshal du//gcig pur nyams len byas pa'i mthus/ /da lta bde skyid nyi ma shar/ /slob bu rnams kyang de bzhin mdzod/ /ces pa 'di yang slob bu 509

'ga' res yo kyis sngar ji ltar mdzad/ nged rnams kyis ji ltar bya zer tshe sems la shar ba ltar bris pa'o//sprang na so rgas pa'i dus 'dir/ /lus bskyed pa'i drin can pha ma/ /grogs mdza' bshes thams cad rim bzhin/ /tshe phyi ma'i lam la zhugs song / /gnyen mdza' bshes snying dang 'dra ba/ /dus lan gcig 'bral mi phod rung / /dgra 'chi bdag bsam log slebs nas/ /kun dbang med gtan bral byas song / /dpe tshong 'dus mgon po bzhin du/ /sngar lhan cig yud tsam 'grogs kyang / /yun mi ring so sor gyes nas/ /da 'du ba'i 'brel ba chad song / /sems chags pa'i gnyen bshes bral nas/ /rang gcig pur sa mthar 'khyams tshe/ /kun mi rtag 'gyur tshul bsams pas/ /nang sems la skyo ba skyes song / /da rang yang myur du 'chi nges/ /sems chags zhen 'khri ba bcad nas/ /gnas dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dgar/ /chos sgrub bzhin 'chi bar smon no/ /zhes pa 'di yang nyin zhig sems la shar ba ltar bris pa'o//rab yangs thugs kyi 'chi med lam yangs spor/ /rab gsal mkhyen pa'i rta bdun dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /rab rib rmongs pa'i mun pa rtsad nas sangs/ /rab 'byams chos kun gzigs pa'i bla mar 'dud/ /byang chub lam rim dar gyi sham 510

bus mdzes/ /mdzes par ma zad sngags rim tog gis mtshan/ /mtshan pa'i thub bstan rgyal mtshan bsgrengs pa'i bu/ /bu bzang yin pas legs bshad mgul dar sgron/ /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor mi lus rin chen gru/ /mjal dka'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mnyan pa gnyis/ /'dzom dka' da res 'dzoms pa'i dus skabs 'dir/ /brgal dka' 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgol re ran/ /mi sdug gnyer ma'i zhags nag lus la bkram/ /skra dkar mche ba rnon pos spyi bor btab/ /na rga lce yis bkrag mdangs bcud 'phrog pa'i/ /'chi bdag kha ru chud na sgol mi nus/ /'khor ba'i btson dong nang du rtag par nyal/ /nyes spyod mi gtsang bshang gcis lus la gos/ /mi 'dod sdug bsngal chad las myong bzhin du/ /zhe blo bde bar sdod pa shin tu 'khrul/ /skye rga na 'chi'i lam gyi bzhi mdor nyal/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyi tsha grang bkres skom myang / /ma rig dmus long 'gro drug ma rnams kyi/ /sdug grogs byas nas bsdad kyang dgos pa chung / /gang la ma chags kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /byams dang snying rje byang sems gru gzings sdom/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis dar chen phyor/ /kun mkhyen nor bu len du da chas shig /brtson 'grus rlung gis tshogs gnyis dar chen skyod/ /skyod dang myur du sgrib 511

gnyis mtsho las sgrol/ /sgrol thub phyin chad sku gnyis nor bu lon/ /lon pas bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /phyi rol kha btags 'bul mkhan mang mchis kyang / /legs bshad kha btags blo gros 'dom la 'jal/ /bu yi mgul du sgron mkhan pa min su/ /bu khyod 'di 'dra'i mgul rgyan gyis dang mdzes/ /zhes pa 'di yang slob bu rtogs ldan 'jam dpal la springs pa'o//bde chen chos dbyings pho brang du/ /bde bar bzhugs pa'i bla ma la/ /rab tu gus pas phyag byas nas/ /rnal 'byor bde lugs dbyangs su len/ /bla mas nges don bstan nas bzung / /gu yangs yan pa blo re bde/ /chos rnams bar snang 'ja' tshon bzhin/ /sems kyi dbyings su shar bas bde/ /sems nyid nam mkha' yangs pa ltar/ /stong gsal mtha' dbus med pas bde/ /mnyam rjes snang sems ro gcig 'dres/ /ltad mo cir yang mthong bas bde/ /'khor 'das thams cad sems su rdzogs/ /srid zhi'i spang blang bral bas bde/ /bsgom bya sgom byed gcig tu 'dres/ /bsgom rgyu rdul tsam med pas bde/ /mi bsgom snyam yang sgom du song / /bsgom la rgyun 'chad med pas bde/ /de ltar ma rtogs 'gro ba la/ /phyogs med snying rje skyes pas bde/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyi sprul sgyur ltar/ /zhen med 'gro don byas 512

pas bde/ /nam zhig sgyu lus 'dzig pa'i tshe/ /'chi ba chos skur grol bas bde/ /chos sku'i dbyengs las ma g.yos bzhin/ /gzugs skus 'gro don 'ong bas bde/ /tshe 'dir bde zhing phyi mar skyid/ /kun kyang 'di ltar bde bar smon/ /zhes pa 'di yang dad brtson shes rab snying rje dang ldan pa'i slob bu sangs rgyas don grub kyis bde zhus byas pa'i skabs sems la shar ba ltar yi ger bris pa'o//rje bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas rnams/ /spyir 'gro drug yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /sgos bdag la re ltos byed mkhan gyi/ /rgyud smin kyang grol bar byin gyes rlobs/ /sprang bdag gis chos mang mi shes kyang / /rang gang shes go tshad dbyangs su len/ /khyed shes pa rnams la'ang gsal 'debs dgos/ /chos shes rung gus pa'i tshul gyes nyon/ /rten dal 'byor mi lus thob dus 'dir/ /yar sangs rgyas zhing du 'gro ba dang / /mar ngan song gnas su 'gro ba yi/ /dbang gnyis ka rang gi lag na yod/ /dus yang yang rnyed dka'i mi lus 'di/ /yun mi ring myur du 'jig par nges/ /khong 'chi bdag pho nya slebs pa'i tshe tshe 'di ru zhag gcig sdod dbang med/ /rang shi tshe 'khor bar skye ba'i rgyu/ /las nyon mongs gnyis kyi gzhan dbang gis/ /skyes phyin chad bde ba'i go skabs med/ /da 'khor bar phyi phyag 'tshal re 513

ran/ /las nyon mongs dbang gis 'khor bar skyes/ /sdug sna tshogs myong ba'i 'gro ba kun/ /tshe sngon ma rang gi pha mar gyur/ /khong rnams kyang yal bar 'dor mi rung / /rang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'di las thar/ /gzhan thar ba'i bde la 'god pa la/ /skyon kun zad yon tan kun ldan gyi/ /mchog sangs rgyas go 'phang thob pa dgos/ /de thob thabs rgya che grangs mang yang / /mdor bsdus na mi dge'i sdig pa spangs/ /las dge ba bsgrub pa 'di ka yin/ /las mi dge'i sdig pa ma spangs na//mchog sangs rgyas thob pa phar la zhog /yar lha mi'i go 'phang thob mi 'gyur/ /mar ngan song ngan 'gro'i rigs su skye/ /las dkar bo dge la 'bad gyur na/ /tshe 'dir yang bde la phyi mar skyid//dus ring min myur du sangs rgyas nas/ /ma 'gro ba yongs la phan thogs 'gyur/ /don de phyir chags sdang rmongs gsum sgos//las mi dge bcu sogs sdig ma byed/ /sdig sngar byas rnams la bshags pa dang / /da phyin chad mi byed sdom sems gyis/ /de byas na sngar byas sdig pa 'dag /byams snying rje byang chub sems kyi sgos/ /las dge ba bcu sogs chos la 'bod/ /chos sngar byas rnams la dga' ba dang / /da phyin chad byed pa'i blo rgya skyed/ /de byas na sngar byas dge ba 'phel/ /chos gang byas mjug tu bstan 514

'gro la/ /spyir phan pa'i bsngo smon gang shes dang / /sgos rang nyid ma gyur 'gro don du/ /sangs myur du rgyas pa'i bsngo smon gyis/ /don de ltar mdzad na gnas skabs bde/ /mthar sangs rgyas thob par rgyal bas gsungs/ /gsung tshad mar zungs la nyams su longs/ /chos de bzhin nyams su len mkhan la/ /rje rtsa brgyud bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /lha yi dam tshogs kyis dngos grub stsol/ /ma mkha' 'gro srung mas bu bzhin skyongs/ /gtam 'di las byung ba'i dge tshogs rnams/ /ma 'gro ba yongs la phan phyir bsngo/ /kun gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces pa 'di yang dad gtong sogs 'phags pa'i nor bdun gyis phyug pa'i slob bu sgar dpon dbang rgyal nor bu la smras pa'o//bslu med gtan gyi skyabs gnas mchog gsum dang / /dpag med yon tan 'byung gnas rtsa gsum lha/ /thogs med 'phrin las sgrub pa'i chos skyong rnams/ /zla med rtsa ba'i bla ma'i rnam 'phrul du/ /go nas skyabs gcig bla ma dam pa la/ /snying nas rtse gcig gus pas phyag byas nas/ /skal bzang tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'dod rnams la/ /gdams ngag mchog cig bshad kyis gus pas nyon/ /'khor 'das chos kun ngo bo mkha' ltar stong / /stong bzhin rnam pa snang ba rmi lam 'dra/ /rmi lam snang ba 515

sems las byung ba ltar/ /'khor 'das chos rnams rang gi sems las byung / /sems kyi ngo bo mkha' ltar ye nas stong / /stong gsal sems kyi mkha' klong yangs pa ru/ /chos rnams rgya mtsho dwangs pa'i zla gzugs ltar/ /'gag med shar zhing gang shar 'dzin pa med/ /snang bzhin stong la stong bzhin snang ba yi//snang stong thabs shes zung 'jug yangs pa'i lam/ /mnyam rjes snang sems dbye ru ma mchis pas/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan stong ba nyid/ /de yi ngang la mnyam par 'jog tsa na/ /nam mkha' bzhin du mtha' dbus med par zhog /bar snang bzhin du ngos bzung med par zhog /sa gzhi bzhin du g.yo 'gul med par zhog /de ltar mnyam par bzhag na nor bu las/ /'dod dgu 'byung ltar 'gro la snying rje dang / /stobs dang mi 'jigs mi brjed gzugs la sogs/ /sangs rgyas yon tan gang yin thams cad 'byung / /sngon byon grub thob pho mo mkha' lding gis/ /snang stong zung 'jug yangs pa'i gshog zung brgyangs/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i g.yang sa rab bcad nas/ /kun mkhyen mkha' klong yangs par 'phur nas song / /kha mig yar lta skal bzang khyung phrug rnams/ /'jig rten chos brgyad sgong shun rdog brdzis thongs/ /dben pa'i brag la rnga rtsa legs gtod la/ /zung 516

'jug 'dab gshog rgyongs la da 'phur cig /bdag sems dri med rab dkar gangs ri la/ /stong gsal 'dzin med nyi 'od lhung ba'i mod/ /sngar bas nyams rtogs 'od dkar ches cher gsal/ /glu dbyangs snyan pa'i chu rgyun lhung lhung babs/ /'di nyid gdul bya'i zhing la 'grem nus na/ /nyams rtogs yon tan 'bras bu ci yang 'khrungs/ /nyon mongs tshad pas gdungs pas 'thung nus na/ /dug lnga'i tsha gdung sel bar gdon mi za/ /'di ltar nyams su len pa'i skal bzang gis/ /ring min myur du chos sku mngon gyur nas/ /chos sku'i dbyings las g.yo ba med bzhin du/ /gzugs sku gnyis kyis 'gro don byed par shog /ces pa 'di yang slob bu skal ldan rang grol la springs pa'o//dmar ser me tog rgyas nas/ /zil mngar bcud bzang myong dus/ /ba mo phog na mi rung / /de la brten pa'i bung ba/ /lho sprin rogs su sgon cig /sngo ljang snye ma 'khrungs nas/ /'bras bu smin pa za dus/ /ser ba phog na mi rung / /de la brten pa'i zhing bdag /sngags 'chang rogs su sgon cig /mtho ris bu mor 'grogs nas/ /'dod dgu'i gar gyis rtse dus/ /sbyin skyes byung na mi rung / /de la brten pa'i lha bu/ /dpung bzhi rogs su spron cig /dal 'byor mi lus thob nas/ /dam pa'i lha chos byed 517

dus/ /'chi bdag byung na mi rung / /de la brten pa'i rang sems/ /tshe lha rogs su sgon cig /tshe dpag med kyi thugs rjes/ /tshe ring nad med byung na/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba ma byed/ /tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms dang / /tshe rabs gtan du bde yong / /zhesapa 'di yang nyin zhig yid la shar ba ltar bris pa'o/ /pha yul la zhen chags ni ma byas/ /mi yul gyi dben pa rnams bsten song / /bsten dus su rnam g.yeng ni ma byas/ /zab rgyas kyi gdams pa rnams bsgoms song / /bsgoms pa'i tshe gol sa ru ma shor/ /sa lam gyi grol rtags rnams shar song / /yul phyogs kyang gcig tu rang ma bsdad/ /phyogs med kyi rgyal khams la langs song / /song ba'i tshe 'dod yon dang phrad kyang / /rlung bo bzhin chags med du bzhud song / /'gro ba'i tshe rgyal khams la bltas pas/ /ltad mo yang sna tshogs shig mthong song / /gzhan skyon yang mang po zhig mthong bas/ /rang skyon yang yod pa rnams tshor song / /tshor ba'i tshe gab nas rang ma bzhag /mi gtsang bzhin phyi rol tu bton song / /'dris med kyi yul phyogs su 'khyams dus/ /skyid sdug kyang mang bo zhig myangs song ro snyoms kyi spyod pa rang byas nas//chags sdang la 'bur 'joms rang btang song / /chos phyir du shi na yang rung snyam/ /lus srog 518

kyang chos phyir du dor song / /kha tsam min snying nas rang dor bas/ /lto gos kyi 'jigs pa dang bral song / /skyid sdug la gdam kha ni ma byas/ /gang byung kun lam du rang khyer song / /sdug bsngal kyang bde ba ru shar bas/ /rnal 'byor ngas skyid glu rang blangs song / /zhes pa 'di yang mi 'ga' res 'dris med kyi yul phyogs 'grim dus ci 'dra byas sogs dris pa'i tshe yid la shar ba ltar yi ger bris pa'o/ /chos kun sgyu ma lta bur shes/ /chos dbyings stong gsal ngang la bzhugs//chos rje bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /chos brgyad rtog pa 'gag tu gsol/ /nyon dang tshogs drug rang grol ba/ /rnyed dang ma rnyed bde mi bde/ /snyan dang mi snyan bstod smad la/ /'jig rten chos brgyad mi zer ram/ /chos brgyad bzang ngan gang byung la/ /blang dor chags sdang dga' mi dga'i/ /rnam par rtog pa yod ring la/ /chos pa yin snyam ma sems shig /rmi lam bde sdug dar rgud rnams/ /rmis pa'i dus kyang rang bzhin med/ /sad kyang bden par ma grub pa/ /shes nas dga' sdug med pa ltar/ /rnyed dang mi rnyed bde mi bde/ /gang 'dra byung yang dga' mi dga'i/ /rnam par rtog pa ma skyes par/ /rmi lam gnas skabs tsam du soms/ /brag cha'i sgra dbyangs bzang ngan la/ /grags pa'i dus kyang rang bzhin med/ /dar cig grags 519

nas yal 'gro ba/ /shes nas dga' sdug med pa ltar/ /snyan dang mi snyan bstod smad sgra/ /gang 'dra go yang dga' mi dga'i/ /rnam par rtog pa ma skyes par/ /brag cha bzhin du khyer la thongs/ /'ja' tshon ri mo gang shar yang / /thams cad nam mkha'i dbyings nas shar/ /nam mkha' stong ba yangs dog dang / /'pho 'gyur med par gnas pa ltar/ /chos brgyad rnam rtog gang shar yang / /thams cad sems kyi dbyings nas shar/ /sems nyid stong gsal chos dbyengs kyi/ /ngang du shes pa glod la zhog /bzhag tshe dga' sdug rnam rtog rnams/ /sems nyid 'od gsal dbyings su nub/ /'od gsal ngang du dga' yal le/ /gnas na rmad byung skal ba bzang / /chos rgyal rtog pa 'gags tsa na/ /chos kyang rnam dag 'ongs pas na/ /chos pa'i gral du chud pa yin/ /chos bzhin byed na de ltar mdzod/ /ces pa 'di yang nyin zhig chos brgyad gdon gyis yid bskyod nas dga' mi dga'i rtog pa mang bo byung dus rang nyid la phan phyir bris pa'o// bya btang spyon pa gtad med bdag gi /lta ba ngos bzung gtad so mi 'dug /gtad so med pas bsgom rgyu mi 'dug /bsgom rgyu med pas shor rgyu mi 'dug /shor rgyu med pas 'du rgyu mi 'dug /'du rgyu med pas 'bral rgyu mi 'dug /'du 'bral 520

med pas nam mkha' lta bu'i/ /ting nge 'dzin la ngang gis gnas song / /rgyun 'chad med pa'i sgom zhig 'byung ba/ /chos rgyal wang gi bka' drin lags so/ /sangs rgyas las kyang bka' drin che byung / /drin lan sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul lo/ /sgrub pa snying bor byed pa'i dus su/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byen gyis rlobs shig /yi dam lha yis dngos grub stsol cig /mkha' 'gro srung mas bar chad srungs shig /myur du chos sku mngon du byas te/ /gzugs sku 'gro ba'i don la byung nas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'gro ba yongs la/ /phan thogs rgya chen 'byung bar gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang bris pa'o// lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan yid bzhin nor/ /bshad sgrub rgyal bstan gsal byed nyi ma mchog /lung rtogs yon tan mi zad rgya mtsho'i gter/ /'gro ba yongs kyi ma 'dris mdza' bshes che/ /bla mar 'os kyang slob ma'i tshul 'dzin pa'i/ /pha bas lhag pa'i skal ldan snying gi bu/ /mtshan snyan gang shar rang grol zhes bya ba'i/ /zhabs kyi pad+mo dri ma med drung du/ /phyogs med rgyal khams yangs pa'i sa phyogs su/ /chags med rlung ltar rgyu ba'i bya btang ba/ /'do med snyom las smyon pa'i gar mkhan gyis/ /zol med sgo gsum gus pas 'di skad zhu/ /mgon khyod 521

gzugs sku rab tu bde ngos nas/ /rin chen dang po la sogs skyes bzang dang / /zhal gsung tshigs su bcad pa'i glegs bu bcas/ /'byor bas dngos mjal lta bu'i dga' spro shar/ /phran yang rtsa gsum lha yi thugs rje yis/ /sa chu 'phrod cing sgyu ma'i lus po bde/ /dam pa khyed dang gzhan gyi sku drin gyis/ /mthun rkyen 'dzom zhing dge sbyor 'phel bar mchis/ /ched gsol mgon khyod byang phyogs gdul bya yi/ /don du yun ring bzhugs pa'i thugs 'dun dang / /zhabs brtan rim gro lo re bzhin du bsgrubs/ /nyams len chu bo'i rgyun bzhin mdzad par zhu/ /gang nus chos byed bdag gis mgon khyod kyis/ /gang gsung thams cad mi brjed sems la 'jog /gangs ljongs bstan pa'i gsal byed khyed kyis kyang / /gang zhus nang ltar mdzod ces thal mo sbyor/ /thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa'i dpon slob rnams/ /rnam mkhyen go 'phang ma thob de srid du/ /du ma'i skye ba bzang bo len pa'i tshe/ /tshe rabs kun tu mjal ba'i smon lam 'tshal /zhes pa 'di yang byang phyogs gdul bya'i gtsug rgyan mtshan yongs grags bla ma gnas brtan nam/gsang mtshan gang shar rang grol tu 'bod pas gsung shog cig gi 'byor lan du bris nas phul ba'o//bya btang ri ba khu byug sngon mo nga / /ri khrod dben pa'i ljon shing ra ba nas/ /gang shes nyams len 'phur lding g.yo 522

bzhin du/ /legs bshad skad snyan lhang lhang 'byen la spro/ /yongs 'dzin bla mas bskyangs pa'i rgod phrug khyod/ /thos bsam gshog brgyangs mdo rgyud bstan bcos mkhar/ /'phur nas ya mtshan ltad mo ci yang mthong / /da ni bsgom bya'i gzan la rub pa mtshar/ /mtshan ldan bla ma sku bzhi'i gangs ri la/ /mos gus gsol 'debs nyi ma ma shar na/ /byen rlabs chu rgyun gtsang ma mi 'byung bas/ /mos gus gsol 'debs 'od kyis lan brgyar bzhus/ /byams dang snying rje byang sems rtar zhon nas/ /gzhan phan dkyus thag yang yang ma bcad na/ /lha mi'i khrom la ltad mo mi 'byung bas/ /gzhan phan dkyus thag yang dang yang du chod/ /rang lus lha sku rgyal po'i gdan sa la/ /'gyur ba med pa'i rgyal srid ma bzung na/ /mkha' 'gro'i 'khor 'bangs dbang du mi 'du bas/ /bskyed rim rgyal sa 'di nyid rtag tu zungs/ /rtsa rlung thig le'i gshag shing bzang bo la/ /a shad gtum mo'i me zhig ma sbar na/ /bde drod me dpung rang 'bar mi 'byung bas/ /bum can rlung gis gtum mo'i bde drod sbor/ /sems nyid stong gsal nam mkha' yangs pa la/ /rnam rtog sprin phung 'khrigs pa ma dwangs na/ /mkhyen brtse'i nyi zla gza' skar mi bkra bas/ /rnam rtog lho sprin mi rtog dbyings su sbos/ /'od gsal lhun grub 523

thong rgal gdams pa yis/ /myong grol lha yi bdud rtsi ma 'thungs na/ /'chi med 'ja' lus go 'phang mi brnyes pas/ /thod rgal snang bzhi'i bdud rtsi ngoms med thungs/ /phun tshogs tshogs gnyis yid bzhin nor bu la/ /bsngo smon byi dor yang yang ma byas na/ /gzhan phan 'phrin las dgos 'dod mi 'byung bas/ /bsngo smon rnam dag byi dor lan mang gyis/ /pha rgan mgrin pa lha yi lam yangs nas/ /legs bshad nyi ma gzhon nus ma brtses na/ /slob bu'i blo gros pad+mo mi bzhad pas/ /de phyir dri med glu dbyangs 'od zer spros/ /zhes pa 'di yang slob bu gang shar rang grol la springs pa'o//chos thams cad sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad ltar/ /gang snang yang sgyu mar lam lam du/ /kun gzigs pa'i chos rgyal ngag gi dbang / /thugs brtse bas bdag gzhan yongs la gzigs/ /sngon thog ma'i dus nas da lta'i bar/ /blo ma rig 'khrul ba'i sngags kyis zin/ /phyi 'khrul snang sgyu ma'i ltad mo mthong / /de bden par bzung nas 'khor bar 'khyams/ /da sgyu ma rmi lam rab rib dang / /sa'i smig rgyu mig yor me long gzugs/ /lha'i sprul ba dri za'i grong khyer bzhin/ /gang snang tshad rang bzhin med par rig /kun tshugs thub bden par mi 'dzin par/ /chos thams 524

cad sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad ltar/ /bsgom nus na skabs shig mngon sum du/ /kun snang stong sgyu ma lta bur mthong / /rang sgyu ma lta bur sangs rgyas tshe/ /gzhan sgyu ma lta bu'i sems can la/ /chos sgyu ma lta bur legs bstan na/ /kun sgyu ma lta bur 'tshang rgya gsungs/ /don de phyir rang lus snod bcud chos/ /gang snang yang bden par mi 'dzin par/ /kun sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad ltar du sgoms/ /blo chags sdang dbang du ma gtang zhig /nang rang sems ma rig gnyid kyis non/ /phyi 'khrul snang rmi lam sna tshogs byung / /de bden par bzung nas 'khor 'khyams bdag /da ma rig gnyid las sad par smon/ /dge 'di yis ma gyur sems can yang / /chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur shes/ /dus gnas skabs chags sdang kun zhi nas/ /mthar sgyu ma lta bur 'tshang rgya shog /ces pa 'di yang nyin zhig sems la shar ba ltar 'phral du yi ger bris pa'o//chu phran rnams kyang ni phal cher bskams song / /chu bo chen po yang chu phran gyur snang / /rgan pa rnams kyang ni phal cher shi song / /gzhon nu rnams tsho yang rgas par gyur snang / /chu 'dzin smug po rnams mi snang yal nas/ /sprin dkar gzhon nu zhig gsar du byung snang / /sngar yod phyug po tsho dbul bor gyur song / /sngar med dbul bo rnams phyug por gyur snang / /bya rgyal 525

rgod po zhig nam 'phang bstod song / /skabs shig mtho sa nas dma' sar babs snang / /mi dregs 'ga' zhig ni mthon por gyur song / /skabs shig mtho sa nas dma' sar lhung snang / /mgron khang mgron po rnams 'gro ran gyes song / /mgron chung gsar ba rnams byung nas bzung snang / /pha yul pha ma rnams rgas nas shi song / /bu dang tsha bo rnams skyes nas bzung snang / /sngo ljang rtsi shing rnams kha dog 'gyur song / /'bras bu smin pa yang phal cher thor snang / /nag po'i skra lo rnams dkar bor 'gyur song / /dung so sum cu yang phal cher bud snang / /chos rnams thams cad po mi rtag 'gyur song / /rtag pa'i chos shig ni gang na'ang mi snang / /tshul 'di zhib tu rang yid la bsams song / /bsams tshe skyo shas shig ma gtogs mi snang / /tshe 'di'i bya ba rnams blo yis thongs song / /da ni gang la yang zhen chags mi snang / /rang blo dam chos kyi phyogs su shor song / /chos min bsam pa zhig 'char rgyu mi snang / /zhes pa 'di yang ston dus chu phran bskams pa dang chu bo chen po chung du 'gro ba sogs mthong bas rkyen byas sems la skyo shas skyes pa'i tshe yid la shar ba ltar yi ger bris pa'o/ /bla ma rje yi bka' drin gyis/ /rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /zab mo'i gdams pa glu ru len/ /skal ldan snying gi 526

slob bu nyon/ /mtshan ldan bla ma mjal ba dang / /dal 'byor mi lus rnyed par dka'/ /nam 'chi nges pa ma mchis shing / /'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba med/ /sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can rnams/ /pha mar ma gyur gcig kyang med/ /pha ma 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las/ /sgol la rang nyid sangs rgyas dgos/ /sangs rgyas thob thabs chos mang yang / /nyams su lon na mang mi dgos//bu khyod 'di bzhin nyams len mdzod/ /smon 'jug sems bskyed bzang bo'i sgos/ /rang lus lhar gsal las 'od 'phros/ /phyi snod thams cad dag pa'i zhing / /nang bcud lha dang lha mor mos/ /rang gi mdun nam spyi bo ru/ /ngo bo bla ma yin pa la/ /rnam pa rdo rje 'chang chen sogs/ /sangs rgyas gang 'dod rnam par bsgoms//skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma la/ /gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas thobs/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi longs/ /'od zhu thugs yid gcig tu bsres/ /lung dang rigs pa'i 'khor 'das chos/ /rang gi sems su shes pa dang / /sems kyi gnas lugs nam mkha' ltar/ /rtogs pa'i mtha' bral chos dbyings kyi/ /ngang la nam mkha' lta bur zhog /mkha' las yangs pa'i lta ba de/ /gnam sa mgo mjug ldog na yang / /nam mkha' bzhin du 'gyur ba med/ /de yi ngang la mnyam bzhag na/ /lus ni yang 527

zhing shin tu bde/ /sems ni gsal zhing rab tu dga'/ /de ltar ma rtogs 'gro kun la/ /bcos ma min pa'i snying rje skye/ /spyan dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul dang / /stobs dang mi 'jigs mi brjed gzungs/ /sangs rgyas yon tan ci yang 'byung / /mdor na chos dbyengs rgyal sa de/ /zin na 'khor 'das mnga' dbang bsgyur/ /bde ba gang yang lag tu 'ong / /rnam rtog zhi ba'i dwangs cha tsam/ /lhag mthong lta ba yin ma snyam/ /mda' rgyang gang tsam lta ba des/ /'bus sgra tsam gyi rkyen mi theg /gnas cha yod kyang grol cha med/ /spyan dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs/ /lam rtags yon tan 'byung ba med/ /de la yun ring mnyam bzhag tshe/ /dran brjed che zhing byeng rmugs 'phel/ /tha ma sgom rgas gnyid du 'gro/ /phyi mar lha lam dud 'gror skye/ /de phyir skal ldan snying gi bu/ /'gags dang nyag ga ma nor cig /de ltar ma nor nyams blangs na/ /nam zhig sgyu lus 'jig pa'i tshe/ /'chi ba chos skur grol bar 'gyur/ /chos sku'i dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin/ /gzugs skya 'gro ba'i don la 'byung / /myur du sangs rgyas sar bgrod pa'i/ /nye lam 'di las gzhan ma mchis/ /mkhas blun gang gis nyams blangs kyang / /tshegs chung don che gnad 'gag zab/ /gcig shes kun grol gdams pa 'di/ /528

gcig la bshad rung kun la phan/ /skal ldan snying gi slob bu khyod/ /gnad kyi gdams ngag snying la chongs/ /gser srang stong las 'di nyid lhag /gdams ngag chud zos ma byed cig /'di ltar nyams su len pa rnams/ /gegs med myur du 'tshang rgya shog /ces pa 'di yang nyin zhig sems la shar tshe skal ldan gyi slob ma bstan 'dzin ras pa la gdams pa'o// e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /phan pa'i snying gtam 'di la nyon/ /grub thob gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /thog mar tshe 'di blo yis thongs/ /mi med dben pa'i ri sul du/ /mi rtag 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sogs/ /'gro kun drin can pha mar sgoms/ /byams dang snying rje byang sems skyed/ /snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams kun/ /bar snang 'ja' bzhin sems kyi 'phrul/ /sems kyi ngo bo gdod nas stong / /stong gsal nam mkha' yangs pa 'dra/ /de yi ngang la mnyam 'jog dus/ /thang ma bzhin du rdol la zhog /la kha mthon po'i so ba bzhin/ /dran pa'i rgyang so tshugs la zhog /rnam rtog 'phro rgod byung ba'i tshe/ /ras bal bzhin du glod la zhog /bying rmugs gnyid 'thibs byung ba'i tshe/ /nyi ltar gsal ngar thon la zhog /de ltar bzhag pas sems nyid ni/ /ston gnam g.ya' dag bzhin du gsal/ /nyams dang 529

rtogs pa'i yon tan rnams/ /nyi zla gza' skar bzhin du bkra/ /chos sku'i dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin/ /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du 'byung / /yid bzhin nor bu lta bu yi//gcig chog gdams pa 'di ka lags/ /zhes pa 'di yang slob bu blo bzang shes rab la gdams pa'o//lhar bcas 'gro ba yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i pad tshal rgyas pa'i gnyen/ /gangs can 'gro ba yongs kyi mig gcig pu/ /skyabs mgon gzugs sku nyi ma gzhon nu'i drung / /'khor ba'i 'dam skyes phran chung pad+ma dkar/ /sor bcu'i 'dab ma spyi bo'i ze'u 'bru la/ /phyogs nas dad gus 'dzum mdangs bzhad bzhin du/ /dma' ba'i sa na zhu tshig dri bsung spro/ /phun tshogs tshogs gnyis rin chen khams las 'khrungs/ /tshad med bzhi yi bang rim mngon par mtho/ /lung rtogs yon tan gzi brjid rab 'bar ba'i/ /mgon khyod gzugs sku g.yo med ri dbang la/ /mkhan slob rnam gnyis nyi zla zung gis mdzes/ /thugs sras sku drag gser gyi ri bos bskor/ /skal bzang gdul bya rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus/ /lhang nge lham me lhan ner bzhugs so zhes/ /gtam snyan dbyar gyi rnga gsang stong ldir bas/ /phyogs kyi khor yug thams cad gang ba'i mod/ /gus 530

phran slob bu bdag yid gar mkhan gyes/ /dga' dad zlos gar lan mang bsgyur dgos byung / /gtan gyi skyabs mgon nam mkha'i nor bu yi/ /thugs rje 'od zer kho nas rab 'tsho ba'i/ /gus phran sgyu lus nyam chung 'dam skyes kyang / /na 'chi grang reg ba mo'i dgra las rgyal/ /byams dang snying rje byang sems 'dab ma rgyas/ /rim gnyis nyams rtogs bcud kyang cung zad 'khyel/ /dge sbyor dri ngad khor yug kun tu 'thul/ /skal bzang rkang drug 'ga' yang 'khor bzhin mchis/ /dpag bsam shing dang gter chen bum pa bzang / /nor bu nyi ma las lhag skyabs mgon khyed/ /zhabs pad srid mtha'i bar du brtan dgos zhes/ /snying nas gsol 'debs re 'bras mchis par mdzod/ /bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /khyed min re sa gzhan med thugs rjes zungs/ /'di phyi bar do'i dus rnams thams cad du/ /'jigs dang sdug bsngal kun las bskyab tu gsol/ /de ltar skyabs 'jug zhus pa'i yig chung la/ /gzigs rten stong min tsam gyi dngos po bcas/ /'dzam gling sa yi lte ba gangs ri nas/ /zla tshes bzang bor rab tu gus pas phul/ /zhesapa 'di yang drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma bod skyong chos rgyal de mo rin po che la phul ba'o//sprang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol/ /lo gzhon pa'i snang ba 531

ma 'char/ /lus skra dkar gnyer ma byung 'dug /lo lon ni min na ci yin/ /lo na so yar yar rgas nas/ /tshe nyi ma na tshas gtugs bzhag /lus na rgyu tsha rgyu mang gi /da 'chi rgyu min na ci yin/ /mi 'chi ba rgan gzhon mi snang / /nam zhig la shi 'gro ci shes/ /gzhan shi ba mthong thos mang gi /'di bya gtong min na ci yin/ /sngar gshin rjes mi zhig tshe thar/ /btang zer ba gcig kyang ma thos/ /rang gcig pu dmigs bsal byas nas/ /'jog snyam pa'i re ba ma mchis/ /don de phyir tshogs drug rang grol/ /nga da dung mi 'chi ma snyam/ /dgra 'chi bdag myur du 'ong bas/ /chos zab mo myur du sgrubs ang / /zhes pa 'di yang nyin zhig gzhan mi mang bo shi ba thos pas rkyen byas rang la phan phyir bris pa'o//nam 'chi nges med ma dran/ /tshe 'di'i khol bor gyur pa/ /bdag 'dra'i chos pa yongs la/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes gzigs shig /tshe 'di'i kha drag dpon la/ /rtag tu ci mnyes bsgrubs bsgrubs/ /rtsa ba'i bla mar byung na/ /da tsam byin rlabs zhugs yod/ /pho mo gzhon nu phan tshun/ /gcig yid gcig la chags chags/ /rdo rje'i spun la byung na/ /da tsam thugs yid 'dres yod/ /kha dbugs thogs nas bzung ste/ /kha nas ngag 'khyal lab lab/ /kha ton bzlas par byung na/ /da tsam ngag nus thon 532

yod/ /zhing las 'tsho skyong phyir du/ /'gro 'dug 'gul skyod byed byed/ /phyag dang skor bar byung na/ /da tsam sgrib pa dag yod/ /mdza' ba'i gnyen bshes thams cad/ /brtse gdung byams pas skyong skyong / /'gro ba yongs la byung na/ /da tsam byang sems 'byongs yod/ /sdang ba'i dgra bo rnams la/ /gnod pa ci 'khrol skyel skyel/ /nyon mongs 'dul la byung na/ /da tsam dgra bcom thob yod/ /nyi ma re re bzhin du/ /bza' btung chag med mdzad mdzad/ /thos bsam sgom la byung na/ /da tsam mkhas grub byung yod/ /chung nas da lta'i bar du/ /tshe 'di'i don la 'bad 'bad/ /dam pa'i chos la byung na/ /da tsam sangs rgyas tshar yod/ /don chung tshe 'di'i 'dun ma/ /don du da bar gnyer kyang / /don go spu tsam ma byung / /don chen yal bar shor song / /da ni mi tshe cha gsum/ /byas pa'i cha gnyis shor snang / /cha gcig tsam pa'i ring 'dir/ /lha chos 'ong bar gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang nyin zhig sems la shar ba ltar bris pa'o//chos dbyengs bde chen pho brang du/ /rtag tu bde bar bzhugs mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma rje yi bka' drin gyes/ /rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol bde/ /sems nyid rang ngo rang gis shes/ /gnas lugs don dang ldan pas bde/ /ngang la ma bcos lhug 533

par bzhag /'gyur med rang sa zin pas bde/ /cir snang chos kyi sku ru rtogs/ /re dogs the tshom chod pas bde/ /thams cang rang gi sems su nges/ /cir snang grogs su shar bas bde/ /'jig rten bya ba blo yis btang / /ched 'dzin gza' gtad bral bas bde/ /'khor bar zhen pa gnying nas log /thams cad sgyu mar rtogs pas bde/ /brtson 'grus myur ba'i rta la zhon/ /thar ba'i sa lam bgrod pas bde/ /thos bsam phyi yi sgro 'dogs chod/ /ltad mo sems la blta bas bde/ /re dogs the tshom kun chod nas/ /'od gsal rgyun chad med pas bde/ /mdor na 'jig rten rgyab tu bskyur/ /rtag tu lha chos byas pas bde/ /rnal 'byor bde ba'i glu dbyangs 'di/ /thos tshad bde zhing skyid par shog /ces pa 'di yang slob bu 'ga' res bde zhus byas pa'i dus shig yid la shar ba ltar bris pa'o//dgung sngon mthon po yi dbyings rum de mthong bas chos sku kun tu bzang bo de dran byung / /nam zhig sgyu lus g.yar bo 'di 'jog dus/ /'chi ba 'od gsal gsal 'debs rang mdzod cig /'od gsal 'dzam gling nyi ma de mthong bas /longs sku rdo rje 'chang chen de dran byung / /'chi khar ma grol bar do ru 'khyams na/ /bar do longs sku'i gsal 'debs rang 534

mdzod cig /dri med sprin dkar gzhon nu de mthong bas/ /sprul sku shākya thub pa de dran byung / /bar dor ma grol 'khor ba ru 'khyams na/ /skye ba sprul sku'i 'dzin grogs rang mdzod cig /rab dkar gangs ri dkar bo de mthong bas/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma de dran byung / /'di dang phyi ma bar do yi gnas su/ /byon la mgon skyabs dpung gnyen rang mdzod cig /ces pa 'di yang nyin zhig nyi ma la bsdad dus phyi rol gyi snang ba'i rkyen gyis yid la shar ba ltar blangs pa'o//rang sems skye med chos kyi sku/ /rjen par ston mdzad bla mar 'dud/ /drin can bla ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /cer gyis bltas pas sems ngo mthong / /mthong med nam mkha' lta bur mthong mthong ba'i ngang la cog ge bzhag /bzhag pas rtogs tshogs sprin ltar yal/ /sprin bral ston gnam g.ya' dag bzhin/ /ngos bzung med pa'i stong nyams shar/ /lkugs pas rmi lam rmis pa bzhin/ /smra rgyu med pa'i gsal nyams byung / /na chung bde bas myos pa bzhin/ /brjod du med pa'i bde nyams skyes/ /rgya mtsho'i nang du rdo bsgyur bzhin/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i gdeng zhig rnyed/ /yangs shing rgya che sems kyi klong / /nam mkha' bzhin du mu mtha' bral/ /sems nyid 'od gsal chos kyi dbyings/ /nyi ma bzhin du 535

gsal la dwangs/ /chos rnams sems kyi rang snang tsam/ /sgyu ma bzhin du stong zhing snang / /rang sems dri med chos kyi sku/ /nor bu bzhin du 'dod dgu 'byung / /'di don rtogs pa lta ba zer/ /mnyam par 'jog pa sgom pa lags/ /'bral med skyong ba spyod pa yin/ /mngon du gyur pa 'bras bu'o/ /rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /nges don glu ru blangs pa yin/ /bu khyod 'di bzhin nyams su longs/ /thos tshad yongs la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang slob bu dad ldan 'jigs med rgyal mtshan gyis nges don lta bu'i mgur dbyangs shig dgos zhes bskul ngor bris pa'o//byams dang snying rje byang chub sems/ /mnga' ba rnams la gus phyag 'tshal/ /nyes pa'i lan yang legs pa yis 'jal ba rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /ma gyur sems can thams cad la/ /brten nas sangs rgyas thob pas na/ /yid bzhin nor bu las lhag pa'i/ /'gro la rtag tu gces par bya/ /gnas shig gang du sdo da kyang rung / /grogs po su dang 'grogs na yang / /rang nyid kun las dma' bar blta/ /gzhan la rab tu gus par bya 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug la sogs pa/ /spyod lam kun tu rang rgyud la/ /brtags nas chags sdang la sogs pa'i/ /nyon mongs gang skyes 'bur 'joms bya/ /rang bzhin ngan pa'i sems can ni/ /sdig 536

sdug drag pos non mthong tshe/ /nam yang yal bar mi 'dor bar/ /snying nas rab tu gces par bya//rang la gzhan gyis gshe skur dang / /g.yo sgyu rku 'phrog la sogs pa/ /byed tshe pham kha rang gis khur/ /rgyal kha thams cad kho la ster/ /rang gis gzhan la phan btags pas/ /re ba che ba 'ga' zhig gis/ /tshur la gnod pa byed na yang / /dge ba'i bshes su blta bar bya/ /mdor na dngos dang yid kyis kyang / /phan bde thams cad 'gro la ster//'gro ba'i don dang sdug bsngal kun/ /dngos dang yid kyis rang la len/ /de dag rnams kyang tshe 'di yi/ /rtogs pa'i dri mas ma 'bags shing / /chos kun sgyu mar shes pa'i blos/ /gang la'ang chags zhen med par slobs/ /ces pa 'di yang slob bu ngag dbang seng ges blo sbyong zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor bris pa'o//mtshan ldan bla ma ni bzhugs dus/ /zhabs tog ci 'grub cig gyis dang / /nam zhig bla ma dang bral nas/ /shi yang 'gyod pa rang mi snang / /chos mthun grogs po tsho yod dus/ /phan thogs gang nus shig gyis dang / /nam zhig grogs po dang bral nas/ /shi yang 'gyod pa rang mi snang / /zas nor longs spyod rnams 'dzoms dus/ /gang yod mchod sbyin du thongs dang / /nam zhig zas nor dang bral nas/ /shi yang 'gyod pa rang mi 537

snang / /sgyu ma'i lus po ni bde dus/ /phyag mchod skor ba la rem dang / /nam zhig sgyu lus dang bral nas//shi yang 'gyod pa rang mi snang / /zhes pa 'di yang slob bu skal bzang shes rab la gdams pa'o//e ma ho/ gnas mchog 'di nyid nyams re dga'/ /tshogs kyi mchod pa dwangs re spro/ /rnal 'byor pho mo dam re gtsang / /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa lags/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'du/ /rdo rje'i glu dbyangs 'brug bzhin sgogs/ /snyan pa'i char ba phyogs bcur 'bab/ /ngo mtshar byin rlabs zhu ba la/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma yod/ /byen rlabs gzhan la re dgos med/ /'o skol rnams tsho'i dga' ba la/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis ster ba la/ /yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs yod/ /dngos grub gzhan la re dogs med/ /'o skol rnams tsho'i dga' ba la/ /'gal rkyen bar chad sel ba la/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong yod/ /bar chad bgegs la nyam nga med/ /'o skol rnams tsho'i dga' ba la/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob pa la/ /gsang sngags smin grol gdams pa yod/ /sangs rgya mi rgya the tshom med/ /'o skol rnams tsho'i skyid pa la/ /bla med byang chub sgrub pa la/ /dam gtsang rdo rje'i mched lcam yod/ /sangs yang mnyam por rgya ba lags/ /'o skol rnams 538

tsho'i skyid pa la/ /bden tshig smon lam 'grub pa la/ /bsod nams tshogs kyi 'khor lo yod/ /smon lam ci btab grub nas yong / /'o skol rnams tsho'i skyid pa la/ /lus ni snang stong lha yi sku/ /mtshan dpe'i gzi byen ya la la/ /ngag ni grags stong tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /gdangs snyan glu dbyangs kyu ru ru/ /sems ni gsal stong chos kyi sku/ /stong gsal 'dzin med hrigs se hrig /phyag gis gar byed khyugs se khyug /zhabs kyis bro brdung khrigs se khrig /'dren 'gug snyan pa'i glu blangs pas/ /bla ma mched lcam mnyes gyur cig /dad gus dag snang 'bar gyur cig /nyams rtogs gong du 'phel gyur cig /rang lus lha sku'i gar bsgyur bas/ /khams gsum dbang du 'du gyur cig /sde brgyad bran du 'khol gyur cig /ci bsam yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig /zhabs bro sa la brdabs pa yis/ /ngan song gsum po stongs gyur cig /srid gsum zil gyis non gyur cig /sa gsum bkra shis 'byung gyur cig /ces tshogs kyi mchod pa'i skabs su rdo rje'i gru dbyangs len tshul 'di yang slob bu 'jigs med rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ngor bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o/ /smin lam dbang bzhi bskur dus dang / /grol lam gdams pa ston dus dang / /rnal 'byor pho mo 'tshogs pa'i dus/ /tshogs 539

kyi 'khor lo bskor dus yin/ /mched lcam dam tshig gtsang ba dang / /cho ga phyag len nges pa dang / /lha sngags ting 'dzin gsal ba rnams/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo skor lugs yin/ /myur du tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang / /sku gnyis mngon du 'gyur ba dang / /don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub pa rnams/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dgos pa yin/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor dus dang / /dpa' bo dpa' mor dga' ston dang / /gcig pur nyams myong skyong ba'i dus/ /rdo rje'i glu dbyangs len dus yin/ /lus kyi rkang bro phyag rgya mjes/ /ngag gi 'dren 'gug tshig 'bru snyan/ /sems kyi lta sgom gsal ba rnams/ /rdo rje'i glu dbyangs len lugs yin/ /dad dang nges 'byung skyes pa dang / /sgrub la brtson 'grus 'byung ba dang / /nyams rtogs gong du 'phel ba rnams//rdo rje'i glu yi dgos pa yin/ /zhes tshogs 'khor dang glu dbyangs len pa'i dus dang /len lugs dgos pa rnams slob bu 'jigs med rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ngor tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//nam yang bslu med bla mar gsol ba 'debs//nam 'chi cha med dran par byen gyes rlobs/ /chos la dad brtson shes rab snying rje che/ /chos kyi snod ldan snying gi slob bu khyod/ /mi tshe cha gsum byas pa'i cha gnyis lhag /yad ma yud la shor ba ma tshor 540

ram/ /lus la sngar med skra dkar gnyer ma sogs/ /'chi ba'i ltas kyang byung ba ma mthong ngam/ /rgan gzhon go rim med par 'chi tshul la/ /bltas na nam 'chi nges med mi dran nam/ /de ring tsam yang mi 'chi'i gdeng med na/ /de lta myur du lha chos mi byed dam/ /na ning lo la nyi ma gza' yis zin/ /nyin gung sa gzhi thams cad smag tu song / /da lo skyabs mgon rgyal ba zhing gzhan gshegs/ /dbus gtsang dag zhing mya ngan gling du gyur/ /'od gsal nyi ma glo bur nyin gung la/ /mi snang yal na gzhan rnams smos ci dgos/ /skyabs mgon rgyal ba sku na phra mo'i dus/ /zhing gzhan gshegs na 'o skol lta ci smos/ /glo bur da lta yin yang 'chi nyen gda'/ /dam pa'i chos la phyi bshol bya mi rigs/ /de ring nangs par gnyis kyi de ring yang / /dben par lha chos bsgrub pa'i dus la bab/ /de phyir skal ldan snying gi slob bu khyod/ /nga min gzhan gyi gros la ma gsan par/ /da lo'i zla ba bcu gcig pa tshun la/ /thogs pa med par gnas chen 'di ru shog /pha yul bdud kyi btson ra log 'tsho dang / /ngan spyod sdig pa'i grogs po rgyang bsrengs te/ /spang gzhongs me tog sna tshogs bkra ba'i ljongs/ /khor yug ri dwags bag phebs rgyu ba'i sa/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin 'du ba'i zhing / /'dzam gling sa 541

yi lte ba gangs ri nas/ /lus la phyag dar khrod kyi gos 'chang zhing / /gang byung ngan ngon zas kyi 'tsho ba la/ /brten nas zab rgya'i gdams pa bsgom nus na/ /sngar med bde skyid nyi ma gsar du 'char/ /zhes pa 'di yang skal ldan slob bu blo bzang sbyin pa la gnas chen gangs ri'i dben gnas dzu 'phrul phug nas smras pa'o//rab 'byams chos kun 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /yangs so che'o chos kyi dbyengs/ /nam mkha'i klong ltar gting mtha' bral/ /mtha' dbus med par khyab gdal le/ /mtha' bral chos dbyengs chen po yi/ /klong na snang ba yangs po byas/ /khyung chen mkha' la lding ba bzhin/ /gu yangs yan pa blo re bde/ /chos dbyengs klong na gu yangs byas/ /sdod pa'i tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /gu yangs rtsed 'jo'i rgyang glu len/ /chos dbyings gnas lugs rtogs rnams nyon/ /lta ba nam mkha'i rlung ltar 'phyo/ /dgos 'dod kun 'byung gu re yangs/ /khyab gdal zang thal gu yangs kyi/ /lta ba yangs po 'di la gzigs/ /'khor 'das kun rdzob gu yangs kyi/ /'bras bu bzang bo 'di la gzigs/ /rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /chos dbyings ngang la gu yangs gzigs/ /sdug btsir gu yangs phyal gyis song / /bu slob rnams kyang de ltar gzigs/ /chos dbyings gzigs mo'i rgyang 542

glu 'di/ /gu yangs blo bde'i ngang nas blangs/ /thos tshad blos byas sdug btsir gyi/ /'ching ba kun las grol bar shog /ces pa 'di yang sems la shar ba ltar bris pa'o//bya bral rnal 'byor ka la piṅga'i bya/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos mkha' la legs 'phur nas/ /shes bya nam mkha'i pha mtha' ma chod rung / /rnam dpyod gshog brgyangs legs bshad dbyangs snyan sgog /mtshan ldan bla ma gser gyi ri bo la/ /skal ldan bya tshogs yun ring ma brten na/ /yon tan kha dog gser du mi 'gyur bas/ /yongs 'dzin gser gyi ri dang 'bral med gyis/ /sems kyi glang gog bde chen grong khyer la/ /skyel ba mi rtag lcag gis ma bskul na/ /la lo'i thang chen dkyil nas lus nyen gda'/ /nam 'chi cha med lcag tshan yang yang thongs/ /'khor ba srin mo'i gling nas nges 'byung rta/ /sprin gyi shugs can zhon nas ma bros na/ /las nyon srin mos gson por za bar nges nges 'byung sprin gyi shugs can zhon la phros/ /byams dang snying rje byang sems rtar zhon nas/ /tshul khrims rnam gsum dkyus thag ma bcad na/ /sa lam thang chen ring bo mi bgrod pas/ /tshul khrims rnam gsum dkyus thag yang yang chod/ /chos kun gdod nas stong ba'i nam mkha' la/ /ngos 'dzin mtshan ma'i lho sprin 543
