'khrigs gyur na/ /mkhyen pa gnyis kyi nyi zla mi gsal bas/ /zhi lhag zung 'brel rlung gis yang yang skyod/ /'khor ba'i mtsho la gsang sngags gru btang nas/ /bde chen thar ba'i gser gling ma phyin na/ /kun mkhyen nor bu myur du ma lon pas/ /gsang sngags smin grol gdams pa'i gru ru zhugs/ /shes ldan khyed kyi sems nyid me long du/ /shes bya'i chos kun gzugs brnyan shar ba la/ /shes chung bdag gis 'phrin yig mi dgos kyang / /shes pa gsal 'debs yin pas nyams su longs/ /tshig gi sdeb sbyor 'thag tshul shin tu legs/ /mdo rgyud man ngag gnad kyi ri mo bkra/ /brgyud pa'i byen rlabs kha tshar ma nyams pa'i/ /sngar med legs bshad lha rdzas 'di nyid phul/ /zhes pa 'di yang slob bu'i mchog gyur lcags zam mkhan po la gangs ri nas springs pa'o//bla ma mi rtag nyi ma dang 'dra'o/ /e 'dra mi 'dra nam mkha' la gzigs dang / /nyi ma nub tshe mi rtag pa dran yong / /bla ma bzhugs dus dad gus kyis sten dang / /mched grogs mi rtag tshong 'dus dang 'dra'o/ /e 'dra mi 'dra tshong ra ru gzigs dang / /tshong 'dus gyes tshe mi rtag pa dran yong / /mched grogs yod dus brtse gdung gis 'grogs dang / /zas nor mi rtag sbrang rtsi dang 'dra'o/ /e 'dra mi 'dra sbrang tshang du gzigs dang / /544

sbrang rtsi len tshe mi rtag pa dran yong / /zas nor 'dzoms dus chos phyogs su thongs dang / /sgyu lus mi rtag zil ba dang 'dra'o/ /e 'dra mi 'dra rtswa kha ru gzigs dang / /zil ba bskams tshe mi rtag pa dran yong / /sgyu lus bde dus lha chos la spyod dang / /zhes pa 'di yang yid la shar ba ltar slob bu blo bzang shes rab la gdams pa'o//na mo gu ru/ dga' ldan lha yi yul gyi/ /ngo mtshar skyed mos tshal na/ /lha mos glu dbyangs len pa/ /mdzes ma'i rang gshis yin rung / /'dod ldan lha bus nyon dang / /sems la nges par phan yong / /stong gsal nam mkha'i khams kyi/ /ngo mtshar chu 'dzin gseb na/ /g.yu 'brug sgra dbyangs sgog pa/ /'brug gi rang gshis yin rung / /mdongs ldan rma byas nyon dang / /sems la nges par phan yong / /'dzam gling gangs dkar te se'i/ /ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul phug na/ /rnal 'byor glu dbyangs len pa/ /rtogs ldan rang gshis yin rung / /dad ldan slob mas nyon dang / /sems la nges par phan yong / /rgyal pos bdag rkyen chen po/ /gnang rung ngo mtshar mi snang / /mtshan ldan bla mas zab rgya'i/ /gdams pa gnang na ngo mtshar/ /gnam la 'phur ba'i bya zhig /zin rung ngo mtshar mi snang / /bla mas gdams ngag 545

gnang ba/ /blo la zin na ngo mtshar/ /ri dang brag gnyis sprad nas/ /'phrod rung ngo mtshar mi snang / /bla mas sems ngo sprad nas/ /rang ngo 'phrod na ngo mtshar/ /sra ba'i shing zhig bkug nas/ /khugs rung ngo mtshar mi snang / /rang sems gyong bo nang du/ /bkug nas khugs na ngo mtshar/ /lcags kyus glang chen smyon pa/ /btul rung ngo mtshar mi snang / /chos kyis bdag 'dzin phung rgan/ /btul nas thul na ngo mtshar/ /rta yi steng du langs nas/ /chags rung ngo mtshar mi snang / /sgom chen stan gyi steng du/ /yun ring chags na ngo mtshar/ /'jig rten pa yi glu dbyangs/ /snyan yang ngo mtshar mi snang / /dam pa'i chos kyi mgur dbyangs/ /'di 'dra blangs na ngo mtshar/ /zhes pa 'di yang nyin zhig sems la shar ba ltar bris pa'o//sprin thag chod pa'i mkha' ltar/ /rig pa sgrib med dwangs gsal/ /bcirngos grol med pa'i gu yangs/ /phyi nang zang thal gyur song / /stong gsal 'dzin med rig pa/ /phyogs mtha' kun dang bral nas/ /ci tsam ma 'gags shar ba/ /de tsam gsal cha che byung / /kha yengs mig yengs mchong rgyug /rnam g.yeng ji 'dra byas rung / /rig pa gu yangs sang nge / /je gsal je brtan gyur song / /bar snang rlung dang 'ja' bzhin/ /rnam rtog snang ba shar 546

yang / /rig pa'i 'char sgo ma 'gags/ /rig stong rgyan du gyur byung / /lus ni g.yo med krong nge / /sems ni rtog med sa le/ /mig kyang 'dzum med hrig ge /mnyam bzhag ngang la lus song / /nam mkhar nyi 'od phog bzhin/ /rig pa bkra yangs sa le mgo btums sangs pa 'dra ba/ /khog yang yangs cha che byung / /nam mkha' dwangs par bltas bzhin/ /rig stong rjen ne ye re/ /gsal 'grib rgyun chad med pa'i/ /brjod med nyams shig shar ro/ /sog phon thag pa chad ltar/ /bdag 'dzin nyon mongs 'ching ba/ /thams cad hrul gyis zhig nas/ /khyab gdal chen por grol song / /rig pa sprin thag chod pa'i//nam mkha' lta bur gyur tshe/ /snying yangs sang nge song nas/ /nyams dga' yal le gnas byung / /zhes pa 'di yang nyams la shar ba ltar bris pa'o//thugs dgongs mkha' ltar yangs pa'i bla mar 'dud/ /thugs yid gcig tu 'dres par byen gyis rlobs/ /skye med chos dbyings ngang las ma g.yos bzhin/ /'gag med grags stong glu yi sgra dbyangs sgogs/ /mkha' ltar yangs shing mtsho ltar gting yang zab/ /nyi ltar gsal zhing shel ltar zang thal le//bar snang dngos ltar ngos bzung gza' gtad dang / /bral ba'i sems nyid mtha' bral chos kyi dbyings/ /rtag mthar ma lhung cir yang 547

grub pa med/ /chad mthar ma lhung sa le hrig ger gsal/ /gcig pu ma yin du ma'i chos rnams 'byung / /du ma ma yin snang sems ro gcig gnas/ /nam mkha' mtha' med bzhin du rang sems la/ /gang nas bltas kyang mtha' med dbus su song / /'di las chen po gzhan na ma mchis pas/ /mtha' bral dbu ma chen mo zhes kyang zer/ /sems nyid stong gsal zang thal klong yangs su/ /'khor 'das chos rnams gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /yongs rdzogs chud cing 'di las rgya chen po//gzhan na med pas rdzogs pa chen po zer/ /sems nyid stong gsal rgyal po'i phyag lta bus/ /'khor 'das yongs la rgya yis ma thebs med/ /phyag rgya zhig la 'di las chen po zhig /gzhan na med pas phyag rgya chen po zer/ /de 'dra'i gnas lugs ngang la mnyam 'jog dus/ /nam mkha' bzhin du sems dpangs stod la zhog /nyi zla bzhin du gsal ngar thon la zhog /bar snang khams ltar gu yangs sang nge zhog /sa gzhi'i ngos ltar rgya yang bskyed la zhog /ri rgyal bzhin du lhun yang phobs la zhog /de ltar bzhag na bying rgod rang sar grol/ /mnyam bzhag nam mkha' 'dra ste 'gyur ba med/ /mkha' ltar ya ngas na mtha' bral lta ba yin/ /nyi ltar gsal na 'od gsal sgom pa zer/ /bu chung 'dra na zhen med spyod pa ste/ /548

mi g.yo ri ltar brtan na 'bras bu lags/ /mdo rgyud man ngag go mtshon mang thogs nas/ /nyon mongs dgra la 'bros pa'i mi de'i ci/ /bla ma'i man ngag mtshon rnon gcig gis kyang / /nyon mongs dgra rnams thul ba'i dpa' bo dgos/ /bde chen thang la yan 'dod slob bu rnams/ /mtha' bral lta ba'i mdung ring phyag tu bsnams/ /sems kyi mkhar bo che yi sgo bkag nas/ /nyon mongs dgra rnams byung tshad cham la phobs/ /gnas lugs stong gsal nam mkha' yangs pa yi/ /nyon mongs lho sprin rab rib dag gyur na/ /snying rje'i nyi ma phyogs ris med par 'char 'gro kun pad tshal skyong ba'i rten 'brel 'grig /stong nyid snying rje gru chen la brten nas/ /'gro kun mgron po 'khor ba'i chu bo las/ /sgol la skyo ngal med par brtson pa yi/ /sngar med rnal 'byor mnyan pa byung na mtshar/ /rang gi rtogs pa glu ru blangs pa 'di/ /bla ma mkhas grub yongs la mchod par 'bul/ /nges don lta ba'i glu 'di thos tshad kyis/ /'gro la phan thogs 'byung bar byen gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang sems la shar tshe slob bu rnams la phan phyir bris pa'o//rgyud byin gyis rlobs pa'i bla ma dang / /mchog dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha/ /rkyen bar chad sel ba'i mkha' 'gro la/ /549

bdag gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs//rje rtsa gsum lha yi skyabs 'og nas/ /sprang skyid pa'i shugs kyis glu dbyangs len/ /rten dal 'byor mi lus rnyed par dka'/ /de yun ring mi rtag 'jig par sla/ /las rgyu 'bras nam yang bslu ba med/ /mar 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bzod par dka'/ /da rang gzhan gang gi don du yang / /yar sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs mdzad dgos//dpe rgya mtsho'i nor bu len pa la/ /gzhan ded dpon ma bsten mi lon ltar/ /yar sangs rgyas go 'phang rin chen de/ /lha dkon mchog ma bsten mi thob pas/ /skyabs bslu ba med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /zhe thag pas skyabs 'gro yang yang gyis/ /dpe zhing la sa bon ma btab na/ /dus nam yang 'bras bu mi 'byung ltar/ /byams snying rjes drangs pa'i byang chub kyi/ /sems ma bskyed sangs rgyas mi thob pas/ /chos kun gyi rtsa ba smon 'jug sems/ /dus yang dang yang du bskyed par mdzod/ /dpe sa bon btab kyang chu lud drod/ /kun ma 'dzoms 'bras bu mi smin ltar/ /sems bskyed kyang bsod nams ye shes tshogs//kun ma bsags sangs rgyas mi thob pas/ /tshogs bsags thabs tshogs chung don che ba/ /de maṇ+ḍal yin pas yang yang phul/ /dpe zhing steng rtsi shing rdo ba sogs/ /kun ma bsal lo legs mi 550

'byung ltar/ /rang rgyud kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung rnams/ /kun ma sbyangs sangs rgyas mi thob pas/ /sdig nyes ltung sbyang thabs rdor sems kyi/ /sgom bzlas pa 'di la nan tan mdzod/ /dpe nor bur mchod bstod ma bkur na/ /nor longs spyod dgos 'dod mi 'byung ltar/ /rje bla mar gsol ba ma btab na/ /nyams rtogs pa'i yon tan mi 'char bas/ /dus rtag tu bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgoms/ /snying thag pas gsol ba yang yang thobs/ /dpe rta bzang med par thag ring gi /yul bzang bor myur du mi bsleb ltar/ /chos bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen ma bsgoms na//yar sangs rgyas myur du mi thob pas/ /snod thams cad gzhal yas nang bcud rnams/ /lha lha mor bsgyur ba'i bskyed rim sgoms/ /lus bde drod sems la nyams rtogs pa/ /kun 'char ba'i rdzogs rim gtum mo sgoms/ /chos kun gyi mchog gyur rdzogs chen kyis/ /sems chos skur grol byed khregs chod dang / /lus 'od skur bsgyur ba'i thod rgal lam/ /de gnyis ka zung 'brel bsgom par mdzod/ /chos zab rgyas myur myur mang na yang / /kun nyams su len pa dka' mor gda'/ /chos nyams su len na mang mi dgos/ /'di ji bzhin nyams su len nus na/ /tshe 'di'am 'chi kha bar do tshun//mchog sangs rgyas thob par rgyud nas gsungs//551

don de bzhin nyams su len mkhan la/ /rje rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin gyis rlobs/ /lha yi dam zhi khros dngos grub stsol/ /ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bar chad sol/ /dpal chos skyong srung mas 'phrin las sgrubs//gegs gol sa med par 'tshang rgya shog /ces pa 'di yang slob bu kun bzang gzhan phan gyis zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis gnas chen gangs ri nas sbyar ba'o//res 'ga' phyi yi yul la ltos/ /phyi yi yul la ma bltas na/ /cir snang sems su mi shes par/ /snang ba dgra ru langs nyen yod/ /phyi yi yul la cer gyis ltos/ /kun rdzob snang grags chos rnams kun/ /rmi lam sgyu ma chu zla bzhin/ /rang gi sems su gtan la phobs/ /res 'ga' nang gi sems la ltos/ /nang gi sems la ma bltas na/ /sems kyi ngo bo mi mthong bas/ /lung ma bstan du lus nyen gda'/ /rang gi sems la cer gyis ltos/ /bltas tshe ci yang mthong ba med/ /rtog tshogs thams cad 'ja' ltar yal/ /lung ma bstan yang sprin ltar dwangs/ /ngo bo mkha' ltar mthong ba la//sems ngo mthong zhes tha snyad btags//mthong ba'i ngang der phyam gyis zhog /de la mnyam bzhag zer ba yin/ /de ltar bzhag pas sems nyid la/ /bde gsal mi rtog nyams myong 'char/ /de la zhen chags ma byas na/ /gegs dang gol sar 552

lhung mi 'gyur/ /mdor na cir snang sems su shes/ /sems nyid stong ba nyid du rtogs/ /stong gsal ngang la mnyam bzhag na/ /e ma rmad byung skal ba bzang / /ces pa 'di yang slob bu mang thang chos rgyal la gdams pa'o/ /don dam bden pa'i dbang du ni/ /chos kun ngo bo skye med stong / /nam mkha' bar snang dpe bzhin du/ /rang bzhin grub pa rdul tsam med/ /sa dang lam gye rim pa med/ /'bras bu sgu dang ye shes med/ /'khor ba dang ni myang 'das med/ /sangs rgyas med cing sems can med/ /bzang bo med cing ngan pa'ang med/ /chos rnams gang yang gnas pa med/ /song ba med cing 'ong ba'ang med/ /don dam dbang du de ltar gda'/ /kun rdzob bden pa'i dbang du ni/ /chos kun rnam pa 'gag med snang / /phreng ba dmag gi dpe bzhin du/ /rgyu rkyen tshogs las thams cad yod/ /sa dang lam gyi rim pa yod/ /'bras bu sku dang ye shes yod/ /'khor ba dang ni myang 'das yod/ /sangs rgyas yod cing sems can yod/ /bzang bo yod cing ngan pa'ang yod/ /chos rnams gang yang gnas pa yod/ /song ba yod cing 'ong ba'ang yod/ /kun rdzob dbang du de ltar gda'/ /chos rnams ngo bo mkha' ltar du/ /stong yang rnam pa 'ja' ltar snang / /rgyu ma'i 553

snang bas bzang ngan ltar/ /'khor 'das bzang ngan sna tshogs snang / /rmi lam skabs kyi bde sdug bzhin/ /bde dang sdug bsngal nyams su myong / /sa bon mngar kha'i 'bras bu ltar/ /rgyu 'bras mi 'chol so sor smin/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar/ / snang bzhin stong la stong bzhin snang / /snang stong gnyis su ma mchis pas/ /thams cad dbyer med zung 'jug yin/ /bden gnyis zung 'jug de ltar gda'/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung dam pa'i chos/ /chos kun rtsa ba bden gnyis lam/ /lam ston bla ma'i drin gyis shes/ /shes tshe kun la phan phyir bris/ /dmag de dmag mi gang las byung / /btsal na dmag de mi dmigs su med/ /phreng ba phreng rdog gang las byung / /btsal na phreng ba dmigs su med/ /sgyu ma rdzas sngags gang las byung / /btsal na sgyu ma dmigs su med//rmi lam gnyid sems gang las byung / /btsal na rmi lam mi dmigs bzhin/ /ngan song mi dge gang las byung / /btsal na ngan song dmigs su med/ /mtho ris dge ba gang las byung / /btsal na mtho ris dmigs su med/ /thar ba bslab gsum gang las byung / /btsal na thar ba dmigs su med/ /sangs rgyas tshogs gnyis gang las byung / /btsal na sangs rgyas dmigs su med/ /de bzhin 'khor 'das 554

chos rnams kun/ /btsal na gcig kyang dmigs su med/ /de yang go mtshon can gyi mi/ /mang bo 'tshogs las dmag 'byung zhing / /phreng ba rdog po mang bo zhig /phyogs gcig 'tshogs las phreng ba 'byung / /sgyu ma mkhan pos rdzas sngags rnams/ /'tshogs las sgyu ma'i rta glang 'byung / /mtshan mo gnyid dang sems gnyis po/ /'tshogs pas rmi lam gsal bo 'byung / /de bzhin bsam ngan mi dge'i las/ /'tshogs las ngan song sdug bsngal 'byung / /bsam pa bzang dang dge ba'i las/ /'tshogs pas mtho ris bde skyid 'byung / /thar 'dod sems dang bslab pa gsum/ /'tshogs las bde chen thar ba 'byung / /byang chub sems dang tshogs gnyis rnams/ /'tshogs las rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung / /de bzhin rgyu rkyen rten 'brel las/ /'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad 'byung / /des na rang sems 'khor 'das kyis/ /bsdus pa'i chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /ngo bo mkha' ltar mi dmigs tshul/ /shes nas zab mo'i stong nyid sgoms/ /rgyu rkyen rten 'brel 'tshogs pa las/ /chos kun rnam pa 'ja' tshon bzhin/ /rang bzhin med bzhin snang ba'i tshul/ /shes nas sdig spong dge sgrub gyis/ /dper na sgyu ma sprul mkhan gyis/ /rdzas sngags bzang ngan sna 555

tshogs pa/ /bsags pa'i rgyu rkyen rten 'brel las/ /lha dang mi yul dmyal ba sogs/ /sgyu ma'i snang ba mi 'dra ba/ /bzang ngan sna tshogs snang ba ltar/ /rang sems sgyu ma mkhan lta bus/ /dge sdig rdzas sngags sna tshogs pa/ /bsags pa'i rgyu rkyen rten 'brel las/ /ngan song mtho ris thar ba sogs/ /bzang ngan mi 'dra sna tshogs snang / /gnyid du song ba'i rmi lam na/ /me chu g.yang la lhung ba'i dus/ /'jigs skrag sdug bsngal snang ba 'byung / /zas gos bud med bsten pa'i dus/ /dga' bde'i snang ba 'byung ba ltar/ /sdig pa'i dbang gis ngan song du/ /lhung nas 'jigs skrag sdug bsngal myong / /dge ba'i 'bras bus mtho ris dang / /thar ba thob nas dga' bde myong / /de ltar rgyu 'bras mi bslu ba'i/ /tshul la nges pa cher bskyed nas/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyi rta glang sogs/ /sgyu ma'i ltad mo snang tshad kun/ /snang la rang bzhin med pa de/ /shes bzhin rdzas sngags sna tshogs pa/ /bsags nas sangs rgyas zhing khams dang / /sangs rgyas byon nas chos gsungs pa/ /la sogs ngo mtshar ltad mo'i rigs/ /sprul nas ltad mo lta mkhan gyi/ /lag nas zas nor sdud pa ltar/ /sems kyi 'khor 'das chos rnams kun/ /rang bzhin med par shes bzhin du/ /snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas su/ /gsal ba'i yi 556

dam bskyed rdzogs sogs/ /ngo mtshar bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ /bsags nas mngon mtho nges legs kyi/ /go 'phang gang yang thob par gyis//nam mkha' lta bu'i sems kyis ni/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i chos rnams la/ /nam mkha' lta bur bsgom byas na/ /nam mkha' lta bur 'itshang rgya zhes/ /thub pas gsungs ltar chos rnams kyi/ /ngo bo mkha' ltar stong bar shes/ /mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /ngang la rtse gcig mnyam par bzhag /sgyu ma lta bu'i sems kyis ni/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i chos rnams la/ /sgyu ma lta bur bsgom byas na/ /sgyu ma lta bur 'tshang rgya zhes/ /thub pas gsungs ltar chos rnams kun/ /rnam pa 'ja' ltar snang ba shes/ /rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i blos/ /sdig spangs dge ba'i las la 'bad/ /chos rnams thams cad stong na yang / /stong ba nyid las chos kun skye/ /snang stong gnyis su med pa'i phyir/ /rtag pa ma yin chad pa'ang min//chos kun stong nyid las byung bas/ /kun gyi rgyu yang stong ba nyid/ /chos rnams ngo bo stong bas na/ /kun gyi 'bras bu'ang stong nyid yin/ /snang bzhin stong la stong bzhin snang / /snang stong rten cing 'brel 'byung yin/ /de bzhin chos kun gcig la gcig /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung 'di mtshar/ /chos kun stong ba nyid 557

du shes/ /stong yang sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin/ /rgyu 'bras bslu ba med mthong na/ /e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /stong nyid lta ba shes tsam gyis/ /rgyu 'bras med par ga la 'gyur/ /phan gnod mngon sum myong bzhin du/ /las 'bras med ces ma smra zhig /stong nyid rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ /lus ni dum bu brgyar gtubs kyang / /na tsha spu tsam mi 'byung na/ /rgyu 'bras 'phrang las thar ba yin/ /rang gi ngos nas mi gnod rung / /ma gyur 'gro la gnod pa shes/ /gzhan gyi don du las 'bras la/ /sngar bas blang dor zhib byed pa/ /theg chen byang chub sems dpa' yi//rnal 'byor pa yi khyad chos yin/ /ngo mtshar bas kyang 'di ngo mtshar/ /rmad byung bas kyang 'di rmad byung / /'gro kun drin can pha mar shes/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub kyi/ /sems dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /don med sdig pa byed don med/ /'on kyang bsad pa gso nus shing / /rnam shes dag zhing 'dren nus pa'i//theg pa chen po'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /'gro la phan phyir bsad kyang rung / /de min chos kun stong bar bltas/ /nam mkha' phan gnod med pa ltar/ /stong ba nyid la phan gnod med/ /sems can bsad chog brdungs chog zer/ /byed rgyu'i dge ba thams cad spangs/ /mi byed rgyu yi sdig pa byed/ /nag po kha 'byams bdud lta zhes/ /558

yi dam phyag na rdo rjes gsungs/ /dngos por lta ba phyugs dang 'dra/ /dngos med 'dzin pa de bas kyang / /blun zhes sa ra ha bas gsungs/ /stong ba nyid la lta nyes na/ /shes rab chung rnams 'phung bar 'gyur/ /rtsa ba shes rab dag las gsungs/ /'phung tshul rin chen phreng ba las/ /yod pa po ni bde 'gror 'gro/ /med pa po ni ngan 'gror 'gro/ /gsungs pas chos kun stong ba ru/ /shes kyang las 'bras ma 'jems na/ /ngan 'gro'i rgyu zhig stong nyid kyi/ /chos la brten nas rnyed pa yin/ /mkhas pa yin snyam ma sems shig /des na chos kun stong bar shes/ /las 'bras bslu med tshul shes nas/ /mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /stong ba nyid la rtse gcig bzhag /rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i dus/ /zhes med sdig spangs dge la brtson/ /thabs shes zung du 'brel ba'i lam/ /lam bzang 'di las gzhan na gang / /gang zag sangs rgyas thob 'dod rnams/ /rnam dag lam bzang 'dir zhugs shig /lung dang rigs pa du ma yis/ /rang sems 'khor 'das chos rnams kun/ /ye stong rtsa bral dngos med du/ /rtogs pa'i mtha' bral chos kyi dbyings/ /spros bral nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa de/ /mnyam rjes gnyis kyi mnyam 559

bzhag yin/ /zab rgyas lam gyi zab mo'i lam/ /thabs shes gnyis kyi shes rab cha/ /tshogs gnyis nang nas ye shes tshogs/ /sku gnyis nang nas chos sku'i rgyu/ /bden pa gnyis kyi don dam gyi/ /bden pa yin pas shes par mdzod/ /bar snang khams kyi 'ja' sprin tshogs/ /nam mkha'i dbyengs las byung ba ltar/ /snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams kun/ /skye med chos kyi dbyengs las byung / /chos kun ngo bo nam mkha' ltar/ /rang bzhin grub pa ma mchis kyang / /rnam pa 'ja' tshon chu zla bzhin/ /stong bzhin ma 'gag snang ba mtshar/ /dper na rmi lam bzang ngan dus/ /bde sdug nyams su myong ba bzhin/ /dge sdig sbyad pas bde sdug kyang / /myong bas las 'bras bslu ba med/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyis bzang ngan gang / /sprul kyang de ltar snang ba ltar/ /sems kyis ci 'dra'i las byas kyang / /'bras bu de 'dra smin par 'gyur/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyis sprul sgyur ltar/ /zhen med sdig spong dge sgrub sogs/ /spyod phyogs rnams la 'jug pa de/ /mnyam rjes gnyis kyi rjes thob yin/ /zab rgyas lam gyi rgya che'i lam/ /thabs shes gnyis kyi thabs kyi cha/ /tshogs gnyis nang nas bsod nams tshogs/ /sku gnyis nang nas gzugs sku'i rgyu/ /bden pa gnyis las kun rdzob kyi/ /bden pa yin pas shes 560

par mdzod//dper na rta rtsal can gyi mis/ /mda' dang me mda' rgyag pa sogs/ /bya ba ci byed rta thog nas/ /ma babs bzhin du byed pa ltar/ /mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu la/ /brtan pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /mnyam bzhag ngang las ma g.yos bzhin/ /mkha' la 'ja' tshon 'then pa ltar/ /blo yi zur gyis bskyed rdzogs sogs/ /rjes thob sgyu ma'i spyod pa gyis/ /dper na rta rtsal med pa'i mis/ /mda' dang me mda' rgyag pa sogs/ /bya ba ci byed rta thog nas/ /sa la babs nas byed pa ltar/ /mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu la/ /brtan pa ma thob rnal 'byor pas/ /mnyam bzhag ngang nas tshur langs nas/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyi sprul sgyur ltar/ /tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong la sogs pa/ /rjes thob sgyu ma'i spyod pa gyis/ /bsod nams tshogs dang ye shes tshogs/ /mthar thug sku gnyis thob pa'i rgyu/ /gnas skabs phan tshun gcig grogs su/ /gcig 'gyur gcig bogs gcig gis 'don/ /de phyir bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ /zung 'brel byed pa bogs che bas/ /mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /ye shes tshogs la 'bad par bya/ /mnyam par bzhag na mi 'dod dus/ /rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu yi/ /bsod nams tshogs la 'bad par bya/ /de la skyo 561

nas mi 'dod dus/ /mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu skyongs/ /de ltar re mos byas tsa na/ /gnas skabs gcig bogs gcig gis 'don/ /mthar thug sku gnyis thob par 'gyur/ /theg pa kun gyi thun mong gi /gzhi lam 'bras gsum mdor bsdu na/ /gzhi yi chos kun lung rigs kyis/ /bden pa gnyis su gtan la 'bebs/ /lam gyi skabs su bsod nams dang / /ye shes tshogs la 'bad par bya/ /mthar thug 'bras bu chos sku dang / /gzugs sku gnyis ni thob par 'gyur/ /gnad 'di 'khrul med legs rtogs na/ /lam la nor gyis dogs pa med/ /dbul bos 'bad pas nor sgrub ltar/ /'bad brtson byas nas sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang thob pa'i gdams pa 'di/ /gang zag yongs kyi spyod yul lags/ /thun mong ma yin rdzogs chen gyi/ /gzhi lam 'bras gsum mdor bsdu na/ /gzhi ni ka dag lhun grub la/ /lam ni khregs chod thod rgal te/ /'bras bu sku gnyis lhun grub 'byung / /gnad 'di 'khrul med legs rtogs na/ /chos ma byas kyang blo bde rnyed/ /rgyal bus rgyal sa thob pa ltar/ /'bad med 'tshang rgya'i gdams pa 'di/ /gang zag dbang bo rab kyi chos/ /kun gyi spyod yul 'di ma lags/ /thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /gzhi lam 'bras gsum rnam gzhag lags/ /562

lung dang rigs pas 'khor 'das chos/ /gang la brtags shing dpyad pa'i tshe/ /nam mkha'i klong ltar rang bzhin gyis/ /grub pa rdul tsam ma rnyed par/ /stong ba nyid du rtogs pa la/ /don dam bden pa rtogs zhes zer/ /stong nyid nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /ngang la nam mkha' ltar 'jog pa/ /mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /skyong tshul yin zhes yongs la grags/ /ye shes tshogs kyang de la zer/ /rgyu rkyen rten 'brel 'tshogs pa las/ /chos rnams sgyu ma rmi lam dang / /gzugs brnyan dri za'i grong khyer dang / /chu zla mig yor smig rgyu dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul ba ltar/ /tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong byed pa la//rjes thob sgyur ma lta bu yi/ /skyong tshul yin zhes yongs la grags/ /bsod nams tshogs kyang de la zer/ /mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /stong ba nyid ni yun ring du/ /bsgoms pas ye shes tshogs rdzogs nas/ /'bras bu chos sku thob pa dang / /rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu yis/ /rgyal sras spyod pa yun ring du/ /sbyangs pas bsod nams tshogs rdzogs nas/ /'bras bu gzugs sku 'thob par 'gyur//mthar thug 'bras bu'i gnas skabs na/ /chos sku thob byar 'jog pa dang //gzugs sku thob byar byed pa gnyis/ /phan tshun 563

'gal ba med pa ltar/ /lam gyi tshe yang bdag gnyis su/ /tshad mar 'dzin pa'i dmigs gtad kyang / /rdul tsam ma lus spros bral la/ /yang yang nges shes 'dren pa dang / /las ni 'di las 'di byung dang / /'di la skyon yon 'di yod la/ /yang yang nges shes 'dren pa gnyis/ /phan tshun 'gal ba med pa dgos/ /de yang gzhi yi lta ba'i skabs/ /bden gnyis gtan la 'bebs pa'i tshul/ /legs par shes la rag las pas/ /lung dang rigs pas 'khor 'das chos/ /thams cad rang gi sdod lugs sam/ /yin tshul rang bzhin ma grub par/ /gtan la 'bebs pas don dam pa/ /rnam par 'jog pa'i tshad ma dang / /dkar nag las kyi rgyu 'bras rnams/ /cung zad tsam yang ma 'chol bar so sor nges pa'i rgyu 'bras chos/ /rnam par 'jog pa'i tha snyad pas/ /tshad ma gnyis ka phan tshun du/ /gnod bya gnod byed phar la zhog /gcig gi grogs su gcig 'gro ba'i/ /tshul la nges pa rnyed tsa na/ /de nas bden gnyis rtogs pa dang / /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag tu/ /rnyed pa'i grangs su 'gro ba yin/ /ma nor las la zhugs so zhes/ /kun mkhyen tsong kha pa yis gsungs//gzhi yi lta ba'i gnas skabs su/ /kun rdzob bden pa snang ba'i cha/ /chos rnams thams cad tha snyad du/ /grub cing las 564

'bras ma 'tshol bar/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba dang / /don dam bden pa stong ba'i cha/ /chos rnams thams cad rang ngos nas/ /grub pa cung zad ma mchis pas/ /bden pa gnyis kyi tshul rtogs nas/ /lam gyi skabs su sbyin pa sogs/ /spyod pa rlabs chen tshogs bsags dang / /stong nyid lta ba zab mo gnyis/ /zung 'brel nyams su blangs pa la/ /brten nas 'bras bu gzugs sku dang / /chos kyi sku gnyis 'thob par 'gyur/ /skyes bu chen po rnams kyis ni/ /thob bya mthar thug 'di lags shes/ /phyag na pad+ma'i rnam 'phrul dngos/ /rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs/ /tshad mar zungs la nyams su longs/ /lta bas zin pa'i spyod pa dang / /thabs kyis zin pa'i shes rab ni/ /dper na snying du sdug pa'i bu/ /shi ba'i mya ngan can gyi mas/ /gzhan dang smra ba la sogs la/ /'jug tshe blo ni ci skyes kyang / /mya ngan shugs des ma btang yang / /blo de thams cad mya ngan gye/ /blo yin mi dgos pa bzhin du/ /zab mo stong ba nyid kyi don/ /rtogs pa'i shes rab shugs drag na/ /mchod sbyin phyag skar bzlas brjod sogs/ /rgya chen spyod la 'jug pa'i tshe/ /de dag dmigs pa'i blo de rnams/ /stong nyid rtogs pa ma yin kyang / /de yi rtsis sam shugs ldan par/ /'jug pa mi 'gal de 565

bzhin du/ /thun 'go lta bu byang chub sems/ /shugs drag bsgom pa sngon btang nas/ /stong ba nyid kyi ting 'dzin la/ /bzhag pa'i tshe na byang chub sems/ /dngos su med kyang de nyid kyi/ /rtsi yis zin pas mi 'gal lo/ /des na de 'dra ba rnams la/ /dmigs pa med pa'i mchod sbyin zer/ /de bzhin thabs shes ma bral bas/ /tshul yang de ltar shes par gyis/ /de ltar lta spyod zung 'brel lam/ /thabs shes zung 'brel nyam blangs na/ /sku gnyis myur du mngon gyur te/ /don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub bo zhes/ /tshad ldan mkhas grub mang bos gsungs/ /tshad mar zungs la nyams su longs/ /zhes pa 'di rnams kyang rang gzhan gyi rgyud la phan phyir sems la shar ba ltar bris pa'o// 'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /ngo bo mkha' ltar ye nas stong / /rnam pa 'ja' ltar 'gag med snang / /gang snang sems kyi rol ba yin/ /sems nyid gnas dang 'gyu ba yi//ngo bo mkha' ltar rtogs tsa na/ /lta ba logs su btsal mi dgos/ /de kha4 lta ba lta ba zer/ /de phyir sems nyid gnas pa'i dus/ /gnas pa'i ngo bor cer gyis ltos/ /bltas tshe stong bar lhag ger mthong / /mthong ba'i ngang la lhod kyis glod/ /sems nyid 'gyu na 'gyu ba'i dus/ /'gyu ba'i ngo bor cer gyis ltos/ /bltas tshe 566

stong bar lhag ger mthong / /mthong ba'i ngang la lhod kyis zhog /gnas 'gyu stong bar mthong tsa na/ /lhag mthong gzhan nas btsal mi dgos/ /de yi ngang la gnas tsa na/ /zhi gnas logs su sgrub mi dgos/ /zhi lhag zung 'brel de la zer/ /mdor na chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /rtsa ba sems nyid stong sang du/ /ye nas gnas pa rjen la phud/ /sa le skyongs dang nyams rtogs 'char//zhes pa 'di yang skal ldan slob bu 'brug chos rgyal la gdams pa'o//'khor 'das thugs su rdzogs pa'i bla mar 'dud/ /bdag sems thugs dang 'dres par byin gyis rlobs/ /sems nyid mkha' las yangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /bya btang gu yangs yan pa blo bde ngas/ /gnas lugs gnyug ma'i ngang nas glu zhig len/ /mtha' bral chos dbyings ngang nas bro zhig brdung / /ye nas khyab gdal zang thal klong yangs pa'i/ /dwangs gsal sems kyi me long chen po la/ /bying rgod rdul gyis gos pa bye dor byas/ /stong gsal zang thal rang mdangs rjen la phud/ /ma yengs dran pa gsal ba'i mig yangs pos/ /sa ler sang nge hrig ger bltas pa'i mod/ /snang srid 'khor 'das gzugs brnyan sna tshogs pa/ /mi srid dgu srid thams cad 'char bar gda'/ /gang shar nyid la 'dzin pa ma byas pas/ /snang srid gsal ba'i 567

rang sems me long gi /gsal stong rang mdangs cung zad tsam ma 'gags/ /gang shar sems nyid rgyan du gyur pa mtshar/ /sems kyi 'char sgo nyi zer rdul bas mang / /'gog rgyu yin na dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ /phyag gis bkag kyang khogs par ngas ma mthong / /'o skol rnams kyis khogs par ga la srid/ /de dag 'gog par 'dod pa'i skyes bu ni/ /byis pa'i lag pas nyi ma 'gog dang mtshungs/ /shar bas mi 'ching de la zhen pas 'ching / /gang shar nyid la zhen 'dzin med pa gces/ /shin tu yangs shing rgya che'i thang chen du/ /ra lug brgya stong mang bo gcal du bkram/ /ched gnyer rtsol bas mi 'gog rgyang so bltas/ /'bral ba med gar skyong ba'i rdzi bo bzhin/ /rang sems skye med chos dbyings klong chen du/ /'char sgo brgya stong khri 'bum gcal du bkram/ /'dzin med khyab gdal dran pas rgyang so bltas/ /gnas lugs 'bral med skyong ba'i rnal 'byor bde/ /'khor 'das ltad mo blta 'dod slob bu rnams/ /chu bur mig gis phyi rol yul rnams la/ /ci tsam bltas kyang ltad mo cher mi mthong / /ltad mo chen po 'dod na sems la ltos/ /bdag gis sems la bltas pas ci yang mthong / /da dung ltad mo sems la blta bar bya/ /ji lta ji snyed chos kyi gzugs brnyan rnams/ /568

sems nyid me long nang du 'char bar shog /ces pa 'di yang sems la shar tshe slob bu rnams la phan phyir bris pa'o//mtshan ldan bla ma yid bzhin nor bu yis/ /spyi bo brgyan nas snyan pa'i glu dbyangs len/ /ma nor mdo sngags chos kyi lam la zhugs/ /sangs rgyas sa ru 'gro 'dod slob bu nyon/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen yid bzhin nor bu la/ /rtag tu mchod bstod gsol ba ma btab na/ /mchog thun dngos grub dgos 'dod mi 'byung bas/ /spyi bor bkur la gsol ba yang yang thobs/ /gtan gyi skyabs gnas mchog gsum mnyan pa la/ /skyabs su bsten cing ci mnyes ma bsgrubs na/ /'khor ba'i chu bo che las mi sgrol bas/ /bslu med mchog gsum mnyan pa gus pas sten/ /rang rgyud zhing sa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung gi /rtsi shing rdo ba ngan pa ma bsal na/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i lo legs mi 'byung bas/ /stobs bzhi'i phyags shing thogs la yang yang sol/ /byams dang snying rje chu bos rang rgyud sa/ /brlan nas sems bskyed sa bon ma btab na/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ston thog mi 'byung bas/ /bla med byang chub sems kyi sa bon thobs/ /smon 'jug sems bskyed sa bon btab nas bzung / /tshogs gnyis chu lud drod gsher ma sbyar na/ /kun mkhyen 'bras bu myur du mi smin pas/ /569

pha rol phyin drug chu lus drod gsher sbyor/ /gsang sngags smin grol gdams pa'i gser 'gyur rtsis/ /tha mal sgo gsum lcags phyer ma btab na/ /phung khams 'jal lus gser du mi 'gyur bas/ /gsang sngags gser 'gyur rtsi yi lag len gyes/ /bdag sems gsal stong yid bzhin nor bu las/ /zab rgyas gdams pa'i dgos 'dod ci yang byung / /nang nas legs bshad gser gyi phreng ba 'di/ /skal ldan bu la ster bas mgul rgyan gyis/ /zhes pa 'di yang dad gtong blo gros mchog mnga' sgar dpon sban tsa lho ba la gdams pa'o/ /dper na sa phyogs gzhan zhig na/ /srin po'am yang na mi rgod cig /yod snyam 'jigs pa skye ba la/ /sa de'i rkang skungs thams cad la/ /srin po 'am ni mi rgod de/ /btsal bas ci yang ma rnyed tshe/ /phyin chad sa der srin po'am/ /mi rgod yod snyam mi skye bzhin/ /nga 'am bdag cig yod snyam nas/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i gnyen po la/ /lus la gzugs drug lhu bco brgyad/ /mgo bo ya thod ma thod gnyis/ /nyi shur phye zhing de las kyang / /cha shas dum bur mang phye ste/ /bshig cing btsal bas nga'am bdag /rang bzhin grub pa rdul tsam yang / /mi rnyed de ka gcig pus kyang / /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i blo ldog 'gyur//gang zag las ni dang po bas/ /thos dang bsam pa shes 570

rab kyi/ /phung bo khams dang skye mched dang / /gzung ba dang ni 'dzin pa la/ /bdag gi dngos po yod med kyi/ /rigs pas brtags shing dpyad tsa na/ /ci yang ma rnyed bdag med du/ /mthong ba don dam gnas lugs te/ /jo bo rje yi zhal snga nas/ /kun nas ji ltar snang ba 'di/ /rigs pas brtags na 'ga' mi rnyed/ /ma rnyed pa de don dam yin/ /ye nas gnas pa'i chos nyid do/ /zhes gsungs lung dang rigs pa yis//dpyad tshe chos rnams ma lus pa/ /rang bzhin med par nam mkha' yi/ /dkyil ltar song bas stong sang la/ /rtse gcig mnyam par 'jog dgos te/ /jo bo rje yi zhal snga nas/ /lung dang rigs pa dag gis ni/ /chos rnams thams cad skye med pa'i/ /rang bzhin med par nges byas nas/ /rnam par rtog med bsgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nyams su longs/ /zhes pa 'di yang skal ldan slob ma yongs la phan du re ba'i blos yid la shar ba ltar bris pa'o/ /drin can bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran par byen gyis rlobs/ /dgung sngon mkha' nas 'od gsal nyi ma yis/ /mi rtag rnam 'gyur bstan nas nub rir yibs/ /bar snang khams nas 'ja' tshon na bun gyis/ /mi rtag rnam 'gyur bstan nas mkha' la yal/ /sa gzhi'i khams nas rtsi 571

shing me tog gis/ /mi rtag rnam 'gyur bstan nas yal 'dab lhung / /dgon pa'i nang nas bla ma khri ba yis/ /mi rtag rnam 'gyur bstan nas zhing gzhan gshegs/ /grwa tshang nang nas sngar 'dris mched grogs kyis/ /mi rtag rnam 'gyur bstan nas phyi mar song / /skyes pa'i yul nas mdza' ba'i gnyen bshes kyis/ / mi rtag rnam 'gyur bstan nas tshe las 'das/ /'di tsam zhig gis mi rtag brda' bstan kyang / /da dung mi rtag 'chi ba mi dran nam/ /lug gzhan gsod kyang 'gal re bag phebs bzhin/ /'chi bar shes bzhin bde bar sdod phod dam/ /gsod sar khrid pa'i mi la rgyan btags bzhin/ /bslu brid nor la ci phyir dga' ba skyes/ /myur du nag can btson nas 'bros pa ltar/ /che bzhag chung bskyur gyis la dben par phros/ /dad zas gshin zas dkor nag dug gi chu/ /sngon chad mang bo 'thungs pa des chog gi /da ni ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /dam chos bdud rtsi 'thung ba'i dus la bab/ /ma byed ma byed tshe 'di blo yis thongs/ /byed na byed na dben par lha chos gyis/ /da lta dam pa'i lha chos ma byas na/ /'chi khar 'gyod kyang thabs med a tsa ma/ /snying 'di phyir phyung bstan yang sha zhig yin/ /snying gtam de bas lhag go sems la chongs/ /zhes pa 'di ni skal ldan snying gi slob bu blo bzang 572

tshe ring dang sde ba dbang bo gnyis la gdams pa'o//rgya mtsho'i gling na gser dngul sogs/ /ngo mtshar rin chen mang na yang / /ded dpon mkhas pas rang gzhan gyi/ /dbul ba sel ba'i nor bu longs/ /rgyal byed tshal na bzang drug sogs/ /ngo mtshar sman bzang mang na yang / /sman pa mkhas pas rang gzhan gyi/ /nad kun sel ba'i sman mchog longs/ /bla ma mkhas grub zhal snga na//ngo mtshar gdams ngag mang mchis kyang / /slob ma mkhas pas rang gzhan gyi/ /don gnyis 'grub pa'i gdams pa longs/ /gang zag phal gyes nyin zhag bcu'i/ /bar du bgrod dgos sa lam yang / /rkang mgyogs 'grub pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /snga dro gcig la chod par 'gyur/ /sa nas mi yis zhag bcu'i bar/ /'dren dgos gdung ma chen po yang / /chu bo chen por bskur tsa na/ /nya ma gcig la chod par 'gyur/ /mdo nas bskal chen grangs med gsum/ /tshogs bsags sangs rgyas thob pa yang / /sngags nas bskyed rdzogs gdams pa sogs/ /bsgoms tshe tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /shin tu bkres pa'i dar seng gis/ /sha khrag rnyed nas za ba'i dus/ /su yis bskrad kyang mi 'gro bar/ /lto ba ma 'grangs bar du za/ /nyi mas gdungs pa'i glang bo ches/ /rgya mtsho mthong nas 'jug pa'i 573

dus/ /su yis bkag kyang mi thub par//rgya mtshor ma thug bar du 'gro/ /skye 'chir 'jigs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /gdams ngaka thob nas bsgom pa'i dus/ /su yis bar chad mi nus par/ /sangs rgyas ma thob bar du bsgrub//'od gsal 'dzam gling nyi ma de/ /shar yang rung la ma shar rung / /gsal ba'i sgon me sbor nus na/ /khang stong mun pa sel bar gda'/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i kha zas de/ /yod kyang rung la med kyang rung / /sbrang dkar rtsam pa za nus na/ /sgyu ma'i lus po 'tsho bar gda'/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de/ /byon kyang rung la ma byon rung / /bla ma'i gdams ngag bsgoms nus na/ /rang nyid sangs rgyas thob par gda'/ /zas nor longs spyod mang yod kyang / /byams pas gnyen rnams ma bskyangs na/ /zas nor yod pas ci la phan/ /yod dus byams pas gnyen rnams skyongs/ /dpa' bo'i dpung tshogs mang yod kyang / /sdang ba'i dgra bo ma btul na/ /dpa' bo mang bas ci la phan/ /yod dus sdang ba'i dgra bo thul//gdams ngag zab mo mang yod kyang / /rang gi nyams su ma blangs na/ /gdams ngag zab pas ci la phan/ /yod dus rang gi nyams su longs/ /go mtshon mang bo ma mchis kyang / /mtshon cha rnon po 574

gcig thogs nas/ /dgra yi sna nas sdod nus na/ /pha rol dgra yang snying rtsa 'dar/ /kha zas mang bo ma mchis kyang / /zhim mngar chang bzang gcig thogs nas/ /mgron po'i sna nas sdod nus na/ /rgyal blon rnams kyang zhal 'dzum ldang / /thos bsam rgya cher ma mchis kyang / /gnad kyi gdams ngag cig thob nas/ /bsgom gyi sna nas sdod nus na/ /sangs rgyas yin yang myur du thob/ /steng phyogs dga' ldan lha yul na/ /yod pa'i ngo mtshar ltad mo rnams/ /rje btsun thogs med la sogs pa/ /mkhas grub phal gyis mthong ba mang / /'og phyogs rgya mtsho chen po na/ /yod pa'i 'dod 'byung nor bu rnams/ /khye'u sbyin pa chen po sogs/ /ded dpon phal gyis thob pa mang / /lho phyogs 'dzam gling sa steng na/ /yod pa'i zab rgyas gdams pa rnams/ /bsgoms nas mi la yab sras sogs/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob pa mang / /phyugs kyi 'tsho skyong ma byas rung / /'bri mar ja la nged tshos rgyag /'bri mang 'jo ba'i 'brog pa yis/ /'bri mar za rung smon rgyu med/ /zhing gi so nam ma byas rung / /sbrang dkar rtsam pa nged tshos za/ /zhing mang 'debs pa'i rong ba yis/ /rtsam pa za rung smon rgyu med/ /thos bsam rgya che ma byas rung / /mdo rgyud glu ru nged tshos len/ /thos pa mang ba'i dge bshes kyis/ /'chad rtsod 575

mdzad rung smon rgyu med/ /'chi med lha yi bdud rtsi 'di/ /rang gi lag na yod pa'i dus/ /dus min 'chi las thar ba'i phyir/ /myur du thungs dang lha min tsho/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i kha zas de/ /rang gi lag na yod pa'i dus/ /bkres pa'i sdug bsngal sel ba'i phyir/ /myur du zo dang gshin rje tsho/ /zab dang rgya che'i gdams pa rnams/ /rang gi lag na yod pa'i dus/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs las thar ba'i phyir/ /myur du sgoms dang chos pa tsho/ /byang tshwa dkar mo sgra che ba/ /mtsho yi nang na chags par gda'/ /kha char bar chad ma byung na/ /zas kyi ro mchog bsgyur bar nges//sman mchog ga bur sgra che ba/ /tsan dan nags na skye bar gda'/ /bser bu'i bar chad ma byung na/ /tshad pa'i nad rnams 'joms par nges/ /sangs rgyas zer ba'i sgra che ba/ /dge ba byas pas thob par gda'/ /mi dge'i bar chad ma byung na/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par nges/ /mgyogs pa'i rta la ma zhon rung / /ga le byas nas song tsa na/ /gnas chen thams cad rkang bas 'khor/ /gye ling rta las mgyogs pa byung / /zas nor longs spyod ma bsogs rung / /gang yod sbyin par btang tsa na/ /nor rdzas thams cad lag tu byung / /gsog 'jog byas las lhag pa byung / /thos bsam rgya 576

chen ma byas rung / /zab mo'i gdams ngag bsgoms tsa na/ /snang ba thams cad dpe char 'char/ /thos bsam byas las lhag pa byung //gser g.yu la sogs rin chen gyi/ /gling du slebs nas bltas tsa na/ /mi dgos rin chen gcig kyang med/ /dgos kyang thams cad len long med/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos la sogs pa'i/ /chos kun zhal phyes bltas tsa na/ /mi dgos chos ni gcig kyang med//dgos kyang thams cad bsgom long med/ /yid bzhin nor bu gcig blangs nas/ /mchod bstod gsol ba btab tsa na/ /dgos 'dod thams cad de las 'byung / /rin chen gzhan kun lon dang mtshungs//mdo sngags gdan kyi gdams pa zhig /thob nas rtse gcig bsgoms tsa na/ /mchog thun dngos grub ci yang 'byung / /gdams ngag gzhan kun bsgoms dang mtshungs/ /ded dpon mkhas pas rin chen kun/ /mthong kyang len khom ma mchis na/ /'dod 'byung yid bzhin nor bu zhig /blangs nas gsol ba 'debs pa gces/ /blo gros can gyes dam chos kun/ /shes kyang bsgom khom ma mchis na/ /sangs rgyas thob pa'i gdams ngag gcig /nyan nas nyams su len pa gces//gdams pa kun gyi mdzod 'dzin pa'i/ /jo bo chen po'i zhal 577

snga nas/ /tshe thung nad mang longs spyod dman/ /dus ngan snyigs ma bar chad mang / /yun ring sdod pa'i mthu med pas/ /snying bo myur du bsdu bar rigs/ /zhes gsungs lho brag mar pa yis/ /deng dus bstan pa'i snyigs ma la/ /tshe la long med rkyen mang bas/ /shes bya'i gshis la ma 'chor bar/ /sgrub pa nyams su longs shig gsungs/ /rje btsun mi la ras pas kyang / /mang bo bslabs las don thog tu/ /dar cig bzhag pa phan zhes gsungs/ /de phyir bsgoms na tshegs chung zhing / /don che gcig shes kun grol gyi/ /gnad kyi gdams ngag nyams su longs/ /bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub nas 'ong / /jo bo chos kyi phyug po dang / /mjal nas gleng mo byas tsa na//mi dgos chos ni gcig kyang med/ /dgos pa thams cad shes byas nas/ /de nas bsgom dgos snyan tsa na/ /shes bya'i mtha' la chod dus med/ /so ma gcig de slob ring la/ /snga ma shes pa mang bo brjed/ /thams cad yid la zin dus med/ /zin kyang kha cig nga rgyal skyes/ /skyes bu dam pa gzhan dag la/ /mthong chung dad gus dag snang med/ /mang bo shes rung snyigs dus kyi/ /sems can tshe thung nad mang bas/ /gang shes thams cad bsgom long med/ /gdams ngag zab mo mang drags na/ /legs legs mang 578

bo bltas bltas nas/ /sems g.yengs sgrub pa byed dus med/ /bsgrubs kyang gcig de bsgrub ring la/ /gzhan ma bsgrubs na e drag bsam/ /bsgrubs pas gang yang 'grub dus med/ /chos gcig bsgom khom ma byung bar/ /glo bur shi na ji ltar bya/ /da lta mi 'chi'i blo gdeng med/ /nges par 'chi brod chos 'dod na/ /mang bo slob 'dod spros pa zhog /mdo sngags gnad kyi gdams ngag sgoms/ /tshe 'di blos btang bsgom nus na//da lta 'chi yang mi 'gyod pa'i//mtshan ma rtags bzang 'ong bar nges//grub thob gong ma'i zhal gsung ltar/ /slob ma rnams la zhal gdams ster/ /bla ma bsten na byin rlabs 'jug /pha ma bkur na mi khas byams//mched grogs mchod na ci bsam 'grub//snyom chung bskyangs na gtam snyan 'ong / /rnam rtog med na 'dre kha khegs//byang sems che na gzhan don yong / /gzhan don byas na rang don 'grub/ /gshis ngan spangs na chos pa yong / /ngo skog med na dam tshig gtsang / /dma' sa bzung na mtho sar bsleb/ /gcig pur bsdad na snang ba bde/ /dben pa bsten na dge sbyor 'phel/ /sbyin pa btang na longs spyod che/ /tshul khrims bsrungs na kun gyes bkur/ /bzod pa bsgoms na gzugs byad mdzes/ /brtson 'grus byas na las kun 'grub/ /bsam gtan 579

bsgoms na lus sems bde/ /shes rab bskyed na blang dor shes/ /sdig pa dor na sdug bsngal med/ /dge ba blangs na bde skyid 'byung / /nyams len byed na mang mi dgos/ /de tsho rgyud la e 'byor ltos/ /zhes pa 'di rnams kyang skabs 'ga' zhig tu sems la shar tshe rang gi slob ma sogs dad can rnams kyi rgyud la cung zad phan du re ba'i blos 'phral du yi ger bris pa'o//na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣa ya/ /chos sku kun bzang longs sku rdo rje 'chang / /sprul ba'i sku mchog thub pa'i dbang bo sogs/ /'gro la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor mdzad pa'i/ /dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal dang de sras rgya bod mkhas grub kyis/ /sngon chad ma gsungs pa zhig brjod rgyu med/ /'ong kyang de dag rnams kyis gsungs pa'i don/ /slar yang glu ru len gyis gus pas nyon/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka'(dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam/)'chi ba myur('chi ba mi rtag pa bsam/)du 'ong / /las bras(las rgyu 'bras bsam/)mi bslu 'khor bar('khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam/)bde ba med/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum(skyabs 'gro/)la skyabs su mchi/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems(sems bskyed/)bskyed do/ /spyi bor rdor(rdor sems sgom bzlas/)sems sku las bdud rtsi babs rang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag par gyur/ /lus dang longs spyod 580

dge tshogs(maṇ+ḍal)lha la 'bul/ /bzhes nas byen rlabs dngos grub bas pa du gsol/ /skyabs(bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms nas gsol ba 'debs pa/)gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /mdun(zhiganas/)gyi nam mkhar sangs rgyas bzhugs par mos/ /de nyid yid la wal ler dran par bya//sems(lhag mthong la mnyam par 'jog tshul/)kyi rang bzhin gdod nas mkha' ltar stong / /stong gsal 'dzin med ngang la mnyam par 'jog /sems kyi(rjes thob sgyu ma'i spyod pa/)mkha' la chos kun 'ja' ltar snang / /snang stong sgyu ma lta bur shes par bya/ /gdos(bskyed rim/)bcas lus 'di snang stong lha skur bsgoms//ngag gis grag stong sngags kyi bzlas pa bya/ /rtsa gsum(rdzogs rim gzhung shing gtum mo/)'khor lo a haṃ gsal btab la/ /bum can rlung gis gtum mo'i bde drod sbor/ /skabs rer 'dun pa drag pos zhing sbyong bya/ /mjug tu bsngo ba smon lam rgya yis gdab/ /tshe 'di blos btang dben par nyams blangs na/ /dal 'byor thob pa don dang ldan par 'gyur/ /dge 'dis skal ldan slob ma thams cad kyi/ /shes rgyud chos la bskul ba'i rgyur gyur cig /yid bzhin nor bu las lhag pa'i/ /gzhan pa'i rin chen zhig mi snang / /mtshan ldan bla ma las lhag pa'i/ /gzhan pa'i 581

sangs rgyas shig ma mchis/ /lha yi bdud rtsi las lhag pa'i/ /gzhan pa'i kha zas shig mi snang / /bla ma'i gdams ngag las lhag pa'i/ /gzhan pa'i zab chos shig ma mthong / /rin chen gser gling du phyin na/ /gser min sa rdo zhig mi snang / /kun rdzob byang chub sems 'byongs na/ /gnyen min dgra bo zhig mi rnyed/ /khyung chen nam mkha' la lding na/ /ngam grog g.yang sa la mi 'jigs/ /don dam byang chub sems 'byongs na/ /'khor bar ya nga zhig ma mchis/ /shel gyi khang ba ru zhugs na/ /phyi nang bar gsum kun mthong yong / /gnas lugs klong du rang zhugs na/ /'khor 'das ltad mo kun mthong yong / /'og min gnas mchog tu slebs na/ /gong na gzhan ma zhig ma mchis sangs rgyas go 'phang de thob na/ /gong na thob rgyu zhig mi yong //zhes pa 'di ni rang gi sems la shar ba ltar slob bu ngag dbang chos grub la gdams pa'o//na mo gu ru/ mtshan ldan bla ma dang mjal nas/ /zab mo'i gdams pa rnams thob ste/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang ba'i/ /bya btang rnal 'byor tsho'i skyid pa/ /gang byung ngan ngon gyi gos dang / /gang rnyed 'tsho ba la brten nas/ /dben pa'i ri khrod la zhugs pa'i/ /bya btang rnal 'byor tsho'i skyid pa/ /'khor 'das rang sems la rdzogs shing / /sems nyid stong gsal gyi ngang la//582

nyin mtshan khor yug tu 'jog pa'i/ /bya btang rnal 'byor tsho'i skyid pa/ /'gro kun pha ma ru go zhing / /chos kun sgyu ma ru rtogs nas/ /'gro ba gzhan don la brtson pa'i//bya btang rnal 'byor tsho'i skyid pa/ /bde bas phongs pa zhig mthong na/ /byams pa tshad med kyi ngang nas/ /bde la 'god thabs la brtson pa'i/ /bya btang rnal 'byor tsho'i skyid pa/ /sdug bsngal nyam thag cig mthong tshe/ /snying rje tshad med kyi ngang nas/ /sdud bsngal sel thabs la brtson pa'i/ /bya btang rnal 'byor tsho'i skyid pa/ /bde skyid 'dzoms pa zhig mthong na/ /dga' ba tshad med kyi ngang nas/ /bde dang mi 'bral bar smon pa'i/ /bya btang rnal 'byor tsho'i skyid pa/ /chags sdang byed mkhan 'dra mthong tshe/ /btang snyoms tshad med kyi ngang nas/ /chags sdang sel thabs la brtson pa'i/ /bya btang rnal 'byor tsho'i skyid pa/ /rang 'dod 'khri ba kun bcad nas/ /gzhan don 'ba' zhig gi phyir du/ /rgyal khams phyogs med la 'gro ba'i//bya btang rnal 'byor tsho'i skyid pa/ /zhes skyid pa'i rgyang glu 'di slob bu blo bzang don grub la gdams pa'o//gong na gnya' gnon gyi dpon med//'dab na rkang 'dren gyi g.yog med/ /dpon g.yog gnyis ka dang bral ba'i/ /rnal 'byor ras pa tsho'i skyid pa//phyi na 'dul rgyu yi dgra med/ /nang 583

na skyong rgyu yi gnyen med/ /dgra gnyen gnyis ka dang bral ba'i/ /rnal 'byor ras pa tsho'i skyid pa/ /nyal na slong mkhan gyi ma med/ /langs na ngu mkhan gyi bu med/ /ma bu gnyis ka dang bral ba'i/ /rnal 'byor ras pa tsho'i skyid pa/ /'gro na bshol mkhan gyi grogs med/ /'dug na 'ded mkhan gyi mi med/ /'gro bde 'dug bde rang yin pa'i/ /rnal 'byor ras pa tsho'i skyid pa/ /khur na mi theg pa'i nor med/ /song na mi sleb pa'i sa med/ /ga le sos dal du 'gro ba'i//rnal 'byor ras pa tsho'i skyid pa/ /rang nyid gar skyid la pha yul/ /su byams pha ma bzhin bsten nas/ /rgyal khams phyogs med la 'gro ba'i/ /rnal 'byor ras pa tsho'i skyid pa/ /las ngan gsog dgos kyi rgyu med/ /nyon mongs slong mkhan gyi rkyen med/ /las nyon gnyis ka dang bral ba'i/ /rnal 'byor ras pa tsho'i skyid pa/ /rgyal khams ma zad kyi bar du/ /lto gos bzang bo yang thob na/ /ngan pa ma thob kyi dogs med/ /rnal 'byor ras pa tsho'i skyid pa/ /sdug bsngal nyam thag 'dra mthong na/ /bdag pas rang gces kyi bsam pas/ /phan thogs gang nus rang mdzad pa'i/ /rnal 'byor ras pa tsho'i skyid pa/ /ri khrod dben pa la sleb tshe/ /'tsho ba dka' thub kyi ngang nas/ /rtse gcig nyams len la gzhol ba'i/ /rnal 'byor ras pa tsho'i skyid 584

pa/ /zhes skyid pa'i rgyang glu 'di ni slob bu skal bzang chos 'phel la gdams pa'o//'brog pa'i 'tsho skyong byed mi dgos/ /rong ba'i zhing las byed mi dgos//rong 'brog gar song yang bde ba'i/ /bya btang ras pa tsho'i skyid pa//nyin par lto gcog kyang mi dgos/ /mtshan mo gnyid gcog kyang mi dgos/ /nyin mtshan gnyis ka la bde ba'i/ /bya btang ras pa tsho'i skyid pa/ /dgong mo nyal phyi byed mi dgos/ /nangs par langs snga yang mi dgos/ /nangs nub thams cad la bde ba'i/ /bya btang ras pa tsho'i skyid pa/ /yod na bgo bsha' rgyag mi dgos/ /med rung gzhan ma gso mi dgos/ /gcig pur bde mo byas sdod pa'i/ /bya btang ras pa tsho'i skyid pa/ /sdug rung skyid pa la mi re//skyid kyang sdug po byung mi dgos//skyid sdug gdam kha gnyis zad pa'i/ /bya btang ras pa tsho'i skyid pa//'gro kun pha ma gnyis snying rje/ /skyid sdug ltad mo la lta bzhin//rgyal khams phyogs med la 'gro ba'i//bya btang ras pa tsho'i skyid pa/ /lha khang bla ma dang mjal tshe/ /gang yod 'brel ba re bzhag nas/ /phyag skor smon lam la brtson pa'i/ /bya btang ras pa tsho'i skyid pa/ /lus kyi mtshams khang gi nang du/ /sems kyi sgrub pa po gnas nas/ /ting 'dzin sgo brgya rang 'byed pa'i/ /bya btang ras pa tsho'i skyid pa/ /zhes pa 'di yang slob bu rgyal ba lhun 585

grub la gdams pa'o//'od dkar zla ba yis gang byed/ /'phepa 'grib mang ba las mi 'dug /gling bzhi bskor ba la chas pa'i/ /'od gsal nyi ma tsho'i skyid pa/ /spang gzhongs ne'u gsing gis gang byed/ /sad ser sdang ba las mi 'dug /dkon mchog mchod gral du chas pa'i/ /me tog pad+ma tsho'i skyid pa/ /khyem pa'i bong bu yis gang byed//dkal las che ba las mi 'dug /rgyal po'i chibs gral du chas pa'i/ /cang shes rta mchog tsho'i skyid pa/ /pha yul gnyen grogs kyis gang byed/ /bsams na sdug bsngal las mi 'dug /dben pa'i ri khrod la chas pa'i/ /bya btang rnal 'byor tsho'i skyid pa/ /khor yug ljon shing gis bskor zhing / /phan tshun me tog gis mdzes pa/ /nyams dga'i ri khrod na gnas pa'i/ /bya btang rnal 'byor tsho'i skyid pa/ /jo bo yab sras kyi gsung bzhin/ /myur lam do ha sogs gsang sngags/ /zab mo'i nyams len la gzhol ba'i/ /bya btang rnal 'byor tsho'i skyid pa/ /bsgoms pas nyams rtogs kyi klong rdol/ /'od gsal rig shes kyi nyams 'bar/ /shugs 'byung glu dbyangs rang len pa'i/ /bya btang rnal 'byor tsho'i skyid pa/ /mi med lung stong na phar la/ /snyan pa'i ḍā ma ru khrol le/ /rtsal sbyong nyams gar rang rtse ba'i/ /bya btang rnal 586

'byor tsho'i skyid pa/ /sems la 'od gsal gyi nyams 'bar /nyams kyi rtsal sbyong gi phyir du/ /sa yi dkyil 'khor 'di gar gyis/ /'gengs pa'i yid smon rang 'cha'o/ /zhes pa 'di yang rang gi sems la shar ba ltar slob ma yongs la gdams pa'o//sems kyi rang bzhin chos dbyengs nam mkha' che/ /chos rnams kun kyang ngo bo de ltar stong / /stong yang rnam pa snang ba rmi lam 'dra/ /skye ba med cing mtha' bral chos dbyings kyi/ /klong las skye zhing klong yangs ngang du gnas/ /chos dbyings khyab gdal klong yangs chen po yang / /yangs dog 'pho 'gyur med pa mkha' ltar gnas/ /gnas med 'gro 'ong med cing bsam brjod bral//don de rtogs na rmad byung skal ba bzang / /rtogs phyir sems kyi gnas lugs gtan la phobs/ /stong gsal bzang thal shel gong 'dra ba de/ /klong du ma gyur bar du sa ler skyongs/ /gyur nas de yi ngang la 'brel med gyis/ /don dam byang chub sems kyi klong yangs nas/ /kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi rtsal sbyongs shig /'di nyid dam pa gong ma'i thugs dam mthil/ /yin pas skal ldan bu yis shes par gyis/ /zhes pa 'di yang slob bu bsod nams stobs chen la gdams pa'o//bla ma la gus sgrub la brtson/ /slob bu mkhas btsun don 587

ldan khyod/ /bla ma dam pa'i gsung bzhin du//lha chos byed na 'di bzhin mdzod/ /grong dgon gang nas ma sdod par/ /rtag tu gcig pur ri la sdod//'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba med/ /thar 'dod nges 'byung shugs drag skyed/ /'gro kun drin can pha mar sgoms/ /byams dang snying rje byang sems sbyongs/ /lung dang rigs pa du ma yis/ /chos kun gnas lugs gtan la phobs /spros bral nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /lta ba'i klong du mnyam par zhog /thams cad sgyu mar shes pa'i blos/ /spyod phyogs rnams la 'jug par gyis/ /de ltar mdzad na tshe 'dir skyid/ /phyi mar gtan du bde bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di ni slob ma mkhas btsun don ldan la gdams pa'o//dad brtson shes rab snying rje can/ /slob bu ngag dbang ye shes khyod/ /lus dang srog la mi blta bar/ /chos shig snying nas mdzad 'dod na/ /gos(spyan snga ba'i gsung /)su bem po mda' stug gyon/ /skom du tshwa med sdor med thungs/ /zas su gye na ngan ngon zo/ /brgya la mi yis mi mthong zhing / /gal te mi yis mthong ba na/ /mig rtsa sha zhan mdog nag cing / /gsang bar lhan pa gyon pa zhig /skyes bu 'di 'dra snying rje zhes//snying rje'i yul du byed pa zhig /da ni lag len mi 'gel ri/ /sngon chad skyid chos byas 588

pa'i 'phung / /da ni skyid chos byed ri shi /za 'dod 'thung 'dod dug bzhin spongs/ /mi la ri dwags bzhin du bros/ /shi la khad pa'i sdug khur tshugs/ /grub thob gong ma'i rnam thar soms/ /'chi ru 'jug pa'i go cha('diyan yin/)bskyed/ /mi med lung stong lha yi zhing / /rang nyid gcig pur lha las skyid/ /ltogs nas mu ges shi yang rung / /ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag bsgom pa las/ /gzhan pa'i bsam rgyu med par gyis/ /zhes pa 'di ni mtho lding bya bral ri khrod pa dge slong ngag dbang ye shes la gdams pa'o//bslab gsum rgyan dang mi 'bral zhing / /'phags nor bdun gyis phyug pa yi/ /slob bu blo bzang dge legs khyod/ /gong ma'i rnam thar skyong 'dod na/ /chos brgyad tshe 'di'i zhen pa thongs/ /chos mdzad yongs la dag snang sbyongs/ /ma gyur 'gro la snying rje sgoms/ /mkha' ltar(phyag na rdo rje'i gsung /)dag pa'i lta ba la/ /rig pa'i khyung lding yan du chugs/ /gser gling bsam gtan bsgom pa la/ /ma yengs rgyun du gnas par mdzod/ /glang chen lta bu'i spyod pa la//'dzin chags med par rol tu khrid/ /sgrub tu med pa'i 'bras bu la/ /brtson 'grus shin tu myur ba gces/ /zhes pa 'di ni tshe blos btang ri khrod pa blo bzang dge legs la gdams pa'o/ / 589

dad pa dam tshig ldan pa yi//slob bu dge 'dun thos bsam lags/ /tshe 'di bla yis gtong ba la/ /nam 'chi cha med dran pa gces/ /zhen pa nang nas bzlog pa la/ /'dod yon nyes dmigs dran pa gces/ /byams dang snying rje'i rtsa ba la 'gro kun pha mar shes pa gces/ /bdag 'dzin 'khrul ba gzhig pa la/ /bdag med gnas lugs rtogs pa gces/ /mu mtha'(yi dam phyag na rdo rje/)bral ba'i lta ba la/ /gdeng gis chod pa shin tu gces//bsam du med pa'i sgom pa la/ /dran pas zin pa rab tu gces/ /blang dor med pa'i spyad pa la/ /bag dang ldan pa rab tu gces/ /thob tu med pa'i 'bras bu la/ /re dogs bral ba shin tu gces//zhes pa 'di ni tshe blos btang rang yul phyogs kyi slob ma dge 'dun chos bsam la gdams pa'o// 'jig rten mi chos rgyab tu bskyur/ /dam pa'i lha chos byed 'dod pa'i/ /slob bu bsam 'grub seng ge khyod/ /snying nas chos shig mdzad 'dod na/ /rnal(gang shar rang grol gyi gsung /)'byor dbang phyug mi la yis//snying rus mthu yis ji ltar thob/ /sos dal skyid chos mkhan rnams la/ /ci 'dra byung 'dug bsam blo thongs/ /las nyon dbang gis skyes phyin chad/ /nam yang 'chi ba mnyam po la/ /chos phyir dka' spyod drag bsten nas/ /myur du shi na mi 590

legs sam/ /bya btang yin zhes khas len kyang / /bya ba med na ci zhig gtong / /yod bzhin btang na bya btang ste/ /khas len don mthun mdzod cig ang / /snyigs dus mi la khrel gzhung med/ /bsags pa'i nor la snying bo med/ /las kyang zin tshar mi 'dug pas/ /kun spangs gtsang ma byed re('di yan yin/)ran//tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang nas//mi med ri khrod dben pa ru/ /byang chub sems kyis kun bslangs nas/ /rang gis gang shes nyams su longs/ /dge ba 'gro kun don du bsngos/ /snying gtam 'di bzhin byas gyur na/ /nam zhig khyod la skyid po yong / /zhes pa 'di ni slob bu dge slong bsam 'grub seng ge la gdams pa'o// slob bu dkon mchog chos ldan khyod/ /sngon chad rnam g.yeng ci tsam byas/ /bzang btung sogs la ji tsam spyad//bsams na snying bo ga 'dra 'dug /tshe thung nam 'chi nges pa med/ /tshe 'di blo yis mi gtong ri/ /ltogs sam 'khyags nas shi yang rung / /lto phyir bsam mno gtong ri shi/ /snyam du zhe mna' yang yang skyol//ja(spyan snga ba'i gsung /)thud sha mar la sogs pa/ /bkra mi shis pa de dag gis/ /khyod la ltas ngan gtong 'gyur gyis/ /sbrul gdug de dag myur spongs la//dpag tshad brgya yi pha rol bros/ /mtshan mo thog thag ro nyal byas//nyin mo'i bzhi cha bza' btung 591

byed/ /bzhi cha long gtam rnam g.yeng byed/ /dge sbyor glog 'gyu tsam byas nas/ /grub thob 'ong du re ba yi/ /khyod kyi brtson 'grus 'di la('diyan yin/)ltos/ /da ni snying nas chos byed na//mi nor zas gsum dug bzhin spongs/ /ri khrod dben pa'i gnas mchog tu//bla ma'i gdams ngag rtse gcig sgoms/ /zhes pa 'di ni slob bu dkon mchog chos ldan la gdams pa'o//gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /skye bo(gtsang ba rgya ras kyis/)tsa na'i shes pa 'di/ /chos kyi sku ru 'dug pa la/ /bla mas bstan kyang ma dgos par/ /rang gi shes su gsha' ba la/ /shes pa(blamazhang gis/)lhod kyis glod pa'i tshe/ /gas pa la rtog pa med pa'i nyams/ /bar snang dag pa'i dkyil ltar 'char/ /de ni 'od gsal chos sku yin//dri med dag pa'i sangs rgyas(mkha' 'gro snying thig las/)ni//rang rig chos sku 'gyur ba med/ /gsal le sang nge wal le ba/ /sprin med ston kha'i nam mkha' bzhin/ /'di(rgyalababyams pas/)la bsal bya ci yang med/ /bzhag par bya ba cung zad med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag lta/ /yang dag mthong na rnam par grol/ /ji ltar(joborjes/)chu la chu bzhag dang / /mar la mar nyid bzhag pa bzhin/ /chos nyid sprod 592

dang bral bar bzhag /bram(sar has/)zer skud pa 'khel ba bzhin/ /rnal 'byor shes pa glod la zhog /'jur bus bcings pa'i sems nyid ni/ /glod na grol bar the tshom med/ /gang yang(ma cig gis/)yid la ma byas na/ /gol sar ltung ba ci las byung / /bsam med sgom pa ma nor na/ /chos sku byang chub the tshom med/ /ces pa 'di ni jo mo ye shes chos 'dzom la gdams pa'o//gdod nas(lhobrag mar bas/)dag pa'i sems nyid ni/ /glo bur rkyen gyis ma bslad na/ /nam mkha' bzhin du 'dus ma byas/ /phyin ci ma log gnas lugs yin//yid la bya rgyu rdul dang bral//bzung du rdul tsam mi dmigs kyang / /man ngag rgyud la goms pa yis/ /tshe yi 'du byed gtong ba'i tshe/ /pha rol phyin pa'i dbyings su thim/ /de la skye ba yod ma yin/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i rang sems 'di/ /na bun rtogs pas ma bslad cig /rje nā ro paṇa chen 'di skad gsungs/ /chos tshul bzhin nyams su len pa'i tshe/ /smyug dong bcug pa'i sbrul bzhin du/ /rtsol ba bral bas lus mi 'gul/ /yid la chags pa'i mya ngan rnams//gnad la phog pa'i zug rngu ltar/ /bya ba btang bas sems mi g.yeng / /sems nyid gnyug ma'i rang bzhin gdod nas stong / /tho bas dngos po gzhom pa bzhin/ /mthong dang reg dang dran pas 593

grol/ /don 'di legs par go bar mdzod//'di ni phyag rgya chen po'i bsgom dbyangs yin//zhes pa 'di ni slob bu lhun grub 'brug rgyal la gad sa pa'o/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//rtogs(rjemi las/)na cir snang sems su 'dus/ /sems la nyin dang mtshan du ltos/ /sems la bltas pas mthong ba med/ /mthong ba med pa'i ngang la zhog /sems(ma cig gis/)la gnyis su ma mchis te/ /blta ru med pa'i tshul du blta/ /bltas pas rang gi sems mi mthong / /ma mthong ba de chos mthong yin/ /mthong ba med pa'i ngang la zhog /mthong ba'i chos nyid don mi rig /de bas lta bar bya ba ni/ /rdul tsam grub pa ma yin no/ /gang yang yid la ma byas na/ /bag chags mi 'byung sa lam rdzogs/ /rang rig snang ba(o rgyanarin po ches/)mtha' yas sku/ /gzung 'dzin bral ba'i sems la ltos/ /snang ba mtha' yas logs na med/ /rang byung chos sku ngo mtshar che/ /ma 'gags rang gsal thugs rje che/ /smra brjod bral ba'i sems la ltos/ /thugs rje chen po logs na med/ /rang byung logs sku ngo mtshar che/ /dran rtog rang grol pad+ma 'byung / /'dzin med zang thal rang la zhog /594

pad+ma 'byung gnas logs na med/ /rang byung sprul sku ngo mtshar che/ /zhes pa 'di ni slob bu grub pa bsam gtan rdo rje la gdams pa'o//bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /kun gyi skyabs gnas bla ma yin/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang(rje rgod tshang pas/)gi sems la cer gyis ltos/ /bltas pas mi mthong dngos po med/ /med pa'i ngang la lhod kyis glod/ /yal le chad de 'dzin med zhog /yang gcig rnam rtog skyes pa na/ /ngo yi cer gyis bzung mdzod la/ /kho rang thog tu glod la zhog /rang sar grol bar the tshom med/ /phyi yi yul la cer gyis ltos/ /rang snang sgyu ma lta bu yin/ /gang shar thog tu 'dzin med zhog /gang(mnyam med nam mkhar spyod pas/)shar sgom du ma shar na/ /gang shes sdug gi snon pa yin/ /gang shar gyi rnam rtog ma dgag mdzod/ /shar ba de'i rjes su mi 'brang mdzod/ /sems de ga'i steng du bskyur la zhog /ma bsgoms pa'i ngang nas ma yengs pa/ /'di ga gcig pus chog pa lags/ /'di don go ba lta ba zer/ /nyams su len pa sgom pa yin//rgyan du skyong ba spyod pa yin//brtan pa thob pa 'bras bu yin/ /zhes pa 'di ni slob ma jo mo zla ba la gdams pa'o//steng nas rtsa brgyud bla ma'i/ /byin rlabs sprin ltar gtibs 595

byung / /bar na yi dam lha yis/ /dngos grub char bzhin phab byung / /de 'og chos skyong srung mas/ /'phrin las glog ltar 'khyug byung / /mdun nas rdo rje spun tshos/ /glu dbyangs 'brug bzhin ldir byung / /snod rnams gzhal yas khang dang / /bcud rnams lha dang lha mo/ /rang snang dag pa don gyi/ /'og min gnas mchog 'di ru/ /lha dang ḍāk+ki mnyes phyir/ /snyan pa'i glu dbyangs len no/ /dga' ba'i gar stabs bsgyur ro/ /skyid pa'i rkang bro byed do//chos sku kun tu bzang bos/ /rdzongs pa chen po'i chos gsungs/ /longs sku rdo rje 'chang gis/ /gsang sngags bskyed rdzogs chos gsungs/ /sprul sku shākya thub pas/ /sde snod gsum gyi chos gsungs/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos bla mas/ /mdo sngags yongs rdzogs chos gsungs/ /sangs rgyas de rnams byon kyang / /gsung rgyu de lhag mi yong / /de la bsam gyen dga' nas//tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i skabs su/ /bla ma'i gces phrug nged kyis/ /gnas khang nyams dga' 'di ru//phyag rgya gar stabs bsgyur ro//zhabs gnyis bro chung 'khrab bo//chos rgyal gnyan btsan ring la/ /dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes/ /srong btsan sgam po'i ring la/ /dam pa'i chos kyi srol 596

btod/ /khri srong sde'u btsan ring la/ /dam chos dar zhing rgyas song / /da lta snyigs ma'i dus 'dir/ /skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bus/ /mi nub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ /srid pa'i rtse mor bsgrengs byung / /dbu 'phang srid mtha'i bar du/ /nam yang nyams pa mi snang / /bsam gyen dga' nas nged tsho/ /rin chen gzhal med khang 'dir//nyams dga'i glu dbyangs len bzhin/ /skyid pa'i bro gar 'khrab bo//slob dpon pad+ma byon nas/ /bstan pa'i sgon me sbar song / /bod yul mun pa'i gling 'di/ /'phags yul las kyang gsal byung //jo bo chen po byon nas//bstan pa sngar bas gsal song / /mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pas/ /gangs can ljongs rnams khengs byung / /blo bzang yab sras byon nas/ /bstan pa ches cher 'bar song / /ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i tshogs kyis/ /sa steng thams cad khyab byung / /mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla mas/ /'gro la chos 'khor bskor song / /slob ma yon bdag tshogs la/ /bde skyid snyan gsum 'dzoms byung / /de la bsam gyin dga' ston/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor nas/ /chos grogs rdo rje spun tsho/ /nyams dbyangs bro gar byed do//mi la yab sras byon nas/ /sgrub brgyud bstan pa dar 597

song / /ras dkar can gyes mkha' spyod/ /zhing du lam chen btod byung / /'brug pa yab sras byon nas/ /sgrub brgyud bstan pa bzung song / /bya rgod nyin lam bco brgyad/ /sangs rgyas bstan pas khyab byung / /rtsa ba'i bla ma byon nas/ /bdag cag rjes su bzung song / /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing / /sems can bde la 'khod byung / /de la bsam gyin dga' nas/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su/ /dam gtsang mched grogs nged tsho/ /glu len gar byed bro rdung //sa skya paṇa chen byon nas/ /bstan pa bye dor byas song / /phyi rol ma rtogs log rtog /the tshom thams cad chod byung / /rjes 'jug mang bo byon nas/ /bstan pa rin chen spel song / /sa skya gong ma'i snyan pas/ /'dzin ma'i khyon kun khyab byung / /dpal ldan bla ma byon nas/ /zab rgyas gdams pa bstan song / /skal bzang slob ma'i rgyud la/ /nyams rtogs yon tan 'khrungs byung / /de la bsam gyen dga' nas/ /mched grogs rdo rje spun tsho/ /rang snang dag pa'i zhing 'dir/ /dgyes rgu'i gar gyis rol lo/rin chen gser gyi gling du/ /phyin na sa rdo med bzhin/ /snod rnams dag zhing gzhal yas/ /bcud rnams lha dang lha 598

mo/ /sgra rnams gsang sngags chos 'khor/ /dran rtog thugs kyi rang bzhin/ /rang snang dag pa don gyi/ /'og min gnas mchog nyams dga'/ /ngo mtshar gzhal med khang du/ /yi dam lha yi gsal snang / /nga rgyal brtan po'i ngang nas/ /skal ldan rdo rje'i spun tsho/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor phyir/ /rdo rje'i glu dbyangs len no/ /thar ba'i sgo mo 'byed phyir/ /phyag rgya mkha' la bsgyur ro/ /ngan song sgye sgo gcod phyir/ /zhabs bro sa la brdabs so/ /'dir tshogs yon bdag yongs la/ /nam yang skyid po shog shog /bla ma lha dang ḍāk+kis/ /byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir/ /dad can yon bdag pho mos/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor byung / /rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtshos/ /'dir tshogs yon bdag rnams kyi/ /tshe 'di'i bar chad sol la/ /mchog thun dngos grub stsol cig /gtan gyi spun grogs nged tsho/ /gnas khang nyams dga' 'di ru/ /bde legs bkra shis 'byung phyir/ /glu len gar byed bro rdung / /zhabs gnyis bro rdung 'khrab tshe/ /res 'ga' mtho mtho zer byung / /mtho mtho zer na dkon mchog /dbu 'phang mtho bar gyur cig /g.yas kyi zhabs bro 'khrab tshe/ /res 'ga' dar dar zer byung / /dar dar zer nas sangs rgyas/ /bstan pa dar bar gyur cig /g.yon gye zhabs bro 599

'khrab tshe/ /res 'ga' brtan brtan zer byung / /brtan brtan zer na 'dir tshogs//sku tshe brtan par gyur cig /chos grogs rdo rje'i spun tsho/ /gnas 'dir sprin bzhin 'dus byung / /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i longs spyod/ /'bad med char bzhin babs byung / /sku gzugs 'ja' ltar mdzes shing / /gnas khang mkha' ltar yangs byung / /phyag rgya glog ltar 'khyug bzhin/ /glu dbyangs 'brug bzhin bsgrags byung / /snod rnams dag zhing gzhal yas/ /bcud rnams lha dang lha mo/ /rang snang dag pa don gyi/ /'og min zhing khams 'di ru/ /bla ma lha dang ḍāk+kir/ /skal ba mnyam pa'i phyir du/ /gsol ba yang yang 'debs so/ /skal ba mnyam par gyur cig /'og min zhing khams de na bzhugs pa'i/ /drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen de yis/ /rjes 'jug rdo rje'i spun grogs nged tshor/ /ngo mtshar byen rlabs dngos grub stsol cig /rdo rje 'chang gi bu rgyud nged tshos/ /rdo rje'i glu dbyangs len pa shes so/ /phyag rgya gar stabs bsgyur ba shes so/ /zhabs bro sa la brdabs pa shes so/ /rnga yab pad+ma 'od na bzhugs pa'i/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas de yis/ /rjes 'jug rdo rje'i spun grogs nged tshor/ /ngo mtshar byen rlabs dngos grub stsol cig /600

slob dpon pad+ma'i bu rgyud nged tshos/ /rdo rje'i glu dbyangs len pa shes so/ /phyag rgya gar stabs bsgyur ba shes so/ /zhabs bro sa la brdabs pa shes so/ /spyi gtsug pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de yis/ /rjes 'jug rdo rje'i spun grogs nged tshor/ /ngo mtshar byen rlabs dngos grub stsol cig /mtshan ldan bla ma'i gces phrug nged kyis/ /rdo rje'i glu dbyangs len pa shes so/ /phyag rgya gar stabs bsgyur ba shes so/ /zhabs bro sa la brdabs pa shes so/ /sangs rgyas sa la 'gro ba'i lam bzang / /rdo rje'i theg pa'i nye lam 'di la/ /'dod yon ma spangs rgyan du rol bzhin/ /bde nas bde bar 'gro ba ngo mtshar/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs kun tu/ /lam bzang 'di dang 'bral ba med cing / /lam gyi gnas skabs glu dbyangs gar byas/ /sangs rgyas sa ru 'gro bar gyur cig /ces pa 'di rnams tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i skabs rnams su blangs na snyam nas bris pa'o//'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba med/ /sdug bsngal chu bo'i gnyer ma 'dra/ /snga ma ma sangs phyi ma 'byung / /'di la sangs pa'i dus mi gda'/ /ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal de/ /cung zad tsam yang bzod par dka'/ /lha mi'i bde skyid mi rtag 'gyur/ /skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal mang / /'khor ba'i gnas 601

'dir mtho dman bar/ /gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gnas/ /'dod yon gang la longs spyod kyang / /nyon mongs sdug bsngal 'phel ba'i rgyu/ /sdug bsngal nyam thag sems can rnams/ /pha mar ma gyur gcig kyang med/ /pha ma sems can 'di kun gyis/ /sdug bsngal myong ba snying re rje/ /sangs rgyas grangs med sngar byon kyang / /'gro kun las ngan tshan che bas/ /skyob pa'i skal ba med par gzigs/ /yal bar dor nas zhing gzhan gshegs/ /rang la da lta'i gnas skabs su/ /'gro kun skyob pa'i nus pa med/ /skyabs med sems can snying re rje/ /kye ma kye hud ji ltar bya/ /bu chus khyer ba'i lag rdum mas/ /gnyen kun rogs su spron pa ltar/ /phongs pa'i gnyen gcig sbyan ras gzigs/ /khyod ni 'gro ba'i don la bskul/ /bdag gi pha ma sems can gyi/ /skyid sdug bcol lo khyed rang mkhyen/ /khyed min re sa gzhan na med/ /byang chub ma thob bar du skyongs/ /bdag kyang khyed kyi thugs rje la//brten nas myur du sangs rgyas te/ /ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar/ /khyed bzhin 'gro don byed par shog /khyed la gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /bdag ni gar gnas sa phyogs su/ /nad dang mu ge med pa dang / /chos dang bkra shis 'phel bar shog /ces pa 'di ni snying rje sgom pa'i skabs shig tu 602

yid la shar ba ltar bris pa'o//rang la na tsha 'byung ba'i dus/ /'jig rten khams na 'di 'dra ba'i/ /nad pa bsam gyis mi khyab yod/ /de dag thams cad snying re rje/ /de kun sdug bsngal rang nyid kyis/ /blangs nas kun gyi sdug bsngal rgyun/ /gcad par bya'o snyam du bsgoms/ /dbugs de phar la gtong ba'i dus/ /rang las 'od zer dpag med 'phros/ /nad pa rnams kyi lus sems la/ /zhugs pas bde bas tshim par mos/ /dbugs de tshur la len pa'i dus/ /khab len rdo yis lcags blangs bzhin/ /'od des nad pa thams cad kyi/ /nad rnams thams cad 'ub kyis bsdus/ /rang nyid na ba'i steng du spungs/ /de nas nad 'don bya tshul ni/ /rang nyid gang na na ba'i sar/ /bug pa zang thal yod par bsgoms/ /dbugs de nang du len pa'i dus/ /nad kun bug sgo'i phyogs su bsdus/ /dbugs de phar la gtong ba'i dus/ /na tsha thams cad bug sgo nas/ /phyi ru thon nas bar snang la/ /yal nas nad dang bral bar mos/ /yang na na sar a dkar bsgoms/ /a las 'od 'phros na tsha kun/ /'ub kyis bsdus nas a la thim/ /a de je chung je chung du/ /song nas rim gyis yal bar mos/ /rang nyid na ba la brten nas/ /kun gyi 603

natsha rgyun gcod pa'i/ /thabs mkhas gnad kyi zhal gdams 'di/ /skal ldan bu yi sems la chongs/ /de ltar byas na rang nyid kyi/ /nad drag dngos sam brgyud nas kyang / /sems can rnams la phan thogs nas/ /rang gzhan thams cad bde bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin byed pa'i chos pa de/ /na yang dge sbyor yin pas na/ /na ba'i dus su dge sbyor gzhan/ /chag song snyam du ma sems shig /ces pa 'di ni bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho na ba'i dus su smras pa'o//e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /na tsha byung na 'di ltar gyis/ /pha mar ma gyur su yang med/ /'di ltar na tshad snying re rje/ /snyam du 'gro ba'i na tsha kun/ /rang gi thog tu yang yang spungs/ /de nas spyi bor rdor sems bsgoms/ /sku las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs/ /nad dang sdig sgrib kun dag nas/ /rang lus dwangs gsal 'od phung du/ /gyur par mos la yig brgya bzlos/ /yang na lte bar nyi dkyil bsgoms/ /de'i steng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa las/ /me 'bar nad dang sdig sgrib bsregs/ /me dpung cher 'bar lus kyang 'tshig /me yang yal nas stong bar gyur/ /stong ba'i ngang las skad cig gis/ /rang nyid yi dam lha bu bzhengs/ /grag stong sngags kyi bzlas pa bya/ /yang na rang gi snying ga ru/ /hūṃ yig mthing nag me 'bar bsgoms/ /ngag nas 604

hūṃ zhes brjod pa'i tshe/ /hūṃ yig de las hūṃ mang 'phros/ /lus kun phar thal tshur thal phug /nad pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dang / /lus po bcas te rdul du brlag /hūṃ yang gcig la gcig thim nas/ /gcig po de yang yal nas stong / /stong ba'i ngang la mnyam par zhog /'di ni na tsha byung dus su/ /dge sbyor byed pa'i man ngag yin/ /de ltar byas na nad kyang drag /bsod nams dpag med 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di ni slob bu mkhas grub na ba la gdams pa'o//tshe rabs 'khor bar thog ma ma mchis pa'i/ /rang gi pha mar ma gyur sems can med/ /sems can bzang ngan 'bring gsum su mthong yang / /drin can pha ma yin soms phan sems sbyongs/ /mngon shes med phyin bzang ngan mi shes pas/ /chos pa rab 'bring tha gsum su mthong yang / /bzang ngan ma 'byed rang gzhan 'khor ba las/ /sgrol ba'i bshes gnyen yin soms dag snang sbyongs/ /skyon gcig mi 'gog yon tan sna gcig tsam/ /mi bskyed zer ba'i chos ni gcig kyang med/ /de phyir chos lugs grub mtha' mang mchis kyang / /kun gyis 'gro la phan soms dag snang sbyongs/ /rgyun du chos kun rtsa ba sems la ltos/ /legs par brtags na gzhi med stong ba nyid/ /bar 605

snang khams ltar ngos bzung gza' gtad med/ /gnas lugs de ga'i ngang la ma yengs zhog /slar yang byeng rmugs 'phro rgod gang byung yang / /sngon bsu rjes gcod gang yang mi byed par/ /sngar bltas sems kyi gnas lugs ngang la zhog /gcig shes kun grol gnad kyi gdams pa lags/ /rjes thob skabs su snang grag chos rnams kun/ /sems nyid stong ba'i rol bar shes pa dang / /kun kyang snang stong sgyu ma lta bur ltos/ /de yi ngang nas chos spyod thams cad gyis/ /zhes pa 'di ni dad gtong blo gros che ba'i yon bdag dpal le la gdams pa'o// nam 'chi cha med tshe 'di blo yis thongs/ /dman pa'i sa bzung hrul bo'i gos gyon nas/ /bod kyi lha skal spyan ras gzigs dbang sgoms/ /chos kyi snying bo yi ge drug ma bgrongs/ /rgyun du ma yengs rang gi sems la ltos/ /bltas pa'i tshe na dbyibs dang kha dog med/ /sems kyi rang bzhin gdod nas nam mkha' 'dra/ /de yi ngang la gtang bzhag med par glod/ /bar snang dngos ltar ngos bzung gza' gtad dang / /bral ba'i zang thal 'dzin med ngang la zhog /rjes thob skabs su rang lus snod bcud kun/ /snang stong sgyu ma tsam du shes par gyis/ /de ltar ma rtogs 'gro la snying rje sgoms/ /606

chags sdang med par kun la phan thogs kyis/ /de ltar byas na tshogs rdzogs sgrib byang nas/ /myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di ni chos la snying rus sdug bsran che ba'i slob ma jo mo dam chos sgrol ma la gdams pa'o//rgyun du ma yengs rang gi sems la ltos/ /mthong rgyu med pa'i ngang la mnyam par zhog /gang shar rnam rtog ngo bor cer gyis ltos/ /rang sar yal ba'i ngang la mnyam par zhog /gang snang chos rnams stong bar gtan la phobs/ /snang stong 'dzin med ngang du mnyam par zhog /na ba'i dus su ngo bo cer gyis ltos/ /ngos bzung med pa'i ngang du mnyam par zhog /bying rgod 'ong snyam sdug btsir byed pa'i dus/ /byed mkhan stong bar nges pa'i ngang la zhog /bsgom yod snyam dus sgom rngo 4khan gtan la phobs/ /bsgom med yengs med ngang du mnyam par zhog /snang ba gu dog sgom gyis sun pa'i dus/ /shes pa rgya bskyed dpangs bstod phyal yas thongs/ /gzung 'dzin blo yi gtad so kun bshig la/ /gtad med klong du gu yangs yan par zhog /mdor na bsgom la mu ge ma yong bar/ /gang snang gang shar chos sku'i yo langs gyis/ /lung rigs dpyad pas skya rengs shar tsa na/ /stong nyid nam mkha' mtha' nas langs par 'gyur/ /mnyam 607

gzhag thang ma phyogs bcur brdal tsa na/ /bag chags shog dril 'dra ba thang chod 'gyur/ /kun khyab mnyam bzhag mig 'bur gsal tsa na/ /'khor 'das ltad mo shugs kyis mthong bar 'gyur/ /snang srid sems kyi rol bar shar tsa na/ /srid zhi spang blang bral ba'i rnal 'byor yong / /ma rtogs 'gro la snying rje skyes tsa na/ /phan sems ngang ngam shugs kyis skye bar 'gyur/ /stong nyid snying rje gnyis po 'byongs tsa na/ /srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /chos kyi snying bo stong nyid snying rje yin/ /snying bo 'di gnyis rgyun du nyams su longs/ /zhes pa 'di ni slob bu bstan 'dzin 'gyur med la gdams pa'o/ / 'jig rten pa rnams phan zhig 'dogs pa la/ /lha zer gnod pa byed la 'dre zer bzhin/ /sems can rnams kyis rang la phan 'dogs pas/ /thams cad lha yin snyam du dag snang sbyongs/ /gnod pa byas kyang bzod pa bsgoms gyur na/ /tshe 'dir gtam snyan thos shing lha mis bkur/ /phyi mar mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i lus thob 'gyur/ /gnod min phan thogs yin soms dag snang sbyongs/ /chos kun rnam pa bzang ngan ltar snang yang / /ngo bo stong nyid ngang la bzang ngan mnyam/ /mnyam par ma zad mi bzang gcig kyang med/ /bzang ngan ma 'byed 608

kun la dag snang sbyongs/ /snang tshad me long bltas na de 'dra mthong / /me long skyon min rang skyon shar ba bzhin/ /gzhan skyon mthong ba rang gi skyon yin pas/ /gzhan skyon ma yin snyam du dag snang sbyongs/ /log lta byas na lha yang bdud du 'bab/ /dag snang che na bdud kyang lha ru 'gyur/ /de phyir bzang ngan snang ba gang la yang / /log lta ma byed phyogs med dag snang sbyongs/ /mdor na phyi snod dag zhing gzhal yas khang / /nang bcud sems can lha dang lha mor mos/ /tshur la gang sbyin lha yis gnang bar sgoms/ /phar la byin tshad lha la phul bar soms/ /de ltar byas na sgrib dag tshogs rdzogs nas/ /skabs shig gang du sdod kyang dag pa'i zhing / /su dang 'grogs kyang lha dang lha mor 'char/ /ci 'dod dngos grub thams cad ster bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di ni slob bu bsod nams snyan grags la gdams pa'o/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir rgyal ba sras bcas kyis/ /bzang ngan sna tshogs tshul bzung 'gro don mdzad/ /mngon shes med par sangs rgyas sems can ni/ /su yin mi shes snyam du dag snang sbyongs/ /sems can rnams la mtha' yas mu med bzhin/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos kyang grangs med gsungs/ /de phyir chos lugs grub mtha' mang mchis kyang / /sangs rgyas gsung 609

yin snyam du dag snang sbyongs/ /mdor na mngon shes thogs med ma thob bar/ /gang la brnyas smod khyad gsod sun 'byin dang //bzang ngan 'dor len gang yang ma byed par/ /chos dang gang zag yongs la dag snang sbyongs/ /sbyangs na sdig sgrib nyes ltung kun 'gag cing / /khyad par chos spong nyes pas gos mi 'gyur/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub gang bsgrubs kyang / /tshegs med 'grub pa'i gnad cig 'di na snang / /de phyir nga yi rjes 'jug bu slob dang / /gzhan yang chos pa yongs la snying gtam tu/ /chos dang gang zag yongs la dag snang rang / /sbyongs zhes tshogs drug rang grol gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa 'di ni slob ma chos mdzad yongs la smras pa'o/ /bde ldan zhing gi chos sku snang mtha' yas/ /gangs can ljongs 'dir gdu' bya rnams kyi ngor/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i gar gyes rnam rol ba/ /paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes zhal snga nas/ /dbus gtsang mnga' ris bar gyi grub pa'i mtha'/ /kun kyang rgyal bstan kho na yin pas na/ /phyogs lhung gdon gyi sdang shugs ma mdzad par/ /dag snang nor bu'i 'od kyis khyab na legs//zhes gsungs pa ltar chos lugs thams cad la/ /ris su ma chad phyogs med dag snang sbyongs/ /rang lugs 'di bzang chos lugs gzhan 610

rnams ngan/ /de 'dzin gang zag rnams kyang gti mug ces/ /smod pa mdo las gsungs pa'i chos spong las//'bras bu mi bzad sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i rgyu/ /yin phyir srog la bab kyang ma byed ces/ /kun la thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa 'di yang slob ma yongs la gdams pa'o/ /chos kun gnas lugs stong nyid du mngon sum/ /gzigs pa'i bla ma snying dbus su bzhugs shig /mtshan ldan bla mar gsol ba rang 'debs bzhin/ /lung dang rigs pas yang yang du dpyad tshe/ /rang sems 'khor 'das chos kun gyi gnas lugs/ /ye stong rtsa bral dngos med du rtogs song / /stong sang nam mkha' lta bu yi ngang nas/ /'jog pa'i bya btang rnal 'byor nga'i skyid pa/ /mnyam bzhag thang ma phyogs bcu ru brdal bas/ /sdug bcir 'ching ba lhod grol la langs song / /byeng rmugs 'phro rgod gtan med du sangs nas/ /gsal 'grib med pa'i mnyam bzhag 'di skyid do/ /lhag mthong nam mkha' mtha' nas rang langs tshe/ /nyon mongs mun pa sdod dbang zhig ma byung / /'od gsal nyi ma snying dbus su shar tshe/ /dga' bde'i drod kyis lus sems kun khyab byung / /rjes thob sgyu ma'i ting 'dzin la sbyangs tshe/ /las 'bras mi bslu'i nges pa zhig rnyed song / /de ltar ma 611

rtogs nyam thag gi 'gro la/ /sngar bas lhag pa'i snying rje zhig skyes byung / /stong nyid snying rje'i chang gis rang bzi tshe/ /glu dbyangs 'di 'dra rang shugs kyis thon song / /nyams len bzang bo de 'dra zhig gyis dang / /nyams rtogs bzang bo rim pa byas skyes yong / /de 'dra'i glu dbyangs snyan mo de 'then mkhan/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol kho yin snang / /zhes pa 'di ni rang gi nyams la shar tshe skal ldan gyi slob bu sman bla bstan 'dzin la gdams pa'o/ /dad pa nor bu rin po cher/ /dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gtong ba btsun mo rin po ches/ /zas nor longs spyod gang 'dod ster/ /tshul khrims 'khor lo rin po che/ /mngon mtho nges legs gnas rnams 'khor/ /thos pa blon po rin po ches/ /blang dor gnas rnams gsal bar ston/ /khrel yod glang bo rin po ches/ /bzang ngan thams cad gong du khur/ /ngo tsha rta mchog rin po ches/ /rang gzhan bde ba'i gnas su skyel/ /shes rab dmag dpon rin po ches/ /log rtog dgra yi g.yul ngo 'joms/ /ston pa 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi/ /chos kyi rgyal srid 'dzin pa'i bu/ /'phags nor rgyal srid sna bdun 'di/ /med na rgyal sa mi zin pas/ /'phags pa'i mdzod nas legs thon pa'i/ /ngo mtshar rgyal srid sna bdun 'di/ /chos pa bzang bo'i phyag brgyud 612
