nas/ /da lta bdag gi lag tu byung / /da ni skal ldan slob bu la/ /'phangs pa med par ster bar bya/ /chos kyi rgyal srid skyong 'dod na/ /'di rnams rtag tu bsten par mdzod/ /ces pa 'di ni spu grengs bshad 'phel gling gi skal ldan slob bu dbu mdzad blo bzang dar rgyas la gdams pa'o/ /sems(dri med bshags rgyud lag/)kyi rang bzhin chos dbyengs nam mkha' che/ /chos rnams rnam dag ye nas 'od gsal zhing / /rnal 'byor nyid dbyings smra bsam las 'das pa/ /mnyam nyid byang chub sems la rtag tu 'dud/ /sems(slob dpon dga' rab rdo rjes/)kyi rang bzhin ye nas sangs rgyas te/ /sems la skye 'gag med pas nam mkha' 'dra/ /chos kun mnyam nyid yang dag don rtogs nas/ /de nyid ma btsal bzhag na sgom pa yin/ /sems(te lo bas/)ni nam mkha' bsam pa'i yul las 'das/ /de yi ngang la gtang bzhag med par glod/ /sems la gtad med phyag rgya chen po yin/ /de la goms pa bla med 'bras bu yin/ /'dzin(kun ma.o klong chen rab 'byams pas/)pas ma bcings gzung ba'i yul las 'das/ /dmigs gtad chos med har sangs rgya yan pa/ /ma yengs dran pa zad pa'i dgongs pa ni/ /mkha' ltar phyal yas sgom dang mi bsgom med/ /bsgom(slob dpon bai ro tsa nas/)du med pa'i chos dbyings chen po la/ /bsam du med pa'i rig pa ma yengs zhog /yul(bla ma 613

gser gling pas/)dang yul gyi chos nyid ma mchis kyang / /blang dor kun bral spros dang bral ba yi/ /gnyug ma'i ngang du blo gros ma bcos pa/ /lhan ner gnas na skyes bu chen por gyur/ /sa le sang nge trig(mkhas grub rāga.agagye'i zhal nas/)ge rjen ne ba/ /sprin med nam mkha' dwangs pa'i dkyil 'dra ba/ /'di ni mos gus phyag rgya chen po yin/ /ma yengs rang ngo ltos dang e ma ho/ /zhes pa 'di ni dad gus che ba'i slob ma blo bzang rin chen la gdams pa'o/ /smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'das(rigapa gcer mthong las/)pa'i rtog pa rjes med yal nas sangs/ /ma 'ongs rtog pa ma skyes sa le ba/ /da lta bzo med rang lugs gnas pa'i dus/ /tha la la rang gi dus kyi shes pa la/ /rig pa ma yengs cer gyis bltas pa'i tshe/ /bltas pas mthong rgyu med pa'i sa le ba//rig pa mngon sum rjen ne trig ge ba/ /rtag pa ma yin cir yang grub pa med/ /chad pa ma yin sa ler hrig ger gsal/ /gcig tu ma yin du mar rig cing gsal/ /du ma ma yin dbyer med ro gcig pa/ /gzhan na med de rang rig 'di nyid do/ /dngos gzhi'i gnas lugs don gyi ngo sprod do/ /'di la sku gsum dbyer med ci yang 614

tshang / /ci yang ma grub stong ba chos kyi sku/ /stong ba'i rang mdangs gsal ba longs sku yin/ /'gag med cir yang 'char ba sprul ba'i sku/ /gsum ka gcig tu tshang ba ngo bo yin/ /'di nyid mngon sum mdzub btsugs ngo sprod na/ /da lta'i rang gi shes pa 'di ka yin/ /ma bcos rang gsal 'di ka yin pa la/ /sems ngo ma mthong bya ba ci la zer/ /'di la bsgom rgyu ci yang med pa la/ /bsgoms pas ma byung bya ba ci la zer/ /gsal rig stong gsum dbyer med gcig pa la/ /bsgrubs pas ma 'grub bya ba ci la zer//zhes rig pa gcer mthong gi ngo sprod zab mo 'di ni o rgyan chen pos gsungs pa bzhin jo mo chos rgyal sgrol ma la gdams pa'o/ / chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang / /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor 'byung / /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la gus pas 'dud/ /nam()lopas/)mkha'i rang bzhin gang gis gang la brten/ /rang sems phyag rgya che la brten yul med/ /bcings pa glod na grol bar the tshom med/ /ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang la glod la zhog /mi(mkha' 'gro snying thig las/)'gyur brtan pa ri bo bzhin du zhog /mi g.yo dwangs pa rgya mtsho bzhin du zhog /yangs dog bral ba nam mkha' bzhin du zhog /gang ltar gnas kyang rig pa'i 615

ngang yin zhog /gang ltar shar yang rig pa'i gdangs yin zhog /'phro nas rang rig dwangs sang phyes par zhog /ji ltar bya rnams gang du 'phur na yang / /mkha' las ma 'das de bzhin rig pa'i ngang / /chos rnams rang gsal g.yo ba med par zhog /snang(mkhas grub khyung bos/)srid rang grol sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin/ /bde ba chen po rgyun chad med pa'i nyams/ /yid la byar med stong gsal nam mkha'i ngang / /bde chen phyag rgya chen po'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di ni jo mo kun dga' chos skyid la gdams pa'o/ /e ma(dwags po lha rjes/)rang rig ye shes skyong 'dod na/ /ras bal bzhin du shes pa glod la zhog /ma bcos bzhag pas sems ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /bcos ma'i sems ni rgyal ba'i dgongs pa min/ /ma bcos(gling chen ras pas/)so mar bzhag na rtogs pa 'char/ /chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bsgoms na yongs kyang 'char/ /dmigs gtad mtshan ma thams cad yongs sgongs la/ /rtag tu mnyam par zhog dang rnal 'byor pa/ /bsam dang bsam(sā ra has/)bya thams cad dor nas su/ /ji ltar bu chung lhug par gnas pa bzhin/ /bla ma'i lung la bsgrims te gus 'bad na//lhan cig skyes pa 'byung bar je tshom med//'di ltar(orgyan chen pos/)yid kyi yul du 'gyu ba yi/ /nyon mongs dug lnga'i rtog pa ci shar yang / /sngon 616

bsu rjes gcod blo yis bcos mi bya/ /'gyu ba rang sar bzhag pas chos skur grol/ /ma bsam(klong chen rab 'byams pas/)ma dpyad gdal ba chen po'i gzhi/ /dbyengs las ma g.yos chos sku rang mal lam/ /rang rig dri med mngon gyur 'bras bu'i ngang / /rang byung rig pa 'gyur med zang thal le/ /zhes pa 'di jo mo ye shes sgol ma la gdams pa'o/ /snang stong sgyu ma'i gar mkhan/ /drin can bla ma'i zhabs la/ /rmi lam ltar snang slob mas/ /snang stong lus kyis phyag 'tshal/ /mkhris nad can gyi mig la/ /dung dkar ser bor 'char yang / /sman pa'i sman gyes sbyangs tshe/ /dung dkar rang mdog mthong yong / /ma rig dbang gis chos kun/ /tshugs thub bden par 'char yang / /bla ma'i gdams pas dpyad tshe/ /stong gsal rjen par 'char ro/ /tsha grang rgyu rkyen rten 'brel/ /tshogs las 'ja' tshon ri mo/ /mdun gyi bar snang khams su/ /'char la ltad mo ltos dang / /rgyu rkyen cha shas rten 'brel/ /tshogs las 'khor 'das chos kun/ /'o skol rnams kyi snang ngor/ /'char la ltad mo ltos dang / /chos rnams rang bzhin stong bar/ /shes pas rtag mtha' sel zhing / /stong bzhin snang bas chad mtha'/ /sel ba ngo mtshar che yang / /stong nyid gshis la bltas tshe/ /'gag med cir 617

yang snang bas/ /stong nyid rang gis chad mtha'/ /sel ba ltad mo ltos dang / /snang tsam sgyu ma'i rol bar/ /shes pas a 'thas zhig pas/ /snang ba rang gis rtag mtha'/ /sel la ltad mo ltos dang / /snang ba stong ba'i rgyu dang / /stong ba de 'bras yin pas/ /snang ba'i thog nas stong ba/ /rnyed la ltad mo ltos dang / /stong ba snang ba'i rgyu dang / /snang ba de'i 'bras yin pas/ /stong ba'i ngang las snang ba/ /'char la ltad mo ltos dang / /snang dang stong ba gnyis ka /phan tshun rgyu 'bras 'gro zhing / /'gal med grogs su 'char bas/ /ngo mtshar 'di la gzigs dang / /mdor na chos rnams ma lus/ /ming gis phar btags ma gtogs/ /don la grub pa med pas//skye 'chi ya nga mi dgos/ /zhes pa 'di ni slob bu bstan 'dzin rab rgyas la bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o/ /bla mar mos gus kyi bdag po/ /skyon rtog log lta la ltos dang / /mched lcam dam tshig gi bdag po//ngan shags lkog lab la ltos dang / /sems rgyud 'dul mkhan gyi bdag po/ /zhe rgyud gyong tshul la ltos dang / /ri la sdod mkhan gye bdag po/ /grong du rgyug tshul la ltos dang / /dag snang phyogs med kyi bdag po/ /grub mtha'i phyogs ris la ltos dang / /tshe 'di blos btang gi bdag po/ /blo rgya che tshul la ltos dang / /chags med zhen med kyi bdag 618

po/ /zas nor chags zhen la ltos dang / /dka' thub bcud len gyi bdag po/ /sgo kha'i dri chen la ltos dang / /ras gos rkyang gcig gi bdag po/ /mal sa'i thul ba la ltos dang / /thig le yar 'dren gyi bdag po/ /a ne'i grod khog la ltos dang / /grub thob chang 'thung gi bdag po/ /bzi nas 'gyel tshul la ltos dang / /zhesapa 'di yang sems la shar ba ltar slob bu /rma tshe brtan la gdams pa'o/ /mi rtag sgom mkhan gyi bdag po/ /rtag 'dzin che tshul la ltos dang / /zhen log nges 'byung gi bdag po/ /nor gyi gsog 'jog la ltos dang / /byams dang snying rje yi bdag po/ /chags sdang che tshul la ltos dang / /gzhan phan byang sems kyi bdag po/ /phan 'dogs med tshul la ltos dang / /zas nor sbyin gtong gi bdag po/ /rgyud kyi ser sna la ltos dang / /tshul khrims rnam dag gi bdag po/ /nang gi g.yo sgyu la ltos dang / /khro med bzod pa yi bdag po/ /tshig ngag smra tshul la ltos dang / /yengs med brtson 'grus kyi bdag po/ /nangs nub nyal tshul la ltos dang / /rtog med ting 'dzin gyi bdag po/ /chad med rnam rtog la ltos dang / /bdag med shes rab kyi bdag po/ /bdag 'dzin che tshul la ltos dang / /bskyed rim gsal snang gi bdag po/ /tha mal snang zhen la ltos dang / /rdzogs rim 'od gsal gyi bdag po/ /gti mug che tshul la 619

ltos dang / /'gro ba gzhan don gyi bdag po/ /rang don sgrub tshul la ltos dang / /zhes pa 'di yang sems la shar ba ltar slob bu skal bzang phun tshogs la smras pa'o/ /dran shes so ba la bzhag na/ /chags sdang bdud kyi rkun po yong / /bsam blo tshe 'dir shor ba la/ /ya mtshan grub rtags 'ong ba med/ /mos gus med pa'i slob ma la/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug mi 'gyur/ /snying rus sdug bsran chung ba yis chos mgo mtha' ru thon mi srid/ /sdod ma tshugs pa'i chos pa la/ /bya btang sgom chen yong ba med/ /lto gdung nan tan che ba la/ /ri khrod pa zhig ga nas 'ong / /ser sna can gyi gang zag la/ /gtam snyan grags pa 'ong ba dka'/ /snying rje med pa'i chos pa la/ /'gro don sku bsod rgyas pa med/ /zhen pa nang nas ma log na/ /tshe 'di'i 'khri ba chod mi 'gyur/ /ri khrod dben pa ma bsnyegs na/ /gong ma'i rnam thar zin mi 'gyur/ /snying rus zhe bcad ma byas na/ /sgrub pa mtha' ru 'khyol ba med/ /ngo srung thag pa ma bcad na/ /g.yeng bas khyer nas chos mi 'ong / /gros phugs lha la ma gtad na/ /bdud kyi bar chad 'byung nyen yod/ /'gro don bya bar sngas song na/ /byen rlabs tshan kha rdol mi 'gyur/ /snying rje'i rgya mtsho ma 'khyil na/ /gdul bya'i nya mo 'khyu ba med/ /ci byas 620

chos brgyad dbang song na/ /mi dge dug sbyor me tog rgyas/ /tshe 'di rmang nas ma bshig na/ /chos brgyad mkhar la 'gyel dus med/ /dgos med chung mar ma thob na/ /'di la 'di dgos zad pa med/ /nor rdzas rlung la ma bskur na/ /gzung 'dzin sgog las thar dus med/ /nye ring chags sdang ma spangs na/ /chos pa'i ming yang thogs don med/ /nyams len so nam ma byas na/ /sku gsum ston thog 'byung mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di ni skal ldan snying gi slob bu blo bzang chos grags la gdams pa'o/ / deng sang bskal pa snyigs dus 'dir/ /chos dang mthun pa'i gang zag dkon/ /tshe 'di'i dbang song chos pa de/ /bkur na gzhan la khyad du gsod/ /ma bkur tsa na sdug yus kyis/ /gzhan la skur ba thebs tshad 'debs/ /rtogs ldan gza' gtad med ces zer/ /chags sdang yul la gza' gtad che/ /chos rnams sgyu ma rmi lam zer/ /rmi lam la yang bzang ngan 'byed/ /cir snang sems kyi cho 'phrul zer/ /rnyed bkur bdud kyi phye la dga'/ /mnyam bzhag rjes thob gnyis med zer/ /'jig rten chos brgyad lhag par 'phel/ /'gro don dus la bab ces zer/ /rang gi don la sngar bas rem/ /zas nor sbyin par gtong zhes zer/ /gnyen sogs lan re lon la ster/ /dge sdig 'dor len mi dgos 621

zer/ /zas la bzang ngan 'dor len dgos/ /nam zhig shi na 'tshang rgya zer/ /'chi khar tshe 'dir shi spar 'tham/ /cir snang sangs rgyas zhing yin zer/ /'chi dus 'khrul nas ldab ldib lab/ /de 'dra'i chos pa phal cher de/ /bdud kyi zhags pas thebs pa yin/ /snying nas chos shig byed snyam na/ /de 'dra nam yang ma byed cig /bsten na mtshan ldan bla ma sten/ /'grogs na chos mthun grogs dang 'grogs/ /bsrung na dam tshig sdom pa srungs/ /spong na mi dge'i sdig pa spongs/ /byed na dam pa'i lha chos gyes/ /gtong na tshe 'di blo yis thongs/ /'dug na ri khrod dben par sdod/ /bsgom na bla ma'i gdams ngag sgoms/ /'dul na bdag 'dzin nyon mongs thul/ /skyong na snying rje 'gro kun skyongs/ /sgol na 'khor ba'i pha rol sgol/ /bsnyeg na rgyal ba'i go 'phang snyogs/ /zhes pa 'di ni slob bu dge slong rgan pa blo bzang tshe ring la gdams pa'o/ /bla ma'i byen rlabs kyis sems la/ /stong nyid nam mkha' rang langs byung / /rgya bskyed dpangs bstod yang ma dgos/ /gu yangs khyab gdal la langs song / /shes rab yangs po yi mig 'bur/ /sngar las ches cher du gsal byung / /gzhung lugs rab 'byams kyi thang la/ /bltas pas sna tshogs shig mthong song / /622

nyon mongs rnam rtog sprin dag nas/ /gsal stong rjen pa la thug byung / /stong gsal mkha' dbyengs nas shugs kyis/ /snying rje'i nyi ma yang shar song / /phan sems 'od zer gyis 'gro ba'i/ /sa gzhi thams cad la khyab byung / /legs bshad tsha zer gyis slob bu'i/ /blo gros pad+mo kha phye bas/ /nyams rtogs yon tan gyi bcud bzang / /zil mngar zhim po yang 'khyil byung / /skal bzang bung ba yang 'dus nas/ /snyan grags dar dir rang bsgrags song / /stong nyid snying rje yi rta bzang / /cang shes shugs can gyi gong nas/ /lhag bsam gom 'gros rang byed bzhin/ /phyogs med 'gro don la chas 'gro/ /rnal 'byor mgrin pa yi lam nas/ /skyid pa'i rgyang glu de thal song / /nyams len de 'dra zhig gyis dang //nyams rtogs nyi ma zhig shar yong / /zhes pa 'di ni rang gi nyams la shar ba ltar dad gtong blo gros che ba'i lha rje kun dga' la gdams pa'o/ /mnyam med thub dbang rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs/ /dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /byang chub lam rim rtogs pa khyad par can/ /bdag gzhan rgyud la skye bar byen gyis rlobs/ /bla ma skyes chen dam pa gong ma yis/ /'di phyi'i legs tshogs thams cad 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /mtshan nyid tshang ba'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes/ /bsam dang sbyor ba'i sgo nas tshul bzhin bsten/ /623

dal ba brgyad dang 'byor ba bcu tshang ba'i/ /dal 'byor don che rnyed par dka' ba bsam/ /chos kyi snying bo len 'dod bsgyed par mdzad/ /rjes 'jug rang yang de bzhin bskyang 'tshal lo/ /de nas skyes chen dam pa gong ma yis/ /'chi ba ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal bsams/ /de las skyob pa'i skyabs 'gro yang yang byas/ /de'i rgyu mi dge bcu bo dug bzhin spangs/ /rnam smin brgyad ldan rten bzang rgyu rnams bsgrubs/ /las sgrib sbyong phyir stobs bzhi'i bshags pa byas/ /skyes bu chung ngu'i nyams len de ltar mdzad/ /rjes 'jug rang yang de ltar bskyang tshul lo/ /de nas skyes chen dam pa gong ma yis/ /khams gsum 'khor ba spyi yi sdug bsngal bsams/ /mtho ris na yang bde ba med par shes/ /sdug bsngal de kun las nyon gnyis las byung / /de yi rtsa ba ma rig yin par go /de yi gnyen po bslab pa gsum la bslabs/ /skyes bu 'bring gi nyams len de ltar mdzad/ /rjes 'jug rang yang de bzhin bskyang tshul lo/ /de nas skyes chen dam pa gong ma yis/ /rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun dang bdag gzhan gnyis/ /brje ba'i tshul bsam smon 'jug sems bskyed nas/ /sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus dang / /bsam gtan shes rab bsdu ba rnam bzhir bslabs/ /khyad par zhi lhag gnyis la nan 624

tan byas/ /skyes bu chen po'i nyams len de ltar mdzad/ /rjes 'jug rang yang de bzhin bskyang tshul lo/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams/ /byang chub lam rim bsgom pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /lam bzang 'di dang 'bral bar ma gyur cig /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / /'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing / /sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /ces pa 'di ni slob bu blo bzang don grub dang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho gnyis kyis myur lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor la brten nas lam rim sgom tshul nyung la 'dus pa zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor bris pa'o/ /gangs ri lha yi pho brang / /bde mchog 'khor lo'i lha tshogs/ /dad can skor mi yongs la/ /byen rlabs dngos grub stsol dang / /mdo khams smad nas 'ongs pa'i/ /rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol/ /phyag mchod skor ba byas nas/ /dben gnas gzhan du chas 'gro/ /'dzam gling gangs dkar te se/ /lha yi pho brang yin snang / /dad can skor mi yod na/ /las ngan sdig sgrib dag yong / /stod phyogs mnga' ris skor gyi/ /dad can yon bdag pho mo/ /dam pa'i chos la spyod bzhin/ /thams cad bde bar bzhugs dang / /rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol/ /dad pa dam tshig can 625

la/ /chos 'brel smon lam 'debs bzhin/ /yul phyogs gzhan du chas 'gro/ /ma bu so sor bral bzhin/ /sems 'khreng 'bral mi phod rung / /kun la phyi mig lta bzhin/ /sems la bzhag nas bzhud 'gro/ /zhes pa 'di ni 'gro khar stod phyogs mnga' ris skor gyi yon bdag pho mo yongs la smras pa'o/ /khu byug lcang gling 'gyu ba nyams dga' yang / /thag rnyi khra mos gar zin mi shes pas/ /thang dkar rgod po'i phyi rjes bsnyeg pa'i phyir/ /gshog sgo brgyangs nas bar snang bde mo bskor/ /nya mo chu mtha' 'grim pa nyams dga' yang / /lcags kyu sngon mos nam 'debs cha med pas/ /nya chen yor mo'i phyi rjes bsnyeg pa'i phyir/ /dpa' rtsal bskyed nas gtsang chab gzhung ring 'grims/ /rnal 'byor tshogs dpon byed pa nyams dga' yang / /'chi bdag bdud po nam sleb mi shes pas/ /bka' brgyud gong ma'i phyi rjes bsnyeg pa'i phyir/ /tshe blos btang nas phyogs med ri khrod 'grims/ /yul gcig mi 'dzin gnas gcig mi sdod par/ /dge sbyor 'phel ba'i 'dris med yul du 'khyams/ /dam pa'i chos kyi glu dbyangs len bzhin du/ /gu yangs dben pa'i gnas su nyams dga' skyongs/ /zhes pa 'di yang yid la shar ba ltar bris pa'o/ /rje bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas rnams/ /gnas mi mngon 626

dbyings nas thugs rjes gzigs/ /mi 'dir tshogs tshe 'di'i bar chad sol/ /tshe phyi mar 'gro yang lam sna drongs/ /khyed dad can yon bdag pho mo dang / /nged lo gsum bar du phyogs gcig bsdad/ /da mi sdod so sor 'bral ba bzhin//tshe phyi mar 'gro yang 'di dang 'dra/ /tshe 'di ru sdod mkhan su yang med/ /tshe phyi mar chos min phan pa med/ /khyed dad can yon bdag pho mo rnams/ /tshe 'di la ma chags lha chos mdzod/ /nged lha chos byed pa'i dpon slob la/ /khyed yon bdag pho mo bka' drin che/ /da drin can thams cad bde bar bzhugs/ /nga rnal 'byor mi sdod chas nas 'gro/ /mi nga yang yul phyogs gar song yang / /khyed thams cad mi brjed sems la bzhag /nged kun gyi don du tshe mjug 'dir/ /mchog sangs rgyas thob phyir sgrub la 'bad/ /kun so sor 'bral glags mi phod rung / /spyir 'dus pa'i mtha' ma 'bral ba de/ /lar 'khor ba'i chos nyid yin pas na/ /sems 'khreng yang bya thabs gzhan ma mchis/ /gnas gangs ri sa thag ring ba dang / /nga rnal 'byor na so rgas pa'i mthus/ /dus da nas tshe 'dir mi mjal yang / /tshe phyi mar mjal ba'i smon lam 'tshal mi nga yang myur du sangs rgyas nas/ /yar zhing khams dag pa'i pho brang du/ /khyed 'brel thogs thams cad 'dren par smon/ /yid smon 627

pa bzhin du 'grub gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni yul spu trengs pa dang gang zag pa hor sde rnams kyi yon bdag rnams la 'gro khar smras pa'o/ /'khor ba pa la bde ba med/ /ngan song sdug bsngal bzod par dka'/ /lha mi'i bde skyid mi rtag 'gyur/ /'khor bar phyi phyag 'tshal re ran/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor bcas kun/ /da ni tshe 'dir mi mjal yang / /phyi mar dag pa'i zhing khams nas/ /mjal ba'i smon lam bdag gis 'debs/ /'di nas shar gye phyogs rol na/ /mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams yod/ /skye ba 'di yi 'og rol tu/ /zhing khams de ru mjal bar smon/ /gal te de ru ma mjal na/ /'di nas lho yi phyogs rol na/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing khams yod/ /zhing khams de ru mjal bar smon/ /gal te de ru ma mjal na/ /'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na/ /bde ba can gyi zhing khams yod/ /zhing khams de ru mjal bar smon/ /gal te de ru ma mjal na/ /'di nas byang gi phyogs rol na/ /las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing khams yod/ /zhing khams de ru mjal bar smon/ /gal te de ru ma mjal na/ /'di nas steng gi phyogs rol na/ /stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams yod/ /zhing der cis kyang mjal bar shog /yon bdag pho mo 'khor bcas kun/ /tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med cing / /ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub pa 628

dang / /dge legs bkra shis 'phel bar shog /ces pa 'di ni 'gro khar dad can pho mo yongs la phyi mar mjal ba'i sgon lam du btab pa'o/ /sbas pa'i sangs rgyas mi gzugs can/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /bu slob yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /gangs ri sa thag ring ba dang / /rnal 'byor na so rgas pa dang / /nam 'chi nges pa med pas na/ /da nas tshe 'dir mjal bar dka'/ /'on kyang dad can bu slob rnams/ /nga yis mi brjed sems la 'jog /dngos sam nyams dang rmi lam la/ /yang yang mjal ba'i gsol ba thobs/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor bcas kun/ /'dus nas so sor 'bral ba ltar/ /chos rnams mi rtag 'di dang 'dra/ /de la soms la lha chos mdzod/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor bcas rnams/ /skye ba 'di yi 'og rol tu/ /zhing khams dag pa'i pho brang nas/ /mjal ba'i smon lam bdag gis 'debs/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i byin rlabs dang / /bdag gi lhag bsam dge ba'i mthus/ /skye ba 'di yi 'og rol tu/ /mngon dga'i zhing du mjal bar shog /mjal nas 'bral med 'grog par shog /'grogs nas chos la spyod par shog /spyad nas sangs rgyas thob par shog /thob nas 'gro ba 'dren par shog /'dis mtshon bdag gi dge 629

ba'i mthus/ /yul phyogs 'di dag thams cad kyi/ /mi nad phyugs nad zhi ba dang / /lo legs 'bru nor 'phel bar shog /ces pa 'di ni gangs ri'i phyogs kyi dad can bu slob yongs la 'gro khar smras pa'o/ /bla ma mkhas grub du mdzibaka' drin las/ /sprang bo dam pa'i chos kyis phyug pa byung / /sku drin bsam gyin zang zing nor med rung / /'dzad med legs bshad mchog sbyin yang yang spro/ /don rnams chos dang mthun zhing tshig gi rigs/ /'jig rten pa yi glu dang mthun par byas/ /shugs 'byung 'gag med glu dbyangs blangs rnams kyis/ /mthong thos 'gro la phan par byen gyis rlobs/ /bdag gi byang khog stod kyi lha khang gi /zur gsum snying gi rgyal mtshan rtse mo yi/ /sems nyid gsal stong yid bzhin nor bu las/ /lepo/sa bshad zab mo'i dgos 'dod ci yang 'byung / /skal bzang slob ma rnams kyis rim bzhin du/ /skul tshig bser bus yang yang bskyod pa'i mod/ /bdag gi rnam dpyod tsan dan nags tshal las/ /legs bshad dri bzang ngad pa yang yang 'thul/ /rang sems shel dkar bum pa bzang bo ru/ /legs 'khyel zab rgyas chos kyi bdud rtsi de/ /skal ldan slob ma'i gser dngul bum bzang du/ /ci tsam blugs kyang 'dzad pa'i dus ma byung / /bdag gi shes rab dpag bsam ljon shing las/ /cung zad 630

rkyen rer brten nas dbang med du/ /mgur dbyangs me tog mang bo thor song ba/ /slar yang glegs bam snod du bsdus pa mtshar /bya btang rnal 'byor rgas nas shi song yang / /legs bshad 'di dag mi nyams sa steng 'dir/ /yun ring gnas nas dad can mang bo la/ /rang nyid gnas pa las kyang phan par shog /'dis mtshon dge bas sangs rgyas bstan pa dar/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro la bde skyid 'byung ba dang / /nad mug 'khrug rtsod ming yang mi grags par/ /bkra shis chen bos phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i pho brang dgra bcom rnams kyi bzhugs gnas/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i zhing / gang zag phal ba rnams kyi rgyud byen gyis rlobs pa'i gnas mchog khyad par can 'dzam gling rgyan gcig phyag skor mchod pa'i zhing mchog dam pa/gangs ri na sdod pa'i dus su rang gzhan gyi rgyud la phan pa'i blos glu dbyangs sna tshogs blangs pa'i mjug gi smon tshig tu bya btang ri khrod pa glu dbyangs la rab tu dga' ba'i tshogs drug rang grol gyis sbyar ba'o/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun zhabs dkar rdo rje 'chang chen pos mchog dman bar ma'i gdul byar rdo rje'i mgur dpag tu med pa bzhengs pa yi ger 'khod pa'i nang tshan las/ 'dzam gling sa yi lte ba bde mchog 'khor lo'i pho brang gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i 'du gnas gangs dkar te se nas bzhengs pa'i skor ro/ /631

gangs ri nas phyir phebs shing khyung lung dang spu hrengs sogs sa cha mang bo brgyud skabs bzhengs pa'i skor/ na mo gu ru mañdzu sgo ṣa ya/ chos sku lha yi lam nas thugs bskyed smon lam rlung gi shing rtas drangs/ /gzugs sku nyi ma gzhon nu 'od 'bar ris med 'gro ba'i dpal du shar/ /'gro kun blo yi rmongs pa'i mun sel thub bstan pad tshal rgyas pa'i gnyen/ /sngar med rje btsun nyi ma khyod la lan brgya'i bar du bstod par 'os/ /mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar khyed sku ri dbang bu slob gser ri'i khrod na mdzes/ /tshems dkar chu 'dzin dbus na ljags mnyen glog 'khyug chos kyi dbyar rnga ldir/ /thugs kyi mkha' la mkhyen brtse'i nyi zla yon tan gza' skar grangs med shar/ /de 'dra'i mgon khyod sku gsung thugs la bstod bsngags me tog char ba 'bebs/ /mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku mchog mthong tshe phal ba'i rgyan rnams khur du song / /tshangs pa'i gsung 632

dbyangs bsgyur na dri za'i glu dbyangs snyan zer dzun du gtong / /mkhyen brtse chen po'i nyi zla'i 'od la phyogs ris med pa 'di mthong tshe/ /phyi rol nyi ma byang ngos mi 'char ba la ngo tsha gling bzhir bros/ /sngon chad ded dpon khyed kyis mkhas grub klu dbang stong gis yongs bzung ba/ /zab rgyas chos kyi nor bu blangs nas kun gyi re ba skong 'di mtshar/ /mi nub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mthon po rnam dpyod gser gyi yu bas btegs/ /srid pa'i bar du ches cher bsgrengs tshe snyan pa tshangs gnas bar du khyab/ /mtha' yas chos rnams rnam dag thugs kyis mkhyen/ /bgrang yas ma lus lus can kun la brtse/ /dpag yas bdud dpung dpung tshogs cig char 'joms bsam yas 'gro kun kun mkhyen sa ru 'dren/ /chos gsungs gsung mchog mchog shes shes rab zab/ /zab don don mchog mchog ston ston pa dngos/ /dngos kun kun mkhyen mkhyen rab rab gsal thugs/ /thugs rje'i rjes bzung gzung 'dzin 'dzin med dag /rtag tu byams pas thugs rgyud brlan byas kyang / /nag bo'i rtsa lag sde rnams lhag med bsregs/ /las nyon 'khor ba'i 'ching ba kun bcad kyang / /dbang med snying rje chen pos dam du bcings/ /rgyun du nye ring chags sdang kun zhi nas/ /btang 633

snyoms gnas kyang bdag pas gzhan la gces/ /lung rtogs yon tan mdzod la mnga' brnyes kyang / /'dzad med 'phags nor bdun gyi gter kha 'byed/ /dam chos 'chad tshe gzugs sku tha dad tsam/ /ma gtogs 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang cis mi mtshungs/ /rtsod pa'i seng ge'i nga ro cher bsgrags tshe/ /rgol ngan wa skyes rgyang nas snying rtsa 'dar/ /yid 'ong rtsom pa'i mdzes ma mthong ba na/ /dbang med mkhas mang gzhon nu'i yid rab 'phrog /mkhas pa phal cher zab yangs nam mkha' 'dra/ /phal cher rgyu skar bzhin du cher mi gsal/ /legs bshad 'od kyis thub bstan gsal mdzad pa/ /smra ba'i nyi ma khyod min gzhan na gang / /tshul khrims gos la bag yod ska rags bcings thos pa'i rna rgyan legs bshad mgul rgyan 'chang / /gtong ba'i gser gyi gdu bu mthong ba'i mod/ /phal ba'i rgyan la blta ba'i go skabs bral/ /khyod kyis legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba yis/ /blo gsal mgul ba brgyan pas yid 'phrogs nas/ /mkhas rlom gzhan gyis bshad pa'i 'ching bu la/ /lan gcig tsam re bltas nas 'dor ba mang //khyed kyis legs bshad rin chen rgyan mang gis/ /rgyal bstan mjes ma'i lus po brgyan mthong tshe/ /bshad pa phal gyis bstan pa'i na chung lus/ /shin tu lod por byed la 634

chas pa 'dra/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis brtsad cing dris pa'i tshe/ /dris lan yid 'phrog pi wang bsgyur tsa na/ /gzhan gyi dri ba dris lan 'ga' zhig de/ /rna bar gzan pa'i cho nges 'debs pa 'dra/ /ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i kha yis ma rtogs log rtog je tshom gyi/ /dra ba ma lus rtsad nas gcod tshe 'jam dbyangs sprul ba'i ral gri 'dra/ /dri med thugs kyi mthing shog ngos la sher phyin tshig don ma lus pa/ /mi brjed gzungs kyi yi ger btab pa mthong na glegs bam yin nam ci/ /bla ma sangs rgyas bye bor bsgoms tshe 'od zer 'phro ba gzhan gyes mthong / /yi dam phyag na rdo rje bsgrubs tshe mngon sum byon nas lung bstan mdzad/ /'jam dbyangs gong ma'i mdun du byon dus chos skyong mgon po'i zhal yang gzigs/ /dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du byon dus sngon gyi tshe rabs mang bo dran/ /'od gsal ngang la mnyam par bzhag dus sangs rgyas zhing khams mang bo gzigs/ /gzhan gyi skyid sdug legs nyes thams cad zhus pa las kyang gsal bar gsungs/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung dzu 'phrul mnga' ba gang zag pha la la mi ston yang //las snang dag pa rnams kyi snang ngor ngo mtshar ltad mo cir yang ston/ /mdzad pa'i tha ma gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul ba'i phyir//khru gang tsam 635

gye nam mkhar 'phags nas mkha' skyod dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ /ngo mtshar ltas dang cho 'phrul ston bzhin zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa'i dus/ /lha mi'i bstod bsngags rol mo dkrol bas gtam gzhan gleng ba'i go skabs bcom/ /mdor na legs pa'i yon tan ma lus pa/ /khyed kyi sku gsung thugs la legs bsdus nas/ /skyon kyi rigs su gyur pa ma lus pa/ /'khor ba pa la 'jog pa byas pa 'dra/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang mi yi gzugs su shar/ /'og min zhing du phyin kyang gzhan ma mchis /e ma sangs rgyas dngos dang mjal zin pas/ /da ni brgyud pa'i nye ring su yis bgrang / /khyod kyi yon tan ri dbang che mthong na/ /lhun po ngo tsha rgya mtsho'i nang du zhugs/ /yon tan ri dbang mthong nas nyi zla yis/ /khyed dang lhun poganyis gar skor ba byas/ /snyan grags dbyar gyi rnga gsang stong ldir tshe/ /'brug kyang 'jigs nas rdza yi nang du bros/ /me yis khyed kyi rnam thar ston pa'i phyir/ /rtag par gyen du 'bar ba kho nar 'dod/ /khyed kyi yon tan gzhan la sgogs pa'i phyir/ /chu klung rnams kyang rgyal khams kun tu rgyu/ /sems med bem po rnams kyang 'di 'dra na//sems yod rnams ni khyod la cis mi dad/ /bdag gis khyod kyi yon tan mthong ba'i tshe/ /dbang med dad pa'i spu long g.yo ba 636

de/ /gtong phod che ba'i sbyin bdag mthong ba na/ /'dod pa che ba'i slong mo ba bzhin gyur/ /grangs med phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku/ /dpag med yon tan ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs kyi pad+mo la/ /zol med sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam dag mchod tshogs kun 'bul sdig ltung bshags/ /rnam thar mdzad par yi rang chos 'khor bskor/ /rnam mang 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /rnam dkar dge rnams rjes su 'dzin phyir bsngo//dung dung snying nas mtshan ldan bla ma la/ /yang yang bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ /'jigs 'jigs 'khor ba'i mtsho las rab bsgral nas/ /myur myur sangs rgyas sa la bzhag tu gsol/ /sgrib gnyis sgo nga'i sbubs nas rang gi sems/ /tshogs gnyis 'dab ldan ka la piṅka'i bya/ /sku gnyis nyi zla 'char ba'i mkha' la 'phur/ /don gnyis 'grub pa'i dbyangs snyan sgrogs par shog /mthun rkyen kun 'dzoms kun nas nyams dga'i zhing / /gangs can yul 'di'i yul la dar tshad kyi/ /grub mtha' ma lus ma nyams rgyas pa dang / /dam chos dbyangs snyan dbyangs su/ len par shog /mnyam med zas gtsang sras po 'gro ba'i mgon/ /mgon de'i phan bde ma lus 'byung ba'i bstan/ /bstan 'dzin 637

dge 'dun sde yis sa steng gang / /gang zhig srid mtha'i bar du khyab gyur cig /ces rang la bka' drin sangs rgyas las kyang lhag pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma gtsug gi nor bu mtshan brjod par dka' ba don gyi slad du mtshan nas smras na/ mtshan snyan pa chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo zhes bya ba de nyid bka' mdo rgyud kyi don la mkhas pa la bsams na/rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po zhig yin nam snyam zhing / mi dge sdig lhung dri mas ma gos par btsun pa'i tshul la bsams na sngon bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos dgra bcom pa zhig dang mtshungs la/byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bzang ba la bsams na bod kyi bka' gdams bla ma gong ma rnams la 'gran bzod pa de lta bu'i skyon kun zad yon tan kun ldan rje rin po che de nyid kyi gsang gsum yon tan dang / rang la bka' drin che ba'i tshul rnams yid la dran bzhin/ rje nyid kyi sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor la bstod bsngags me tog du ma'i char chen po yang yang 'bebs bzhin du dam pa de nyid kyis gang gsung rdo rje'i tshig rang gi sems la gang nges rnams/las dang skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya pho mo rnams la gdams pa'i tshul 'ga' zhig phyi rabs rjes 'jug rnams la phan phyir slar yang yi ge'i lam nas bshad par bya'o/ /de yang phyogs med kyi rgyal khams 'grims pa'i sprang 'khyams gu yangs yan pa blo bde bdag gangs ri nas thon te/khyung lung / spu hrengs/ gli me/ hor sde/ dro shod rnams brgyud nas 'ong dus/ dad can gyi grwa bu slob yon bdag pho mo brgya stong du ma la tshe dbang dang / thugs rje chen po la sogs pa'i smin byed kyi dbang dang / bskyed rdzogs sogs grol byed kyi khrid dang / gzhan yang gang la gang 'tsham gyi chos mang bo bshad pa'i thog mar chos kyi snod du rung ba'i phyir/dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas sogs tshigs lhug pa'i sgo nas bshad pa 638

logs su gsal la/ 'dir tshigs su bcad pa'i rim pa 'ga' zhig 'bri ba ni 'di lta ste/lhar bcas 'gro ba yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /'dren pa mnyam med ston pa sangs rgyas kyis/ /rab tu brtse bas 'o skol rjes 'jug la/ /rtag tu dge sbyong chos bzhi bsten pa dang / /'phags pa'i rigs bzhir rgyun du gnas pa dang / /'dzad med 'phags nor bdun gyi gsog 'jog dang / /chos spyod bcu la rtag tu 'bad dgos gsungs/ /ston pa thugs rje can gyi gsung bzhin du/ /gzhan gyis tshur la khro yang slar mi khro/ /tshur la gshe yang slar la mi gshe zhing / /tshur la mtshang brus na yang slar mi 'bru/ /tshur la brdegs kyang slar la mi brdeg par/ /rtag tu dge sbyong chos bzhi bsten par bya/ /chos gos bsod snyoms gnas mal ngan ngon dang / /mkho ba'i yo byad ngan ngon tsam zhig gis/ /chog pa'i 'phags pa'i rigs bzhir gnas par bya/ /dad pa sbyin gtong tshul khrims thos pa dang / /khrel yod ngo tsha shes dang shes rab ste/ /'dzad med 'phags nor bdun gyi gsog 'jog bya/ /yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin dang nyan pa dang / /klog dang 'dzin dang 'chad dang kha ton bya/ /de don sems shing rtse gcig bsgom pa ste/ /chos spyod bcu la rtag tu 'bad par 639

bya/ /de ltar byas na gnas skabs lha mi yi/ /phyag dang mchod pa'i zhing du 'gyur ba dang / /mthar thug yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang thob nas 'gro kun 'dren par 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di yang bshad sgrub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i slob bu blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang /blo bzang chos grags gnyis la gdams pa'o//bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byen gyes rlobs/ /skye ba'i tha ma nges par 'chi ba yin/ /tshe 'dir chags zhen ma che blo yis thongs/ /'dus pa'i tha ma nges par 'bral ba yin/ /gnyen la gdung sems ma che rgyab tu skyur/ /bsags pa'i tha ma nges par 'dzad pa yin/ /nor la ser sna ma che mchod sbyin thongs/ /mthon po'i tha ma nges par ltung ba yin/ /'jig rten che 'dod ma che dman sa zungs/ /gzhan yang chos mdzad yongs la dag snang sbyongs/ /drin can bla ma yongs la mos gus mdzod/ /grwa rogs grogs mched yongs la brtse gdung gyes/ /ma gyur 'gro ba yongs la snying rje skyed/ /lus ni lhar sgoms ngag gis bzlas brjod gyis/ /rgyun du ma yengs rang gi sems la ltos/ /shes ldan khyod la mang du smra ci dgos/ /mdor na dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar skyongs/ /glu 'di thos tshad skye bo pho mo yi/ /rgyud la phan thogs 'byung ba'i smon lam 640

'tshal/ /zhes pa 'di yang dad gtong blo gros che ba'i dkon mchog bstan 'dzin chos grags la gdams pa'o/ /rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud chos dang mthun par byin gyes rlobs/ /khyed chos mthun snying gi slob bu rnams/ /pha'i gdams ngag sgom bzhin bde bar bzhud/ /dgra nyon mongs dug lnga 'dul gyen song / /gnyen 'gro drug sems can skyong bzhin song / /dus rgyun du nam 'chi cha med soms/ /tshe 'di yi bya ba blo yis thongs/ /gnas shin tu dben pa'i dga' tshal sten/ —/yar bla ma rnams la mos gus mdzod/ /mar 'gro ba yongs la snying rje skyed/ /bar mched grogs yongs la brtse gdung gyis/ /lus lhar sgoms ngag gis bzlas brjod rem/ /sems stong gsal 'dzin med ngang la zhog /glu 'di nyid thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /rgyud dam pa'i chos dang mthun par shog /ces pa 'di yang skal ldan snying gi bu chen o rgyan rnam rgyal dang / kun bzang bstan 'dzin shākya'i sras po rnams phyogs gzhan gyi ri khrod la 'gro ba'i dus su smras pa'o/ /spyi gtsug 'ja' gur 'khyil ba'i 'od klong na/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma bzhugs/ /bdag gi sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /pha rjes bu yis zin par byen gyes rlobs/ /snying nas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro gyis/ /nam yang bslu ba med do slob bu rnams/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla mar 641

gsol ba thobs/ /byin rlabs sems la 'jug go slob bu rnams/ /dal 'byor mi lus shin tu rnyed par dka'/ /don med chud zos ma byed slob bu rnams/ /mi rtag klong na brtson 'grus bskul ma yod/ /nam 'chi cha med soms dang slob bu rnams/ /phyi mar ngan song gnas su skye ba'i rgyu/ /mi dge sdig pa spongs shig slob bu rnams/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba med/ /khyem nas rab tu byung zhig slob bu rnams/ /'gro kun tshe rabs sngon ma'i pha ma yin/ /byams dang snying rje sgoms shig slob bu rnams/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gzhan phan sems las 'byung / /kun la phan sems sbyongs shig slob bu rnams/ /sbyin pa btang na rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub/ /don med ser sna ma byed slob bu rnams/ /tshul khrims bsrungs na 'di phyi gnyis ka bde/ /chang dang bud med spongs shig slob bu rnams/ /bzod pa bsgoms na phyi mar gzugs byad mdzes/ /don med khong khro ma byed slob bu rnams/ /brtson 'grus byas na chos ldan bya ba 'grub/ /gnyid dang le lo ma che slob bu rnams/ /rtse gcig bsam gtan bsgoms na mngon shes 'char/ /don med rnam g.yeng ma byed slob bu rnams/ /shes rab stong nyid bsgoms na thar ba thob/ /bdag 'dzin rtsad nas chod cig slob bu rnams/ /dam 642

tshig gtsang na mkha' 'gro chos skyong 'khor/ /mched grogs dam tshig srungs shig slob bu rnams/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob pa gsang sngags yin/ /yi dam bsgyed rdzogs sgoms dang slob bu rnams/ /sdig can btsan thabs 'tshang rgya 'pho ba yin/ /'di la nan tan gyis dang slob bu rnams/ /rgyun du ma yengs rang gi sems la ltos/ /'khor 'das ltad mo mthong ngo slob bu rnams/ /dam pa'i chos la mi zab gang yang med/ /chos lugs gzhan la ma smod slob bu rnams/ /dag snang yon tan bskyed pa'i gzhi ma yin/ /kun la dag snang sbyongs shig slob bu rnams/ /grong dgon gang du bsdad kyang bde ba med/ /ri khrod dben pa sten cig slob bu rnams/ /dus ngan snyigs ma'i mi la khrel gzhung med/ /grogs med gcig pur sdod cig slob bu rnams/ /'di bzhin nyams su len pa'i gang zag la/ /bde skyid nyi ma 'char ro slob bu rnams/ /snying 'di phyir phyung bstan yang sha zhig yin/ /snying gtam de bas lhag go slob bu rnams/ /snying nas chos shig byed na 'di bzhin gyes/ /chos kyi snying bo yin no slob bu rnams/ /mkhas grub brgya phrag mang bor dris na yang / /'di'i lhag gsung rgyu med do slob bu rnams/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos mang bor bltas na yang / /'di las zab cig med do slob bu 643

rnams/ /yid mi ches na rgyal ba'i bka' la ltos/ /nga ni mi sdod gzhan du song na yang / /legs bshad 'di nyid sdod do slob bu rnams/ /'di bzhin nyams su len pa'i dad can la/ /nga nyid bsdad dang khyad med slob bu rnams/ /'di bzhin mi byed mi la nga bsdad rung / /'di'i lhag bshad rgyu med do slob bu rnams/ /dad pa med pa'i mi la bsdad pa las/ /da dung song ba drag go slob bu rnams/ /pha ngas snying gtam zab mo bshad nas song / /khyed rnams snying la chongs shig slob bu rnams/ /skye ba 'di la da nas mi mjal yang / /skye ba phyi mar mjal lo slob bu rnams/ /glu 'di thos tshad skye bo pho mo rnams/ /gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug 'tshang rgya shog /ces pa 'di yang skal ldan snying gi slob bu yongs la 'gro khar smras pa'o/ / bla ma dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gzhan chos dang mthun par byin gyis rlobs/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis phan pa'i glu dbyangs len/ /khyed rnams ma yengs nyon cig yon bdag rnams/ /mi tshe yad ma yud la shor nas thal/ /mi rtag 'chi ba yong ngo yon bdag rnams/ /'chi dus bsags pa'i nor rnams shul du 'jog /don med sdig gsog ma byed yon bdag rnams/ /phyi mar phan pa dam pa'i lha chos 644

yin/ /da lta lha chos gyis shig yon bdag rnams/ /gtan gyi skyabs su bslu med dkon mchog bzang / /mchod bstod gsol ba thobs dang yon bdag rnams/ /'jig rten lha yis phan las gnod pa che/ /don med dmar mchod ma byed yon bdag rnams/ /rang la sangs rgyas dngos te bla ma yin/ /rtag tu ci mnyes sgrubs shig yon bdag rnams/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dngos te mched grogs yin/ /grogs la brtse gdung gyis shig yon bdag rnams/ /bod kyi lha skal spyan ras gzigs dbang yin/ /rtag tu gsol ba thobs dang yon bdag rnams/ /skyong rgyu'i gnyen de 'gro drug sems can yin/ /byams dang snying rjes skyongs shig yon bdag rnams/ /'dul rgyu'i dgra de nyon mongs dug lnga yin/ /gnyen pos ci thul gyis shig yon bdag rnams/ /dmyal ba'i rgyu yi gtso bo srog gcod yin/ /nam yang srog gcod ma byed yon bdag rnams/ /srog gcod byed pa'i rtsa ba sha 'di yin/ /sdig zas sha khrag spongs shig yon bdag rnams/ /khyim tshang mi rtag tshong 'dus mgon po 'dra/ /don med 'khon 'dzing ma byed yon bdag rnams/ /bzang rung ngan rung g.yas g.yon khyem mtshes dgos/ /khyem mtshes sdang bo ma byed yon bdag rnams/ /phyugs la rdeg rdung byas na g.yang lha nyams/ /sgo phyugs 645

byams pas skyongs shig yon bdag rnams/ /khong khros rang gzhan gnyis phung dge rtsa 'joms/ /dgra la zhe sdang ma che yon bdag rnams/ /tshe stod gnyen yang tshe smad dgra ru 'gyur/ /gnyen la gdung sems ma che yon bdag rnams//ser sna byas na yi dwags gnas su skye/ /g.yog por lto gos byin cig yon bdag rnams/ /phyi ma'i yul la zas nor khyer sa med/ /dbul bor sbyin pa thongs shig yon bdag rnams/ /pha ma bkur na bu la bsod nams skye/ /rgas dus byams pas skyongs shig yon bdag rnams/ /mar me phul na phyi mar gzugs byad mdzes/ /lha la mar me phul cig yon bdag rnams/ /phyag dang skor bas lus kyi sgrib pa 'dag /rten la phyag skor gyis shig yon bdag rnams//kha ni kha mchu kun gyi rtsa ba yin/ /don med lab lob ma mang yon bdag rnams/ /chos kyi snying bo yi ge drug ma yin//rgyun du ma ṇi bgrongs shig yon bdag rnams/ /bsam pa bzang na ci byas chos su 'gro/ /bsam pa bzang bo gyes shig yon bdag rnams/ /bsod nams 'dzad pa'i rgyu ni bsam ngan yin/ /bsam ngan yid la ma 'dzin yon bdag rnams//dus ngan snyigs ma'i mi la blo gtad med/ /blo phugs chos la gtod cig yon bdag rnams/ /gros de 'dri na rgyal ba'i bka' la dris/ /legs nyes 646

gsal bar ston no yon bdag rnams/ /mi la ma re lha la gsol ba 'debs/ /ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub bo yon bdag rnams/ /nga ni mi sdod rgyal khams gzhan du 'gro/ /khyed rnams bde bar bzhugs shig yon bdag rnams/ /da ni 'o skol tshe 'dir mi mjal yang / /phyi mar mjal bar smon no yon bdag rnams/ /glu 'di thos tshad skye bo pho mo yis/ /gtan tu bde ba'i skyid 'go tshugs par shog /ces pa 'di yang dad can yon bdag pho mo yongs la 'gro khar smras pa'o/ /dpal ldan bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /dam ldan mched grogs rnams la thugs rjes gzigs/ /dpon gye mchog tu bla ma dam pa sten/ /dgos sar bslu ba med do mched grogs rnams/ /skyabs kyi mchog tu bslu med dkon mchog sten/ /srid zhi'i 'jigs las skyob bo mched grogs rnams/ /nor gyi mchog tu 'phags pa'i nor bdun gsogs/ /nam yang 'dzad pa med do mched grogs rnams/ /zas kyi mchog tu zag med ting 'dzin zo//bkres skom sdug bsngal sel lo mched grogs rnams//gos kyi mchog tu gtum mo'i bde drod sbor/ /dbyar dgun grang dro med do mched grogs rnams/ /nye gnas mchog tu rang gi lag pa sten/ /dgos sar nam yang sleb bo mched grogs rnams/ /khang 647

ba'i mchog tu rang byung brag phug sten/ /zhig gso thigs tshags mi dgos mched grogs rnams/ /grogs kyi mchog tu rang byung ye shes sten//dga' bde rgyun mi 'chad do mched grogs rnams//bu yi mchog tu rig pa'i khye'u gsos/ /rgyal ba'i gdung rgyud 'dzin no mched grogs rnams/ /sa zhing mchog tu 'gyur med dad pa sten/ /dge ba'i ston thog 'byung ngo mched grogs rnams/ /pha yul mchog tu phyogs med rgyal khams bzang / /phyogs ris chags sdang zad do mched grogs rnams/ /dgon gzhi'i mchog tu nges med ri khrod zungs/ /thugs dam dge sbyor 'phel lo mched grogs rnams/ /skyong rgyu'i mchog tu 'gro drug sems can skyongs/ /phan thogs shugs kyis yong ngo mched grogs rnams/ /'dul rgyu'i mchog tu rang rgyud nyon mongs thul/ /phyi dgra 'dul mi dgos so mched grogs rnams/ /las kyi mchog tu chos spyod bcu la 'bod/ /bsod nams dpag med thob bo mched grogs rnams/ /'gro 'dug mchog tu phyag dang skor ba rem/ /las ngan sdig sgrib 'dag go mched grogs rnams/ /gtam gye mchog tu chos kyi gleng mo gyis/ /thos tshad rnams la phan no mched grogs rnams/ /yi dam mchog tu thugs rje chen po sten/ /bod kyi lha skal yin no mched grogs rnams/ /kha ton mchog tu yi ge drug 648

ma bgrongs/ /chos kyi snying bo yin no mched grogs rnams/ /chos skyong mchog tu ye shes pa rnams sten/ /ko long phrag dog chung ngo mched grogs rnams/ /sgom gyi mchog tu steng nyid snying rje sgoms/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob bo mched grogs rnams/ /bde ba'i mchog tu dam pa'i lha chos gyis/ /'di phyi gnyis shar phan no mched grogs rnams/ /nga ni mi sdod yul phyogs gzhan du 'gro/ /khyed rnams 'di bzhin mdzod cig mched grogs rnams/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /yang yang mjal bar smon no mched grogs rnams//glu 'di thos tshad skye bo pho mo rnams/ /ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /cesapa 'di yang dam ldan mched grogs yongs la 'gro khar smras pa'o/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan bla ma rje//rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi gsung gi rjes 'brangs nas/ /mkhas blun yongs la phan pa'i glu dbyangs len/ /sngon dus chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po yis/ /mi dge bcu spangs khrims bsdams bod khams bskyangs/ /kha tsam min par de yi rnam thar la/ /kha mig yar lta rgyal blon kun gyis gyis/ /rgyal po zla bas dbu yang sbyin par btang / /dri med kun ldan sbyan yang sbyin la ltos/ /de 'dra'i lus srog gtong bar ma nus 649

kyang / /sbyin pa gtong ba rgyal po'i chos lugs yin/ /bung bas me tog mdangs la mi gnod bzhin/ /rim bzhin song nas sbrang rtsi len la ltos/ /rgyal pos mi ser rnams la mi gnod bzhin/ /kun la rim bzhin khral yang sdud shes gyis/ /shed mong rgyas pa'i sgo phyugs g.yag rnams la/ /'brog pa 'ga' res khrag kyang gtar ba mthong / /mi ser rnams la longs spyod 'dzoms pa'i tshe/ /khral yang cung zad skabs re bzhag na yong / /shed med g.yag la yang yang khrag gtar na/ /tha ma khrag kyang mi yong chu ser thon//mi ser rnams la yang yang khral bzhag na/ /tha ma khral kyang mi khur yul nas thon/ /mgo bo gcig pu 'tshams pas ci la phan/ /yan lag rnams kyang 'dzoms na mgo bo'i rgyan/ /rgyal po gcig pu yod pas ci la phan/ /'bangs 'khor kun kyang phyug na rgyal po'i rgyan/ /gang zhig gser gyi ri la gnas bcas na/ /de yi 'dab chags thams cad gser du 'gyur/ /chos rgyal chen po zhig la rten bcas na/ /de yi 'khor 'bangs thams cad skyid par 'gyur/ /thigs pas rgyun du brdung ba'i khang ba las/ /phye rol gad khung zhig nas bsdad pa skyid/ /dpon po zhal ngo nag pa'i ja chang las/ /g.yog po thang ka yangs pa'i chu ra skyid/ /rang la dgos pa mig gnyis yin pas 'tshos/ /ma la yod pa bu 650

tsha yin pas byams/ /'bangs la dgos pa rgyal blon yin pas bkur/ /rgyal por yod pa 'bangs rnams yin pas skyongs//'og khang bshig nas steng khang phub na yang / /steng 'og gnyis ka 'gyel ba'i las ka yin/ /mi ser gtor nas dpon pos khral bsdus kyang / /dpon g.yog gnyis ka sdug pa'i bya ba yin/ /nags tshal mang bo'i nang du bltas na yang //shing la ya yo med pa'i drang bo dkon/ /mi yang mang bo'i nang du bltas pa'i tshe/ /skyon med yon tan ldan pa re re tsam/ /gang nas tshad kyang longs pa'i ras kha gang / /gang la bstan kyang mi yis nyo ba yin/ /gang nas bltas kyang skyon med yon tan can/ /gang du song yang mi yis bkur bar 'gyur/ /lcang ma thams cad chu yi phyogs su g.yon/ /spre'u thams cad nags kyi khrod la dga'/ /gtam rnams thams cad 'dod pa'i phyogs su gtong / /mi rnams thams cad phyug po'i bu la dga'/ /lba ba med na gling phran 'ga' zhig na/ /yan lag gcig de nyams pa'i skyon du brjod/ /ngan spyod g.yo sgyu med pa'i gnyom chung la/ /bzo lta mi 'dug zer nas 'phya mi rigs/ /'bru ldan snye ma mgo bo kug nas 'dug /'bras med lang long rnams kyi mgo 'phang mtho/ /yon tan ldan na zhi zhing dul bar gnas/ /yon tan med na 651

rang mthong nga rgyal che/ /byang bstan phug par nyi ma mi 'char yang / /phyogs gzhan phug pa'i mun pa cis mi sel ma rabs rnams la bshad pas mi phan yang / /ya rabs rnams kyi sems la cis mi phan/ /byes pas rgan pa'i gtam gyi rjes bzlos shig /thub kyang de la pha mas mtshar du 'dzin/ /blo chung bdag kyang mkhas pa'i gsung bzhin du/ /'di 'dra smras la'ang mkhas pa dgyes par rigs/ /mig ldan rnams kyis mthong kyang long ba yis/ /lam der zhugs zhes bshad la 'gal ba ci/ /blo ldan rnams kyis shes kyang rmongs pa ngas/ /de ltar mdzod ces bshad la 'gal med snyam/ /gsal dwangs yid 'ong dmar ser li khri'i mtshor/ /nyi 'od lhung tshe sngar bas ches cher gsal/ /blo ldan rnams la bslab bya byas pa'i tshe/ /sngar bas sems rgyud ches cher bzang bar 'gyur/ /rnam dag 'dzin ma'i gzhi las dpag bsam shing / /rnams kyi rtsa ba brtan cing rtse mo rgyas/ /rnam dkar dge ba'i mthu las rgyal blon sras/ /rnams kyi sku tshe rgyal mtshan brtan gyur cig /rnam thos sras dang dze+e lha nor rgyun ma/ /rnams kyi nor rnams mi zad 'phel ba bzhin/ /rnam kun rje 'bangs mnga' thang 'byor ba rgyas/ /rnam mang 'gro la phan pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di ni dad gtong blo gros che ba'i man thang rgyal po la smras 652

pa'o/ /ngag gi dbang phyug rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /dbyangs can lha mos legs bshad dga' ston stsol/ /sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyi lugs srol bzhin/ /rnal 'byor ngas kyang lugs gnyis bslab bya ston/ /bya ba gang byed sngon du rtog dpyod thongs/ /ma brtags pa yi bya ba byed mi rung / /thun mong bya ba gros kyis bsgrub par bya/ /rjes nas ma 'grub na yang khag ngan med/ /dkrugs shing byed mkhan gros kyis khyur ma 'jug /bud med ngan ma'i gros la nyan mi rung / /thams cad gros byas byed ngo ma things na/ /sha tsha nyams can yul mi rgan la dris/ /gros mthil re zhig mi la ma bshad par/ /rtog dpyod zhib tu thongs dang nyen mi 'byung / /bza' mi kha 'cham zos nas tshar ba dang / /yul mi gros byas lad na 'gyod pa med/ /bya ba chen po sgrub tshe chung ngu'i nor/ /chud zos song kyang de la ser sna spang //yid la shar tshad lag tu len mi rung / /lag tu blangs tshad mtha' ru thon par bya/ /rang gis mi shes rogs la ma dris na/ /rjes nas nyes tshe 'gyod pa chen po 'ong / /ma rabs mang bo'i dpon po byed pa las/ /ya rabs shig gi g.yog po byas na skyid/ /khrel med dpon dang gnyen la re ba las/ /khrel yod 653

gzhung bzang gzhan la skyabs na bzang / /blo gtad med pa'i spun dang 'grogs pa las/ /sha tsha snying nye'i grogs dang 'grogs na bde/ /dgra la sdang kyang 'phral du mi khro bar/ /rjes su 'jam pa'i thabs kyis 'dul bar bya/ /gnyen la byams kyang kha ru mi 'don par/ /sems la bzhag nas mi mngon shugs kyis skyongs/ /zas nor 'dod kyang ham pa mi byed par/ /ngag 'jam thabs mkhas mi gnod bzhin du len/ /gnyen grogs mgron rnams thog mar 'dzum gyes bsu/ /zas skom byin na gtam snyan yong sgo mang / /lang shor rkun po mi yi khyur mi chud/ /de dang 'grogs na gtam ngan shugs kyis 'ong / /mi dga'i rnam 'gyur bstan na grogs la gzan/ /mig log btsog pa su la'ang ma ston cig /lag tu byung tshad thams cad khar ma rgyag /gsog 'jog mkhas po gyis dang phyug por 'gyur/ /rgyal po nor la ham pa mi che bar/ /rang gi longs spyod rnams kyis chog shes gyis / /'bangs rnams kun kyang phan tshun mi 'khrug par/ /dpon po'i gsung bzhin rang sar gnas na legs/ /khyim tshang kun gyes 'thab mo ma rgyag dang / /kha la za rgyu med rung sems kha bde/ /ci bsam thams cad yid bzhin 'grub pa la/ /bsod nams dpag med dgos zhes mkhas pas gsungs/ /phyi ma phar zhog 654

'jig rten khams 'dir yang / /bde ba'i thabs su tshogs bsags byed pa gces/ /tshe 'di bde rung sdug rung yud tsam yin/ /phyi mar bde thabs dam pa'i lha chos gyis/ /chos la bzang ngan med kyang pha mes dus//dar ba'i chos dang chos skyong bsten na shis/ /'di dang 'di 'dra shes nas byed pa rnams/ /mtho nas mtho ru 'gro'o shes ldan rnams/ /'di ltar bgyis pa'i rnam dkar dge ba kun/ /kun la phan thogs 'byung ba'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /mi nor zas gsum 'dzom pa'i smon lam 'debs/ /bde skyid snyan gsum 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di yang rnam dkar dge phyogs la mos pa'i glo bo khri jog rgyal po la gdams pa'o/ /shes bya kun mkhyen mkhyen rab 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /dbyangs can lha mos shes rab dngos grub stsol/ /'jig rten mi chos lugs dang lha chos lugs/ /lugs gnyis shes na 'di phyi gnyis gar bde/ /lha chos lta zhog 'jig rten mi chos kyang / /'grub phyir mchod sbyin gang nus byed pa gnad/ /drin can mi de nam yang sun ma 'jug /pha dang ma la rgas khar drin gzo gyis/ /mthon por gyur tshe rang mthong nga rgyal spongs/ /kun gyis bkur tshe spyi la byams skyong gyis/ /dgra la ha cang sdang na rang yang brlag /gnyen la ha cang byams na lang la 'chor/ /dpe ngan 655

gzhan la bton na rang la 'khor/ /tshig ngan mi la brgyab na rang la'ang 'ong / /g.yog por ha cang sdang na 'khor mkhan med/ /grogs la rngan can mang na sems la gnod/ /gzhan gyi yon tan brjod na sems la phan/ /bu la nyes skyon bshad na rjes su phan/ /snying gtam kha mang mi la mi bshad gsang / /snying nor 'dod pa can la mi ston sba/ /zas zhim skog nas ma za gzhan la byen/ /gos bzang khyem nas ma bzad khrom du ngom/ /zer tshad bden par ma 'dzin rtog dpyod thongs/ /dran tshad kha ru ma 'don khog tu chugs/ /ma bshad sus kyang mi go rgyu mtshan shod/ /ma 'bar bus kyang mi nyan rang sar rgol/ /ma bslabs sus kyang mi shes yon tan slobs/ /ma byen gnyen yang mi 'khor mkho ba byin/ /mthon po nga rgyal can gyi mtshang ma 'bru/ /bsam ngan phyi thag thung dang grogs ma byed/ /phyug pos longs spyod shes na rang gzhan skyid/ /dbul bos za shes byas na rang sdug chung / /yod pas sdug skad ma che gzhan gyes shes/ /med pos skyid 'dod ma che khyim mtshes 'phya/ /kha gdangs spar bsdams mi dang 'brel tshad 'phung / /kha 'jam g.yo sgyu can la dogs zon gyis/ /gang phan mi shes gnyom chung ris ma bor/ /gang bden mi shes gzhan la rgyu mtshan dris/ /mkhas pa ris su ma bor yon 656

tan longs/ /mi mang dgra ru ma len gnyen du khug /rdzun dang g.yo sgyu med na nam phugs bzang / /gang bcol go chod byung na bran gyi rab/ /kha nyung lag pa gtsang ba yon tan mchog /byas yus che na las la ngo so chung / /drin 'dren mang na dga' ba'i dung sems 'chor/ /gyong mang btang na gnyen yang zhen pa ldog /blo sna mang na grogs kyang snang ba sun/ /phog dug can gyi gtam gyis dgra bo 'gugs/ /mi snying bcol ba'i gtam de khar ma 'don/ /ya rabs dma' sar phab na kun la gnod/ /ma rabs mtho sar bzhag na kun la sdang / /phran bu'i khe la bltas nas nyen ma nyo/ /grogs ngan kha la nyan nas sdig ma byed/ /skyid po byung dus ma ngom sdug phongs skyongs/ /gros nyes byung dus ma ngu phyin chad gzobs/ /mi nyan pa la nan gyis gros ma 'debs/ /med pa rnams la khyer shog ma zer cig /mi yong ba la nan gyis las ma bcol/ /mi shes pa la ko long ma che zhig /'phrad ma thag tu mi la grogs ma byed/ /'dris ma thag gi grogs la blo ma gtod/ /sems la babs ma thag tu 'dzum ma ston/ /ma babs pa zhig byung rung bzhin ma gnag /dgos med mi ser mnar ba'i las ma byed/ /'bab nges khral yang ma lci yang du chugs/ /tshe 'dir de ltar byas na skyid par nges/ /phyir mar 657

skyid par 'dod na lha chos gyis//de dang de 'dra shes nas byed pa rnams/ /bde nas bde bar 'gro ba'i blo ldan rnams/ /'di ltar legs par bshad pa'i dge ba rnams/ /'di bzhin byed pa rnams la phan phyir bsngo/ /mi la tshe ring phyugs la g.yang 'khyil zhing / /sa la byin chags yul la bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di yang bsam pa bzang zhing kun la byams pa'i sgyu lung sde ba la gdams pa'o/ /mi mngon dbyings na bzhugs pa yi/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas kyis/ /snyom las mkhan la gzigs su gsol/ //gzigs nas byen gyis brlab tu gsol/ /dri med rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang / /mtshungs med bla ma'i gsung bzhin du/ /rang gis rang la gros shig 'debs/ /nyon dang tshogs drug rang grol ba/ /ngan song sdug bsngal phar la zhog /mtho ris na yang bde ba med/ /'o skol mi yi sdug bsngal ni/ /skye ba'i sdug bsngal bshad tsa na/ /rnam shes mngal na gnas pa'i dus/ /mi gtsang dong nang gnas pa 'dra/ /de nas mnga' sgor thon pa'i tshe/ /'jur mig 'phrang la drangs pa 'dra/ /stan gyi thog tu lhung ba'i tshe/ /gcer bur tsher dong lhung ba 'dra/ /thog gi dri ma 'khrud pa'i tshe/ /lus kyi pags pa bshus pa 'dra/ /mal du bsnyal nas bzhag pa'i tshe/ /bkyigs nas btson dong bzhag pa 'dra/ /rgas pa'i sdug bsngal bshad tsa 658

na/ /lus kyi stobs rnams thams cad shor/ /drang bo'i lus po gzhu dang 'dra/ /'gro ba'i tshe na gom tshugs 'khyor/ /ljon shing rlung gis bskyod pa 'dra/ /nag por skyes pa'i skra lo dkar/ /mgo yang spra ba'i me tog 'dra/ /dung so sum cu rim bzhin bud/ /kha yang brag khung skam po 'dra/ /gdong la gnyer ma mang po byung / /bzo bo zhig gi dras stan 'dra/ /na ba'i sdug bsngal bshad tsa na/ /glo bur nad kyis thebs pa de/ /bye'u chung lus la rdo phog 'dra/ /tsha grang ma snyom bsil sa ru/ /bzhag kyang me nang gnas pa 'dra/ /dro sar bzhag nas gos g.yogs kyang / /chu 'khyags nang du gnas pa 'dra/ /zhim pa'i kha zas byen na yang / /mid par mi 'gro yi dwags 'dra/ /na tsha zug gzer sdug bsngal de/ /bzod med mtshon gyis gshags pa 'dra/ /nyin dang mtshan mo mi 'khyos bar//mtshan gcig lo dang zla ba 'dra/ /'chi ba'i sdug bsngal bshad tsa na/ /drod rnams thams cad mtha' nas 'chor/ /lus po sa rdo 'khyags pa 'dra/ /kha sna'i dbugs kyi 'gyu ba chad/ /snum zad mar me shi ba 'dra/ /phung bo mal du bor ba de/ /mi gtsang phyis pa'i rdo dang 'dra/ /rnam shes bar dor 'khyams pa de/ /rgyus med sa cha'i mgron po 'dra/ /phyi ma'i skye gnas 'tshol ba de/ /sbrang mas sbrang tshang 'tshol ba 'dra/ /gar 659

'gro gtad so med pa de/ /bu chung gcig 'khyar bor ba 'dra//de 'dra'i sdug bsngal legs bsams nas/ /'khor bar phyi phyag 'tshal re ran/ /skyes pa'i rjes su 'chi ba mthong / /lang tsho ldan yang mi rtag pas/ /phung bo'i 'dzin pa blos btang nas/ /'chi med thar ba'i go 'phang snyogs/ /bsags pa'i rjes su 'dzad pa mthong //zas nor ldan yang mi rtag pas/ /nor rdzas thams cad blos btang nas/ /'dzad med 'phags pa'i nor bdun gsogs/ /brtsigs pa'i rjes su 'jig pa mthong / /rdo mkhar brtsigs kyang mi rtag pas/ /pha yul mkhar khang blos btang nas//'jig med chos nyid mkhar khang rtsigs/ /'dus pa'i rjes su 'bral ba mthong / /pha ma 'dzoms kyang mi rtag pas/ /gnyen bshes thams cad blos btang nas/ /'bral med rig pa'i grogs dang 'grogs/ /mdor na 'khor ba'i bya ba kun/ /gang yang mi rtag sdug bsngal rgyu/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang nas/ /da ni dam pa'i lha chos gyis/ /rang la phan pa'i bslab bya 'di/ /gzhan ma la yang phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang nyin zhig sems la shar ba ltar rang la smras pa'o/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug gi rgyan/ /rgyan gyis rab mjes 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /dbyangs snyan sgrog mkhas dbyangs can 660

ma/ /ma ltar brtse bas bdag gzhan skyongs/ /ci bsam thams cad 'grub pa la/ /bsod nams dpag tu med pa dgos/ /skye 'gro kun gyis bkur ba la/ /yon tan dpag tu med pa dgos/ /bla ma yan na sangs rgyas med/ /thugs la 'bab pa'i zhabs tog dgos/ /pha ma yan na drin can med/ /sems la phan pa'i drin gzo dgos/ /srog gcod yan na sdig pa med/ /srog la babs kyang 'dzem pa dgos/ /rang gi lus la rang gis mtshon/ /tshad kyang 'go ba'i lha rnams 'bros/ /gzhan la dug mtshon ngan sngags byed/ /snyam kyang rang gi bsod nams 'dzad/ /kun la phan pa nyi ma yin/ /phyi mar phan pa lha chos yin/ /gzhung la 'bab pa chu bo yin/ /dmyal bar ltung ba sdig pa yin/ /yang yang brdar na lcags kyang zad/ /yun ring bsgoms na nyon mongs thul/ /ljon shing rgas pa bal 'dab chags/ /sgom chen rgas pa nyams rtogs ldan/ /khyi rgan rgas kyin zhe sdang che/ /mi rgan rgas kyin 'dod pa che/ /kun la mkho ba bde skyid yin/ /bde ba'i rgyu de dge ba yin/ /sus kyang mi 'dod sdug bsngal yin/ /sdug bsngal rgyu de sdig pa yin/ /'di phyi gnyis gar phan pa'i phyir/ /dge sdig gnyis kyi blang dor gyis/ /chos kun gnad du dril na de/ /de bzhin byas na 'phral phugs bde/ /bde thabs 661

mdzod cig rigs kyi bu/ /bu rnams yongs la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang nyin zhig sems la shar ba ltar slob ma rnams la phan phyir bris pa'o/ /rab mdzes gzugs sku'i nyin byed dbang bo skye dgu kun gye gtsug na mdzes/ /rab snyan gsung dbyangs legs bshad 'od kyis thub bstan pad+mo'i tshal rnams bzhad/ /rab 'byams mkhyen dang brtse ba'i thugs rje'i drod kyis ris med 'gro la phan/ /rab gsal rje btsun nyi ma khyod la phyogs nas bstod bsngags me tog thor/ /skyid grong phyogs su gzugs sku'i dpag bsam shing / /legs 'khrungs 'phrin las yal 'dab phyogs kun rgyas/ /nyams rtogs yon tan me tog ci yang bkra/ /don gnyis lhun grub 'bras bu smin 'di mtshar/ /chos kun tshig don thams cad mkhyen pa'i mkhas/ /nyes kun dri mas nam yang ma gos btsun/ /'gro kun bu ltar brtse bas skyong ba'i bzang / /rnam kun mgon khyod gtsug tu bkur bar 'os/ /dben gnas brag dkar mi nub rgyal mtshan rtser/ /rje btsun yid bzhin nor bu khyed bzhugs nas/ /zab rgyas chos kyi dgos 'dod 'chad pa'i tshe/ /nyan po'i yid kyi re ba ci yang skong / /thog mar zang zing sbyin pa'i lag pa g.yab/ /mgon med sems can mang bo 'khor du bsdus/ /gang 'dod chos kyi dga' ston legs bkyes nas/ /662

thams cad tshims par mdzad mkhan khyed min su/ /rnam dag smin byed dbang bzhi'i chu bo yis//gdul bya'i shes rgyud zhing sa brlan par byas/ /grol byed khrid kyi sa bon legs btab tshe/ /mchog thun dngos grub 'bras bu ci yang smin/ /nyams rtogs g.yu ral rgyas pa'i seng chen khyed/ /nges don zab mo'i nga ro cher bsgrags tshe/ /skal med ri dwags rgyang na'ang snying rtsa 'dar/ /skal bzang seng phrug mdun na dga' bas rtse/ /lung rtogs yon tan rtsal ldan g.yu 'brug khyed/ /skabs re snyan brgyud sgra dbyangs bsgrags pa'i tshe/ /blo chung bya bye'u 'ga' re bag 'khum kyang / /blo ldan rma bya dga' dad zlos gar bsgyur/ /mkhyen pa'i spyan ldan lha dbang brgya byin khyed/ /mi 'jigs spobs pa'i glang chen steng 'gyeng nas/ /rtsod lan lung rigs gnam lcags 'khor lo de/ /'phangs tshe rgol ngan lha min dpung tshogs 'joms/ /rab yangs thugs kyi shel dkar bum bzang las/ /rab legs rtsom pa'i bdud rtsi dal gyes 'bab/ /rab mang gdul bya rnams kyis ngoms med 'thungs/ /rab dkar bum pa zhig las khyod nyid mtshar/ /gzugs sku'i nyi ma mthong na na chung mdzes kyang de la su zhig blta/ /gsung snyan tshangs dbyangs bsgyur na pi wang bsgyur na de la su zhig nyan/ /brtse 663

ba'i thugs kyis bskyangs na dpon po bzang yang de la su zhig gus/ /khyod kyi yon tan bsams na mkhas rlom mang yang de la su zhig 'dud/ /skyabs mgon khyed ni rtag tu cis mi bkur/ /yid la khyed kyi yon tan dran pa dang / /ngag gis khyed la bstod dbyangs sgog bzhin du/ /lus kyis khyed la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod tshogs kun 'bul sdig pa spyan sngar bshags/ /mdzad par yi rang chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /dge tshogs zhabs pad brtan pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /'gro ba'i don mdzad mdzad bzang chos kyi rje/ /rje btsun ngag dbang dbang phyug brgyad ldan khyod/ /khyod kyi rjes 'jug mjug na yod tshad kun/ /kun mkhyen myur thob thob nas 'gro 'dren shog /phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan/ /bstan 'dzin sbyin bdag 'gro ba'i bde skyid kun//kun nas 'phel zhing rgyas te yongs la khyab/ /khyab pa mi nyams gong du 'phel gyur cig /ces bstod bsngags me tog pad+ma dkar bo'i phreng bas sdun bsus te rab tu gus pas 'dod pa'i don 'ga' zhig tshig lhug par grol nas zhus pas lan du slar yang 'di skad ces gsung snang / sna tshogs chos tshul mtha' dag 'gal med rtogs/ /rigs drug yid can nyam thag snying rjes 'dzin/ /rang nyid zhi bde ma 664

yin gzhan don du/ /rjes chags grol ba'i dpal ster gang zhabs su/ /chos med chos kyi rgyus lon dred por song / /dbang med 'dir snang dbang song dkor zan mkhan/ /phyug po'i gral bud phyug por yid smon pa'i/ /bya mang bya bral yin zer des zhu ba/ /yang yang sngon nas legs legs tshogs gnyis mang mang bsags pa khyod sku'i nyi/ /mog mog sgrib med gsal gsal dwangs la lhag lhag gzi byen mtshungs pa med/ /snyan snyan legs bshad khrol khrol smra la thog thog 'dzer med mkhyen pa'i dpal/ /lhod lhod mnyam bzhag 'bol 'bol ngang nas lhug lhug gsung 'phrin skyes bzang bcas/ /myos ldan gnam lo'i rang zhal gsar ngom pa'i/ /dge mtshan thog ma'i rten 'byung nyid du 'dir/ /son pa'i dga' ba rgyas pa'i khong 'dzum ni/ /bsam gtan dang po'i ro la chags pa snyam/ /bstod yul 'os su bdag 'dra mi che yang / /bstod bsngags dam par 'os pa'i tshig phreng ni/ /bstod dbyangs snyan 'gyur bsngags 'os pad dkar phreng / /bstod tshig cod paṇa mgul rgyan 'os su thob/ /'on te mi gtsang phung bo dag la sa le sbram dang blun po la/ /mkhas par sgo btags sgren mo'i lus la mdzes mar brjod dang mu to zhig /rnam thos bur btags dpyod ldan rnams kyi ngang tshul 665

rigs min 'dir yang ches/ /gsung gis bsngags pa'i khur chen 'di ni lci phyir ma theg logs shig bzhag /de na'ang chos kun rten cing 'brel 'byung phyir/ /deng sang de 'dra'i yon tan dri med kyang / /nam zhig brtson na go 'phang cha shas tsam/ /reg gyur dbugs dbyung nyams sad mdzad dam ci/ /khyod ni gtsang byas gtsang ma'i gos bklubs sdom gsum ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin/ /mang thos chos tshul oṃ yig glur len dam pa'i rigs kyi tshangs skud can/ /nyams rtogs yon tan rtsal rdzogs mtshon phyir rang rtags ral ba'i gdengs ka 'chang / /dben par rab zhi'i ting 'dzin mi g.yo drang srong khyod 'dra gang nas byon/ /ston thog 'bru sna dus bzhir bsdus kyang dpyid dus brgyags zad bsnyung bar gnas/ /ri ngogs ljon shing mang kyang thab khar chu shing gnyis spangs mi la bzhin/ /bod rong tshong 'dus 'dod dgu 'dzoms kyang kha 'gegs yi dwags gter srung dngos/ /wa ti bzang bo'ang skyo bas ngal ba'i phyag g.yon dkur brten no/ /khyad par dge ba'i bshes la log par 'khu ba shin tu mang / /chags sdang me dpung g.yo bas rang gzhan rtswa phung lhag med bsreg /'dod dang brnab sems ngan g.yo gya gyu'i rba rlabs cher 'khrugs pa'i/ /kho bo'i skye yul phyogs de'i tshul 'dra gar 666

yang yod ma yin/ /de 'dra'i gshis lugs mtshar bo'i gzigs mo la/ /re zhig brtse bas byams bzhin dgyes bzhugs te/ /bsngags 'os dam pa'i mdzad bzang gong 'phel nas/ /dpyid kyi dpal mo'i lang tsho gsar bar 'gran/ /dri bral dag pa thugs kyi a dar+shar/ /sna tshogs chos kun ri mo'i gzugs 'char mod/ /rnam par rtog med zab zhi'i dbyengs chen por/ /dgyes par rtsen na grub pa'i tshul zhes bsngags/ /zhes snyan 'gyur mgrin pa'i lam nas drangs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa sngon du gsol nas/ skabs don tshigs lhug par grol nas gsungs pa rnams 'dir ma spras so/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan thub dbang rje/ /rje btsun ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /dbyangs can lha mo lha chen tshangs pa rnams/ /rnam mang 'gro la chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed/ /lha rnams kun kyi mchog gyur dzam+bha la/ /lha mo rnams kyi gtso mo nor rgyun ma/ /lha yi dbang bo rnam thos sras la sogs/ /lha rnams kun gyis chos kyi mthun rkyen stsol/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa ma dar zhing / /dar kyang rjes su nyams pa'i sa phyogs su/ /bdag gis sna tshogs thabs kyis bstan pa btsugs/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par shog /phan pa'i chos 'di 'bri 'don klog pa dang / /phan tshun 'chad cing 667

nyan pa thams cad la/ /phan yon byin rlabs dngos grub 'byung ba dang / /phan mdzad lha yis rtag tu grogs byed shog /gang la phan bde ster ba'i glegs bam 'di/ /gang du gnas pa'i yul la bkra shis shing / /gang du bzhag pa'i sa la byin chags nas/ /gang gis mthong thos dran reg sangs rgyas shog /de bzhin bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs shig /'byung bar rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin gyis rlobs/ /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyis dngos grub stsol/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung mas grogs mdzod cig /ces glegs bam gyi mjug gi smon tshig 'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o/ /'di dag rnams kyis kyang bstan pa dang 'gro ba yongs la phan thogs par gyur cig /668

bal yul mchod rten rnam gnyis la mjal du phebs pa'i lam skabs dang bka' brgyud gong ma'i gdan sa 'brog la phyi gangs kyi ra ba nas bzhengs pa'i skor/na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣa ya/ myur du smin cing grol bar byin brlab pa'i/ /dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag dang 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi/ /shes rgyud smin cing grol bar byin gyes rlobs/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol mdzad pa'i/ /yi dam lha tshogs rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag dang 'gro ba sems can thams cad la/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad kun sel ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag dang 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi/ /'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad bsal du gsol/ /dpal ldan rtsa gsum lha yi skyabs 'og tu/ /bsdad nas 669

lha chos byed pa'i zhabs dkar bas/ /bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i lhag bsam gyes/ /zab rgyas chos kyi glu dbyangs blangs pa la/ /bla mar dad gus grogs la brtse gdung che/ /'gro la snying rje chos la dag snang can/ /skal ldan slob ma yon bdag thams cad kyis/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sems kyis legs par nyon/ /de yang sa steng 'di na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba'i gnas chen gsum gye nang nas mchog tu gyur pa yi dam bde mchog 'khor lo'i gsung gi gnas/ sprin dang na bun 'khor zhing ngo mtshar 'ja' 'od 'khrigs pa'i zhing / sngon byon mkhas grus du mas grub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs shing rtogs pa'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i lte ba 'brog la phyi gangs kyi ra ba'i dben gnas bdud 'dul phug nas sgrub la gzhol bzhin skal ldan gyi slob ma yon bdag pho mo dad can brgya phrag du ma la chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed dus/ zhal gdams mgur dbyangs sna tshogs blangs pa'i tshul ni 'di ltar ro//mi nub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid rtse'i bar ches cher bsgreng mkhas grub pa'i dbang phyug mchog /rje btsun chen po skal ldan rgya mtsho yi/ /yang sprul 'khrul med mchog gi zhabs drung du/ /pha yul dgon sde gang yang ma zin par/ /phyogs med rgyal 670

khams nyul ba'i sprang bo ba/ /tshe 'di'i dgra 'dul gnyen skyong bsgrub ma langs/ /dben par sos dal sdod pa'i snyom las mkhan/ /gangs ri'i zhabs rjes dkar mor yun ring du/ /bsdad pa'i shugs kyis ming la zhabs dkar zhes/ /phyogs 'dir 'bod pa'i chos pa'i tha shal ngas/ /zol med sgo gsum gus pas 'di skad zhu/ /sngar med 'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dpon mchog /khyed kyi sku na phra mo'i dus skabs nas/ /zab rgyas chos kyi nor bu lon 'dug ces/ /thos pas ngo mtshar dga' spro dpag med byung / /phran kyang chung nas chos kyi sgor zhugs kyang / /dam chos byed blo'i ngang la mi tshe rgas/ /da ni rgan po 'chi la thag nye yang / /da dung ma shi lus sems bde bar mchis /mtshams kyi zhu gsol byes pa chung ngu yis/ /pha mar bslab bya byed bzhin mgon khyod la/ /blo dman bdag gi sems la gang shar gyi/ /tshig 'ga' zhu la brtse bas gsan par 'tshal/ /da snga phan chad yul phyogs skye 'gro la/ /nad yams 'khrug rtsod med par bkra shis shing / /lo legs 'bru nor rgyas shing chos 'phel ba/ /rje btsun khyed kyi bka' drin yin par 'khums/ /da dung 'brel tshad don ldan dge ba'i bshes/ /khyed kyi grwa tshang slob ma sbyin bdag gi /bya spyod ngan pa gzigs kyang thugs ma sun/ /dper na ma yis 671

bu bzhin brtse bas skyongs/ /mgon khyod bdag cag gdul bya'i snang ngo ru/ /bsnyung dang bgres tshul tsam yang mi ston par/ /dgung lo brgya phrag mang bo bzhugs dgos zhes/ /lag gnyis thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs/ /snga sor snyan pa rgyang nas thos pa tsam/ /ma gtogs mngon sum zhal ngo mi 'tsho yang da ni myur du zhal mjal gsung chos nyan/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i smon lam 'tshal/ /de skad zhu chung khu byug sngon mo yis/ /dri med lha rdzas dar gye 'dab gshog brgyangs/ /legs bshad tshig gi skad snyan sgrog bzhin du/ /rje btsun dpag bsam ljon shing drung du 'phur/ /de ltar legs par phul ba'i dge tshogs mthus/ /bla ma rnams kyi sku tshe mdzad 'phrin rgyas/ /dge 'dun sde rnams khrims gtsang bshad sgrub 'phel/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho'i yang sprul sku gzhogs shar rin po che la 'tshams zhus su la phyi nas phul ba'o/ /sku drin bla ma gzhan las ches che zhing / /sha tsha tshe 'di'i ma las lhag pa yi/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /pad+ma bzhad pa rdo rje'i zhabs drung du/ /dam pa khyed kyis brtse bas rjes bzung ba'i/ /slob bu'i tha shal byams pa chos dar ngas/ /672

thag ring ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal nas/ /rab tu dad cing gus pas zhu yig 'bul/ /ma rig mun pa sel ba'i nyi ma mchog /nyon mongs tsha gdung sel ba zla ba'i 'od/ /sgye dgu'i 'dod don skong ba'i nor bu dang / /mtshungs pa'i rje btsun bla ma dam pa khyed/ /'gro ba'i don du zhabs pad brtan 'dug ces/ /thos pa tsam gyis dga' bde 'char ba'i gtam/ /snyan po thos pa'i mod la rab dga'i sa/ /thob pa lta bu'i dga' spro tshad med thob/ /phran kyang dam pa khyed kyi bka' drin gyis/ /da bar rgyal khams gang du song na yang / /lus la nad dang sems la sdug bsngal rigs/ /gang yang med par shin tu bde bar mchis/ /mtshams kyi zhu gsol skyabs mgon khyed kyi zhal/ /mjal snying skom pa chu 'dod ltar byung mod/ /'on kyang skye ba sngon ma'i las dbang gis/ /sprang bo'i nyi ma lam nas shor bud song / /lo mang ma mjal ba la shin tu skyo/ /da ni 'chi bdag dbang du ma song na/ /kha tsam min par snying nas mjal rtsis yod/ /gser zhal myur du mjal ba'i skyabs 'jug mkhyen/ /ma mjal bar du dam pa khyed nyid kyang / /dgung lo mtho rung bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /da nas 'azung ste sangs rgyas ma thob bar/ /brtse ba chen pos rjes su gzung du gsol/ /bla ma 673

shin tu yid la 'khreng ba'i brda'/ /tshe rabs brgya phrag du mar rjes 'dzin phyir/ /rang gi lag tu yun ring bzung ba yi/ /pad+ma'i snying bo'i phreng ba brgya rtsa la/ /rin chen byu ru'i rgyan gyes mdzes par byas/ /la phyi bdud 'dul phug nas zla tshes phul/ /tshe rabs kun tu rje btsun bla ma yis/ /'bral med rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni rang gi yul phyogs kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma mkhan chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen pad+ma bzhad pa'i rdo rje rin po che la phul ba'o/ /rang yul skyid pa'i 'byung gnas kyi/ /phyug po ya rabs dad pa can/ /zho 'ong dpon po pha bu sogs/ /dad can skya ser thams cad la/ /phyogs med rgyal khams gang bzang dang / /nges med ri khrod nyams dga' rnams/ /'grim pa'i tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /phan pa'i snying gtam 'di nyid 'bul/ /skyes pa thams cad 'che la ltos/ /'dus pa thams cad 'bral la ltos/ /bsags pa thams cad 'dzad la ltos/ /gang la'ang snying bo med la ltos/ /snying bo med pa'i bya ba spongs/ /snying bo'i lha chos byed 'dod na/ /snying nor khyer la byang lam nas/ /snying rus can rnams dbus su shog /skyes pa mi yis mi tshor zhing / /rgas pa rang gis ma tshor bar/ /byas nas phyi mar ma 'gro bar/ /dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du shog /jo shāka rnam gnyis dbus na 674

snang / /rgyal ba yab sras dbus na bzhugs/ /ser 'bras dge gsum dbus na yod/ /dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du shog /snying nas chos phyir mi 'ong kyang / /ltad mo sna tshogs dbus na gda'/ /gzhon nu sa lta yul lta'i phyir/ /dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du shog /ltad mo'i phyir du mi 'ong kyang / /gang 'dod nor rdzas dbus na gda'/ /phyug po nyo tshong phyir du yang / /dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du shog /'ong dus gos bzang gyon la shog /rta yang bzang bo zhon la shog /grogs kyang bzang bo khrid la shog /zas nor gang bzang khyer la shog /de skad smras pa thos tshad po/ /rta bzang lcag gis bskul ba bzhin/ /ring min myur du dbus su yong / /slar yang yul du sleb par shog /ces pa 'di yang rang gi pha yul phyogs kyi dpon po ya rabs dad can rnams la gnas chen la phyi nas springs pa'o/ /dad brtson shes rab snying rje can/ /slob bu pad+ma rang grol dang / /yang slob yon tan kun bzang sogs/ /slob ma yang slob thams cad la/ /bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /thag ring ri khrod dben pa nas/ /snying nor bskur rgyu ma mchis kyang / /snying gtam yi ger bkod nas 'bul/ /'chi nges nam 'chi cha med kyang / /bla ma mchog gsum thugs rje yis/ /khyed rnams bde 675

bar yod las che/ /nga yang da lta bde bar yod/ /dang po nged rnams lhan cig 'tshogs/ /bar du da lta so sor gyes/ /tha ma 'jig rten pha rol 'gro/ /da lta mjal na skal ba bzang / /khyed rnams na so gzhon thog 'dir/ /khams gseng sa lta yul lta dang / /pha rgan nga dang 'phrad pa'i phyir/ /dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du shog /nga ni mar la 'ong bsams kyang / /sgrub pa blo yis ma thongs par/ /sngar yang phyogs 'dir lo mang lus da dung lo 'ga' lus nyen gda'/ /khyed rnams kun gye bsam pa la/ /nga ni mar la sleb 'ong snyam/ /lo re bzhin du bltas nas bsdad/ /yar la dbus su ma 'ongs na/ /nga yang na so rgas dang gcig /sa yang kha thag ring dang gnyis/ /nam 'chi nges pa med dang gsum/ /de gsum mdzom pa'i dus tshod na/ /mjal ba'i rten 'brel 'dzol nyen gda'/ /'on kyang tshe mjug 'di nyid la/ /dngos sam nyams dang rmi lam la/ /yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /gal te tshe 'dir ma mjal na/ /skye ba 'di yi 'og rol tu/ /mngon dga'i zhing nas mjal bar smon/ /smon pa bzhin du 'grub par shog /ces pa 'di yang rang gi yul phyogs kyi skal ldan slob ma yang slob rnams la gnas chen la phyi nas springs pa'o/ /'jig rten khams dang phyogs bcu'i zhing khams na/ /676

bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams/ /bdag gzhan yongs la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran par byen gyes rlobs/ /phyogs med rgyal khams 'grim pa'i rnal 'byor ngas/ /bshul ring mgron po'i lam glu ji bzhin du/ /thag ring ri khrod dben pa 'grim bzhin du/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran pa'i glu dbyangs len/ /bshul ring lam la zhugs pa'i mgron po rnams/ /ngal zhing dub pa'i dus su glu dbyangs 'dra/ /gzhan gyis blangs pa go tshe khams sangs te/ /sems kyang spro nas de la nyan pa bzhin/ /phyi ma'i yul la 'gro ba'i skye bo rnams/ /na so rgas pa'i dus su mgur dbyangs 'dra/ /blangs pa thos na sems la phan thogs yong / /de phyir ma yengs rnal 'byor glu 'dir nyon/ /zla ba skar ma thams cad shul du bzhag /'od gsal nyi ma nub rir yib la ltos/ /'di yang mi rtag ston pa'i slob dpon yin/ /mi rtag dran na dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /sdod gnas ljon shing thams cad shul du bzhag /'dab chags bya dang bye'u 'phur la ltos/ /'di yang mi rtag ston pa'i slob dpon yin/ /mi rtag dran na dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /spang gzhongs ne'u gsing thams cad shul du bzhag /yid 'ong ri dwags yul gzhan song la ltos/ /'di yang mi rtag ston pa'i slob dpon 677

yin/ /mi rtag dran na dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /dgon gnas grwa btsun thams cad shul du bzhag /bla ma phal cher zhing gzhan gshegs la ltos/ /'di yang mi rtag ston pa'i slob dpon yin/ /mi rtag dran na dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /bu nor zhing khang thams cad shul du bzhag /drin can pha dang ma yang shi la ltos/ /'di yang mi rtag ston pa'i slob dpon yin/ /mi rtag dran na dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /pha yul nye 'brel thams cad shul du bzhag /rnal 'byor ngas kyang ri khrod 'grim la ltos/ /'di yang mi rtag ston pa'i slob dpon yin/ /mi rtag dran na dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /mdor na mi rtag 'chi ba myur du 'ong / /mi dge sdig pa spongs la dge ba sgrubs/ /rgan gzhon med par bsam pa bzang bo gyis/ /nga dang 'phrad kyang bshad rgyu 'di las med/ /'on kyang mjal snying 'dod pa'i dad can la/ /da dung tshe 'dir mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /gal te tshe 'dir mjal bar ma gyur na/ /phyi mar dag pa'i zhing nas mjal bar shog /ces pa 'di ni rang gi pha yul gyi gnyen nye ba yon bdag pho mo dad can rnams la gnas chen la phyi nas springs pa'o//drin can bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /chos bzhin bsgrub par byen gyis rlobs/ /yul la zhen na chos pa min/ /pha yul spangs 678

na chos byed sla/ /bsam blo mang bo bdud kyi las/ /rtog med nyams la ci yang 'char/ /smra ba mang bo sdig pa'i rgyu/ /kha rog bsdad pa gdams ngag zab/ /'gro 'dug mang bo dge sbyor dgra/ /gnas gcig bsdad na thugs dam 'phel/ /ser snas bsags na mi 'phel ba/ /mkha' 'gro spyi yi dam tshig yin/ /btang nas nyung du mi 'gro ba/ /nor lha spyi yi dam tshig yin/ /phyug po longs spyod 'phel 'dod na/ /sbyin pa gtong ba man ngag yin/ /phongs pa slong ba 'du ba bzhin/ /'bul bar 'dod pa de bas mang / /rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa la/ /'tsho ba snang srid lha 'dres sbyor/ /dge slong tshul khrims ldan pa la/ /dkar phyogs lha mis bsnyen bkur byed/ /sgom chen ri la sdod tshugs na/ /zan gong gyen la 'dril nas 'ong / /byang chub sems gnyis 'byongs tsa na/ /skye 'gro ma lus dbang du 'du/ /'di rnams dam pa gong ma yi/ /gsung bzhin bdag gis bshad pa yin/ /tshig 'di ma brjed yid la zungs/ /thos tshad yongs la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang bla ma la mos gus che zhing dben par sgrub la gzhol ba'i rtsib ri ba gang shar rang grol dang / khams pa dge ba gong 'phel sogs dad can tshe blos btang nas ri khrod dben par sdod pa'i slob ma mang bo la phan phyir smras pa'o/ /e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /snying nas dam pa'i chos byed 679

na/ /nam 'chi cha med yang yang soms/ /bu dang chung ma blo yis thongs/ /smyo chu chang yang dug bzhin spongs/ /ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal snyegs/ /gcig pur ri dwags bzhin du sdod/ /'phral la zas 'tshol bya ltar gyis/ /sgom yun ma thung tshe dang snyoms/ /le lo ma che brtson 'grus skyed/ /snying rus ma chung dka' ba spyod/ /bya byed ma mang chos la 'bod/ /lha chos byen na mang mi dgos/ /bla mar snying nas gsol ba thobs/ /yi dam lha yi bsnyen sgrub gyis/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma mchod/ /gzhan yang tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong gyes/ /khyad par byang chub sems gnyis sgoms/ /bsngo ba sgon lam rgya chen thobs/ /de ltar byas na don gnyis 'grub/ /snying gtam ma brjed sems la chongs/ /zhes pa 'di yang dad gus dag snang che ba'i mtsho gsham bla ma sprul sku dang / gzhung gi bla ma tshe dbang nor bu/li sde ba go'i bla ma sogs rong phyogs kyi slob ma bu chen yongs la gdams pa'o/ /na mo gu ru/ dam pa'i chos kyi sgor zhugs nas/ /ngan sngags bsgrub pa ngo re tsha/ /sdom pa bsrung bar khas blangs nas/ /nag chang bsten pa ngo re tsha/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /skur ba 'debs pa ngo re tsha/ /phung bo mi gtsang rkyal ba la/ /bye dor byed pa ngo re tsha/ /theg pa chen por khas blangs nas/ /snying rje med pa ngo re tsha/ /gsang sngags zab mo'i sgor zhugs nas/ /680
