dam tshig med pa ngo re tsha/ /gzhan gyis mthong na ngo tsha ba'i/ /bya byed de 'dra ma byed ang / /gzhan las lhag par bya ba'i phyir/ /thos pa byed pa log pa yin/ /rnyed dang grags pa 'byung ba'i phyir/ /bka' chos 'chad pa log pa yin/ /sgom gyi gdams pa med bzhin du/ /sams gtan bsgom pa log pa yin/ /rang la rnyed bkur 'ong du re/ /tshul khrims bsrung ba log pa yin/ /thams cad dbang du bsdu ba'i phyir/ /sbyin pa gtong ba log pa yin/ /zas nor mang bo 'ong ba'i phyir/ /bla ma byed pa log pa yin/ /gzhan gyis rig na zhen log pa'i/ /log pa de 'dra ma byed ang / /gcig pur ri khrod dben pa 'grims/ /grogs su lha srin sde brgyad yod/ /yengs med rang gi sems la ltos/ /sangs rgyas sems la rnyed nas yong / /bla ma 'bral med spyi bor sgoms/ /byin rlabs char ltar babs nas yong / /bla ma'i bka' dang ma 'gal na/ /thugs yid gcig tu 'dres nas yong / /lus srog thed la bor la sgoms/ /'khrul ba'i phu thag chod nas yong / /rnam rtog mun pa dwangs su chugs/ /chos sku'i nam mkha' langs nas yong / /zhes pa 'di yang zhabs phyi re gnyis kyis chos min gyi bya ba ngo tsha ba'i las byed pa mthong bas rkyen byas nas thab tshang nang ba rnams la gdams pas slar yang chos bzhin byed pa'i bsam sbyor dang ldan par gyur to// 681

bsod nams med pa'i mi yis nor/ /bsags kyang gsog pa'i nges pa med/ /gal te bsags kyang gzhan gyes khyer/ /rang gis spyod pa'i nges pa med/ /don med zas nor gsog pa'i phyir/ /sdig pa chen po ma gsogs shig /dge ba chen bo mi nus kyang / /nyal ldang dus su dkon mchog la/ /dmigs pa'i lha phyag gsum re 'tshol/ /ma ṇi brgya rtsa tsam re bgrongs/ /rang gis ci za ci 'thung gi /phud kyis bla ma dkon mchog mchod/ /sprang bo nyam thag sgo rtsa ru/ /byung ba kha stong ma zlog cig /de rnams 'gro zhor 'dug zhor la/ /'ong ba'i dge ba yin pas na/ /nyin re bzhin du ma chag dang / /'di phyi gnyis gar bde bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di yang dad can chu dbar brin gye yon bdag pho mo dang / gnya' nang ba'i yon bdag 'ga' zhig la phan pa'i phyir du smras pa'o/ / steng phyogs dga' ldan gye lha gnas 'jig rten 'dir 'phos 'dra'i/ /dbus gtsang dag zhing du skyes pa'i las can tsho'i skyid pa/ /'jig rten mi chos dang lha chos gnyis ka ni 'dzom snang / /khral dang 'u lag gnyis med na de bas rang skyid snyam/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha gnas mi yul du chags 'dra'i/ /yul bzang bal yul du skyes pa'i pho mo tsho'i skyid pa/ /mi nor zas gsum kun 'dzoms pas sdug bsngal ni mi snang / /dmag 682

'khrug las ka de med na de bas rang skyid snyam/ /dag pa mkha' spyod dang mtshungs pa'i la phyi yi gangs ra/ /bal bod gnyis ka yis bgrod dka'i sa mtshams na chags 'dug /lha chos byed mkhan la gegs dang bar chad ni mi snang / /mthun rkyen 'dzom po zhig byung na de bas rang skyid snyam/ /gnas chen 'di ka na gnas pa'i bya btang gi rnal 'byor/ /zhabs dkar dpon slob tsho'i snang ba'i bde zhad la gzigs dang / /me tog sna tshogs kun bkra ba'i bsil grib tu 'khod nas/ /stong nyid snying rje tsho bsgoms na de bas rang skyid snyam/ /phyogs med rgyal khams la song bas ltad mo kun mthong byung / /nges med ri khrod la bsdad pas snang so ni bde snang / /gu yangs yan pa nga'i snang ba'i bde zhad la gzigs dang / /phyi ma dag zhing kun bgrod tshe de bas rang skyid snyam/ /rang gzhan don gnyis kun 'grub pa'i rang blo ni bde byung / /bde skyid snyam gsum kun 'dzoms dus glu dbyangs rang los len/ /skyid pa'i rgyang glu 'di kha nas rang bzhin gyes thon song / /thos tshad thams cad kyis 'di bzhin byas na rang snyam byung / /zhes pa 'di yang dben gnas la phyi nas shin tu skyid pa'i shugs kyis kha nas thon pa'o/ /rje mi la ras pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /tshe blo yis thongs par 683

byen gyis rlobs/ /sprang nga yi rjes 'jug bu slob rnams/ /yid ma yengs pha yi glu 'dir nyon/ /dpe zla ba sprin gyis bsgribs pa bzhin/ /tshe 'di snang blo yis ma thongs na/ /skyon gcig gis yon tan kun bsgribs nas/ /chos mang bo shes rung phan mi thogs/ /dpe nyi ma sprin dang bral ba bzhin/ /tshe 'di nyid blo yis thongs tsa na/ /gnad gcig gis skyon rnams kun sangs nas/ /chos gang shes de yis yongs la phan/ /chos 'di la gnad gcig shes pa gces/ /khyed bu slob rnams kyis ma shes na/ /gnad gcig po tshe blos gtong ba yin/ /da tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis thongs/ /blos gtong thabs man ngag mang na yang / /gnad nam 'chi cha med yang yang soms/ /sems rnam par mi rtog ye shes sgoms/ /de gnad du song na blo yis thongs/ /blos thongs phyin chos kyi phyed ka 'grub/ /las ngan pa'i sdig pa rang sar 'gags/ /nyon mongs pa rnams kyang rang sar zhi/ /chos byas tshe rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub/ /don de ltar go ba'i slob ma rnams/ /tshe blos shongs dben par sgrub la gzhol/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa thos tshad kyis/ /tshe 'di yi bya ba blos thongs shog /ces pa 'di yang dad brtson shes rab snying rje dang ldan pa'i slob bu mkhas pa dang / grub chen sogs tshe blos gtong 'dod pa rnams la smras pa'o/ /684

sngon sangs rgyas 'gro la chos 'khor bskor/ /dpe de bzhin da lta snyigs dus 'dir/ /sprang bdag la bka' chos stsol mkhan gye/ /rje bla ma sangs rgyas gus pas 'dud/ /dpe bzhag nas yang yang ma bshad na/ /khyed glen pa 'ga' res go ba dka'/ /don de phyir snang ba dper bzhag nas/ /glu rnar snyan yid 'bab len gyis nyon/ /was kha zas thob snyam lung stong 'grim/ /dpe de bzhin lto re thob snyam nas/ /gnas ri khrod dben pa 'grims gyur na/ /wa lung stong 'grims 'dra'i sgom chen yin/ /khyes zhal zas rku snyam lha khang bskor/ /dpe de bzhin nor re e thob snyam/ /gzhan rgyal khams mang bo bskor gyur na/ /khyes lha khang bskor 'dra'i sgom chen yin/ /bya 'ug rgan brag la gnas nas dgod/ /dpe de bzhin brag la gnas na yang / /gzhan chos par gtam ngan sgogs pa de/ /bya 'ug rgan 'dra ba'i sgom chen yin/ /bya chos med gong mo ri la gnas/ /dpe de bzhin ri khrod mthon por gnas/ /chos zab mo nyams su ma blangs na/ /bya gong mo 'dra ba'i sgom chen yin/ /seng gangs la bsdad pas rtsal gsum rdzogs/ /dpe de bzhin gangs rir sgrub pa mdzad/ /mchog sku gsum go 'phang brnyes pa de/ /seng dkar mo 'dra ba'i sgom chen yin/ /rgod brag la gnas nas mkha' la 'phur/ /dpe de bzhin 685

brag la rtse gcig bsgoms/ /yar sangs rgyas sa ru bgrod pa de/ /bya rgod po 'dra ba'i sgom chen yin/ /steng nyi mas gling bzhi'i mun pa sel/ /dpe de bzhin rgyal khams 'grims pa'i tshe/ /gzhan bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa de/ /steng nyi ma 'dra ba'i sgom chen yin/ /yar bkur na nor bu'i dgos 'dod 'byung / /dpe de bzhin mchod cing gsol btab na/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub ster ba de/ /yar nor bu 'dra ba'i sgom chen yin/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /seng bya rgod nyi ma nor bu dang / /chos mtshungs pa'i bya btang sgom chen pas/ /mtho ri khrod thams cad khyab par shog /ces pa 'di yang dad ldan spu trengs phyag mdzod dang / gnyer ba a mchog la dwags mkhan po/ dge slong o rgyan sogs ri khrod 'grims pa'i slob ma sgom chen pa rnams la smras pa'o//nam mkha' yangs po yi klong na/ /gza' skar grangs med cig snang rung / /'od zer phyogs kun tu 'phro ba/ /nyi ma zla ba las mi snang / /rgyal khams mang bo 'di'i khrod na/ /mkhas grub grangs med cig snang rung / /'phrin las phyogs kun tu khyab pa/ /rgyal ba yas sras las mi snang //lha dbang brgya byin gyi dus su/ /lha min pha ma de ma gtogs/ /sum cu rtsa gsum las lhag pa'i/ /lha yul bzang bo zhig mi snang / /gor+ṣa rgyal po yi dus su/ /dmag 686

'khrug langs pa de ma gtogs/ /yul bzang bal yul las lhag pa'i/ /sa cha skyid po zhig mi snang / /mtshan mo mun pa de 'thibs dus/ /'gro 'dug dka' ba de ma gtogs/ /pho brang po ta las lhag pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i bzhugs sa zhig mi snang / /dgun kha kha ba de rgyag dus/ /lto 'dren dka' ba de ma gtogs/ /la phyi gangs ri las lhag pa'i/ /chos pa sdod sa zhig mi snang / /nam mkha' mthon po la 'phur nas/ /phyogs kun ma mthong ba ma gtogs/ /khu byug sngon mo las lhag pa'i/ /skad snyan sgog pa zhig mi snang / /gzhung lugs rab 'byams la sbyangs nas/ /chos kun mi shes pa ma gtogs/ /tshogs drug rang grol las lhag pa'i/ /glu dbyangs len mkhan zhig mi snang / /dbyar kha me tog kun rgyas dus/ /bung ba'i sgra dbyangs rang sgog bzhin/ /ston kha kha zas kun mod dus/ /skyid glu 'di 'dra rang thon song / /zhes pa 'di yang ston kha zla ba bdun pa'i nang la kha zas mod po byung tshe skyid drag pa'i shugs kyis nyin zhig sems la gang shar rgyang gru ru blangs pa'o// bslu med dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /dri med smon lam 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'dis mtshon rang gzhan dge rtsa ci mchis pa/ /bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /de mthus sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /sems 687

can thams cad bde zhing skyid par shog /bdag ni myur ba myur du sangs rgyas nas/ /bstan 'gror phan thogs dpag med 'byung bar shog /thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i sgo nas sems can la/ /phan pa dpag tu med pa thogs par shog /'chad rtsod rtsom gsum sgo nas sems can la/ /phan pa dpag tu med pa thogs par shog /rgyud sde bzhi yi sgo nas sems can la/ /phan pa dpag tu med pa thogs par shog /mngon shes dzu 'phrul sgo nas sems can la/ /phan pa dpag tu med pa thogs par shog /bdag ni gang song yul la bkra shis shing / /gang bsam don rnams yid bzhin 'grub par shog /gang du bsdad pa'i sa la byen chags shing / /gang yod nor la g.yang kun 'khyel bar shog /'grogs tshad rnams la yon tan 'go ba dang //mjal mi rnams la byen rlabs 'jug par shog /su zhig 'jigs pas nyen pa'i dus su bdag /dran tshe 'jigs skrag sdug bsngal zhi bar shog /bdag ni mthong thos dran reg sems can kyi/ /rgyud la rnam dkar dge sems skye bar shog /kun gyi blo kha dam pa'i chos la 'gyur/ /dam chos byed pa'i skal ba ldan par shog /lus nad sems kyi sdug bsngal kun zhi nas/ /lus sems dga' bdes rtag tu 'tsho bar shog /bzang ngan 'brel ba thogs tshad 688

thams cad po/ /gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas shog /mdor na sgo gsum bya ba gang byas kyang / /bstan dang 'gro ba yongs la phan par shog /dge rtsa ci bsags bstan dang 'gro ba'i don/ /bla med byang chub thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /phyogs bcu'i drang srong bden tshig 'grub rnams kyi/ /bden pa'i stobs kyis smon lam 'grub gyur cig /rgyal khams kun tu lo legs bkra shis shing / /bkra shis chen pos sa gsum khyab gyur cig / ces pa 'di yang mgur 'bum gyi mjug tu zhabs dkar bas bris pa'o//'di dag rnams kyis dngos sam brgyud nas rang gzhan bstan pa dang 'gro ba yongs la phan thogs rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun zhabs dkar rdo rje 'chang chen pos mchog dman bar ma'i gdul byar gang la gang 'tsham gye rdo rje'i mgur dpag tu med pa bzhengs pa yi ger 'khod pa'i nang tshan las/ bal yul mchod rten rnam gnyis la mjal du phebs pa'i lam skabs dang bka' brgyud gong ma'i gdan sa 'brog la phyi gangs kyi ra ba nas bzhengs pa'i skor ro//689

dbus gtsang sogs nas bzhengs pa kha thor sna tshogs pa'i skor/na mo gu ru dre wa ḍāk+ki ye/ byen rlabs stsol ba'i rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam zhi khro'i lha/ /bar chad sel ba'i mkha' 'gro chos skyong gis/ /rtag tu thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs/ /nad gdon 'gal rkyen bar chad kun zhi zhing / /tshe dpal bsod nams lung rtogs yon tan rgyas/ /gnas skabs mthar thug 'dod don ma lus pa/ /'bad med lhun gyis 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /chos dbyings khyab gdal chen po'i klong yangs su/ /gu yangs yan par 'phyo ba'i rnal 'byor ngas/ /shugs 'byung 'gag med glu dbyangs sna tshogs pa/ /blangs pa'i tshul rnams phyogs gcig 'bri bar bya/ /de yang dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing 'dir 'ongs te/ jo bor gser gyi mchod kong phul nas smon lam btab pa dang / chos lung phu'i ri khrod nas sdod dus rgyal ba blo bzang dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs blangs tshul sogs gzhan du gsal la/ 'dir kha thor sna tshogs phyogs gcig tu bkod pa ni 'di lta ste/690

brtse bas phyag brkyangs mkhyen pa'i dbyu gu 'phyar/ /chos rnga cher brdungs stong gsum chos sgras bkang / /ma rig gnyid log 'gro kun dbang med du/ /sad mdzad sangs rgyas zhabs rdul spyi bor len/ /bstan pa dus kyi dbang gis nyams pa'i mod/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis ma bzod gtsug phud dor/ /ngur smrig 'chang ba'i tshul 'dzin tsong kha par/ /gus pas phyag byas stod bsngags me tog 'thor/ /gsal stong thugs kyi mthing shog dri med ngos/ /lung rtogs yon tan gser yig du mas mdzes/ /zab rgyas chos gter 'jam dbyangs glegs bam dngos/ /rgyal ba rin po che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i kha gnyis mnga'/ /byams dang brtse bas gzi brjid 'od zer 'bar/ /blun rmongs 'ching gcod 'jam dbyangs ral gri dngos/ /paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen la gus pas 'dud/ /mkha' ltar sangs rgyas bstan pa phyogs kun khyab/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu ri brag bas kyang mang / /sa kun li khris kha dog bsgyur ba ltar/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pas sa thog khebs 'di rmad/ /ngo mtshar ltad mo 'di la lha lam nas/ /lha yis bltas na dga' bar ma zad kyi/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rab 'byams kun gyes kyang / /ye shes spyan gyes gzigs na spro ba skye/ /dgon mtha' 691

grong sde gang na'ang bshan pa yis/ /tshe sngon drin gyis bskyangs pa'i pha ma bsad/ /sha yi ri brtsigs khrag gis mtsho yang bskyil/ /glo snying gcal du bkram pa mthong ba'i mod//mi yi grogs mdzad dkar phyogs lha klu kun/ /mi dga' rang yul bros par ma zad kyi/ /zhing 'di'i 'gro 'dren byang sems thugs skyo nas/ /zhing khams gzhan du gshegs grabs yang yang mdzad/ /kye hud pha ma ra lug g.yag gsum la/ /mi 'dod sna dgu gtong ba'i sdig can dgra/ /sar gnas byang sems dpal bos thul cig ces/ /snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'gro ba'i don la bskul/ /sdig spong dge sgrub bstan pa rin po che/ /bshan pas bshig par ma shes grogs su rlom/ /dgon pa'i thag nyer bzhag nas khyem mtshes byas/ /stan las sha la kun gyis brtson 'di mtshar/ /bshan pa pho mos sems can brgya stong bsad/ /bcad gtub btso sreg za zhing btsong ba sogs/ /mi dge'i sdig las byed pa 'dir bltas na/ /bskal ba snyigs tshe dmyal khams sa 'og nas/ /ma bsdad sa steng dgon sde phal cher gyi/ /thag nyer byung ba yin nam the tshom skye/ /kye hud snod bcud sdig pa'i 'bras bu gang / /'gro ba'i thog tu mi 'dod char bzhin babs/ /btsun pas kha gdangs mig bgrad gri yang 'phyar/ /pha ma ra lug g.yag gsum bsad pa'i 692

sha /bcad gtub rngam nas za 'dra'i gajigs 'jigs shig /sa steng 'di na snga sor yod ma myong / /'di la bltas na 'jig rten pa rnams khros/ /dpa' bo rnams kyis go khrab mtshon cha thogs/ /rngams nas dgra bo 'dul la chas pa yang mang bo mthong ste 'jigs snang chung bar gda'/ /dpa' bo'i dpung tshogs 'dzoms pa'i dus skabs su/ /gnod byed ma rungs dgra bo 'dul dgos bzhin/ /da re bod la bstan pa dar dus 'dir/ /sdig zas sha yi bstan pa bsnubs re ran/ /de phyir byang chub sems dpa'i dmag dpung gis/ /byams dang snying rje snying stobs cher bskyed nas/ /thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i go khrab mtshon cha thogs/ /bstan dgra sdig can myur du cham la phobs/ /bya btang rnal 'byor nyam chung byis pa ngas/ /bdag gi pha ma bshan pas bsad do zhes/ /byang sems chos rgyal rnams la zhus pa'i mthus/ /pha bsad lag dmar cham la 'beb par shog /ces pa 'di yang phyogs phyogs kyi dgon chen dang gtsug lag khang phal cher gyi thag te na bshan pas lug brgya phrag mang bo bsad nas/ sha yi ri brtsigs khrag gi chu rgyun 'gro ba mthong bas rkyen byas/skyabs mgon rgyal ba paṇa chen rin po che sogs sar gnas kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis 'di tsho la phan jogs re 'byung na ci ma rung snyam pas lhag bsam dag pa'i sgo nas/ bya btang ri khrod pa tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o//'gro ba'i sdug bsngal mthong na bzhugs mi tshugs/ /dmyal 693

ba'e me dong yin yang thogs med zhugs/ /mgon med nyam thag 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /nyam thag sems can mthong na spyan chab 'byin/ /srog tshab rang srog gtong la'ang phangs pa med/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems mnga' ba'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' yongs la gus pas 'dud/ /snyigs dus sangs rgyas bstan pa nyams re dma'/ /phyi rol ba yang bod la yong ma dgos/ /dgon pa'i lcags ri lha khang khor yug kun/ /bshan pas sha dang khrag gis dmar bor btang / /sangs rgyas byang sems zhing gzhan gshegs pa'i mod/ /sdig can bshan pas bsad pa'i pha ma'i sha /mthong na mchog dman kun gyes mchil ma mid/ /byams dang snying rje med pa'i rang mtshang ston/ /o rgyan lho nub srin yul la phebs rung / /ma gyur 'gro ba'i srog dbugs bcad pa'i sha /rngam nas za ba'i srin po bod na snang / /'di yi kha gnon mdzad na ci ma rung / /kye hud bdag gis mgon med sems can sdug /mthong bas ma bzod rang la phan 'dogs pa'i/ /nus pa med tshe rgyal ba paṇa chen sogs/ /sar gnas byang sems 'gro ba'i don la bskul/ /ma 'dris mdza' bshes chen po sangs rgyas kyis/ /'gro la phan pa'i chos 'khor bskor ba rnams/ /bsdu 694

na sdig spong dge sgrub gnyis su 'du/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin par gsungs/ /deng sang lha khang khor yug sde dgon na/ /sdig can bshan pas sha yi thang ka bshams/ /glo snying nang khrol mchod rdzas gcal du bkram/ /rin thang rten bshad byed 'di su yis bstan/ /ma gyur 'gro ba'i sha rus spungs dkyil du/ /btsun pas gri 'phyar kha gdangs za la chas/ /kye hud nang bas 'gro la 'di phod dam/ /phyi rol ba yis phod pa smos ci dgos/ /skyabs ston sangs rgyas zhing gzhan gshegs song yang / /skyabs gnas bstan pa gshegs par mi rigs kyang / /kye hud rgya gar bsod nams dman pa'i mthus/ /bstan yang ma bzhugs 'og min zhing du gshegs/ /rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa zhing brjes kyang / /rgyal bstan da dung phyogs 'dir gnas snyam yang / /kye hud bod kyi bya spyod la bltas na/ /bstan pa'ang dga' ldan gnas su gshegs pa 'dra/ /rgya gar phyi rol ba yis nag 'byams byas /bod yul sdig can bshan pas dmar bor btang / /kye hud nyam thag 'gro bas ci bya zhes/ /phyogs bzhir kha bltas mya ngan smre sngags 'don/ /'di 'dra'i smre sngags gsan na 'dir bzhugs kyi/ /byang chub sems dpas 'gro don cis mi mdzad/ /rab 'byams zhing gi rgyal ba grangs med kyang //zhing 'dir byon nas 695

'gro don mdzad par rigs/ /nyam thag ma gyur sems can bu chung rnams/ /sdug bsngal me 'obs nang du chud 'dug ces/ /sangs rgyas byang sems pha mar zhus pa'i mthus/ /myur du bde ba'i sa la bgrod par shog /ces pa 'di yang lha sa'i bshan pa rnams kyis nyin re bzhin pha ma ra lug g.yag gsum brgya phrag mang bo'i srog bcad nas/ jo bo chen po'i phyi rol skor lam na brtsigs nas 'tshong ba mthong bas rkyen byas 'di rnams la 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs mgon rgyal ba paṇa chen/ rgyal tshab dam pa dga' ldan gser khri/ rgyal ba'i yongs 'dzin sogs sar gnas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis chos gsungs/ /srog gcod mi rung ba'i khrims bzhag nas phan thogs re byung na ci ma rung snyam pa'i lhag bsam bzang bos bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o/ /sa bcu'i byang sems rgyal ba paṇa chen dang / /rgyal tshab yongs 'dzin dga' ldan gser khri sogs/ /bla ma dbu mdzad dge bskul thams cad kyi/ /snyan du gsal 'debs tshul du 'di skad zhu/ /sngar yang bstan dang 'gro don khur du bzhes/ /dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing 'di'i mchog dman la/ /srog gcod rku 'phrog mi rung chos khrims bzhag /ri rgya klung rgya bsdams sogs bka' drin che/ /da dung bstan pa'i gzhi ma dgon mtha' na/ /bshan pas pha ma ra lug brgya stong bsad/ /sha kun dge 'dun pa rnams nyos nas za/ /'di yang nyes dmigs che bar thub pas gsungs/ /za mkhan med na srog la 'tshe mkhan med/ /za ba mang bzhin srog la 'tshe ba mang / /de phyir dge 'dun yongs kyis sha 696

zos na/ /ra lug g.yag gsum 'chor ba'i go skabs bral/ /dge 'dun dkon mchog zer yang mi dkon gi /'bras spungs gcig pur stong phrag bdun tsam snang / /sa steng dge 'dun 'di yang mang re gzigs/ /pha ma'i srog la 'tshe ba med slad du/ /dge 'dun yongs kyis dkar gsum mngar gsum sten/ /bshan pa pho mor srog gcog mi rung zhes/ /chos gsungs khrims kyang zhog ces thal mo sbyor/ /sha tsha'i nga ro che na bzod par gsol/ /zhes pa 'di yang nyin zhig 'bras spungs dgon par mjal du song ba'i dus dgon mtha'i sha mang bo dge 'dun pa mang bos nyos nas khyer ba mthong bas rkyen byas/ bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o/ /skyabs mgon rgyal ba paṇa chen thog drangs pa'i/ /dbus gtsang bla chen thams cad brtse bas dgongs/ /khyed rnams ris med 'gro ba kun don du/ /phebs pa yin pas phyogs ris ga nas mnga'/ /sems can skyid sdug legs nyes gsal ler mkhyen/ /ma mkhyen pa zhig zhu rgyu gang nas rnyed/ /'on kyang sngon dus thub pa'i dbang bor yang / /'khor gyis gsal 'debs snyan bskul mdzad pa ltar//phran kyang de bzhin lag pa thal sbyar nas/ /gus pas gsal 'debs tshul du 'di skad zhu/ /a mdo lho kha la sogs thag ring gi /yul du skyes pa'i dad can pho mo 697

yis/ /khyed rnams yon tan thos pas dad pa g.yos/ /dbang med mjal 'dod byung nas sdod ma tshugs/ /byang kha'i 'ong la khal rta'i stabs ma 'grig /'chi rung lho kha brgyud nas mjal du 'gro/ /snyam nas lus dang srog la ma bltas par/ /sprang nas 'ongs dus tsha grang bkres skom gyi/ /sdug bsngal myang tshul bshad na brjod mi lang / /shi ba'i mi yang mang bo yod ces grags/ /dka' las myang nas lha sar slebs pa'i tshe/ /dag pa'i zhing du slebs 'dra'i dga' spro skyes/ /mjal du song tshe drung 'khor 'ga' zhig gis/ /bsdigs nas yar la ma 'ongs phar rgyugs zer/ /song na mar 'then skyug bron zer nas brdungs/ /mar la ded tshe yi mug snying rlung ldang / /lha sar yun ring sdod pa'i zas ma rnyed/ /mjal kha ma thob mar la 'gro ma phod/ /ltogs skom 'khyags nas yun ring sdod ma tshugs/ /mig nas mchi ma 'byin pa mang bo snang / /de phyir skyabs mgon rgyal ba rin po che/ /khyed kyi drung 'khor spyi dang khyad par du/ /sgo 'gag rnams la dman pa ar skyo ba/ /yong na ma 'gog yar la thongs shig gsungs/ /bla ma gzhan ma rnams kyi'ang de bzhin du/ /gsungs na dman pa rnams la thugs rje che/ /rin chen gser gyi ri la brten pa yi/ /'dab chags kha dog gser du snang ba ltar/ /bla ma dam par 698

brten pa'i drung 'khor ba/ /rnams kyang byams dang snying rje can yin pas/ /lho kha brgyud nas 'ongs pa'i ar skyo ba/ /ring min myur du mjal ba'i grogs re mdzod/ /mjal dus kha btags gtsang ma tsam zhig kyang / /'bul rgyu med rung brtse bas de dag la/ /phyag mchod dad pa'i rten du phyag mdud de/ /cis kyang gnongs zhes snying nas gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar mdzad na dman pa ar skyo ba/ /rnams la sngon med dga' spro'i nyi ma shar/ /da re don 'grub skal ba bzang bo byung / /yang yang mjal bar shog ces smon lam 'debs/ /bdag gis de ltar zhus pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /skyabs mgon rgyal ba paṇa chen la sogs pa'i/ /skyes bu dam pas dad can nyam chung rnams/ /tshe rabs kun tu brtse bas rjes 'dzin shog /ces pa 'di yang ar skyo ba skyes dman jo mo 'ga' res skyabs mgon gyil ba rin po che la mjal ma thub zer nas ngu ba mthong bas rkyen byas dam pa de dag la snyan bskul gyi tshul du bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o/ /chos pa rnam dag yongs la 'dud/ /chos dang mthun par byen gyes rlobs/ /chos grogs mtshan snyan 'byor ldan khyed/ /chos bzhin byed na 'di ltar mdzod/ /bka' brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /gang la'ang ched 'dzin chags zhen med/ /'jig rten chos brgyad don mi gnyer/ /thams cad gong du khur 699

ba dang / /dgra gnyen gnyis la dbye ba med/ /su dang 'grogs kyang kun dang mthun/ /gzhan la rang gi dbang mi ster/ /'dus byas dge ba khyad mi gsod/ /de la mchog tu mi zhen par/ /sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin du spyod/ /thams cad chos dbyings rol bar go /mtha' bral chos dbyengs chen po yi/ /ngang la kyi li me re gnas/ /bu chung ma pang gnas pa ltar/ /mi dga' med par 'dzum 'bol le/ /'dug pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig gyis/ /deng sang snyigs ma'i dus 'di ru/ /dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar dang / /dam pa'i chos dang mthun pa dkon/ /chos pa yin zer phal che ba/ /yo byad phyug po las kyang 'byor/ /rtsis grangs mi ltogs las kyang zhib/ /chags sdang bya sbrul las kyang che/ /kha khog tsher ma las kyang rtsub/ /rtag tu rang nyid gces par bzung / /gzhan rnams thams cad yal bar dor/ /chos brgyad tshe 'di don du gnyer/ /de 'dra nam yang ma byed ang / /mdor na chos mthun grogs po khyod/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis thongs/ /ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal sten/ /tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms par mdzod/ /chos pa tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /chos dang mthun pa'i snying gtam 'di/ /chos la thos bsam sgom byed pa'i/ /chos grogs khyed kyis thugs la zungs/ /dge ba 'di'i mthus sems 700

can kun/ /dge ba'i bshes dang legs mjal nas/ /dge sgrub mi dge'i las rnams spangs/ /dge legs bde skyid 'byung bar shog /ces pa 'di yang snyigs dus kyi chos pa 'ga' re'i bya spyod mthong bas rkyen byas nas chos grogs 'byor ldan bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dben gnas dwags lha sgam po nas smras pa'o/ /bla ma dkon mchog rin po che/ /thugs rje spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs/ /dad can sgar dpon rnam gnyis la/ /phan pa'i snying gtam bshad kyis nyon/ /tshe thung nam 'chi nges pa med/ /'chi tshe nor rnams bzhag nas 'gro/ /phan med nor gyes ci zhig bya/ /nor la 'dod pa ma che zhig /sgar gye phyogs de sdig tshabs che/ /lo re bzhin du ra lug g.yag /brgya stong mang bo la dwags la/ /btsongs nas sdig pa ma gsogs shig /nor gyi phyir du sdig bsags na/ /phyi mar 'gro ba'i lam nor nas/ /dmyal ba'i gnas su 'gro bas na/ /nor gyi sgra don de ka lags/ /nor rdzas 'di ni bsam pa nag /nor gyi phyir du mi ser la/ /don med 'bam tshong spus sgyur dang / /chad las mang bo ma rgyag cig /'dod pa me mtshon dug dang 'dra/ /mi nor zas gsum 'dod 'dod nas/ /'dod pa ma khengs 'khrug pa shor/ /bkyigs rdung mi gsod ma byed cig /zas nor 'dzoms pa'i dus skabs su/ /701

lo re bzhin du mchod sbyin thongs/ /mi ser rnams la phan thogs rem/ /khyad par tshe thar srog blu gyes/ /de ltar mdzad na tshe 'dir bde/ /phyi mar bde ba can du skye/ /phan pa'i gtam 'di thos tshad kyi/ /rgyud la phan thogs 'byung bar shog /ces pa 'di yang dad can sgar dpon gnyis la ri bo che nas smras pa'o/ /sngon tshe chos mdzad skyes bu kun/ /bla ma yongs la mos gus che/ /mched grogs rnams la brtse gdung che/ /sems can kun la snying rje che/ /chos lugs gzhan la dag snang che/ /slob bu ye shes grags pa khyod/ /chos pa'i khyad chos de bzhi bo/ /rgyud la 'dug gam mi 'dug ltos/ /deng sang chos pa phal cher ni/ /rang gi nor la ser sna che/ /gzhan gyi nor la ham pa che/ /don med bzhin du khong khro che/ /gzhan la phrag dog 'gran sems che/ /slob bu ye shes grags pa khyod/ /chos pa'i skyon mtshang de bzhi bo/ /rgyud la 'dug gam mi 'dug ltos/ /mdor na rang gi sems la ltos/ /mi dge sems spongs dge sems spel/ /sems nyid stong gsal ngang la zhog /gnad kyi zhal gdams de ka lags/ /zhes pa 'di yang ru thog chos mdzad la gnas chen ri bo che nas smras pa'o/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid ston pa sangs rgyas dang / /snying rje'i lha mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang la/ /rtag tu sgo gsum gus 702

pas gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud la snying rje skye bar byen gyis rlobs/ /snying rje ston pa'i chos kyi snying bo yin/ /snying rje yod na chos kyi rtsa ba tshugs/ /snying rje med na chos kyi rtsa ba rul/ /snying rje yod med khyad par bshad kyis nyon/ /srog dang ldan pa'i lus po chung na yang / /de yi bya ba las don nus pa ltar/ /snying rje ldan pa'i chos pa nyam chung yang / /de yi chos kyis 'gro la phan thogs 'byung / /srog med lus po ci tsam che na yang //de yi lus kyis 'gul skyod mi nus ltar/ /snying rje med pas chos mang shes na yang / /de yi chos kyis 'gro la phan mi thogs/ /snying rje can gye a mas bu tsha la/ /phan ma thogs kyang gnod pa mi byed ltar/ /snying rje can gye chos pas sems can la/ /phan ma thogs kyang gnod 'tshe byed mi 'gyur/ /bu la snying rje med pa'i ma yar gyis/ /dwa phrug rnams la rgyun du sdang ba ltar/ /'gro la snying rje med pa'i mi rnams kyis/ /sems can gzhan la rtag tu sdang bar byed/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal 'khor lo yod pa la/ /'khor dang dpung rnams shugs kyis 'du ba ltar/ /chos kyi rtsa ba snying rje yod pa la/ /chos gzhan kun kyang shugs kyis 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rgyal po'i bka' khrims med pa'i yul phyogs la/ /mi ngan jag pa rkun ma 'byung ba ltar/ /snying rje med pa'i chos pa'i 703

shes rgyud la/ /bsam ngan zhe sdang nyon mongs skye bar 'gyur/ /dper na nyi ma shar na mun pa sangs/ /de yi drod kyis 'gro la phan pa ltar/ /snying rje rgyud la shar na nyon mongs sangs/ /de yi chos kyis 'gro la phan par 'gyur/ /rang la khab kyis gtsags pa mi bzod par/ /gzhan srog gri yis gcod pa snying re rje/ /de phyir ra lug g.yag gsum mi gsod par/ /snying rje bskyed la tshe thar srog blu gyis/ /snying bo med pa'i tshe 'di'i bya ba spangs/ /snying bo'i lha chos byed pa'i zhabs dkar bas/ /snying gtam 'di nyid bshad pa thos tshad kyi/ /snying la snying rje'i nyi ma 'char bar shog /ces pa 'di yang dad gtong blo gros che ba'i mgron lha'i bla ma'i grwa btsun rnams la ri bo che nas smras pa'o/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum la gus phyag 'tshal/ /bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /phan pa'i snying gtam bzang bo tshigs su bcad/ /slar yang dbyangs su len gyis ma yengs nyon/ /ngo mtshar mi lus rin chen thob dus 'dir/ /kun gyis sdig spangs dge la 'bad re ran/ /bla ma rnams kyang btang snyoms ma bzhugs par/ /bstan 'gro'i don chen mdzod ces thal mo sbyor/ /dpon po rnams kyis jag khrims ma 'chol bar/ /gong ma'i bka' bzhin rgyal khrims dam po 704

gyis/ /dge 'dun rnams kyis nag chang ma bsten par/ /chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin du mdzad na bzang / /sgom chen rnams kyang grong du ma 'bab par/ /dben pa'i ri la sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs/ /sngags pa rnams kyis ngan sngags mthu gtad spongs/ /yi dam lha yi bsnyen sgrub kho na gyes/ /reb gong stod kyis jag dang brkus ma byed/ /dud 'gro'i 'tsho skyong gyis dang phyug por 'gyur/ /reb gong smad kyis dmag 'khrug las ma byed/ /zhing las so nam rem dang longs spyod che/ /sog po rnams kyis bod la gnod ma byed/ /phan thogs gang nus mdzod dang grogs su 'gyur/ /bod sog gnyis gas nye ring chags sdang spongs/ /skyid sdug gcig pa gyis dang thams cad skyid/ /kun gyi bkur gnas dpon tshang ching wang yin/ /dbon tshang wang gis kun la phan thogs mdzod/ /gsar rnying grub mtha' gang la'ang khas ma gtong / /gang mos nyams su longs dang byin rlabs 'byung / /de ltar byas na bod sogs thams cad la/ /sngar med bde skyid nyi ma gsar du 'char/ /'dis mtshon phan pa'i snying gtam gang bshad kyis/ /gzhan la phan thogs dpag med 'byung bar shog /yul phyogs kun tu lo legs bkra shis shing / /bkra shis chen pos phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang mdo 705

smad kyi yon bdag rnams la rgyang gi yon po lung nas bskur ba'o/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug gi rgyan/ /bdag gi 'di phyi'i gtan gyi skyabs/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /rgyal gyi mkhan chen zhabs drung du/ /khyed kyi bka' drin thugs rje la/ /brten nas lha chos byed mkhan gyi/ /bya btang byams pa chos dar ngas/ /rab tu dad pas 'di skad zhu/ /khyed sku shin tu bde ba'i gtam/ /phyag bris 'khrul med 'byor ba'i mod/ /rab dga'i sa thob bzhin du spro/ /bka' drin che'o drin can rje/ /bdag kyang chos rgyal khyed rnams kyi/ /drin gyes rgyal khams gar phyin kyang / /lus sems bde zhing nyams rtogs 'phel/ /rang gzhan don gnyis sgrub bzhin mchis/ /da ni kha tsam ma yin par/ /nga yang bya yi lo la 'ong / /khyed kyang ha cang bgres po min/ /nges par mjal ba'i skal ba yod/ /de 'dra'i gtam snyan gsan pa dang / /mjal ba tsam gye dga' spro mdzod/ /thugs blo rab tu bde ngos nas/ /thugs dam gzhan don gong 'phel mdzod/ /deng nas bzung ste byang chub bar/ /jo bo 'brom gyi rnam thar bzhin/ /tshe rabs kun tu mjal ba dang / /'bral ba med par 'grogs par shog /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog shing mchog /lhar bcas 'gro 706

ba'i gtsug gi rgyan/ /lung rtogs yon tan du ma'i gter/ /mtshan snyan 'jigs med skal bzang zhes/ /snyan grags dbyar kyi rnga bzhin du/ /phyogs kun ldir ba'i zhabs drung du/ /phyogs med rgyal khams gang bzang dang / /nges med ri khrod nyams dga' rnams/ /'grim pa'i tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /rab tu gus pas zhu yig 'bul/ /khyod sku nyi ma gzhon nu ltar/ /bde bar bzhugs pa'i gtam snyan dang / /lhan du ngo mtshar skyes dang bcas/ /'byor bas dga' spro dpag med byung / /phran kyang mchog gsum thugs rje yis/ /rgyal ba yab sras gdul bya'i zhing / /dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing khams na/ /da lta lus sems bde bar mchis/ /sngon gyi las bzang smon lam mthus/ /sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis/ /ma thul yal bar dor ba kun/ /khyed kyis thabs mkhas du ma'i sgos/ /btul ba ngo mtshar bka' drin che/ /da dung brtson 'grus ma lhod par/ /gong ma rgyal po'i bka' khrims ltar/ /jag khrims rkun khrims yang yang sdoms/ /bod sog kun la phan thogs mdzod/ /bdag kyang na so rgas na yang / /na dang 'chi ba ma byung tshe/ /myur du mdo khams smad du 'ongs/ /mngon sum mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /de ltar zhus pa'i bsod nams mthus/ /yul phyogs kun tu lo 707

legs shing / /mi nad phyugs nad kun zhi nas/ /thams cad bde zhing skyid par shog /ces mdo khams smad kyi yig lan 'di rnams kyang rgyang gi yon po lung nas smras pa'o/ /bstan pa'i pad tshal legs skyong zhing / /'gro kun gling bzhir phan thogs pa'i/ /thugs rje'i 'od ldan dge ba'i bshes//rta bdun dbang bo'i zhabs drung du/ /gus phran nyam chung 'dam skyes kyis/ /lag gnyis sor bcu'i 'dab ma rnams/ /spyi bo'i ze'u 'brur rab phyogs nas/ /zhu tshig snyan pa'i dri bsung spro/ /mgon khyod gzugs sku rta bdun gye/ /dbang bor mi 'dod sgra gcan med/ /bstan pa'i pad tshal gdul bya yi/ /gling bzhir thugs rje'i 'od 'phro zhes/ /snyan grags dbyar gyi rnga bo che/ /phyogs kun yang yang ldir ba'i mod/ /bdag blo rmongs pa'i gar mkhan gyes/ /dbang med dga' dad zlos gar bsgyur/ /gus phran sgyu lus 'dam skyes kyang / /rgas pa'i nam zlas gtugs na yang / /na 'chi'i ba mos ma mnar bar/ /dge sbyor dri ngad 'thul bzhin mchis/ /sngar med ded dpon chen po khyed/ /dbus gtsang chu gter gling du phyin/ /mkhas grub klu dbang mang bor gtugs/ /mdo sngags chos kyi nor bu blangs/ /slar yang nyes skyon ma mchis par/ /'jam dbyangs zhing sa chen por 708

slebs/ /legs bshad zab mo'i dga' ston yang / /'gyed pa thos pas dga' spro shar/ /mdzad pa kun gyi nang nas kyang / /gsung gi mdzad pa ngo mtshar che/ /khyed kyis sngar med gsung rtsom 'dra/ /mdzad pa bka' drin shin tu che/ /deng sang mkhas pa mang na yang / /legs bshad rtsom pa re re tsam/ /khyed kyi gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang / /mthun pa'i legs bshad 'di dag gis/ /ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus skabs su/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan par nges/ /de phyir da dung yin na yang / /rang gi yid la goms pa dang / /skal bzang gzhan la'ang phan pa'i phyir/ /legs bshad rtsom zhes gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag kyang ma shi tshe rid na/ /ri bo rtse lnga'i phyogs su 'ongs/ /dam pa nyid kyi gser zhal mjal/ /gsung gi bdud rtsi myang bar smon/ /gal te tshe yis ma 'tsho bar/ /tshe 'dir mjal bar ma gyur na/ /phyi mar dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /mjal nas 'bral med bsten par shog /legs bshad gtam snyan smra mkhan gyi/ /zhu shog ne tso lce bde bo/ /yig rgya'i sgam chung nang du bzhag /rje btsun chen po'i phyag tu phul/ /de ltar phul ba'i bsod nams mthus/ /bdag kyang tshe rabs thams cad du/ /bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyes/ /dgyes bzhin rjes su 'dzin par shog /de skad smras pa thos tshad 709

kyis/ /snang ba chos la bsgyur ba dang / /gang du khyer ba'i yul phyogs su/ /lo legs bkra shis 'phel gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni mtshan sgrogs mkhan rin po che'i drung du zhabs dkar bas dben gnas mkhar rdo nas phul ba'o/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog shing mchog /'gro ba yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa zhes/ /yongs su grags pa'i zhabs drung du/ /grong ba'i las kyang ma nus shing / /grwa sar chos kyang ma nus par/ /phyogs kun 'khyams pa'i zhabs dkar bas/ /rab tu gus pas 'di skad zhu//skyabs mgon khyed kyis tshe sngon dus/ /thugs bskyed tshogs bsags sgrib pa sbyangs//myur du rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang thob pa ngo mtshar che/ /da lta bdag cag snang ngo ru/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i sku ru bzhengs/ /thabs mkhas bsdu ba rnam bzhi'i sgos/ /'gro don mdzad la rjes yi rangs/ /phyogs med rgyal khams gang bzang dang / /nges med ri khrod nyams dga' rnams//'grim pa'i sprang 'khyams zhabs dkar ngas/ /chos dang 'jig rten ma nus rung / /sdig pa'i las kyang ma bsags par//rgyal khams yongs la ltad mo bltas/ /snang so gang bde byed rgyu byung / /da lta gu yangs blo re bde/ /mgon khyod sku tshe 'di nyid la'ang / /bstan dang 'gro la gang phan dang / /khyad par skal bzang gdul bya 710

la/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /bdag kyang tshe rabs thams cad du/ /khyed kyi rjes su 'dzin pa dang / /chos ldan bya ba gang byed kyang / /gegs med 'grub pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ /tshe mjug 'di la mgon khyod kyi/ /gser zhal lan gcig mjal 'dod pas/ /myur du mjal ba'i skal ba zhig /yong ba'i smon lam yang yang 'debs/ /gal te smon lam ma thebs par tshe 'dir mjal bar ma gyur na/ /phyi mar 'khor gyi thog ma ru/ /gyur nas chos la spyod par shog /legs bshad ri mo bkra ba yi/ /zhu shog lha gos gsar ba 'di/ /bdag gi rnam dpyod mdzod nas bton/ /zla tshes bzang bor legs par phul//de ltar phul ba'i dge tshogs mthus/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen mnyes pa dang / /thos tshad rnams kyis dge ba'i bshes/ /bsten nas lha chos byed par shog /ces pa 'di yang lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa mchog la zhabs dkar bas gnas chen mkhar rdo nas phul ba'o/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub par byin gyes zlobs/ /dam chos snying nas byed 'dod kun dga' khyod/ /phan pa'i snying gtam 'di la gus pas nyon/ /'jig rten khams 'dir sdod mkhan gcig kyang med/ /phyi mar phan pa dam pa'i chos min med/ /'o skol mi tshe 711

phal cher zad nas thal/ /myur du lha chos byed pa'i dus la bab//da dung mi tshe zad pa mi tshor bar/ /rgas rung gzhon no snyam na snang ba 'khrul/ /tshe 'di'i gshom ra mang bo byed byed nas/ /phyi ma'i lha chos mi byed de bsar 'khrul/ /de phyir nam 'chi cha med yang yang soms/ /don med tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis thongs/ /dam pas byin rlobs dben pa'i ri khrod du/ /nyin mtshan med par dam pa'i lha chos gyis//zhes pa 'di yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis skal ldan slob bu kun dga' bstan 'dzin la dben gnas mkhar rdo nas spras pa'o/ /bla ma mchog gsum yid bzhin nor bu la/ /rtag tu sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag dang 'gro ba sems can thams cad la/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char bzhin phobs/ /'jigs ni mi rtag 'chi bar shin tu 'jigs/ /bros nas grong nas ma tshugs ri la bros/ /ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal 'grims pa'i tshe/ /skyid pa'i rgyang glu kho na len 'dod byung / /de phyir da yang rgyal ba gong ma'i gsung / /tshigs su bcad nas snyan pa'i dbyangs su len/ /tshe rabs gtan du bde zhing skyid 'dod pa'i/ /skal bzang skye bo pho mo ma yengs nyon//e ma mi lus yang yang rnyed par dka'/ /rnyed dus lha chos byas na don re che/ /don med tshe 'di'i bya ba bsgrub bsgrubs nas/ /phyi 712

mar lag stong song na 'dun ma 'khrul/ /'jig rten khams 'dir sdod mkhan su yang med/ /phyi mar phan pa dam pa'i chos min med/ /shi na las can yar la 'gro dus su/ /sdig can dmyal bar 'gro rnams snying re rje/ /de phyir dad can skye bo pho mo rnams/ /mi dge sdig pa'i las rnams dug bzhin spongs/ /rnam dkar dge ba'i las la 'bad par mdzod/ /rgyun du nang gi bsam pa bzang bo gyis/ /glu 'di thos tshad skye bo pho mo rnams/ /tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /yul phyogs kun tu lo legs skya rgyal zhing / /thams cad dam pa'i chos la spyod par shog /ces pa 'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis lha ldan phyogs kyi slob ma sbyin bdag pho mo yongs la dbe+en gnas mkhar rdo nas smras pa'o/ /longs spyod sbyin las 'byung bar mkhyen nas ni/ /thub pas thog mar sbyin pa'i gtam 'di gsungs/ /longs spyod 'phel bar 'dod na sbyin gtong ba/ /man ngag yin zhes sa skya paṇa chen gsungs/ /ser snas bsags na mi 'phel mkha' 'gro spyi'i/ /dam tshig yin zhes rje btsun mi las gsungs/ /btang na nyung du mi 'gro nor lha spyi'i/ /dam tshig yin zhes mkhas grub mang bos gsungs/ /zas nor yod kyang sbyin par mi gtong na/ /dbul bo yin zhes mkhas mang rnams kyis bshad/ /zan gcig 713

med bzhin gang dag gtong phod pa/ /phyug po yin zhes yang dag gzigs rnams bshad/ /phyug bo rnams kyis tshe rabs sngon gyi dus/ /mchod sbyin btang bas tshe 'dir phyug por 'gyur/ /tshe 'dir mchod sbyin btang na phyi ma ru/ /'di bas lhag gi phyug bor 'gyur bar nges/ /dbul bo rnams kyis tshe rabs sngon gyi dus/ /mchod sbyin ma btang tshe 'dir dbul bor 'gyur/ /da dung mchod sbyin gang yang ma btang na/ /phyi mar 'di bas sdig gi dbul bor skye/ /mchod sbyin btang ba'i phan yon ma btang ba'i/ /nyes dmigs bsams nas mchod sbyin byed pa gces/ /zhes pa 'di yang lha ldan phyogs kyi skye bo pho mo rnams la dben gnas mkhar rdo nas smras pa'o/ /tshe dpag med mgon thugs rje can/ /tshe 'dir nad med dngos grub stsol/ /dus min 'chi las thar 'dod kyi/ /kha zas spyod lam 'di ltar gyes/ /ha cang 'grangs pa ma yin zhing / /ha cang ltogs pa'ang ma yin par/ /'grang ltogs ran pa'i kha zas za/ /'dzoms na sha thud mar gsar sogs/ /bcud can zas za tshe ril dang / /tshe rdzas bdud rtsi ril bu dang / /byen can dam rdzas bsten par bya/ /gos srab 'grangs pa'i sha mi za/ /lus kyi bya ba gang byed kyang / /rang gi shed mong che chung dang / /dpag pa'i bya ba byed dgos pas/ /mi theg pa la shugs ma 'byin/ /mi 714

thub dgra la phod ma btsongs/ /mi nus rngul bzhin rgyug mi bya/ /dpyid ka mtsho chu 'khyags pa'i steng / /dbyar dus gad khar 'gro mi bya/ /'brug ldir char thog rgyag pa'i dus/ /lung mdo ri rtser sdod mi bya/ /gad 'og khang rul g.yo ba'i nang / /'jig la khad du sdod mi bya/ /dgun dus shing 'khyags khar mi 'jeg /rgod cing 'drog pa'i rtar mi zhon/ /zhon na lam nas dogs zon bya/ /khye ngan sgo kha 'grims pa dang / /g.yang kha sogs la sems chung bya/ /lha 'dre mang bo rgyu ba'i sar/ /nyin par dus su gnyid mi bya/ /gnyan sar sa brko rdo slog dang / /thab gsur gzhob gsur bya mi rung / /nor rdzas rngams can mang bo bzung / /gcig pur sdod dang 'gro mi bya/ /gzhan la brnyas smod khyad gsod dang / /sun 'byin rdeg rdung ngan mi bya/ /chang gis bzi nas zhe 'gras pa'i/ /mi dang bsdongs nas 'gro mi bya/ /kha dkar gting nag grogs ma sten/ /dmag jag rkun gsum gcan gzan 'phrang / /rnams su 'gro 'dug mi bya zhing / /gal te 'gro sdod byed na yang / /rtag tu dogs zon byed pa gces/ /ko gru rul bar mi mang dang / /bsdebs nas chu chen bgrod mi bya/ /dug mthu rims tshad 'go ba'i nad//ro grib dme grib sogs la 'dzems/ /rgyun du spyod lam dal bar gyis/ /tshe thar srog blu ci 715

mang dang / /tshe dbang tshe mdo mchod sbyin thongs/ /chos dang mthun pa'i bya ba gyis/ /mdor na rnyed dka'i mi lus 'di/ /rtag tu bu chung bzhin du 'tshos/ /de ltar byed pa'i pho mo kun/ /dus min 'chi las thar bar shog /ces pa 'di yang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis sbyin bdag kun la phan phyir lha ldan nas smras pa'o/ /tshe 'di phyi bar do gang du yang / /blo gtad na mi bslu gtan gyi skyabs/ /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /thugs brtse bas bdag la cung zad dgongs/ /spyir snyigs dus sems can tshe thung zhing / /sgos tshe la bar chad rkyen ngan mang / /lus chu sbyar bzhin rdu 'jig par sla/ /rang gang la bsams kyang 'chi la nye/ /sprang gang du 'gro 'am 'dug kyang rung / /tshe bar chad med pa'i bsrung ba zhu/ /tshe phyi ma'i yul la 'gro dus yang / /yar lam sna drongs zhes gsol ba 'debs/ /lha'i sku gzugs bas kyang zhal ras mdzes/ /lha tshangs pa'i dbyangs las gsung gdangs snyan/ /lha'i gos dar bas kyang thugs 'jam pa'i/ /lha bla ma sku khams bde bar bzhugs/ /tshe 'di phyi bar do gang du yang / /dngos nyams dang rmi lam gnas skabs su/ /zhal mjal zhing gsung chos thos par smon/ /yid smon pa bzhin du 'grub par shog /ces pa 'di yang dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la 'gro khar skyabs 'jug zhu rten 'bul dus su phul ba'o/ /716

thugs dgongs mkha' ltar yangs pa'i bla mar 'dud/ /thugs yid dbyer med 'dres par byen gyis rlobs/ /thugs rgyud bzang ba'i gzhon nu seng ge la/ /thugs dam gsal 'debs cung zad tsam zhig zhu/ /chos kun ngo bo gdod nas mkha' ltar stong / /stong gsal zang thal ngos bzung gza' gtad bral/ /gtad med yangs pa chen po'i ngang nyid du/ /gu yangs yan par zhog dang ngo mtshar che/ /mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang nyid las/ /byams dang snying rje nyi zla ltar shar nas/ /ma gyur 'gro ba yongs la phan thogs zhes/ /kha tsam min par 'gro ba'i don la bskul/ /mdo rgyud man ngag shel dkar rgyu bzang las/ /legs grub khyed kyi legs bshad me long du/ /kun gyi skyon yon gzugs brnyan gsal bar gda'/ /shes rab mig ldan rnams la bstan du gsol/ /zhes pa 'di yang yar klung sgo ma chen gzhon nu seng ge la kun bzang nags khrod nas phul ba'o //rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /sems chos dang mthun par byin gyis rlobs/ /khyed dad can blo bzang skal bzang la/ /ngas phan pa'i bslab bya bshad kyis nyon/ /rje bla mar snying nas gsol ba thobs/ /grogs bzang ngan gang la'ang brtse gdung skyed/ /tshe 'di yi bya ba blo yis thongs/ /sdom dam tshig 717

mig gi 'bras bzhin srungs/ /rang gang mos lha yi sgom bzlas brtson/ /sems stong gsal 'dzin med ngang la zhog /ma 'gro ba yongs la snying rje sgoms/ /gzhan chos lugs gang la'ang dag snang sbyongs/ /chos nyams su blangs pa'i lag rjes la/ /rgyud zhi zhing dul bar yong dgos pas/ /chos gang shes rang gi rgyud la sbyor//rgyud bdag 'dzin nyon mongs ci thul gyis/ /don de ltar nyams su len nus na/ /sang 'chi yang 'gyod pa med pa 'ong / /tshe phyi mar dag pa'i zhing du skye/ /zhing de ru mjal ba'i smon lam 'tshal/ /zhes pa 'di mi bsam pa dkar zhing bla ma la mos gus che ba'i bu chen blo bzang skal bzang la gdams pa'o/ /stong ba nyid rgyu dang 'bras bu ru/ /'char ba'i tshul ston pa'i bla ma mchod/ /chos rnams kun sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin/ /snang stong du rtogs par byen gyis rlobs/ /gzugs stong nyid stong ba nyid gzugs so/ /gzugs las kyang stong ba nyid ma mchis /stong nyid las gzugs gzhan ma mchis so/ /dpe bzhag na me long gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /snang bzhin du stong la stong bzhin snang / /snang bzhin du stong bas tshugs grub tu/ /grub snyam pa'i yod mtha' sel ba yin/ /stong bzhin du snang bas gtan med du/ /song snyam pa'i med mtha' sel ba yin/ /stong ba nyid rgyu 718

'bras shar tsa na/ /rgyu 'bras la sngar bas zhib tu 'gyur/ /stong nyid kyi sgra dbyangs snyan mo 'di/ /thos tshad kyi skye bo pho mo rnams/ /rtag chad kyi mtha' la mi ltung bar/ /dbu ma yi lam la 'jug par shog /ces pa 'di yang slob bu yon tan rgya mtshos bskul ngor rnal 'byor zhabs dkar bas kun bzang nags khrod nas smras pa'o/ /skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu mchog /'bral med spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /dad ldan slob ma thams cad la/ /mchog mthun dngos grub char bzhin phobs/ /rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol ngas//phan pa'i snying gtam smra ba la/ /nor bu sgrol mas gtso byas pa'i/ /chos byed btsun ma rnams kyis nyon/ /chos rnams mi rtag snying bo med/ /thams cad rmi lam lta bur ltos/ /pha yul pha ma nor rdzas la/ /nam yang chags med zhen med gyis/ /chos kun rtsa ba sems la ltos/ /bltas tshe mi rnyed stong ba nyid/ /stong gsal nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /ngang la nam mkha' lta bur zhog /mkha' la nyi ma shar ba bzhin/ /ma gyur sems can thams cad la/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems/ /phyogs ris/ med par khyab par sgoms/ /rnyed dang mi rnyed bde mi bde/ /snyan dang mi snyan bstod smad kyi/ /'dod phyogs bzhi bo gzhan la byin/ /mi 'dod phyogs bzhi rang gis longs/ /gnod pa'i dgra 719

yang tshe sngon gyi/ /pha ma yin pas snying rje sgoms//tshur la gnod pa gang byed kyang / /phar la phan pa kho na sgrubs/ /phan thogs chen po ma nus kyang / /gnod pa spu tsam ma byed cig /de ltar byas na da nas bzung / /tshe rabs kun tu bde bar 'gyur/ /de skad smras pa thos tshad kyi/ /yul phyogs kun la bkra shis shing / /mi nad phyugs nad rgyun chad nas/ /lo legs skya rgyal 'byung gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni dad ldan nor bu sgol ma sogs chos byed btsun ma nyi shu rtsa gcig la kun bzang nags khrod nas smras pa'o/ /'di phyi bar do'i gtan gyi skyabs/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /spyi gtsugs 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /thugs rjes gzigs la byen gyis rlobs/ /dad gus che zhing chos la mos blo ldan sde ba rdo rje dang / /lcam dang nang mi thams cad la/ /phan pa'i snying gtam bshad kyis nyon/ /nam zla dus bzhi'i 'gyur ldog bzhin/ /gzhon pa rgan par 'gyur dus 'dir/ /nam 'chi cha med tshul soms la/ /phyi mar phan pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /zas nor longs spyod gang yod kyi/ /steng nas mchod sbyin yang yang jongs/ /sdig zas sha khrag za dgos kyang / /ched du gnyer nas srog ma gcod/ /lo re bzhin du nya sogs kyi/ /tshe thar srog blu gang mang thongs/ /phyag skor kha ton gang shes rnams/ /nyin re 720

bzhin du chag med gyis/ /'phags pa thigs rje chen po la//kha zhe med par gsol ba thobs/ /snying bo yi ge drug ma ni//nangs nub med par rgyun du bgrongs/ /sems nyid stong gsal 'dzin med gye/ /ngang la ma yengs mnyam par zhog /mi ser ngan slong nyam thag la/ /mchi ma 'khrug pa'i snying rje sgoms/ /lus ngag yid kyis phan thogs rem/ /phan pa'i bsngo ba sgon lam thobs de ltar mdzad na tshe 'dir bde/ /phyi mar byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba rnams/ /sbyin bdag yongs la phan phyir bsngo/ /de'i mthus tshe ring nad med cing / /bde skyid phun sum tshogs par shog / ces pa 'di yang dad can sde ba rdo rje nang mi yongs la zhabs dkar bas kun bzang nags khrod nas smras pa'o/ /na mo gu ru/ lhar bcas 'gro ba yongs kyi bsod nams zhing //mchog thun dngos grub ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid bzhin nor bu las kyang ches lhag pa'i/ /mchod rten chen po bya rung kha shor la/ /zas nor 'brel ba thogs tshad ma lus pa/ /tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med bde zhing skyid/ /phyi mar bde ba can sogs dag zhing du/ /skyes nas sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par gsungs/ /de phyir mchod rten chos 'khor bcu gsum la/ /rin chen gser gyi na bza' sgon pa'i dus/ /zhal 'debs rgyag 721

mkhan mang yang che shos te/ /mtshan snyan bla ma sbyin pa nor bu dang / /skal ldan rang grol sde ba rta go dang / /she dpon rnam rgyal bsod nams dar rgyas dang / /gnya' nang gnas chen nor bu yin no zhes/ /gtam 'di dkar phyogs lha mi'i snyan du 'bul/ /'brel ba chen po phul la phan yon yang / /chen po yod pa'i tshul la legs bsams nas/ /dad can rnams kyi rjes su yi rang sgos/ /bstod bsngags me tog dkar bo thor bar rigs/ /'di 'dra'i rlabs chen dge rtsa btang tsa na/ /snga sor nged tsho 'dra 'dra yin snyam pa'i/ /phyug po phal gyis 'gran par ma bzod tshe/ /ngo tsha dbul bo'i phag tu yibs sam snyam/ /gtong phod can gyes mchod sbyin btang tsa na/ /ser sna can tsho ngo tshar gtad pa 'dra/ /de phyir ngo tsha ldan pa'i phyug po rnams/ /ser sna'i mdud pa khrol la mchod sbyin thongs/ /zhes pa 'di yang mchod rten bya rung kha shor kyi chos 'khor bcu gsum la gser zangs kyi na bza' sgon skabs su/ slob ma yon bdag rnams kyi nang nas zhal 'debs che shos de sus byas zhes 'dri mkhan byung ba'i lan du yid la shar ba ltar rjes nas bris pa'o/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje'i thugs kyi sprul/ /gtan gyi skyabs gnas chos kyi rgyal/ /'bral med spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs/ /byen rlabs dngos grub char chen phobs/ /gnas lugs rjen par 'char ba dang / /nyams rtogs ye shes bskyed du gsol/ /e ma 722

skal ldan grogs mched rnams/ /rdzogs chen khregs chod lta ba yi/ /nyams len byed na 'di bzhin mdzod/ /dang po tshe 'di blos btang nas//yid 'ong dben pa'i gnas rnams su/ /rnyed dka' mi rtag 'chi ba dang / /las 'bras 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rnams/ /snying nas bsams te skyabs 'gro bya/ /sems bskyed sgrib sbyangs rdor sems kyi/ /sgom bzlas tshogs bsags maṇ+ḍal dang / /spyi bor bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom/ /snying nas bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /dbang bzhi blangs la thugs yid bsres/ /dur khrod bor ba'i mi ro bzhin/ /rtsol ba bral bas lus mi 'gul/ /pi wang rgyun thag chad pa bzhin/ /ngag gis 'khrul gtam chos spyod spangs/ /skyes bu'i snying ni bton pa bzhin/ /bya ba btang bas sems mi g.yeng / /lus ni rnam snang chos bdun bya/ /mig 'bras mdun mkhar hrig ger blta/ /sems nyid rang sor glod nas kyang / /rtog bral rjen par bzhag pa'i tshe/ /gsal le sang nge trig ge ba/ /sprin med dwangs pa'i nam mkha' bzhin/ /zang thal rgya yan phyal le ba/ /gsal la dwangs pa'i nyams shig 'char/ /de la rang rig ces kyang bya/ /rdzogs pa chen po zhes kyang bya/ /phyag rgya chen po zhes kyang bya/ /khregs chod gnas lugs zhes kyang bya/ /thig le nyag gcig ces kyang bya/ /bde 723

gshe rga rgasnyingabo zhes kyang bya/ /gdod ma'i mgon po zhes kyang bya/ /'di ni pad 'byung byen rlabs kyis/ /rang babs rang byung ye shes yin/ /rig pa rang gnas bsam gtan gyi/ /thog ma'i ngo sprod man ngag go /'di la bsam bya ci yang med/ /yid dpyod rtsol bas mi bslad par/ /ma bcos rang babs ngang du zhog /nyi ma sprin dang bral ba bzhin/ /kun gsal gdangs dang ldan par zhog /stong gsal mkha' yi dkyil ltar du/ /yangs dog bral ba nyid du zhog /bu chung lha khang bltas pa bzhin/ /gang snang 'dzin pa med par zhog /rgya mtsho rlabs dang bral ba bzhin/ /sems nyid g.yo 'gul med par zhog /bya rgod mkha' la 'phur ba bzhin/ /dran bsam rjes med nyid du zhog /rtog med khyab gdal chen po'i ngang / /dus dang rnam pa kun tu zhog /rtsal gyi rnam rtog shar ba'i tshe/ /shar ba de nyid dgag pa min/ /de la brtag dpyad byed pa'ang min/ /de yi rjes su mi 'brang bar/ /shar sa shar mkhan med pa yi/ /rang gnas bsam gtan ngang du glod/ /shar grol dus mnyam nyid du grol/ /de la rnam rtog sgom shar zer/ /byeng rmugs 'thib gsum la sogs pa/ /zhi gnas ltengs por song ba'i tshe/ /lta stangs rig pa'i ngar bskyed de/ /nyi ma sprin las grol ba bzhin/ /gsal dwangs ngar dang ldan par 724

zhog /bying rgod phra mo'i za zi rnams/ /rang gnas bsam gtan ngang nyid du/ /rbad kyis chod la phyam gyis zhog /rtog med zang thal chen por glod/ /stong gsal rig pa 'dzin med 'char/ /rgod 'phro'i dbang du mi gtang zhing / /bying rmugs dbang du mi gtang bar/ /rang rig ye shes rgyun de skyongs/ /rig pa'i gsal cha nyams gyur nas/ /btang snyoms tha mal sdod pa 'am/ /ci yin 'di yin med pa yi/ /shes pa dran med thom me ba/ /lung ma bstan gyi bsam gtan te/ /sgom yun ring yang yon tan med/ /mi tshe stong zad byed pa yin/ /de la sgom go mi gcod par/ /spyi bor bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms/ /kha zhe med par gsol ba gdab/ /dbang bzhi blangs la thugs yid bsre/ /thun chung grangs mang chod la sgoms/ /yang na sprin med g.ya' dag dus/ /nam mkha'i mthong rgya che ba'i sar/ /nyi ma dag la rgyab gtad de/ /rang sems nam mkha' dag dang bsres/ /mig ni nam mkha'i gzhung la gtad/ /rtog med zang thal chen por glod/ /stong gsal rig pa rjen par 'char/ /'di ni bogs 'don zab mo yin/ /'di ltar yang yang nyams su longs/ /cung zad brtan pa thob pa na/ /rkyen snang phra mo dag dang bsre/ /de nas khro bo'i stangs stabs dang / /khyad kyi 'dor stabs seng ge yi/ /lta 725

stangs gsum la rim bzhin slobs/ /des kyang bsam gtan mi 'chor na/ /'gro 'chag nyal 'dug la sogs pa/ /spyod lam rnam bzhi gang tshe yang / /thun mtshams mi gcad khor yug sprod/ /de ltar yengs med bskyangs pa yis/ /nyams len mtha' ru phyin pa'i tshe/ /ji ltar snang ba'i yul rnams la/ /der 'dzin shes pa med pa na/ /bu chung lta bu'i nyams yin no/ /shes pa rang yan btang gyur kyang / /pha rol yul la mi 'phro na/ /rgyal po lta bu'i nyams yin no/ /lha 'dre'i srang lam nyal gyur kyang / /ya nga bag tsha med pa na/ /seng ge lta bu'i nyams yin no/ /ku re bzhad gad la sogs pa/ /ci smrar 'dzin pa med pa na/ /brag cha lta bu'i nyams yin no/ /zas nor longs spyod thams cad la/ /chags zhen spu tsam med pa na/ /mkha' lding lta bu'i nyams yin no/ /sgom pa'i rtsol ba ma byas kyang / /shes pa don thog gnas pa na/ /ri bo lta bu'i nyams yin no/ /'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad la/ /bzang ngan blos byas bral ba na/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i nyams yin no/ /rang rig rtog pa'i ye shes ni/ /dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/ /nam mkha' bzhin du 'gyur med na/ /lta ba klong du gyur pa yin/ /byeng rgod phra rags gtan med sangs/ /rang rig gsal 'grib med pa na/ /sgom pa klong du gyur pa 726

yin/ /dran bsam rjes med nyid du sangs/ /gza' gtad kun dang bral ba na/ /spyod pa klong du gyur pa yin/ /dri bral rang rig rjen pa 'di/ /mthar thug mngon du gyur pa'i tshe/ /'bras bu klong du gyur pa yin/ /don 'di legs par go bar mdzod/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i sgom dbyangs yin/ /bla ma'i drin gyis de ltar rtogs/ /dga'o skyid do rdo rje'i spun/ /zhes lta ba'i skyong tshul phan pa'i rgyang glu 'di ni bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis dad ldan grogs mched rnams la phan pa'i phyir du bris pa dge legs 'phel/gangs ri'i khrod na seng ge srab med du/ /'phyo 'dra'i 'gran gyis zla dang bral ba yi/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la yab sras kyis/ /rnam dag smon lam 'grub pa'i dbang po mdzod/ /ya rabs dad can yid 'dzin lha mo yis/ /rje btsun chen po'i rnam mgur gser dngul las/ /legs par bris pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i tshogs/ /bstan dang 'gro ba kun la phan phyir bsngo/ /de mthus sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /bstan 'dzin skyes mchog thams cad sku tshe ring / /'gro kun gnas skabs kun tu bde zhing skyid/ /mthar thug sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par shog /khyad par yid 'dzin lha mo ma bu rnams/ /tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med phun sum tshogs/ /'chi khar mnar gcod sdug 727

bsngal mi 'byung zhing / /phyi mar bde ba can du skye bar shog /gal te de 'dra'i skal ba mi ldan na/ /slar yang dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing khams 'dir/ /rab tu gzugs mdzes skad snyan sems bzang ba'i/ /skyes pa pho lus gtsang ma thob par shog /lus thog de la rje btsun mi la ltar/ /dang po bla ma bsten nas gdams pa nyan/ /bar du ri khrod dben par nyams len byas/ /tha mar sangs rgyas 'gro don byed par shog /gzhan yang yul 'dir nad mug 'khrug rtsod sogs/ /mi 'dod gnod 'tshe'i ming yang mi grags shing / /char chu dus babs lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /thams cad gtan du bde zhing skyid par shog /sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i byen rlabs dang / /chos nyid mi 'gyur bden pa'i byen rlabs dang / /dge 'dun mi phyed 'dun pa'i byen rlabs kyis/ /bsngo ba smon lam btab tshad 'grub par shog / ces ya rabs dad can yid 'dzin lha mos bskul ngor zhabs dkar bas bde skyid khang gsar nas sbyar ba'o/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /ya rabs rigs bzang rje btsun ma/ /khyod kyis nyams len 'di bzhin mdzod/ /tshe thung nam 'chi cha med soms/ /che 'di'i bya ba blo yis thongs/ /ri khrod dben pa'i 728

dga' tshal sten/ /gcig pur drang srong tshul du gnas/ /skyabs sems gsol 'debs sngon du thongs/ /lus kyi gnad ni drang bor srongs/ /mig gis lta stangs mthon po gyis/ /ngag gis smra brjod thams cad spongs/ /sems nyid gzhan du ma yengs par/ /snang srid 'khor 'das chos kun gye/ /rtsa ba sems kyi gnas lugs te/ /stong gsal 'dzin med zang thal le/ /spros bral nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /ngang la lhod kyis glod la thongs/ /phyogs ris med par yan par zhog /khyab gdal dran pa'i mkhar tshugs shig /sgrib med zang thal rjen la phud/ /ma yengs mi bsgom sa ler skyongs/ /ci yin 'di yin med pa yi/ /lung ma bstan du ma 'jog cig /sems kyi gnas lugs ma rtogs pa'i/ /'gro la snying rje chen po sgoms/ /phan pa'i smon lam rgya chen thobs/ /gzhan yang sems ngo skyong ba'i dus/ /nyams myong can gyi rnal 'byor pa'i/ /gsung mgur thon la skyongs dang bzang / /skabs re bla mar gsol ba thobs/ /thugs yid dbyer med gcig tu bsres/ /rig pa kha yan glod la zhog /de ltar byas na bogs thon nas/ /rtogs pa nam mkhar mnyam pa 'ongs/ /snying rje nyi ma lta bur shar/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /glu 'di thos tshad thams cad kyi/ /rgyud la 729

nyams rtogs 'char bar shog /ces pa 'di ni chos rgyal lha rgya ri'i sras mo rje btsun ma lhag bsam sgrol ma la zhabs dkar bas smras pa'o/ /nges don ston pa'i bla ma/ /sangs rgyas kun las lhag pas/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so/ /byin rlabs dngos grub stsol cig /lung dang rig pa du mas/ /chos kun rtsa ba rang sems/ /gdod ma gshis kyi gnas lugs/ /ye nas stong gsal 'dzin med/ /zang thal khyab gdal klong yangs/ /spros bral nam mkha' lta bur/ /gtan la phab pa'i ngang la/ /kha yan glod la zhog dang / /rnam rtog sprin ltar yal nas/ /gnas 'gyu'i 'phrang las thar zhing / /lta sgom 'dzin pa'i sgog grol/ /'og 'gyu'i zhabs 'dren med cing / /zhi gnas mgo skor sangs nas/ /dbyengs rig khyab gdal chen po'i/ /klong du rab tu 'byams pas/ /gar bzhugs chos dbyings pho brang / /snang ba brda' dang dpe char/ /shar ba'i klong nas gnas skabs/ /'gro don shugs kyis 'byung zhing / /lus rgya'i 'ching ba zhig tshe/ /yongs grags 'chi ba chos sgu/ /rnying ma'i gzhon nu bum skur/ /mngon sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /de 'dra 'ong bar gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni snye mo smrar lam rje btsun ma ye shes chos bzang dang nya mo'i chos la shes rab chos sgron gnyis kyis bskur ngor zhabs dkar bas smras pa'o/ /skyabs rje drin can bla ma/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs 730

shig /sems bzang slob ma chos la/ /sems ngo 'di bzhin skyongs shig /tshe 'di blo yis thongs la/ /gcig pur ri khrod dben par/ /bla ma'i gsol 'debs byas mthar/ /thugs yid gcig tu bsres la/ /'khor 'das chos kun rtsa ba/ /sems nyid stong gsal 'dzin med/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la/ /gu yangs glod la zhog dang / /gsal la 'dzin pa med cing / /dwangs la phyi nang med pa/ /mtha' bral chos dbyings chen po'i/ /klong du rab tu 'byams pas/ /dgra dang gnyen la khyad med/ /gser dang sa rdo khyad med/ /'di dang phyi ma khyad med/ /sems dang nam mkha' khyad med/ /rtog ldan 'khrul zhig nam mkha'i/ /rnal 'byor ma zhig 'byung nges/ /de ltar ma rtogs 'gro la/ /snying rje tshad med bskyed la/ /chos sku nam mkha' lta bu'i/ /ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du//gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du/ /byung nas 'gro don byed pa'i/ /bsngo ba smon lam thobs dang / /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub yong / /nyams su len mkhan rgyud la/ /nyams rtogs 'char bar gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni sbrags yang rdzong gi slob ma skal bzang chos sgon gyis bskul ngor zhabs dkar bas smras pa'o/ /drin can bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /dad can slob ma'i shes rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /chos bzhin mdzad pa'i dngos 731

brgyud bla ma yi/ /gsung bzhin lha chos sgrub pa'i zhabs dkar bas/ /sa bcu lam lnga bgrod pa'i rten 'brel du//bcu tshan lnga yi snyan pa'i glu dbyangs len/ /dad brtson shes rab snying rje che ba yi/ /slob bu snyan grags rgya mtsho gus pas nyon/ /rtogs pa thugs rje ldan pa'i bla ma bsten/ /lta spyod mthun pa'i blo thub grogs po bsten/ /grub thob brgyud pa'i man ngag phyogs med bsten/ /'tsho ba yo byad skyon bral chog shes bsten/ /dben zhing nyams dga' byin chags dgon pa bsten/ /khams la 'phrod pa'i zas dang spyod lam bsten/ /nyams la phan pa'i chos dang mgur dbyangs bsten/ /dad gus skal bar ldan pa'i slob ma bsten/ /kun la phan pa'i rdzas dang sman rnams bsten/ /spyod lam rnam bzhi dran dang shes bzhin bsten/ /bsten pa'i chos bcu yin pas sems la zungs/ /'jig rten chos brgyad slob pa'i slob dpon spongs/ /sems dang nyams la gnod pa'i gnyen grogs spongs/ /rku 'phrog g.yo sgyus sgrub pa'i 'tsho ba spongs/ /thos bsam sgom la gnod pa'i las rnams spongs/ /rnam g.yeng 'tshe ba mang ba'i dgon pa spongs/ /khams la gnod pa'i zas dang spyod lam spongs/ /'dod 'dun ser snas bcings pa'i nor rdzas spongs/ /pha rol mi dad rgyu yi spyod pa sgongs/ /don med 732

ngag 'khyal 'gro 'dug bya byed spongs/ /rang skyon sbas nas gzhan skyon sgog pa sgongs/ /spang bya'i chos bcu yin pas sems la zungs/ /mi lus sdig pa'i las la bskol ba phangs/ /don med ngang la mi tshe 'da' ba phangs/ /chos med lag stong phyi mar 'gro ba phangs/ /'khor ba'i gnas su rang sems 'khyams pa phangs/ /lam sna 'dren pa'i bla mar 'bral ba phangs/ /nyon mongs rkyen gyis sdom pa 'chor ba phangs/ /rnam g.yeng dbang gis nyams rtogs 'grib pa phangs/ /man ngag zab mo zong du btsongs pa phangs/ /ma gyur 'gro kun yal bar 'dor ba phangs/ /sgo gsum tha mal btang snyoms sdod pa phangs phangs pa'i chos bcu yin pas sems la zungs/ /yon tan kun gye gzhi ma dad pa dgos/ /bla ma dam pa'i bka' bzhin bsgrub pa dgos/ /shes rab stobs kyis thugs dgongs lon pa dgos/ /mi ldog brtan pa'i brtson 'grus bzang bo dgos/ /sgo gsum sdig pa'i skyon gyis ma gos dgos/ /yid kyi dam bca' mtha' ru thon pa dgos/ /gang la chags med zhen med spyod pa dgos/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems mchog dgos/ /chos kun sgyu mar rtogs pa'i lta ba dgos/ /rtag tu tshogs gnyis las la brtson pa dgos/ /dgos pa'i chos bcu yin pas sems la 733

zungs/ /chos sgor zhugs nas chos bzhin nyams su longs/ /pha yul spangs nas chags med nyams su longs/ /bla ma bsten nas bka' bzhin nyams su longs/ /thos bsam byas nas sgom pa nyams su longs/ /rtogs pa shar nas yengs med nyams su longs/ /nyams myong skyes nas dben par nyams su longs/ /gzhon nu'i dus su dka' thub nyams su longs/ /khas blangs byas nas sdom pa nyams su longs/ /sems bskyed byas nas gzhan don nyams su longs/ /gsang sngags thob nas bskyed rdzogs nyams su longs/ /blang bya'i chos bcu yin pas sems la zungs/ /'dis mtshon dge bas skal ldan slob ma yi/ /ci bsam thams cad chos bzhin 'grub par shog /gang du phyin pa'i yul la bkra shis shing / /gang bsam don rnams yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig /ces zhal gdams snyan pa'i pi wang 'di ni skal ldan slob bu snyan grags rgya mtshos bskul ngor rnal 'byor zhabs dkar bas dbe+en gnas bkra shis 'khyil ba nas smras pa'o/ /rje bla ma dkon mchog rin po che/ /spyir nad pa rnams la thugs rjes gzigs/ /sgos slob bu'i lus kyi na tsha dang / /sems sdug bsngal zhi bar byen gyis rlobs/ /sprang bya btang tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /bu khyod la phan pa'i kha ta bya/ /spyir sems can 734

thams cad skyes nas 'chi/ /mi'i 'chi rkyen nad la bzang bo dkon/ /sgos nad zug drag pos glo bur du/ /chos sgrub khom med par 'chi ba las/ /nad 'di 'dras bzung yang lo mang la chos gang nus bsgrubs na chog pas bzang / /khyod gnyen bshes nor rdzas chags yod dus/ /nad 'di yis chags su ma bcug bzang / /khyod tshe 'di'i don du sdig byed dus/ /nad 'di yis byed du ma bcug bzang / /khyod lha chos ma dran g.yengs pa'i dus/ /nad 'di yis dran du bcug pas bzang / /blo chos kyi phyogs su dbang med bsgyur/ /nad chos la bskul ba'i slob dpon yin/ /sngar las ngan gang bsags nad 'dis 'dag /nad sdig sgrib 'dag pa'i gnyen po yin/ /sngon mi la'i bu chen ras chung dang / /mtshan snyan pa dge slong dpal mo la/ /nad 'di 'dra'i rkyen byas chos bsgrubs pas/ /'phral nad sos grub thob chen por gyur/ /sngon jo bos 'brom la khyod gshegs dus/ /nad 'di 'dras bzung nas gshegs gyur na/ /zhing dga' ldan gnas su skye'o gsungs/ /phyis nad des bzung ba'i tshul bstan dus/ /nga'i bsam don 'grub gsung thugs dgyes skad/ /nad 'di 'dra mchog dman gnyis shar 'ang / /khyod gcig pur nad 'di byung ba min/ /nad 'phral du gnod kyang phugs su phan/ /735

khyod nad 'dis bzung la sems ma sdug /chos sgrubs dang tshe mjug nad kyang sos/ /nad ma drag gal te shi song yang tshe phyi mar dag pa'i zhing du skyes/ /nad 'di 'dra'i ming yang thos mi 'gyur//glu 'di nyid thos tshad nad pa yis/ /lus sems la phan thogs 'byung bar shog /ces pa 'di ni ya rabs dad can slob bu tshe 'brug sa grib kyis na ba la sems gso'i tshul du bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis smras pa'o/ /'di phyi'i gtan gyi skyabs mgon bla ma rje/ /spyi bor sgom bzhin snyan pa'i glu dbyangs len/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran pa'i dad can rnams/ /sems la skyo ba bskyed la glu 'dir nyon/ /rgan gzhon go rim med par 'chi la ltos/ /nam 'chi cha med soms la chos la 'bod/ /dkon mchog thugs rjes ma shi tshe ring na/ /lo re bzhin du dge ba gong 'phel thongs/ /khyad par lnga mchod sde bas lo re bzhin/ /sbyin bdag byas nas 'dzin pa skal ba bzang //'dzin dus yod pas dā dmar dā dkar sogs/ /gos thebs tsam re yin yang gtong thub ltos/ /med po rnams kyis kyang nam yang med mug 'di/ /gcig red soms la gang yod phangs med thongs/ /de 'dra'i dpe srol bzang bo 'dzugs nus na//'khor ba ma stongs bar du tshugs par nges/ /tshugs na dge rgyun de las lhag pa zhig /'dzugs rgyu med pas kun gyi sems 736

la zhog /de ltar byas na dgon pa dar zhing rgyas/ /sde ba la yang bde skyid tshad med 'byung / /yon mchod thams cad gnas skabs bde zhing skyid/ /mthar thug sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob par nges/ /de ltar yi ge phul ba la brten nas/ /yul la chos dang bkra shis 'phel gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang zho 'ong gshis kyi sbyin bdag pho mo rnams la dge ba'i bskul mar rnal 'byor zhabs dkar bas dben gnas bkra shis 'khyil ba nas sbras pa'o/ /bla ma tshe dpag med la gsol ba 'debs/ /'chi med tshe yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /bla ma ma gshegs yun ring bzhugs na snyam/ /bsam bzang slob ma yon bdag gus pas nyon/ /bla ma na so rgas nas 'chi la nye/ /nam gshegs mi shes snyam pa bden na yang / /bla ma rgas nas gshegs pa lugs srol yin/ /'khrungs nas bla ma ma gshegs gcig kyang med/ /kye ma ston pa sangs rgyas 'khor bcas gshegs/ /skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras rnams kyang gshegs/ /de 'dra'i bla ma rnams kyang gshegs song na/ /bdag 'dra'i bla ma gshegs pa smos ci dgos/ /bla ma gshegs snyam sems sdug mang byas kyang / mi gshegs thabs la nam yang phan mi 'gyur/ /de bas nam gshegs cha med tshul bsams nas/ /bla ma'i gsung bzhin lha 737

chos bsgrubs na bzang / /bla ma'i gsung la slob mas ma nyan na/ /ma gshegs yun ring bzhugs kyang dgos pa med/ /bla ma gshegs rung gsung bzhin bsgrubs gyur na/ /bzhugs kyang khyad par med do slob bu rnams/ /dad med rnams la bla ma bzhugs pa las/ /da dung gshegs pa tshor na dga' ba mang / /gshegs na dga' ba'i bsam pa rdzogs phyir du/ /deng sang bla ma phal cher gshegs par 'gyur/ /dad can rnams la gshegs kyang dngos nyams la/ /bla mar yang yang mjal ba'i lo rgyus mang / /ngas kyang bla ma gshegs nas gsol btab nas/ /nyams dang rmi lam skabs su mjal ba byung / /khyed rang rnams kyang gsol ba snying nas thobs/ /tshe rabs kun tu bla ma mjal bar 'gyur/ /bla ma gshegs snyam sems sdug byed mi dgos/ /rang nyid 'chi ba soms la lha chos rem/ /nga ni skye 'chir rang dbang ma thob mod/ /'on kyang yun ring sdod pa'i 'dun pa byed/ /glu 'di thos tshad rnams kyis bla ma yang / /mi rtag bsams nas chos la spyod par shog /ces pa 'di ni nyin zhig phung khams cung zad ma bde ba la 'ga' re sems sdug byas tshe de yis rkyen byas sems la shar ba ltar zhabs dkar bas rma 'gram ri khrod dben pa zhig nas smras pa'o/ /738

springs yig ka la piṅka'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru/ thugs kyi dgongs pa nam mkha'i khyon ltar yangs/ /dus gsum sa ler gzigs pa'i bla ma mkhyen/ /'khor 'das chos rnams lag mthil skyu ru ra/ /bzhag nas bltas ltar gzigs pa rnams la 'dud/ /'di phyi bar do'i gnas rnams thams cad du/ /thugs rje gzigs la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /'khor 'das yongs la ltad mo lta bzhin du/ /mtha' yas 'gro don byed par byen gyis rlobs/ /bstan dang 'gro ba yongs la phan pa'i phyir/ /phyogs med rgyal khams 'grim pa'i zhabs dkar ba/ /thag ring rgyang na gnas kyang dung sems kyis/ /phan pa'i snying gtam rgyang glu'i tshul du len/ /bla ma rdo rje mched lcam snying nas dran/ /slar yang myur ba myur du mjal na snyam/ /skom pa chu 'dod lta bu'i slob ma dang / /yon bdag pho mo thams cad ma yengs nyon/ /sems kyi gnas lugs nam mkha' lta bur rtogs/ /rtogs pa'i dbyings su snang ba gu yangs byas /glod nas bzhag pas rtog tshogs sprin ltar yal/ /sdug btsir 739

'ching ba thams cad lhod grol la/ /song nas gsal stong mtha' dbus dang bral ba'i/ /brjod med nyams shig 'bad med lhun 'grub shar/ /shar ba'i ngang la gsal 'grib med par gnas/ /bde gsal mi rtog stong ba'i ngang nyid las/ /de ltar ma rtogs 'gro la snying rje yang / /phyogs ris med pa nyi ma bzhin du shar/ /kun khyab snying rje chen po'i ngang nyid las/ /mtha' yas 'gro don 'bad med lhun grub byung / /da lta shi yang 'gyod pa spu tsam med/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis bya ba tshar nas gda'/ /'on kyang dad can bskyur bar ma phod pas/ /bya btang byas nas phyogs gcig sdod ma tshugs/ /las dang skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya la/ /phan phyir nyi zla bzhin du 'khor dgos byung / /sngon gyi las bzang smon lam dag pa'i mthus/ /thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa'i dpon slob rnams/ /dang po dngos su mjal dus lo mang yang / /da lta bsams na skad cig yud tsam gda'/ /nged rnams so sor bral nas lo 'ga' las/ /ma song na yang yun ring snang ba shar/ /khyed rnams kun la skyid sdug gang byung yang / /rna ba'i lam du go rgyu ma byung tshe/ /'di ru mi mang shi ba mthong tsa na//khyed rnams bde mo byas nas gang na yod//phal cher shi nas 'jig rten pha rol tu/ /song 'dra los yod snyam 740

nas skyo snang shar/ /kye ma lo zla kha shas bar 'di la/ /slob ma yon bdag mang bo 'das pa mthong / /rang yang de ltar myur du los 'chi snyam/ /nam 'chi cha med yang yang dran pa byung //rnal 'byor na so rgas nas 'chi la nye/ /shi 'dra song ba tshor na dad can rnams/ /mi rtag 'chi ba ston pa'i slob dpon du/ /go nas rnam dkar dge la 'bad par mdzod/ /da dung yin yang ma shi tshe ring na/ /jo shāka rnam gnyis rgyal ba yab sras kyi/ /gser zhal mjal zhing stod smad bar gsum gyi/ /slob ma sbyin bdag yongs la 'phrad pa'i phyir/ /dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du sleb par smon/ /gar bzhugs chos kyi dbyengs kyi lha lam nas/ /byen rlabs dngos grub sbrang char 'bebs bzhin du/ /gtam snyan dbyar gyi rnga gsang stong ldir bas/ /phyogs kyi khor yug thams cad gang ba'i mod/ /dbus gtsang mnga' ris phyogs phyogs skyed tshal na/ /gnas pa'i gdul bya gar mkhan gzhon nu kun/ /rab tu dga' ba'i zlos gar sgyur bzhin du/ /dad gus sgo mdongs gdugs mdzes 'bub par rigs/ /'jig rten khams na snyan pa'i sgra zhig la/ /ka la piṅka'i sgra las snyan pa med/ /de bzhin gtam snyan 'di nyid thos tshad kyi/ /rgyud la dga' spro dpag med 'char bar shog /'jig rten khams na phan pa'i 741

chos gcig la/ /byams dang snying rje'i chos las zab pa med/ /chos gtam bzang bo phyogs bcur sgog mkhan gyi/ /chos pa mang bos sa steng khyab gyur cig / ces springs yig ka la piṅka'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni dbus gtsang phyogs phyogs kyi slob ma yon bdag pho mo yongs la phan phyir/ zhabs dkar bas dben gnas nyams dga' bkra shis 'khyil ba nas springs pa'o//742

nyams mgur khu byug sngon mo'i skad snyan bzhugs so//na mo gu ru/ /'di phyi yi skyabs mgon yid bzhin gye nor bus/ /byin rlabs dang dngos grub char bzhin du phobs shig /stong nyid dang snying rje rang shugs kyis 'byongs pa'i/ /rnal 'byor nga'i skyid pa skyid nyams kyi ngang nas/ /rang nyams la shar ba'i mgur dbyangs rang len no/ /nyams mgur la dga' bas ma yengs par nyon dang / /snang ba ni gu yangs rig pa ni zang thal/ /khyab gdal gyi lta ba phyogs med du phyam phyam/ /sgrib g.yog dang bral ba'i chos sku dang mjal byung / /'jam dbyangs la dris kyang 'di 'dra zhig los gsung / /dbyangs can mas go yang 'dzum pa zhig 'chor snyam/ /chos pa dang 'jig rten thams cad kyi kha nas/ /'chi ba ni chos sku yong rgyu zhig yod zer/ /nga rang la gar gnas chos sku yi pho phrang / /phyin chad tsho yong rgyu'i re ba dang bral song / /da lta rang shi rung 'gyod pa zhig mi snang / /phyogs med kyi rgyal khams gang la rang song yang / /snang so ni mda' las bde mo rang byung song / /gang la yang chags zhen spu tsam 743

zhig mi snang / /gang gis kyang sems khur byed rgyu zhig mi 'dug /gu yangs kyi yan pa blo bde ngas skyid pa/ /bde stong gi ro yis gting nas rang myos tshe/ /nyam thag gi 'gro la snying rje zhig skyes song / /thams cad la 'di 'dra'i skyid po rang shog cig /rnal 'byor pa'i nyams la 'grib rgyu zhig mi 'dug /'di 'dra yi mgur la tshar rgyu yang mi snang / /da dung yang ma shi tshe ring 'dra byung na/ /'di 'dra yi nyams dbyangs sna tshogs pa len bzhin/ /dbus gtsang gi phyogs su yar yar la chas yong / /nga bzhin du byed pa'i rnal 'byor 'dra yod na/ /bde skyid kyi nyi ma nang nas rang 'char nges/ /zhes nyams mgur khu byug sngon mo'i skad snyan zhes bya ba 'di yang snang so mda' las bde zhing chags med rlung ltar 'phyo ba'i rnal 'byor zhabs dkar bas nyin zhig nyasas la shar ba ltar bris nas bkra shis 'khyil nas phul ba'o/ /744

'dun ma legs pa'i mgur dbyangs gdangs snyan pi wang gling bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /byin rlabs dngos grub char bzhin 'bebs mdzad pa'i/ /skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag dang slob ma yon bdag thams cad la/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /dang po chung dus chos la dad pa skyes/ /bar du gzhon dus lha chos byed 'dod dran/ /tha ma yul spangs bla ma'i zhabs drung bsnyegs/ /tshul 'di bsams na 'dun ma legs nas gda'/ /dang po bla ma bsten nas thos bsam byas/ /bar du ri khrod dpen par rtse gcig bsgoms/ /tha ma nyams rtogs yon tan gter kha brdol/ /tshul 'di bsams na 'dun ma legs nas gda'/ /dang po mnga' ris skor gsum 'gro don 'grub/ /bar du dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i 'gro don 'grub/ /tha ma mdo khams sgang gsum 'gro don 'grub/ /tshul 'di bsams na 'dun ma legs nas gda'/ /dang po thos 745

bsam byed pa'i slob ma mang / /bar du nyams len byed mkhan slob ma mang / /tha ma 'gro don byed mkhan slob ma mang / /tshul 'di bsams na 'dun ma legs nas gda'/ /dang po mthun rkyen sbyor ba'i yon bdag mang / /bar du ci gsung bsgrub pa'i yon bdag mang / /tha ma bstan 'gror phan pa'i yon bdag mang/ /tshul 'di bsams na 'dun ma legs nas gda'/ /bla ma slob ma yon bdag thams cad kyis/ /tshe 'dir thog mtha' bar gsum gang la yang / /chos ldan bya ba rlabs chen mang bo byas/ /tshul 'di bsams na 'dun ma legs nas gda'/ /pha rgan 'dun ma legs snyam shin tu dga'/ /bu slob rnams kyang bla ma'i rnam thar skyongs/ /yon bdag rnams kyis sdig spong dge sgrub gyis/ /kun gyis thun mong bstan 'gro'i don chen sgrubs/ /phyi mar dag pa'i zhing nas mjal bar nges/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi bya ba tshar nas gda'/ /shi yang kha chems 'jog rgyu 'di'i lhag med/ /thos tshad thams cad bde zhing skyid par shog /ces 'dun ma legs pa'i mgur dbyangs gdangs snyan pi wang gling bu zhes bya ba 'di ni sngar gyi bya ba byas tshul rnams la bsams nas/ nyin zhig sems la shar ba ltar bris nas dben gnas nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i bkra shis 'khyil ba nas phul ba'o/ /746

dam chos gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas('brom rin po che'i gsung /) 'dra ba'i ston pa med/ /chos dang 'dra ba'i skyob pa med/ /dge 'dun 'dra ba'i zhing sa med/ /de phyir bdag gis skyabs su mchis/ /skyabs gnas(rje btsun sgol ma'i gsung /)bla ma dran par mdzod/ /lus ni lha yi rang bzhin la/ /ngag ni bzlas brjod brtson par mdzod/ /'gro ba ma lus pha mar sgoms/ /sems kyi gnas lugs stong bar sbyongs/ /sdig pa(sangs rgyas kyi gsung /)ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /srid pa'i(rje rin po che'i gsung /)sbyor bas mi bslu med/ /gcig tu phan pa dam pa'i chos/ /bstan dang mjal ba lan re tsam//de phyir de yi don la dgongs/ /nad(jobo rje'i gsung /)med pa ni bde ba'i mchog /dga' ba sbyin pa sbyin pa'i mchog /mya ngan 'das pa bde ba'i mchog /blo gtad thub pa grogs kyi mchog /ser snas(rjemila'i gsung /)bsags na mi 'phel ba/ /mkha' 'gro spyi yi dam tshig yin/ /btang na nyung du 747

mi 'gro ba/ /nor lha spyi yi dam tshig yin/ /phyug po(sa skya paṇa chen gyi gsung /)longs spyod 'phel 'dod na/ /sbyin pa gtong ba man ngag yin/ /phongs pa slong ba 'du ba bzhin/ /'bul bar 'dod pa de bas mang / /gang la(norabu'i phreng ba las/)chags pa spang bya zhing / /chags pa med par gnas par bya/ /chags pas bde 'gro'ang mi thob cing / /thar ba'i srog kyang gcod par byed/ /ge(glang ru thang ba'i gsung /)dang rgyal kha gzhan la byin/ /gyong dang pham kha rang gis longs/ /dam chos ji 'dra'i zhal phye nas/ /bltas rung 'di min go rgyu med/ /sems(zhabs dkar bas/)la phan pa'i chos shig la/ /blo sbyong rnams las zab pa med/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems/ /kun gyis yi dam lha bzhin sgoms/ /rna bar snyan pa'i gtam zhig la/ /byams dang snying rje'i sgra dbyangs las/ /lhag pa'i gtam snyan gzhan na med/ /gtam 'di ma ṇi bzhin du bgrongs/ /byang chub(yongs grags sgon lam lags/)sems mchog rin po che/ /ma skyes pa rnams skye gyur cig /skyes pa nyams pa med pa dang / /gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /ces dam chos gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba 'di ni byen rlabs che ba'i khyad byas rang bzo ma yin par dam pa gong ma'i gsung kha shas phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas/ zhabs dkar bas dben gnas nyams dga' bkra shis 'khyil ba nas phul ba'o/ /748

rgyal ba yab sras la phul ba'i zhu shog rab dkar gos bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /skye med chos sku'i lha lam yangs pa nas/ /'gag med gzugs sku'i rta bdun dbang bo shar/ /gdul bya gling bzhi yongs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /skyabs mgon nyi ma gzhon nu'i zhabs drung du/ /tshul khrims rtsa ba brtan cing phan sems kyi/ /'dab rgyas rnal 'byor pad+ma dkar bo yis/ /sor bcu'i 'dab ma spyi bo'i ze'u 'brur phyogs/ /zhu tshig dri zhim cung zad tsam zhig spro//mgon khyod gzugs sku nyi ma gzhon nu la/ /mi mthun sgra gcan 'tshe ba ring nas dben/ /thugs rje'i 'od zer phyogs ris med par spros/ /thub bstan pad+ma'i tshal rnams bzhad pa mtshar/ /de tshe gtam snyan dbyar gyi rnga bo che/ /phyogs kun ldir ba lan mang thos pa'i mod/ /bdag blo'i gar mkhan gzhon nu dbang med du/ /dad gus dga' spro'i gar gyis brel ba byung / /bdag lus nyam chung mgron khang hrul bo la/ /lo zla nyin zhag 749

thigs pas brdungs na yang / /na 'chi'i char rlung drag pos ma bsgyel par/ /rnam shes mgron po skabs re 'khor bzhin mchis/ /skyabs mgon khyed ni tshe dpag med pa ltar/ /mya ngan 'da' tshul tsam yang mi ston par/ /bskal pa khri phrag 'bum phrag mang bo'i bar/ /bzhugs nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /bdag cag gdul bya byang chub ma thob bar tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med rjes 'dzin cing / /byang chub thob kyang rigs kyi bdag po ru/ /bzhugs nas 'bral ba med par byin gyis rlobs/ /da dung ma shi tshe ring byung gyur na/ /gser zhal mjal phyir dbus su yong dgos snyam/ /gzhi dang lam bar gang du'ang gegs med par/ /bde bar myur du sleb pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu/ /de ltar skyabs 'jug zhus pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /tshe 'dir ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub pa dang / /phyi mar bde ba can gye zhing skyes nas/ /'od dpag med mgon 'khor bcas mjal bar shog /ces dngul rdo tshad lha rdzas bcas rgyal ba rin po che la phul ba'o/ /nges 'byung byang sems yang dag lta ba yi/ /rtsa ba brtan cing rim gnyis yal 'dab rgyas/ /nyams rtogs me tog 'bras bu brjid chags pa'i/ /skyabs mgon dpag bsam ljon pa'i zhabs drung du/ /mgon khyod thugs rje'i yal 'dab grib bsil 750
