du/ /chud pa'i rnal 'byor lha bu rgan pa yis/ /lag gnyis thal mo spyi bo'i gtsug tu sbyar/ /lha phyag dang bcas gsol ba 'debs 'bras ni/ /mgon khyod gzugs sku dpag bsam ljon shing la/ /mi mthun lha min nyer 'tshe ring nas dben/ /byams brtse byang chub sems kyi grib bsil la/ /gdul bya lha phrug stong phrag mang bo 'khod/ /bstod sngags snyan pa'i ba dan phyogs kun g.yo/ /de nyid sgra 'dzin dbang bor son ma thag /rab dga'i sa thob lta bu'i dga' spro gnyis/ /sems khong dog por mi shong tsam zhig byung / /phran chung sgyu lus me tog rnyings na yang / /na 'chi grang reg ba mos ma mnar bar/ /phan sems dri ngad phyogs kun 'thul bzhin du/ /rnam shes sbrang mas ma btang tsam du mchis/ /mgon khyod tshe mtha' yas pa ji bzhin du/ /bskal pa bye ba brgya stong mang bo'i bar/ /gdul bya'i don du zhabs pad brtan dgos zhes/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal bstan rin po che/ /phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa'i phyir/ /ris med 'gro la mdo sngags zung 'brel gyis/ /zab rgya'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /bdag cag rnams kyang byang chub ma thob bar/ /tshe rabs kun tu 'brel med rjes su zungs/ /byang chub 751

thob kyang spyi bo'i gtsug rgyan du/ /nam yang 'bral ba med par bzhugs su gsol/ /de ltar skyabs 'jug zhus pa'i yig chung la/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis yud tsam gzigs pa'i rten/ /rin chen lha rdzas dang bcas phul ba'i mthus/ /tshe rabs kun tu rjes su 'dzin gyur cig /ces dngul rdo tshad lha rdzas bcas paṇa chen rin po che la phul ba'o/ / 752

skyo mgur pi wang rgyud mang bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru/ thugs dgongs nam mkha' la sa yangs shing / /thugs rje nyi ma las che ba'i/ /skyabs gcig drin can gyi bla ma/ /'bral med snying dbus su bzhugs shig /bla ma bde gshegs de dran bzhin/ /'khor ba'i chos nyid la bsams tshe/ /skyo ba rang shugs kyis skyes nas/ /skyo mgur 'di 'dra zhig thal song //skyes pa 'chi ba tsho mthong bas/ /lus la gces 'dzin 'dra byas rung / /tha ma 'di 'dra rang los yin/ /bsams pas skyo ba rang skyes song / /'dus pa 'bral ba tsho mthong bas/ /pha ma nye 'brel 'dra 'dzoms rung / /tha ma 'di 'dra rang los yin/ /bsams pas skyo ba rang skyes song / /bsags pa 'dzad pa tsho mthong bas/ /nor rdzas mang bo 'dra bsags rung //tha ma 'di 'dra rang los yin/ /bsams pas skyo ba rang skyes song / /mthon po lhung ba tsho mthong bas/ /go sa mthon po 'drar slebs rung / /tha ma 'di 'dra rang los yin/ /bsams pas skyo ba rang skyes song / /brtsigs pa 'jig pa tsho mthong bas/ /sa mkhar mthon po 'dra 753

snyebartsigs rung / /tha ma 'di 'dra rang los yin/ /bsams pas skyo ba rang skyes song / /thams cad mi rtag pa mthong bas mi nor zas gsum 'dra 'dzoms rung / /tha ma 'di 'dra rang los yin/ /bsams pas skyo ba rang sgyes song / /dbus gtsang dag zhing du chas yong / /yong rgyu'i skal ba 'dra med na/ /phyi ma dag zhing nas mjal ba'i//rnam dag smon lam zhig 'debs so/ /grong ba'i sdug bsngal tsho mthong bas/ /khyem bdag bza' dpo na 'dra byas kyang / /nam zhig 'di ltar du sdug snyam/ /khyim thab byed 'dod cig mi snang / /bla ma'i dka' las tsho mthong bas/ /dgon ngan bla ma 'dra byas kyang / /nam zhig 'di ltar du dka' snyam/ /bla ma byed 'dod cig mi snang / /dpon po'i 'o rgyal tsho mthong bas/ /sde ngan dpon po 'dra byas kyang / /nam zhig 'di ltar du 'gro snyam/ /dpon po byed 'dod cig mi snang / /rgan mo lo lon tsho mthong bas/ /chung ma gzhon nu 'dra blangs kyang / /nam zhig 'di ltar du rgas snyam/ /chung ma len 'dod cig mi snang / /gon pa hral hrul tsho mthong bas/ /gos chen yag po 'dra gon kyang / /nam zhig 'di ltar du 'dzad snyam//gos bzang gyon 'dod cig mi snang / /mi gtsang dor ba tsho mthong bas/ /kha zas zhim po 'dra zos kyang //nam zhig 'di ltar 754

du 'gyur snyam/ /zhim po za 'dod cig mi snang / /dbus gtsang dag zhing du chas yong / /yong rgyu'i skal ba 'dra med na/ /phyi mar dag zhing nas mjal ba'i/ /rnam dag smon lam zhig 'debs so//dgung sngon mthon po na gnas pa'i/ /'od gsal nyi zla gnyis mthong bas/ /dbus gtsang dag zhing na bzhugs pa'i/ /rgyal ba yab sras gnyis dran byung / /na bun dngul mdog gis bskor pa'i/ /spang ri mthon po tsho mthong bas/ /dad can mang bo yis bskor pa'i/ /lha ldan bsam yas tsho dran byung / /'brog pa'i ri klung na gnas pa'i/ /g.yang lug brgya stong kun mthong bas/ /dbus gtsang yul phyogs na gnas pa'i/ /dgon chen mang bo tsho dran byung / /phyogs 'di'i yar mar na yod pa'i//slob ma yon bdag tsho mthong bas/ /dbus gtsang mnga' ris na gnas pa'i/ /grwa slob yon bdag tsho dran byung / /tshe 'das drin can tsho dran pas//skyo shas snying rlung 'dra langs song //bla ma bde gshegs de dran pas/ /mig nas mchi ma zhig lhung thal/ /'di dang 'di 'dra yi tshul la/ /bsam blo zhib tu rang btang tshe/ /skyo ba rang shugs kyis skyes nas/ /gang la chags rgyu zhig mi snang / /dbus gtsang dag zhing du chas yong / /yong rgyu'i skal ba 'dra med na/ /phyi mar dag zhing nas mjal ba'i/ /rnam dag smon lam 755
zhig 'debs so/ /zhes skyo mgur pi wang rgyud mang zhes bya ba 'di yang nyin zhig sems la shar ba ltar bris nas/ dbus gtsang mnga' ris phyogs kyi slob ma yon bdag rnams la phul ba'o /

man ngag gser gyi thur ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes chen po/ yid la mi byed pa'i phyag rgya chen po/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ting 'dzin chen po'i ros gting nas myos shing 'khor 'das zil gyes gnon pa'i lta stangs can/ zhabs dkar mig po ches/ long ba mig phye ba lta bu'i man ngag ston pas/ bskal brgyar bsod nams bsags pa'i 'bras bu can las dang skal bar ldan pa'i slob ma kun gyis bying rmugs gnyid gsum rnam rtog 'phro rgod thams cad yul thon la ma yengs par sa ler nyon cig de yang gnas lugs kyi don la mnyam par bzhag nas/ tshe 'dir nyon mongs pa'i dgra thams cad cham la phab nas/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'dod pas/ tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad blos btang nas gang la yang chags pa dang zhen pa med par/ ri khrod dben par dkor grib la 'dzems shing / khrus dang gtsang sbra byas/ bla ma la gsol ba btab/thugs yid gcig tu bsres/ rig pa kha yan du glod/ lus drang 757

bor bsrang / mig gi lta stangs gzengs bstod/ shes pa hur phyung / dbang bo la mdangs thon/ sang nge ye re sgoms dang / lta ba la bogs thon nas/ rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam/ ma bsgrubs pa'i lha zhal mthong / mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul yong /dgra gnyen la khyad par med/ byams snying rje byang chub sems kyi gter kha brdol nas/ rang gzhan gyi don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par 'gyur bas kun gyis bsgom pa la brtson par mdzod cig /smras pa/ thugs dgongs zab mo nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /cir yang sa ler gzigs pa thams cad mchod/ /ye shes spyan gyis 'khor 'das chos rnams kun/ /ma 'dres sa ler gzigs par byin gyis rlobs/ /rtogs pa nam mkha'i khyon ltar rab yangs pa'i/ /rnal 'byor nyams la shar ba'i glu dbyangs len/ /sems nyid mkha' ltar yangs shing nyi ltar gsal/ /shel ltar dwangs 'dod skal bzang rnams kyis nyon/ /chos kun rtsa ba don dam byang chub sems/ /stong gsal 'dzin med zang thal khyab gdal le/ /ri rab rtse nas mkha' la bltas pa ltar/ /mtha' dang dbus med gu yangs sang nger gnas/ /phyi yi rgya mtsho'i mtha' la bltas pa ltar/ /shin tu gting zab phyogs kun mer re 758

gnas/ /shel gyi khang par bzhugs nas bltas pa ltar/ /phyi nang med par zang nge thal ler gnas/ /ston gnam g.ya' dag pa la bltas pa ltar/ /shin tu gsal zhing dwangs la sgrib med gnas/ /rlung med bar snang khams la bltas pa ltar/ /byeng rmugs 'phro rgod kun bral rjen ne gnas/ /gsal zhing dwangs la rnam par mi rtog pa'i/ /mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang nyid las/ /srid pa'i rtse nas dmyal ba yan chad kyi/ /snang ba'i dngos po spu yi rtse mo tsam/ /yan chad lag pa'i mthil du skyu ru ra/ /rlon pa bzhag nas mig gis bltas pa ltar/ /ci yang sa le sang nge gzigs rag gi /bar du gnas lugs ngang la 'jog nus na/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang brnyes/ /de dus 'khor 'das ltad mo sna tshogs mthong / /mthong tshe ma gyur sems can thams cad dang / /bcos ma min pa'i snying rje chen po skye/ /snying rje che bas nye ring chags sdang med/ /chags sdang med pa'i 'gro don 'grub par 'gyur/ /glu 'di thos tshad dga' bzhin spro bzhin du/ /gnas lugs ngang la mnyam par 'jog par smon/ /mnyam par bzhag pas sgrib gnyis kun dag nas/ /spyan dang mngon shes dzu 'phrul 'char bar shog /bla ma'i rgyud la shar ba'i nyams rtogs kun/ /slob ma'i sems la 'char ba'i bkra shis 759

shog /ces bla ma'i man ngag gser gyi thur ma zhes bya ba 'di yang nyin zhig nyams la shar tshe slob ma rnams la phan phyir zhabs dkar bas yi ger bris nas phul ba'o/ /'dis kyang kun la phan thogs par gyur cig /phyogs bcu yi zhing gi sangs rgyas rnams/ /phyogs gang du 'gro yang thugs rjes gzigs/ /phyogs phyogs na gnas pa'i dpon slob rnams/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dzom par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe lha mchog mgon po tshe dpag med/ /tshe bsod nams rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /tshe yun thung nam 'chi cha med rung / /tshe ring bo yong ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /dus da nas sangs rgyas ma thob bar/ /dus yang yang mjal zhing mthar thug tu/ /dus nam yang 'bral ba med par shog /rang nyid mthong thos dran reg thams cad kyi/ /lus nad sems kyi sdug bsngal kun zhi nas/ /tshe 'dir lus sems bde zhing skyid pa dang / /phyi mar bde ba can du skye bar shog /rang nyid gar song yul la bkra shis shing / /gang bsam don rnams yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /gang du bsdad pa'i nang la byin chags shing / /gang yod nor la g.yang kun 'khyil bar shog /ces gang bsam 'grub pa'i smon tshig 'di rnams kyang dbus gtsang du yi ge bskur pa phal cher gyi gsham du bris nas phul ba'o//760

zhing phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rab 'byams rnams//thugs brtse ba'i spyan gyis rtag tu gzigs/ /stod dbus gtsang slob ma sbyin bdag la/ /dus yang yang mjal bar byen gyis rlobs/ /tshe 'di ru da dung mjal bar shog /tshe phyi ma'i yul la'ang mjal bar shog /zhal bar do'i skabs su'ang mjal bar shog /dus yang nas yang du mjal bar shog /kun tshe ring nad med smon lam 'debs/ /yid smon pa bzhin du 'grub gyur cig /zhal mjal dus dge legs bkra shis shog /bkra shis pas phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /ces dus yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam 'di yang bris nas phul ba'o/ /jo shāka rnam gnyis dang rgyal ba yab sras kyi gsol 'debs smon lam gser phreng rnams kyang phul ba chos spyod na gsal lo//yang 'brong lung dben pa'i dga' tshal na gnas dus nyin gcig nam mkha' dag pa la nyi ma gsal bo shar/ phyogs phyogs na sprin dkar bo 'o ma 'phyur ba bzhin yar langs pa mthong bas rkyen byas/ chu 'go gangs la thug pa lta bu'i bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa sangs rgyas/ skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo la sogs pa'i dngos brgyud kyi bla ma rnams rim bzhin du dran pa'i tshe khye'us pha ma 'bod 'dra'i glu dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /761

mgon thub dbang rgyal ba yab sras dang / /pha chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo sogs/ /khong rgya bod mkhas grub thams cad kyi/ /rang gar bzhugs zhing nas bdag la dgongs/ /yul rgya gar rdo rje gdan dbus na/ /shing byang chub ljon pa'i bsil grib na/ /sngon sangs rgyas bzhugs tshul yid la shar/ /dus da lta bzhugs na dga' ba la/ /nga rgya gar yul la 'gro snying 'dod/ /ngas bsam zhing sangs rgyas 'khor bcas dran/ /gzhan mkhas grub mang bo dran nas byung / /de dran pa'i mod la dad pa skyes/ /dbus po ta la yi rtse mo na/ /gtsang bkra shis lhun po'i pho brang na/ /sngon skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras bzhugs/ /dus da lta bzhugs na dga' ba la/ /nga dbus gtsang yul la 'gro snying 'dod/ /ngas bsam zhing rgyal ba yab sras dran/ /gzhan bla ma mang bo dran nas byung / /de dran pa'i mod la ba spu g.yo/ /sa sog phyogs lha yul gnyis pa na/ /gur dkar bo lha yi pho brang na/ /sngon chos rgyal bzhugs tshul yid la shar/ /dus da lta bzhugs na dga' ba la/ /nga sog po'i yul la 'gro snying 'dod//ngas bsam zhing chos rgyal yum sras dran/ /gzhan blon 'khor grogs rnams dran nas byung / /de dran pa'i mod la mchi ma shor/ /tshe 'di phyi bar do gang du yang //rje gtan gyi skyabs mgon khyed rnams la/ /762

zhal yang nas yang du mjal ba dang / /gsung chos kyi bdud rtsi 'thung bar shog /zhes blangs nas mchi ma btang tshe/ de na 'dug pa'i grwa btsun 'ga' rer kyang mig nas mchi ma shor/ bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis/ der 'tshogs pa rnams kyi rgyud la bla ma la mos gus/ mched grogs la brtse gdung / sems can la snying rje/ chos lugs yongs la dag snang skyes pa 'ba' zhig byung ngo / /yang bkra shis 'khyil ba na mtshams la yod dus khyung dgon sprul ba'i skus kho bo la phan pa'i zhal gdams shig gsung dgos zhes bsgul ngor/ rje btsun spyan snga ba'i gsung ltar gnod pa byed pa la bzod pa bsgom pa'i phan yon 'di byen/bzod pa'i phar phyin rdzogs pa yi/ /bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnod pa byed pa thams cad la/ /bzod pa bsgom par byen gyis rlobs/ /yon tan mchog gyur bzod pa ni/ /gnod byed med par skye mi srid/ /bzod pa nyid kyis sa lam kun/ /bgrod par sangs rgyas zhal gyis bzhes/ /gnod byed rkyen dang phrad pa'i tshe/ /dbul bo gter dang phrad pa ltar/ /dga' ba chen po bskyed byed pa/ /de yi bde ba zad pa med/ /mkhas pa kun gyis bsngags pa dang / /dpal dang gzi brjid cher ldan 'gyur/ /tshe 'di nyid la myur ba ru/ /go 'phang je mtho je mthor 'gyur/ /de ltar mkhas pas shes byas te/ /rang gis bu bzhin 763

bskyangs pas kyang / /tshur la gnod mang byed pa dang / /gzhan yang gshe dang brdeg pa dang / /gces pa'i nor rnams chud gzon pa'i/ /brkus sam mi rigs slong ba 'am/ /rang gi gnyen dang mdza' bshes la/ /gnod pa byed cing rang nyid la/ /bsnyen bkur bya bar rigs pa yi/ /re ba chad par byed pa sogs/ /yid du mi 'ong ci byung yang / /bzod pa bsgom la 'bad par bya/ /bzod pa bsgom pa'i chos pa la/ /rkyen ngan chos kyi grogs su 'char/ /gnas skabs bde zhing skyid pa dang / /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur/ /sngon chad gnod pa byas gyur tam/ /byed dam byed du dogs pa yi//rigs la mi dga' mi byed par/ /dga' bzhin bzod pa bsgom par bya/ /zhes byen pas khong gis kyang de ltar mdzang pas rkyen ngan thams cad grogs su shar ro/ /yang dgu rong sprul skus sems la phan pa'i zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor spyan snga ba'i gsung ltar gzhan la bstod pa'i phan yon 'di byen/bla ma dkon mchog rin chen la/ /rab tu gus pas phyag byas nas/ /rang dang gzhan la phan pa yi/ /kha ta tshig 'ga' bshad kyis nyon/ /mdo dang bstan bcos thams cad las/ /bdag bstod gzhan smod 'di smad cing / /'di dang phyi ma'i nyes 764

dmigs ni/ /drag cing mi zad mang du gsungs/ /mtshon gyi rma la sos dus yod/ /tshig ngan rma la sos dus med/ /khwa tas 'ug par sma phab pas/ /bskal pa'i bar du 'gras la ltos/ /brag la ku co btab pa na/ /de ma thag tu lan 'byung ltar/ /'gro la mi snyan smras byas na/ /de ma thag tu le lan 'byung / /de bas blo gros ldan rnams kyis/ /bdag bstod gzhan smod 'di spongs la/ /gzhan bstod bdag la smad par bya/ /gzhan la ji ltar bstod pa tsam/ /rang la 'gro bas bstod par 'gyur/ /snyan pa'i tshig gis bstod pa yis/ /'gro ba dga' zhing mgu bar 'gyur/ /'gro ba dga' mgur gyur pa yis/ /bdag nyid mchog tu dga' mgur 'gyur/ gzhan dag la ni bstod pa yis/ /de lta bur ni bde thob na/ /mkhas pa su zhig de mi byed/ /'phangs pa'i nor ni gtong mi dgos/ /lus kyi sdug bsngal 'khur mi dgos/ /dka' ba gang yang 'dir med na/ /su zhig gzhan la bstod mi byed/ /mdor na ji ltar bdag bstod cing / /gzhan la smad pa de tsam du/ /bdag nyid smad pa'i mchog tu 'gyur/ /ji ltar ji ltar bdag smad cing / /gzhan la bstod pa de tsam du/ /bdag nyid bstod pa'i chog tu 'gyur/ /zhes byen pa'i nang ltar mdzad pas/ gzhan rnams dga' zhing mgu bar gyur te/ slar yang mchod bstod bkur bar gyur to// 765

yang dmag gsar rdo rje 'chang gi sras mi bskyod rdo rjes kho bo la yang zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor/ spyan snga ba'i gsung ltar dam pa'i chos la brtson 'grus byas pa'i phan yon 'di byin/ brtson pas tshe gcig sangs rgyas pa'i/ /bla ma gong ma rnams la 'dud/ /le lo snyom las kun spangs nas/ /brtson 'grus rtsom par byin gyis rlobs/ /mtshan mo thog thag ro nyal byed/ /nyin mo'i bzhi cha bza' btung byed/ /bzhi cha long gtam rnam g.yeng byed/ /dge sbyor glog 'gyu tsam byas nas/ /grub rtags yong du re ba yi/ /khyod kyi brtson 'grus 'di la ltos/ /rang gis rang la ngo yang tsha/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs kyang khrel/ /spyod ngan 'di ni ma bor na/ /sangs rgyas thob pa lta ci smos/ /bde ba gang yang thob mi srid/ /rang gis rang la bsam blo thongs/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas grangs med kyang / /gdod ma nyid nas sangs rgyas min/ /tha mal shin tu tha chad kyis/ /'bad pas byang chub thob pa yin/ /bsgrubs na mi 'grub gang yang med/ /gtsubs na shing la me yang 'byung / /bsags na rgya mtsho'ang thigs pas khengs/ /brkos na skam sar chu yang thon/ /chu yi thigs pa babs pa yis/ /sra ba'i rdo yang 'bigs par nus/ /mi yi rkang bas phyin 766

pa yis/ /sra ba'i them pa'ang zad par nus/ /'bad pa dag la rgyun chad med/ /brtsams na'ang 'bras bu ma byung ba/ /sngar yang ma byung phyis mi 'byung / /da lta'i dus su'ang 'byung mi srid/ /mdor na rje btsun mi la sogs/ /dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar ltar/ /khyod kyis brtson 'grus byas gyur na/ /'dod don thams cad 'grub par nges/ /legs par bshad pa'i gtam 'di la/ /dge ba ji snyed yod pa des/ /'gro rnams sangs rgyas thob phyir du/ /rlabs chen brtson 'grus rtsom par shog /ces byen pa'i nang ltar byas pas 'dod don thams cad 'grub pa byung /yang mang ra'i slob bu blo bzang mkhas mchog gis kho bo la yang skal ba bzang bzang byas zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor/ spyan snga ba'i gsung ltar ja la sred pa spong ba'i gtam 'di byin/chos nyid nam mkha' lta bu las/ /nam yang g.yo ba mi mnga' yang / /thugs rje spyod pa sna tshogs ston/ /bla ma'i zhabs la gus pas 'dud/ /dus ngan snyigs ma lnga bdo la/ /thams cad 'dod yon lnga yis bslus/ /khyad par ja 'dis brlag pa tsam/ /dgra bo yis kyang ga la brlag /ja yi phyir du nor shor nas/ /sprang bor 'gro ba grangs mi chod/ /phyug po 'dod na dgra bo che/ /767

ja la gdon du shes par gyes/ /ja zhig yod do byon byas na/ /bshad 'phro nyan 'phro sgrub 'phro dang / /bzlas brjod 'phro yang ling bskyur nas/ /'gro yin 'dug pa mang du mthong / /ja yi phyir du chos bskyur nas/ /bla ma dang yang 'thab rtsod byed/ /mched grogs dag dang pha ma la'ang / /'thab rtsod byed pa du ma yod/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la'ang / /khong gis nga la ja zhig kyang / /ma blud ces 'khang dam nyams su/ /gyur pa bdag gis mang bo mthong / /ja zhig 'thung ba'i dus skabs su/ /mi zhig glo bur byung gyur na/ /ja ni 'chor bar 'gyur ro snyam/ /bzhin gyi 'gyur ldog skad cig ston/ /ja la dga' ba'i gang zag ni/ /gang na 'dug kyang ja yod pa'i/ /gnas dang dgon pa 'tshol bar byed/ /ja yi gleng mo kho na byed/ /dben pa'i gnas na ja med pas/ /dben pa dgra ru mthong ba 'di/ /ja la zhen pa'i khyad chos yin/ /dben pa dgra ru mthong gyur na/ /rtogs pa rgyud la ji ltar skye/ /rtogs pa rgyud la ma skyes na/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob mi 'gyur/ /de phyir ja la ma dga' zhig /ja yi nyes dmigs cung zad tsam/ /bshad pa'i dge des 'gro ba kun/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho las brgal ba'i/ /thar ba'i gling du phyin par shog /ces bshad pa ltar byas pas ja la sred pa chung bar gyur to//768

sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ /chos phung brgyad khri yi 'byung gnas/ /'phags tshogs dge 'dun gyi rgyan gcig /drin can bla ma rang mkhyen no/ /zla ba rgyang ring na gnas kyang / /dwangs pa'i mtsho nang du shar bzhin/ /bla ma thag ring na bzhugs rung / /yid la wa le rang shar byung / /snying nas gsol ba rang 'debs so/ /thugs rje rgyang nas rang gzigs shig /khyed la nye ring ni mi mnga'/ /'bad dang rtsol ba yang mi dgos/ /bdag ni gang du rang gnas kyang / /byen rlabs dngos grub kyi char phobs/ /'di phyi bar do yi gnas skabs/ /skyabs dang skyel ma rang mdzod cig /ces bla ma rgyang 'bod 'di ni dad can 'brong lung dkon gnyer dge 'dun rgya mtshos bskul ngor/ rnal 'byor zhabs dkar bas dben gnas bkra shis 'khyil ba nas sbyar ba'o/ /bla ma dkon mchog mgo yi zhwa bzhin bkur/ /mched lcam dam tshig dpral ba'i mig bzhin 'tshos/ /khas blangs sdom pa kha yi so bzhin srungs/ /byang chub sems mchog khog pa'i snying bzhin gces/ /tshad med bzhi bo yan lag bzhin du dgos/ /lus ni snang stong lha yi sku ru sgoms/ /ngag gis grags stong sngags kyi bzlas pa gyis/ /sems ni gsal stong 'dzin med ngang la zhog /mkha' 'gro chos skyong lus dang grib bzhin sten/ /769

'dzad med 'phags nor bdun gyis phyug par gyis/ /de ltar byas na bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /bstan dang 'gro ba yongs la phan par 'gyur/ /ces pa 'di ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho 'jigs med dang snyan grags sogs dad can gyi slob ma yongs la phan phyir zhabs dkar bas smras pa'o//dang po bla ma'i drung nas thos bsam byas/ /bar du ri khrod dben par gcig pur bsgoms/ /tha mar bstan dang 'gro la gang phan byas/ /mi rgan nga yi bya ba tshar nas gda'/ /da ni tshe mjug la mgo'i nyi zer tsam/ /yun thung nam 'chi cha yang mi 'dug pas/ /gzhon pa'i dus bzhin 'gro 'dug mi mang bar/ /dben par skyid nyal rgyag pa'i dus la babs/ /dam pa gong ma'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ /sa chu 'phrod cing mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa yi/ /ri khrod nyams dga' zhig tu 'chi nus na/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi bsam pa rdzogs pa yin/ /tshe 'dir ri khrod gang du phyin na yang / /sgrub la bar chad med pa bla ma'i drin/ /drin lan sgrub pa'i mchod pa rgyun du 'bul/ /sgrub la bar chad med par byin gyis rlobs/ /gangs rdza g.ya' dang nags tshal dur khrod sogs/ /yid mthun bag phebs ri yi rgyud bzang zhing / /byin ldan ma mo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i sa/ /dus kun rgyun du bsten pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di ni chos byed lo'i ngang la mi tshe shor ba'i 770

rnal 'byor zhabs dkar bas rang lo drug cu rtsa drug thog tu slebs tshe/ nyin zhig sems la shar ba ltar dben gnas bkra shis 'khyil ba nas smras pa'o//bka' chos zab mo mi gnang na/ /bla ma yin pas ci la phan/ /chos kyi nang bzhin mi byed na/ /slob ma yin pas ci la phan/ /'jig rten chos brgyad ma spangs na/ /chos pa yin pas ci la phan/ /'gyed phog mang ja mi gtong na/ /khri ba yin pas ci la phan/ /pha ma gnyis la mi byams na/ /bu tsha yin pas ci la phan/ /sprang bo rig tshe spro langs na/ /snying rje bsgoms pas ci la phan/ /'gro don 'ong rung mi byed na/ /sems bskyed byas pas ci la phan/ /phyogs med sbyin pa mi gtong na/ /kha lan sbyin pas ci la phan/ /tshul 'chos g.yo sgyu ma spangs na/ /tshul khrims bsrungs pas ci la phan/ /tshig ngan tsam re mi bzod na/ /bzod pa bsgoms pas ci la phan/ /chos la le lo byas gyur na/ /brtson 'grus yod pas ci la phan/ /lus sems las su ma rung na/ /bsam gtan bsgoms pas ci la phan/ /rgyu 'bras shes rung mi brtsi na/ /shes rab che bas ci la phan/ /lha bsnyen tsam yang mi byed na/ /dbang bskur zhus pas ci la phan/ /dam tshig sdom pa mi bsrung na/ /khas blangs mang bos ci la phan/ /gdams ngag zab mo mi bsgom na/ /sems khrid zhus pas ci la phan/ /thams 771

cad nang ba'i chos yin na/ /chos gzhan smad pas ci la phan/ / phyogs med dag snang ma sbyangs na/ /phyogs ris byas pas ci la phan/ /'chi brod chos shig ma byas na/ /'chi khar 'tsher bas ci la phan/ /ci la'ang phan pa med pa yis/ /ci zhig bya zhes zhog la thongs/ /zhes pa 'di ni rje btsun mi la ras pa'i ci la phan gyi mgur dang mthun par rang gzhan yongs la phan phyir rnal 'byor zhabs dkar bas smras pa'o/ /mtshan ldan bla ma ma bsten na/ /thams cad bsten pas ga la lang / /gnyen la chags sems ma spangs na/ /thams cad bskyangs pa'i ga la lang / /dgra la sdang sems ma spangs na/ /thams cad btul bas ga la lang / /'jig rten chos brgyad ma spangs na/ /snyan grags bsgrubs pas ga la lang / /nga rgyal rang mtho ma spangs na/ /che tshugs bzung bas ga la lang //'dod chung chog shes ma bsten na/ /'bul sdud brgyab pas ga la lang / /yon bdag ngo 'dzin ma spangs na/ /gos phrug byen pas ga la lang / /zhim po za 'dod ma spangs na/ /lug sha nyos pas ga la lang / /'jam po gyon 'dod ma spangs na/ /tshar rtsag bzos pas ga la lang / /'dod chags byed 'dod ma spangs na/ /bud med bsten pas ga lang / /khal rta zhon 'dod ma spangs na/ /rta bzang nyos pas ga la lang / /'don cha blo la ma bzung na/ /dpe 772

cha khyer bas ga la lang / /grogs la bzod pa ma bsgoms na/ /khong khro byas pas ga la lang / /mtshams byas nang nas ma bsdad na/ /'gro 'gro mang bos ga la lang / /lhag pa'i lha gcig ma bsgrubs na/ /lha mang bsgrubs pas ga la lang / /chos kyi gnad gcig ma bsgoms na/ /mang bo bsgoms pas ga la lang / /grub mtha'i phyogs ris ma spangs na/ /rtsod pa byas pas ga la lang / /kun la dag snang ma sbyangs na/ /log lta byas pas ga la lang / /dam pa'i chos bzhin ma byas na/ /'chi khar 'gyod pas ga la lang / /sems can las kyis 'chi ba la/ /mya ngan byas pas ga la lang / /ga la lang gi skyon 'di rnams/ /ga nas bltas kyang spangs na legs/ /zhes pa 'di ni rje btsun mi la ras pa'i ga la lang gi mgur bzhin rang gzhan la phan phyir zhabs dkar bas smras pa'o/ /yang nyin zhig grwa ba mang bos chos bshad 'dra byed snang /gcig na re/ phan bde 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di 'jig rten khams 'dir dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa zhig byung na ci ma rung / dge tshogs thams cad kyang bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du bsngo ba gal che zer ba byung tshe/ ngas sangs rgyas kyis lha mi yongs la chos bstan tshad pos ri ba tsho rgyas kyin bsdad na yang phan yon los che ste/ gtso bo chos 773

pa 'jig rten pa su yin yang rang rang gi sems rgyud la rgyas pa re byung na rang gzhan sdug bsngal dang bral nas/ bde ba rgyun mi 'chad du 'byung bar 'gyur zhes mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so mi dge'i sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /rnam dkar dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems rgyud gyong bo yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin par gsungs/ /rgad po rnams kyi rgyud na rgyu 'bras shig /yod phyin sangs rgyas bstan pa gnas pa yin/ /bstan 'dzin rgad po rgyu 'bras can la zer/ /rgyu 'bras med na bstan pa gnas pa min/ /chos pa rnams kyi rgyud na snying rje zhig /yod phyin sangs rgyas bstan pa gnas pa yin/ /bstan 'dzin chos pa snying rje can la zer/ /snying rje med na bstan pa gnas pa min/ /dge slong rnams kyi rgyud na sdom pa zhig /yod phyin sangs rgyas bstan pa gnas pa yin/ /bstan 'dzin dge slong sdom pa can la zer/ /sdom pa men na bstan pa gnas pa min/ /sngags pa rnams kyi rgyud na dam tshig cig /yod phyin sangs rgyas bstan pa gnas pa yin/ /bstan 'dzin sngags pa dam tshig can la zer/ /dam tshig med na bstan pa gnas pa min/ /bla ma rnams kyi rgyud na phan sems shig /yod phyin sangs 774

rgyas bstan pa gnas pa yin/ /bstan 'dzin bla ma phan sems can la zer/ /phan sems med na bstan pa gnas pa min/ /sgom chen rnams kyi rgyud na rtogs pa zhig /yod phyin sangs rgyas bstan pa gnas pa yin/ /bstan 'dzin rtogs ldan sgom chen rnams la zer/ /rtogs pa med na bstan pa gnas pa min/ /chos pa 'jig rten pa gnyis gang yin yang / /rgyud la sangs rgyas bstan pa gnas phyin chad/ /gnod dang sdug bsngal ming yang mi thos shing / /phan dang bde ba ma lus 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes smras pas kun gyi sems la phan po byung ngo / /skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /byen rlabs gter chen bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so slob bu yis/ /chos mgo thon par byen gyis rlobs/ /mang thos sgrub la brtson pa ngas/ /khyod la phan pa'i bslab bya 'chad/ /chos mgo mtha' ru thon pa'i phyir/ /bu khyod dga' ba'i sems kyis nyon/ /mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rnasas/ /bsam dang sbyor bas tshul bzhin bsten/ /lam rim blo sbyong phyag rdzogs sogs/ /sems la phan pa'i gdams pa zhus//ston pa'i gsung rab mdzangs blun dang //las brgya rtogs brjod brgya ba dang / /'dul ba lung gi rnam 'byed sogs/ /mdo sder lta rtogs byas na 'tshengs/ /phyi ru 775

'dul ba'i kun spyod gtsang / /nang du 'dod chung chog shes ldan/ /dge la sbyor ba'i grogs po de/ /bsten na chos mgo mtha' ru thon/ /nag chang sha la sred pa che/ /khe tshong byed cing ser sna dam/ /tshe 'dir sbyor ba'i grogs ngan de/ /nye na phung bas rgyang ring spongs/ /yang ba'i zhig gso zhing las dang / /phyug gi 'tsho skyong la sogs pa'i/ /don med 'jig rten bya gzhag la/ /sdug rus ma che skyur la thongs/ /sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab//gzhan gye rgyud tshod mi shes pas/ /kun spyod ngan pa mthong na yang / /dag snang sbyong ba gtso bor gyis/ /nyams len gzhan du dril ba la/ /dkon mchog gsum la blo rtse gtod/ /rgyun du dkon mchog mchod la brtson/ /phyag skor kha ton bsnyen sgrub la/ /gzhol dang bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /chos bshad byed pa'i zhabs dkar bas/ /slob ma'i chos mgo mthar thon phyir/ /bshad pa'i dge bas slob ma yis/ /chos mgo mtha' ru thon par shog /ces pa 'di ni dad gtong blo gros che ba'i slob bu ye shes dar rgyas kyis bskul ngor zhabs dkar bas 'brong lung nas smras pa'o/ /chos legs tshogs ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /rje mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /las skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams//tshe 'di ru grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /ngas mdo sngags 776

gnad kyi glu dbyangs len/ /khyed bu slob rnams kyang dga' bas nyon/ /spyir skye 'chi 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs soms/ /tshe 'di yi bya ba blo yis thongs/ /gzhan 'gro kun drin can ma ru sgoms/ /byams snying rje smon 'jug sems mchog skyed/ /lam phar phyin drug dang bskyed rdzogs gnyis/ /dus rgyun du nyams len mthil du zungs/ /mjug bsngo smon mtshams sbyor thun mtshams su/ /gzhan tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong gang nus gyes/ /don de ltar byas na brtson 'grus can/ /tshe 'di ru grol bar gdon mi za/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /ma 'gro kun sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces pa 'di ni dad brtson shes rab snying rje dang ldan pa'i dbu mdzad dkon mchog 'phrin las la sogs dad can rnams la phan phyir 'brong lung dben pa'i dga' tshal nas smras pa'o/ /pha chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo sogs/ /rje bla ma rnams la gus pas 'dud/ /bus tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang nas/ /chos tshul bzhin nus par byen gyis rlobs/ /rten dal 'byor mi lus thob dus 'dir/ /chos zab mo nyams su ma blangs na/ /dpe rin chen gling song ded dpon gyis/ /don ma grub stong bar log dang mtshungs/ /nor longs spyod sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi 'dra/ /rang ser snas bsags kyang shul du lus/ /gnyen 'khor g.yog tshong 777

'dus mgron po bzhin/ /mgron snga dro 'tshogs kyang phyi dro gyes/ /gzugs lang tsho ston mtha'i me tog 'dra/ /rkyen cung zad tsam res nyams nas 'gro/ /tshe rlung dmar nang gi mar me bzhin/ /dus nam 'dor cha yang rang la med/ /lus longs spyod phun tshogs thams cad la/ /yid 'phreng bzhin grogs med pha rol tu/ /rang 'di nas gcig pur 'gro ba'i tshe/ /chos ma gtogs gang gis phan pa med/ /don de phyir skal ldan snying gi bu/ /tshe 'di snang bya ba blo yis thongs/ /gnas ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /chos zab mo tshul bzhin bsgrub par mdzod/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge tshogs dang / /gzhan rnam dkar dge ba gang bsags mthus/ /bu'i bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa dang / /ma 'gro kun bde zhing skyid par shog /ces pa 'di yang skal ldan bu mchog mdzo dge'i mtshams pas bskul ngor rnal 'byor zhabs dkar bas dben gnas 'brong lung nas smras pa'o/ /sku rmad byung mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar ba/ /gsung thos pas mi ngoms tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /thugs zab cing rgya che mkhyen brtse'i gter/ /pha mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /dus nyin zhig rig pa dwangs pa'i tshe/ /khyed dad brtson ldan pa'i slob ma la/ /bka' mdo rgyud lam nas 'ongs pa 'a glu 778

snyan po tshig 'ga' len gyis nyon/ /rten dal 'byor mi lus rin chen 'di/ /ches rnyed par dka' zhing 'jig sla ba//dus da re lan gcig thob pa 'di/ /da don med byed na smyon pa yin/ /spyir 'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba med/ /sgos ngan song sdug bsngal shugs re drag /rang myong na bzod pa'i skabs med pas/ /der mi skye'i thabs la 'bad par 'tshal/ /lha tshangs dang dbang bo la sogs pa/ /slar mnar med 'bar ba'i mes bsregs na//dpal srid pa'i phun tshogs 'byor rgud la//gdeng cung zad tsam yang yod ma yin/ /sngar 'dod yon ro la ji tsam spyad/ /da bsams na snying bo ji 'dra 'dug /khyod rang gis rang nyid ma bslu bar/ /dus gtan gyi 'dun ma sgrub re ran/ /sngon byon pa'i grub thob gong ma bzhin/ /blo 'di snang bya ba phyam gyis bor//gnas 'du 'dzis dben par tshe lhag 'dir/ /sems 'gyod med lha chos sgrub 'tshal lo/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i rnam dkar dge /gzhan dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /bu slob ma yang slob sangs rgyas nas/ /bstan 'gro ba yongs la phan par shog /ces pa 'di yang skal ldan slob bu snyan grags la gdams pa'o/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum la 'dud/ /thugs rjes gzigs la byin gyis rlobs/ /rnal 'byor tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /779

phan pa'i snying gtam bshad kyis nyon/ /tshe thung nam 'chi cha med soms/ /blo kha nang du tshur phyogs la/ /rang gi rgyud la legs par rtogs/ /mi dge sems spongs dge ba'i sems/ /khyad par can gyi ngang nyid las/ /mdo sngags zung du 'brel ba yi zab dang rgya che'i lam bzang mchog /nyin mtshan med par nyams su longs/ /phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i/ /chos dang gang zag su la yang / /phyogs med dad gus dag snang sbyongs/ /bstan dang 'gro la gang phan mdzod/ /de ltar byas na tshe 'dir yang / /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /chos dang mthun pa'i snying gtam 'di/ /thos tshad yongs la phan par shog /ces pa 'di ni skal ldan slob bu ban tho la smras pa'o/ /chos nga/'i khyad chos bzhi ldan pa'i/ /chos mdzad yongs la gus pas 'dud/ /bdag gis chos pa'i mtshang bzhi dang //khyad chos bzhi bo gsal bar bshad/ /rang dang gzhan gyi slob ma'i rigs/ /zhal gdams zhu tshad kun gyis nyon/ /rang gi nor la ser sna che/ /mi yi nor la ham pa che/ /don dag med bzhin khong khro che/ /gzhan la phrag dog 'gran sems che/ /chos pa rnams kyi mtshang chen bzhi/ /yin pas kun gyis dug bzhin spongs/ /bla ma yongs la dad gus che/ /mched grogs yongs la brtse gdung che/ /780

sems can yongs la snying rje che/ /chos lugs yongs la dag snang che/ /chos pa rnams kyi khyad chos bzhi/ /yin pas kun gyes sman bzhin sten/ /bka' phyag chu bo gnyis 'dres kyi/ /zhal gdams kun gyi mthar thug yin/ /chos mdzad rnams kyis snying la chongs//thos tshad sems la phan par shog /ces pa 'di ni mgo log gser tha'i phyogs kyi dad can slob bu pad+ma kun bzang dang mi 'gyur gnyis la smras pa'o/ /snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo nas/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma yar la bzhengs/ /bag yod dran dang shes bzhin kyang / /de dang mnyam du bzhengs su gsol/ /gang la le lo gcig yod pa/ /de la chos kun med pa yin/ /ci yang dran med thom me ba/ /de ka ma rig 'khrul ba'i rgyu/ /gti mug zer ba'i ro nyal mkhan/ /phan par bzung yang gnod pa bskyal/ /gnyid kyi bde la chags pa yi/ /don med rab tu shor la ltos/ /gang la brtson 'grus gcig yod pa/ /de la chos kun yod pa yin/ /ci yang sa le hrig ge ba/ /de ka rang rig ye shes te/ /'od gsal zer ba'i sgra bo che/ /rang rig rang gsal 'di la zer/ /tho rangs rig pa gsal ba'i dus/ /ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas la ltos/ /snga bar yar la mi lang bar/ /nyi shar bar du nyal ba de/ /chos pa yongs kyi ltas ngan yin/ /de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /ces pa 'di ni tho 781

rangs khar nyal yod dus rang la rtse mtshar lta bur smras pa'o/ /gsar rnying chos lugs kun mkhyen pa'i/ /pha rgan chos kyi rgyal po la/ /bu ngas rgyun du gsol ba 'debs/ /bstan 'gror phan par byin gyis rlobs/ /mkha' la 'phyo ba'i g.yu 'brug nga / /rgas rung ze ba ma nyams 'dug /nags khrod 'grim pa'i rgya stag de/ /rgas rung thig le ma nyams 'dug /rdza lung 'grim pa'i 'brong bo de/ /rgas rung ru thur ma nyams 'dug /rgyal khams 'grim pa'i rnal 'byor nga / /rgas rung dbang bo ma nyams 'dug /bya rgyal khyung chen rgas na yang / /da dung nam 'phang bstod la spro/ /stobs ldan glang chen rgas na yang / /da dung khur chen 'khur la spro/ /rta mchog cang shes rgas na yang / /da dung thang chen gcod la spro/ /rnal 'byor zhabs dkar rgas na yang / /da dung 'gro don byed la spro/ /deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /phan bde 'byung gnas bstan pa dang / /mar gyur sems can thams cad la/ /phan thogs dpag med 'byung bar shog /ces pa 'di ni dad can 'ga' res khong dgung lo mtho rung dbang bo gsal zhing 'gro don byed pa spro ba bka' drin che bar gda' zer dus rang gi yid la shar ba ltar smras pa'o/ /khyung dang seng ge mthun pa'i bu/ /seng ge rkang ba brgyad pa zer/ /dung dang chu srin mthun pa'i bu/ /chu srin ma ga ra zhes zer/ /sram dang nya gnyis mthun pa'i bu/ /nya chen spu skyes zhes 782

su grags/ /gsar rnying gnyis ka mthun pa'i bu/ /rnal 'byor zhabs dkar zhes su grags/ /cha lugs kun dang mi mthun kyang / /chos lugs kun dang mthun pa mtshar/ /phyi rabs rjes 'jug bu slob rnams/ /chos lugs kun dang mthun par mdzod//ces pa 'di yang nyin zhig sems la shar tshe rjes 'jug bu slob rnams kyi sems la phan phyir smras pa'o/ /bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /mi rtag dran par byen gyis rlobs/ /skyes pa'i tha ma 'chi ba yin/ /zhen chags can la 'dug dbang med/ /'dus pa'i tha ma 'bral ba yin/ /brtse gdung can la 'grogs dbang med/ /bsags pa'i tha ma 'dzad pa yin/ /ser sna can la khyer dbang med/ /mthon po'i tha ma ltung ba yin/ /khengs dregs can la sdod dbang med/ /'jig rten phyi mar 'gro nges yin/ /lha chos ma gtogs phan pa med/ /phyi mar bde zhing skyid 'dod na/ /thams cad dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /thos tshad rnams kyis mi rtag pa/ /dran nas chos la spyod par shog /ces pa 'di ni khe rus snying dkar gyi ru skor gyi yon bdag rnams la zhabs dkar bas smras pa'o/ /drin can bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /legs nyes blang dor shes par byin gyis rlobs/ /mi la rtog dpyod med na dud 'gro yin/ /rta la gom 'gros med na bong bu yin/ /rtog 783

dpyod sngon du thongs na mkhas pa yin/ /'gyod pa rjes nas skyes na blun po yin/ /nyin mtshan bsam pa las ni blo 'byung zhing / /zhib mo bsags pa las ni zas nor 'byung / /chos dang grogs la rnying ba bzang ba yin/ /gos dang lham la gsar ba dro ba yin/ /bu mo 'gro sa thag ring gnas yin zhing / /ban de 'gro sa dbus gtsang chos yul yin/ /bye'u chung nyal shes tsher ma'i gseb na bde/ /blo ldan thabs mkhas dgra yi nang na bde/ /dug sbrul gdug can gang gis mthong yang sdang / /zhe sdang can la su zhig 'grogs kyang 'khon/ /rtsal med khyem bya khyem tshang nang na bde/ /khyem pa chos byed rang yul bsdad na bzang //rtsal ldan bya rgod brag dmar them na bde/ /rtogs ldan rnal 'byor ri khrod dben par skyid/ /brlan la ma brten me tog skye ba dkon/ /sems la ma brten sangs rgyas 'byung ba dka'/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan 'dogs byed 'dod na/ /rig gnas gzhung lugs mang bor sbyangs na legs/ /tshe gcig lus gcig sangs rgyas 'thob 'dod na/ /yengs med sems la lta ba man ngag yin/ /de ltar shes nas blang dor byed nus na/ /'di phyi kun tu bde zhing skyid par 'gyur/ /glu 'di thos tshad chos pa 'jig rten pa/ /kun kyi rgyud la phan thogs 'byung bar shog /ces pa 'di ni rgyud pa grwa tshang gi 784

yon bdag rnams la smras pa'o/ /mkhas grub gong ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /lugs gnyis blang dor shes par byen gyis rlobs/ /lhan lhon bsdus pa'i gon pa phyug po tshos/ /mi gon na yang med pos gon na dro//slong mo byas pa'i sprang zas rgyags pa tshos/ /mi za na yang ltogs pas zos na zhim/ /sna tshogs bsdus pa'i bslab bya mkhas pa tshos//mi nyan na yang blun pos nyan na phan/ /zhe sdang gdug rtsub che bas 'khrug pa slong / /'dod chags zhen pa che bas rku 'phrog byed/ /mi shes gti mug che bas chos la sdang / /phrag dog bsam ngan che bas sems mi bde/ /rang mthong nga rgyal che bas gzhan la 'gran/ /dug gsum dug lnga che bas rang gzhan 'phung / /mi gtsang zos na zhim po ga la 'ong / /khyi yis zos na bu ram las kyang zhim//chos min byas na chos pa ga la 'ong / /zog pos byas na dam pa'i chos las lhag /rtug dri btang na rlung khams song lags te/ /dri zhim mi 'byung nyal grogs ngo tsha 'chor/ /g.yo sgyu byas na lto gos yong lags te/ /gzhan yid mi 'ong chos grogs ngo tsha 'chor/ /khyem mtshes 'gran sems can gyis bstod ra las/ /pha mas ngan mtshang brus shing brdungs na dga'/ /sems ngan rgan mos ma ṇi bton pa las/ /sems bzang rgad pos skad 785

cha bshad na dga'/ /glu 'di thos tshad skye bo pho mo yis/ /legs nyes shes nas blang dor byed par shog /ces pa 'di ni mdo ba'i yon bdag rnams la smras pa'o/ /grub mtha'i phyogs ris ma mchis pa'i/ /bla ma gong ma rnams la 'dud/ /gsar rnying grub mtha' thams cad kyi/ /phyogs ris zhi bar byin gyes rlobs/ /dge ldan bstan pa'i gzhi ma la/ /rnying ma bstan pa'i zur rgyan dgos/ /'gal med grogs su shar tsa na/ /thub bstan yun ring gnas par 'gyur/ /gsar rnying grub mtha' ma lus pa/ /rgyal bstan kho na yin pas na/ /kun la dag snang mdzod cig ces/ /paṇa chen snga phyi rnams kyis gsungs/ /phyogs lhung gdon chen khog tu zhugs/ /gcig gis gcig la sdang byas na/ /rgyal bstan nyams par 'gyur ro zhes/ /mkhas grub gong ma mang bos gsungs/ /gsar mas rnying ma ma dar na//rnying mas gsar ma ma dar na/ /snyam pa'i bsam ngan gcig skyes kyang / /gnyis ga'i bsod nams 'dzad par 'gyur//gsar rnying thams cad dar gyur na//snyam pa'i bsam pa gcig skyes kyang / /bsod nams dpag tu med pa thob/ /bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur/ /de phyir nga yi rjes 'jug rnams/ /gsar rnying phyogs ris ma mdzad par/ /kun la dag snang sbyong bzhin du/ /786

bstan 'gro yongs la gang phan mdzod/ /de ltar nges par mdzad nus na/ /bde skyid nyi ma 'char ro zhes/ /rnal 'byor zhabs dkar pa yis smras/ /thos tshad yongs la phan par shog /cesapa 'di ni rang gi slob ma yang slob rnams la smras pa'o/ /sngon gyi legs byas bsod nams mthu dpal las/ /rigs gzugs 'byor ba'i dpal gyis rab brgyan cing / /bstan la rab gus lhag bsam dge ba yis/ /dad can yon bdag rnams la 'di skad zhu/ /deng dus lus la nad med bde zhing skyid/ /dkon mchog mchod dang dkar bo dge brtson ngos/ /gnas zhes thos pas dga' ba'i spu long g.yos/ /'dir yang lus sems dge la 'dun bzhin gnas/ /skabs don mi lus thob cing dam pa'i chos/ /bsgrub la rang dbang yod pa'i dus 'di ru/ /snying nas dkar bo'i lha chos ma byas na/ /phyi nas sgrub dbang med pas bsam blo thongs/ /dkon mchog mchod dang dge 'dun bsnyen bkur dang / /rang la ltos bcas byams pas skyong ba dang / /dman par snying brtse sbyin pa gtong ba sogs/ /ya rabs khyem pa'i tshul yin de la 'bod/ /las dang bya ba gang dang ci byed kyang / /zhib mo'i blo yis bsam gzhig legs btang nas/ /'phral du bde zhing phugs su phan nges pa'i/ /tshul de 787

dag ni brtson pas bsgrubs na legs/ /bag med glu gar chang dang rtsed mo dang / /mi dang dud 'gro gsod dang bcings pa dang / /gzhan nor brku dang byi bo byed pa sogs/ /ngan spyod mi dge'i las rnams spangs na dge /zla dus nya stong brgyad gsum dus chen la/ /rgyal bas khyim pa'i rten la rab bsngags pa'i/ /bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa rab blangs nas/ /bslab bya dang bcas nan tan bsrung bar mdzod/ /dkar bo'i sems kyis dge bskul yi ge lags/ /'di bzhin sgrubs dang tshe rabs kun tu bde/ /yig rten stong min tsam gyi dngos po bcas/ /rang gnas mtshams khang nang nas zla tshes phul/ /zhes pa 'di ni dbus gtsang gi yon bdag 'ga' rer phan phyir smras pa'o/ /bla ma gong ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /gong ma'i rnam thar zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /dad brtson shes rab snying rje ldan pa yi/ /slob ma rnams la snying gtam bshad kyis nyon/ /phan bde legs tshogs yon tan ma lus pa'i/ /'byung gnas bla ma yin pas gsol ba thobs/ /chos kyi bar chad pha ma nor rdzas yin/ /pha yul pha ma nor rdzas blo yis thongs/ /chos kyi rtsa ba byams dang snying rje dang / /rin chen sems mchog thugs dam mthil du zungs/ /dbu rdzogs phyag chen lta ba gang yin yang / /788

don la gcig pas gang mos nyams su longs/ /chos kun sgyu ma lta bur shes bzhin du/ /rgyal sras spyod pa rnams la 'jug par gyes/ /de ltar lta spyod gnyis po zung 'brel na/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /snying gtam ma brjed kun gyis yid la zungs/ /ngas kyang khyed rnams mi brjed sems la 'dzin/ /tshe mjug 'di la da dung mjal ba dang / /phyi mar dag pa'i zhing nas mjal bar shog /ces pa 'di ni rnal 'byor zhabs dkar bas bla ma 'jigs med rang grol sogs khams dang mgo log phyogs kyi dad can slob ma rnams la smras pa'o/ /kun bzang rdo rje 'chang dang thub dbang sogs/ /dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis gang zag dbang bo rab/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas go 'phang thob pa'i phyir/ /gsang sngags rim gnyis mthar thug 'od gsal don/ /rtsal du bton te 'od gsal rdzogs chen bstan//'dir ni chos kun blo yis btags pa tsam/ /ma gtogs rang bzhin grub pa rdul tsam yang / /med bzhin snang ba yin phyir blos byas kyi/ /mtshang kun rig nas yul med zang thal gyi/ /ngang du bzhag nas 'od gsal mngon sum du/ /rtogs byed blo 'das rdzogs chen lta ba ste/ /shin tu zab pa'i gnas 'di rtogs pa la/ /bla ma 789

gang yin zhig gis mi chog gis/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa'i mthar thug rnyed pa yi/ /bla ma rtogs ldan zhig la brten pa gces/ /de phyir 'di ni theg pa thams cad kyi/ /yang rtse sngags kyi lta ba'i mthar thug yin/ /myur du sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob 'dod pas/ /nyams su longs dang tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /gal te tshe 'dir nyams su ma lon kyang / /theg pa'i yang rtse rdzogs pa chen po 'di/ /lta ba mthon po yin rgyu red snyam du/ /dag snang sbyongs dang bsod nams chen po yong / /zhes sems la shar tshe skal bzang slob ma dbang bo yang rab rnams la phan phyir smras pa'o/ /chung nas dge ba'i bshes bsten thos bsam byas/ /cher song ri khrod dben par sgom sgrub byas/ /tshe mjug bstan 'gro yongs la gang phan byas/ /mi rgan nga yi bya ba tshar nas gda'/ /da ni tshe lhag ci tsam yod kyi bar/ /thugs rje chen po sems nyid ngal gso bzhin/ /dben pa'i gnas su sgo gsum rang bab bzhag /sems nyid 'od gsal dbyengs su ngal gso bya/ /sngon byon rgyal ba gong ma'i rnam thar dang / /pha nga'i rnam thar skyong 'dod bu chen rnams/ /chos brgyad tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis thongs/ /dben pa'i gnas su tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms/ /de ltar mdzad na bla ma'i zhabs tog dang / /pha ma'i drin gzo sems 790

can 'gro don rnams/ /'grub ces dam pa gong mas yang yang gsungs/ /gsung bzhin lha chos yong ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /zhes pa 'di ni sngon sbyangs las kyi 'phro can dgu rong sprul sku sogs dad can rjes 'jug slob ma bu chen rnams la 'brong lung nas smras pa'o/ /na mo gu ru/ dgongs pa zab mo nam mkha' dang / /mnyam pa'i bla mar phyag byas nas/ /sems nyid mkha' las rab yangs pa'i/ /rnal 'byor glu dbyangs len la nyon/ /lta ba har sangs rgya yan yin/ /sgom pa dmigs gtad 'dzin med yin/ /spyod pa gu yangs blo bde yin/ /'bras bu 'khor 'das sems rdzogs yin/ /thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam yin/ /snang ba'in stong la stong bzhin snang / /snang stong zung 'jug yangs pa yin/ /'bras bu 'khor 'das sems rdzogs yin/ /thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam yin/ /rnal ni chos nyid rnal ma'i don/ /'byor ni de la 'byor ba yin/ /de phyir don gyi rnal 'byor lags/ /yongs grags bla ma zhabs dkar zer/ /bla ni gong na med pa ste/ /ma ni nyam thag 'gro ba'i ma/ /zhabs ni bla ma'i zhabs pad bsten/ /dkar ni chos la dkar ba yin/ /gsang ming tshogs drug rang grol zer/ /tshogs drug yul gyi snang ba dang / /der 'dzin rtogs pa stong nyid kyi/ /dbyings su rang sar grol ba yin/ /rang gi rang la 791

ming zhig btags/ /ming la gu yangs blo bde zer/ /gnas lugs rtogs pas gu re yangs/ /lha chos byas pas blo re bde/ /ming la brten nas chos kyi don/ /go phyir ming don glu ru blangs/ /thos tshad yongs la phan par shog /ces pa 'di ni dad can bu slob 'ga' res khyed kyi mtshan rnams kyi don dang mthun pa'i zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor smras pa'o/ /dad gtong blo gros gsum mnga' ba'i/ /skal ldan slob bu rnams kyis mchog /mtshan snyan gnyan thog tshul khrims zhes/ /yongs la grags pa'i sku drung du/ /rgyal khams rnam dkar dge phyogs la/ /bskul ba'i rnal 'byor zhabs dkar bas/ /rab tu brtse zhing dung ba'i sgos/ /gtam snyan yi ger bkod nas 'bul/ /khyed kyi lus sems rab bde zhing / /chos ldan bya ba sgrub bzhin du/ /gnas pa'i gtam snyan thos pa'i mod/ /dngos su mjal 'dra'i dga' spro shar/ /phran kyang bla ma dkon mchog gi /thugs rjes sgyu ma'i lus po bde/ /'od gsal nyi ma snying dbus su/ /shar bas sems kyang bde bar mchis/ /dam pa gong ma'i gsung bzhin du/ /bdag gis legs par bshad pa yi/ /lam rim blo sbyong rnams la ltos/ /rang rgyud gyong bo ci thul gyis/ /'di nas khyod kyi bsam don kun/ /chos bzhin 'grub 792

pa'i skyabs 'jug bya/ /da dung tshe mjug 'di nyid la/ /yang yang mjal ba'i sgon lam 'debs/ /mi lo stong phrag thub pa yi/ /byang phyogs sgra mi snyan gyi lugs/ /'chi ba med pa'i ring gzungs sgos//bsgrubs pa'i tshe ril bcas te phul/ /zhes pa 'di ni dad ldan slob ma gnyan thog tshul khrims la phul ba'o//ngo mtshar snang ra'i gser khang nyams dga' na/ /bstan dang 'gro la gang phan mdzad bzhin du/ /bzhugs pa'i mkhas grub nyis 'dzom dge ba'i bshes/ /'brel tshad don ldan mchog gi zhabs drung du/ /phyogs med rgyal khams bskor ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /nges med ri khrod 'grims pa'i bya bral ba/ /chos med glu dbyangs len pa'i zhabs dkar bas/ /zol med sgo gsum gus pas 'di skad zhu/ /mgon khyod gzugs sku rab tu bde ngos nas/ /bstod bsngags tshigs bcad glegs bu lha rdzas bcas/ /stsal ba ma nyams lag tu 'byor ba'i mod/ /sems la dngos su mjal 'dra'i dga' spro shar/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi sgyu lus rgas na yang / /sems la nam yang rgas rgyu ma byung bar/ /rab tu gsal ba'i ngang nas da dung yang / /bstan dang 'gro don gang nus byed bzhin mchis/ /rgyun du bla mar dad pa skyes gyur na/ /byin rlabs sems la 'jug pa'i snga ltas yin/ /bdag 793

gi rgyud kyi nyams rtogs yon tan rnams/ /khyed kyi rgyud la skye ba'i skyabs 'jug bya/ /khyed kyang rmi lam tsam gyi tshe mjug 'dir/ /tshe 'di blos thongs sems nyid 'od gsal gyi/ /ngang la zhog dang bcos min snying rje sogs/ /nyams rtogs shar nas 'gro la phan par 'gyur/ /yi ge'i rten du sku tshe ring ba'i phyir/ /lo stong thub pa'i sgra mi snyan gyi lugs/ /'chi med ring gzungs sgo nas bsgrubs pa yi/ /tshe ril dang bcas zla tshes bzang bor phul/ /zhes pa 'di ni snang ra'i gser khang na bzhugs pa'i ri rtsa'i a lags mtshams pa la 'brong lung nas phul ba'o/ /'jam mgon bla ma mdo sngags gnad bsdus pa/ /nges 'byung byang sems yang dag lta ba dang / /rim gnyis lam bzang yin zhes yongs la grags/ /'di la nan tan mdzod dang ri khrod pa/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo yab sras sogs/ /bka' gdams gong ma rnams kyi thugs dam mthil/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems gnyis yin/ /'di la nan tan mdzod dang ri khrod pa/ /sa ra ha dang gling chen ras pa sogs/ /rgya bod grub thob mang bo'i thugs dam mthil/ /rdzogs rim mthar thug phyag chen do ha yin/ /'di la nan tan mdzod dang ri khrod pa/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /mkha' 'gro'i gsang 794

mdzod sogs nas blangs pa yi/ /rdzogs chen grub thob gong ma'i gsang chos yin/ /'di la nan tan mdzod dang ri khrod pa/ /ma cig lab sgon gcod kyi gdams pa 'di/ /mdo sngags chos rnams kun gyi nying khu yin/ /bdag 'dzin nyon mongs gcod la shin tu bsngags/ /'di la nan tan mdzod dang ri khrod pa/ /nyams len mdzad na ha cang mang mi dgos/ /'di dag re re tsam gyis chog par gda'/ /rang nyid gang mos bstan 'gror gang phan gyi/ /chos la nan tan mdzod dang ri khrod pa/ /bstan dang 'gro ba yongs la phan pa'i thabs/ /chos lugs gang la'ang phyogs ris mi mdzad par/ /kun la dag snang sbyong bzhin ston pa mchog /'di la nan tan mdzod dang ri khrod pa/ /zhes pa 'di ni dge slong 'jigs med sogs slob bu ri khrod pa yongs la phan phyir 'brong lung nas smras pa'o/ /yang zho 'ong la steng 'og gi yon bdag rnams la ma ṇi'i lung byas pas/ rgan rgon dad can 'ga' res ma ṇi bton pa'i phan yon zhig gsung dgos zer ba 'o de yin na ma ṇi bka' 'bum las/ khyab gdal chen po'i gnas mchog tu/ /drug pa thugs rje chen po yis/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ brjod pas/ /rtag chad ma spangs gnas su dag /lha ltung ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar byas//des na ngo 795

mtshar che zhes bya/ /kun gyis ma ṇi pad+me sgongs/ /ma ṇis sgrib pa sbyong ba ni/ /sum cu rtsa gsum lha yul na/ /lha bu dri ma med pa yis/ /mtshams med lnga yi las byas pas/ /rdo rje dmyal bar skyes pa la/ /brgya byen lha yi thub pa yis/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ brjod pas/ /rdo rje dmyal nas thon nas ni/ /rdo rje lta bu'i dgongs pa shar/ /des na sgrib pa sbyong zhes bya/ /kun gyis ma ṇi pad+me sgrongs/ /ri rab chen po'i khong gseng na/ /lha min snang byed ces bya bas/ /srog gcod byas pa'i rnam smin gyis/ /tsha ba'i dmyal bar skyes pa la/ /bcom ldan thags bzang thub pa des/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ brjod pas/ /tsha ba'i dmyal ba'i gnas nas thar/ /dpa' bar 'gro ba'i rtogs pa shar/ /des na ngo mtshar che zhes bya/ /kun gyis ma ṇi pad+me sgrongs/ /mabārnya yi grong khyer du/ /stobs ldan bu ni ma skyes dgras/ /pha bsad pa yi rnam smin gyis/ /grang ba'i dmyal bar skyes pa la/ /bcom ldan shākya thub pa yis/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ brjod pas/ /grang ba'i dmyal ba'i gnas nas thar/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i dgongs pa shar/ /des na ngo mtshar che zhes bya/ /kun gyis ma ṇi pad+me sgongs/ /gang bzang bu ni lnga brtsegs kyis/ /sangs rgyas gser thub bstan pa la/ / dam pa'i chos la skur ba btab/ /de yi rnam smin dud 'gror skyes/ /sgrib sel 796

shākya seng ge yis/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ brjod pas/ /glen khrugs byol song gnas nas thar/ /gsal la mi rtog dgongs pa shar/ /des na ngo mtshar che zhes bya/ /kun gyis ma ṇi pad+me sgongs/ /rgyal bu mjes ldan bya ba yis//khyem bdag mgon med zas sbyin la/ /ser sna 'jur gegs cher byas pas/ /de yis rnam smin yi dwags skyes/ /'phags pa nam mkha' mdzod chen gyis/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me t+t+waṃ brjod pas/ /yi dwags bkres skoms gnas nas thar/ /longs spyod 'gags med dgongs pa shar/ /des na ngo mtshar che zhes bya/ /kun gyis ma ṇi pad+me sgrongs/ /gyad yul mi'u thung sor phreng gis/ /mi stong dgu brgya go dgu bsad/ /dmyal khams bco brgyad gnas su lhung / /thub pa'i dbang bo stobs can gyis/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ brjod pas/ /tsha grang sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ /seng ge'i stobs kyi dgongs pa shar/ /de ltar sgrib pa sbyong zhes bya/ /kun gyes ma ṇi pad+me sgongs/ /zhes brjod pas kun dad cing ma ṇi 'don pa la brtson par gyur to/ /sa gang du song rung bla ma dran/ /rang chung 'dris rtse grogs dran nas byung / /yul gang du bsdad rung bla ma dran/ /grogs rdo rje spun rnams dran nas byung / /grong gang du phyin rung ri khrod dran/ /grogs bya dang ri dwags dran nas byung / /khyim gang du 797

bsdad rung brag phug dran/ /shing ljon pa'i bsil grib dran nas byung / /zas ci zhig zos rung sngo tshod dran/ /nags dga' ldan shing tog dran nas byung / /gos ci zhig gon rung phying dkar dran/ /mdog sngo ljang rtswa gdan dran nas byung / /dus rgyun du bka' brgyud rnam thar dran/ /gnas dben par bzhugs tshul dran nas byung / /de dran pas dben par sdod snying 'dod/ /nyams rtogs pa med rung blo re bde/ /pha rgas rung ri khrod je mthor gtong / /bu slob ma rnams kyang de ba zhin mdzod/ /cesapa 'di yang nyin zhig sems la shar ba ltar blangs pa'o/ /gzhan yang skal bzang slob ma mang bos khong tsho la yang /skal ba bzang bzang byas zhal gdams re gnang dgos zer ba la rim pa bzhin du 'di rnams byin/ dus gsum rgyal ba bskyed mdzad pa'i/ /chos sku yum chen mo la 'dud/ /stong ba nyid la dpyad sgom dang / /'jog sgom nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyal yum shes rab snying bo las/ /phung bo lnga bo rang bzhin gyis/ /stong ba rnam par blta'o gsungs/ /de bzhin dpyad nas bsgom pa gces/ /de yi rjes su stong nyid la/ /gzugs med tshor ba 'du shes med/ /'du byed rnam shes med gsungs bzhin/ /med pa'i ngang la mnyam par zhog /chos kun 798

stong ba yin nyan na/ /de ltar bsgom ni cis mi nyan/ /bsgom ni nyan na stong nyid kyi/ /ngang la 'jog pa de bas nyan//dge lugs pa yis stong nyid la/ /dpyad sgom gtso bor byed pa yin/ /phyag rdzogs pa yis stong nyid la/ /'jog sgom gtso bor byed pa yin/ /su zhig yin yang dpyad sgom dang / /'jog sgom gnyis ka dgos pa yin/ /ngas ni de ltar byas pa yin/ /khyed kyang de ltar byas na legs/ /glu 'di thos tshad thams cad kyis//dpyad sgom steng du 'jog sgom byas/ /myur du chos sku yum chen mo'i/ /dgongs pa mngon du 'gyur bar shog /ces pa 'di ni dge slong dpal ri ba la gdams pa'o/ /ma gyur 'gro kun snying rje nas/ /ma sha nam yang mi gsol ba'i/ /ma 'dra'i thugs rje chen po yis/ /ma lus 'gro kun bu bzhin skyongs/ /chos kyi rtsa ba byang chub sems/ /de yi rtsa ba snying rje yin/ /snying rje rgyud la sgye ba'i gegs/ /sdig zas sha khrag yin pas spongs/ /sha zan phyi mar dmyal bar skye/ /sha zan sha za srin por skye/ /sha zan phra men bshan par skye/ /sha zan khra dang spyang kir skye/ /sha khrag zos na 'dod chags skye/ /sha khrag zos na bying rmugs 'phel/ /sha khrag zos na lus po lci/ /sha khrag zos na ma zhus na/ /sha khrag yod sar lha 'dre 'khor/ /sha khrag yod sar god kha sdang / /sha khrag yod sar khrag 'brum 'ong / /sha khrag yod 799

sar sdig can mod/ /sha la dga' na nor rdzas 'dzad/ /sha la dga' na sdig pa 'ong / /sha la dga' na bstan la gnod//sha la dga' na kun gyis smod/ /sha yi nyes dmigs legs bsams nas/ /sha la sred pa ma che zhig /tshe rabs kun tu pha ma yi sha khrag za bar ma gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang sems la shar ba ltar slob bu 'phrin las dar rgyas la gdams pa'o//rgyud la snying rje rin po che/ /skyes pa'i sku la gus phyag 'tshal/ /chos kyi rtsa ba snying rje yin/ /med na chos kyi rtsa ba rul/ /snying rje yod na sangs rgyas sras/ /med na sems can ngan shos yin/ /nang ba'i khyad chos snying rje yin/ /men na phyi rol pa las thu/ /snying rje yod na 'gro don 'grub/ /med na rang don tsam yang dka'/ /snying rje yod na sha mi za/ /med na sha rkyang za snying 'dod/ /snying rje yod na sdig mi byed/ /med na srog gcod las la dga'/ /snying rje yod na ma dang 'dra/ /med na ma yang ngan ma 'dra/ /snying rje can la kun gyis smon/ /med na lha mi kun gyis 'phya/ /chos pa'i bzang ngan khyad par yang / /snying rje yod med 'di la thug /de phyir chos pa'i khyad chos mchog /snying rje yin pas bsgom par mdzod/ /tshe rabs kun tu snying rje dang / /nam yang 'bral ba med pa shog /ces pa 'di yang garma lhun grub la gdams pa'o/ /800

chu 'go gangs la thug pa bzhin/ /chos 'go ston pa sangs rgyas thug /ston pas gsungs pa'i dam chos rnams/ /bsdu na mdo sngags gnyis su 'dus/ /mi kun zhing las 'tsho skyong la/ /'bad na phyug por 'gro ba bzhin/ /kun kyis rgyu yi phar phyin la//bslabs na sangs rgyas 'thob par 'gyur/ /khe ba 'ga' res gser dngul sogs/ /tshong byas phyug por 'gro ba bzhin/ /'ga' res 'bras bu gsang sngags chos/ /nyams su blangs na sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /ded dpon kha cig nor bu la//brten nas phyug por 'gro ba bzhin/ /dbang rab mdo sngags mthar thug don/ /phyag rdzogs bsgoms nas sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /de rnams gang la brten nas kyang / /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob dus 'dir/ /bla ma mkhas pa la brten nas/ /gang mos nyams su len par mdzod/ /ces pa 'di ni hor nag dge slong ngag dbang bstan 'dzin bzang bo la gdams pa'o/ /de ltar gdams pas thams cad dga' zhing spro bar gyur to/ /yang slob bu dad can dkar dris dge slong gis sems la phan pa'i zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul ngor 'di skad smras/ mgon thub dbang sman bla 'od dpag med/ /lha spyan ras gzigs dbang sgol ma yis/ /mi bdag dang rjes 'jug bu slob 801

la/ /thugs brtse bas gzigs la byin gyis rlobs/ /ngas phan pa'i snying gtam zab mo zhig /bu'i sems la phan phyir glu ru len/ /chos kha ton bzlas brjod byed mkhan gyi/ /khyod dkar dris dge slong dga' bas nyon/ /sdig mi dge byas pa'i nyes dmigs dang / /chos dge ba byas pa'i phan yon gnyis/ /dus yang yang soms dang sdig spangs nas/ /chos dge ba bsgrub 'dod skye bar 'gyur/ /khyod kha ton gang byed phan yon kun/ /ngas bskal par brjod kyang ga la rdzogs/ /gzhan ma ṇi bton pa'i phan yon yang / /tshe gang bor bshad kyang rdzogs mi 'gyur/ /don de phyir kha ton phan yon rnams/ /skabs skabs su soms la dga' ba sgoms/ /de bsgoms na dge ba gang byas rnams/ /dus nyin re bzhin du gong 'phel 'gyur/ /chos rdor gcod bton na mnar bar 'gyur/ /des sngar byas sdig pa dag gsungs bzhin/ /khyod na bas sdig sgrib 'dag pas na/ /de mi dga' ma byed dga' ba sgoms/ /shi song rung tshe 'dir sdig ma byas/ /chos kha ton mang bo byas pa'i mthus/ /tshe phyi mar ngan 'gror skye mi 'gyur/ /yar mtho ris thar ba'i gnas su skye/ /dus nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus skabs su/ /rje bla ma lha la gsol ba thobs yar bde ba can du skye bar smon/ /mi ngas kyang smon lam de ltar 802

'debs/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba dang / /gzhan dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /dus gnas skabs kun tu bde ba dang / /mthar bde ba can du skye bar shog /ces smras pas kho rang gis kha ton la brtson pa cher song ngo / /rang gi zhabs phyi dang gzhan gye grwa btsun mang bo dbus su 'gro ba la phan pa'i phyir lam yig tshigs bcad ma 'di yi ger bris nas byin/rje bla ma dkon mchog thugs rje can/ /dbus 'gro mkhan yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /lho'i lam kha'i yon bdag thams cad la/ /thugs brtse bas gzigs la byin gyis rlobs/ /sa kha thag ring bos bar chod nas/ /nged thams cad dngos su mjal dka' yang / /ngas phan pa'i glu 'di mjal ba dang //khyad med pas dga' ba'i sems kyis nyon/ /shig ltogs skom nad kyis gzir ba yi/ /dman sprang bo ar skyo snying rje nas/ /sman zas gos gang mkho byin gyur na/ /de'i lhag gi chos shig gzhan na med/ /tshe 'dir yang tshe bsod snyan grags rgyas/ /tshe phyi mar bde ba can du skye/ /chos byed na 'di phyi'i bde thabs su/ /dman sprang bor byams pa gcig pus chog /gzhan snying rje med pa'i khrel med kyis//dman sprang bo ar skyo bcom gyur na/ /sdig 803

de bas che zhig gzhan na med/ /tshe 'dir sdug phyi mar dmyal bar skye/ /don de phyir zas gos mi ster kyang / /gzhan byen tshad lag nas ma 'phrogs par/ /lam yag po ston la bde bar thongs/ /de byas na bya ba lam du 'gro/ /glu 'di nyid mthong thos dran reg gi /rgyud gdug rtsub bsam sbyor kun zhi nas/ /byams snying rje byang chub sems kyi sgos/ /dman sprang bor zas gos ster bar shog /lus yi ge 'di nyid bcings pa yi/ /lus sems la sdug bsngal mi 'byung bar/ /stod dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du mjal/ /phyir slebs nas kun kyang dga' bar shog /'di gang du khyer ba'i sa phyogs kyi/ /nad dbul phongs 'thab rtsod zhi ba dang / /char babs shing lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /chos bkra shis dge legs 'phel gyur cig /ces pa 'di khyer nas gzhan la bstan pas khong rnams gar song gi yul la bkra shis shing gang bsam kyi don 'grub pa byung ngo / /bla ma spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud la snying rje skye bar byin gyes rlobs/ /chos kyi rtsa ba snying rje 'di yin pas/ /snying rje chen po dgos tshul glu ru len/ /rgyud la snying rje chen po yod pa yi/ /mi de theg pa chen po'i rigs can yin/ /de 'dra'i chos pa gang du gnas na yang / /de la lha mi kun gyis phyag byar 'os/ /dper na rgyu bzang 'khar rnga chen po de/ /yang yang 804

brdungs nas sa la bzhag tsa na/ /rnga sgra de yang je phra je phrar song / /phyi ru mi mngon nang du gnas pa ltar/ /sems bzang byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje de/ /yang yang bsgoms nas mnyam par bzhag tsa na/ /snying rje de yang je phra je phrar song //phyi ru mi mngon nang du gnas par 'gyur/ /dper na rnga la dbyu gus ma bsnun par/ /nang na rnga sgra yod pa sus mi shes/ /dbyu gus bsnun tshe phyi ru lhang lhang du/ /grags tshe gzhan gyis go nas nyan pa ltar/ /snying rje can la gzhan gyis ma bskul par/ /rgyud na snying rje yod pa sus mi shes/ /nyam thag rnams kyis bskul tshe snying rje bo/ /skyes pa gzhan gyis shes nas dad par 'gyur/ /mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bur gnas pa'i dus/ /nyam thag 'gro ba su zhig mthong na yang / /bcos min snying rje chen po skyes tsa na/ /stong ba nyid la snying rje yod pa'i rtags/ /de nyid yod na sangs rgyas chos gzhan yang / /yod pas chos pa de nyid ngo mtshar che/ /de nyid gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs su/ /chos dang bkra shis dge legs 'phel bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di ni sngags rgan mgon po skyabs dang pad+ma rig 'dzin pha bu sogs rma pha ri'i phyogs kyi dad can rnams la zhabs dkar bas smras pa'o/ /chung gzhon nu'i dus nas chos sgor zhugs/ /yar cher song 805

bla ma'i lung bstan bzhin/ /khams mdo smad yul nas phyogs 'dir byon/ /khyod chos mdzad dam pa bdag la dgongs/ /nga 'dra ba'i phyi ldir nang stong ba'i/ /nga 'dra ba'i bla rgan mang na yang / /gser 'dra ba'i shin tu sems bzang ba'i/ /khyed 'dra ba'i chos pa dkon par gda'/ /rang na so yar la rgas stabs kyis/ /khyed lta bu'i chos pa bzang bo re/ /mthong thos tshe phrad na 'dod pa byung / /'dir phebs dang chos mthun gleng mo bya/ /rje skyabs mgon gser khang rin po che'i/ /bka' bzhin du bsgrub dgos byung ba 'am/ /sa thag ring jag rkun 'jigs drag nas/ /phebs ma thub na yang thugs ma skyo/ /nga 'phrad dang khyad med snying gtam 'bul/ /tshe 'di yi bya ba blo yis thongs/ /chos dbu rdzogs phyag gsum la sogs pa/ /gzhan ma smod kun la dag snang sbyongs/ /chos nyams su len na mang mi dgos/ /las mi dge 'dzems la dge tshogs sgrubs/ /dus rgyun du bsam pa bzang bo'i sgos/ /bstan 'gro ba'i bde thabs kho na mdzod/ /nga sa phyogs gang du song na yang / /khyed thugs kyi bzhed don kun 'grub phyir/ /yar bla ma lha la skyabs 'jug dang / /bsngo smon lam mtshams sbyor yang dag bya/ /rten lha rdzas dang bcas yi ge 'di/ /rje bla ma'i gdan sa khyung dgon nas/ /phyogs kun tu 806

'khyams pa'i zhabs dkar bas/ /yar zla tshes bzang bor gus pas phul/ /zhes pa 'di ni mkhas pa'i dbang bo khams rdo smad bla ma'i gsung shog gi 'byor lan du phul/yang ma phug na bzhugs pa'i g.yer gshong mkhan pos khong phyi mar gang du skye zhes brtag pa zhus pa'i lan du tshigs su bcad nas zhus pa/mkhas btsun bzang gsum yon tan dang / /ldan pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen la/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi sems nyid la/ /gang shar yi ger bkod nas 'bul/ /mgon khyod sdom pa dam tshig gtsang / /byang chub sems kyis kun bslangs nas/ /phyag mchod skor ba la sogs pa'i/ /tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong mang bo gnang / /khyad par nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i/ /sgom bzlas mang bo mdzad pa'i mthus/ /nam zhig nā ro mkha' spyod mas/ /mkha' spyod zhing du 'khrid par nges/ /slar yang thugs bskyed smon lam mthus/ /gdul bya gar yod sa phyogs su/ /gang la gang 'dul sprul ba'i sku/ /byon nas 'gro don byed par 'gyur/ /de skad zhu ba'i yig rten du/ /myong grol rten 'dus ril bu bcas/ /khyung dgon dben pa'i dga' tshal nas/ /phul mthus dge legs 'phel gyur cig /ces sems la gang shar bris nas phul bas rjes su khong gshegs khar 807

mnar gcod med par dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig gi ngang nas mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /yang khyung dgon na sdod dus dad gtong blo gros mchog mnga' yul skyong chos mdzad kyis zhal gdams mgur ma zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor/ 'dod yon gyi nyes dmigs bsams nas 'dod chung chog shes byas na bde tshul gyi mgur dbyangs 'di byen no//'dod yon sgyu ma lta bur gzigs/ /gang la 'dod pa mi mnga' ba'i/ /sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la 'dud/ /'dod pa zad par byen gyis rlobs/ /gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim zhing / /ro mngar reg bya 'jam pa yis/ /phye leb ri dwags sbrang ma dang / /nya mo glang chen lnga bo 'phung //'dod yon lnga bo de dag gi /re re bsten na'ang 'phung gyur na//lnga ka rtag tu bsten pa'i mi/ /phung bar 'gyur ba smos ci dgos/ /khyad par sdig zas sha dang gcig /nyes pa'i rtsa ba chang dang gnyis/ /nyon mongs gzhi ma bud med gsum/ /chos pa 'phung ba'i btsan dug yin/ /'dod pa'i dbang du song ba la/ /nam yang bde ba'i go skabs med/ /'dod pa me mtshon dug 'dra zhes/ /sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis smad/ /'dod pa che na thun mong gi /dngos grub thob pa'i gegs byed na/ /mchog gi dngos grub thob pa yi /808

gegs su 'gro ba smos ci dgos/ /sdug bsngal med par bde 'dod na/ /'dod pa thams cad yongs su spongs/ /'dod pa thams cad yongs spangs na/ /mchog tu bde ba thob par 'gyur/ /'dod pa zad na 'phags pa dngos/ /'dod pa chung na 'phags pa'i rigs/ /sangs rgyas zer ba'i sgra bo che/ /'dod pa chung na thun mong gi /dngos grub thob cing 'dod pa'i rigs/ /zad na mchog gi dngos grub kyang / /thob ces dam pa gong mas gsungs//de phyir blo ldan chos mdzad khyod/ /spyir ni 'dod yon lnga bo dang / /khyad par sha chang bud med gsum/ /spong ba'i thabs la 'bad par mdzod/ /'dod yon bsten pa'i nyes dmigs dang / /spang ba'i phan yon cung zad tsam/ /bshad pa 'di nyid thos tshad kyi/ /rgyud la phan thogs 'byung bar shog /ces pa dang /yang bslab gsum rgyud kyis mdzes pa'i dbu mdzad bstan rgyas kyis zhal gdams shig dgos zhes zer ba la chos byed tshul gyi glu dbyangs 'di byen/rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /spyir 'dod yon lnga bor chags na phung / /dgos sha chang bud med bsten na brlag /khyod 'dod yon 809

dkor la ma chags par/ /da mi nor zas gsum blo yis thongs /rje gong ma'i gdan sa ri khrod sten/ /las mi dge bcu bo dug bzhin spongs/ /rang khas blangs sdom gsum mig bzhin srungs/ /byams snying rje byang chub sems mchog sbyongs/ /chos thams cad snang stong sgyu mar sgoms/ /de kun kyang sems su shes par gyis/ /sems bde gsal mi rtag stong ba nyid/ /dpe nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la zhog /sha'i ched du ra lug gsod pa sogs/ /sdug myong ba'i ma gyur 'gro ba la/ /mig mchi ma 'khrug pa'i snying rje sgoms/ /phan thogs pa'i smon lam rgya chen thobs/ /rang 'chi dus chags zhen 'khri ba chod/ /rje bla ma lha la gsol ba thobs /sems gsal stong 'dzin med ngang la zhog /khyod 'chi ba chos skur grol bar 'gyur//chos byed tshul glu ru blangs pa 'di/ /gang thos tshad sems la phan thogs shog /ces byen pas gnyis ga'i rgyud la phan thogs chen po byung ngo //yang de'i sos ka mgon po rdo rje rta lo spun sogs rma pha ri'i yon bdag mang bos rta nor gos phrug sogs 'bul ba chen po khyer nas mjal du byung ba la/ bka' bsgo byin rlabs bsngo smon bkra shis brjod/ chos bshad ma ṇi'i lung byas pa'i rjes su yang mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /810

las rgyu 'bras mkhyen pa'i bla ma la/ /bdag gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /las rgyu 'bras shes pa'i glu zhig len/ /stod mnga' ris yul na gser dngul mang / /sngon rten bzhengs byas pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /da rten bzhengs gyes shig yon bdag rnams/ /bar dbus gtsang yul na rgyan cha mang / /sngon dkon mchog mchod pa'i bsod nams yin/ /da dkon mchog mchod cig yon bdag rnams/ /smad mdo khams yul na rta nor mang / /sngon bla mar phul ba'i phan yon yin//da rta nor phul zhig yon bdag rnams/ /rong 'brog pa'i yul na dbul bo mang / /sngon jag brkus byas pa'i rnam smin yin/ /da jag brkus ma byed yon bdag rnams/ /phyogs 'di na na tsha god kha mang / /sngon ri dwags bsad pa'i rnam smin yin/ /da ri dwags ma gsod yon bdag rnams/ /kun tshe ring nad med smon lam 'debs/ /zhal yang nas yang du mjal bar smon/ /bkra shis pas phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /ces blangs pas kun dad cing gus pa'i sgo nas phyag mang bo phul nas/ dga' zhing spro bzhin du rang rang gi yul du song ngo / /de bzhin du rma tshur ri'i yon bdag mang bo 'ongs pa la yang chos bshad mgur dbyangs 'di blangs so//las rgyu 'bras ston pa'i bla ma la/ /bdag gsol ba 'debs 811

so yon bdag rnams/ /blo chos la phyogs par byen gyis rlobs//steng lha yi yul na bde skyid che/ /sngon dge ba byas pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /da dge ba sgrubs shig yon bdag rnams/ /'og dmyal ba'i yul na sdug bsngal che/ /sngon sdig pa byas pa'i rnam smin yin/ /da sdig pa spongs shig yon bdag rnams/ /bar yi dwags yul na bkres skom che/ /sngon ser sna byas pa'i rnam smin yin/ /da ser sna ma byed yon bdag rnams/ /shar lus 'phags po na gzugs byad mjes/ /sngon bzod pa bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /da bzod pa sgoms shig yon bdag rnams/ /lho 'dzam bu'i gling na dam chos dar/ /sngon lha chos nyan pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /da chos nyan gyis shig yon bdag rnams/ /nub ba glang spyod na longs spyod che/ /sngon sbyin pa btang ba'i 'bras bu yin/ /da sbyin pa thongs shig yon bdag rnams/ /byang sgra mi snyan na mi tshe ring / /sngon tshe thar btang ba'i 'bras bu yin/ /da tshe thar thongs shig yon bdag rnams/ /kun tshe ring nad med smon lam 'debs//zhal yang dang yang du mjal bar smon/ /bkra shis pas sa gsum khyab gyur cig /ces blangs pas kun gyis yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs bzhin rang rang gi gnas su bde bar bzhud do//812

rnam dkar ma/thu las dal ba'i rten thob cing / /phan bde'i 'byung gnas brnya/na pa'i sgo ru zhugs/ /legs tshogs rtsa ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen la/ /dad pa'i slob ma rnams la 'di skad zhu/ /deng gi dus su lus la nad med cing / /phyi nang mi mthun nyer 'tshe dang bral nges/ /bde bar gnas zhes thos pas sems dga' zhing / /'dir yang mchog gsum thugs rje'i bde bar 'tsho/ /ched 'bras 'u cag dal 'byor thob dus 'dir/ /dam pa'i lha chos dag la ma 'bad na/ /thob kyang don med tshong ba stong log bzhin/ /de bas gcig tu dge la 'bad na legs//tshe 'di mi rtag snum zad mar me dang / /lang tsho mi rtag bar snang glog 'dra bas/ /rtag 'dzin phyi bshol le lo ma mdzad par/ /myur du dkar bo'i lha chos byas na legs/ /sdig grogs ngan pa'i mi yis bslu srid pas/ /grogs ngan spangs te bzang bo'i grogs la brten/ /chang dang bud med glu gar sho rgyan sogs/ /don med ngan pa'i las rnams spang na bzang / /tshe 'dir ji ltar byas kyang 'tsho 'gyur gyi/ /phyi mar bde nas bde bar 'gro dka' bas/ /snying rus bskyed de chos la ma 'bad na/ /ngan 'gro'i g.yang la ltung bar gdon mi za/ /mdor na bya byed chos dang mthun pa dang / /dam pa gong ma'i rjes su slob pa dang / /dam 813

tshig sdom pa mig bzhin bsrung ba dang / /kha ton bzlas brjod dag la 'bad par mdzod/ /de ltar dge bskul yi ge'i nang bzhin du/ /bsgrubs na bde skyid nyi ma bzhin du 'char/ /yi ge gzigs rten dngos po phran tsam bcas/ /zla tshes bzang bor phul ba dge legs 'phel/ /zhes dbus gtsang gi slob ma rnams la phan phyir smras pa'o/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhabs drung nas/ /bka' chos nyan nas thos pa btsal/ /thos don bzhin du yang yang bsam/ bsam pa'i nang bzhin bsgoms na bzang / /zhi zhing dul na thos rtags yin/ /nyon mongs chung na sgom rtags yin/ /gnas lugs rtogs na rnal 'byor yin/ /lung rig 'phrod na mkhas pa yin/ /thos bsam mi tshe bsgril gyur kyang / /spang blang mi shes las ro yin/ /de phyir chos mdzad dge 'dun kun/ /thos bsam sgom la nan tan mdzod/ /dge 'dun spyi yis chos khrims sdoms/ /mthon po'i gnya' chog dma' ba skyongs/ /chos min sgrod la chos pa khur/ /nor dang mi chen dgos pa med/ /sdig grogs sbal ba rma can yin/ /dge ba'i grogs bsten de sems zungs/ /da ni mi rgan 'chi la nye/ /kha chems 'jog kyang de las med/ /ces pa 'di ni bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dge 'dun pa rnams la smras pa'o//814

nam mkha' las kyang yangs shing rgya che zhing / /nyi ma 'bum gyi mdangs las rab gsal ba'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs la gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs yid gcig tu 'dres par byin gyis rlobs/ /yangs sar yangs dgos sems kha yangs po dgos/ /'khor 'das chos kun nang du bzhag na yang / /shong bar ma zad da dung yangs khrol ler/ /gnas pa lta bu'i sems kha yangs po dgos/ /khyab sar khyab dgos snying rjes khyab pa dgos/ /mtha' dbus med pa'i nam mkha' gar khyab tu/ /ma gyur 'gro bas khyab pas de dag la/ /snying rjes chen pob/ yongs su khyab pa dgos/ /de ltar stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i dbyengs las ma g.yos bzhin/ /gang la gang 'dul sna tshogs skur bstan nas/ /'gro don byed pa'i smon lam rgya chen dgos/ /sems nyid mkha' las yangs pa'i rnal 'byor ngas/ /dgos 'dod kun 'byung nor bu lta bu yi/ /gdams pa skal ldan slob mar phangs med byin/ /nyams su longs dang dgos 'dod kun 'byung 'gyur/ /ces pa 'di ni rnal 'byor zhabs dkar bas dad can chos mdzad la gdams pa'o/ /dpyi sa dang dme shul mtshams pa sogs slob ma 'ga' res/ mi rtag dran bskul zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor 'di byin/815

'dus byas thams cad mi rtag ste/ /rang nyid nam 'chi nges pa med/ /da snga ma shi kha rje che/ /da ni 'chi ba sleb la khad/ /a tsa ma na 'chi ba 'ong / /da lta myur du 'chi ba 'ong sos dal sdod pa ga la khom/ /gnyid kyang log pa ga la khom/ /nyin mtshan med par chos la 'bod/ /chos pa rab ni 'chi la brod/ /'bring ni mi 'tsher tha ma yang / /mi 'gyod zer ba tsam re mdzod/ /ces pa 'di thon la rang blo dge la skul dang bzang zhes pas/ khong rnams kyis de ltar bton pas nyin re bzhin dge sbyor gong 'phel byung ngo / /nam yang bka' drin 'khor thabs rang med pa'i/ /chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo ni dran byung / /rig 'dzin 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho de dran byung / /bla ma 'jam dpal rdo rje yang dran byung / /drin can de gsum yid la rang dran tshe/ /mig nas mchi ma dbang med du shor song / /dag pa'i zhing khams gang na rang bzhugs kyang / /thugs rje sbyan gyes dus kun tu gzigs shig /gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas rang 'debs so/ /byin rlabs thugs kyi klong nas rang stsol cig /nam zhig 'chi tshe mngon sum du byon la/ /'chi ba chos sku'i gsol 'debs rang mdzod cig /ces bka' drin che ba'i bla ma rnam gsum dran pa'i dus shig la zhabs dkar bas smras pa'o/ /816

dge ba'i bshes gnyen legs bsten nas/ /thos bsam sgom gsum byed 'dod pas/ /ngo mtshar ri mo 'di nyid la/ /ltos dang go rgyu chen po yod/ /tshe rabs kun tu dam pa'i chos /bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen dge ba'i bshes/ /yi dam chos skyong dben gnas grogs/ /yon bdag 'di bzhin 'dzom par shog /de la brten nas mdo sngags chos/ /thos bsam sgom gsum byas pa'i mthus/ /rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas myur thob nas/ /ma gyur 'gro kun 'dren par shog /ces pa 'di ni bde ba can gyi lha khang ngos la thos bsam sgom gsum gyi ri mo bris pa'i gsham du 'di lta bu'i smon tshig cig dgos zhes/ lha bzo ye shes dar rgyas kyis bskul ngor zhabs dkar bas gnas chen de ka nas smras pa'o /steng spyi gtsug pad zla'i gdan steng na/ /rje byin rlabs can gyi bla ma bzhugs/ /bu mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /phas thugs rje ma chung byen gyes rlobs/ /rje bla ma mjal rgyu yod dus mjol/ /phyis zhal ras mi mjal dus shig yong / /gsung bka' chos nyan rgyu yod dus nyon/ /phyis gsung ngag mi thos dus shig yong / /thugs brtse bas skyong dus yun ring sten/ /phyis bsten rgyu med pa'i dus shig yong / /sku bzhugs dus gdams ngag ma zhus na/ /phyis gsung 'bum klog dus 'gyod po 'ong / /zhal bzhugs dus yang yang ma mjal na/ /phyis 817

sku gdung mjal dus 'gyod po 'ong / /khong bzhugs dus zas nor ma phul na/ /phyis gdung mchod byed dus 'gyod po 'ong / /thugs brtse dus dad gus sus kyang yong / /bka' gyon dus dad gus yong ba gyes/ /rkyen med dus jo bzang sus kyang yong / /rkyen ngan pas gtses dus bzang bo gyis/ /skyid 'dzoms dus kha pho sus kyang thon/ /sdug thug dus kha pho thon pa gyis/ /rje bla ma bzang bor mjal ba yin/ /blo yar bskyed dum re yong ba gyis/ /chos zab mo mang bo thos pa yin/ /nang chags sdang nyon mongs med pa gyis/ /yar theg chen chos sgor zhugs pa yin/ /dus rgyun du blo khog yangs bo gyis/ /tshe blo yis btang nas bla ma la/ /nor 'bul rgyu med rung a'u tsi/ /rje bla ma sangs rgyas mthong tsa na/ /sems mos gus chung rung a'u tsi/ /las rgyu 'bras spong len shes tsa na/ /gzhan thos chung zer yang a'u tsi/ /rje bsten dus sgo 'dogs mi gcod par/ /gyes tshar dus dran yang 'phyis pa yin/ /na gzhon dus sgrub pa mi byed par/ /lo lon dus dran yang 'phyis pa yin/ /lus bde dus nyams len mi byed par/ /na 'chi dus dran yang 'phyis pa yin/ /rje bla mas bka' bkyon btang tsa na/ /mos gus kyi 'chor sa yod pas gzob/ /mi ngan gyi spyod pa mthong tsa na/ /snying rje yi 'chor sa yod pas 818

gzob/ /'chi bdag gi bdud dang 'phrad tsa na/ /lta ba yi 'chor sa yod pas gzob/ /rje bla mar mir bzung sangs rgyas de/ /gzhan zhig nas 'tshol ba'i mi tsho ltos/ /sems stong ba 'di las gsal ba med/ /de rang ngo mi shes mi tsho ltos/ /rang gzhan la phan pa smon lam yin/ /de mi 'debs pa yi mi tsho ltos/ /rje'i zhabs tog phyogs su sdug thub pa/ /zhig gyis dang nam mkha' mdzod la dbang / /chos dge sbyor phyogs su sdug thub pa/ /zhig gyis dang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob/ /gzhan don gyi phyogs su sdug thub pa/ /zhig gyis dang kun gyi skyabs su 'gyur/ /rje 'gro mgon gtsang ba rgya ras kyi/ /gsung tshigs su bcad nas dbyangs su blangs/ /glu 'di nyid thos tshad pho mo yi/ /nang sems la phan thogs 'byung bar shog /ces pa 'di ni nyang gi mtshams pa dang / lha khang dbu mdzad sogs rjes 'jug rnams la gdams pa'o/ /rje rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin can/ /steng spyi gtsug bde chen rgyan du bzhugs/ /bu mos gus gdungs pas gsol ba 'debs/ /sems chos dang mthun par byen gyis rlobs/ /rje mtshan ldan bla mar mjal ba'i dus/ /gsung bka' chos mi nyan mi tsho ltos/ /rten dal 'byor mi lus thob dus 'dir/ /chos mi byed pa'i mi tsho ltos/ /chos gsang sngags zab mo'i dbang thob 819

nas/ /lam bskyed rdzogs mi bsgom mi tsho ltos/ /mi skyes tshad thams cad 'chi bar 'dug /rang ma shi gong 'dir lha chos rem/ /gang mthun tshad thams cad 'bral bar 'dug /grogs gang la ma chags lha chos mdzod/ /nor bsags tshad 'chi khar ldus par 'dug /gang yod tshad chos kyi phyogs su thongs/ /tshe stod la btsun pa byas byas nas/ /mthar rgas khar khyim thab byed nyen yod/ /tshe gang bo thos pa byas byas nas/ /mthar rgas khar bza' dpon byed nyen yod/ /tshe stod la ri khrod 'grim 'grim nas/ /mthar rgas khar grong nas 'chi nyen yod/ /chos phyogs med thos bsam byas byas nas/ /rgyud je gyong song ba yi re mug /gnas dben par sgom sgrub mi byed par/ /nyal 'dug pa'i chos pa yi re mug /khong btsun pas 'dul khrims mi bsrung bar/ /chang bud med bsten pa yi re mug /gtam mang bo nyon mongs 'phel ba'i rgyu//tshig lab lob ma mang smra ba chod/ /las bya byed mang bo dge sbyor 'dra/ /sems g.yeng pa'i bya ba thams cad spongs/ /blo mang bo rang sems 'khrul ba'i gzhi/ /sems rang bab zhog dang mnyam bzhag 'ong / /yul yod pa'i chags sdang mthong tsa na/ /pho yul med pa tsho skyid par mthong / /dgon grwa ba'i pho rus mthong tsa na/ /khong ri khrod pa tsho skyid par mthong / /820

nor yod pa'i dka' las mthong tsa na//pho nor med pa tsho skyid par mthong / /grong dgon pa'i nang du sdod dus su/ /sems chags sdang skyon gyis ma gos shig /las dge sgrub sdig pa spong dus su/ /sems g.yo zol skyon gyis ma gos shig /ma 'gro ba gzhan don byed dus su/ /rang 'dod kyi skyon gyis ma gos shig /yid 'ong gi yul dang 'phrad tsa na/ /jo bzang gi 'chor sa yod pas gzob/ /rkyen ngan gyi rlung 'tshub langs tsa na/ /nyams len gyi 'chor sa yod pas gzob/ /tshogs drug gi ltad mo mthong tsa na/ /ting 'dzin gyi 'chor sa yod pas gzob/ /tshe gcig la sangs rgyas thob 'dod na/ /dus rgyun du rang gi sems la ltos//sems btsal na mi rnyed bzhag na mngon/ /dus rgyun du rang sems glod la zhog /'bras sku gsum rang gi sems la 'char/ /gzhan re dogs rgyab tu skyur la thongs/ /nang sems la phan pa'i glu dbyangs 'di/ /rje 'gro mgon rgya ras gsung bzhin blangs/ /glu 'di nyid blangs pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /ma 'gro kun sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces pa 'di yang skal ldan slob bu 'jigs med dang mi bskyod/ban jo sogs bu slob rnams la phan phyir zhabs dkar bas smras pa'o/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i sems kyi dbyengs/ /rjen par ston mdzad bla ma la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal thugs yid gnyis/ /821
