gcig tu 'dres par byin gyis rlobs/ /'gro 'chag nyal 'dug la sogs pa/ /spyod lam rnam bzhi gang gi dus/ /phyi yi yul la mi blta bar/ /nang gi rang gi sems la ltos/ /bltas pas dbyibs dang kha dog sogs/ /mthong med nam mkha' lta bu mthong / /mthong ba'i ngang la lhod kyis glod/ /glod pas bying rgod sprin ltar yal/ /bde gsal mi rtog nyams myong 'char/ /shar kyang chags zhen med par skyongs/ /bskyangs pas sems nyid nam mkha' bzhin/ /nam yang 'gyur ba med pa 'byung / /de ltar ma rtogs sems can la/ /ma las lhag pa'i snying rje 'byung / /'bad rtsol med par nor bu bzhin/ /lam rtags yon tan ci yang 'byung / /skal bzang gdul bya mang bo la/ /phan thogs dpag tu med pa 'byung / /nam zhig 'chi ba chos sku ru/ /grol 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /chos sku'i dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin/ /longs sku sprul sku'i 'gro don 'byung / /glu 'di thos tshad thams cad kyis/ /sems ngo bskyangs nas 'tshang rgya shog /ces pa 'di ni dad brtson shes rab snying rje che ba'i dbus kyi snye mo em jis bskul ngor zhabs dkar bas dben gnas bkra shis 'khyil nas smras pa'o/ /yang slob ma 'ga' res gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa bzang bo nam tshod grol ba yin nam zer ba la/ 'di skad smras/822

seng ge dkar mo'i phru gu de/ /a ma'i mngal nas rtsal gsum rdzogs/ /mngal gyi rgya las grol ba dang / /gangs dkar stod du 'phyo bar nges/ /bya rgyal khyung gi phru gu de/ /sgo nga'i nang nas gshog sgo rgyas/ /sgo nga'i rgya las grol ba dang / /dgung sngon mkha' la 'phur bar nges/ /rnal 'byor pa yi sems nyid de/ /lus kyi nang nas nyams rtogs rgyas/ /lus kyi rgya las grol ba dang / /'chi ba chos skur grol bar nges//zhes blangs pas kun dad cing gus par gyur to/ /dkon mchog gsum la gus pas phyag byas/ /dad can grwa slob sbyin bdag rnams la/ /chos mdzad nga yis 'phrin cig bskur 'bras/ /bcu ba'i nyi shu lnga yi nyin par/ /sangs rgyas kun la sa bka' drin che ba'i/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa/ /dga' ldan zhing du gshegs pa'i dus chen/ /yin pas de'i nyin dge ba byas na/ /sangs rgyas gzhan kun gshegs pa'i dus las/ /'gyur khyad phan yon chen po gsungs pas/ /de phyir nyi shu lnga yi dgong mo/ /gling me la sogs mchod pa phul la/ /tshogs gsog smon lam rgya chen thobs dang / /phan bde 'byung gnas bstan pa dar zhing / /ma gyur 'gro kun bde zhing skyid nges/ /chos la bskul ba'i tshigs bcad gtam snyan/ /thos tshad rnams 823

kyis dga' zhing spro bzhin/ /bcu ba'i nyi shu lnga yi nyin par/ /tshogs bsags smon lam 'debs par gyur cig /ces bcu ba'i nyi shu lnga la gling me mchod pa phul na 'gyur khyad phan yon chen po yod ces dad can la dge bskul du chos mdzad zhabs dkar bas bkra shis 'khyel nas smras pa'o/ /rtsa gsum lha la phyag cig 'tshal nas/ /skal ldan slob ma yon bdag rnams la/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis 'phrin cig bskur 'bras/ /'di dang phyi ma'i bde skyid thams cad/ /tshogs bsags byas las byung bar gsung snang / /de phyir nam 'chi cha med soms la/ /kun gyis tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong mdzod cig /bla ma yi dam mnyes pa'i mchod pa/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dam rdzas/ /bad gan rlung nad sel ba'i sman rta/ /tshe dpal bsod nams rgyas pa'i longs spyod/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dga' ston gtso bo/ /bdud rtsi chang ser 'di nyid yin zhes//bla med tshogs 'khor skabs su bshad snang / /byen rlabs rdzas su bdud rtsi chang ser/ /ka pā li yis gang re phul kyang / /mi la tshe ring nor la g.yang chags/ /zas la bcud yong bsam pa'i don kun/ /'grub ces bla med rgyud las gsung snang / /gsungs bzhin sgrub mkhan yod na yar ngo / /mar ngo'i tshes bcu'i skabs su khyer shog /thos tshad kun gyis dga' zhing spro bzhin/ /bla ma'i 824

gsung bzhin bsgrub par smon no/ /ces pa 'di ni dad can yon bdag pho mo rnams la rnal 'byor zhabs dkar bas gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin 'du ba'i dben gnas bkra shis 'khyil ba nas smras pa'o//chu 'go gangs la thug pa lta bu yi/ /dam pa'i chos kyi 'go yi thug sa mchog /rnam 'dren bzhi ba shākya thub pa yi/ /bstan pa rin po che dang mjal bar shog /phyi ru nyan thos byang sems spyod pa skyongs/ /nang du gsang sngags rim gnyis rnal 'byor brtson/ /gsang ba 'od gsal rdzogs chen don la spyod//o rgyan pad+ma'i bstan dang mjal bar shog /bstan pa grub bzhi lam du 'khyer mkhas pa'i/ /jo bo bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos bla ma'i man ngag bzhi/ /ma nyams gru bzhi lam du 'khyer bar shog /phyogs re tsam gyi grub mtha' ma yin par/ /mdo sngags thams cad gdams par shar ba yi/ /rnam thar gtsang ma dge ldan bka' brgyud pa'i/ /bstan pa rin po che dang mjal bar shog /byang chub sems kyi ngang ba dkar bo yis/ /thabs shes gnyis kyi gshog zung rab brgyangs te/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i mkha' la legs 'phur nas/ /mdo sngags chos kyi dbyangs snyan sgog par shog /de ltar ma nor lam ston dge ba'i bshes/ /gsung bzhin sgrub pa'i chos mthun 825

grogs rnams dang / /deng nas bzung ste sangs rgyas ma thob bar//tshe rabs kun tu 'bral ba med par shog /ces tshe rabs kun tu rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang mjal zhing / rnam mkhyen gyi go 'phang thob pa'i smon lam 'di yang zhabs dkar bas dben gnas bkra shis 'khyil ba nas smras pa'o/ /byin rlabs dngos grub char ltar 'beb mdzad pa'i/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bkra shis shog /chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /nor lha gter bdag rnams kyi bkra shis shog /yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyi bkra shis shog /mi 'gyur lhun po sku yi bkra shis shog /yan lag drug cu'i gsung gi bkra shis shog /mtha' bral dri med thugs kyi bkra shis shog /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi bkra shis shog /nad gdon bar chad zhi ba'i bkra shis shog /tshe dpal bsod nams rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /mi nor zas gsum 'du ba'i bkra shis shog /gnod byed dgra bgegs thul ba'i bkra shis shog /char chu dus su 'bab pa'i bkra shis shog /lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa'i bkra shis shog /rgyal khams bde zhing skyid pa'i bkra shis shog /thams cad chos la spyod pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis dang dge 826

legs bde skyid chen pos 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad la khyab par gyur cig byen chags par gyur cig g.yang 'khyil bar gyur cig phun sum tshogs pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig bkra shis dge legs sarba maṅga lo/rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun zhabs dkar rdo rje 'chang chen pos mchog dman bar ma'i gdul byar rdo rje'i mgur dpag tu med pa yi ger 'khod pa'i nang tshan las/ dbus gtsang sogs nas bzhengs pa kha thor sna tshogs pa'i skor te khyen sdoms mgur tshan zung ri mda'i(572)grangs ldan gyi bdag nyid can gyi pu sta ka gnyis pa'o//827

dam pa gang gi bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba'i ban chung sangs rgyas rin chen gyis bris pa'i bstod tshigan mo gu ru maṅga swa ste sidhi pha la ho/ /sgrib bral gsal stong thugs ni kun gsal dwangs pa'i khyen ltar yangs/ /'gag med tshangs pa'i gsung ni ngag dbang lha mos bsgrun nus min/ /mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar sku yi gzis kyang lhun po'i khengs pa 'phrog /srid 'dir bsnyems ldan kun gyi gtsug nor bdag gi 'dren pa rgyal gyur cig /rmad byung dge legs bye bas legs bskrun gser gyi ri 'dra mtshan dpe'i sku/ /'gro khams dang 'tsham drug cu'i dbyangs kyis theg gsum chos sgra sgrog pa'i gsung / /nyi ma 'bum gyi mdangs las gsal zhing byams brtse'i bdud sde 'joms pa'i thugs/ /mnga' ba'i ston mchog nyi ma'i gnyen der dngos po kun gyis phyag bgyi'o/ /phul byung tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i sa 'dzin spor/ /mtshan dpe'i kho lag rab rgyas g.yur za ngom/ /theg dgu'i 'bras dud stobs bcu'i dpal 828

mnga' ba/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje yongs 'dus ljon par gus/ /rgyal kun 'dus zhal byin mthu'i me drod kyis/ /nyon mongs ha la'i zas tshogs 'ju ba'i 'bras/ /rim gnyis sgo mdongs gdugs mjes ngom pa can/ /rje 'bangs mdongs mtha'i tshogs rnams gtsug gi rgyan/ /byams dang brtse ba'i chu 'dzin rab 'phel tshogs gnyis 'bras char gyis/ /'gro drug duḥ khas gdungs pa rab bcil chos khams dge ba'i gsos/ /bstan gnyis pad mtsho dar mdzad rang gzhan rnam grol lam 'grod zhabs/ /bdag snying pad dkar bzhad par dgyes rol rnam byang bar du skyongs/ /gang thugs pad mtsho'i rtog pa'i rnyog ma rnams/ /chos rgyal man ngag rin chen ke taḥ kas/ /bgrungs byas chos dbyings brgyad ldan dwangs mtsho'i klong / /sna tshogs chos tshul skar tshogs bkra de rmad/ /rtsol med a ti'i dgongs don rtogs pa'i 'bras/ /mtha' med 'gro rnams byang chen dkri ba'i thabs/ /'bad med mgur gye bum bzang 'dod dgu'i gter/ /'dzad med chos sbyin spro mkhas bstan 'gro'i dpyid/ /ma phyis thugs kyi dwangs shel a dar+shar/ /ma 'phos mdo rgyud dgongs pa'i gzugs brnyan rnyed/ /ma 'bad yongs shar —mgur gyi shel bum nas/ /ma lus 'gro la rtsol mdzad bdag gi 829

mgon/ /ba tshwa'i mtsho min gang thugs chos dbyengs dwangs mtsho'i spun/ /grang reg rlung min brtan g.yo'i snang bas bsrubs pa las/ /'chags 'jig sogs min gdul bya 'dod lha'i nyer 'tsho'i gzhi/ /dngos dang dngos min mgur dbyangs lhun po 'khrungs 'di mtshar/ /gang gi gsang gsum thugs kyi gangs ri las/ /legs babs mgur 'bum sna tshogs chu klung 'bum/ /rnam dag dad pa'i sor rtse'i yur bar drangs/ /pu sta ka yi rdzing bur bskyil de rmad/ /nyams myong rtogs pa'i zho 'thung rus las grub/ /mdo rgyud dgongs pa'i lto ba rab tu rgyas/ /lung rigs man ngag rtsibs stong tsha dbal 'bar/ /nyon mongs sbyin skyes mthar byed 'khor lo yin/ /zab zab thugs kyi rgya mtsho'i mjings chen por/ /mang mang gdul bya yul snang ded dpon gyis/ /yang yang phyin blangs mgur 'bum 'dod dgu'i dbyeg /mkho mkho'i re 'bras skong ba'i ma ṇi gaḥ / /thos pas mkhas dbang gzhon nu'i brtan pa 'phrog /bsam pas zag med dga' bde khong nas rgyas/ /bsgoms pas rnam kun mchog ldan bde ster ba'i/ /rnam byang rgyal srid skyong ba'i btsun mo yin/ /rnam dag chos mdzad 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyis/ /gang 'dod las 'grub thar 'dod 'khor 'bangs la/ /blang dor blo gros 830

gsal bar 'doms pa'i gnyen/ /tshig don dpa' mdzangs blon po rin chen yin/ /khungs ldan brgyud pa'i lus stobs rab tu rdzogs/ /mkha' khyab 'khor lor shar ba'i rgyan gyis spud/ /bstan gnyis lha dbang 'degs pa'i lus shed can/ /nyon mongs tshal 'joms glang bo rin chen yin/ /bka' rtags phyag rgya'i dzu 'phrul rkang bar ldan/ /go myong rtogs pa'i spu mdog rnam par bkra/ /zab don mdzod kyi rin chen rgyan chas mdzes/ /sus bsten thar gling skyel byed rta mchog yin/ /sgrib gnyis dpung tshogs 'joms pa'i brtul phod can/ /tshig don phun sum tshogs pa'i dpung gis bskor/ /man ngag zab dgu'i go khrab mtshon chas brgyan/ /thar ba'i dgra 'joms dmag dpon rin chen yin/ /ri khrod dben pa gling bzhir dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /chos mdzad 'khor los bsgyur ba thams cad la/ /mgur dbyangs rgyal sred rin chen sna bdun 'di/ /rtsol ba med par bdag gi mgon des stsal/ /de lta mod kyis mkhas rlom dregs pas rgyal/ /log sred kun dbang 'don dang mdza' ba min/ /byang chub don gnyer 'gro la sems snyom can/ /chos mdzad nga las nu 'dra'i khyad nor yin/ /rtogs pa mchog ldan rnams kyi nyams kyi grogs/ /gnas lugs skyong ba rnams kyi bogs 'byen 831

mchog /sems 'dzin 'ching ba gcod pa'i mtshon cha ste/ /chos nyid rang zhal ston pa'i a dar+shaḥ / /ma rig gnyid las slong ba'i lha yi rnga/ /mi shes rab rib sel ba srid pa'i mig /las nyon na kraḥ mthar byed g.yas 'khyel dung / /legs nyes blang dor ston pa'i bshes gnyen mchog /chos la gsar zhugs rnams kyi grogs kyi phul/ /log lam 'phyan rnams legs lam khrid pa'i gnyen/ /srid zhi'i 'jigs las skyob pa'i 'dren pa dngos/ /ci 'dod re ba skong ba'i yid bzhin nor/ /dgos dgu phun sum tshogs pa dpag bsam shing / /bum pa bzang ltar yon tan dpag yas kyang / /tshur mthong byis pa bdag 'dra'i spyod yul min/ /rang nus tsam zhig dad pa'i sor rtses bskrun/ /kwa ye grogs dag gdams ngag zab dgu'i bcud/ /yid bzhin nor las ches lhag thob dus 'dir/ /rang nyams bstar dang gzhan la 'chad spel sogs/ /'khor lo gsum gyes nyin mtshan 'da' bar bskul/ /nor skyong don med ku co'i ngang tshul bzhin/ /skad gsang mthon pos rjes 'jug yongs la bos/ /'on tang rang mthong grags 'dod ched du min/ /lhag bsam dge bar skyon med snyan sgron no/ /gang gi gsung gsang dpag dka'i rgya mtsho las/ /rab mchog gyur pa rnam mgur pu sta ga'i/ /yid bzhin 832

nor 'di dad gsum yol go ru/ /thob 'di rang mthu ma yin mgon khyod drin/ /tshul 'di bsam gyen da dung rje khyod kyi/ /bka' bzhin ci nus sgrub pa'i mchod pa dang / /chos ldan bya ba las kyi 'khor lo la/ /dal ba spangs nas gsung gsang bsdu bar 'tshal/ /dam pa'i yul la bstod tshig ni/ /man+ta ra yis sngun bsus nas/ /bdag gi legs spyad dge ba'i 'bras/ /byang chub mchog tu bsngo bar bgyi/ /deng nas rnam byang ma thob bar/ /mgon po khyod dang mi 'bral zhing //'di 'dra'i gsung zab bsdu ba dang / /khyod mnyes 'ba' zhig byed par shog /de'i mthus bdag gi sgrib gnyis kyi/ /mun stug rdzogs pa'i thun gsum mthar/ /shar ba'i tshogs gnyis skya rengs kyis/ /legs drangs sku gnyis nyin byed des/ /ma rgan skye dgu'i sgrib pa'i mun/ /mthar byas skal bzang pad+mo rnams/ /lung rtogs kho lag rab brtas shing / /don gnyis bcud kyis gtams par shog /de ma thob pa'i tshe rabs su/ /ngan 'gro'i gnas kyis rab dben cing / /mtho ris yon tan rab rgyas pa'i/ /rten bzang mchog ste bdag gir shog /de yang mi khom rkyen dang bral/ /'byor ba dam pas rab brgyan pa'i/ /bshes gnyen dam pas legs zin te/ /chos khams dge ba rnams 'phel shog /der yang rtag 833

'byor phun sum tshogs//nor bzang rtag ngu'i rnam thar bzhin/ /chos don 'tshol la mi zhum zhing / /de bzhin bsam pa 'grub par shog /zab don legs par rnyed gyur nas/ /tshe 'di don du mi gnyer bar/ /rgya bod rig 'dzin rnam thar bzhin/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par shog /de nas grangs med sangs rgyas shing / /bgrod nas mnyes pa'i mchod tshogs phul/ /de mthus rgyal bas phyag brkyangs nas/ /byang chub mchog tu dbugs dbyung shog /ma dag zhing du sprul ba bkye/ /pad 'byung zhi 'tsho'i rnam thar ltar/ /bstan pas khyab dang ma khyab pa'i/ /'gro la de don 'doms par shog /gang zhig spel ba'i bstan pa de//nam yang nyams pa med gyur cig /ci ste nyams nyer gyur pa na/ /jo 'brom rnam thar 'khyongs par shog /de las nam yang 'da' ma gyur/ /dge ba de yis ma rgan 'gro'i/ /chos khams rim gyes 'phel ba las/ /byang chub ljon shing rgyas par shog /sgrib gnyis dwangs pa'i kun gsal mkhar/ /byang sems sa lam cha shas rdzogs//byang chub mchog gi dkyil 'khor rgyas//'khor ba'i mun pa gtan sangs shog /rab 'byams stong khams rgyal ba'i zhing / /skye 'gro ma lus rgyal bar gyur/ /sgra rnams grag stong rgyal ba'i gsung / /'gyu dran rtog tshogs rgyal ba'i thugs/ /'khor 834

ba'i ming med dag pa'i zhing / /zhing khams rnam dag stug po bkod/ /bkod pa rab rdzogs gzhal yas khang / /khang bzang mchog der rtag rtsen shog /'dir yang chos 'byor phun sum tshogs/ /bshes gnyen mchog de mnyes byed cing / /ma rgan skye dgu phan bde yi/ /dpal la 'god pa nyid gyur cig /khyad par rje btsun bla ma yi/ /mdzad 'phrin kun gsal pha mthar brgal/ /skye 'gro thams cad rdzogs ldan gyi/ /dpal la 'god pa'i bkra shis shog /ces dam pa gang gi bka' drin gyis ratsho ba'i ban chung snyom las pa sangs rgyas rin chen gyis/ rnam mgur rin po che bsod nams kyi bgo skal du thob ste/ ming gzhi'i lam du spel ba'i tshe dga' spro'i bstod tshig smon lam du bgyis pa sarbadzag ti/ dge'o// dge'o//dge'o//835

mjug byang /rgyal kun snying rje'i rang gzugs pad dkar 'chang / /gdul bya'i mos ngor bshes gnyen tshul bsten pa/ /skyabs gcig 'khor lo'i mgon po rdo rje 'chang / /byang chub bar du 'bral med spyi bor bzhugs/ /gang thugs zag bral bde chen mkha' klong las/ /tshad med thugs rje snang ba'i mu khyud kyis/ /rmad byung gdams pa'i gdung byed tsha ba'i zer/ /skal ldan pad dkar tshogs la gang dgar 'gyed/ /kun mkhyen mnyam med bu ram shing ba yi/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa rgya mtsho'i don/ /sna tshogs gdul bya'i khams dbang bsam pa dang / /mthun par stsol mkhas mgon khyod las gzhan gang / /bskal mang sngon nas mngon par byang chub kyang / /grangs med 'gro ba 'dul phyir gzugs kyi sku/ /dag dang ma dag gdul bya'i snang ngo ru/ /dpag med 'gyed la pad 'byung gnyis par nges/ /mdo smad nor 'dzin sa yi thig le ru/ /'khrungs kyang gangs ljongs khyon kun zhabs kyis bcags/ /ris med 'gro ba'i mgon dang skya bas mdzad pa'i/ /snyan pa'i ba dan srid pa'i rtse mor g.yo /mdo 836

sngags zab rgya'i chos tshul rgya mtsho las/ /drangs pa'i legasabashad zla med rin chen phreng / /sdeb legs tshig gi srad buralegs brgyus pa/ /sngon med mtshungs bral rgyan mchog 'di na rmad/ /grangs med zhal gdams glegs bur bkod pa las/ /chos rgyun mi zad rgya cher spel ba dang / /skal mnyam gdul bya yongs la phan pa'i ched/ /ngo mtshar thabs shes grangs kyi pu sta ka /par du bskrun la sngon smon lhag bsam bzang / /bsam dang sbyor bas bshes gnyen tshul bzhin bsten/ /rim gnyis lam la drod thob bya btang ba/ /mkhan po rin chen mchog gis kha 'go mdzad//bzo rigs gnas la mkhas pa'i rigs sngags 'chang / /bskal bzang skyabs kyis par yig legs par bris/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i gzhung lugs mthar son pa/ /sangs rgyas rin chen bzang bos zhus dag byas/ /legs nyes rnam dpyod blo ldan bsam pa bzang / /sgrub pa mchog la gus pa'i dpon po dang / /bla ma'i bka' bzhin dman rnams bu ltar skyong / /bzod brtson phul byung gnyer ba rab byung gis/ /rnam dag bsam pas mthun rkyen tshul bzhin bsgrubs/ /rko mkhan mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang ldan pa'i/ /snyan grags rgya mtsho blo bzang bsam 'grub dang / /ngag dbang bstan 'dzin sogs kyis zhib mor 837

byas/ /sor mo'i 'du byed rtsal las legs par bsgrubs/ /par yon yul phyogs stod smad bar gsum gyi/ /dad ldan slob ma yon bdag rnams kyis phul/ /chos sbyin 'dzad med par gyi gter mdzod 'di/ /mkhas grub du mas byen phab zhabs kyis bcags/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin 'du ba'i gling //dam pa'i bzhugs gnas bkra shis 'khyil bar bzhugs/ /'dir 'bad las byung rnam dkar phung bo gang / /dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs dang thabs gcig tu/ /bsdoms pa'i mthu yis lus can mtha' dag kun/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub la 'god shog /khyad par par 'di bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen la/ /sgo gsum 'brel thogs ji snyed mchis so cog /deng nas bzung ste skye ba'i phreng ba kun/ /theg mchog dam pa'i mgon dang mi 'bral zhing / /zab rgya'i gsung gi rgyun gyis legs bskyangs nas/ /rim gnyis lam gyi bsgrod pa mthar phyin shog /lus can 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig bla ma rje'i/ /zhabs pad rdo rje chos kyi ngo bo ru/ /'gyur med gdong lngas btegs ba'i rin chen khrir/ /bskal brgyar g.yo ba med par brtan gyur cig /phan bde legs tshogs ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /dri med rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che/ /nam yang nub med dbyar gyi chu bo ltar/ /srid mtha'i 838

bar du mi nyams 'phel rgyas shog /bgrang yas 'jig rten khams ni ma lus par/ /chos dang nor dang 'dod pa bde ba sogs/ /rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dus bzhin 'byor ba la/ /rtag tu spyod pas nyin mtshan 'da' nus shog /mgur 'bum gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs su/ /nyin yang bkra shis mtshan yang bkra shis shing / /nyin mtshan rtag tu bkra shis bde legs pa'i/ /bkra shis chen pos phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /ces mgur 'bum gyi mjug tu par byang nyung bsdus bkod pa 'di ni/ dad ldan dam tshig gtsang ba'i dbu mdzad bskal bzang kyis bskul pa ltar/ dam pa gang gi bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba'i slob 'bangs yongs kyi tha shal ba dus mtha'i sngags btsun khyab gdal klong yangs kyis bris pa tshe rabs kun tu rje btsun bla ma mchog gis 'bral ba med par rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig gu/ sarba maṅga lo/839
